verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, - rda allh 'nh - aanna rajulaan, waqa'a biamraaatihi fiy ramadaana faastaftaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an dhalika faqaala ‏"‏ hal tajidu raqabaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ wahal tastatiy'u siyaama shahrayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaat'im sittiyna miskiynana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that a person had intercourse with his wife during Ramadan (while fasting). He asked for the religious verdict (about it) from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said:Can you find a slave (to grant him freedom)? He said: No. He (the Prophet again) said: Can you afford to observe fasts for two (consecutive) months? He said: No. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Then feed sixty poor men
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَفْطَرَ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَأَمَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُكَفِّرَ بِعِتْقِ رَقَبَةٍ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu 'iysaa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi aanna rajulaan, aaftara fiy ramadaana faaamarahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yukaffira bi'itqi raqabaain ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bimithli hadiythi abni 'uyaynaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters that a person broke fast in Ramadan whereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded him to free a slave (as an atonement), and the rest of the hadith is the same as narrated by Ibn Uyaina
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ رَجُلاً أَفْطَرَ فِي رَمَضَانَ أَنْ يُعْتِقَ رَقَبَةً أَوْ يَصُومَ شَهْرَيْنِ أَوْ يُطْعِمَ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, haddathaniy abnu shihaabin, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, haddathahu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aamara rajulaan aaftara fiy ramadaana aan yu'tiqa raqabaaan aaw yasuwma shahrayni aaw yut'ima sittiyna miskiynana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Humaid b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported that Abu Huraira had narrated to him that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded the person (who) broke the fast in Ramadan to free a slave or observe fasts for two (consecutive) months or feed sixty poor persons
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwa hadiythi abni 'uyaynaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated with the same chain of transmitters on the authority of Zuhri
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ احْتَرَقْتُ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لِمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَطِئْتُ امْرَأَتِي فِي رَمَضَانَ نَهَارًا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَصَدَّقْ تَصَدَّقْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مَا عِنْدِي شَىْءٌ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ فَجَاءَهُ عَرَقَانِ فِيهِمَا طَعَامٌ فَأَمَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ بِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'abdi, alrrahmani bni alqaasimi 'an muhammadi bni ja'fari bni alzzubayri, 'an 'abbaadi bni 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - aannahaa qaalat jaa'a rajulun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ahtaraqtu ‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ lima ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala watiitu amraaatiy fiy ramadaana nahaarana ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ tasaddaq tasaddaq ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala maa 'indiy shaa'un ‏.‏ faaamarahu aan yajlisa fajaa'ahu 'araqaani fiyhimaa ta'aamun faaamarahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yatasaddaqa bihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that a person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said:I am burnt, whereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: How is it? He (the person) said: I had intercourse with my wife during the day in Ramadan. Upon this (the Holy Prophet) said: Give charity, give charity. He (the person) said: There is nothing with me. He commanded him to sit down, (In the meanwhile) there were brought to him (to the Holy Prophet) two baskets containing eatables, whereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) told him to give them as sadaqa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَبَّادَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - تَقُولُ أَتَى رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ وَلَيْسَ فِي أَوَّلِ الْحَدِيثِ ‏ "‏ تَصَدَّقْ تَصَدَّقْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلاَ قَوْلُهُ نَهَارًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi althhaqafiyyu, qaala sami'tu yahyaa bna sa'iydin, yaquwlu aakhbaraniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu alqaasimi, aanna muhammada bna ja'fari bni alzzubayri, aakhbarahu aanna 'abbaada bna 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri haddathahu aannahu, sami'a 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - taquwlu aataa rajulun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara alhadiytha walaysa fiy aawwali alhadiythi ‏ "‏ tasaddaq tasaddaq ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walaa qawluhu nahaarana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abbad b. Abdullah b. Zubair narrated that he heard 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) saying:A person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he then narrated the hadith. But (neither these words are found):" Give charity, give charity" (nor) his words:" during the day time
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنَ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَبَّادَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَقُولُ أَتَى رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ احْتَرَقْتُ احْتَرَقْتُ ‏.‏ فَسَأَلَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا شَأْنُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَصَبْتُ أَهْلِي ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَصَدَّقْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ مَا لِي شَىْءٌ وَمَا أَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اجْلِسْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجَلَسَ فَبَيْنَا هُوَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ أَقْبَلَ رَجُلٌ يَسُوقُ حِمَارًا عَلَيْهِ طَعَامٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَيْنَ الْمُحْتَرِقُ آنِفًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَصَدَّقْ بِهَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَغَيْرَنَا فَوَاللَّهِ إِنَّا لَجِيَاعٌ مَا لَنَا شَىْءٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَكُلُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, aanna 'abda alrrahmani, bna alqaasimi haddathahu aanna muhammada bna ja'fari bni alzzubayri haddathahu aanna 'abbaada bna 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri haddathahu aannahu, sami'a 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm taquwlu aataa rajulun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy almasjidi fiy ramadaana faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi ahtaraqtu ahtaraqtu ‏.‏ fasaaalahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa shaanuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala aasabtu aahliy ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ tasaddaq ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala waalllahi yaa nabiyya alllahi maa liy shaa'un wamaa aaqdiru 'alayhi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ ajlis ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fajalasa fabaynaa huwa 'alaa dhalika aaqbala rajulun yasuwqu himaarana 'alayhi ta'aamun faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aayna almuhtariqu anifana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaama alrrajulu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ tasaddaq bihadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aaghayranaa fawaalllahi iinnaa lajiyaa'un maa lanaa shaa'un ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fakuluwhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abbad b. Abdullah b. Zubair reported that he had heard 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), as saying:A person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the mosque during (the month of) Ramadan and said: Messenger of Allah, I am burnt, I am burnt, whereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked him as to what the matter was. Upon this he said: I had intercourse with my wife (in a state of fasting) Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Give charity. Upon this he said: Apostle of Allah, I swear by God, there is nothing with me (to give in charity) as I do not possess anything. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Sit down. So he sat down and he was in this very state when there came a person urging a donkey with a load of eatables upon it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Where is that burnt one who was just here? Thereupon the person stood up. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Give this (eatables brought by the man) in charity. Upon this the person said: Messenger of Allah, can there be anyone else (more deserving than I)? By Allah. we are hungry, we have nothing with us. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: Then eat (these eatables)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ، سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَصَامَ حَتَّى بَلَغَ الْكَدِيدَ ثُمَّ أَفْطَرَ وَكَانَ صَحَابَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَّبِعُونَ الأَحْدَثَ فَالأَحْدَثَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu, sa'iydin haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - aannahu aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja 'aama alfathi fiy ramadaana fasaama hattaa balagha alkadiyda thumma aaftara wakaana sahaabaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yattabi'uwna alaahdatha faalaahdatha min aamrihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out during the month of Ramadan in the year of Victory (when Mecca was conquered) and was fasting till he reached Kadid (a canal situated at a distance of forty-two miles from Mecca) and he then broke the fast. And it was the habit of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to follow him in every new thing (or act). So they followed him also (in this matter)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَحْيَى قَالَ سُفْيَانُ لاَ أَدْرِي مِنْ قَوْلِ مَنْ هُوَ يَعْنِي وَكَانَ يُؤْخَذُ بِالآخِرِ مِنْ قَوْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma 'an sufyaana, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏ qaala yahyaa qaala sufyaanu laa aadriy min qawli man huwa ya'niy wakaana yuukhadhu bialakhiri min qawli rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters. Yahya (one of the narrators) said that Sufyan (the narrator) had stated:I do not know whose statement it is:" It is the last word of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) which is accepted as (final as it abrogates the previous ones)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَكَانَ الْفِطْرُ آخِرَ الأَمْرَيْنِ وَإِنَّمَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالآخِرِ فَالآخِرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ فَصَبَّحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَكَّةَ لِثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ لَيْلَةً خَلَتْ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi qaala alzzuhriyyu wakaana alfitru akhira alaamrayni waiinnamaa yuukhadhu min aamri rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialakhiri faalakhiri ‏.‏ qaala alzzuhriyyu fasabbaha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm makkaaa lithalaatha 'ashraaa laylaaan khalat min ramadaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters that breaking of fast (in a journey) is the final of the two commands (whether one may fast or one may break it), and it is the last command of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) which is to be accepted as final. Zuhri said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) marched on Mecca on the morning of 14th of Ramadan (lit. when thirteen nights had passed)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَكَانُوا يَتَّبِعُونَ الأَحْدَثَ فَالأَحْدَثَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ وَيَرَوْنَهُ النَّاسِخَ الْمُحْكَمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithla hadiythi alllaythi ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin fakaanuwa yattabi'uwna alaahdatha faalaahdatha min aamrihi wayarawnahu alnnaasikha almuhkama ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadlth like this has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Shibab who said that they (the Compnions of the Holy Prophet) followed the latest of his commands and looked upon it as one abrogating (the previous ones) and the most firm
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ سَافَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَمَضَانَ فَصَامَ حَتَّى بَلَغَ عُسْفَانَ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِإِنَاءٍ فِيهِ شَرَابٌ فَشَرِبَهُ نَهَارًا لِيَرَاهُ النَّاسُ ثُمَّ أَفْطَرَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ مَكَّةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ - رضى الله عنهما - فَصَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَفْطَرَ فَمَنْ شَاءَ صَامَ وَمَنْ شَاءَ أَفْطَرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an mujaahidin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala saafara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ramadaana fasaama hattaa balagha 'usfaana thumma da'aa biiinaa'in fiyhi sharaabun fasharibahu nahaarana liyaraahu alnnaasu thumma aaftara hattaa dakhala makkaaa ‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin - rda allh 'nhma - fasaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaaftara faman shaa'a saama waman shaa'a aaftara ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) journeyed during the month of Ramadan in a state of fasting till he reached 'Usfan. He then ordered a cup containing drinking water and he drank that openly so that the people might see it, and broke the fast (and did not resume it) till he reached Mecca. Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) said:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fasted and broke the fast, so he who wished fasted and he who wished to break it broke it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عَبَّاسٍ - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ لاَ تَعِبْ عَلَى مَنْ صَامَ وَلاَ عَلَى مَنْ أَفْطَرَ قَدْ صَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي السَّفَرِ وَأَفْطَرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an 'abdi alkariymi, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni, 'abbaasin - rda allh 'nhma - qaala laa ta'ib 'alaa man saama walaa 'alaa man aaftara qad saama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alssafari waaaftara ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported:Do not condemn one who observes fast, or one who does not observe (in a journey). for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed fast in a journey or he did not observe it (too)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ - حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَصَامَ حَتَّى بَلَغَ كُرَاعَ الْغَمِيمِ فَصَامَ النَّاسُ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِقَدَحٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ فَرَفَعَهُ حَتَّى نَظَرَ النَّاسُ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ شَرِبَ فَقِيلَ لَهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ إِنَّ بَعْضَ النَّاسِ قَدْ صَامَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أُولَئِكَ الْعُصَاةُ أُولَئِكَ الْعُصَاةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, - ya'niy abna 'abdi almajiydi - haddathanaa ja'farun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, - rda allh 'nhma - aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja 'aama alfathi iilaa makkaaa fiy ramadaana fasaama hattaa balagha kuraa'a alghamiymi fasaama alnnaasu thumma da'aa biqadahin min maa'in farafa'ahu hattaa nazara alnnaasu iilayhi thumma shariba faqiyla lahu ba'da dhalika iinna ba'da alnnaasi qad saama faqaala ‏ "‏ auwlaiika al'usaaau auwlaiika al'usaaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to Mecca in Ramadan in the year of Victory, and he and the people fasted till he came to Kura' al-Ghamim and the people also fasted. He then called for a cup of water which he raised till the people saw it, and then he drank. He was told afterwards that some people had continued to fast, and he said:These people are the disobedient ones; these are the disobedient ones
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ فَقِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ شَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الصِّيَامُ وَإِنَّمَا يَنْظُرُونَ فِيمَا فَعَلْتَ ‏.‏ فَدَعَا بِقَدَحٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy alddaraawardiyya - 'an ja'farin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wazaada faqiyla lahu iinna alnnaasa qad shaqqa 'alayhimu alssiyaamu waiinnamaa yanzuruwna fiymaa fa'alta ‏.‏ fada'aa biqadahin min maa'in ba'da al'asri ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Ja'far with the same chain of transmitters and he added:It was said to him (to the Holy Prophet): There are people to whom fasting has become unbearable and they are waiting how you do. He (the Holy Prophet) then called for a cup of water when it was afternoon. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ، بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، - عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ فَرَأَى رَجُلاً قَدِ اجْتَمَعَ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهِ وَقَدْ ظُلِّلَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا رَجُلٌ صَائِمٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَيْسَ مِنَ الْبِرِّ أَنْ تَصُومُوا فِي السَّفَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin jamiy'ana 'an muhammadi, bni ja'farin - qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa ghundarun, - 'an shu'baaa, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni sa'din, 'an muhammadi bni 'amriw bni alhasani, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy safarin faraaaa rajulaan qadi ajtama'a alnnaasu 'alayhi waqad zullila 'alayhi faqaala ‏"‏ maa lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa rajulun saaiimun ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laysa mina albirri aan tasuwmuwa fiy alssafari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported that in the course of a journey Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw a man, people crowding around him and providing him a shade. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said:What is the matter with him? They said: He is a person observing fast. Whereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It is no righteousness that you fast on journey
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَسَنِ، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - رضى الله عنهما - يَقُولُ رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاً بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala sami'tu muhammada bna 'amriw bni alhasani, yuhaddithu aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, - rda allh 'nhma - yaquwlu raaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulaan bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amr b. al-Hasan is reported to have said that he heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with both of them) as saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw a man. The rest of the hadith is the same as mentioned above
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ النَّوْفَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ وَزَادَ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَكَانَ يَبْلُغُنِي عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَزِيدُ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ وَفِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ عَلَيْكُمْ بِرُخْصَةِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي رَخَّصَ لَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا سَأَلْتُهُ لَمْ يَحْفَظْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aahmadu bnu 'uthmaana alnnawfaliyyu, haddathanaa aabuw daawuda, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwahu wazaada qaala shu'baau wakaana yablughuniy 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin aannahu kaana yaziydu fiy hadhaa alhadiythi wafiy hadhaa aliisnaadi aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ 'alaykum birukhsaai alllahi alladhiy rakhhasa lakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala falammaa saaaltuhu lam yahfazhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition that he (the Holy Prophet) said:" Take advantage of the concession of Allah Who Wanted it to you." When he (one of the narrators) asked him (the other one, Yabya b. Abi Kathar) he did not retain it in his mind
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ غَزَوْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِسِتَّ عَشْرَةَ مَضَتْ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ فَمِنَّا مَنْ صَامَ وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَفْطَرَ فَلَمْ يَعِبِ الصَّائِمُ عَلَى الْمُفْطِرِ وَلاَ الْمُفْطِرُ عَلَى الصَّائِمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haddaabu bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamu bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, - rda allh 'nh - qaala ghazawnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lisitta 'ashraaa madat min ramadaana faminnaa man saama waminnaa man aaftara falam ya'ibi alssaaiimu 'alaa almuftiri walaa almuftiru 'alaa alssaaiimi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported:We went out on an expedition with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the 16th of Ramadan. Some of us fasted and some of us broke the fast. But neither the observer of the fast found fault with one who broke it, nor the breaker of the fast found fault with one who observed it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ التَّيْمِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ نُوحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَامِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ هَمَّامٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ التَّيْمِيِّ وَعُمَرَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ وَهِشَامٍ لِثَمَانَ عَشْرَةَ خَلَتْ وَفِي حَدِيثِ سَعِيدٍ فِي ثِنْتَىْ عَشْرَةَ ‏.‏ وَشُعْبَةَ لِسَبْعَ عَشْرَةَ أَوْ تِسْعَ عَشْرَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'ani alttaymiyyi, h wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa shu'baau, waqaala abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin, haddathanaa hishaamun, waqaala abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa saalimu bnu nuwhin, haddathanaa 'umaru ya'niy abna 'aamirin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, 'an sa'iydin, kulluhum 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi hammaamin ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi alttaymiyyi wa'umara bni 'aamirin wahishaamin lithamaana 'ashraaa khalat wafiy hadiythi sa'iydin fiy thintaa 'ashraaa ‏.‏ washu'baaa lisab'a 'ashraaa aaw tis'a 'ashraaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters by different narrators (except this difference) that in the hadith transmitted by Taimi and Umar b. Amir and Hisham (the date of setting out is) 18th, and in the hadith transmitted by Sa'id it is the 12th, and in the one transmitted by Shu'ba it is the 17th or 19th
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ - عَنْ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ كُنَّا نُسَافِرُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَمَضَانَ فَمَا يُعَابُ عَلَى الصَّائِمِ صَوْمُهُ وَلاَ عَلَى الْمُفْطِرِ إِفْطَارُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathanaa bishrun, - ya'niy abna mufaddalin - 'an aabiy maslamaaa, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, - rda allh 'nh - qaala kunnaa nusaafiru ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ramadaana famaa yu'aabu 'alaa alssaaiimi sawmuhu walaa 'alaa almuftiri iiftaaruhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported:We went out on an expedition with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during Ramadan and neither the observer of the fast was found fault with for his fasting, nor the breaker of the fast for breaking it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ كُنَّا نَغْزُو مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَمَضَانَ فَمِنَّا الصَّائِمُ وَمِنَّا الْمُفْطِرُ فَلاَ يَجِدُ الصَّائِمُ عَلَى الْمُفْطِرِ وَلاَ الْمُفْطِرُ عَلَى الصَّائِمِ يَرَوْنَ أَنَّ مَنْ وَجَدَ قُوَّةً فَصَامَ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ حَسَنٌ وَيَرَوْنَ أَنَّ مَنْ وَجَدَ ضَعْفًا فَأَفْطَرَ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ حَسَنٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, - rda allh 'nh - qaala kunnaa naghzuw ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ramadaana faminnaa alssaaiimu waminnaa almuftiru falaa yajidu alssaaiimu 'alaa almuftiri walaa almuftiru 'alaa alssaaiimi yarawna aanna man wajada quwwaaan fasaama faiinna dhalika hasanun wayarawna aanna man wajada da'fana faaaftara faiinna dhalika hasanun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported:We went out on an expedition with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during Ramadan. Some of us observed the fast and some of us broke it. Neither the observer of the fast had any grudge against one who broke it, nor the breaker of the fast had any grudge against one who had fasted They knew that he who had strength enough (to bear its rigour) fasted and that was good, and they also found that he who felt weakness (and could not bear the burden) broke it, and that was also good
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، وَسَهْلُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، وَسُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَحُسَيْنُ، بْنُ حُرَيْثٍ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ، - قَالَ سَعِيدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، - عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا نَضْرَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، وَجَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - رضى الله عنهم - قَالاَ سَافَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَصُومُ الصَّائِمُ وَيُفْطِرُ الْمُفْطِرُ فَلاَ يَعِيبُ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'amrinw alaash'athiyyu, wasahlu bnu 'uthmaana, wasuwaydu bnu sa'iydin, wahusaynu, bnu huraythin kulluhum 'an marwaana, - qaala sa'iydun aakhbaranaa marwaanu bnu mu'aawiyaaa, - 'an 'aasimin, qaala sami'tu aabaa nadraaa, yuhaddithu 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, wajaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, - rda allh 'nhm - qaalaa saafarnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fayasuwmu alssaaiimu wayuftiru almuftiru falaa ya'iybu ba'duhum 'alaa ba'din ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Nadra reported Abu Sa'id al. Khudri and Jabir b. Abdullah as saying:We travelled with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The observer of the fast observed it, and the breaker of the fast broke it, but none of them found fault with each other
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ سُئِلَ أَنَسٌ - رضى الله عنه - عَنْ صَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ فِي السَّفَرِ فَقَالَ سَافَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَمَضَانَ فَلَمْ يَعِبِ الصَّائِمُ عَلَى الْمُفْطِرِ وَلاَ الْمُفْطِرُ عَلَى الصَّائِمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an humaydin, qaala suiila aanasun - rda allh 'nh - 'an sawmi ramadaana fiy alssafari faqaala saafarnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ramadaana falam ya'ibi alssaaiimu 'alaa almuftiri walaa almuftiru 'alaa alssaaiimi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Humaid reported that Anas (Allah be pleased with him) was asked about fasting during Ramadan while travelling. He said:We travelled with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during the month of Ramadan, but neither the observer of the fast found fault with the breaker of the fast, nor the breaker of the fast found fault with the observer of the fast
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ فَصُمْتُ فَقَالُوا لِي أَعِدْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ أَنَسًا أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّ أَصْحَابَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانُوا يُسَافِرُونَ فَلاَ يَعِيبُ الصَّائِمُ عَلَى الْمُفْطِرِ وَلاَ الْمُفْطِرُ عَلَى الصَّائِمِ ‏.‏ فَلَقِيتُ ابْنَ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ فَأَخْبَرَنِي عَنْ عَائِشَةَ - رضى الله عنها - بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin alaahmaru, 'an humaydin, qaala kharajtu fasumtu faqaaluwa liy aa'id ‏.‏ qaala faqultu iinna aanasana aakhbaraniy aanna aashaaba rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaanuwa yusaafiruwna falaa ya'iybu alssaaiimu 'alaa almuftiri walaa almuftiru 'alaa alssaaiimi ‏.‏ falaqiytu abna aabiy mulaykaaa faaakhbaraniy 'an 'aaiishaaa - rda allh 'nha - bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Khalid al-Ahmar narrated from Humaid who said:I went out and was fasting; they said to me: Break (lit. go back, repeat). He said that Anas reported that the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to set out on a journey and neither the observer of the fast found fault with the breaker of the fast, nor the breaker of the fast found fault with the observer of the fast. (One of the narrators Humaid said): I met Ibn Abi Mulaika who informed me the same thing on the authority of 'A'isha
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ مُوَرِّقٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي السَّفَرِ فَمِنَّا الصَّائِمُ وَمِنَّا الْمُفْطِرُ - قَالَ - فَنَزَلْنَا مَنْزِلاً فِي يَوْمٍ حَارٍّ أَكْثَرُنَا ظِلاًّ صَاحِبُ الْكِسَاءِ وَمِنَّا مَنْ يَتَّقِي الشَّمْسَ بِيَدِهِ - قَالَ - فَسَقَطَ الصُّوَّامُ وَقَامَ الْمُفْطِرُونَ فَضَرَبُوا الأَبْنِيَةَ وَسَقَوُا الرِّكَابَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ذَهَبَ الْمُفْطِرُونَ الْيَوْمَ بِالأَجْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'an 'aasimin, 'an muwarriqin, 'an aanasin, - rda allh 'nh - qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alssafari faminnaa alssaaiimu waminnaa almuftiru - qaala - fanazalnaa manzilaan fiy yawmin haarrin aaktharunaa zilaaan saahibu alkisaa'i waminnaa man yattaqiy alshhamsa biyadihi - qaala - fasaqata alssuwwaamu waqaama almuftiruwna fadarabuwa alaabniyaaa wasaqawua alrrikaaba faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ dhahaba almuftiruwna alyawma bialaajri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported:We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey. Some of us had been observing the fast and some of us had not been fasting. We got down at a place on a hot day. Most of us had the cloth for shelter. There were also those amongst us who sheltered (themselves against the rays of the) sun with the help of their hands. The observers of the fast fell down (on account of weakness). Those who had not observed it got up and pitched tents and watered the mounts. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The breakers of the fast have taken away the reward today
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ مُوَرِّقٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ فَصَامَ بَعْضٌ وَأَفْطَرَ بَعْضٌ فَتَحَزَّمَ الْمُفْطِرُونَ وَعَمِلُوا وَضَعُفَ الصُّوَّامُ عَنْ بَعْضِ الْعَمَلِ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ فِي ذَلِكَ ‏ "‏ ذَهَبَ الْمُفْطِرُونَ الْيَوْمَ بِالأَجْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa hafsun, 'an 'aasimin alaahwali, 'an muwarriqin, 'an aanasin, - rda allh 'nh - qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy safarin fasaama ba'dun waaaftara ba'dun fatahazzama almuftiruwna wa'amiluwa wada'ufa alssuwwaamu 'an ba'di al'amali - qaala - faqaala fiy dhalika ‏ "‏ dhahaba almuftiruwna alyawma bialaajri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was journeying (along with his Companions). Some of them had observed the fast whereas the others had broken it. Those who did not fast girded up their loins and worked, but the observers of the fast were too weak to work. Upon this he (the Messenger of Allah) said:Today the breakers of the fast have gone with the reward
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي قَزَعَةُ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ - رضى الله عنه - وَهُوَ مَكْثُورٌ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا تَفَرَّقَ النَّاسُ عَنْهُ قُلْتُ إِنِّي لاَ أَسْأَلُكَ عَمَّا يَسْأَلُكَ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْهُ ‏.‏ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الصَّوْمِ فِي السَّفَرِ فَقَالَ سَافَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى مَكَّةَ وَنَحْنُ صِيَامٌ قَالَ فَنَزَلْنَا مَنْزِلاً فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّكُمْ قَدْ دَنَوْتُمْ مِنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَالْفِطْرُ أَقْوَى لَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَكَانَتْ رُخْصَةً فَمِنَّا مَنْ صَامَ وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَفْطَرَ ثُمَّ نَزَلْنَا مَنْزِلاً آخَرَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكُمْ مُصَبِّحُو عَدُوِّكُمْ وَالْفِطْرُ أَقْوَى لَكُمْ فَأَفْطِرُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَكَانَتْ عَزْمَةً فَأَفْطَرْنَا ثُمَّ قَالَ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنَا نَصُومُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فِي السَّفَرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni saalihin, 'an rabiy'aaa, qaala haddathaniy qaza'aau, qaala aataytu aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya - rda allh 'nh - wahuwa makthuwrun 'alayhi falammaa tafarraqa alnnaasu 'anhu qultu iinniy laa aasaaluka 'ammaa yasaaluka hauulaa'i 'anhu ‏.‏ saaaltuhu 'ani alssawmi fiy alssafari faqaala saafarnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa makkaaa wanahnu siyaamun qaala fanazalnaa manzilaan faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnakum qad danawtum min 'aduwwikum waalfitru aaqwaa lakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fakaanat rukhsaaan faminnaa man saama waminnaa man aaftara thumma nazalnaa manzilaan akhara faqaala ‏"‏ iinnakum musabbihuw 'aduwwikum waalfitru aaqwaa lakum faaaftiruwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wakaanat 'azmaaan faaaftarnaa thumma qaala laqad raaaytunaa nasuwmu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da dhalika fiy alssafari ‏.‏
verses.translation: Qaza'a reported:I came to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) and he was surrounded (by people), and when they dispersed I said to him: I am not going to ask you about what these people were asking. I ask you about fasting on a journey. Upon this he said: We travelled with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) towards Mecca and we had been observing fast. We halted at a place. There the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: You are nearing your enemy and breaking of fast would give you greater strength, and that was a concession (given to us). But some of us continued to observe the fast and some of us broke it. We then got down at another place and he (the Holy Prophet) said: You are going to encounter the enemy in the morning and breaking of the fast would give you strength, so break the fast. As it was a point of stress, so we broke the fast. But subsequently we saw ourselves observing the fast with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ سَأَلَ حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَسْلَمِيُّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الصِّيَامِ فِي السَّفَرِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ شِئْتَ فَصُمْ وَإِنْ شِئْتَ فَأَفْطِرْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - aannahaa qaalat saaala hamzaau bnu 'amrinw alaaslamiyyu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alssiyaami fiy alssafari faqaala ‏ "‏ iin shiita fasum waiin shiita faaaftir ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Hamza b. 'Amr al-Aslami asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about fasting on a journey, and he (the Holy Prophet) said:Fast if you like and break it if you like
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - أَنَّ حَمْزَةَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو الأَسْلَمِيَّ، سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي رَجُلٌ أَسْرُدُ الصَّوْمَ ‏.‏ أَفَأَصُومُ فِي السَّفَرِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ صُمْ إِنْ شِئْتَ وَأَ��ْطِرْ إِنْ شِئْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, - wahuwa abnu zaydin - haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - aanna hamzaaa bna 'amrinw alaaslamiyya, saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy rajulun aasrudu alssawma ‏.‏ aafaaasuwmu fiy alssafari qaala ‏ "‏ sum iin shiita waaa��tir iin shiita ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Hamza b. Amr al-Aslami asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) thus:Messenger of Allah, I am a person devoted much to fasting. Should I fast during the journey? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Fast if you like and break it if you like
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ إِنِّي رَجُلٌ أَسْرُدُ الصَّوْمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithla hadiythi hammaadi bni zaydin iinniy rajulun aasrudu alssawma ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَنَّ حَمْزَةَ، قَالَ إِنِّي رَجُلٌ أَصُومُ أَفَأَصُومُ فِي السَّفَرِ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu numayrin, waqaala aabuw bakrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahiymi bnu sulaymaana, kilaahumaa 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi aanna hamzaaa, qaala iinniy rajulun aasuwmu aafaaasuwmu fiy alssafari
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters that Hamza said:I am a person much used to fasting. Should I fast during the journey? (The rest of the hadith is the same)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، - قَالَ هَارُونُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ أَبِي مُرَاوِحٍ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الأَسْلَمِيِّ، - رضى الله عنه - أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَجِدُ بِي قُوَّةً عَلَى الصِّيَامِ فِي السَّفَرِ فَهَلْ عَلَىَّ جُنَاحٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هِيَ رُخْصَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ فَمَنْ أَخَذَ بِهَا فَحَسَنٌ وَمَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَصُومَ فَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ هَارُونُ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ هِيَ رُخْصَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مِنَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, wahaaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, - qaala haaruwnu haddathanaa waqaala aabuw alttaahiri aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an aabiy alaaswadi, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an aabiy muraawihin, 'an hamzaaa bni 'amrinw alaaslamiyyi, - rda allh 'nh - aannahu qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aajidu biy quwwaaan 'alaa alssiyaami fiy alssafari fahal 'alaaaa junaahun faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hiya rukhsaaun mina alllahi faman aakhadha bihaa fahasanun waman aahabba aan yasuwma falaa junaaha 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala haaruwnu fiy hadiythihi ‏"‏ hiya rukhsaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur mina alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hamza b. 'Amr al-Aslami (Allah be pleased with him) said:Messenger of Allah, I find strength in me for fasting on a journey; is there any sin upon me (in doing it)? Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It is a concession from Allah. He who took advantage of it, it is good for him, and he who preferred to observe fast, there is no sin upon him. Harun (one of the narrators) in his narration said: 'lt is a concession, and he made no mention of" from Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ رُشَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فِي حَرٍّ شَدِيدٍ حَتَّى إِنْ كَانَ أَحَدُنَا لَيَضَعُ يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْحَرِّ وَمَا فِينَا صَائِمٌ إِلاَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَوَاحَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa daawudu bnu rushaydin, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, 'an sa'iydi bni 'abdi al'aziyzi, 'an iismaa'iyla, bni 'ubaydi alllahi 'an aummi alddardaa'i, 'an aabiy alddardaa'i, - rda allh 'nh - qaala kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy shahri ramadaana fiy harrin shadiydin hattaa iin kaana aahadunaa layada'u yadahu 'alaa raasihi min shiddaai alharri wamaa fiynaa saaiimun iilaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'abdu alllahi bnu rawaahaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Darda' (Allah be pleased with him) reported:We set out during the month of Ramadan with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in such an intense heat that one of us would place his hand over his head (in order to protect himself) against the excessive heat, and none among us was observing the fast, except the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and 'Abdullah b. Rawaha
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ حَيَّانَ، الدِّمَشْقِيِّ عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَتْ قَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ فِي يَوْمٍ شَدِيدِ الْحَرِّ حَتَّى إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَضَعُ يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْحَرِّ وَمَا مِنَّا أَحَدٌ صَائِمٌ إِلاَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَوَاحَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa alqa'nabiyyu, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu sa'din, 'an 'uthmaana bni hayyaana, alddimashqiyyi 'an aummi alddardaa'i, qaalat qaala aabuw alddardaa'i laqad raaaytunaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ba'di aasfaarihi fiy yawmin shadiydi alharri hattaa iinna alrrajula layada'u yadahu 'alaa raasihi min shiddaai alharri wamaa minnaa aahadun saaiimun iilaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'abdu alllahi bnu rawaahaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Darda' reported:We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on some of his journeys on an intensely hot day so much so that a person would place his hand on his head (in order to protect himself) against excessive heat, and none amongst us was fasting but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and Abdullah b. Rawaha
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، عَنْ عُمَيْرٍ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ نَاسًا، تَمَارَوْا عِنْدَهَا يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ فِي صِيَامِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ هُوَ صَائِمٌ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لَيْسَ بِصَائِمٍ ‏.‏ فَأَرْسَلْتُ إِلَيْهِ بِقَدَحِ لَبَنٍ وَهُوَ وَاقِفٌ عَلَى بَعِيرِهِ بِعَرَفَةَ فَشَرِبَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an aabiy alnnadri, 'an 'umayrin, mawlaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin 'an aummi alfadli binti alhaarithi, aanna naasana, tamaarawa 'indahaa yawma 'arafaaa fiy siyaami rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ba'duhum huwa saaiimun waqaala ba'duhum laysa bisaaiimin ‏.‏ faaarsaltu iilayhi biqadahi labanin wahuwa waaqifun 'alaa ba'iyrihi bi'arafaaa fasharibahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm al-Fadl bint- al-Harith reported that some people argued about the fasting of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day of 'Arafa. Some of them said that he had been fasting, whereas the others said that he had not been fasting. I sent a cup of milk to him while he was riding his camel at 'Arafa, and he drank it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ وَهُوَ وَاقِفٌ عَلَى بَعِيرِهِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَنْ عُمَيْرٍ مَوْلَى أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara, 'an sufyaana, 'an aabiy alnnadri, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ walam yadhkur wahuwa waaqifun 'alaa ba'iyrihi ‏.‏ waqaala 'an 'umayrin mawlaa aummi alfadli ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Nadr with the same chain of transmitters, but he did not mention that he was mounting (riding on) his camel
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ أَبِي، النَّضْرِ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ وَقَالَ عَنْ عُمَيْرٍ، مَوْلَى أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an sufyaana, 'an saalimin aabiy, alnnadri bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwa hadiythi abni 'uyaynaaa waqaala 'an 'umayrin, mawlaa aummi alfadli ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Nadr on the authority of Umair, the freed slave of Umm al-Fadl, through the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ أَبَا النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عُمَيْرًا مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ - رضى الله عنهما - حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أُمَّ الْفَضْلِ، - رضى الله عنها - تَقُولُ شَكَّ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي صِيَامِ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ وَنَحْنُ بِهَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَرْسَلْتُ إِلَيْهِ بِقَعْبٍ فِيهِ لَبَنٌ وَهُوَ بِعَرَفَةَ فَشَرِبَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, aanna aabaa alnnadri, haddathahu aanna 'umayrana mawlaa abni 'abbaasin - rda allh 'nhma - haddathahu aannahu, sami'a aumma alfadli, - rda allh 'nha - taquwlu shakka naasun min aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy siyaami yawmi 'arafaaa wanahnu bihaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaarsaltu iilayhi biqa'bin fiyhi labanun wahuwa bi'arafaaa fasharibahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm al-Fadl (Allah be pleased with her) is reported to have said that some people among the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) were in doubt about fasting on the day of 'Arafa and we were with him on that day. I (Umm al-Fadl) sent him a cup of milk and he was halting at 'Arafa, and he drank that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ، الأَشَجِّ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ - رضى الله عنهما - عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ إِنَّ النَّاسَ شَكُّوا فِي صِيَامِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ فَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِ مَيْمُونَةُ بِحِلاَبِ اللَّبَنِ وَهُوَ وَاقِفٌ فِي الْمَوْقِفِ فَشَرِبَ مِنْهُ وَالنَّاسُ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, 'an bukayri bni, alaashajji 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin - rda allh 'nhma - 'an maymuwnaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa qaalat iinna alnnaasa shakkuwa fiy siyaami rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma 'arafaaa faaarsalat iilayhi maymuwnaau bihilaabi alllabani wahuwa waaqifun fiy almawqifi fashariba minhu waalnnaasu yanzuruwna iilayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Kuraib, the freed slave of Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him), reported from Maimuna, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), that people had doubt about the fasting of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of 'Arafa. Maimuna sent him a cup of milk and he was halting at a place and he drank it and the people were seeing him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ كَانَتْ قُرَيْشٌ تَصُومُ عَاشُورَاءَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصُومُهُ فَلَمَّا هَاجَرَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ صَامَهُ وَأَمَرَ بِصِيَامِهِ فَلَمَّا فُرِضَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ شَاءَ صَامَهُ وَمَنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat kaanat qurayshun tasuwmu 'aashuwraa'a fiy aljaahiliyyaai wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasuwmuhu falammaa haajara iilaa almadiynaai saamahu waaamara bisiyaamihi falammaa furida shahru ramadaana qaala ‏ "‏ man shaa'a saamahu waman shaa'a tarakahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Quraish used to fast on the day of 'Ashura in the pre-Islamic days and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also observed it. When he migrated to Medina, he himself observed this fast and commanded (others) to observe it. But when fasting during the month of Ramadan was made obligatory he said:He who wishes to observe this fast may do so, and he who wishes to abandon it may do so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي أَوَّلِ الْحَدِيثِ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصُومُهُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فِي آخِرِ الْحَدِيثِ وَتَرَكَ عَاشُورَاءَ فَمَنْ شَاءَ صَامَهُ وَمَنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَهُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْهُ مِنْ قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَرِوَايَةِ جَرِيرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu numayrin, 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkur fiy aawwali alhadiythi wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasuwmuhu ‏.‏ waqaala fiy akhiri alhadiythi wataraka 'aashuwraa'a faman shaa'a saamahu waman shaa'a tarakahu ‏.‏ walam yaj'alhu min qawli alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm kariwaayaai jariyrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters, but he made no mention in the first part of the hadith that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe fast, and said about the second part that he abandoned the (fast) of Ashura, and he who wished observed the fast and who wished otherwise abandoned it, and he did not hold it as the words of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as mentioned in the narration transmitted by Jarir
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - أَنَّ يَوْمَ، عَاشُورَاءَ كَانَ يُصَامُ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ الإِسْلاَمُ مَنْ شَاءَ صَامَهُ وَمَنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - aanna yawma, 'aashuwraa'a kaana yusaamu fiy aljaahiliyyaai falammaa jaa'a aliislaamu man shaa'a saamahu waman shaa'a tarakahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported. In the pre-Islamic days fast was observed on the day of Ashura, but with the advent of Islam (its position was ascertained as that of a voluntary fast). Then he who wished to fast fasted, and he who liked to abandon it abandoned it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُ بِصِيَامِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفْرَضَ رَمَضَانُ فَلَمَّا فُرِضَ رَمَضَانُ كَانَ مَنْ شَاءَ صَامَ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ وَمَنْ شَاءَ أَفْطَرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaamuru bisiyaamihi qabla aan yufrada ramadaanu falammaa furida ramadaanu kaana man shaa'a saama yawma 'aashuwraa'a waman shaa'a aaftara ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had ordered to observe fast (on 'Ashura) before the fasting in Ramadan was made obligatory. But when it became obligatory, then he who wished fasted on the day of Ashura, and he who wished did not observe it (on that day)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، - قَالَ ابْنُ رُمْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، - عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، أَنَّ عِرَاكًا، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ قُرَيْشًا كَانَتْ تَصُومُ عَاشُورَاءَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِصِيَامِهِ حَتَّى فُرِضَ رَمَضَانُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ شَاءَ فَلْيَصُمْهُ وَمَنْ شَاءَ فَلْيُفْطِرْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, jamiy'ana 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, - qaala abnu rumhin aakhbaranaa alllaythu, - 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, aanna 'iraakana, aakhbarahu aanna 'urwaaa aakhbarahu aanna 'aaiishaaa aakhbarathu aanna qurayshana kaanat tasuwmu 'aashuwraa'a fiy aljaahiliyyaai thumma aamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bisiyaamihi hattaa furida ramadaanu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man shaa'a falyasumhu waman shaa'a falyuftirhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Quraish used to fast on the day of Ashura during the pre-Islamic days. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then commanded to fast on that day till (fasting) in Ramadan became obligatory. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:He who wishes to fast should do so, and he who wishes to break it may do so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ أَهْلَ، الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ كَانُوا يَصُومُونَ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ وَأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَامَهُ وَالْمُسْلِمُونَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفْتَرَضَ رَمَضَانُ فَلَمَّا افْتُرِضَ رَمَضَانُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ عَاشُورَاءَ يَوْمٌ مِنْ أَيَّامِ اللَّهِ فَمَنْ شَاءَ صَامَهُ وَمَنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara, rda allh 'nhma aanna aahla, aljaahiliyyaai kaanuwa yasuwmuwna yawma 'aashuwraa'a waaanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm saamahu waalmuslimuwna qabla aan yuftarada ramadaanu falammaa afturida ramadaanu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna 'aashuwraa'a yawmun min aayyaami alllahi faman shaa'a saamahu waman shaa'a tarakahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that (the Arabs of) pre-Islamic days used to observe fast on the day of Ashura and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed it and the Muslims too (observed it) before fasting in Ramadan became obligatory. But when it became obligatory, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:'Ashura is one of the days of Allah, so he who wished should observe fast and he who wished otherwise should abandon it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, wahuwa alqattaanu h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, kilaahumaa 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, ‏.‏ bimithlihi fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah through the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، رضى الله عنهما أَنَّهُ ذُكِرَ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كَانَ يَوْمًا يَصُومُهُ أَهْلُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَمَنْ أَحَبَّ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَصُومَهُ فَلْيَصُمْهُ وَمَنْ كَرِهَ فَلْيَدَعْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa abnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, rda allh 'nhma aannahu dhukira 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmu 'aashuwraa'a faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ kaana yawmana yasuwmuhu aahlu aljaahiliyyaai faman aahabba minkum aan yasuwmahu falyasumhu waman kariha falyada'hu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said that the day of 'Ashura was mentioned before the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him). Thereupon the Messenger of Allah, (ﷺ) said:That was a day on which the people of pre-Islamic days used to observe fast. So he who amongst you likes to observe fast should do so, and he who does not like it should abandon it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ كَثِيرٍ - حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ فِي يَوْمِ عَاشُورَاءَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ هَذَا يَوْمٌ كَانَ يَصُومُهُ أَهْلُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَمَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَصُومَهُ فَلْيَصُمْهُ وَمَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَتْرُكَهُ فَلْيَتْرُكْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ - رضى الله عنه - لاَ يَصُومُهُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُوَافِقَ صِيَامَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'ani alwaliydi, - ya'niy abna kathiyrin - haddathaniy naafi'un, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - haddathahu aannahu, sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu fiy yawmi 'aashuwraa'a ‏ "‏ iinna hadhaa yawmun kaana yasuwmuhu aahlu aljaahiliyyaai faman aahabba aan yasuwmahu falyasumhu waman aahabba aan yatrukahu falyatrukhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wakaana 'abdu alllahi - rda allh 'nh - laa yasuwmuhu iilaaa aan yuwaafiqa siyaamahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say about the day of Ashura:It is a day on which the people of pre-Islamic days observed fast. So he who liked to fast on this day should do so, and he who liked to abandon it should abandon it. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) did not observe fast except when it coincided (with the days when he was in the habit of observing voluntary fasts during every month)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَالِكٍ، عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الأَخْنَسِ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ ذُكِرَ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَوْمُ يَوْمِ عَاشُورَاءَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ سَوَاءً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu aahmada bni aabiy khalafin, haddathanaa rawhun, haddathanaa aabuw maalikin, 'ubaydu alllahi bnu alaakhnasi aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala dhukira 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm sawmu yawmi 'aashuwraa'a ‏.‏ fadhakara mithla hadiythi alllaythi bni sa'din sawaa'an ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the day of 'Ashura was mentioned before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he narrated a hadith like one (narrated above)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ النَّوْفَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ، زَيْدٍ الْعَسْقَلاَنِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ ذُكِرَ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ ذَاكَ يَوْمٌ كَانَ يَصُومُهُ أَهْلُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَمَنْ شَاءَ صَامَهُ وَمَنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'uthmaana alnnawfaliyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu muhammadi bni, zaydin al'asqalaaniyyu haddathanaa saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala dhukira 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmu 'aashuwraa'a faqaala ‏ "‏ dhaaka yawmun kaana yasuwmuhu aahlu aljaahiliyyaai faman shaa'a saamahu waman shaa'a tarakahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the day of 'Ashura was mentioned before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said:It is a day when the people in the pre-Islamic days need to observe fast, so he who wishes to observe fast should do so, and he who wishes to abandon it should do so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ دَخَلَ الأَشْعَثُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَهُوَ يَتَغَدَّى فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ ادْنُ إِلَى الْغَدَاءِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَوَلَيْسَ الْيَوْمُ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ قَالَ وَهَلْ تَدْرِي مَا يَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءَ قَالَ وَمَا هُوَ قَالَ إِنَّمَا هُوَ يَوْمٌ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصُومُهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ تُرِكَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ تَرَكَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin jamiy'ana 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'umaaraaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda, qaala dakhala alaash'athu bnu qaysin 'alaa 'abdi alllahi wahuwa yataghaddaa faqaala yaa aabaa muhammadin adnu iilaa alghadaa'i ‏.‏ faqaala aawalaysa alyawmu yawma 'aashuwraa'a qaala wahal tadriy maa yawmu 'aashuwraa'a qaala wamaa huwa qaala iinnamaa huwa yawmun kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasuwmuhu qabla aan yanzila shahru ramadaana falammaa nazala shahru ramadaana turika ‏.‏ waqaala aabuw kuraybin tarakahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid said:When al-Ash'ath b. Qais entered the house of 'Abdullah he was having his breakfast. He ('Abdullah b. Umar) said: Abd Muhammad (al-Asha'th), come near to the breakfast. Thereupon he said: Is not today the day of 'Ashura? He ('Abd al-Rahman) said: Do you know what the day of 'Ashura is? He said: What is it? He said: It is a day on which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe fast before the (fasting) in the month of Ramadan (became) obligatory. But when it became obligatory the (fasting of 'Ashura) was abandoned (as compulsory). Abu Kuraib said: He (the Holy Prophet) abandoned it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالاَ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ رَمَضَانُ تَرَكَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wa'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, qaalaa haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaalaa falammaa nazala ramadaanu tarakahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated from Jarir on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters and he said (these words with a little bit of variation from the previous hadith):When (fasting) in Ramadan was (made) obligatory, he abandoned it (the practice of observing fast on Ashura)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنِي زُبَيْدٌ الْيَامِيُّ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ سَكَنٍ، أَنَّ الأَشْعَثَ بْنَ قَيْسٍ، دَخَلَ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ وَهُوَ يَأْكُلُ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ ادْنُ فَكُلْ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنِّي صَائِمٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ كُنَّا نَصُومُهُ ثُمَّ تُرِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, wayahyaa bnu sa'iydin alqattaanu, 'an sufyaana, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathaniy zubaydun alyaamiyyu, 'an 'umaaraaa bni 'umayrin, 'an qaysi bni sakanin, aanna alaash'atha bna qaysin, dakhala 'alaa 'abdi alllahi yawma 'aashuwraa'a wahuwa yaakulu faqaala yaa aabaa muhammadin adnu fakul ‏.‏ qaala iinniy saaiimun ‏.‏ qaala kunnaa nasuwmuhu thumma turika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Qais b Sakan reported that al-Ash'ath b. Qais went to 'Abdullah on the day of 'Ashura while he was eating. He said:Abu Muhammad, come near and dine. Upon this he said: I am fasting. Thereupon he said: We used to observe fast and then (this practice) was abandoned
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، قَالَ دَخَلَ الأَشْعَثُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ عَلَى ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ وَهُوَ يَأْكُلُ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنَّ الْيَوْمَ يَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ قَدْ كَانَ يُصَامُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ رَمَضَانُ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ رَمَضَانُ تُرِكَ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ مُفْطِرًا فَاطْعَمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, qaala dakhala alaash'athu bnu qaysin 'alaa abni mas'uwdin wahuwa yaakulu yawma 'aashuwraa'a faqaala yaa aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani iinna alyawma yawmu 'aashuwraa'a ‏.‏ faqaala qad kaana yusaamu qabla aan yanzila ramadaanu falammaa nazala ramadaanu turika faiin kunta muftirana faat'am ‏.‏
verses.translation: Alqama reported that Ash'ath b. Qais went to Ibn Mas'udd while he was eating on the day of Ashura. Thereupon he said:Abu Abd al-Rahman, it is the day of 'Ashura (and you are eating). Upon this he said: Fast was observed on (this day) before the (fasting) in Ramadan was made obligatory, but when it was made obligatory, (fasting on the day of 'Ashura) was abandoned. So if you are not fasting, then take food
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَوْرٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُنَا بِصِيَامِ يَوْمِ عَاشُورَاءَ وَيَحُثُّنَا عَلَيْهِ وَيَتَعَاهَدُنَا عِنْدَهُ فَلَمَّا فُرِضَ رَمَضَانُ لَمْ يَأْمُرْنَا وَلَمْ يَنْهَنَا وَلَمْ يَتَعَاهَدْنَا عِنْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa shaybaanu, 'an aash'atha, bni aabiy alshha'thaa'i 'an ja'fari bni aabiy thawrin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, - rda allh 'nh - qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaamurunaa bisiyaami yawmi 'aashuwraa'a wayahuthhunaa 'alayhi wayata'aahadunaa 'indahu falammaa furida ramadaanu lam yaamurnaa walam yanhanaa walam yata'aahadnaa 'indahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b Samura reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to observe fast on the day of Ashura and exhorted us to do it and was particular about it But when (fasting) in Ramadan was made obligatory, he hence. forth neither commanded us nor forbade us, nor was he so particular about it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، خَطِيبًا بِالْمَدِينَةِ - يَعْنِي فِي قَدْمَةٍ قَدِمَهَا - خَطَبَهُمْ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ فَقَالَ أَيْنَ عُلَمَاؤُكُمْ يَا أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ لِهَذَا الْيَوْمِ ‏ "‏ هَذَا يَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءَ وَلَمْ يَكْتُبِ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ صِيَامَهُ وَأَنَا صَائِمٌ فَمَنْ أَحَبَّ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَصُومَ فَلْيَصُمْ وَمَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُفْطِرَ فَلْيُفْطِرْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy humaydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahu sami'a mu'aawiyaaa bna aabiy sufyaana, khatiybana bialmadiynaai - ya'niy fiy qadmaain qadimahaa - khatabahum yawma 'aashuwraa'a faqaala aayna 'ulamaauukum yaa aahla almadiynaai sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu lihadhaa alyawmi ‏ "‏ hadhaa yawmu 'aashuwraa'a walam yaktubi alllahu 'alaykum siyaamahu waaanaa saaiimun faman aahabba minkum aan yasuwma falyasum waman aahabba aan yuftira falyuftir ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman reported that he heard Mu'awiya b. Abu Sufyan delivering a sermon in Medina. i. e. when he came there (for Hajj). He delivered a sermon on the day of 'Ashura and said:People of Medina, where are your scholars? I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say on this very day: It is the day of 'Ashura. Allah has not made fasting on This day obligatory for you but I am fasting. He who likes to observe fast among you should do so, and he who likes not to observe it may not observe it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy maaliku bnu aanasin, 'ani abni, shihaabin fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab through the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ فِي مِثْلِ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي صَائِمٌ فَمَنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يَصُومَ فَلْيَصُمْ "‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ بَاقِيَ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ وَيُونُسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu fiy mithli hadhaa alyawmi ‏ "‏ iinniy saaiimun faman shaa'a aan yasuwma falyasum "‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur baaqiya hadiythi maalikin wayuwnusa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters that be heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying on a similar day:I am fasting today, so he who wishes to observe fast should do so; but he did not make mention of the rest of the hadith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
