verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, - rda allh 'nh - qaala raaaa rajulun aanna laylaaa alqadri laylaau sab'in wa'ishriyna ‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aaraa ruuyaakum fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri faatlubuwhaa fiy alwitri minhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim reported on the authority of his father that a person saw Lailat-ul- Qadr on the 27th (of Ramadan). Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:I see that your dreams agree regarding the last ten (nights of Ramadan). So seek it on an odd number (of these ten nights)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ لِلَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ نَاسًا مِنْكُمْ قَدْ أُرُوا أَنَّهَا فِي السَّبْعِ الأُوَلِ وَأُرِيَ نَاسٌ مِنْكُمْ أَنَّهَا فِي السَّبْعِ الْغَوَابِرِ فَالْتَمِسُوهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الْغَوَابِرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna aabaahu, - rda allh 'nh - qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu lilaylaai alqadri ‏ "‏ iinna naasana minkum qad auruwa aannahaa fiy alssab'i alauwali waauriya naasun minkum aannahaa fiy alssab'i alghawaabiri faaltamisuwhaa fiy al'ashri alghawaabiri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim b. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that his father said:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: So far as Lailat-ul-Qadr is concerned. some persons among you have seen it (in a dream) in the first week and some persons among you have been shown that it is in the last week; so seek it in the last ten (nights)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ حُرَيْثٍ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْتَمِسُوهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ - يَعْنِي لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ - فَإِنْ ضَعُفَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَوْ عَجَزَ فَلاَ يُغْلَبَنَّ عَلَى السَّبْعِ الْبَوَاقِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'uqbaaa, - wahuwa abnu huraythin - qaala sami'tu abna 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ altamisuwhaa fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri - ya'niy laylaaa alqadri - faiin da'ufa aahadukum aaw 'ajaza falaa yughlabanna 'alaa alssab'i albawaaqiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Seek it (Lailat-ul-Qadr) in the last (ten nights). If one among you shows slackness and weakness (in the earlier part of Ramadan), it should not be allowed to prevail upon him in the last week
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ جَبَلَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ مُلْتَمِسَهَا فَلْيَلْتَمِسْهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an jabalaaa, qaala sami'tu abna 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - yuhaddithu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ man kaana multamisahaa falyaltamishaa fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who is anxious to seek it (Lailat-ul-Qadr) should seek it in the last ten (nights of Ramadan)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ جَبَلَةَ، وَمُحَارِبٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَحَيَّنُوا لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ فِي التِّسْعِ الأَوَاخِرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an jabalaaa, wamuhaaribin 'ani abni 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ tahayyanuwa laylaaa alqadri fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw qaala ‏"‏ fiy alttis'i alaawaakhiri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Seek the time of Lailat-ul-Qadr in the last (ten nights), or he said: in the last nine (nights)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، - رضى الله عنه - أَنَّاللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أُرِيتُ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ ثُمَّ أَيْقَظَنِي بَعْضُ أَهْلِي فَنُسِّيتُهَا فَالْتَمِسُوهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الْغَوَابِرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ حَرْمَلَةُ ‏"‏ فَنَسِيتُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, - rda allh 'nh - aannaalllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ auriytu laylaaa alqadri thumma aayqazaniy ba'du aahliy fanussiytuhaa faaltamisuwhaa fiy al'ashri alghawaabiri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala harmalaau ‏"‏ fanasiytuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I was shown Lailat-ul-Qadr; then some members of my family awoke me up, then I was caused to forget it. So seek it in the last week. Harmala said: (The Prophet did not say:" I was made to forget," but he stated):" But I forgot it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مُضَرَ - عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ، بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُجَاوِرُ فِي الْعَشْرِ الَّتِي فِي وَسَطِ الشَّهْرِ فَإِذَا كَانَ مِنْ حِينِ تَمْضِي عِشْرُونَ لَيْلَةً وَيَسْتَقْبِلُ إِحْدَى وَعِشْرِينَ يَرْجِعُ إِلَى مَسْكَنِهِ وَرَجَعَ مَنْ كَانَ يُجَاوِرُ مَعَهُ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ أَقَامَ فِي شَهْرٍ جَاوَرَ فِيهِ تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةَ الَّتِي كَانَ يَرْجِعُ فِيهَا فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ فَأَمَرَهُمْ بِمَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي كُنْتُ أُجَاوِرُ هَذِهِ الْعَشْرَ ثُمَّ بَدَا لِي أَنْ أُجَاوِرَ هَذِهِ الْعَشْرَ الأَوَاخِرَ فَمَنْ كَانَ اعْتَكَفَ مَعِي فَلْيَبِتْ فِي مُعْتَكَفِهِ وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةَ فَأُنْسِيتُهَا فَالْتَمِسُوهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ فِي كُلِّ وِتْرٍ وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي أَسْجُدُ فِي مَاءٍ وَطِينٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ مُطِرْنَا لَيْلَةَ إِحْدَى وَعِشْرِينَ فَوَكَفَ الْمَسْجِدُ فِي مُصَلَّى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَيْهِ وَقَدِ انْصَرَفَ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ وَوَجْهُهُ مُبْتَلٌّ طِينًا وَمَاءً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa bakrun, - wahuwa abnu mudara - 'ani abni alhaadi, 'an muhammadi, bni iibraahiyma 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, - rda allh 'nh - qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yujaawiru fiy al'ashri allatiy fiy wasati alshhahri faiidhaa kaana min hiyni tamdiy 'ishruwna laylaaan wayastaqbilu iihdaa wa'ishriyna yarji'u iilaa maskanihi waraja'a man kaana yujaawiru ma'ahu thumma iinnahu aaqaama fiy shahrin jaawara fiyhi tilka alllaylaaa allatiy kaana yarji'u fiyhaa fakhataba alnnaasa faaamarahum bimaa shaa'a alllahu thumma qaala ‏ "‏ iinniy kuntu aujaawiru hadhihi al'ashra thumma badaa liy aan aujaawira hadhihi al'ashra alaawaakhira faman kaana a'takafa ma'iy falyabit fiy mu'takafihi waqad raaaytu hadhihi alllaylaaa faaunsiytuhaa faaltamisuwhaa fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri fiy kulli witrin waqad raaaytuniy aasjudu fiy maa'in watiynin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw sa'iydin alkhudriyyu mutirnaa laylaaa iihdaa wa'ishriyna fawakafa almasjidu fiy musallaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fanazartu iilayhi waqadi ansarafa min salaaai alssubhi wawajhuhu mubtallun tiynana wamaa'an ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) spent in devotion (in i'tikaf) the middle ten nights of the month of Ramadan, and when twenty nights were over and it was the twenty-first night, he went back to his residence and those who were along with him also returned (to their respective residences). He spent one month in devotion. Then he addressed the people on the night he came back (to his residence) and commanded them as Allah desired (him to command) and then said:I used to devote myself (observe i'tikaf) during these ten (nights). Then I started devoting myself in the last ten (nights). And he who desires to observe i'tikaf along with me should spend the night) at his place of i'tikaf. And I saw this night (Lailat-ul-Qadr) but I forgot it (the exact night) ; so seek it;In the last ten nights on odd numbers. I saw (the glimpses of that dream) that I was prostrating in water and mud. Abu Sa'id al-Khudri said: It rained on the twenty-first night and the water dripped (from the roof) of the mosque at the place where the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed prayer. I looked at him and as he completed the dawn prayer, (I found) his face was wet with mud and water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنْ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، - رضى الله عنه - أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُجَاوِرُ فِي رَمَضَانَ الْعَشْرَ الَّتِي فِي وَسَطِ الشَّهْرِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَلْيَثْبُتْ فِي مُعْتَكَفِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ وَجَبِينُهُ مُمْتَلِئًا طِينًا وَمَاءً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy alddaraawardiyya - 'an yaziyda, 'an muhammadi bni iibraahiyma, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, - rda allh 'nh - aannahu qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yujaawiru fiy ramadaana al'ashra allatiy fiy wasati alshhahri ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bimithlihi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ falyathbut fiy mu'takafihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala wajabiynuhu mumtaliiana tiynana wamaa'an ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) devoted (himself to prayer) in the middle (ten nights) of Ramadan. The rest of the hadith is the same except for these words:" That he adhered to his place of i'tikaf and his forehead was besmeared with mud and water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ بْنُ غَزِيَّةَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اعْتَكَفَ الْعَشْرَ الأَوَّلَ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ اعْتَكَفَ الْعَشْرَ الأَوْسَطَ فِي قُبَّةٍ تُرْكِيَّةٍ عَلَى سُدَّتِهَا حَصِيرٌ - قَالَ - فَأَخَذَ الْحَصِيرَ بِيَدِهِ فَنَحَّاهَا فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْقُبَّةِ ثُمَّ أَطْلَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَكَلَّمَ النَّاسَ فَدَنَوْا مِنْهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي اعْتَكَفْتُ الْعَشْرَ الأَوَّلَ أَلْتَمِسُ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةَ ثُمَّ اعْتَكَفْتُ الْعَشْرَ الأَوْسَطَ ثُمَّ أُتِيتُ فَقِيلَ لِي إِنَّهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ فَمَنْ أَحَبَّ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَعْتَكِفَ فَلْيَعْتَكِفْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَاعْتَكَفَ النَّاسُ مَعَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنِّي أُرِيتُهَا لَيْلَةَ وِتْرٍ وَأَنِّي أَسْجُدُ صَبِيحَتَهَا فِي طِينٍ وَمَاءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنْ لَيْلَةِ إِحْدَى وَعِشْرِينَ وَقَدْ قَامَ إِلَى الصُّبْحِ فَمَطَرَتِ السَّمَاءُ فَوَكَفَ الْمَسْجِدُ فَأَبْصَرْتُ الطِّينَ وَالْمَاءَ فَخَرَجَ حِينَ فَرَغَ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ وَجَبِينُهُ وَرَوْثَةُ أَنْفِهِ فِيهِمَا الطِّينُ وَالْمَاءُ وَإِذَا هِيَ لَيْلَةُ إِحْدَى وَعِشْرِينَ مِنَ الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, haddathanaa almu'tamiru, haddathanaa 'umaaraau bnu ghaziyyaaa alaansaariyyu, qaala sami'tu muhammada bna iibraahiyma, yuhaddithu 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, - rda allh 'nh - qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm a'takafa al'ashra alaawwala min ramadaana thumma a'takafa al'ashra alaawsata fiy qubbaain turkiyyaain 'alaa suddatihaa hasiyrun - qaala - faaakhadha alhasiyra biyadihi fanahhaahaa fiy naahiyaai alqubbaai thumma aatla'a raasahu fakallama alnnaasa fadanawa minhu faqaala ‏"‏ iinniy a'takaftu al'ashra alaawwala aaltamisu hadhihi alllaylaaa thumma a'takaftu al'ashra alaawsata thumma autiytu faqiyla liy iinnahaa fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri faman aahabba minkum aan ya'takifa falya'takif ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faa'takafa alnnaasu ma'ahu qaala ‏"‏ waiinniy auriytuhaa laylaaa witrin waaanniy aasjudu sabiyhatahaa fiy tiynin wamaa'in ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaasbaha min laylaai iihdaa wa'ishriyna waqad qaama iilaa alssubhi famatarati alssamaa'u fawakafa almasjidu faaabsartu alttiyna waalmaa'a fakharaja hiyna faragha min salaaai alssubhi wajabiynuhu warawthaau aanfihi fiyhimaa alttiynu waalmaa'u waiidhaa hiya laylaau iihdaa wa'ishriyna mina al'ashri alaawaakhiri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed i'tikaf (confined himself for devotion and prayer) in the first ten (days) of Ramadan; he then observed i'tikaf in the middle ten (days) in a Turkish tent with a mat hanging at its door. He (the Holy Prophet) took hold of that mat and placed it in the nook of the tent. He then put his head out and talked with people and they came near him, and he (the Holy Prophet) said:I observed i'tikaf in the first ten (nights and days) in order to seek that night (Lailat-ul-Qadr). I then observed i'tikaf in the middle ten days. Then (an angel) was sent to me and I was told that this (night) is among the last ten (nights). He who among you likes to observe i'tikaf should do so; and the people observed it along with him, and he (the Holy Prophet) said: That (Lailat-ul-Qadr) was shown to me on an odd (night) and I (saw in the dream) that I was prostrating in the morning in clay and water. So in the morning of the twenty-first night when he (the Holy Prophet) got up for dawn (prayer). there was a rainfall and the mosque dripped, and I saw clay and water. When he came out after completing the morning prayer (I saw) that his forehead and the tip of his nose had (traces) of clay and water, and that was the twenty-first night among the last ten (nights)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ تَذَاكَرْنَا لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ فَأَتَيْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ - رضى الله عنه - وَكَانَ لِي صَدِيقًا فَقُلْتُ أَلاَ تَخْرُجُ بِنَا إِلَى النَّخْلِ فَخَرَجَ وَعَلَيْهِ خَمِيصَةٌ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ سَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَذْكُرُ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ اعْتَكَفْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعَشْرَ الْوُسْطَى مِنْ رَمَضَانَ فَخَرَجْنَا صَبِيحَةَ عِشْرِينَ فَخَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي أُرِيتُ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ وَإِنِّي نَسِيتُهَا - أَوْ أُنْسِيتُهَا - فَالْتَمِسُوهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ مِنْ كُلِّ وِتْرٍ وَإِنِّي أُرِيتُ أَنِّي أَسْجُدُ فِي مَاءٍ وَطِينٍ فَمَنْ كَانَ اعْتَكَفَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلْيَرْجِعْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَجَعْنَا وَمَا نَرَى فِي السَّمَاءِ قَزَعَةً قَالَ وَجَاءَتْ سَحَابَةٌ فَمُطِرْنَا حَتَّى سَالَ سَقْفُ الْمَسْجِدِ وَكَانَ مِنْ جَرِيدِ النَّخْلِ وَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْجُدُ فِي الْمَاءِ وَالطِّينِ قَالَ حَتَّى رَأَيْتُ أَثَرَ الطِّينِ فِي جَبْهَتِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, qaala tadhaakarnaa laylaaa alqadri faaataytu aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya - rda allh 'nh - wakaana liy sadiyqana faqultu aalaa takhruju binaa iilaa alnnakhli fakharaja wa'alayhi khamiysaaun faqultu lahu sami'ta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadhkuru laylaaa alqadri faqaala na'am a'takafnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'ashra alwustaa min ramadaana fakharajnaa sabiyhaaa 'ishriyna fakhatabanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ iinniy auriytu laylaaa alqadri waiinniy nasiytuhaa - aaw aunsiytuhaa - faaltamisuwhaa fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri min kulli witrin waiinniy auriytu aanniy aasjudu fiy maa'in watiynin faman kaana a'takafa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falyarji' ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faraja'naa wamaa naraa fiy alssamaa'i qaza'aaan qaala wajaa'at sahaabaaun famutirnaa hattaa saala saqfu almasjidi wakaana min jariydi alnnakhli waauqiymati alssalaaau faraaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasjudu fiy almaa'i waalttiyni qaala hattaa raaaytu aathara alttiyni fiy jabhatihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Salama reported:'We discussed amongst ourselves Lailat-ul-Qadr. I came to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) who was a friend of mine and said to him: Would you not go with us to the garden of date trees? He went out with a cloak over him. I said to him: Did you hear the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) making mention of Lailat-ul-Qadr? He said: Yes, (and added) we were observing i'tikaf with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the middle ten days of Ramadan, and came out on the morning of the twentieth and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) addressed us and said: I was shown Lailat-ul-Qadr, but I forgot (the exact night) or I was caused to forget it, so seek it in the last ten odd (nights), and I was shown that I was prostrating in water and clay. So he who wanted to observe i'tikaf with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) should return (to the place of i'tikaf). He (Abu Sa'id al-Khudri) said: And we returned and did not find any patch of cloud in the sky. Then the cloud gathered and there was (so heavy) a downpour that the roof of the mosque which was made of the branches of date-palms began to drip. Then there was prayer and I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prostrating in water and clay till I saw the traces of clay on his forehead
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي، كَثِيرٍ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ انْصَرَفَ وَعَلَى جَبْهَتِهِ وَأَرْنَبَتِهِ أَثَرُ الطِّينِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi, bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu aakhbaranaa aabuw almughiyraai, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, kilaahumaa 'an yahyaa bni aabiy, kathiyrin bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwahu wafiy hadiythihimaa raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna ansarafa wa'alaa jabhatihi waaarnabatihi aatharu alttiyni ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Yahya b. Abu Kathir with the same chain of transmitters (with a slight variation of these words):I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) after he had completed (the prayer) and there was a trace of clay on his forehead and tip (of the nose)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ اعْتَكَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعَشْرَ الأَوْسَطَ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ يَلْتَمِسُ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُبَانَ لَهُ فَلَمَّا انْقَضَيْنَ أَمَرَ بِالْبِنَاءِ فَقُوِّضَ ثُمَّ أُبِينَتْ لَهُ أَنَّهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ فَأَمَرَ بِالْبِنَاءِ فَأُعِيدَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ عَلَى النَّاسِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ أُبِينَتْ لِي لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ وَإِنِّي خَرَجْتُ لأُخْبِرَكُمْ بِهَا فَجَاءَ رَجُلاَنِ يَحْتَقَّانِ مَعَهُمَا الشَّيْطَانُ فَنُسِّيتُهَا فَالْتَمِسُوهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ الْتَمِسُوهَا فِي التَّاسِعَةِ وَالسَّابِعَةِ وَالْخَامِسَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ إِنَّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِالْعَدَدِ مِنَّا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَجَلْ ‏.‏ نَحْنُ أَحَقُّ بِذَلِكَ مِنْكُمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ مَا التَّاسِعَةُ وَالسَّابِعَةُ وَالْخَامِسَةُ قَالَ إِذَا مَضَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ وَعِشْرُونَ فَالَّتِي تَلِيهَا ثِنْتَيْنِ وَعِشْرِينَ وَهْىَ التَّاسِعَةُ فَإِذَا مَضَتْ ثَلاَثٌ وَعِشْرُونَ فَالَّتِي تَلِيهَا السَّابِعَةُ فَإِذَا مَضَى خَمْسٌ وَعِشْرُونَ فَالَّتِي تَلِيهَا الْخَامِسَةُ .‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ خَلاَّدٍ مَكَانَ يَحْتَقَّانِ يَخْتَصِمَانِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waaabuw bakri bnu khalaaadin qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, - rda allh 'nh - qaala a'takafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'ashra alaawsata min ramadaana yaltamisu laylaaa alqadri qabla aan tubaana lahu falammaa anqadayna aamara bialbinaa'i faquwwida thumma aubiynat lahu aannahaa fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri faaamara bialbinaa'i faau'iyda thumma kharaja 'alaa alnnaasi faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa aayyuhaa alnnaasu iinnahaa kaanat aubiynat liy laylaau alqadri waiinniy kharajtu laukhbirakum bihaa fajaa'a rajulaani yahtaqqaani ma'ahumaa alshhaytaanu fanussiytuhaa faaltamisuwhaa fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri min ramadaana altamisuwhaa fiy alttaasi'aai waalssaabi'aai waalkhaamisaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu yaa aabaa sa'iydin iinnakum aa'lamu bial'adadi minnaa ‏.‏ qaala aajal ‏.‏ nahnu aahaqqu bidhalika minkum ‏.‏ qaala qultu maa alttaasi'aau waalssaabi'aau waalkhaamisaau qaala iidhaa madat waahidaaun wa'ishruwna faallatiy taliyhaa thintayni wa'ishriyna wahaa alttaasi'aau faiidhaa madat thalaathun wa'ishruwna faallatiy taliyhaa alssaabi'aau faiidhaa madaa khamsun wa'ishruwna faallatiy taliyhaa alkhaamisaau .‏ waqaala abnu khalaaadin makaana yahtaqqaani yakhtasimaani ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed i'tikaf in the middle ten days of Ramadan to seek Lailat-ul-Qadr before it was made manifest to him. When (these nights) were over, he commanded to strike the tent. Then it was made manifest to him that (Lailat-ul-Qadr) was in the last ten nights (of Ramadan), and commanded to pitch the tent (again). He then came to the people and said: O people, Lailat-ul-Qadr was made manifest to me and I came out to inform you about it that two persons came contending with each other and there was a devil along with them and I forgot it. So seek it in the last ten nights of Ramadan. Seek it on the ninth, on the seventh and on the fifth. I (one of the narrators) said: Abu Sa'id, you know more than us about numbers. He said: Yes, indeed we have better right than you. I said: What is this ninth, seventh, and fifth? He said: When twenty-one (nights are over) and the twenty-second begins, it is the ninth, and when twenty-three (nights) are over, that which follows (the last night) is the seventh, and when twenty-five nights are over, what follows it is fifth. Ibn Khallad said: Instead of the word Yahliqan (contending), he said Yakhtasiman, (they are disputing)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الأَشْعَثِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، الْكِنْدِيُّ وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو ضَمْرَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، - وَقَالَ ابْنُ خَشْرَمٍ عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، - عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، مَوْلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ، سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُنَيْسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أُرِيتُ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ ثُمَّ أُنْسِيتُهَا وَأَرَانِي صُبْحَهَا أَسْجُدُ فِي مَاءٍ وَطِينٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمُطِرْنَا لَيْلَةَ ثَلاَثٍ وَعِشْرِينَ فَصَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَانْصَرَفَ وَإِنَّ أَثَرَ الْمَاءِ وَالطِّينِ عَلَى جَبْهَتِهِ وَأَنْفِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُنَيْسٍ يَقُولُ ثَلاَثٍ وَعِشْرِينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'amriw bni sahli bni iishaaqa bni muhammadi bni alaash'athi bni qaysin, alkindiyyu wa'aliyyu bnu khashramin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw damraaa, haddathaniy alddahhaaku bnu 'uthmaana, - waqaala abnu khashramin 'ani alddahhaaki bni 'uthmaana, - 'an aabiy alnnadri, mawlaa 'umara bni 'ubaydi alllahi 'an busri bni, sa'iydin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aunaysin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ auriytu laylaaa alqadri thumma aunsiytuhaa waaaraaniy subhahaa aasjudu fiy maa'in watiynin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala famutirnaa laylaaa thalaathin wa'ishriyna fasallaa binaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faansarafa waiinna aathara almaa'i waalttiyni 'alaa jabhatihi waaanfihi ‏.‏ qaala wakaana 'abdu alllahi bnu aunaysin yaquwlu thalaathin wa'ishriyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Unais reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I was shown Lailat-ul-Qadr; then I was made to forget it, and saw that I was prostrating in water and clay in the morning of that (night). He (the narrator) said: There was a downpour on the twenty-third night and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in prayer, and as he went back, there was a trace of water and clay on his forehead and on his nose. He (the narrator) said: 'Abdullah b. Unais used to say that it was the twenty-third (night)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ ‏ "‏ الْتَمِسُوا - وَقَالَ وَكِيعٌ - تَحَرَّوْا لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, wawakiy'un, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala abnu numayrin ‏ "‏ altamisuwa - waqaala wakiy'un - taharrawa laylaaa alqadri fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri min ramadaana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) and Ibn Numair reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Look for (and in the words of Waki, seek) Lailat-ul-Qadr in the last ten nights of Ramadan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنْ عَبْدَةَ، وَعَاصِمِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّجُودِ، سَمِعَا زِرَّ بْنَ حُبَيْشٍ، يَقُولُ سَأَلْتُ أُبَىَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ - رضى الله عنه - فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ أَخَاكَ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ يَقُولُ مَنْ يَقُمِ الْحَوْلَ يُصِبْ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ أَرَادَ أَنْ لاَ يَتَّكِلَ النَّاسُ أَمَا إِنَّهُ قَدْ عَلِمَ أَنَّهَا فِي رَمَضَانَ وَأَنَّهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ وَأَنَّهَا لَيْلَةُ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ حَلَفَ لاَ يَسْتَثْنِي أَنَّهَا لَيْلَةُ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ فَقُلْتُ بِأَىِّ شَىْءٍ تَقُولُ ذَلِكَ يَا أَبَا الْمُنْذِرِ قَالَ بِالْعَلاَمَةِ أَوْ بِالآيَةِ الَّتِي أَخْبَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا تَطْلُعُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لاَ شُعَاعَ لَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu haatimin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, kilaahumaa 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, - qaala abnu haatimin haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - 'an 'abdaaa, wa'aasimi bni aabiy alnnajuwdi, sami'aa zirra bna hubayshin, yaquwlu saaaltu aubaaaa bna ka'bin - rda allh 'nh - faqultu iinna aakhaaka abna mas'uwdin yaquwlu man yaqumi alhawla yusib laylaaa alqadri ‏.‏ faqaala rahimahu alllahu aaraada aan laa yattakila alnnaasu aamaa iinnahu qad 'alima aannahaa fiy ramadaana waaannahaa fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri waaannahaa laylaau sab'in wa'ishriyna ‏.‏ thumma halafa laa yastathniy aannahaa laylaau sab'in wa'ishriyna faqultu biaaaai shaa'in taquwlu dhalika yaa aabaa almundhiri qaala bial'alaamaai aaw bialayaai allatiy aakhbaranaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa tatlu'u yawmaiidhin laa shu'aa'a lahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zirr b. Habaish reported:I thu asked Ubayy b. Ka'b (Allah be pleased with him): Your brother (in faith) Ibn Mas'ud says: He who stands (for the night prayer) throughout the year would find Lailat-ul-Qadr, whereupon he said: May Allah have mercy upon him; (he said these words) with the intention that people might not rely only (on one night), whereas he knew that it (Lailat-ul-Qadr) is in the month of Ramadan and it is the twenty-seventh night. He then took oath (without making any exception, i. e. without saying In sha Allah) that it was the twenty-seventh night. I said to him: Abu Mundhir, on what ground do you say that? Thereupon he said: By the indication or by the sign which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave us, and that is that on that day (the sun) would rise without having any ray in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَةَ، بْنَ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ قَالَ أُبَىٌّ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُهَا - قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَأَكْبَرُ عِلْمِي - هِيَ اللَّيْلَةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقِيَامِهَا هِيَ لَيْلَةُ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ ‏.‏ وَإِنَّمَا شَكَّ شُعْبَةُ فِي هَذَا الْحَرْفِ هِيَ اللَّيْلَةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَنَا بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي بِهَا صَاحِبٌ لِي عَنْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu 'abdaaa, bna aabiy lubaabaaa yuhaddithu 'an zirri bni hubayshin, 'an aubaaai bni ka'bin, - rda allh 'nh - qaala qaala aubaaaun fiy laylaai alqadri waalllahi iinniy laa'lamuhaa - qaala shu'baau waaakbaru 'ilmiy - hiya alllaylaau allatiy aamaranaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biqiyaamihaa hiya laylaau sab'in wa'ishriyna ‏.‏ waiinnamaa shakka shu'baau fiy hadhaa alharfi hiya alllaylaau allatiy aamaranaa bihaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaala wahaddathaniy bihaa saahibun liy 'anhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zirr b. Hubaish reported that Ubayy b. Ka'b (Allah be pleased with him) said about Lailat-ul-Qadr:By Allah, I know well about it. Shu'ba said: To the best of my knowledge it was the twenty-seventh night for which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to stand for prayer. Shu'ba doubted these words: That it was the night for which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to stand for prayer. And (he further) said: This was narrated to me by a friend of mine from him (the Holy Prophet)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، - وَهُوَ الْفَزَارِيُّ - عَنْ يَزِيدَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ كَيْسَانَ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ تَذَاكَرْنَا لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيُّكُمْ يَذْكُرُ حِينَ طَلَعَ الْقَمَرُ وَهُوَ مِثْلُ شِقِّ جَفْنَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaalaa haddathanaa marwaanu, - wahuwa alfazaariyyu - 'an yaziyda, - wahuwa abnu kaysaana - 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, - rda allh 'nh - qaala tadhaakarnaa laylaaa alqadri 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ aayyukum yadhkuru hiyna tala'a alqamaru wahuwa mithlu shiqqi jafnaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported:We were talking about Lailat-ul-Qadr in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: He who amongst you remembers (the night) when the moon arose and it was like a piece of plate (at the fag end of the month in a state of waning)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الرَّازِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَعْتَكِفُ فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu mihraana alrraaziyyu, haddathanaa haatimu bnu iismaa'iyla, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana ya'takifu fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri min ramadaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe i'tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّ نَافِعًا، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَعْتَكِفُ الْعَشْرَ الأَوَاخِرَ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَافِعٌ وَقَدْ أَرَانِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ - رضى الله عنه - الْمَكَانَ الَّذِي كَانَ يَعْتَكِفُ فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu bnu yaziyda, aanna naafi'ana, haddathahu 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana ya'takifu al'ashra alaawaakhira min ramadaana ‏.‏ qaala naafi'un waqad aaraaniy 'abdu alllahi - rda allh 'nh - almakaana alladhiy kaana ya'takifu fiyhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina almasjidi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe i'tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan. Nafi' said:Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) showed me the place in the mosque where the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe i'tikaf
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ السَّكُونِيُّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْتَكِفُ الْعَشْرَ الأَوَاخِرَ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa sahlu bnu 'uthmaana, haddathanaa 'uqbaau bnu khaalidin alssakuwniyyu, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'takifu al'ashra alaawaakhira min ramadaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe i'tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُمَا - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْتَكِفُ الْعَشْرَ الأَوَاخِرَ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaa sahlu bnu 'uthmaana, aakhbaranaa hafsu bnu ghiyaathin, jamiy'ana 'an hishaamin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu lahumaa - qaalaa haddathanaa abnu numayrin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'takifu al'ashra alaawaakhira min ramadaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَعْتَكِفُ الْعَشْرَ الأَوَاخِرَ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ حَتَّى تَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ثُمَّ اعْتَكَفَ أَزْوَاجُهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana ya'takifu al'ashra alaawaakhira min ramadaana hattaa tawaffaahu alllahu 'azza wajalla thumma a'takafa aazwaajuhu min ba'dihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) used to observe i'tikif in the last ten days of Ramadan till Allah called him back (to his heavenly home). Then his wives observed i'tikaf after him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَعْتَكِفَ صَلَّى الْفَجْرَ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ مُعْتَكَفَهُ وَإِنَّهُ أَمَرَ بِخِبَائِهِ فَضُرِبَ أَرَادَ الاِعْتِكَافَ فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ فَأَمَرَتْ زَيْنَبُ بِخِبَائِهَا فَضُرِبَ وَأَمَرَ غَيْرُهَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِخِبَائِهِ فَضُرِبَ فَلَمَّا صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْفَجْرَ نَظَرَ فَإِذَا الأَخْبِيَةُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ آلْبِرَّ تُرِدْنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِخِبَائِهِ فَقُوِّضَ وَتَرَكَ الاِعْتِكَافَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ حَتَّى اعْتَكَفَ فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَّلِ مِنْ شَوَّالٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aaraada aan ya'takifa sallaa alfajra thumma dakhala mu'takafahu waiinnahu aamara bikhibaaiihi faduriba aaraada alai'tikaafa fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri min ramadaana faaamarat zaynabu bikhibaaiihaa faduriba waaamara ghayruhaa min aazwaaji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bikhibaaiihi faduriba falammaa sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alfajra nazara faiidhaa alaakhbiyaau faqaala ‏ "‏ albirra turidna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaamara bikhibaaiihi faquwwida wataraka alai'tikaafa fiy shahri ramadaana hattaa a'takafa fiy al'ashri alaawwali min shawwaalin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) decided to observe i'tikaf, he prayed in the morning and then went to the place of his i'tikaf, and he commanded that a tent should be pitched for him, and it was pitched. He (once) decided to observe i'tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan. Zainab (the wife of the Holy Prophet) commanded that a tent should be pitched for her. It was pitched accordingly. And some other wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) commanded that tents should be pitched for them too. And they were pitched. When the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) offered the morning prayer, he looked and found (so many) tents. Thereupon he said:What is this virtue that these (ladies) have decided to acquire? He commanded his tent to be struck and abandoned i'tikaf in the month of Ramadan and postponed it to the first ten days of Shawwal
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ، وَهْبٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنِ ابْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ، سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ وَعَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ وَابْنِ إِسْحَاقَ ذِكْرُ عَائِشَةَ وَحَفْصَةَ وَزَيْنَبَ - رضى الله عنهن - أَنَّهُنَّ ضَرَبْنَ الأَخْبِيَةَ لِلاِعْتِكَافِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, h wahaddathaniy 'amruw bnu sawwaadin, aakhbaranaa abnu, wahbin aakhbaranaa 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa aabuw aahmada, haddathanaa sufyaanu, h wahaddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa aabuw almughiyraai, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa aabiy, 'ani abni iishaaqa, kullu hauulaa'i 'an yahyaa bni, sa'iydin 'an 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi aabiy mu'aawiyaaa ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi abni 'uyaynaaa wa'amriw bni alhaarithi waabni iishaaqa dhikru 'aaiishaaa wahafsaaa wazaynaba - rda allh 'nhn - aannahunna darabna alaakhbiyaaa lilai'tikaafi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported through another chain of transmitters, and there it is mentioned that. 'A'isha, Hafsa and Zainab (Allah be pleased with them) pitched the tents for i'tikaf
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ صُبَيْحٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا دَخَلَ الْعَشْرُ أَحْيَا اللَّيْلَ وَأَيْقَظَ أَهْلَهُ وَجَدَّ وَشَدَّ الْمِئْزَرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, waabnu aabiy 'umara, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - 'an aabiy ya'fuwrin, 'an muslimi bni subayhin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa dakhala al'ashru aahyaa alllayla waaayqaza aahlahu wajadda washadda almiizara ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that when the last ten nights began Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept awake at night (for prayer and devotion), wakened his family, and prepared himself to observe prayer (with more vigour)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، - قَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ الأَسْوَدَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، يَقُولُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ رضى الله عنها كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَجْتَهِدُ فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ مَا لاَ يَجْتَهِدُ فِي غَيْرِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi alwaahidi bni ziyaadin, - qaala qutaybaau haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, - 'ani alhasani bni 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala sami'tu iibraahiyma, yaquwlu sami'tu alaaswada bna yaziyda, yaquwlu qaalat 'aaiishaau rda allh 'nha kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yajtahidu fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri maa laa yajtahidu fiy ghayrihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to exert himself in devotion during the last ten nights to a greater extent than at any other time
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، الآخَرَانِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَائِمًا فِي الْعَشْرِ قَطُّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin waiishaaqu qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala, alakharaani haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat maa raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm saaiimana fiy al'ashri qattu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I never saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fasting in the ten days of Dhu'I-Hijja
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَصُمِ الْعَشْرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu naafi'in al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm lam yasumi al'ashra ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) did not observe fast in the ten days of Dhul-Hijja
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ مِنَ الثِّيَابِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَلْبَسُوا الْقُمُصَ وَلاَ الْعَمَائِمَ وَلاَ السَّرَاوِيلاَتِ وَلاَ الْبَرَانِسَ وَلاَ الْخِفَافَ إِلاَّ أَحَدٌ لاَ يَجِدُ النَّعْلَيْنِ فَلْيَلْبَسِ الْخُفَّيْنِ وَلْيَقْطَعْهُمَا أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ وَلاَ تَلْبَسُوا مِنَ الثِّيَابِ شَيْئًا مَسَّهُ الزَّعْفَرَانُ وَلاَ الْوَرْسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - aanna rajulaan, saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa yalbasu almuhrimu mina althhiyaabi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa talbasuwa alqumusa walaa al'amaaiima walaa alssaraawiylaati walaa albaraanisa walaa alkhifaafa iilaaa aahadun laa yajidu alnna'layni falyalbasi alkhuffayni walyaqta'humaa aasfala mina alka'bayni walaa talbasuwa mina althhiyaabi shayiana massahu alzza'faraanu walaa alwarsu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that a person asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) what a Muhrim should put on as dress. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Do not put on a shirt or a turban, or trousers or a cap, or leather stockings except one who does not find shoes; he may put on stockings but he should trim them below the ankles. And do not wear clothes to which saffron or wars is applied
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ الْقَمِيصَ وَلاَ الْعِمَامَةَ وَلاَ الْبُرْنُسَ وَلاَ السَّرَاوِيلَ وَلاَ ثَوْبًا مَسَّهُ وَرْسٌ وَلاَ زَعْفَرَانٌ وَلاَ الْخُفَّيْنِ إِلاَّ أَنْ لاَ يَجِدَ نَعْلَيْنِ فَلْيَقْطَعْهُمَا حَتَّى يَكُونَا أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, kulluhum 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, - rda allh 'nh - qaala suiila alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm maa yalbasu almuhrimu qaala ‏ "‏ laa yalbasu almuhrimu alqamiysa walaa al'imaamaaa walaa alburnusa walaa alssaraawiyla walaa thawbana massahu warsun walaa za'faraanun walaa alkhuffayni iilaaa aan laa yajida na'layni falyaqta'humaa hattaa yakuwnaa aasfala mina alka'bayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim reported on the authority of his father ('Abdullah b. 'Umar) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked what a Muhrim should wear, whereupon he said:A Muhrim should not wear a shirt, or a turban, or a cap, or trousers, or a cloth touched with wars or with saffron, nor (should he wear) stockings, but in case he does not find shoes, but (before wearing stockings) be should trim them (in such a way) that these should become lower than the ankles
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّهُ قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَلْبَسَ الْمُحْرِمُ ثَوْبًا مَصْبُوغًا بِزَعْفَرَانٍ أَوْ وَرْسٍ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ نَعْلَيْنِ فَلْيَلْبَسِ الْخُفَّيْنِ وَلْيَقْطَعْهُمَا أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'ani abni, 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - aannahu qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yalbasa almuhrimu thawbana masbuwghana biza'faraanin aaw warsin waqaala ‏ "‏ man lam yajid na'layni falyalbasi alkhuffayni walyaqta'humaa aasfala mina alka'bayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade the Muhrim to put on a cloth dyed in saffron or wars and he further said:One who does not find shoes (to wear) he may wear stockings, but (only) after trimming them below the ankles
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، - عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَخْطُبُ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ السَّرَاوِيلُ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدِ الإِزَارَ وَالْخُفَّانِ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدِ النَّعْلَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي الْمُحْرِمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, jamiy'ana 'an hammaadin, - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, - 'an 'amrinw, 'an jaabiri bni zaydin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa yakhtubu yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alssaraawiylu liman lam yajidi aliizaara waalkhuffaani liman lam yajidi alnna'layni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ya'niy almuhrima ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say as he was delivering an address: So far as the trousers are concerned, one who does not find lower garment, he may wear them; as also socks, he may wear them who does not find shoes. It concerns the Muhrim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الرَّازِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، قَالاَ جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ بِعَرَفَاتٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadun ya'niy abna ja'farin, h wahaddathaniy aabuw ghassaana alrraaziyyu, haddathanaa bahzun, qaalaa jamiy'ana haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu bi'arafaatin ‏.‏ fadhakara hadhaa alhadiytha ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amr b. Dinar narrated with the same chain of transmitters that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delivering sermon at 'Arafat, and he made a mention of this hadith (as quoted above)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ يَخْطُبُ بِعَرَفَاتٍ ‏.‏ غَيْرُ شُعْبَةَ وَحْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, h wahaddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, 'ani abni jurayjin, h wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an aayyuwba, kullu hauulaa'i 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkur aahadun minhum yakhtubu bi'arafaatin ‏.‏ ghayru shu'baaa wahdahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Amr b. Dinar with the same chain of transmitters, but none of them (the narrators) made a mention that he (the Holy Prophet) was delivering address at 'Arafat except Shu'ba
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ نَعْلَيْنِ فَلْيَلْبَسْ خُفَّيْنِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ إِزَارًا فَلْيَلْبَسْ سَرَاوِيلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, - rda allh 'nh - qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man lam yajid na'layni falyalbas khuffayni waman lam yajid iizaarana falyalbas saraawiyla ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who does not find shoes to wear may wear socks, and he who does not find lower garment to wear may put on trousers
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ، بْنِ يَعْلَى بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ بِالْجِعْرَانَةِ عَلَيْهِ جُبَّةٌ وَعَلَيْهَا خَلُوقٌ - أَوْ قَالَ أَثَرُ صُفْرَةٍ - فَقَالَ كَيْفَ تَأْمُرُنِي أَنْ أَصْنَعَ فِي عُمْرَتِي قَالَ وَأُنْزِلَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْوَحْىُ فَسُتِرَ بِثَوْبٍ وَكَانَ يَعْلَى يَقُولُ وَدِدْتُ أَنِّي أَرَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ نَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَحْىُ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ أَيَسُرُّكَ أَنْ تَنْظُرَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَحْىُ قَالَ فَرَفَعَ عُمَرُ طَرَفَ الثَّوْبِ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَيْهِ لَهُ غَطِيطٌ - قَالَ وَأَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ - كَغَطِيطِ الْبَكْرِ - قَالَ - فَلَمَّا سُرِّيَ عَنْهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيْنَ السَّائِلُ عَنِ الْعُمْرَةِ اغْسِلْ عَنْكَ أَثَرَ الصُّفْرَةِ - أَوْ قَالَ أَثَرَ الْخَلُوقِ - وَاخْلَعْ عَنْكَ جُبَّتَكَ وَاصْنَعْ فِي عُمْرَتِكَ مَا أَنْتَ صَانِعٌ فِي حَجِّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa 'ataa'u bnu aabiy rabaahin, 'an safwaana, bni ya'laa bni aumayyaaa 'an aabiyhi, - rda allh 'nh - qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa bialji'raanaai 'alayhi jubbaaun wa'alayhaa khaluwqun - aaw qaala aatharu sufraain - faqaala kayfa taamuruniy aan aasna'a fiy 'umratiy qaala waaunzila 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm alwahau fasutira bithawbin wakaana ya'laa yaquwlu wadidtu aanniy aaraa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waqad nazala 'alayhi alwahau - qaala - faqaala aayasurruka aan tanzura iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqad aunzila 'alayhi alwahau qaala farafa'a 'umaru tarafa althhawbi fanazartu iilayhi lahu ghatiytun - qaala waaahsibuhu qaala - kaghatiyti albakri - qaala - falammaa surriya 'anhu qaala ‏ "‏ aayna alssaaiilu 'ani al'umraai aghsil 'anka aathara alssufraai - aaw qaala aathara alkhaluwqi - waakhla' 'anka jubbataka waasna' fiy 'umratika maa aanta saani'un fiy hajjika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ya'la b. Umayya reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them) that a person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was at Ji'rana and he (the person) had been putting on a cloak which was perfumed, or he (the narrator) said:There was a trace of yellowness on it. He said (to the Holy Prophet): What do you command me to do during my Umra? (It was at this juncture) that the revelation came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was covered with a cloth, and Ya'la said: Would that I see revelation coming to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Would it please you to see the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) receiving the revelations 'Umar lifted a corner of the cloth and I looked at him and he was emitting a sound of snorting. He (the narrator) said: I thought it was the sound of a camel. When he was relieved of this he said: Where is he who asked about Umra? When the person came, the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Wash out the trace of yellowness, or he said: the trace of perfume and put off the cloak and do in your 'Umra what you do in your Hajj
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ، يَعْلَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ وَهُوَ بِالْجِعْرَانَةِ وَأَنَا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعَلَيْهِ مُقَطَّعَاتٌ - يَعْنِي جُبَّةً - وَهُوَ مُتَضَمِّخٌ بِالْخَلُوقِ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَحْرَمْتُ بِالْعُمْرَةِ وَعَلَىَّ هَذَا وَأَنَا مُتَضَمِّخٌ بِالْخَلُوقِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا كُنْتَ صَانِعًا فِي حَجِّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنْزِعُ عَنِّي هَذِهِ الثِّيَابَ وَأَغْسِلُ عَنِّي هَذَا الْخَلُوقَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا كُنْتَ صَانِعًا فِي حَجِّكَ فَاصْنَعْهُ فِي عُمْرَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an safwaana bni, ya'laa 'an aabiyhi, qaala aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulun wahuwa bialji'raanaai waaanaa 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'alayhi muqatta'aatun - ya'niy jubbaaan - wahuwa mutadammikhun bialkhaluwqi faqaala iinniy aahramtu bial'umraai wa'alaaaa hadhaa waaanaa mutadammikhun bialkhaluwqi ‏.‏ faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa kunta saani'ana fiy hajjika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aanzi'u 'anniy hadhihi althhiyaaba waaaghsilu 'anniy hadhaa alkhaluwqa ‏.‏ faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa kunta saani'ana fiy hajjika faasna'hu fiy 'umratika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Safwan b. Ya'la reported on the authority of his father (who said):A person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was staying at Ji'rana and I (the narrator's father) was at that time in the apostle's (ﷺ) company and (the person) was donning a cloak having the marks of perfume on it, and he said: I am in a state of Ihram for the sake of Umra, and it (this cloak) is upon me and I am perfumed. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: What would you do in your Hajj? He said: I would take off the clothes and would wash from me this perfume. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: What you do in your Hajj do it in your Umra
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، أَنَّ صَفْوَانَ بْنَ يَعْلَى بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ يَعْلَى كَانَ يَقُولُ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ - رضى الله عنه - لَيْتَنِي أَرَى نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ يُنْزَلُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْجِعْرَانَةِ وَعَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَوْبٌ قَدْ أُظِلَّ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ مَعَهُ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فِيهِمْ عُمَرُ إِذْ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ عَلَيْهِ جُبَّةُ صُوفٍ مُتَضَمِّخٌ بِطِيبٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ تَرَى فِي رَجُلٍ أَحْرَمَ بِعُمْرَةٍ فِي جُبَّةٍ بَعْدَ مَا تَضَمَّخَ بِطِيبٍ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَاعَةً ثُمَّ سَكَتَ فَجَاءَهُ الْوَحْىُ فَأَشَارَ عُمَرُ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى يَعْلَى بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ تَعَالَ ‏.‏ فَجَاءَ يَعْلَى فَأَدْخَلَ رَأْسَهُ فَإِذَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُحْمَرُّ الْوَجْهِ يَغِطُّ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ سُرِّيَ عَنْهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ الَّذِي سَأَلَنِي عَنِ الْعُمْرَةِ آنِفًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَالْتُمِسَ الرَّجُلُ فَجِيءَ بِهِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَمَّا الطِّيبُ الَّذِي بِكَ فَاغْسِلْهُ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ وَأَمَّا الْجُبَّةُ فَانْزِعْهَا ثُمَّ اصْنَعْ فِي عُمْرَتِكَ مَا تَصْنَعُ فِي حَجِّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, h wahaddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, aanna safwaana bna ya'laa bni aumayyaaa, aakhbarahu aanna ya'laa kaana yaquwlu li'umara bni alkhattaabi - rda allh 'nh - laytaniy aaraa nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna yunzalu 'alayhi ‏.‏ falammaa kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bialji'raanaai wa'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thawbun qad auzilla bihi 'alayhi ma'ahu naasun min aashaabihi fiyhim 'umaru iidh jaa'ahu rajulun 'alayhi jubbaau suwfin mutadammikhun bitiybin faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa taraa fiy rajulin aahrama bi'umraain fiy jubbaain ba'da maa tadammakha bitiybin fanazara iilayhi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm saa'aaan thumma sakata fajaa'ahu alwahau faaashaara 'umaru biyadihi iilaa ya'laa bni aumayyaaa ta'aala ‏.‏ fajaa'a ya'laa faaadkhala raasahu faiidhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm muhmarru alwajhi yaghittu saa'aaan thumma surriya 'anhu faqaala ‏"‏ aayna alladhiy saaalaniy 'ani al'umraai anifana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaltumisa alrrajulu fajiy'a bihi faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aammaa alttiybu alladhiy bika faaghsilhu thalaatha marraatin waaammaa aljubbaau faanzi'haa thumma asna' fiy 'umratika maa tasna'u fiy hajjika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Safwan b. Ya'la b. Umayya reported that Ya'la used to say to 'Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him):Would that I see revelation descending upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). (Once) when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in Ji'rana and there was a cloth which provided shade over him, and there were his Companions with him. 'Umar being one of them, there came a person with a cloak of wool on him daubed with perfume and he said: Messenger of Allah, what about the person who entered upon the state of Ihram with a cloak after daubing it with perfume? The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) looked at him for a short while, and then became quiet, and revelation began descending upon him, and 'Umar gestured (with his hand) to Ya'la b. Umayya to come. Ya'la came and he entered his head (beneath the cloth and saw) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with his face red, and breathing heavily. Then he felt relieved (of that burden) and he said: Where is the man who was just asking me about Umra? The man was searched for and he was brought, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: So far as the perfume is concerned, wash it three times, and remove the cloak too (as it was sewn) and do in 'Umra as you do in Hajj
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ رَافِعٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ قَيْسًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ، يَعْلَى بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ بِالْجِعْرَانَةِ قَدْ أَهَلَّ بِالْعُمْرَةِ وَهُوَ مُصَفِّرٌ لِحْيَتَهُ وَرَأْسَهُ وَعَلَيْهِ جُبَّةٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَحْرَمْتُ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَأَنَا كَمَا تَرَى ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ انْزِعْ عَنْكَ الْجُبَّةَ وَاغْسِلْ عَنْكَ الصُّفْرَةَ وَمَا كُنْتَ صَانِعًا فِي حَجِّكَ فَاصْنَعْهُ فِي عُمْرَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'uqbaau bnu mukramin al'ammiyyu, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, - waalllafzu laibni raafi'in - qaalaa haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyri bni haazimin, haddathanaa aabiy qaala, sami'tu qaysana, yuhaddithu 'an 'ataa'in, 'an safwaana bni, ya'laa bni aumayyaaa 'an aabiyhi, rda allh 'nh aanna rajulaan, aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa bialji'raanaai qad aahalla bial'umraai wahuwa musaffirun lihyatahu waraasahu wa'alayhi jubbaaun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy aahramtu bi'umraain waaanaa kamaa taraa ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ anzi' 'anka aljubbaaa waaghsil 'anka alssufraaa wamaa kunta saani'ana fiy hajjika faasna'hu fiy 'umratika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ya'la b. Umayya (Allah be pleased with him) reported that a person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was staying at Ji'rana and he had put on Ihram for 'Umra and he had dyed his beard and his head with yellow colour and there was a cloak on him. He said:I put on Ihram for 'Umra and I am in this state as you see (with dyed beard and head and a cloak over me). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Take off the cloak and wash the yellowness and do in your 'Umra what you do in Hajj
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ، عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا رَبَاحُ بْنُ أَبِي مَعْرُوفٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءً، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَعْلَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ عَلَيْهِ جُبَّةٌ بِهَا أَثَرٌ مِنْ خَلُوقٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَحْرَمْتُ بِعُمْرَةٍ فَكَيْفَ أَفْعَلُ فَسَكَتَ عَنْهُ فَلَمْ يَرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِ وَكَانَ عُمَرُ يَسْتُرُهُ إِذَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَحْىُ يُظِلُّهُ فَقُلْتُ لِعُمَرَ - رضى الله عنه - إِنِّي أُحِبُّ إِذَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَحْىُ أَنْ أُدْخِلَ رَأْسِي مَعَهُ فِي الثَّوْبِ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ خَمَّرَهُ عُمَرُ - رضى الله عنه - بِالثَّوْبِ فَجِئْتُهُ فَأَدْخَلْتُ رَأْسِي مَعَهُ فِي الثَّوْبِ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا سُرِّيَ عَنْهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ السَّائِلُ آنِفًا عَنِ الْعُمْرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ انْزِعْ عَنْكَ جُبَّتَكَ وَاغْسِلْ أَثَرَ الْخَلُوقِ الَّذِي بِكَ وَافْعَلْ فِي عُمْرَتِكَ مَا كُنْتَ فَاعِلاً فِي حَجِّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'aliyyin, 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi almajiydi haddathanaa rabaahu bnu aabiy ma'ruwfin, qaala sami'tu 'ataa'an, qaala aakhbaraniy safwaanu bnu ya'laa, 'an aabiyhi, - rda allh 'nh - qaala kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaataahu rajulun 'alayhi jubbaaun bihaa aatharun min khaluwqin faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy aahramtu bi'umraain fakayfa aaf'alu fasakata 'anhu falam yarji' iilayhi wakaana 'umaru yasturuhu iidhaa aunzila 'alayhi alwahau yuzilluhu faqultu li'umara - rda allh 'nh - iinniy auhibbu iidhaa aunzila 'alayhi alwahau aan audkhila raasiy ma'ahu fiy althhawbi ‏.‏ falammaa aunzila 'alayhi khammarahu 'umaru - rda allh 'nh - bialthhawbi fajiituhu faaadkhaltu raasiy ma'ahu fiy althhawbi fanazartu iilayhi falammaa surriya 'anhu qaala ‏"‏ aayna alssaaiilu anifana 'ani al'umraai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaama iilayhi alrrajulu faqaala ‏"‏ anzi' 'anka jubbataka waaghsil aathara alkhaluwqi alladhiy bika waaf'al fiy 'umratika maa kunta faa'ilaan fiy hajjika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ya'la reported:We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that a person came to him with a cloak on him having the traces of scent. He said, Messenger of Allah, I put on Ihram for 'Umra: what should I do? He (the Holy Prophet) kept quiet and did not make him any reply. And 'Umar screened him and it was (usual) with 'Umar that when the revelation descended upon him, he provided him shade (with the help of a piece of cloth). I (the person who came to the Holy Prophet) said: I said to 'Umar I wish to project my head into the cloth (to see how the Prophet receives revelation). So when the revelation began to descend upon him 'Umar wrapped him (the Holy Prophet) with cloth I came to him and projected my head with him into the cloth, and saw him (the Holy Prophet) (receiving the revelation). When he (the Holy Prophet) was relieved (of its burden), he said: Where is the inquirer who was just inquiring about 'Umra? That man came to him. Thereupon he (the Messenger of Allah) said: Take off the cloak from (your body) and wash the traces of perfume which were upon you, and do in 'Umra what you did in Hajj
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَخَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، - عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ وَقَّتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ وَلأَهْلِ الشَّامِ الْجُحْفَةَ وَلأَهْلِ نَجْدٍ قَرْنَ الْمَنَازِلِ وَلأَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ يَلَمْلَمَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَهُنَّ لَهُنَّ وَلِمَنْ أَتَى عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَهْلِهِنَّ مِمَّنْ أَرَادَ الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ فَمَنْ كَانَ دُونَهُنَّ فَمِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَكَذَا فَكَذَلِكَ حَتَّى أَهْلُ مَكَّةَ يُهِلُّونَ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wakhalafu bnu hishaamin, waaabuw alrrabiy'i, waqutaybaau, jamiy'ana 'an hammaadin, - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, - 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala waqqata rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laahli almadiynaai dhaa alhulayfaai walaahli alshhaami aljuhfaaa walaahli najdin qarna almanaazili walaahli alyamani yalamlama ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ fahunna lahunna waliman aataa 'alayhinna min ghayri aahlihinna mimman aaraada alhajja waal'umraaa faman kaana duwnahunna famin aahlihi wakadhaa fakadhalika hattaa aahlu makkaaa yuhilluwna minhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) specified Dhu'l-Hulaifa, for the people of Medina; Juhfa for the people of Syria; Qarn al-Manazil, for the people of Najd; Yalamlam for the people of Yemen (the Mawaqit) and those (Mawaqit) are also meant for those who live at these (places) and for those too who come from without towards them for the sake of Hajj or 'Umra. And those who live within them (within the bounds of these places) or in the suburbs of Mecca or within Mecca, they should enter upon the state of Ihram at these very places
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، بْنُ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَّتَ لأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ وَلأَهْلِ الشَّامِ الْجُحْفَةَ وَلأَهْلِ نَجْدٍ قَرْنَ الْمَنَازِلِ وَلأَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ يَلَمْلَمَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هُنَّ لَهُمْ وَلِكُلِّ آتٍ أَتَى عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ غَيْرِهِنَّ مِمَّنْ أَرَادَ الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ وَمَنْ كَانَ دُونَ ذَلِكَ فَمِنْ حَيْثُ أَنْشَأَ حَتَّى أَهْلُ مَكَّةَ مِنْ مَكَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi, bnu taawusin 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqqata laahli almadiynaai dhaa alhulayfaai walaahli alshhaami aljuhfaaa walaahli najdin qarna almanaazili walaahli alyamani yalamlama ‏.‏ waqaala ‏ "‏ hunna lahum walikulli atin aataa 'alayhinna min ghayrihinna mimman aaraada alhajja waal'umraaa waman kaana duwna dhalika famin haythu aanshaaa hattaa aahlu makkaaa min makkaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) specified Dhu'l-Hulaifa for the people of Medina; Juhfa for the people of Syria, Qarn al-Manazil for the people of Najd, Yalamlam for the people of Yemen (as their respective Mawaqit), and he also said:These are (Mawaqit) of them too (who live there) and everyone who comes from outside (through) their (directions) for the sake of Hajj and 'Umra and for those who live within (those bounds their Miqat is that) from which they commenced (their journey), and for the people of Mecca, Mecca itself is (the Miqat)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يُهِلُّ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ مِنْ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ وَأَهْلُ الشَّامِ مِنَ الْجُحْفَةِ وَأَهْلُ نَجْدٍ مِنْ قَرْنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَبَلَغَنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ وَيُهِلُّ أَهْلُ الْيَمَنِ مِنْ يَلَمْلَمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ yuhillu aahlu almadiynaai min dhiy alhulayfaai waaahlu alshhaami mina aljuhfaai waaahlu najdin min qarnin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi wabalaghaniy aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ wayuhillu aahlu alyamani min yalamlama ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:The people of Medina should enter upon the state of Ihram at Dhu'l-Hulaifa, and people of Syria at Juhfa, and people of Najd at Qarn (al-Manazil), and 'Abdullah (further) said: It has reached me that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also caid: The people of Yemen should enter upon the state of Ihram at Yalamlam
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، - رضى الله عنه - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يُهِلُّ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ مِنْ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ وَيُهِلُّ أَهْلُ الشَّامِ مِنَ الْجُحْفَةِ وَيُهِلُّ أَهْلُ نَجْدٍ مِنْ قَرْنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - وَذُكِرَ لِي - وَلَمْ أَسْمَعْ - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ وَيُهِلُّ أَهْلُ الْيَمَنِ مِنْ يَلَمْلَمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaala abnu aabiy 'umara haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, - rda allh 'nh - aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ yuhillu aahlu almadiynaai min dhiy alhulayfaai wayuhillu aahlu alshhaami mina aljuhfaai wayuhillu aahlu najdin min qarnin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - wadhukira liy - walam aasma' - aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ wayuhillu aahlu alyamani min yalamlama ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim reported on the authority of his father ('Abdullah b. 'Umar) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:The people of Medina should enter upon the state of Ihram at Dhu'l-Hulaifa; the people of Syria at Juhfa, the people of Najd at Qarn (al-Manazil). Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said: It was mentioned to me but I did not myself bear it (directly) from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) having said this: The people of Yemen should enter upon the state of Ihram at Yalamlam
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، - رضى الله عنه - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مُهَلُّ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ ذُو الْحُلَيْفَةِ وَمُهَلُّ أَهْلِ الشَّامِ مَهْيَعَةُ وَهِيَ الْجُحْفَةُ وَمُهَلُّ أَهْلِ نَجْدٍ قَرْنٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - وَزَعَمُوا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - وَلَمْ أَسْمَعْ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ - قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمُهَلُّ أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ يَلَمْلَمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara bni alkhattaabi, - rda allh 'nh - 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ muhallu aahli almadiynaai dhuw alhulayfaai wamuhallu aahli alshhaami mahya'aau wahiya aljuhfaau wamuhallu aahli najdin qarnun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - waza'amuwa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - walam aasma' dhalika minhu - qaala ‏"‏ wamuhallu aahli alyamani yalamlamu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim b. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar b. al-Khattab (Allah be pleased with them) reported his father as saying:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying that the people of Medina should enter upon the state of Ihram at Dhu'l- Hulaifa, the people of Syria at Mahya'a and that is Juhfa, and the people of Najd at Qarn (al-Manazil). 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said: (I did not hear it myself from him) but heard from them saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had (also) said: The people of Yemen should enter upon the state of Ihram at Yalamlam
