verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - رضى الله عنهما - يُسْأَلُ عَنِ الْمُهَلِّ، فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ - ثُمَّ، انْتَهَى فَقَالَ أُرَاهُ يَعْنِي - النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, - rda allh 'nhma - yusaalu 'ani almuhalli, faqaala sami'tu - thumma, antahaa faqaala auraahu ya'niy - alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Zubair reported that he heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) saying that as he was asked about (the places for entering upon the) state of ihram, he said:I heard (and he then carried the narration directly, I think to) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بَكْرٍ، - قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - رضى الله عنهما - يُسْأَلُ عَنِ الْمُهَلِّ، فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ - أَحْسِبُهُ، رَفَعَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم - فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مُهَلُّ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ مِنْ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ وَالطَّرِيقُ الآخَرُ الْجُحْفَةُ وَمُهَلُّ أَهْلِ الْعِرَاقِ مِنْ ذَاتِ عِرْقٍ وَمُهَلُّ أَهْلِ نَجْدٍ مِنْ قَرْنٍ وَمُهَلُّ أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ مِنْ يَلَمْلَمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, kilaahumaa 'an muhammadi bni bakrin, - qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa muhammadun, - aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, - rda allh 'nhma - yusaalu 'ani almuhalli, faqaala sami'tu - aahsibuhu, rafa'a iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm - faqaala ‏ "‏ muhallu aahli almadiynaai min dhiy alhulayfaai waalttariyqu alakharu aljuhfaau wamuhallu aahli al'iraaqi min dhaati 'irqin wamuhallu aahli najdin min qarnin wamuhallu aahli alyamani min yalamlama ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Zubair heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) as saying as he was asked about (the place for entering upon the) state of Ihram:I heard (and I think he carried it directly to the Messenger of Allah) him saying: For the people of Medina Dhu'l-Hulaifa is the place for entering upon the state of Ihram, and for (the people coming through the other way, i.e. Syria) it is Juhfa; for the people of Iraq it is Dhat al-'Irq; for the people of Najd it is Qarn (al-Manazil) and for the people of Yemen it is Yalamlam
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّ تَلْبِيَةَ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - يَزِيدُ فِيهَا لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ بِيَدَيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ وَالرَّغْبَاءُ إِلَيْكَ وَالْعَمَلُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi, bni 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - aanna talbiyaaa, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ labbayka alllahumma labbayka labbayka laa shariyka laka labbayka iinna alhamda waalnni'maaa laka waalmulka laa shariyka laka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wakaana 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - yaziydu fiyhaa labbayka labbayka wasa'dayka waalkhayru biyadayka labbayka waalrraghbaa'u iilayka waal'amalu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Talbiya of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was this:Here I am at Thy service. O Allah, here I am at Thy service, here I am at Thy service. There is no associate with Thee; here I am at Thy service. Verily all praise and grace is due to Thee, and the sovereignty (too). There is no associate with Thee. He (the narrator) further said that 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) made this addition to it: Here I am at Thy service; here I am at Thy service; ready to obey Thee, and good is in Thy Hand; here I am at Thy service; unto Thee is the petition, and deed (is also for Thee)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، وَنَافِعٍ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَحَمْزَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا اسْتَوَتْ بِهِ رَاحِلَتُهُ قَائِمَةً عِنْدَ مَسْجِدِ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ أَهَلَّ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - يَقُولُ هَذِهِ تَلْبِيَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ نَافِعٌ كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ - رضى الله عنه - يَزِيدُ مَعَ هَذَا لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ بِيَدَيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ وَالرَّغْبَاءُ إِلَيْكَ وَالْعَمَلُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, haddathanaa haatimun, - ya'niy abna iismaa'iyla - 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, wanaafi'in, mawlaa 'abdi alllahi wahamzaaa bni 'abdi alllahi 'an 'abdi alllahi, bni 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa astawat bihi raahilatuhu qaaiimaaan 'inda masjidi dhiy alhulayfaai aahalla faqaala ‏ "‏ labbayka alllahumma labbayka labbayka laa shariyka laka labbayka iinna alhamda waalnni'maaa laka waalmulka laa shariyka laka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa wakaana 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - yaquwlu hadhihi talbiyaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaala naafi'un kaana 'abdu alllahi - rda allh 'nh - yaziydu ma'a hadhaa labbayka labbayka wasa'dayka waalkhayru biyadayka labbayka waalrraghbaa'u iilayka waal'amalu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered upon the state of Ihram near the mosque at Dhu'l-Hulaifa as his camel stood by it and he said:Here I am at Thy service, O Lord; here I am at Thy service: here I am at Thy service. There is no associate with Thee. Here I am at Thy service. All praise and grace is due to Thee and the sovereignty (too). There is no associate with Thee. They (the people) said that 'Abdullah b. 'Umar said that that was the Talbiya of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Nafi' said: 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) made this addition to it: Here I am at Thy service; here I am at Thy service; ready to obey Thee. The Good is in Thy Hand. Here I am at Thy service. Unto Thee is the petition and deed (is also for Thee)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ تَلَقَّفْتُ التَّلْبِيَةَ مِنْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, - ya'niy abna sa'iydin - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala talaqqaftu alttalbiyaaa min fiy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithli hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) reported:I immediately learnt Talbiya from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he then narrated the hadith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ فَإِنَّ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَنْ أَبِيهِ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُهِلُّ مُلَبِّدًا يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لاَ يَزِيدُ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ ‏.‏ وَإِنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - كَانَ يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْكَعُ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ إِذَا اسْتَوَتْ بِهِ النَّاقَةُ قَائِمَةً عِنْدَ مَسْجِدِ الْحُلَيْفَةِ أَهَلَّ بِهَؤُلاَءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - يَقُولُ كَانَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ - رضى الله عنه - يُهِلُّ بِإِهْلاَلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ هَؤُلاَءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ وَيَقُولُ لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ فِي يَدَيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ وَالرَّغْبَاءُ إِلَيْكَ وَالْعَمَلُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala faiinna saalima bna 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara aakhbaraniy 'an aabiyhi, - rda allh 'nh - qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhillu mulabbidana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ labbayka alllahumma labbayka labbayka laa shariyka laka labbayka iinna alhamda waalnni'maaa laka waalmulka laa shariyka laka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ laa yaziydu 'alaa hauulaa'i alkalimaati ‏.‏ waiinna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - kaana yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yarka'u bidhiy alhulayfaai rak'atayni ‏.‏ thumma iidhaa astawat bihi alnnaaqaau qaaiimaaan 'inda masjidi alhulayfaai aahalla bihauulaa'i alkalimaati wakaana 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - yaquwlu kaana 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi - rda allh 'nh - yuhillu biiihlaali rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min hauulaa'i alkalimaati wayaquwlu labbayka alllahumma labbayka labbayka wasa'dayka waalkhayru fiy yadayka labbayka waalrraghbaa'u iilayka waal'amalu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronouncing Talbiya with compacted hair: Here I am at Thy service. O Allah: here I am at Thy service; here I am at Thy service. There is no associate with Thee; here I am at Thy service. Verily all praise and grace is due to Thee and the Sovereignty (too). There is no associate with Thee; and he did not make any addition to these words. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) (further) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to offer two rak'ahs of prayer at Dhu'l-Hulaifa and then when his camel stood up with him on its back near the mosque at Dhu'l-Hulaifa, he pronounced these words (of Talbiya). And 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased'with them) said that 'Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) pronounced, the Talbiya of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in these words of his (Prophet's words) and said: Here I am at Thy service, O Lord; here I am at Thy service, ready to obey Thee, and good is in Thy Hand, Here I am at Thy service. Unto Thee is the petition and deed (is also for Thee)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْيَمَامِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَمَّارٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُمَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ كَانَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ يَقُولُونَ لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ - قَالَ - فَيَقُولُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَيْلَكُمْ قَدْ قَدْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُونَ إِلاَّ شَرِيكًا هُوَ لَكَ تَمْلِكُهُ وَمَا مَلَكَ ‏.‏ يَقُولُونَ هَذَا وَهُمْ يَطُوفُونَ بِالْبَيْتِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abbaasu bnu 'abdi al'aziymi al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa alnnadru bnu muhammadin alyamaamiyyu, haddathanaa 'ikrimaau, - ya'niy abna 'ammaarin - haddathanaa aabuw zumaylin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala kaana almushrikuwna yaquwluwna labbayka laa shariyka laka - qaala - fayaquwlu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ waylakum qad qad ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fayaquwluwna iilaaa shariykana huwa laka tamlikuhu wamaa malaka ‏.‏ yaquwluwna hadhaa wahum yatuwfuwna bialbayti ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the polytheists also pronounced (Talbiya) as:Here I am at Thy service, there is no associate with Thee. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Woe be upon them, as they also said: But one associate with Thee, you possess mastery over him, but he does not possess mastery (over you). They used to say this and circumambulate the Ka'ba
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَاهُ، - رضى الله عنه - يَقُولُ بَيْدَاؤُكُمْ هَذِهِ الَّتِي تَكْذِبُونَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهَا مَا أَهَلَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ مِنْ عِنْدِ الْمَسْجِدِ يَعْنِي ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an saalimi, bni 'abdi alllahi aannahu sami'a aabaahu, - rda allh 'nh - yaquwlu baydaauukum hadhihi allatiy takdhibuwna 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiyhaa maa aahalla rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaa min 'indi almasjidi ya'niy dhaa alhulayfaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that he heard his father saying:This place Baida' is for you that about which you attribute lie to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). And the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not enter upon the state of Ihram but near the mosque at Dhu'l- Hulaifa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ، عُقْبَةَ عَنْ سَالِمٍ، قَالَ كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُ الإِحْرَامُ مِنَ الْبَيْدَاءِ قَالَ الْبَيْدَاءُ الَّتِي تَكْذِبُونَ فِيهَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا أَهَلَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ مِنْ عِنْدِ الشَّجَرَةِ حِينَ قَامَ بِهِ بَعِيرُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa haatimun, - ya'niy abna iismaa'iyla - 'an muwsaa bni, 'uqbaaa 'an saalimin, qaala kaana abnu 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - iidhaa qiyla lahu aliihraamu mina albaydaa'i qaala albaydaa'u allatiy takdhibuwna fiyhaa 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa aahalla rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaa min 'indi alshhajaraai hiyna qaama bihi ba'iyruhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim reported that when it was said to Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) that the state of Ihram (commences from)a al-Baida' he said:Al-Baida', you attribute lie about it to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). And the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not enter upon the state of Ihram but near the tree when his camel stood up with him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رضى الله عنهما يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ رَأَيْتُكَ تَصْنَعُ أَرْبَعًا لَمْ أَرَ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِكَ يَصْنَعُهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ مَا هُنَّ يَا ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ رَأَيْتُكَ لاَ تَمَسُّ مِنَ الأَرْكَانِ إِلاَّ الْيَمَانِيَيْنِ وَرَأَيْتُكَ تَلْبَسُ النِّعَالَ السِّبْتِيَّةَ وَرَأَيْتُكَ تَصْبُغُ بِالصُّفْرَةِ وَرَأَيْتُكَ إِذَا كُنْتَ بِمَكَّةَ أَهَلَّ النَّاسُ إِذَا رَأَوُا الْهِلاَلَ وَلَمْ تُهْلِلْ أَنْتَ حَتَّى يَكُونَ يَوْمُ التَّرْوِيَةِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَمَّا الأَرْكَانُ فَإِنِّي لَمْ أَرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمَسُّ إِلاَّ الْيَمَانِيَيْنِ وَأَمَّا النِّعَالُ السِّبْتِيَّةُ فَإِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَلْبَسُ النِّعَالَ الَّتِي لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَعَرٌ وَيَتَوَضَّأُ فِيهَا فَأَنَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَلْبَسَهَا وَأَمَّا الصُّفْرَةُ فَإِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصْبَغُ بِهَا فَأَنَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَصْبَغَ بِهَا وَأَمَّا الإِهْلاَلُ فَإِنِّي لَمْ أَرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُهِلُّ حَتَّى تَنْبَعِثَ بِهِ رَاحِلَتُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an 'ubaydi bni jurayjin, aannahu qaala li'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma yaa aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani raaaytuka tasna'u aarba'ana lam aara aahadana min aashaabika yasna'uhaa ‏.‏ qaala maa hunna yaa abna jurayjin qaala raaaytuka laa tamassu mina alaarkaani iilaaa alyamaaniyayni waraaaytuka talbasu alnni'aala alssibtiyyaaa waraaaytuka tasbughu bialssufraai waraaaytuka iidhaa kunta bimakkaaa aahalla alnnaasu iidhaa raaawua alhilaala walam tuhlil aanta hattaa yakuwna yawmu alttarwiyaai ‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara aammaa alaarkaanu faiinniy lam aara rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yamassu iilaaa alyamaaniyayni waaammaa alnni'aalu alssibtiyyaau faiinniy raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yalbasu alnni'aala allatiy laysa fiyhaa sha'arun wayatawaddaau fiyhaa faaanaa auhibbu aan aalbasahaa waaammaa alssufraau faiinniy raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasbaghu bihaa faaanaa auhibbu aan aasbagha bihaa waaammaa aliihlaalu faiinniy lam aara rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhillu hattaa tanba'itha bihi raahilatuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubaid b. Juraij said to 'Ahdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them):'Abd al-Rahman, I find you doing four things which I do not see anyone among your companions doing. He said: Son of Juraij, what are these? Thereupon he said: You (while circumambulating the Ka'ba) do not touch but the two pillars situated on the side of yaman (south), and I find you wearing the sandals of tanned leather, and I find you with dyed beard and head, and I also found that, when you were at Mecca, the people pronounced Talbiya as they saw the new moon (Dhu'l-Hijja), but you did not do it till the 8th of Dhu'l-Hijja. Upon this 'Abdullab b. 'Umar said: (So far as the touching of) the pillars is concerned, I did not see the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) touching them but only those situated on the side of yaman. (So far as the wearing of) the shoes of tanned leather is concerned, I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wearing shoes without hair on them, and he (wore them with wet feet) after performing ablution, and I like to wear them. So far as the yellowness is concerned, I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) dyeing (head, beard and cloth) with this colour and I love to dye (my head, beard or cloth) with this colour. And so far as the pronouncing of Talbiya is concerned, I did not see the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronouncing it until his camel proceeded on (to Dhu'l-Hulaifa)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ حَجَجْتُ مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ - رضى الله عنهما - بَيْنَ حَجٍّ وَعُمْرَةٍ ثِنْتَىْ عَشْرَةَ مَرَّةً فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ مِنْكَ أَرْبَعَ خِصَالٍ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِهَذَا الْمَعْنَى إِلاَّ فِي قِصَّةِ الإِهْلاَلِ فَإِنَّهُ خَالَفَ رِوَايَةَ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ فَذَكَرَهُ بِمَعْنًى سِوَى ذِكْرِهِ إِيَّاهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy aabuw sakhrin, 'ani abni qusaytin, 'an 'ubaydi bni jurayjin, qaala hajajtu ma'a 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara bni alkhattaabi - rda allh 'nhma - bayna hajjin wa'umraain thintaa 'ashraaa marraaan faqultu yaa aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani laqad raaaytu minka aarba'a khisaalin ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bihadhaa alma'naa iilaaa fiy qissaai aliihlaali faiinnahu khaalafa riwaayaaa almaqburiyyi fadhakarahu bima'nana siwaa dhikrihi iiyyaahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubaid b. Juraij reported:I remained in the company of 'Abdullah b. 'Umar b. al-Khattab (Allah be pleased with them) its twelve Hajjs and 'Umras and I said to him: I saw four characteristics (peculiar in you), and the rest of the hadith is the same except the case of Talbiya. There he offered the narration given by al-Maqburi and he stated the facts excepting the one given above
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا وَضَعَ رِجْلَهُ فِي الْغَرْزِ وَانْبَعَثَتْ بِهِ رَاحِلَتُهُ قَائِمَةً أَهَلَّ مِنْ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa wada'a rijlahu fiy algharzi waanba'athat bihi raahilatuhu qaaiimaaan aahalla min dhiy alhulayfaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronounced Talbiya in Dhu'l-Hulaifa as he put his feet in the stirrup and his camel stood up and proceeded
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي صَالِحُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُخْبِرُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَهَلَّ حِينَ اسْتَوَتْ بِهِ نَاقَتُهُ قَائِمَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, qaala qaala abnu jurayjin aakhbaraniy saalihu bnu kaysaana, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - aannahu kaana yukhbiru aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aahalla hiyna astawat bihi naaqatuhu qaaiimaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronounced Talbiya as his camel stood up
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكِبَ رَاحِلَتَهُ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ ثُمَّ يُهِلُّ حِينَ تَسْتَوِي بِهِ قَائِمَةً ‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aannaaakhbarahu aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakiba raahilatahu bidhiy alhulayfaai thumma yuhillu hiyna tastawiy bihi qaaiimaaan ‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported:I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) riding on his camel at Dhu'l-Hulaifa and pronouncing Talbiya as it stood up with him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالَ أَحْمَدُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، حَرْمَلَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّهُ قَالَ بَاتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ مَبْدَأَهُ وَصَلَّى فِي مَسْجِدِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, qaala aahmadu haddathanaa waqaala, harmalaau aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna 'ubayda alllahi bna 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aakhbarahu 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - aannahu qaala baata rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bidhiy alhulayfaai mabdaaahu wasallaa fiy masjidihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) spent the night at Dhu'l-Hulaifa while commencing (the rites of) Pilgrimage and he observed prayer in the mosque
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ طَيَّبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِحُرْمِهِ حِينَ أَحْرَمَ وَلِحِلِّهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat tayyabtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lihurmihi hiyna aahrama walihillihi qabla aan yatuwfa bialbayti ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I applied perfume to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) before he entered upon the state of lhram and (concluding) before circumambulating the (sacred) House
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَفْلَحُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ طَيَّبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِي لِحُرْمِهِ حِينَ أَحْرَمَ وَلِحِلِّهِ حِينَ أَحَلَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa aaflahu bnu humaydin, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat tayyabtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadiy lihurmihi hiyna aahrama walihillihi hiyna aahalla qabla aan yatuwfa bialbayti‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her), the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported:I applied perfume to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with my own hand before he entered upon the state of Ihram, and as he concluded it before circumambulating the House (for Tawaf-i-lfada)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أُطَيِّبُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لإِحْرَامِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُحْرِمَ وَلِحِلِّهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - aannahaa qaalat kuntu autayyibu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm liihraamihi qabla aan yuhrima walihillihi qabla aan yatuwfa bialbayti ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I used to apply perfume to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) before his entering upon the state of Ihram and at the conclusion of it, before circumambulating the House (for Tawaf Ifada)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ طَيَّبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِحِلِّهِ وَلِحِرْمِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara, qaala sami'tu alqaasima, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat tayyabtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lihillihi walihirmihi‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said:I applied perfume to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he became free from Ihram and as he entered upon it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُرْوَةَ، وَالْقَاسِمَ، يُخْبِرَانِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ طَيَّبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِي بِذَرِيرَةٍ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ لِلْحِلِّ وَالإِحْرَامِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu haatimin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'umaru bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'urwaaa, aannahu sami'a 'urwaaa, waalqaasima, yukhbiraani 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat tayyabtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadiy bidhariyraain fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i lilhilli waaliihraami ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said:I applied perfume of Dharira to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with my hand (on the occasion of) the Farewell Pilgrimage on freeing from the state of Ihram and entering upon it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، - حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ - رضى الله عنها - بِأَىِّ شَىْءٍ طَيَّبْتِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ حِرْمِهِ قَالَتْ بِأَطْيَبِ الطِّيبِ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, - qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa sufyaanu, - haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala saaaltu 'aaiishaaa - rda allh 'nha - biaaaai shaa'in tayyabti rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'inda hirmihi qaalat biaatyabi alttiybi‏.‏
verses.translation: Uthman b. 'Urwa reported on the authority of his father that he said:I asked 'A'isha with what thing she perfumed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at the time of entering upon the state of Ihram. She said: With the best of perfume
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُرْوَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أُطَيِّبُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِأَطْيَبِ مَا أَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُحْرِمَ ثُمَّ يُحْرِمُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an 'uthmaana bni 'urwaaa, qaala sami'tu 'urwaaa, yuhaddithu 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat kuntu autayyibu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biaatyabi maa aaqdiru 'alayhi qabla aan yuhrima thumma yuhrimu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I applied the best perfume, which I could get, to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) before entering upon the state of Ihram (and after this) he put on the Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، عَنْ أَبِي الرِّجَالِ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ طَيَّبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِحُرْمِهِ حِينَ أَحْرَمَ وَلِحِلِّهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفِيضَ بِأَطْيَبِ مَا وَجَدْتُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku, 'an aabiy alrrijaali, 'an aummihi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - aannahaa qaalat tayyabtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lihurmihi hiyna aahrama walihillihi qabla aan yufiyda biaatyabi maa wajadtu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I applied the best available perfume I could find to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) before he entered upon the state of Ihram and after he was free from it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَخَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ الطِّيبِ فِي مَفْرِقِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ خَلَفٌ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ ‏.‏ وَلَكِنَّهُ قَالَ وَذَاكَ طِيبُ إِحْرَامِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wasa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, waaabuw alrrabiy'i, wakhalafu bnu hishaamin, waqutaybaau, bnu sa'iydin qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat kaaanniy aanzuru iilaa wabiysi alttiybi fiy mafriqi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa muhrimun ‏.‏ walam yaqul khalafun wahuwa muhrimun ‏.‏ walakinnahu qaala wadhaaka tiybu iihraamihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I still seem to see the glistening of the perfume where the hair parted on Allah's Messenger's (ﷺ) head as he was in the state of Ihram, and Khalaf (one of the narrators) did not say: As he was in the state of Ihram, but said: That was the perfume of Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، - عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ لَكَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ الطِّيبِ فِي مَفَارِقِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يُهِلُّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waaabuw kuraybin - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, - 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat lakaaanniy aanzuru iilaa wabiysi alttiybi fiy mafaariqi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa yuhillu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I still seem to see the glistening of the perfume where the hair parted on Allah's Messenger's (ﷺ) head and he was free from Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ الطِّيبِ فِي مَفَارِقِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يُلَبِّي‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waaabuw sa'iydin alaashajju qaaluwa haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat kaaanniy aanzuru iilaa wabiysi alttiybi fiy mafaariqi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa yulabbiy‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I still seem to see the glistening of the perfume where the hair parted on Allah's Messenger's (ﷺ) head, while he was pronouncing Talbiya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، وَعَنْ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ لَكَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, wa'an muslimin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat lakaaanniy aanzuru ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi wakiy'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I still seem to see; the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَأَنَّمَا أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ الطِّيبِ فِي مَفَارِقِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, qaala sami'tu iibraahiyma, yuhaddithu 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - aannahaa qaalat kaaannamaa aanzuru iilaa wabiysi alttiybi fiy mafaariqi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa muhrimun ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said:I still seem to see the glistening of the perfume where the hair was parted on Allah's Messeinger's (ﷺ) head while he was in the state of Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ إِنْ كُنْتُ لأَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ الطِّيبِ فِي مَفَارِقِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa maaliku bnu mighwalin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alaaswadi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat iin kuntu laanzuru iilaa wabiysi alttiybi fiy mafaariqi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa muhrimun ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I still seem to perceive the glistening of perfume where the hair was parted on Allah's Messenger's (ﷺ) head as he was in the state of Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، - وَهُوَ السَّلُولِيُّ - حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ السَّبِيعِيُّ - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي، إِسْحَاقَ سَمِعَ ابْنَ الأَسْوَدِ، يَذْكُرُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يُحْرِمَ يَتَطَيَّبُ بِأَطْيَبِ مَا يَجِدُ ثُمَّ أَرَى وَبِيصَ الدُّهْنِ فِي رَأْسِهِ وَلِحْيَتِهِ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, - wahuwa alssaluwliyyu - haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu yuwsufa, - wahuwa abnu iishaaqa bni aabiy iishaaqa alssabiy'iyyu - 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy, iishaaqa sami'a abna alaaswadi, yadhkuru 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aaraada aan yuhrima yatatayyabu biaatyabi maa yajidu thumma aaraa wabiysa aldduhni fiy raasihi walihyatihi ba'da dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) intended to enter upon the state of Ihram he perfumed himself with the best of perfumes which he could find and after that I saw the glistening of oil on his head and beard
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ رضى الله عنها كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ الْمِسْكِ فِي مَفْرِقِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, 'ani alhasani bni 'ubaydi alllahi, haddathanaa iibraahiymu, 'ani alaaswadi, qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau rda allh 'nha kaaanniy aanzuru iilaa wabiysi almiski fiy mafriqi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa muhrimun ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I still seem to see the glistening of musk (in the parting of the head) of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while he was in the state of Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku bnu makhladin aabuw 'aasimin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alhasani bni 'ubaydi alllahi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، وَيَعْقُوبُ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أُطَيِّبُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَبْلَ أَنْ يُحْرِمَ وَيَوْمَ النَّحْرِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ بِطِيبٍ فِيهِ مِسْكٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aahmadu bnu maniy'in, waya'quwbu alddawraqiyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa mansuwrun, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat kuntu autayyibu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qabla aan yuhrima wayawma alnnahri qabla aan yatuwfa bialbayti bitiybin fiyhi miskun ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I used to perfume the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with a perfume containing musk before entering upon the state of Ihram and on the day of sacrifice (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja) and (at the conclusion of Ihram) before circumambulating the House (for Tawaf-i-Ifada)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ، - قَالَ سَعِيدٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، - عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - عَنِ الرَّجُلِ، يَتَطَيَّبُ ثُمَّ يُصْبِحُ مُحْرِمًا فَقَالَ مَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أُصْبِحَ مُحْرِمًا أَنْضَخُ طِيبًا لأَنْ أَطَّلِيَ بِقَطِرَانٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ أَنْ أَفْعَلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ - رضى الله عنها - فَأَخْبَرْتُهَا أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ قَالَ مَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أُصْبِحَ مُحْرِمًا أَنْضَخُ طِيبًا لأَنْ أَطَّلِيَ بِقَطِرَانٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ أَنْ أَفْعَلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ أَنَا طَيَّبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ إِحْرَامِهِ ثُمَّ طَافَ فِي نِسَائِهِ ثُمَّ أَصْبَحَ مُحْرِمًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, waaabuw kaamilin jamiy'ana 'an aabiy 'awaanaaa, - qaala sa'iydun haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, - 'an iibraahiyma bni muhammadi bni almuntashiri, 'an aabiyhi, qaala saaaltu 'abda alllahi bna 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - 'ani alrrajuli, yatatayyabu thumma yusbihu muhrimana faqaala maa auhibbu aan ausbiha muhrimana aandakhu tiybana laan aattaliya biqatiraanin aahabbu iilaaaa min aan aaf'ala dhalika ‏.‏ fadakhaltu 'alaa 'aaiishaaa - rda allh 'nha - faaakhbartuhaa aanna abna 'umara qaala maa auhibbu aan ausbiha muhrimana aandakhu tiybana laan aattaliya biqatiraanin aahabbu iilaaaa min aan aaf'ala dhalika ‏.‏ faqaalat 'aaiishaau aanaa tayyabtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'inda iihraamihi thumma taafa fiy nisaaiihi thumma aasbaha muhrimana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. al-Muntashir reported on the authority of his father:I asked 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) about a person who applied perfume and then (on the following) morning entered upon the state of lhram. Thereupon he said: I do not like to enter upon the state of Ihram shaking off the perfume. Rubbing of tar (upon my body) is dearer to me than doing this (i. e. the applying of perfume), I went to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) and told her that Ibn 'Umar stated:" I do not like to enter upon the state of Ihram shaking off the perfume. Rubbing of tar (upon my body) is dearer to me than doing it (the applying of perfume)." Thereupon 'A'isha said: I applied perfume to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at the time of his entering upon the state of Ihram. He then went round his wives and then put on Ihram in the morning
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أُطَيِّبُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ يَطُوفُ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ ثُمَّ يُصْبِحُ مُحْرِمًا يَنْضَخُ طِيبًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna alhaarithi - haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an iibraahiyma bni muhammadi bni almuntashiri, qaala sami'tu aabiy yuhaddithu, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - aannahaa qaalat kuntu autayyibu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma yatuwfu 'alaa nisaaiihi thumma yusbihu muhrimana yandakhu tiybana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I used to apply perfume to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He then went round his wives, and entered upon the state of Ihram in the morning and the perfume was shaken off
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، وَسُفْيَانَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ، الْمُنْتَشِرِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - يَقُولُ لأَنْ أُصْبِحَ مُطَّلِيًا بِقَطِرَانٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُصْبِحَ مُحْرِمًا أَنْضَخُ طِيبًا - قَالَ - فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ - رضى الله عنها - فَأَخْبَرْتُهَا بِقَوْلِهِ فَقَالَتْ طَيَّبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَطَافَ فِي نِسَائِهِ ثُمَّ أَصْبَحَ مُحْرِمًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an mis'arin, wasufyaana, 'an iibraahiyma bni muhammadi bni, almuntashiri 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu abna 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - yaquwlu laan ausbiha muttaliyana biqatiraanin aahabbu iilaaaa min aan ausbiha muhrimana aandakhu tiybana - qaala - fadakhaltu 'alaa 'aaiishaaa - rda allh 'nha - faaakhbartuhaa biqawlihi faqaalat tayyabtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fataafa fiy nisaaiihi thumma aasbaha muhrimana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. al-Muntashir reported on the authority of his father:I heard from Ibn 'Umar having said this:" It is dearer to me to rub tar (on my body) than to enter upon the state of Ihram (in a state) of shaking off the perfume." He (the narrator) said: I went to 'A'isha and told her about this statement of his (of Ibn 'Umar). Thereupon she said: I applied perfume to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he then went round his wives and then entered upon the state of Ihram in the morning
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ الصَّعْبِ بْنِ جَثَّامَةَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، أَنَّهُ أَهْدَى لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِمَارًا وَحْشِيًّا وَهُوَ بِالأَبْوَاءِ - أَوْ بِوَدَّانَ - فَرَدَّهُ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَلَمَّا أَنْ رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا فِي وَجْهِي قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّا لَمْ نَرُدَّهُ عَلَيْكَ إِلاَّ أَنَّا حُرُمٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni, 'abdi alllahi 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alssa'bi bni jathhaamaaa alllaythiyyi, aannahu aahdaa lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm himaarana wahshiyyana wahuwa bialaabwaa'i - aaw biwaddaana - faraddahu 'alayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala falammaa aan raaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa fiy wajhiy qaala ‏ "‏ iinnaa lam naruddahu 'alayka iilaaa aannaa hurumun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Sa'b b. Jaththama al-Laithi reported that he presented a wild ass to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when he was at al-Abwa', or Waddan, and he refused to accept it. He (the narrator) said:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) looked into my face (which had the mark of dejection as my present had been rejected by him) he (in order to console me) said: We have refused it only because we are in a state of Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَهْدَيْتُ لَهُ حِمَارَ وَحْشٍ ‏.‏ كَمَا قَالَ مَالِكٌ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ وَصَالِحٍ أَنَّ الصَّعْبَ بْنَ جَثَّامَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, waqutaybaau, jamiy'ana 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h wahaddathanaa hasanun alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi aahdaytu lahu himaara wahshin ‏.‏ kamaa qaala maalikun ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi alllaythi wasaalihin aanna alssa'ba bna jathhaamaaa aakhbarahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith (pertaining to this topic), has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri (and the words are):" I presented to him (the Holy Prophet) a wild ass
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ أَهْدَيْتُ لَهُ مِنْ لَحْمِ حِمَارِ وَحْشٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, bnu 'uyaynaaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala aahdaytu lahu min lahmi himaari wahshin ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters (the narrator having) said this:" I presented to him the flesh of a wild ass
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ أَهْدَى الصَّعْبُ بْنُ جَثَّامَةَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِمَارَ وَحْشٍ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ فَرَدَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْلاَ أَنَّا مُحْرِمُونَ لَقَبِلْنَاهُ مِنْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an habiybi bni aabiy thaabitin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala aahdaa alssa'bu bnu jathhaamaaa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm himaara wahshin wahuwa muhrimun faraddahu 'alayhi waqaala ‏ "‏ lawlaa aannaa muhrimuwna laqabilnaahu minka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that al-Sa'b b. Jaththama presented to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) a wild ass as he was in a state of Ihram, and he returned it to him saying:If we were not in a state of Ihram, we would have accepted it from you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَنْصُورًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - فِي رِوَايَةِ مَنْصُورٍ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ أَهْدَى الصَّعْبُ بْنُ جَثَّامَةَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رِجْلَ حِمَارِ وَحْشٍ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَجُزَ حِمَارِ وَحْشٍ يَقْطُرُ دَمًا ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ حَبِيبٍ أُهْدِيَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شِقُّ حِمَارِ وَحْشٍ فَرَدَّهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa almu'tamiru bnu sulaymaana, qaala sami'tu mansuwrana, yuhaddithu 'ani alhakami, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an habiybin, jamiy'ana 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - fiy riwaayaai mansuwrin 'ani alhakami aahdaa alssa'bu bnu jathhaamaaa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm rijla himaari wahshin ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai shu'baaa 'ani alhakami 'ajuza himaari wahshin yaqturu damana ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai shu'baaa 'an habiybin auhdiya lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm shiqqu himaari wahshin faraddahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: The narration transmitted by Hakam (the words are):Al-Sa'b b. Jaththama presented to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the leg of a wild ass. And in the narration transmitted by Shu'ba (the words are): (He presented to him) the rump of a wild ass as the blood was trickling from it. In the narration transmitted by Shu'ba on the authority of Habib (the words are): A part of a wild ass was presented to the Apostle (may peace he upon him) and he returned it to him (who presented it)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ قَدِمَ زَيْدُ بْنُ أَرْقَمَ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَسْتَذْكِرُهُ كَيْفَ أَخْبَرْتَنِي عَنْ لَحْمِ صَيْدٍ أُهْدِيَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ حَرَامٌ قَالَ قَالَ أُهْدِيَ لَهُ عُضْوٌ مِنْ لَحْمِ صَيْدٍ فَرَدَّهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّا لاَ نَأْكُلُهُ إِنَّا حُرُمٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy alhasanu bnu muslimin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala qadima zaydu bnu aarqama faqaala lahu 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abbaasin yastadhkiruhu kayfa aakhbartaniy 'an lahmi saydin auhdiya iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa haraamun qaala qaala auhdiya lahu 'udwun min lahmi saydin faraddahu ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnaa laa naakuluhu iinnaa hurumun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Tawus reported on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) that Zaid b. Arqam went to him (Ibn 'Abbas) and said:Narrate how you informed me about the meat of the game presented to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was in the state of Ihram. Thereupon he said: He was presented with a slice of the meat of game, but he returned it to him (who presented it) saying: We are not going to eat it, as we are in the state of Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي، عُمَرَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قَتَادَةَ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا قَتَادَةَ، يَقُولُ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِالْقَاحَةِ فَمِنَّا الْمُحْرِمُ وَمِنَّا غَيْرُ الْمُحْرِمِ إِذْ بَصُرْتُ بِأَصْحَابِي يَتَرَاءَوْنَ شَيْئًا فَنَظَرْتُ فَإِذَا حِمَارُ وَحْشٍ ‏.‏ فَأَسْرَجْتُ فَرَسِي وَأَخَذْتُ رُمْحِي ثُمَّ رَكِبْتُ فَسَقَطَ مِنِّي سَوْطِي فَقُلْتُ لأَصْحَابِي وَكَانُوا مُحْرِمِينَ نَاوِلُونِي السَّوْطَ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا وَاللَّهِ لاَ نُعِينُكَ عَلَيْهِ بِشَىْءٍ ‏.‏ فَنَزَلْتُ فَتَنَاوَلْتُهُ ثُمَّ رَكِبْتُ فَأَدْرَكْتُ الْحِمَارَ مِنْ خَلْفِهِ وَهُوَ وَرَاءَ أَكَمَةٍ فَطَعَنْتُهُ بِرُمْحِي فَعَقَرْتُهُ فَأَتَيْتُ بِهِ أَصْحَابِي فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ كُلُوهُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لاَ تَأْكُلُوهُ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَامَنَا فَحَرَّكْتُ فَرَسِي فَأَدْرَكْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هُوَ حَلاَلٌ فَكُلُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy, 'umara - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa saalihu bnu kaysaana, qaala sami'tu aabaa muhammadin, mawlaa aabiy qataadaaa yaquwlu sami'tu aabaa qataadaaa, yaquwlu kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa iidhaa kunnaa bialqaahaai faminnaa almuhrimu waminnaa ghayru almuhrimi iidh basurtu biaashaabiy yataraa'awna shayiana fanazartu faiidhaa himaaru wahshin ‏.‏ faaasrajtu farasiy waaakhadhtu rumhiy thumma rakibtu fasaqata minniy sawtiy faqultu laashaabiy wakaanuwa muhrimiyna naawiluwniy alssawta ‏.‏ faqaaluwa waalllahi laa nu'iynuka 'alayhi bishaa'in ‏.‏ fanazaltu fatanaawaltuhu thumma rakibtu faaadraktu alhimaara min khalfihi wahuwa waraa'a aakamaain fata'antuhu birumhiy fa'aqartuhu faaataytu bihi aashaabiy faqaala ba'duhum kuluwhu ‏.‏ waqaala ba'duhum laa taakuluwhu ‏.‏ wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aamaamanaa faharraktu farasiy faaadraktuhu faqaala ‏ "‏ huwa halaalun fakuluwhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Qatada reported:We went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) till we reached al-Qaha (a place three stages away from Medina). Some of us were in the state of Ihram and some of us were not. I saw my companions looking towards something, and as I saw I found It to be a wild ass. I saddled my horse and took up my spear and then mounted upon (the horse) and my whip, fell down. I said to my companions as they were in the state of Ihram to pick up the whip for me but they said: By Allah, we cannot help you in any (such) thing (i. e. hunting). So i dismounted (the horse) and picked it (whip) up and mounted again and caught the wild ass after chasing it. It was behind a hillock and I attacked it with my spear and killed it. Then I brought it to my companions. Some of them said: Eat it, while others said: Do not eat it. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) was in front of us. I moved my horse and came to him (and asked him), whereupon he said: It is permissible, so eat it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، - رضى الله عنه - أَنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بِبَعْضِ طَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ تَخَلَّفَ مَعَ أَصْحَابٍ لَهُ مُحْرِمِينَ وَهُوَ غَيْرُ مُحْرِمٍ فَرَأَى حِمَارًا وَحْشِيًّا فَاسْتَوَى عَلَى فَرَسِهِ فَسَأَلَ أَصْحَابَهُ أَنْ يُنَاوِلُوهُ سَوْطَهُ فَأَبَوْا عَلَيْهِ فَسَأَلَهُمْ رُمْحَهُ فَأَبَوْا عَلَيْهِ فَأَخَذَهُ ثُمَّ شَدَّ عَلَى الْحِمَارِ فَقَتَلَهُ فَأَكَلَ مِنْهُ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبَى بَعْضُهُمْ فَأَدْرَكُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلُوهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا هِيَ طُعْمَةٌ أَطْعَمَكُمُوهَا اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, 'an maalikin, fiymaa quriia 'alayhi 'an aabiy alnnadri, 'an naafi'in, mawlaa aabiy qataadaaa 'an aabiy qataadaaa, - rda allh 'nh - aannahu kaana ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa iidhaa kaana biba'di tariyqi makkaaa takhallafa ma'a aashaabin lahu muhrimiyna wahuwa ghayru muhrimin faraaaa himaarana wahshiyyana faastawaa 'alaa farasihi fasaaala aashaabahu aan yunaawiluwhu sawtahu faaabawa 'alayhi fasaaalahum rumhahu faaabawa 'alayhi faaakhadhahu thumma shadda 'alaa alhimaari faqatalahu faaakala minhu ba'du aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabaa ba'duhum faaadrakuwa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaaluwhu 'an dhalika faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa hiya tu'maaun aat'amakumuwhaa alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Qatada (Allah be pleased with him) reported that while he was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on one of the highways of Mecca, he lagged behind him (the Holy Prophet) along with companions who were in the state of Ihram, whereas he was himself not Muhrim. He saw a wild ass. As he was mounting his horse he asked his companions to pick up for him his whip (which had dropped) but they refused to do so. He asked them to hand him over the spear, but they refused. He then himself took hold of it and chased the wild ass and killed it. Some of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) ate (its meat), but some of them refused to do so. They overtook the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and asked him about it, and he said:It is a food which Allah provided you (so eat it)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، - رضى الله عنه - فِي حِمَارِ الْوَحْشِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي النَّضْرِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ هَلْ مَعَكُمْ مِنْ لَحْمِهِ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, 'an maalikin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy qataadaaa, - rda allh 'nh - fiy himaari alwahshi ‏.‏ mithla hadiythi aabiy alnnadri ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi zaydi bni aaslama aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ hal ma'akum min lahmihi shaa'un ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith pertaining to the wild ass is reported on the authority of Abu Qatada. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this (variation of words) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:" Is there with you some of its flesh?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا صَالِحُ بْنُ مِسْمَارٍ السُّلَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ يَحْيَى، بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ انْطَلَقَ أَبِي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فَأَحْرَمَ أَصْحَابُهُ وَلَمْ يُحْرِمْ وَحُدِّثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ عَدُوًّا بِغَيْقَةَ فَانْطَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ - فَبَيْنَمَا أَنَا مَعَ أَصْحَابِهِ يَضْحَكُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ إِذْ نَظَرْتُ فَإِذَا أَنَا بِحِمَارِ وَحْشٍ فَحَمَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَطَعَنْتُهُ فَأَثْبَتُّهُ فَاسْتَعَنْتُهُمْ فَأَبَوْا أَنْ يُعِينُونِي فَأَكَلْنَا مِنْ لَحْمِهِ وَخَشِينَا أَنْ نُقْتَطَعَ فَانْطَلَقْتُ أَطْلُبُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُرَفِّعُ فَرَسِي شَأْوًا وَأَسِيرُ شَأْوًا فَلَقِيتُ رَجُلاً مِنْ بَنِي غِفَارٍ فِي جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ فَقُلْتُ أَيْنَ لَقِيتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ تَرَكْتُهُ بِتِعْهِنَ وَهُوَ قَائِلٌ السُّقْيَا فَلَحِقْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَكَ يَقْرَءُونَ عَلَيْكَ السَّلاَمَ وَرَحْمَةَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّهُمْ قَدْ خَشُوا أَنْ يُقْتَطَعُوا دُونَكَ انْتَظِرْهُمْ ‏.‏ فَانْتَظَرَهُمْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَصَدْتُ وَمَعِي مِنْهُ فَاضِلَةٌ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلْقَوْمِ ‏ "‏ كُلُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَهُمْ مُحْرِمُونَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa saalihu bnu mismaarin alssulamiyyu, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an yahyaa, bni aabiy kathiyrin haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy qataadaaa, qaala antalaqa aabiy ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama alhudaybiyaai faaahrama aashaabuhu walam yuhrim wahudditha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna 'aduwwana bighayqaaa faantalaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - qaala - fabaynamaa aanaa ma'a aashaabihi yadhaku ba'duhum iilaa ba'din iidh nazartu faiidhaa aanaa bihimaari wahshin fahamaltu 'alayhi fata'antuhu faaathbattuhu faasta'antuhum faaabawa aan yu'iynuwniy faaakalnaa min lahmihi wakhashiynaa aan nuqtata'a faantalaqtu aatlubu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm auraffi'u farasiy shaawana waaasiyru shaawana falaqiytu rajulaan min baniy ghifaarin fiy jawfi alllayli faqultu aayna laqiyta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala taraktuhu biti'hina wahuwa qaaiilun alssuqyaa falahiqtuhu faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna aashaabaka yaqra'uwna 'alayka alssalaama warahmaaa alllahi waiinnahum qad khashuwa aan yuqtata'uwa duwnaka antazirhum ‏.‏ faantazarahum faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy aasadtu wama'iy minhu faadilaaun faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm lilqawmi ‏ "‏ kuluwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahum muhrimuwna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Abu Qatada reported:My father went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the year of Hudaibiya. His Companions entered upon the state of Ihram whereas he did not, for it was conveyed to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that the enemy (was hiding at) Ghaiqa. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went forward. He (Abu Qatada) said: Meanwhile I was along with his Companions, some of them smiled (to one another) As I cast a glance I saw a wild ass. I attacked It with a spear and held it, and begged for their (i. e. of his companions) assistance, but they refused to help me and we ate its meat. But we were afraid lest we should be separated (from the Messenger of Allah). So I proceeded on (with a view to) seeking the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Some- times I'dashed my horse and sometimes I made it run at a leisurely pace (keeping pace with others). (In the meanwhile) I met a person from Banfu Ghifar in the middle of the night. I said to him: Where did you meet the messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? He said: I left him at Ta'bin and he intended to halt at Suqya to spend the afternoon. I met him and said: Messenger of Allah. your Companions convey salutations and benedictions of Allah to you and they fear that they may not be separated from you (and the enemy may do harm to you), so wait for them, and he (the Holy Prophet) waited for them. I said: Messenger of Allah, I killed a game and there is left with me (some of the meat). The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said to his people: Eat it. And they were in the state of Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَاجًّا وَخَرَجْنَا مَعَهُ - قَالَ - فَصَرَفَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فِيهِمْ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ خُذُوا سَاحِلَ الْبَحْرِ حَتَّى تَلْقَوْنِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَخَذُوا سَاحِلَ الْبَحْرِ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفُوا قِبَلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْرَمُوا كُلُّهُمْ إِلاَّ أَبَا قَتَادَةَ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يُحْرِمْ فَبَيْنَمَا هُمْ يَسِيرُونَ إِذْ رَأَوْا حُمُرَ وَحْشٍ فَحَمَلَ عَلَيْهَا أَبُو قَتَادَةَ فَعَقَرَ مِنْهَا أَتَانًا فَنَزَلُوا فَأَكَلُوا مِنْ لَحْمِهَا - قَالَ - فَقَالُوا أَكَلْنَا لَحْمًا وَنَحْنُ مُحْرِمُونَ - قَالَ - فَحَمَلُوا مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ لَحْمِ الأَتَانِ فَلَمَّا أَتَوْا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا كُنَّا أَحْرَمْنَا وَكَانَ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ لَمْ يُحْرِمْ فَرَأَيْنَا حُمُرَ وَحْشٍ فَحَمَلَ عَلَيْهَا أَبُو قَتَادَةَ فَعَقَرَ مِنْهَا أَتَانًا فَنَزَلْنَا فَأَكَلْنَا مِنْ لَحْمِهَا فَقُلْنَا نَأْكُلُ لَحْمَ صَيْدٍ وَنَحْنُ مُحْرِمُونَ ‏.‏ فَحَمَلْنَا مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ لَحْمِهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ أَمَرَهُ أَوْ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ بِشَىْءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالُوا لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَكُلُوا مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ لَحْمِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an 'uthmaana bni 'abdi alllahi bni mawhabin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi, - rda allh 'nh - qaala kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm haajjana wakharajnaa ma'ahu - qaala - fasarafa min aashaabihi fiyhim aabuw qataadaaa faqaala ‏"‏ khudhuwa saahila albahri hattaa talqawniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faaakhadhuwa saahila albahri ‏.‏ falammaa ansarafuwa qibala rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahramuwa kulluhum iilaaa aabaa qataadaaa faiinnahu lam yuhrim fabaynamaa hum yasiyruwna iidh raaawa humura wahshin fahamala 'alayhaa aabuw qataadaaa fa'aqara minhaa aataanana fanazaluwa faaakaluwa min lahmihaa - qaala - faqaaluwa aakalnaa lahmana wanahnu muhrimuwna - qaala - fahamaluwa maa baqiya min lahmi alaataani falammaa aatawa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaa kunnaa aahramnaa wakaana aabuw qataadaaa lam yuhrim faraaaynaa humura wahshin fahamala 'alayhaa aabuw qataadaaa fa'aqara minhaa aataanana fanazalnaa faaakalnaa min lahmihaa faqulnaa naakulu lahma saydin wanahnu muhrimuwna ‏.‏ fahamalnaa maa baqiya min lahmihaa ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ hal minkum aahadun aamarahu aaw aashaara iilayhi bishaa'in ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qaaluwa laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fakuluwa maa baqiya min lahmihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Abu Qatada reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him):The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) set out for Pilgrimage and we also set out along with him. He (Abu Qatada) said: There proceeded on some of his Companions and Abu Qatada was (one of them). He (the Prophet) said: You proceed along the coastline till you meet me. He (Abu Qatada) said: So they proceeded ahead of the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ), all of them had entered upon the state of Ihram, except Abu Qatada; he had not put on ihram. As they went on they saw a wild ass, and Abu Qatada attacked it and cut off its hind legs. They got down and ate its meat. They said: We ate meat In the state of Ihram. They carried the meat that was left of it. As they came to the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) they said: Messenger of Allah, we were in the state of Ihram whereas Abu Qatada was not. We saw a wild ass and Abu Qatada attacked it and cut off its hind legs. We got down and ate its meat and we thus ate the meat of a game while we were In the state of Ihram. We have (carried to you) what was left out of its meat. Thereupon he (the holy Prophet) said: Did anyone among you command him (to hunt) or point to him with anything (to do so)? They said: No. Thereupon he said: Then eat what is left out of its meat
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ، بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ فِي رِوَايَةِ شَيْبَانَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَمِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَحْمِلَ عَلَيْهَا أَوْ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَشَرْتُمْ أَوْ أَعَنْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ ‏"‏ أَصَدْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ لاَ أَدْرِي قَالَ ‏"‏ أَعَنْتُمْ أَوْ أَصَدْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, h wahaddathaniy alqaasimu, bnu zakariyyaa'a haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an shaybaana, jamiy'ana 'an 'uthmaana bni 'abdi alllahi bni mawhabin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi fiy riwaayaai shaybaana faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaminkum aahadun aamarahu aan yahmila 'alayhaa aaw aashaara iilayhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai shu'baaa qaala ‏"‏ aashartum aaw aa'antum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw ‏"‏ aasadtum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau laa aadriy qaala ‏"‏ aa'antum aaw aasadtum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated'on the authority of 'Uthman b. 'Abdullah b. Mauhab with the same chain of transmitters. And in the narration transmitted on the authority of Shaiban (the words are):" The Messenoer of Allah (ﷺ) said: Did any one of you command him to attack it or point towards it?" And in the narration transmitted by Shu'ba (the words are):" Did you point out or did you help or did you hunt?" Shu'ba said: I do not know whether he said:" Did you help or did you hunt?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَلاَّمٍ - أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، - رضى الله عنه - أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، غَزَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَزْوَةَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ قَالَ فَأَهَلُّوا بِعُمْرَةٍ غَيْرِي - قَالَ - فَاصْطَدْتُ حِمَارَ وَحْشٍ فَأَطْعَمْتُ أَصْحَابِي وَهُمْ مُحْرِمُونَ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَنْبَأْتُهُ أَنَّ عِنْدَنَا مِنْ لَحْمِهِ فَاضِلَةً ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلُوهُ ‏"‏ وَهُمْ مُحْرِمُونَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu hassaana, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau, - wahuwa abnu salaaamin - aakhbaraniy yahyaa, aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy qataadaaa, aanna aabaahu, - rda allh 'nh - aakhbarahu aannahu, ghazaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghazwaaa alhudaybiyaai qaala faaahalluwa bi'umraain ghayriy - qaala - faastadtu himaara wahshin faaat'amtu aashaabiy wahum muhrimuwna thumma aataytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaanbaatuhu aanna 'indanaa min lahmihi faadilaaan ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ kuluwhu ‏"‏ wahum muhrimuwna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Abu Qatada narrated on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him) that they went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on an expedition to Hudaibiya. He (further) said:They had entered upon the state of Ihram except I for 'Umra. He (again) said: I (Abu Qatada) hunted a wild ass and fed my companions in the state of their being Muhrim. 1 then came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and informed him that we had with us the meat that was left out of it. Thereupon he said: "Eat it," while they were in the state of Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ الضَّبِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ النُّمَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَازِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، - رضى الله عنه - أَنَّهُمْ خَرَجُوا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُمْ مُحْرِمُونَ وَأَبُو قَتَادَةَ مُحِلٌّ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَفِيهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هَلْ مَعَكُمْ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا مَعَنَا رِجْلُهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَخَذَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَكَلَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdaaa alddabbiyyu, haddathanaa fudaylu bnu sulaymaana alnnumayriyyu, haddathanaa aabuw haazimin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi, - rda allh 'nh - aannahum kharajuwa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahum muhrimuwna waaabuw qataadaaa muhillun ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha wafiyhi faqaala ‏ "‏ hal ma'akum minhu shaa'un ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa ma'anaa rijluhu ‏.‏ qaala faaakhadhahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakalahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Abu Qatada reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him) that they went out with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and they were Muhrim except Abu Qatada. The rest of the hadith Is the same (but with the exception of these words):" He (the Holy Prophet) said: 15 there any- thing out of it? They said: We have its leg with us. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took it and ate it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، وَإِسْحَاقُ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ فِي نَفَرٍ مُحْرِمِينَ وَأَبُو قَتَادَةَ مُحِلٌّ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ وَفِيهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ إِنْسَانٌ مِنْكُمْ أَوْ أَمَرَهُ بِشَىْءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَكُلُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, waiishaaqu, 'an jariyrin, kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni rufay'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, qaala kaana aabuw qataadaaa fiy nafarin muhrimiyna waaabuw qataadaaa muhillun waaqtassa alhadiytha wafiyhi qaala ‏"‏ hal aashaara iilayhi iinsaanun minkum aaw aamarahu bishaa'in ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa laa yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fakuluwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Abi Qatada reported that Abu Qatada was among the party of those who had entered upon the state of Ihram whereas he was not. The rest of the hadith is the same (and herein it is also narrated):" He (the Holy Prophet) said: Did any person among you point to him (to hunt) or command him (in any form)? They said: Messenger of Allah, not at all. Thereupon he said: Then eat it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ وَنَحْنُ حُرُمٌ فَأُهْدِيَ لَهُ طَيْرٌ وَطَلْحَةُ رَاقِدٌ فَمِنَّا مَنْ أَكَلَ وَمِنَّا مَنْ تَوَرَّعَ فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْقَظَ طَلْحَةُ وَفَّقَ مَنْ أَكَلَهُ وَقَالَ أَكَلْنَاهُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy muhammadu, bnu almunkadiri 'an mu'aadhi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'uthmaana alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kunnaa ma'a talhaaa bni 'ubaydi alllahi wanahnu hurumun faauhdiya lahu tayrun watalhaau raaqidun faminnaa man aakala waminnaa man tawarra'a falammaa astayqaza talhaau waffaqa man aakalahu waqaala aakalnaahu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. `Uthman Taimi reported on the authority of his father:While we were with Talha b. Ubaidullah and were in the state of Ihram we were presented a (cooked) bird. Talha was sleeping. Some of us ate it and some of us refrained from (eating) it. When Talha awoke he agreed with him who ate it, and said: We ate it along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
