verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مِقْسَمٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أَرْبَعٌ كُلُّهُنَّ فَاسِقٌ يُقْتَلْنَ فِي الْحِلِّ وَالْحَرَمِ الْحِدَأَةُ وَالْغُرَابُ وَالْفَارَةُ وَالْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لِلْقَاسِمِ أَفَرَأَيْتَ الْحَيَّةَ قَالَ تُقْتَلُ بِصُغْرٍ لَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy makhramaau bnu bukayrin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu 'ubayda alllahi bna miqsamin, yaquwlu sami'tu alqaasima bna muhammadin, yaquwlu sami'tu 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm taquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ aarba'un kulluhunna faasiqun yuqtalna fiy alhilli waalharami alhidaaaau waalghuraabu waalfaaraau waalkalbu al'aquwru ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqultu lilqaasimi aafaraaayta alhayyaaa qaala tuqtalu bisughrin lahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Four are the vicious (birds, beasts and reptiles) which should be killed in the state of Ihram or otherwise: kite (and vulture), crow, rat, and the voracious dog. I (one of the narrators, `Ubaidullah b. Miqsam) said to Qasim (the other narrator who heard it from `A'isha): What about the snake? He said: Let it be killed with disgrace
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ سَعِيدِ، بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ خَمْسٌ فَوَاسِقُ يُقْتَلْنَ فِي الْحِلِّ وَالْحَرَمِ الْحَيَّةُ وَالْغُرَابُ الأَبْقَعُ وَالْفَارَةُ وَالْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ وَالْحُدَيَّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu 'an sa'iydi, bni almusayyabi 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ khamsun fawaasiqu yuqtalna fiy alhilli waalharami alhayyaau waalghuraabu alaabqa'u waalfaaraau waalkalbu al'aquwru waalhudayyaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported Allah'* Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Five are the harmful things which should be killed in the state of Ihram or otherwise: snake, speckled crow. rat. voracious dog, and kite
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ، عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خَمْسٌ فَوَاسِقُ يُقْتَلْنَ فِي الْحَرَمِ الْعَقْرَبُ وَالْفَارَةُ وَالْحُدَيَّا وَالْغُرَابُ وَالْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, - wahuwa abnu zaydin - haddathanaa hishaamu bnu, 'urwaaa 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ khamsun fawaasiqu yuqtalna fiy alharami al'aqrabu waalfaaraau waalhudayyaa waalghuraabu waalkalbu al'aquwru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Five are the vicious beasts which should be killed even in the state of Ihram: scorpion, rat, kite, crow and voracious dog
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خَمْسٌ فَوَاسِقُ يُقْتَلْنَ فِي الْحَرَمِ الْفَارَةُ وَالْعَقْرَبُ وَالْغُرَابُ وَالْحُدَيَّا وَالْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ khamsun fawaasiqu yuqtalna fiy alharami alfaaraau waal'aqrabu waalghuraabu waalhudayyaa waalkalbu al'aquwru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Mdssenger (ﷺ) having said this:Five are the vicious and harmful things which should be killed even within the precincts of Haram: rat, scorpion, crow. kite and voracious dog
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَتْ أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقَتْلِ خَمْسِ فَوَاسِقَ فِي الْحِلِّ وَالْحَرَمِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ زُرَيْعٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi qaalat aamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biqatli khamsi fawaasiqa fiy alhilli waalharami ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bimithli hadiythi yaziyda bni zuray'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters that she (A'isha) reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded to kill five harmful things in the state of lhram or otherwise. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خَمْسٌ مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ كُلُّهَا فَوَاسِقُ تُقْتَلُ فِي الْحَرَمِ الْغُرَابُ وَالْحِدَأَةُ وَالْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ وَالْعَقْرَبُ وَالْفَارَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni, shihaabin 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ khamsun mina alddawaabbi kulluhaa fawaasiqu tuqtalu fiy alharami alghuraabu waalhidaaaau waalkalbu al'aquwru waal'aqrabu waalfaaraau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: IA'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Five are the beasts 1618 harmful and vicious and these must be killed even within the precincts of the Ka'ba: crow, kite, voracio@s dog, kcorpion and rat
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، - رضى الله عنه - عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ خَمْسٌ لاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَى مَنْ قَتَلَهُنَّ فِي الْحَرَمِ وَالإِحْرَامِ الْفَارَةُ وَالْعَقْرَبُ وَالْغُرَابُ وَالْحِدَأَةُ وَالْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ ‏"‏ فِي الْحُرُمِ وَالإِحْرَامِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, - rda allh 'nh - 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ khamsun laa junaaha 'alaa man qatalahunna fiy alharami waaliihraami alfaaraau waal'aqrabu waalghuraabu waalhidaaaau waalkalbu al'aquwru ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala abnu aabiy 'umara fiy riwaayatihi ‏"‏ fiy alhurumi waaliihraami ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Five are the (beasts) which if one kills them in the precincts of the Ka'ba or in the state of lhram entail no sin: rat, scorpion, crow, kite and voracious dog. In another version the words are:" as a Muhrim and in the state of lhram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ قَالَتْ حَفْصَةُ زَوْجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خَمْسٌ مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ كُلُّهَا فَاسِقٌ لاَ حَرَجَ عَلَى مَنْ قَتَلَهُنَّ الْعَقْرَبُ وَالْغُرَابُ وَالْحِدَأَةُ وَالْفَارَةُ وَالْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala qaalat hafsaau zawju alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ khamsun mina alddawaabbi kulluhaa faasiqun laa haraja 'alaa man qatalahunna al'aqrabu waalghuraabu waalhidaaaau waalfaaraau waalkalbu al'aquwru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hafsa, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this:There are five beasts, all of them are vicious and harmful and there is no sin for one who kills them (and these are): scorpion, crow, kite, rat and voracious dog
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ مَا يَقْتُلُ الْمُحْرِمُ مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ فَقَالَ أَخْبَرَتْنِي إِحْدَى نِسْوَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ أَمَرَ - أَوْ أُمِرَ - أَنْ تُقْتَلَ الْفَارَةُ وَالْعَقْرَبُ وَالْحِدَأَةُ وَالْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ وَالْغُرَابُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa zaydu bnu jubayrin, aanna rajulaan, saaala abna 'umara maa yaqtulu almuhrimu mina alddawaabbi faqaala aakhbaratniy iihdaa niswaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu aamara - aaw aumira - aan tuqtala alfaaraau waal'aqrabu waalhidaaaau waalkalbu al'aquwru waalghuraabu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Jubair reported:A person asked Ibn Umar which beast a Muhrim could kill. Thereupon he said: One of the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) told me: He (the Holy Prophet) commanded to kill rat, scorpion, kite, voracious dog and crow
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ ابْنَ عُمَرَ مَا يَقْتُلُ الرَّجُلُ مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي إِحْدَى نِسْوَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَأْمُرُ بِقَتْلِ الْكَلْبِ الْعَقُورِ وَالْفَارَةِ وَالْعَقْرَبِ وَالْحُدَيَّا وَالْغُرَابِ وَالْحَيَّةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَفِي الصَّلاَةِ أَيْضًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an zaydi bni jubayrin, qaala saaala rajulun abna 'umara maa yaqtulu alrrajulu mina alddawaabbi wahuwa muhrimun qaala haddathatniy iihdaa niswaai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu kaana yaamuru biqatli alkalbi al'aquwri waalfaaraai waal'aqrabi waalhudayyaa waalghuraabi waalhayyaai ‏.‏ qaala wafiy alssalaaai aaydana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Jubair reported:A person asked Ibn 'Umar which beast a Muhrim could kill, whereupon he said: One of the wives of Allahs Apostle (ﷺ) told me: He (the Holy Prophet) commanded to kill voracious dog, rat, scorpion, kite, crow, and snake (and this is allowed) likewise in prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ خَمْسٌ مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ لَيْسَ عَلَى الْمُحْرِمِ فِي قَتْلِهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ الْغُرَابُ وَالْحِدَأَةُ وَالْعَقْرَبُ وَالْفَارَةُ وَالْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ khamsun mina alddawaabbi laysa 'alaa almuhrimi fiy qatlihinna junaahun alghuraabu waalhidaaaau waal'aqrabu waalfaaraau waalkalbu al'aquwru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Five are the beasts for killing which there is no sin for the Muhrim: crows, kites, scorpions, rats and wild dogs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِنَافِعٍ مَاذَا سَمِعْتَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يُحِلُّ لِلْحَرَامِ قَتْلَهُ مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ فَقَالَ لِي نَافِعٌ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ خَمْسٌ مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ لاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَى مَنْ قَتَلَهُنَّ فِي قَتْلِهِنَّ الْغُرَابُ وَالْحِدَأَةُ وَالْعَقْرَبُ وَالْفَارَةُ وَالْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, qaala qultu linaafi'in maadhaa sami'ta abna 'umara, yuhillu lilharaami qatlahu mina alddawaabbi faqaala liy naafi'un qaala 'abdu alllahi sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ khamsun mina alddawaabbi laa junaaha 'alaa man qatalahunna fiy qatlihinna alghuraabu waalhidaaaau waal'aqrabu waalfaaraau waalkalbu al'aquwru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Juraij reported:I said to Nafi: What is that which you heard Ibn, Umar declaring permissible for a Muhrim to kill some of the beasts? Nafi, said to me that 'Abdullah had reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Five are the beasts in killing which or their being killed, there is no sin: crow, kite, scorpion, rat and voracious dog
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، رُمْحٍ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَازِمٍ - جَمِيعًا عَنْ نَافِعٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ، بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي جَمِيعًا، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ وَابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ إِلاَّ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ وَحْدَهُ وَقَدْ تَابَعَ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ عَلَى ذَلِكَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau, waabnu, rumhin 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, h wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa jariyrun, - ya'niy abna haazimin - jamiy'ana 'an naafi'in, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu, bnu mushirin h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy jamiy'ana, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathaniy aabuw kaamilin, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, kullu hauulaa'i 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi maalikin waabni jurayjin walam yaqul aahadun minhum 'an naafi'in 'ani abni 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ iilaaa abnu jurayjin wahdahu waqad taaba'a abna jurayjin 'alaa dhalika abnu iishaaqa ‏.‏
verses.translation: The above hadith was reported with other chains from Nafi' on the authority of Ibn 'Umar, but there was difference in the wording in how the attributed the chain
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ فَضْلُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ خَمْسٌ لاَ جُنَاحَ فِي قَتْلِ مَا قُتِلَ مِنْهُنَّ فِي الْحَرَمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِهِ‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi fadlu bnu sahlin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu iishaaqa, 'an naafi'in, wa'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ khamsun laa junaaha fiy qatli maa qutila minhunna fiy alharami ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithlihi‏
verses.translation: (This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through be upon him) as saying:Five (are the beasts) in killing which or their being killed in the precinct of the Ka'ba there is no sin." The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ، اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خَمْسٌ مَنْ قَتَلَهُنَّ وَهُوَ حَرَامٌ فَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ فِيهِنَّ الْعَقْرَبُ وَالْفَارَةُ وَالْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ وَالْغُرَابُ وَالْحُدَيَّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى بْنِ يَحْيَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wayahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaala yahyaa bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, aannahu sami'a 'abda, alllahi bna 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ khamsun man qatalahunna wahuwa haraamun falaa junaaha 'alayhi fiyhinna al'aqrabu waalfaaraau waalkalbu al'aquwru waalghuraabu waalhudayyaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waalllafzu liyahyaa bni yahyaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messen- ger (ﷺ) as saying:Five (are the animals) which, it one kills them In the state of Ihram, entail no sin for one (who does it): scorpion, rat, voracious dog, crow and kite
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ أَتَى عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَمَنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ وَأَنَا أُوقِدُ تَحْتَ - قَالَ الْقْوَارِيرِيُّ قِدْرٍ لِي ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ بُرْمَةٍ لِي - وَالْقَمْلُ يَتَنَاثَرُ عَلَى وَجْهِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُؤْذِيكَ هَوَامُّ رَأْسِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاحْلِقْ وَصُمْ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ أَطْعِمْ سِتَّةَ مَسَاكِينَ أَوِ انْسُكْ نَسِيكَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَيُّوبُ فَلاَ أَدْرِي بِأَىِّ ذَلِكَ بَدَأَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, - ya'niy abna zaydin - 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, qaala sami'tu mujaahidana, yuhaddithu 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, bni aabiy laylaa 'an ka'bi bni 'ujraaa, - rda allh 'nh - qaala aataa 'alaaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm zamana alhudaybiyaai waaanaa auwqidu tahta - qaala alqwaariyriyyu qidrin liy ‏.‏ waqaala aabuw alrrabiy'i burmaain liy - waalqamlu yatanaatharu 'alaa wajhiy faqaala ‏"‏ aayuudhiyka hawaammu raasika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faahliq wasum thalaathaaa aayyaamin aaw aat'im sittaaa masaakiyna aawi ansuk nasiykaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aayyuwbu falaa aadriy biaaaai dhalika badaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ka'b b. 'Ujra (Allah be pleased with him) reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to me on the occasion of Hudaibiya and I was kindling fire under my cooking pot and lice were creeping on my face. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Do the vermins harm your head? I said: Yes. He said: Get your head shaved and (in lieu of it) observe fasts for three days or feed six needy persons, or offer sacrifice (of an animal). Ayyub said: I do not know with what (type of expiation) did he commence (the statement)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَيَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa, 'an aayyuwba, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Ayyub
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ فِيَّ أُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ مَرِيضًا أَوْ بِهِ أَذًى مِنْ رَأْسِهِ فَفِدْيَةٌ مِنْ صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ‏}‏ قَالَ فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ادْنُهْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَدَنَوْتُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ادْنُهْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَدَنَوْتُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَيُؤْذِيكَ هَوَامُّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَوْنٍ وَأَظُنُّهُ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَمَرَنِي بِفِدْيَةٍ مِنْ صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ مَا تَيَسَّرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'ani abni 'awnin, 'an mujaahidin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, 'an ka'bi bni 'ujraaa, - rda allh 'nh - qaala fiyya aunzilat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏ faman kaana minkum mariydana aaw bihi aadhana min raasihi fafidyaaun min siyaamin aaw sadaqaain aaw nusukin‏}‏ qaala faaataytuhu faqaala ‏"‏ adnuh ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadanawtu faqaala ‏"‏ adnuh ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadanawtu ‏.‏ faqaala sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aayuudhiyka hawaammuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu 'awnin waaazunnuhu qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala faaamaraniy bifidyaain min siyaamin aaw sadaqaain aaw nusukin maa tayassara ‏.‏
verses.translation: Kalb b. Ujra (Allah be pleased with him) reported:It was I for whom this verse was revealed (to the Holy Prophet):" Whoever among you is sick or has an ail- ment of the head, he (may effect) a compensation by lasting or alms or a sacrifice" He said: I came to him (the Holy Prophet) and he said: Come Dear. So I went near. He (again) said: Come near. So I went near. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do the vermins trouble you? Ibn Aun (one of the narrators) said: I think he (Ka'b b. Ujra) replied in the affirmative. He (the Holy Prophet) then commanded to do compensation by fasting or by giving sadaqa (feeding six needy persons) or by sacrifice (of a animal) that is available
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سَيْفٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ، الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى حَدَّثَنِي كَعْبُ بْنُ عُجْرَةَ، - رضى الله عنه - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَفَ عَلَيْهِ وَرَأْسُهُ يَتَهَافَتُ قَمْلاً فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُؤْذِيكَ هَوَامُّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاحْلِقْ رَأْسَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَفِيَّ نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ مَرِيضًا أَوْ بِهِ أَذًى مِنْ رَأْسِهِ فَفِدْيَةٌ مِنْ صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ‏}‏ فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ صُمْ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ تَصَدَّقْ بِفَرَقٍ بَيْنَ سِتَّةِ مَسَاكِينَ أَوِ انْسُكْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sayfun, qaala sami'tu mujaahidana, yaquwlu haddathaniy 'abdu, alrrahmani bnu aabiy laylaa haddathaniy ka'bu bnu 'ujraaa, - rda allh 'nh - aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqafa 'alayhi waraasuhu yatahaafatu qamlaan faqaala ‏"‏ aayuudhiyka hawaammuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faahliq raasaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fafiyya nazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏ faman kaana minkum mariydana aaw bihi aadhana min raasihi fafidyaaun min siyaamin aaw sadaqaain aaw nusukin‏}‏ faqaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ sum thalaathaaa aayyaamin aaw tasaddaq bifaraqin bayna sittaai masaakiyna aawi ansuk maa tayassara ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ka'b b. 'Ujra (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (may peace be, upon him) stood near him and lice were falling from his head. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said:Do these vermins trouble you? I said: Yes. Thereupon he said: Then shave your head; and it was in connection with me that this verse was revealed:" Whoever among you is sick or has an ailment of the head, he (may effect) a compensation by fasting or alms or a sacrifice". He (the Holy Prophet, therefore) said to me: Observe fast for three days or give a quantity of alms enough to feed six needy persons or offer sacrifice (of an animal) that is available
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، وَأَيُّوبَ، وَحُمَيْدٍ، وَعَبْدِ، الْكَرِيمِ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ، - رضى الله عنه - أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ بِهِ وَهُوَ بِالْحُدَيْبِيَةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ مَكَّةَ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ وَهُوَ يُوقِدُ تَحْتَ قِدْرٍ وَالْقَمْلُ يَتَهَافَتُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُؤْذِيكَ هَوَامُّكَ هَذِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاحْلِقْ رَأْسَكَ وَأَطْعِمْ فَرَقًا بَيْنَ سِتَّةِ مَسَاكِينَ - وَالْفَرَقُ ثَلاَثَةُ آصُعٍ - أَوْ صُمْ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوِ انْسُكْ نَسِيكَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ ‏"‏ أَوِ اذْبَحْ شَاةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani abni aabiy najiyhin, waaayyuwba, wahumaydin, wa'abdi, alkariymi 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni aabiy laylaa, 'an ka'bi bni 'ujraaa, - rda allh 'nh - aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm marra bihi wahuwa bialhudaybiyaai qabla aan yadkhula makkaaa wahuwa muhrimun wahuwa yuwqidu tahta qidrin waalqamlu yatahaafatu 'alaa wajhihi faqaala ‏"‏ aayuudhiyka hawaammuka hadhihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faahliq raasaka waaat'im faraqana bayna sittaai masaakiyna - waalfaraqu thalaathaau asu'in - aaw sum thalaathaaa aayyaamin aawi ansuk nasiykaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu aabiy najiyhin ‏"‏ aawi adhbah shaaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ka`b b. 'Ujra (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by him at Hudaibiya before entering Mecca in a state of Ihram and he (Ka'b) was kindling fire under the cooking pot and vermin were creeping on his (Ka`b's) face. Thereupon (the Holy Prophet) said:Do these vermin trouble you? He (Ka'b) said: Yes. The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) said: Shave your head and give some quantity of food enough to feed six needy persons (faraq is equal to three sa's), or observe fast for three days or offer sacrifice of a sacrificial animal. Ibn Najih (one of the narrators) said:" Or sacrifice a goat
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ، رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ بِهِ زَمَنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فَقَالَ لَهُ ‏"‏ آذَاكَ هَوَامُّ رَأْسِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ احْلِقْ رَأْسَكَ ثُمَّ اذْبَحْ شَاةً نُسُكًا أَوْ صُمْ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ أَطْعِمْ ثَلاَثَةَ آصُعٍ مِنْ تَمْرٍ عَلَى سِتَّةِ مَسَاكِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an khaalidin, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, 'an ka'bi bni 'ujraaa, rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm marra bihi zamana alhudaybiyaai faqaala lahu ‏"‏ adhaaka hawaammu raasika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏ faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ ahliq raasaka thumma adhbah shaaaan nusukana aaw sum thalaathaaa aayyaamin aaw aat'im thalaathaaa asu'in min tamrin 'alaa sittaai masaakiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ka'b b. Ujra (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by him during the period of Hudaibiya. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said to him (Ka'b b. Ujra):Do these vermins trouble your head? He said: Yes. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Shave your head. Then sacrifice a goat or observe fasts for three days or give three sits of dates to feed six needy persons
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الأَصْبَهَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْقِلٍ، قَالَ قَعَدْتُ إِلَى كَعْبٍ - رضى الله عنه - وَهُوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ هَذِهِ الآيَةِ ‏{‏ فَفِدْيَةٌ مِنْ صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ‏}‏ فَقَالَ كَعْبٌ رضى الله عنه نَزَلَتْ فِيَّ كَانَ بِي أَذًى مِنْ رَأْسِي فَحُمِلْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْقَمْلُ يَتَنَاثَرُ عَلَى وَجْهِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا كُنْتُ أُرَى أَنَّ الْجَهْدَ بَلَغَ مِنْكَ مَا أَرَى أَتَجِدُ شَاةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لاَ فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ فَفِدْيَةٌ مِنْ صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ‏}‏ قَالَ صَوْمُ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ إِطْعَامُ سِتَّةِ مَسَاكِينَ نِصْفَ صَاعٍ طَعَامًا لِكُلِّ مِسْكِينٍ - قَالَ - فَنَزَلَتْ فِيَّ خَاصَّةً وَهْىَ لَكُمْ عَامَّةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alaasbahaaniyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni ma'qilin, qaala qa'adtu iilaa ka'bin - rda allh 'nh - wahuwa fiy almasjidi fasaaaltuhu 'an hadhihi alayaai ‏{‏ fafidyaaun min siyaamin aaw sadaqaain aaw nusukin‏}‏ faqaala ka'bun rda allh 'nh nazalat fiyya kaana biy aadhana min raasiy fahumiltu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalqamlu yatanaatharu 'alaa wajhiy faqaala ‏"‏ maa kuntu auraa aanna aljahda balagha minka maa aaraa aatajidu shaaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu laa fanazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏ fafidyaaun min siyaamin aaw sadaqaain aaw nusukin‏}‏ qaala sawmu thalaathaai aayyaamin aaw iit'aamu sittaai masaakiyna nisfa saa'in ta'aamana likulli miskiynin - qaala - fanazalat fiyya khaassaaan wahaa lakum 'aammaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Ma'qil said:I sat with Ka'b (Allah be pleased with him) and he was in the mosque. I asked him about this verse:" Compensation in (the form of) fasting, or Sadaqa or sacrifice." Ka'b (Allah be pleased with him) said: It was reveal- ed In my case. There was some trouble in my head. I was taken to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and lice were creeping upon my face. Thereupon he said: I did not think that your trouble had become so unbearable as I see. Would you be able to afford (the sacrificing) of a goat? I (Ka'b) said: Then this verse was revealed:" Com- pensation (in the form of) fasting or alms or a sacrifice." He (the Holy Prophet) said: (It Implies) fasting for three days, or feeding six needy perscins, half sa' of food for every needy person. This verse was revealed particularly for me and (now) Its applica- tion is general for all of you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّاءَ بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الأَصْبَهَانِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَعْقِلٍ، حَدَّثَنِي كَعْبُ بْنُ عُجْرَةَ، - رضى الله عنه - أَنَّهُ خَرَجَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُحْرِمًا فَقَمِلَ رَأْسُهُ وَلِحْيَتُهُ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ فَدَعَا الْحَلاَّقَ فَحَلَقَ رَأْسَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ ‏"‏ هَلْ عِنْدَكَ نُسُكٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مَا أَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَصُومَ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ يُطْعِمَ سِتَّةَ مَسَاكِينَ لِكُلِّ مِسْكِينَيْنِ صَاعٌ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فِيهِ خَاصَّةً ‏{‏ فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ مَرِيضًا أَوْ بِهِ أَذًى مِنْ رَأْسِهِ‏}‏ ثُمَّ كَانَتْ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ عَامَّةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, 'an zakariyyaa'a bni aabiy zaaiidaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu alaasbahaaniyyi, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu ma'qilin, haddathaniy ka'bu bnu 'ujraaa, - rda allh 'nh - aannahu kharaja ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm muhrimana faqamila raasuhu walihyatuhu fabalagha dhalika alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaarsala iilayhi fada'aa alhalaaaqa fahalaqa raasahu thumma qaala lahu ‏"‏ hal 'indaka nusukun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala maa aaqdiru 'alayhi ‏.‏ faaamarahu aan yasuwma thalaathaaa aayyaamin aaw yut'ima sittaaa masaakiyna likulli miskiynayni saa'un faaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla fiyhi khaassaaan ‏{‏ faman kaana minkum mariydana aaw bihi aadhana min raasihi‏}‏ thumma kaanat lilmuslimiyna 'aammaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ka'b b. Ujra (Allah be pleased with him) reported that he went out with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the state of Ihram, and his (Ka'b's) head and beard were infested with lice. This was conveyed to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He sent for him (Ka'b) and called a barber (who) shaved his head. He (the Holy Prophet) said. Is there any sacrificial animal with you? He (Kalb) said:I cannot afford it. He then commanded him to observe fasts for three days or feed six needy persons, one sa' for every two needy persons. And Allah the Exalted and Majestic revealed this (verse) particular with regard to him:" So whosoever among you is sick and has an ailment of the head.." ; then (its application) became general for the Muslims
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، وَعَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عَبَّاسٍ - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'amrinw, 'an taawusin, wa'ataa'in, 'ani abni, 'abbaasin - rda allh 'nhma - aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ahtajama wahuwa muhrimun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got himself cupped in the state of lhrim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ بِطَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ وَسَطَ رَأْسِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa almu'allaa bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an 'alqamaaa bni aabiy 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'ani abni buhaynaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ahtajama bitariyqi makkaaa wahuwa muhrimun wasata raasihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Buhaina reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got himself cupped in the middle of his head on his way to Mecca
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ، عُيَيْنَةَ - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ نُبَيْهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِمَلَلٍ اشْتَكَى عُمَرُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَيْنَيْهِ فَلَمَّا كُنَّا بِالرَّوْحَاءِ اشْتَدَّ وَجَعُهُ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ يَسْأَلُهُ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ اضْمِدْهُمَا بِالصَّبِرِ فَإِنَّ عُثْمَانَ - رضى الله عنه - حَدَّثَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الرَّجُلِ إِذَا اشْتَكَى عَيْنَيْهِ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ ضَمَّدَهُمَا بِالصَّبِرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni, 'uyaynaaa - qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - haddathanaa aayyuwbu bnu muwsaa, 'an nubayhi bni wahbin, qaala kharajnaa ma'a aabaani bni 'uthmaana hattaa iidhaa kunnaa bimalalin ashtakaa 'umaru bnu 'ubaydi alllahi 'aynayhi falammaa kunnaa bialrrawhaa'i ashtadda waja'uhu faaarsala iilaa aabaana bni 'uthmaana yasaaluhu faaarsala iilayhi aani admidhumaa bialssabiri faiinna 'uthmaana - rda allh 'nh - haddatha 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alrrajuli iidhaa ashtakaa 'aynayhi wahuwa muhrimun dammadahumaa bialssabiri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nubaih b. Wabb reported:We went with Aban b. Uthman (in a state of lhram). When we were at Malal the eyes of Umar b. Ubaidullah became sore and, when we reached Rauba' the pain grew intense. He (Nubaib b. Wahb) sent (one) to Aban b. Uthman to ask him (what to do). He sent him (the message) to apply aloes to them, for 'Uthman (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) applied aloes to the person whose eyes were sore and he was in the state of Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنِي نُبَيْهُ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْمَرٍ، رَمِدَتْ عَيْنُهُ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَكْحُلَهَا، فَنَهَاهُ أَبَانُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ وَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُضَمِّدَهَا بِالصَّبِرِ وَحَدَّثَ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi bnu 'abdi alwaarithi, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa aayyuwbu bnu muwsaa, haddathaniy nubayhu bnu wahbin, aanna 'umara bna 'ubaydi alllahi bni ma'marin, ramidat 'aynuhu faaaraada aan yakhulahaa, fanahaahu aabaanu bnu 'uthmaana waaamarahu aan yudammidahaa bialssabiri wahaddatha 'an 'uthmaana bni 'affaana 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu fa'ala dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nubaih b Wahb reported that the eyes of Umar b. Ubaidnllah b. Ma'mar were swollen, and he decided to use antimony. Aban b. 'Uthman forbade him to do so and commanded him to apply aloes on them, and reported on the authority of 'Uthman b. Affan that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had done that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، - وَهَذَا حَدِيثُهُ - عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، وَالْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، أَنَّهُمَا اخْتَلَفَا بِالأَبْوَاءِ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَغْسِلُ الْمُحْرِمُ رَأْسَهُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْمِسْوَرُ لاَ يَغْسِلُ الْمُحْرِمُ رَأْسَهُ ‏.‏ فَأَرْسَلَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ إِلَى أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَوَجَدْتُهُ يَغْتَسِلُ بَيْنَ الْقَرْنَيْنِ وَهُوَ يَسْتَتِرُ بِثَوْبٍ - قَالَ - فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ مَنْ هَذَا فَقُلْتُ أَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ حُنَيْنٍ أَرْسَلَنِي إِلَيْكَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَسْأَلُكَ كَيْفَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَغْسِلُ رَأْسَهُ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ فَوَضَعَ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ - رضى الله عنه - يَدَهُ عَلَى الثَّوْبِ فَطَأْطَأَهُ حَتَّى بَدَا لِي رَأْسُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ لإِنْسَانٍ يَصُبُّ اصْبُبْ ‏.‏ فَصَبَّ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثُمَّ حَرَّكَ رَأْسَهُ بِيَدَيْهِ فَأَقْبَلَ بِهِمَا وَأَدْبَرَ ثُمَّ قَالَ هَكَذَا رَأَيْتُهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَفْعَلُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, - wahadhaa hadiythuhu - 'an maaliki bni aanasin, fiymaa quriia 'alayhi 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an iibraahiyma bni 'abdi alllahi bni hunaynin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin, waalmiswari bni makhramaaa, aannahumaa akhtalafaa bialaabwaa'i faqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abbaasin yaghsilu almuhrimu raasahu ‏.‏ waqaala almiswaru laa yaghsilu almuhrimu raasahu ‏.‏ faaarsalaniy abnu 'abbaasin iilaa aabiy aayyuwba alaansaariyyi aasaaluhu 'an dhalika fawajadtuhu yaghtasilu bayna alqarnayni wahuwa yastatiru bithawbin - qaala - fasallamtu 'alayhi faqaala man hadhaa faqultu aanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu hunaynin aarsalaniy iilayka 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abbaasin aasaaluka kayfa kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaghsilu raasahu wahuwa muhrimun fawada'a aabuw aayyuwba - rda allh 'nh - yadahu 'alaa althhawbi fataataaahu hattaa badaa liy raasuhu thumma qaala liinsaanin yasubbu asbub ‏.‏ fasabba 'alaa raasihi thumma harraka raasahu biyadayhi faaaqbala bihimaa waaadbara thumma qaala hakadhaa raaaytuhu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaf'alu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibrahim b. 'Abdullah narrated on the authorrity of his father that there cropped up a difference of opinion between Abdullah b. 'Abbas and al-Miswar b. Makhrama at a place (called) Abwa'. Abdullah b. 'Abbas contended that a Muhrim (is permitted) to wash his head, whereas Miswar contended that a Muhrim is not (permit- fed) to wash his head. So Ibn Abbas sent me (the father of Ibrabim) to Abu Ayyub al- Ansirl to ask him about it. (So I went to him) and found him taking bath behind two poles covered by a cloth. I gave him salutation, whereupon be asked:Who is this? I said: I am 'Abdullah b. Hunain. 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas has sent me to you to find out how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) washed his head in the state of Ihram. Abu Ayyub (Allah be pleased with him) placed his hand on the cloth and lowered it (a little) till his head became visible to me; and he said to the man who was pouring water upon him to pour water. He poured water on his head. He then moved his head with the help of his hands and moved them (the hands) forward and backward and then said: This is how I saw him (the Messenger of Allah) doing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ فَأَمَرَّ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ بِيَدَيْهِ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ جَمِيعًا عَلَى جَمِيعِ رَأْسِهِ فَأَقْبَلَ بِهِمَا وَأَدْبَرَ فَقَالَ الْمِسْوَرُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ لاَ أُمَارِيكَ أَبَدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'aliyyu bnu khashramin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy zaydu bnu aaslama, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala faaamarra aabuw aayyuwba biyadayhi 'alaa raasihi jamiy'ana 'alaa jamiy'i raasihi faaaqbala bihimaa waaadbara faqaala almiswaru laibni 'abbaasin laa aumaariyka aabadana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters that Abu Ayyub rubbed his whole head with his hands and then moved them forward and backward. Miswar said to Ibn 'Abbas:I would never dispute with you (in future)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ، جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَّ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَعِيرِهِ فَوُقِصَ فَمَاتَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اغْسِلُوهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ وَكَفِّنُوهُ فِي ثَوْبَيْهِ وَلاَ تُخَمِّرُوا رَأْسَهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُلَبِّيًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'amrinw, 'an sa'iydi bni, jubayrin 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm kharra rajulun min ba'iyrihi fawuqisa famaata faqaala ‏ "‏ aghsiluwhu bimaa'in wasidrin wakaffinuwhu fiy thawbayhi walaa tukhammiruwa raasahu faiinna alllaha yab'athuhu yawma alqiyaamaai mulabbiyana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that a person fell down from his camel (in a state of Ihram) and his neck was broken and he died. Thereupon Allah's Apostle. (ﷺ) said:Bathe him with water mixed with the leaves of the lote tree and shroud him in his two (pieces of) cloth (Ihbram), and do not cover his head for Allah will raise him on the Day of Resurrection Pronouncing Talbiya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ يُونُسَ - عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ أَقْبَلَ رَجُلٌ حَرَامًا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَرَّ مِنْ بَعِيرِهِ فَوُقِصَ وَقْصًا فَمَاتَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اغْسِلُوهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ وَأَلْبِسُوهُ ثَوْبَيْهِ وَلاَ تُخَمِّرُوا رَأْسَهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُلَبِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, - ya'niy abna yuwnusa - 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu diynaarin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala aaqbala rajulun haraamana ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakharra min ba'iyrihi fawuqisa waqsana famaata faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aghsiluwhu bimaa'in wasidrin waaalbisuwhu thawbayhi walaa tukhammiruwa raasahu faiinnahu yaatiy yawma alqiyaamaai yulabbiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that a person proceeded along with the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) in the state of Ihram and fell down from his camel and his neck was broken, and he died. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Bathe him with water mixed with lote (leaves) and shroud him in two (pieces of) cloth and do'not cover his head for he would come on the Day of Resurrection pronouncing Talbiya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ الْبُرْسَانِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ أَقْبَلَ رَجُلٌ حَرَامٌ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَإِنَّهُ يُبْعَثُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُلَبِّيًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ لَمْ يُسَمِّ سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ حَيْثُ خَرَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin albursaaniyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu diynaarin, aanna sa'iyda bna jubayrin, aakhbarahu 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala aaqbala rajulun haraamun ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ faiinnahu yub'athu yawma alqiyaamaai mulabbiyana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wazaada lam yusammi sa'iydu bnu jubayrin haythu kharra ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported on the authority of Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) that a person proceeded with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the state of Ihram. The rest of the hadith th is the same except that he (the Holy Prophet) (is reported to have) said:He would be raised on the Day of Resurrection pronouncing Talbiya. Sa'id b. Jubair did not name the place where he fell down
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ، جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَوْقَصَتْهُ رَاحِلَتُهُ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ فَمَاتَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اغْسِلُوهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ وَكَفِّنُوهُ فِي ثَوْبَيْهِ وَلاَ تُخَمِّرُوا رَأْسَهُ وَلاَ وَجْهَهُ فَإِنَّهُ يُبْعَثُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُلَبِّيًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an sa'iydi bni, jubayrin 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - aanna rajulaan, aawqasathu raahilatuhu wahuwa muhrimun famaata faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aghsiluwhu bimaa'in wasidrin wakaffinuwhu fiy thawbayhi walaa tukhammiruwa raasahu walaa wajhahu faiinnahu yub'athu yawma alqiyaamaai mulabbiyana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that there was a person in the state of Ihram whose camel broke his neck and he died. Thereupon the Mes- senger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Bathe him with water mixed (with the leaves of) lote tree and shroud him In his two (pieces of) cloth and cover neither his head nor his face, for he would be raised on the Day of Resurrection pronouncing Talbiya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، رضى الله عنهما ح . وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ، بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ رَجُلاً، كَانَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُحْرِمًا فَوَقَصَتْهُ نَاقَتُهُ فَمَاتَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اغْسِلُوهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ وَكَفِّنُوهُ فِي ثَوْبَيْهِ وَلاَ تُمِسُّوهُ بِطِيبٍ وَلاَ تُخَمِّرُوا رَأْسَهُ فَإِنَّهُ يُبْعَثُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُلَبِّدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu alssabbaahi, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa aabuw bishrin, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, rda allh 'nhma h . wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi, bni jubayrin 'ani abni 'abbaasin, rda allh 'nhma aanna rajulaan, kaana ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm muhrimana fawaqasathu naaqatuhu famaata faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aghsiluwhu bimaa'in wasidrin wakaffinuwhu fiy thawbayhi walaa tumissuwhu bitiybin walaa tukhammiruwa raasahu faiinnahu yub'athu yawma alqiyaamaai mulabbidana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that when a person who was in the state of Ihram was in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), his camel broke his neckand he died. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Bathe him with water (mixed with the leaves) of the lute tree and shroud him in his two (pieces of) cloth and, neither perfume him nor cover his head, for he would be raised on the Day of Resurrection pronouncing Talbiya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّ رَجُلاً، وَقَصَهُ بَعِيرُهُ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَمَرَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُغْسَلَ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ وَلاَ يُمَسَّ طِيبًا وَلاَ يُخَمَّرَ رَأْسُهُ فَإِنَّهُ يُبْعَثُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُلَبِّدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw kaamilin, fudaylu bnu husaynin aljahdariyyu haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - aanna rajulaan, waqasahu ba'iyruhu wahuwa muhrimun ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaamara bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yughsala bimaa'in wasidrin walaa yumassa tiybana walaa yukhammara raasuhu faiinnahu yub'athu yawma alqiyaamaai mulabbidana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) that a camel broke the neck of its owner while he was in the state of lhram and he was at that time in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that he should be bathed with water mixed with (leaves of the) lote (tree) and no perfume should be applied to him and his head should not be covered, for he would be raised on the Day of Resurrection pronouncing Talblya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ قَالَ ابْنُ نَافِعٍ أَخْبَرَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا بِشْرٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ فَوَقَعَ مِنْ نَاقَتِهِ فَأَقْعَصَتْهُ فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُغْسَلَ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ وَأَنْ يُكَفَّنَ فِي ثَوْبَيْنِ وَلاَ يُمَسَّ طِيبًا خَارِجٌ رَأْسُهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ ثُمَّ حَدَّثَنِي بِهِ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ خَارِجٌ رَأْسُهُ وَوَجْهُهُ فَإِنَّهُ يُبْعَثُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُلَبِّدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, waaabuw bakri bnu naafi'in qaala abnu naafi'in aakhbaranaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu aabaa bishrin, yuhaddithu 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, aannahu sami'a abna 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - yuhaddithu aanna rajulaan aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa muhrimun fawaqa'a min naaqatihi faaaq'asathu faaamara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yughsala bimaa'in wasidrin waaan yukaffana fiy thawbayni walaa yumassa tiybana khaarijun raasuhu ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau thumma haddathaniy bihi ba'da dhalika khaarijun raasuhu wawajhuhu faiinnahu yub'athu yawma alqiyaamaai mulabbidana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair heard Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) as saying:A person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) while he was in the state of lhram. He fell down from his camel and broke his neck. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) commanded to bathe him with water (mixed with the leaves of) the lote (tree), and shroud him in two (pieces of) cloth and not to apply perfume (to him), keeping his head out (of the shroud). Shu'ba said: He then narrated to me after this (the words)" keeping his head out," his face out, for he would be raised on the Day of Resurrection pronouncing Talbiya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ زُهَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ - رضى الله عنهما - وَقَصَتْ رَجُلاً رَاحِلَتُهُ وَهُوَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَمَرَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَغْسِلُوهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ وَأَنْ يَكْشِفُوا وَجْهَهُ - حَسِبْتُهُ قَالَ - وَرَأْسَهُ فَإِنَّهُ يُبْعَثُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَهُوَ يُهِلُّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa alaaswadu bnu 'aamirin, 'an zuhayrin, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, qaala sami'tu sa'iyda bna jubayrin, yaquwlu qaala abnu 'abbaasin - rda allh 'nhma - waqasat rajulaan raahilatuhu wahuwa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaamarahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yaghsiluwhu bimaa'in wasidrin waaan yakshifuwa wajhahu - hasibtuhu qaala - waraasahu faiinnahu yub'athu yawma alqiyaamaai wahuwa yuhillu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa`id b. Jubair reported on the authority of Ibn `Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) that the camel of a person broke his neck as he was in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded them (Companions) to wash him with water mixed (with the leaves of) the lote (tree) and to keep his face exposed; (he, the narrator) said:And his head (too), for he would be raised on the Day of Resurrection pronouncing Talbiya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ كَانَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ فَوَقَصَتْهُ نَاقَتُهُ فَمَاتَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اغْسِلُوهُ وَلاَ تُقَرِّبُوهُ طِيبًا وَلاَ تُغَطُّوا وَجْهَهُ فَإِنَّهُ يُبْعَثُ يُلَبِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an mansuwrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala kaana ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulun fawaqasathu naaqatuhu famaata faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aghsiluwhu walaa tuqarribuwhu tiybana walaa tughattuwa wajhahu faiinnahu yub'athu yulabbiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that there was a person in the company of Allah's Messenger (may peace' be upon him) whose camel broke his neck and he died. thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:Wash him, but do not apply perfume and do not cover his face, for he would be raised (on the Day of Resurrection) pronouncing Talbiya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى ضُبَاعَةَ بِنْتِ الزُّبَيْرِ فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ أَرَدْتِ الْحَجَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ مَا أَجِدُنِي إِلاَّ وَجِعَةً ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ حُجِّي وَاشْتَرِطِي وَقُولِي اللَّهُمَّ مَحِلِّي حَيْثُ حَبَسْتَنِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَكَانَتْ تَحْتَ الْمِقْدَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i alhamdaaniyyu haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat dakhala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa dubaa'aaa binti alzzubayri faqaala lahaa ‏"‏ aaradti alhajja ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat waalllahi maa aajiduniy iilaaa waji'aaan ‏.‏ faqaala lahaa ‏"‏ hujjiy waashtaritiy waquwliy alllahumma mahilliy haythu habastaniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wakaanat tahta almiqdaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went (into the house of) Duba`a bint Zubair and said to her:Did you intend to perform Hajj? She said: By Allah, (I intend to do so) but I often remain ill, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said to her: Perform Hajj but with condition, and say: O Allah, I shall be free from Ihram where you detain me. And she (Duba`a) was the wife of Miqdad
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى ضُبَاعَةَ بِنْتِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ الْحَجَّ وَأَنَا شَاكِيَةٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ حُجِّي وَاشْتَرِطِي أَنَّ مَحِلِّي حَيْثُ حَبَسْتَنِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat dakhala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa dubaa'aaa binti alzzubayri bni 'abdi almuttalibi faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy auriydu alhajja waaanaa shaakiyaaun ‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ hujjiy waashtaritiy aanna mahilliy haythu habastaniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) went (to the house of) Duba'a bint al-Zubair b. Abd al-Muttalib. She said:Messenger of Allah, I intend to perform Hajj, but I am ill. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Enter Into the state of Ihram on condition that you would abandon it when Allah would detain you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'isha through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ، وَأَبُو عَاصِمٍ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، بَكْرٍ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ طَاوُسًا، وَعِكْرِمَةَ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ ضُبَاعَةَ بِنْتَ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، - رضى الله عنها - أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي امْرَأَةٌ ثَقِيلَةٌ وَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ الْحَجَّ فَمَا تَأْمُرُنِي قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَهِلِّي بِالْحَجِّ وَاشْتَرِطِي أَنَّ مَحِلِّي حَيْثُ تَحْبِسُنِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَدْرَكَتْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi bnu 'abdi almajiydi, waaabuw 'aasimin wamuhammadu bnu bakrin 'ani abni jurayjin, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu, bakrin aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a taawusana, wa'ikrimaaa, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna dubaa'aaa binta alzzubayri bni 'abdi almuttalibi, - rda allh 'nha - aatat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat iinniy amraaaaun thaqiylaaun waiinniy auriydu alhajja famaa taamuruniy qaala ‏ "‏ aahilliy bialhajji waashtaritiy aanna mahilliy haythu tahbisuniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faaadrakat ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported that Duba'a bint al-Zubair b. 'Abd al-Muttalib (Allah be pleased with her) came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:I am an ailing woman but I intend to perform Hajj; what you command me (to do)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Enter into the state of Ihram (uttering these words) of condition: I would be free from it when Thou wouldst detain me. 'He (the narrator) said: But she was able to complete (the Hajj without breaking down)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ هَرِمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، وَعِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ ضُبَاعَةَ، أَرَادَتِ الْحَجَّ فَأَمَرَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تَشْتَرِطَ فَفَعَلَتْ ذَلِكَ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa aabuw daawuda alttayaalisiyyu, haddathanaa habiybu bnu yaziyda, 'an 'amriw bni harimin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, wa'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, rda allh 'nhma aanna dubaa'aaa, aaraadati alhajja faaamarahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan tashtarita fafa'alat dhalika 'an aamri rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn `Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Duba`a intended to perform Hajj, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded her (to enter into the state of Ihram) with condition. She did it in compliance with the command of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَأَبُو أَيُّوبَ الْغَيْلاَنِيُّ وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ خِرَاشٍ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، - وَهُوَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو - حَدَّثَنَا رَبَاحٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي مَعْرُوفٍ - عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِضُبَاعَةَ رضى الله عنها ‏ "‏ حُجِّي وَاشْتَرِطِي أَنَّ مَحِلِّي حَيْثُ تَحْبِسُنِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ إِسْحَاقَ أَمَرَ ضُبَاعَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waaabuw aayyuwba alghaylaaniyyu waaahmadu bnu khiraashin qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin, - wahuwa 'abdu almaliki bnu 'amrinw - haddathanaa rabaahun, - wahuwa abnu aabiy ma'ruwfin - 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lidubaa'aaa rda allh 'nha ‏ "‏ hujjiy waashtaritiy aanna mahilliy haythu tahbisuniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai iishaaqa aamara dubaa'aaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عَبْدَةَ، - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ نُفِسَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ عُمَيْسٍ بِمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ بِالشَّجَرَةِ فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبَا بَكْرٍ يَأْمُرُهَا أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ وَتُهِلَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hannaadu bnu alssariyyi, wazuhayru bnu harbin, wa'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, kulluhum 'an 'abdaaa, - qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat nufisat aasmaa'u bintu 'umaysin bimuhammadi bni aabiy bakrin bialshhajaraai faaamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aabaa bakrin yaamuruhaa aan taghtasila watuhilla ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Asma' bint `Umais gave birth to Muhammad b Abu Bakr near Dhu'l-Hulaifa. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded Abu Bakr to convey to her that she should take a bath and then enter into the state of Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ، سَعِيدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - رضى الله عنهما - فِي حَدِيثِ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ عُمَيْسٍ حِينَ نُفِسَتْ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ - رضى الله عنه - فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ وَتُهِلَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ghassaana, muhammadu bnu 'amrinw haddathanaa jariyru bnu 'abdi alhamiydi, 'an yahyaa bni, sa'iydin 'an ja'fari bni muhammadin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, - rda allh 'nhma - fiy hadiythi aasmaa'a binti 'umaysin hiyna nufisat bidhiy alhulayfaai aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aamara aabaa bakrin - rda allh 'nh - faaamarahaa aan taghtasila watuhilla ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. `Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that when Asma' bint `Umais gave birth (to a child) in Dhu'l-Hulaifa. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded Abu Bakr (to convey to her) that she should take a bath and enter into the state of Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ فَأَهْلَلْنَا بِعُمْرَةٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ هَدْىٌ فَلْيُهِلَّ بِالْحَجِّ مَعَ الْعُمْرَةِ ثُمَّ لاَ يَحِلُّ حَتَّى يَحِلَّ مِنْهُمَا جَمِيعًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقَدِمْتُ مَكَّةَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ لَمْ أَطُفْ بِالْبَيْتِ وَلاَ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ فَشَكَوْتُ ذَلِكَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ انْقُضِي رَأْسَكِ وَامْتَشِطِي وَأَهِلِّي بِالْحَجِّ وَدَعِي الْعُمْرَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَفَعَلْتُ فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا الْحَجَّ أَرْسَلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ إِلَى التَّنْعِيمِ فَاعْتَمَرْتُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذِهِ مَكَانَ عُمْرَتِكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَطَافَ الَّذِينَ أَهَلُّوا بِالْعُمْرَةِ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ ثُمَّ حَلُّوا ثُمَّ طَافُوا طَوَافًا آخَرَ بَعْدَ أَنْ رَجَعُوا مِنْ مِنًى لِحَجِّهِمْ وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَانُوا جَمَعُوا الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ فَإِنَّمَا طَافُوا طَوَافًا وَاحِدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - aannahaa qaalat kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama hajjaai alwadaa'i faaahlalnaa bi'umraain thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man kaana ma'ahu hadaun falyuhilla bialhajji ma'a al'umraai thumma laa yahillu hattaa yahilla minhumaa jamiy'ana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat faqadimtu makkaaa waaanaa haaiidun lam aatuf bialbayti walaa bayna alssafaa waalmarwaai fashakawtu dhalika iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ anqudiy raasaki waamtashitiy waaahilliy bialhajji wada'iy al'umraaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat fafa'altu falammaa qadaynaa alhajja aarsalaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ma'a 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy bakrin iilaa alttan'iymi faa'tamartu faqaala ‏"‏ hadhihi makaana 'umratiki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fataafa alladhiyna aahalluwa bial'umraai bialbayti wabialssafaa waalmarwaai thumma halluwa thumma taafuwa tawaafana akhara ba'da aan raja'uwa min minana lihajjihim waaammaa alladhiyna kaanuwa jama'uwa alhajja waal'umraaa faiinnamaa taafuwa tawaafana waahidana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said:We went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during the year of the Farewell Pilgrimage. We entered into the state of Ihram for Umra. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who has the sacrificial animal with him, he should put on Ihram for Hajj along with Umra. and should not put it off till he has completed them (both Hajj and Umra). She said: When I came to Mecca. I was having menses, I neither circumambulated the House, nor ran between as-safa' and al-Marwa. I complained about it to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: Undo your hair, comb it, and pronounce Talbiya for Hajj, and give up Umra (for the time being), which I did. When we had performed the Hajj, the Messenger of Allah (way peace he upon him) sent me with Abd al-Rabman b. Abu Bakr to Tan'im saying: This is the place for your Umra. Those who had put on Ihram for Umra circumambulated the House, and ran between al-safa' and al-Marwa. They then put off Ihram and then made the last circuit after they had returned from Mina after performing their Hajj, but those who had combined the Hajj and the Umra made only one circuit (as they had combined Hajj and 'Umra)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ، خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ فَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِحَجٍّ حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا مَكَّةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَحْرَمَ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَلَمْ يُهْدِ فَلْيَحْلِلْ وَمَنْ أَحْرَمَ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَأَهْدَى فَلاَ يَحِلُّ حَتَّى يَنْحَرَ هَدْيَهُ وَمَنْ أَهَلَّ بِحَجٍّ فَلْيُتِمَّ حَجَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ - رضى الله عنها - فَحِضْتُ فَلَمْ أَزَلْ حَائِضًا حَتَّى كَانَ يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ وَلَمْ أُهْلِلْ إِلاَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ فَأَمَرَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أَنْقُضَ رَأْسِي وَأَمْتَشِطَ وَأُهِلَّ بِحَجٍّ وَأَتْرُكَ الْعُمْرَةَ - قَالَتْ - فَفَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى إِذَا قَضَيْتُ حَجَّتِي بَعَثَ مَعِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَعْتَمِرَ مِنَ التَّنْعِيمِ مَكَانَ عُمْرَتِي الَّتِي أَدْرَكَنِي الْحَجُّ وَلَمْ أَحْلِلْ مِنْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu, khaalidin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa qaalat kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama hajjaai alwadaa'i faminnaa man aahalla bi'umraain waminnaa man aahalla bihajjin hattaa qadimnaa makkaaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man aahrama bi'umraain walam yuhdi falyahlil waman aahrama bi'umraain waaahdaa falaa yahillu hattaa yanhara hadyahu waman aahalla bihajjin falyutimma hajjahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau - rda allh 'nha - fahidtu falam aazal haaiidana hattaa kaana yawmu 'arafaaa walam auhlil iilaaa bi'umraain faaamaraniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan aanquda raasiy waaamtashita waauhilla bihajjin waaatruka al'umraaa - qaalat - fafa'altu dhalika hattaa iidhaa qadaytu hajjatiy ba'atha ma'iy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'abda alrrahmani bna aabiy bakrin waaamaraniy aan aa'tamira mina alttan'iymi makaana 'umratiy allatiy aadrakaniy alhajju walam aahlil minhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said:We went out with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during the year of the Farewell Pilgrimage. There were some amongst us who had put on IHram for Umra and there were some who had put on Ihram for Hajj. (We proceeded on till) we came to Mecca. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who put on Ihram for 'Umra but did not bring the sacrificial animal with him should put it off. and he who put on Ihram for Umra and he who had brought the sacrificial animal with him should not put it off until he had slaughtered the animal; and he who put on lhram for Hajj should complete it. A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: I was in the monthlyperiod, and I remained In this state till the day of 'Arafa, and I had entered into the state of Ihram for 'Umra. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) thus commanded me to undo my hair and comb them (again) and enter into the state of Ihram for Hajj, and abandon (the rites of 'Umra). She ('A'isha) said: I did so, and when I had completed my Pilgrimage, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent with me 'Abd al-Rabman b. Abu Bakr and commanded me to (resume the rites of) 'Umra at Tan'im. the place where (I abandoned) 'Umra and put on Ihram for Hajj (before completing Umra)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ فَأَهْلَلْتُ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَلَمْ أَكُنْ سُقْتُ الْهَدْىَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ هَدْىٌ فَلْيُهْلِلْ بِالْحَجِّ مَعَ عُمْرَتِهِ ثُمَّ لاَ يَحِلَّ حَتَّى يَحِلَّ مِنْهُمَا جَمِيعًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَحِضْتُ فَلَمَّا دَخَلَتْ لَيْلَةُ عَرَفَةَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي كُنْتُ أَهْلَلْتُ بِعُمْرَةٍ فَكَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ بِحَجَّتِي قَالَ ‏"‏ انْقُضِي رَأْسَكِ وَامْتَشِطِي وَأَمْسِكِي عَنِ الْعُمْرَةِ وَأَهِلِّي بِالْحَجِّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَلَمَّا قَضَيْتُ حَجَّتِي أَمَرَ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَأَرْدَفَنِي فَأَعْمَرَنِي مِنَ التَّنْعِيمِ مَكَانَ عُمْرَتِي الَّتِي أَمْسَكْتُ عَنْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat kharajnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama hajjaai alwadaa'i faaahlaltu bi'umraain walam aakun suqtu alhadaa faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man kaana ma'ahu hadaun falyuhlil bialhajji ma'a 'umratihi thumma laa yahilla hattaa yahilla minhumaa jamiy'ana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat fahidtu falammaa dakhalat laylaau 'arafaaa qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy kuntu aahlaltu bi'umraain fakayfa aasna'u bihajjatiy qaala ‏"‏ anqudiy raasaki waamtashitiy waaamsikiy 'ani al'umraai waaahilliy bialhajji ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat falammaa qadaytu hajjatiy aamara 'abda alrrahmani bna aabiy bakrin faaardafaniy faaa'maraniy mina alttan'iymi makaana 'umratiy allatiy aamsaktu 'anhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:We went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during the year of the Farewell Pilgrimage. I put on Ihram for Umra and did not bring the sacrificial animal. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who has the sacrihcial animal with him should enter into the state of Ihram for Hajj along with 'Umra, and. he should not put the Ihram off till he has completed both of them. She (Hadrat A'isha) said: The monthly period began. When it was the night of Arafa, I said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): I entered into the state of Ihram for 'Umra. but now how should I perform the Hajj?
