verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna hafsaaa, - rda allh 'nha - qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi maalikin ‏ "‏ falaa aahillu hattaa aanhara ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hafsa (Allah be pleased with her) said:Messenger of Allah; the rest of the hadith is the same and (the concluding words of the Holy Prophet):" I won't put off Ihram until I have sacrificed the animal
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ الْمَجِيدِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي حَفْصَةُ، - رضى الله عنها - أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ أَزْوَاجَهُ أَنْ يَحْلِلْنَ عَامَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ حَفْصَةُ فَقُلْتُ مَا يَمْنَعُكَ أَنْ تَحِلَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لَبَّدْتُ رَأْسِي وَقَلَّدْتُ هَدْيِي فَلاَ أَحِلُّ حَتَّى أَنْحَرَ هَدْيِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu sulaymaana almakhzuwmiyyu, wa'abdu almajiydi, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala haddathatniy hafsaau, - rda allh 'nha - aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aamara aazwaajahu aan yahlilna 'aama hajjaai alwadaa'i ‏.‏ qaalat hafsaau faqultu maa yamna'uka aan tahilla qaala ‏ "‏ iinniy labbadtu raasiy waqalladtu hadyiy falaa aahillu hattaa aanhara hadyiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hafsa (Allah be pleased with her) said that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) commanded his wives that they should put off Ihram during the year of Hajj (at-ul-Wada'). whereupon she (Hafsa) said:What hinders you that you have not put off Ihram? Thereupon he said: I have stuck my hair and driven my sacrificial animal along with men and it is not permissible to put off Ihram (under this condition until I have sacrificed the animal)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، - رضى الله عنهما - خَرَجَ فِي الْفِتْنَةِ مُعْتَمِرًا وَقَالَ إِنْ صُدِدْتُ عَنِ الْبَيْتِ صَنَعْنَا كَمَا صَنَعْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَرَجَ فَأَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَسَارَ حَتَّى إِذَا ظَهَرَ عَلَى الْبَيْدَاءِ الْتَفَتَ إِلَى أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَالَ مَا أَمْرُهُمَا إِلاَّ وَاحِدٌ أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي قَدْ أَوْجَبْتُ الْحَجَّ مَعَ الْعُمْرَةِ ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ حَتَّى إِذَا جَاءَ الْبَيْتَ طَافَ بِهِ سَبْعًا وَبَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ سَبْعًا لَمْ يَزِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَأَى أَنَّهُ مُجْزِئٌ عَنْهُ وَأَهْدَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, - rda allh 'nhma - kharaja fiy alfitnaai mu'tamirana waqaala iin sudidtu 'ani albayti sana'naa kamaa sana'naa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakharaja faaahalla bi'umraain wasaara hattaa iidhaa zahara 'alaa albaydaa'i altafata iilaa aashaabihi faqaala maa aamruhumaa iilaaa waahidun aushhidukum aanniy qad aawjabtu alhajja ma'a al'umraai ‏.‏ fakharaja hattaa iidhaa jaa'a albayta taafa bihi sab'ana wabayna alssafaa waalmarwaai sab'ana lam yazid 'alayhi waraaaa aannahu mujziiun 'anhu waaahdaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' reported that 'Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) set out for Umra during the turmoil, and he said:If I am detained (from going to) the House, we would do the same as we did with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). So he went out and put on Ihram for 'Umra and moved on until he reached al-Baida'. He turned towards his Companions and said: There is one command for both of them. and 1 call you as my witness (and say) that verify I have- made Hajj with 'Umra compulsory for me. He proceeded until, when he came to the House, he circumambulated it seven times and ran between al-Safa' and al-Marwa seven times, and made no addition to it and thought it to be sufficient for him and offered sacrifice
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَسَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، كَلَّمَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ حِينَ نَزَلَ الْحَجَّاجُ لِقِتَالِ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ قَالاَ لاَ يَضُرُّكَ أَنْ لاَ تَحُجَّ الْعَامَ فَإِنَّا نَخْشَى أَنْ يَكُونَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ قِتَالٌ يُحَالُ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ الْبَيْتِ قَالَ فَإِنْ حِيلَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ فَعَلْتُ كَمَا فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا مَعَهُ حِينَ حَالَتْ كُفَّارُ قُرَيْشٍ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْبَيْتِ أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي قَدْ أَوْجَبْتُ عُمْرَةً ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ حَتَّى أَتَى ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ فَلَبَّى بِالْعُمْرَةِ ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنْ خُلِّيَ سَبِيلِي قَضَيْتُ عُمْرَتِي وَإِنْ حِيلَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ فَعَلْتُ كَمَا فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا مَعَهُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ تَلاَ ‏{‏ لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ‏}‏ ثُمَّ سَارَ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بِظَهْرِ الْبَيْدَاءِ قَالَ مَا أَمْرُهُمَا إِلاَّ وَاحِدٌ إِنْ حِيلَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ الْعُمْرَةِ حِيلَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ الْحَجِّ أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي قَدْ أَوْجَبْتُ حَجَّةً مَعَ عُمْرَةٍ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ حَتَّى ابْتَاعَ بِقُدَيْدٍ هَدْيًا ثُمَّ طَافَ لَهُمَا طَوَا��ًا وَاحِدًا بِالْبَيْتِ وَبَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَحِلَّ مِنْهُمَا حَتَّى حَلَّ مِنْهُمَا بِحَجَّةٍ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, haddathaniy naafi'un, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'abdi alllahi, wasaalima bna 'abdi alllahi, kallamaa 'abda alllahi hiyna nazala alhajjaaju liqitaali abni alzzubayri qaalaa laa yadurruka aan laa tahujja al'aama faiinnaa nakhshaa aan yakuwna bayna alnnaasi qitaalun yuhaalu baynaka wabayna albayti qaala faiin hiyla bayniy wabaynahu fa'altu kamaa fa'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa ma'ahu hiyna haalat kuffaaru qurayshin baynahu wabayna albayti aushhidukum aanniy qad aawjabtu 'umraaan ‏.‏ faantalaqa hattaa aataa dhaa alhulayfaai falabbaa bial'umraai thumma qaala iin khulliya sabiyliy qadaytu 'umratiy waiin hiyla bayniy wabaynahu fa'altu kamaa fa'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa ma'ahu ‏.‏ thumma talaa ‏{‏ laqad kaana lakum fiy rasuwli alllahi auswaaun hasanaaun‏}‏ thumma saara hattaa iidhaa kaana bizahri albaydaa'i qaala maa aamruhumaa iilaaa waahidun iin hiyla bayniy wabayna al'umraai hiyla bayniy wabayna alhajji aushhidukum aanniy qad aawjabtu hajjaaan ma'a 'umraain ‏.‏ faantalaqa hattaa abtaa'a biqudaydin hadyana thumma taafa lahumaa tawaa��ana waahidana bialbayti wabayna alssafaa waalmarwaai thumma lam yahilla minhumaa hattaa halla minhumaa bihajjaain yawma alnnahri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' reported that 'Abdullah b. 'Abdullah and Salim b. Abdullah said to 'Abdullah (b. 'Umar) at the time when Hajjaj came to fight against Ibn Zubair:There would be no harm if you do not (proceed) for Hajj this year, for we fear that there would be fight among people which would cause obstruction between you and the House, whereupon he said: If there would be obstruction between me and that (Ka'ba), I would do as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did. I was with him (the Holy Prophet) when the infidels of Quraish caused obstructions between him (the Holy Prophet) and the House. I call you as my witness (to the fact) that I have made 'Umra essential for me. He proceeded until he came to Dhu'l-Hulaifa and pronounced Talbiya for Umra, and said: If the way Is clear forme, I would then complete my 'Umra but If there is some obstruction between me and that (the Ka'ba). I would then do what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done (at the occasion of Hudaibiya), and I was with him (the Holy Prophet). and then recited:" Verily in the Messenger of Allah, there is a model pattern for you" (xxxiii. 21). He then moved on until he came to the rear side of al-Baida' and said: There is one command for both of them automatically) (Hajj and Umra). If I am detained (in the performance) of 'Umra, I am ( automatically detained (in the performance) of Hajj (too). I call you as witness that Hajj along with 'Umra I had made essential for me. (I am performing Hajj and 'Umra as Qiran.) He then bought sacrificial animals at Qudaid and then circumambulated the House and ran between al-Safa' and al-Marwa once (covering both Hajj and Umra), and did not put off Ihram until on the Day of Sacrifice in the month of Dhu'l-Hijja
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ أَرَادَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ الْحَجَّ حِينَ نَزَلَ الْحَجَّاجُ بِابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِ هَذِهِ الْقِصَّةِ وَقَالَ فِي آخِرِ الْحَدِيثِ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ مَنْ جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ كَفَاهُ طَوَافٌ وَاحِدٌ وَلَمْ يَحِلَّ حَتَّى يَحِلَّ مِنْهُمَا جَمِيعًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, qaala aaraada abnu 'umara alhajja hiyna nazala alhajjaaju biabni alzzubayri ‏.‏ waaqtassa alhadiytha bimithli hadhihi alqissaai waqaala fiy akhiri alhadiythi wakaana yaquwlu man jama'a bayna alhajji waal'umraai kafaahu tawaafun waahidun walam yahilla hattaa yahilla minhumaa jamiy'ana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' reported that Ibn Umar intended to go to Hajj (during the year) when Hajjaj attacked Ibn Zubair, and he narrated the account as (narrated above), and he used to say at the end of the hadith:He who combines Hajj with Umra, for him one single circumambulation is sufficient, and he did not put off Ihram until he had completed both of them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، أَرَادَ الْحَجَّ عَامَ نَزَلَ الْحَجَّاجُ بِابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ كَائِنٌ بَيْنَهُمْ قِتَالٌ وَإِنَّا نَخَافُ أَنْ يَصُدُّوكَ فَقَالَ لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ أَصْنَعُ كَمَا صَنَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنِّي أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي قَدْ أَوْجَبْتُ عُمْرَةً ‏.‏ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ حَتَّى كَانَ بِظَاهِرِ الْبَيْدَاءِ قَالَ مَا شَأْنُ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ إِلاَّ وَاحِدٌ اشْهَدُوا - قَالَ ابْنُ رُمْحٍ أُشْهِدُكُمْ - أَنِّي قَدْ أَوْجَبْتُ حَجًّا مَعَ عُمْرَتِي ‏.‏ وَأَهْدَى هَدْيًا اشْتَرَاهُ بِقُدَيْدٍ ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ يُهِلُّ بِهِمَا جَمِيعًا حَتَّى قَدِمَ مَكَّةَ فَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ وَلَمْ يَزِدْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ وَلَمْ يَنْحَرْ وَلَمْ يَحْلِقْ وَلَمْ يُقَصِّرْ وَلَمْ يَحْلِلْ مِنْ شَىْءٍ حَرُمَ مِنْهُ حَتَّى كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ فَنَحَرَ وَحَلَقَ وَرَأَى أَنْ قَدْ قَضَى طَوَافَ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ بِطَوَافِهِ الأَوَّلِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ كَذَلِكَ فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa laythun, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara, aaraada alhajja 'aama nazala alhajjaaju biabni alzzubayri faqiyla lahu iinna alnnaasa kaaiinun baynahum qitaalun waiinnaa nakhaafu aan yasudduwka faqaala laqad kaana lakum fiy rasuwli alllahi auswaaun hasanaaun aasna'u kamaa sana'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinniy aushhidukum aanniy qad aawjabtu 'umraaan ‏.‏ thumma kharaja hattaa kaana bizaahiri albaydaa'i qaala maa shaanu alhajji waal'umraai iilaaa waahidun ashhaduwa - qaala abnu rumhin aushhidukum - aanniy qad aawjabtu hajjana ma'a 'umratiy ‏.‏ waaahdaa hadyana ashtaraahu biqudaydin thumma antalaqa yuhillu bihimaa jamiy'ana hattaa qadima makkaaa fataafa bialbayti wabialssafaa waalmarwaai walam yazid 'alaa dhalika walam yanhar walam yahliq walam yuqassir walam yahlil min shaa'in haruma minhu hattaa kaana yawmu alnnahri fanahara wahalaqa waraaaa aan qad qadaa tawaafa alhajji waal'umraai bitawaafihi alaawwali ‏.‏ waqaala abnu 'umara kadhalika fa'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' reported that Ibn Umar intended to go for Hajj during the year when Hajjaj attacked Ibn Zubair. It was said to him:There is a state of war between people and we fear that they would detain you, whereupon he ('Abdullah b. Umar) said:" Verily in the Messenger of Allah there is a model pattern for you." I would do as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did. I call you as witness that I have undertaken to perform 'Umra. He then set out until, when he reached the rear side of al-Baida', he said: There is one command both for Hajj and Umra. so bear witness. Ibn Rumh said: I call you as witness that I have undertaken to perform my Hajjalong with my Umra (i. e. I am performing both of them as Qiran), and he offered the sacrifice of animals which he had bought at Qudaid. He then proceeded pronouncing Talbiya for both of them together until he reached Mecca, He circumambulated the House. and (ran) between al-Safa' and al-Marwa and made no addition to it. He neither sacrificed the animal, nor got his head shaved, nor got his hair clipped, nor did he make anything lawful which was unlawful (due to Ihram) until it was the Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja). He then offered sacrifice, and got his hair cut, and saw that circumambulation of Hajj and 'Umra was complete with the first circumambulation. Ibn 'Umar said: This is how Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ، حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، ‏.‏ بِهَذِهِ الْقِصَّةِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ فِي أَوَّلِ الْحَدِيثِ حِينَ قِيلَ لَهُ يَصُدُّوكَ عَنِ الْبَيْتِ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِذًا أَفْعَلَ كَمَا فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي آخِرِ الْحَدِيثِ هَكَذَا فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ كَمَا ذَكَرَهُ اللَّيْثُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu, harbin haddathaniy iismaa'iylu, kilaahumaa 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, ‏.‏ bihadhihi alqissaai ‏.‏ walam yadhkuri alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaa fiy aawwali alhadiythi hiyna qiyla lahu yasudduwka 'ani albayti ‏.‏ qaala iidhana aaf'ala kamaa fa'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ walam yadhkur fiy akhiri alhadiythi hakadhaa fa'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ kamaa dhakarahu alllaythu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated from Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters except with (this variation) that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was mentioned in the first part of the hadith,. i. e. when it was said to him:They would bar you (from going) to the House. He said: In that, case I would do what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done. He did not mention at the end of this hadith (i. e. these words):" This is how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had done," as it Is narrated by al-Laith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَوْنٍ الْهِلاَلِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، الْمُهَلَّبِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، - فِي رِوَايَةِ يَحْيَى - قَالَ أَهْلَلْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحَجِّ مُفْرَدًا وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ مُفْرَدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, wa'abdu alllahi bnu 'awnin alhilaaliyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abbaadu bnu 'abbaadin, almuhallabiyyu haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, - fiy riwaayaai yahyaa - qaala aahlalnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialhajji mufradana wafiy riwaayaai abni 'awnin aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahalla bialhajji mufradana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' thus reported on the authority of Ibn Umar:We entered into the state of Ihram with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for Hajj Mufrad and in the narration of Ibn 'Aun (the words are):" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered into the state of Ihram (with the intention) of Hajj Mufrad
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُلَبِّي بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏ قَالَ بَكْرٌ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِذَلِكَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ لَبَّى بِالْحَجِّ وَحْدَهُ ‏.‏ فَلَقِيتُ أَنَسًا فَحَدَّثْتُهُ بِقَوْلِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ مَا تَعُدُّونَنَا إِلاَّ صِبْيَانًا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لَبَّيْكَ عُمْرَةً وَحَجًّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa surayju bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa hushaymun, haddathanaa humaydun, 'an bakrin, 'an aanasin, - rda allh 'nh - qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yulabbiy bialhajji waal'umraai jamiy'ana ‏.‏ qaala bakrun fahaddathtu bidhalika abna 'umara faqaala labbaa bialhajji wahdahu ‏.‏ falaqiytu aanasana fahaddathtuhu biqawli abni 'umara faqaala aanasun maa ta'udduwnanaa iilaaa sibyaanana sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ labbayka 'umraaan wahajjana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) said:I heard Allah's Apostle (way peace be upon him) pronouncing Talbiya for both Hajj and Umra. Bakr (one of the narrators) said: I narrated it to Ibn 'Umar, whereupon he said: He (the Holy Prophet) pronounced the Talbiya for Hajj alone. I met Anas and narrated to him the words of Ibn 'Umar, whereupon he said: You treat us not but only as children. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pronouncing Talbiya both for 'Umra and Hajj
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامَ الْعَيْشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبُ، بْنُ الشَّهِيدِ عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ، رضى الله عنه أَنَّهُ رَأَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَمَعَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَيْنَ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ قَالَ فَسَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ أَهْلَلْنَا بِالْحَجِّ ‏.‏ فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَى أَنَسٍ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ مَا قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ كَأَنَّمَا كُنَّا صِبْيَانًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aumayyaau bnu bistaama al'ayshiyyu, haddathanaa yaziydu, - ya'niy abna zuray'in - haddathanaa habiybu, bnu alshhahiydi 'an bakri bni 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa aanasun, rda allh 'nh aannahu raaaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm jama'a baynahumaa bayna alhajji waal'umraai qaala fasaaaltu abna 'umara faqaala aahlalnaa bialhajji ‏.‏ faraja'tu iilaa aanasin faaakhbartuhu maa qaala abnu 'umara faqaala kaaannamaa kunnaa sibyaanana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Bakr b. 'Abdullah reported:Anas (Allah be pleased with him) had narrated to us that he saw Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) combining Hajj and 'Umra. He (Bakr) said: I asked (about it) from Ibn 'Umar, whereupon he said: We entered into the state of Ihram for Hajj (only). I came to Anas and told him what Ibn Umar had said, whereupon he remarked: (You are treating us) as if we were children
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْثَرٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ وَبَرَةَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ فَجَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ أَيَصْلُحُ لِي أَنْ أَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ قَبْلَ أَنْ آتِيَ الْمَوْقِفَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ فَإِنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ لاَ تَطُفْ بِالْبَيْتِ حَتَّى تَأْتِيَ الْمَوْقِفَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَقَدْ حَجَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ الْمَوْقِفَ فَبِقَوْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحَقُّ أَنْ تَأْخُذَ أَوْ بِقَوْلِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ إِنْ كُنْتَ صَادِقًا
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abtharun, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, 'an wabaraaa, qaala kuntu jaalisana 'inda abni 'umara fajaa'ahu rajulun faqaala aayasluhu liy aan aatuwfa bialbayti qabla aan atiya almawqifa ‏.‏ faqaala na'am ‏.‏ faqaala faiinna abna 'abbaasin yaquwlu laa tatuf bialbayti hattaa taatiya almawqifa ‏.‏ faqaala abnu 'umara faqad hajja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fataafa bialbayti qabla aan yaatiya almawqifa fabiqawli rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahaqqu aan taakhudha aaw biqawli abni 'abbaasin iin kunta saadiqana
verses.translation: Wabara reported:While I was sitting in the company of Ibn 'Umar, a person came to him and said: Is it right for me to circumambulate the House before I come to stay (at 'Arafat)? Ibn 'Umar said: Yes. whereupon he said: Ibn Abbas, however, says: Do not circumambulate the House until you come to stay at 'Arafat. Thereupon Ibn 'Umar said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Performed the Hajj and circumambulated the House before coming to stay (at 'Arafat). If you say the Truth, is it more rightful to follow the saying of the Prophet (ﷺ) or the words of Ibn Abbas?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ بَيَانٍ، عَنْ وَبَرَةَ، قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ ابْنَ عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - أَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ وَقَدْ أَحْرَمْتُ بِالْحَجِّ فَقَالَ وَمَا يَمْنَعُكَ قَالَ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ فُلاَنٍ يَكْرَهُهُ وَأَنْتَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْنَا مِنْهُ رَأَيْنَاهُ قَدْ فَتَنَتْهُ الدُّنْيَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَأَيُّنَا - أَوْ أَيُّكُمْ - لَمْ تَفْتِنْهُ الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ قَالَ رَأَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْرَمَ بِالْحَجِّ وَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَسَعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ فَسُنَّةُ اللَّهِ وَسُنَّةُ رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحَقُّ أَنْ تَتَّبِعَ مِنْ سُنَّةِ فُلاَنٍ إِنْ كُنْتَ صَادِقًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an bayaanin, 'an wabaraaa, qaala saaala rajulun abna 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - aatuwfu bialbayti waqad aahramtu bialhajji faqaala wamaa yamna'uka qaala iinniy raaaytu abna fulaanin yakrahuhu waaanta aahabbu iilaynaa minhu raaaynaahu qad fatanathu alddunyaa ‏.‏ faqaala waaayyunaa - aaw aayyukum - lam taftinhu alddunyaa thumma qaala raaaynaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahrama bialhajji wataafa bialbayti wasa'aa bayna alssafaa waalmarwaai fasunnaau alllahi wasunnaau rasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahaqqu aan tattabi'a min sunnaai fulaanin iin kunta saadiqana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Wabara reported:A person asked Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with him): May I circumambulate the House, whereas I have entered-into the state of Ihram for Hajj? Thereupon he said: What prevents you from doing it? He said: I saw the son of so and so showing disapproval of it, and you are dearer to us as compared with him. And we see that he is allured by the world, whereupon he said: Who amongst you and us is not allured by the world? And said (further) ': 'We saw that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put on Ihram for Hajj and circumambulated the House and run between al Safa' and al-Marwa. And the way prescribed by Allah and that prescribed by His Apostle (ﷺ) deserve more to be followed than the way shown by so and so, if you speak the truth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْنَا ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ، قَدِمَ بِعُمْرَةٍ فَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَلَمْ يَطُفْ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ أَيَأْتِي امْرَأَتَهُ فَقَالَ قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ سَبْعًا وَصَلَّى خَلْفَ الْمَقَامِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَبَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ سَبْعًا وَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, qaala saaalnaa abna 'umara 'an rajulin, qadima bi'umraain fataafa bialbayti walam yatuf bayna alssafaa waalmarwaai aayaatiy amraaatahu faqaala qadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fataafa bialbayti sab'ana wasallaa khalfa almaqaami rak'atayni wabayna alssafaa waalmarwaai sab'ana waqad kaana lakum fiy rasuwli alllahi auswaaun hasanaaun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amr b. Dinar said:We asked Ibn Umar about a person who came for Umra and circumambulated the House, but he did not run between al-Safa' and al-Marwa, whether he is allowed to (put off Ihram) and have intercourse with his wife. He replied: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) circumambulated the House seven times and offered two rak'ahs of prayer after staying (at 'Arafat), and ran between al-Safa and al-Marwa seven times." Verily there is in Allah's Messenger a model pattern for you" (xxxill)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عُمَرَ - رضى الله عنهما - عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, 'an hammaadi bni zaydin, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu, bnu humaydin aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, jamiy'ana 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'ani abni, 'umara - rda allh 'nhma - 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahwa hadiythi abni 'uyaynaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِرَاقِ قَالَ لَهُ سَلْ لِي عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يُهِلُّ بِالْحَجِّ فَإِذَا طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ أَيَحِلُّ أَمْ لاَ فَإِنْ قَالَ لَكَ لاَ يَحِلُّ ‏.‏ فَقُلْ لَهُ إِنَّ رَجُلاً يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ - قَالَ - فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ لاَ يَحِلُّ مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ إِلاَّ بِالْحَجِّ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّ رَجُلاً كَانَ يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ بِئْسَ مَا قَالَ فَتَصَدَّانِي الرَّجُلُ فَسَأَلَنِي فَحَدَّثْتُهُ فَقَالَ فَقُلْ لَهُ فَإِنَّ رَجُلاً كَانَ يُخْبِرُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ وَمَا شَأْنُ أَسْمَاءَ وَالزُّبَيْرِ فَعَلاَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجِئْتُهُ فَذَكَرْتُ لَهُ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ مَنْ هَذَا فَقُلْتُ لاَ أَدْرِي ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا بَالُهُ لاَ يَأْتِينِي بِنَفْسِهِ يَسْأَلُنِي أَظُنُّهُ عِرَاقِيًّا ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لاَ أَدْرِي ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ كَذَبَ قَدْ حَجَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ - رضى الله عنها - أَنَّ أَوَّلَ شَىْءٍ بَدَأَ بِهِ حِينَ قَدِمَ مَكَّةَ أَنَّهُ تَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ ثُمَّ حَجَّ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَكَانَ أَوَّلَ شَىْءٍ بَدَأَ بِهِ الطَّوَافُ بِالْبَيْتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَكُنْ غَيْرُهُ ثُمَّ عُمَرُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ حَجَّ عُثْمَانُ فَرَأَيْتُهُ أَوَّلُ شَىْءٍ بَدَأَ بِهِ الطَّوَافُ بِالْبَيْتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَكُنْ غَيْرُهُ ثُمَّ مُعَاوِيَةُ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ ثُمَّ حَجَجْتُ مَعَ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ فَكَانَ أَوَّلَ شَىْءٍ بَدَأَ بِهِ الطَّوَافُ بِالْبَيْتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَكُنْ غَيْرُهُ ثُمَّ رَأَيْتُ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَالأَنْصَارَ يَفْعَلُونَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَكُنْ غَيْرُهُ ثُمَّ آخِرُ مَنْ رَأَيْتُ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْقُضْهَا بِعُمْرَةٍ وَهَذَا ابْنُ عُمَرَ عِنْدَهُمْ أَفَلاَ يَسْأَلُونَهُ وَلاَ أَحَدٌ مِمَّنْ مَضَى مَا كَانُوا يَبْدَءُونَ بِشَىْءٍ حِينَ يَضَعُونَ أَقْدَامَهُمْ أَوَّلَ مِنَ الطَّوَافِ بِالْبَيْتِ ثُمَّ لاَ يَحِلُّونَ وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ أُمِّي وَخَالَتِي حِينَ تَقْدَمَانِ لاَ تَبْدَآنِ بِشَىْءٍ أَوَّلَ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ تَطُوفَانِ بِهِ ثُمَّ لاَ تَحِلاَّنِ وَقَدْ أَخْبَرَتْنِي أُمِّي أَنَّهَا أَقْبَلَتْ هِيَ وَأُخْتُهَا وَالزُّبَيْرُ وَفُلاَنٌ وَفُلاَنٌ بِعُمْرَةٍ قَطُّ فَلَمَّا مَسَحُوا الرُّكْنَ حَلُّوا وَقَدْ كَذَبَ فِيمَا ذَكَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, - wahuwa abnu alhaarithi - 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna rajulaan, min aahli al'iraaqi qaala lahu sal liy 'urwaaa bna alzzubayri 'an rajulin yuhillu bialhajji faiidhaa taafa bialbayti aayahillu aam laa faiin qaala laka laa yahillu ‏.‏ faqul lahu iinna rajulaan yaquwlu dhalika - qaala - fasaaaltuhu faqaala laa yahillu man aahalla bialhajji iilaaa bialhajji ‏.‏ qultu faiinna rajulaan kaana yaquwlu dhalika ‏.‏ qaala biisa maa qaala fatasaddaaniy alrrajulu fasaaalaniy fahaddathtuhu faqaala faqul lahu faiinna rajulaan kaana yukhbiru aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad fa'ala dhalika wamaa shaanu aasmaa'a waalzzubayri fa'alaa dhalika ‏.‏ qaala fajiituhu fadhakartu lahu dhalika faqaala man hadhaa faqultu laa aadriy ‏.‏ qaala famaa baaluhu laa yaatiyniy binafsihi yasaaluniy aazunnuhu 'iraaqiyyana ‏.‏ qultu laa aadriy ‏.‏ qaala faiinnahu qad kadhaba qad hajja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbaratniy 'aaiishaau - rda allh 'nha - aanna aawwala shaa'in badaaa bihi hiyna qadima makkaaa aannahu tawaddaaa thumma taafa bialbayti thumma hajja aabuw bakrin fakaana aawwala shaa'in badaaa bihi alttawaafu bialbayti thumma lam yakun ghayruhu thumma 'umaru mithlu dhalika thumma hajja 'uthmaanu faraaaytuhu aawwalu shaa'in badaaa bihi alttawaafu bialbayti thumma lam yakun ghayruhu thumma mu'aawiyaau wa'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara thumma hajajtu ma'a aabiy alzzubayri bni al'awwaami fakaana aawwala shaa'in badaaa bihi alttawaafu bialbayti thumma lam yakun ghayruhu thumma raaaytu almuhaajiriyna waalaansaara yaf'aluwna dhalika thumma lam yakun ghayruhu thumma akhiru man raaaytu fa'ala dhalika abnu 'umara thumma lam yanqudhaa bi'umraain wahadhaa abnu 'umara 'indahum aafalaa yasaaluwnahu walaa aahadun mimman madaa maa kaanuwa yabda'uwna bishaa'in hiyna yada'uwna aaqdaamahum aawwala mina alttawaafi bialbayti thumma laa yahilluwna waqad raaaytu aummiy wakhaalatiy hiyna taqdamaani laa tabdaani bishaa'in aawwala mina albayti tatuwfaani bihi thumma laa tahilaaani waqad aakhbaratniy aummiy aannahaa aaqbalat hiya waaukhtuhaa waalzzubayru wafulaanun wafulaanun bi'umraain qattu falammaa masahuwa alrrukna halluwa waqad kadhaba fiymaa dhakara min dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported:A person from Iraq said to him to inquire from 'Urwa b. Zubair for him whether a person who puts on Ihram for Hajj is allowed to put it off or not as he circumambulates the House. And if he says:" No, it can't be put off," then tell him that there is a person who makes such an assertion. He (Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Rahman) then said: I asked him ( Urwa b. Zubair), where- upon he said: The person who has entered into the state of Ihram for Hajj cannot get out of it unless he has, completed the Hajj I (further) said (to him): (What) if a person makes that assertion? Thereupon he said: It is indeed unfortunate that he makes such an assertion. That person ('Iraqi) then met me and he asked me and I narrated to him (the reply of 'Urwa), whereupon he (the Iraqi) said: Tell him ('Urwa) that a person had informed him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done that; and why is it that Asma' and Zubair have done like this? He (Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Rahman) said: I went to him and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he ('Urwa) said: Who is he (the 'Iraqi)? I said: I do not know, whereupon he said: What is the matter that he does not come to me himself and ask me? I suppose he is an 'Iraqi. I said: I do not know, whereupon he said: He has told a lie. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed Hajj, and 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) has told me that the first thing with which he commenced (the rituals) when he arrived at Mecca was that he performed ablution and then circumambulated the Ka'ba. Then Abu Bakr performed Hajj and the first thing with which he commenced (the Hajj) as the circumambulation of the Ka'ba and nothing besides it. So did 'Umar. Then 'Uthman performed Hajj and I saw that the first thing with which he commenced the Hajj was the circumambulation of the Ka'ba and nothing besides it. Then Mu'awiya and Abdullah b. 'Umar did that. Then I performed Hajj with my father Zubair b. al-'Awwam, and the first thing with which he commenced (Hajj) was the circumambulation of the House. He then did nothing besides it. I then saw the emigrants (Muhajirin) and the helpers (Ansar) doing like this and nothing besides it. And the last one whom I saw doing like this was Ibn 'Umar. And he did not break it (the Hajj) after performing 'Umra. And Ibn 'Umar is with them. Why don't they ask him (to testify it)? And none amongst those who had passed away commenced (the rituals of Hajj) but by circumambulating the Ka'ba on their (first arrival) and they did not put off Ihram (without completing the Hajj), and I saw my mother and my aunt commencing (their Hajj) with the circumambulation of the House, and they did not put off Ihram. My mother informed me that she came and her sister, and Zubair and so and so for 'Umra, and when they had kissed the corner (the Black Stone, after Sa'i and circumambulation), they put off Ihram. And he (the 'Iraqi) has told a lie in this matter
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مَنْصُورُ، بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أُمِّهِ، صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَتْ خَرَجْنَا مُحْرِمِينَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ هَدْىٌ فَلْيَقُمْ عَلَى إِحْرَامِهِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُ هَدْىٌ فَلْيَحْلِلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَكُنْ مَعِي هَدْىٌ فَحَلَلْتُ وَكَانَ مَعَ الزُّبَيْرِ هَدْىٌ فَلَمْ يَحْلِلْ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَلَبِسْتُ ثِيَابِي ثُمَّ خَرَجْتُ فَجَلَسْتُ إِلَى الزُّبَيْرِ فَقَالَ قُومِي عَنِّي ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَتَخْشَى أَنْ أَثِبَ عَلَيْكَ
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, haddathaniy mansuwru, bnu 'abdi alrrahmani 'an aummihi, safiyyaaa binti shaybaaa 'an aasmaa'a binti aabiy bakrin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaalat kharajnaa muhrimiyna faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man kaana ma'ahu hadaun falyaqum 'alaa iihraamihi waman lam yakun ma'ahu hadaun falyahlil ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falam yakun ma'iy hadaun fahalaltu wakaana ma'a alzzubayri hadaun falam yahlil ‏.‏ qaalat falabistu thiyaabiy thumma kharajtu fajalastu iilaa alzzubayri faqaala quwmiy 'anniy ‏.‏ faqultu aatakhshaa aan aathiba 'alayka
verses.translation: Asma bint Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported:We set out (to Mecca) in a state of Ihram. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who has the sacrificial animal with him should remain in the state of Ihram, but he who has not the sacrificial animal with him should put off Ihram. As I had not the sacrificial animal with me, I put off Ihram. And since Zubair (her husband) - had the sacrificial animal with him, he did not put off Ihram. She (Asma) said: I put on my clothes and then went out and sat by Zabair, whereupon he said: Go away from me, whereupon I said: Do you fear that I would jump upon you?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هِشَامٍ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، الْمَخْزُومِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَتْ قَدِمْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُهِلِّينَ بِالْحَجِّ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَقَالَ اسْتَرْخِي عَنِّي اسْتَرْخِي عَنِّي ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَتَخْشَى أَنْ أَثِبَ عَلَيْكَ
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abbaasu bnu 'abdi al'aziymi al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabuw hishaamin almughiyraau bnu salamaaa, almakhzuwmiyyu haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa mansuwru bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aummihi, 'an aasmaa'a binti aabiy bakrin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaalat qadimnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm muhilliyna bialhajji ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bimithli hadiythi abni jurayjin ghayra aannahu qaala faqaala astarkhiy 'anniy astarkhiy 'anniy ‏.‏ faqultu aatakhshaa aan aathiba 'alayka
verses.translation: Asma bint Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with th (m) said:We came for Hajj in the state of Ihram with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The rest of the hadith is the same except (for the words) that he (Zubair) said: Keep away from me, keep away from me, whereupon I said: Do you fear that I will jump upon you?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، مَوْلَى أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ - رضى الله عنهما - حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، كَانَ يَسْمَعُ أَسْمَاءَ كُلَّمَا مَرَّتْ بِالْحَجُونِ تَقُولُ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَقَدْ نَزَلْنَا مَعَهُ هَا هُنَا وَنَحْنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ خِفَافُ الْحَقَائِبِ قَلِيلٌ ظَهْرُنَا قَلِيلَةٌ أَزْوَادُنَا فَاعْتَمَرْتُ أَنَا وَأُخْتِي عَائِشَةُ وَالزُّبَيْرُ وَفُلاَنٌ وَفُلاَنٌ فَلَمَّا مَسَحْنَا الْبَيْتَ أَحْلَلْنَا ثُمَّ أَهْلَلْنَا مِنَ الْعَشِيِّ بِالْحَجِّ ‏.‏ قَالَ هَارُونُ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ أَنَّ مَوْلَى أَسْمَاءَ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يُسَمِّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, 'an aabiy alaaswadi, aanna 'abda alllahi, mawlaa aasmaa'a binti aabiy bakrin - rda allh 'nhma - haddathahu aannahu, kaana yasma'u aasmaa'a kullamaa marrat bialhajuwni taquwlu sallaa alllahu 'alaa rasuwlihi wasallama laqad nazalnaa ma'ahu haa hunaa wanahnu yawmaiidhin khifaafu alhaqaaiibi qaliylun zahrunaa qaliylaaun aazwaadunaa faa'tamartu aanaa waaukhtiy 'aaiishaau waalzzubayru wafulaanun wafulaanun falammaa masahnaa albayta aahlalnaa thumma aahlalnaa mina al'ashiyyi bialhajji ‏.‏ qaala haaruwnu fiy riwaayatihi aanna mawlaa aasmaa'a ‏.‏ walam yusammi 'abda alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah, the freed slave of Asma' bint Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with them), narrated that he used to hear Asma, ' whenever she passed by Hajun, saying (these words):" May there be peace and blessing of Allah upon His Messenger." We used to stay here along with him with light burdens. Few were our rides, and small were our provisions. I performed 'Umra and so did my sister 'A'isha, and Zubair and so and so. And as we touched the House (performed circumambulation and Sa'i) we put off Ihram, and then again put on Ihram in the afternoon for Hajj. Harun (one of the narrators) in one of the narrations said: The freed slave of Asma' and he did not mention 'Abdullah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ الْقُرِّيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ - رضى الله عنهما - عَنْ مُتْعَةِ الْحَجِّ، فَرَخَّصَ فِيهَا وَكَانَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ يَنْهَى عَنْهَا فَقَالَ هَذِهِ أُمُّ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ تُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَخَّصَ فِيهَا فَادْخُلُوا عَلَيْهَا فَاسْأَلُوهَا قَالَ فَدَخَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا فَإِذَا امْرَأَةٌ ضَخْمَةٌ عَمْيَاءُ فَقَالَتْ قَدْ رَخَّصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muslimin alqurriyyi, qaala saaaltu abna 'abbaasin - rda allh 'nhma - 'an mut'aai alhajji, farakhhasa fiyhaa wakaana abnu alzzubayri yanhaa 'anhaa faqaala hadhihi aummu abni alzzubayri tuhaddithu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakhhasa fiyhaa faadkhuluwa 'alayhaa faasaaluwhaa qaala fadakhalnaa 'alayhaa faiidhaa amraaaaun dakhmaaun 'amyaa'u faqaalat qad rakhhasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiyhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muslim al-Qurri reported:I asked Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) about Tamattu' in Hajj and he permitted it, whereas Ibn Zubair had forbidden it. He (Ibn 'Abbas) said: This is the mother of Ibn Zubair who states that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had permitted it, so you better go to her and ask her about it. He (Muslim al-Qurri said): So we went to her and she was a bulky blind lady and she said: Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) permitted it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - جَمِيعًا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ فَأَمَّا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ فَفِي حَدِيثِهِ الْمُتْعَةُ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ مُتْعَةُ الْحَجِّ ‏.‏ وَأَمَّا ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ فَقَالَ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ لاَ أَدْرِي مُتْعَةُ الْحَجِّ أَوْ مُتْعَةُ النِّسَاءِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, h wahaddathanaahu abnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - jamiy'ana 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi faaammaa 'abdu alrrahmani fafiy hadiythihi almut'aau walam yaqul mut'aau alhajji ‏.‏ waaammaa abnu ja'farin faqaala qaala shu'baau qaala muslimun laa aadriy mut'aau alhajji aaw mut'aau alnnisaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ الْقُرِّيُّ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - يَقُولُ أَهَلَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعُمْرَةٍ وَأَهَلَّ أَصْحَابُهُ بِحَجٍّ فَلَمْ يَحِلَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلاَ مَنْ سَاقَ الْهَدْىَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ وَحَلَّ بَقِيَّتُهُمْ فَكَانَ طَلْحَةُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ فِيمَنْ سَاقَ الْهَدْىَ فَلَمْ يَحِلَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa muslimun alqurriyyu, sami'a abna 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - yaquwlu aahalla alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bi'umraain waaahalla aashaabuhu bihajjin falam yahilla alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm walaa man saaqa alhadaa min aashaabihi wahalla baqiyyatuhum fakaana talhaau bnu 'ubaydi alllahi fiyman saaqa alhadaa falam yahilla ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muslim al-Qurri heardlbn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) saying that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) entered into the state of Ihram for Umra and his Companions for Hajj. Neither Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) nor those among his Companions who had brought sacrificial animals with them put off Ihram, whereas the rest (of the pilgrims) did so. Talha b. Ubaidullah was one of those who had brought the sacrificial animals along with them so he did not put off Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَكَانَ مِمَّنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُ الْهَدْىُ طَلْحَةُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ وَرَجُلٌ آخَرُ فَأَحَلاَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aannahu qaala wakaana mimman lam yakun ma'ahu alhadau talhaau bnu 'ubaydi alllahi warajulun akharu faaahalaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but with this variation (of words):" Talha and another person also were among those who had not brought the sacrificial animals with them and so they put off Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ كَانُوا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّ الْعُمْرَةَ فِي أَشْهُرِ الْحَجِّ مِنْ أَفْجَرِ الْفُجُورِ فِي الأَرْضِ وَيَجْعَلُونَ الْمُحَرَّمَ صَفَرً وَيَقُولُونَ إِذَا بَرَأَ الدَّبَرْ وَعَفَا الأَثَرْ وَانْسَلَخَ صَفَرْ حَلَّتِ الْعُمْرَةُ لِمَنِ اعْتَمَرْ ‏.‏ فَقَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابُهُ صَبِيحَةَ رَابِعَةٍ مُهِلِّينَ بِالْحَجِّ فَأَمَرَهُمْ أَنْ يَجْعَلُوهَا عُمْرَةً فَتَعَاظَمَ ذَلِكَ عِنْدَهُمْ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَىُّ الْحِلِّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْحِلُّ كُلُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala kaanuwa yarawna aanna al'umraaa fiy aashhuri alhajji min aafjari alfujuwri fiy alaardi wayaj'aluwna almuharrama safaran wayaquwluwna iidhaa baraaa alddabar wa'afaa alaathar waansalakha safar hallati al'umraau limani a'tamar ‏.‏ faqadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waaashaabuhu sabiyhaaa raabi'aain muhilliyna bialhajji faaamarahum aan yaj'aluwhaa 'umraaan fata'aazama dhalika 'indahum faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi aaaau alhilli qaala ‏ "‏ alhillu kulluhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that they (the Arabs of pre-Islamic days) looked upon Umra during the months of Hajj as the greatest of sins on the earth. So they intercalated the month of Muharram for Safar and said:When the backs of their camels would become all right and traces (if the pilgrims) would be effaced (from the paths) and the month of Safar would be over, then Umra would be permissible for one who wants to perform it. When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and his Companions came in the state of Ihram for performing Hajj on the fourth (of Dhu'l-Hijja) he (Allah's Apostle) commanded them to change their state of Ihram (from Hajj) to that of 'Umra. It was something inconceivable for them. So they said: Messenger of Allah, is it a complete freedom (of the obligation) of Ihram? Thereupon he said: It is a complete freedom (from Ihram)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ، الْبَرَّاءِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - يَقُولُ أَهَلَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحَجِّ فَقَدِمَ لأَرْبَعٍ مَضَيْنَ مِنْ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ وَقَالَ لَمَّا صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَهَا عُمْرَةً فَلْيَجْعَلْهَا عُمْرَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy al'aaliyaai, albarraa'i aannahu sami'a abna 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - yaquwlu aahalla rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialhajji faqadima laarba'in madayna min dhiy alhijjaai fasallaa alssubha waqaala lammaa sallaa alssubha ‏ "‏ man shaa'a aan yaj'alahaa 'umraaan falyaj'alhaa 'umraaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) 'is reported to have said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) put on Ihigm for Hajj. When four days of Dhu'l-Hijja were over, he led the dawn prayer, and when the prayer was complete, he said: He who wants to change it to Umra may do so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الْمُبَارَكِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَمَّا رَوْحٌ وَيَحْيَى بْنُ كَثِيرٍ فَقَالاَ كَمَا قَالَ نَصْرٌ أَهَلَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحَجِّ ‏.‏ وَأَمَّا أَبُو شِهَابٍ فَفِي رِوَايَتِهِ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نُهِلُّ بِالْحَجِّ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمْ جَمِيعًا فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ بِالْبَطْحَاءِ ‏.‏ خَلاَ الْجَهْضَمِيَّ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَقُلْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iibraahiymu bnu diynaarin, haddathanaa rawhun, h wahaddathanaa aabuw daawuda almubaarakiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw shihaabin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu kathiyrin, kulluhum 'an shu'baaa, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi aammaa rawhun wayahyaa bnu kathiyrin faqaalaa kamaa qaala nasrun aahalla rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialhajji ‏.‏ waaammaa aabuw shihaabin fafiy riwaayatihi kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nuhillu bialhajji ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythihim jamiy'ana fasallaa alssubha bialbathaa'i ‏.‏ khalaa aljahdamiyya faiinnahu lam yaqulhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Rauh and Yahya b. Kathir narrated as Nasr reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered into the state of Ihram for Hajj. And in the narration of Abu Shihab (the words are):We went out with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronouncing Talbiya for Hajj, And in an the ahadith (narrated in this connection the words are): He led the morning prayer at al-Batha', except al- jahdami who did not make mention of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ السَّدُوسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ الْبَرَّاءِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابُهُ لأَرْبَعٍ خَلَوْنَ مِنَ الْعَشْرِ وَهُمْ يُلَبُّونَ بِالْحَجِّ فَأَمَرَهُمْ أَنْ يَجْعَلُوهَا عُمْرَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu alfadli alssaduwsiyyu, haddathanaa wuhaybun, aakhbaranaa aayyuwbu, 'an aabiy al'aaliyaai albarraa'i, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waaashaabuhu laarba'in khalawna mina al'ashri wahum yulabbuwna bialhajji faaamarahum aan yaj'aluwhaa 'umraaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came along with his Companions when four days had passed out of ten days (of Dhu'l-Hijja) and they were pronouncing Talbiya for Hajj, and he (the Holy Prophet) commanded them to change (this Ihram) into that of 'Umra
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصُّبْحَ بِذِي طَوًى وَقَدِمَ لأَرْبَعٍ مَضَيْنَ مِنْ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ وَأَمَرَ أَصْحَابَهُ أَنْ يُحَوِّلُوا إِحْرَامَهُمْ بِعُمْرَةٍ إِلاَّ مَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ الْهَدْىُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy al'aaliyaai, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alssubha bidhiy tawana waqadima laarba'in madayna min dhiy alhijjaai waaamara aashaabahu aan yuhawwiluwa iihraamahum bi'umraain iilaaa man kaana ma'ahu alhadau ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed the morning prayer at Dhu Tawa (a valley near Mecca) and arrived (in Mecca) when four days of Dhul-Hijja had passed and he commanded his Companions that they should change their Ihram (of Hajj) to that of Umra, except those who had brought sacrificial animals with them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ هَذِهِ عُمْرَةٌ اسْتَمْتَعْنَا بِهَا فَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ عِنْدَهُ الْهَدْىُ فَلْيَحِلَّ الْحِلَّ كُلَّهُ فَإِنَّ الْعُمْرَةَ قَدْ دَخَلَتْ فِي الْحَجِّ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ hadhihi 'umraaun astamta'naa bihaa faman lam yakun 'indahu alhadau falyahilla alhilla kullahu faiinna al'umraaa qad dakhalat fiy alhajji iilaa yawmi alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:This is the 'Umra of which we have taken advantage. So he who has not the sacrificial animal with him should get out of the state of Ihram completely, for 'Umra has been incorporated in Hajj until the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَمْرَةَ الضُّبَعِيَّ، قَالَ تَمَتَّعْتُ فَنَهَانِي نَاسٌ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَأَتَيْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَأَمَرَنِي بِهَا ‏.‏ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ انْطَلَقْتُ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ فَنِمْتُ فَأَتَانِي آتٍ فِي مَنَامِي فَقَالَ عُمْرَةٌ مُتَقَبَّلَةٌ وَحَجٌّ مَبْرُورٌ - قَالَ - فَأَتَيْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِالَّذِي رَأَيْتُ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ سُنَّةُ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu aabaa jamraaa aldduba'iyya, qaala tamatta'tu fanahaaniy naasun 'an dhalika, faaataytu abna 'abbaasin fasaaaltuhu 'an dhalika, faaamaraniy bihaa ‏.‏ - qaala - thumma antalaqtu iilaa albayti fanimtu faaataaniy atin fiy manaamiy faqaala 'umraaun mutaqabbalaaun wahajjun mabruwrun - qaala - faaataytu abna 'abbaasin faaakhbartuhu bialladhiy raaaytu faqaala alllahu aakbaru alllahu aakbaru sunnaau aabiy alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Jam at al-Dubu'i reported:I performed Tamattu' but the people dis- couraged me to do so. I came to Ibn 'Abbas and asked him about it. He ordered me to do so. I came to the House (Ka'ba) and slept. I saw a visitant in the dream who said: 'Umra is acceptable and so is the Hajj performed for God's sake. I came to Ibn Abbas and informed him about that Which I saw in the dream whereupon he said: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest This is the Sunnah of Abu'l-Qasim (the Holy Pro- phet) (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، - قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، - عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَسَّانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الظُّهْرَ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِنَاقَتِهِ فَأَشْعَرَهَا فِي صَفْحَةِ سَنَامِهَا الأَيْمَنِ وَسَلَتَ الدَّمَ وَقَلَّدَهَا نَعْلَيْنِ ثُمَّ رَكِبَ رَاحِلَتَهُ فَلَمَّا اسْتَوَتْ بِهِ عَلَى الْبَيْدَاءِ أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin jamiy'ana 'ani abni aabiy 'adiyyin, - qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, - 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aabiy hassaana, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, - rda allh 'nhma - qaala sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alzzuhra bidhiy alhulayfaai thumma da'aa binaaqatihi faaash'arahaa fiy safhaai sanaamihaa alaaymani wasalata alddama waqalladahaa na'layni thumma rakiba raahilatahu falammaa astawat bihi 'alaa albaydaa'i aahalla bialhajji ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed the Zuhr prayer at Dhu'l-Hulaifa; then called for his she-camel and marked it on the right side of its bump, removed the blood from it, and tied two sandals round its neck. He then mounted his camel, and when it brought him up to al-Baida', he pronounced Talbiya for the Pilgrimage
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا أَتَى ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ صَلَّى بِهَا الظُّهْرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi shu'baaa ghayra aannahu qaala iinna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lammaa aataa dhaa alhulayfaai ‏.‏ walam yaqul sallaa bihaa alzzuhra ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters but with this variation (of words):" When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came to Dhu'l-Hulaifa" and he made no mention (of the fact) that he led the Zuhr prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حَسَّانَ الأَعْرَجَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي الْهُجَيْمِ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ مَا هَذِهِ الْفُتْيَا الَّتِي قَدْ تَشَغَّفَتْ أَوْ تَشَغَّبَتْ بِالنَّاسِ أَنَّ مَنْ طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ فَقَدْ حَلَّ فَقَالَ سُنَّةُ نَبِيِّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَإِنْ رَغِمْتُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, qaala sami'tu aabaa hassaana alaa'raja, qaala qaala rajulun min baniy alhujaymi laibni 'abbaasin maa hadhihi alfutyaa allatiy qad tashaghhafat aaw tashaghhabat bialnnaasi aanna man taafa bialbayti faqad halla faqaala sunnaau nabiyyikum sla allh 'lyh wslm waiin raghimtum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Hassan al-A'raj reported that a person from Bani Hujaim said to Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them):What is this religious verdict of yours which has engaged the attention of the people or which has become a matter of dispute among them that he who circumambulated the House can be free from Ihram? Thereupon he said: That is the Sunnah of your Apostle (ﷺ), even though you may not approve of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَسَّانَ، قَالَ قِيلَ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ إِنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ قَدْ تَفَشَّغَ بِالنَّاسِ مَنْ طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ فَقَدْ حَلَّ الطَّوَافُ عُمْرَةٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ سُنَّةُ نَبِيِّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَإِنْ رَغِمْتُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aahmadu bnu sa'iydin alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa aahmadu bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa hammaamu bnu yahyaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aabiy hassaana, qaala qiyla laibni 'abbaasin iinna hadhaa alaamra qad tafashhagha bialnnaasi man taafa bialbayti faqad halla alttawaafu 'umraaun ‏.‏ faqaala sunnaau nabiyyikum sla allh 'lyh wslm waiin raghimtum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Hassan reported:It was said to Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) that this affair had engaged the attention of the people that he who circumambu- lates the House was permitted to circumambulate for Umra (even though he was in a state of Ihram for Hajj), whereupon he said: That is the Sunnah of your Apostle (ﷺ), even though you may not approve of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، قَالَ كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ لاَ يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ حَاجٌّ وَلاَ غَيْرُ حَاجٍّ إِلاَّ حَلَّ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءٍ مِنْ أَيْنَ يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ قَالَ مِنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏ ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَا إِلَى الْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ‏}‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ بَعْدَ الْمُعَرَّفِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ هُوَ بَعْدَ الْمُعَرَّفِ وَقَبْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ يَأْخُذُ ذَلِكَ مِنْ أَمْرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ أَمَرَهُمْ أَنْ يَحِلُّوا فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, qaala kaana abnu 'abbaasin yaquwlu laa yatuwfu bialbayti haajjun walaa ghayru haajjin iilaaa halla ‏.‏ qultu li'ataa'in min aayna yaquwlu dhalika qaala min qawli alllahi ta'aalaa ‏{‏ thumma mahilluhaa iilaa albayti al'atiyqi‏}‏ qaala qultu faiinna dhalika ba'da almu'arrafi ‏.‏ faqaala kaana abnu 'abbaasin yaquwlu huwa ba'da almu'arrafi waqablahu ‏.‏ wakaana yaakhudhu dhalika min aamri alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna aamarahum aan yahilluwa fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ata' said:Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) used to say that a pilgrim or non-pilgrim (one performing 'Umar) who circumambulates the House is free from the responsibility of Ihram. I (Ibn Juraij, one of the narrators) said to 'Ata': On what authority does he (Ibn Abbas) say this? He said: On the authority uf Allah's words:" Then their place of sacrifice is the Ancient House" (al-Qur'an, xxii. 33). I said: It concerns the time after staying at 'Arafat, whereupon he said: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) had stated (that the place of sacrifice is the Ancient House) ; it way be after staying at 'Arafat or before (staying there). And he (Ibn Abbas) made this deduction I from the command of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) when he had ordered to put off Ihram on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حُجَيْرٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ لِي مُعَاوِيَةُ أَعَلِمْتَ أَنِّي قَصَّرْتُ مِنْ رَأْسِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ الْمَرْوَةِ بِمِشْقَصٍ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ لاَ أَعْلَمُ هَذَا إِلاَّ حُجَّةً عَلَيْكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an hishaami bni hujayrin, 'an taawusin, qaala qaala abnu 'abbaasin qaala liy mu'aawiyaau aa'alimta aanniy qassartu min raasi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'inda almarwaai bimishqasin faqultu lahu laa aa'lamu hadhaa iilaaa hujjaaan 'alayka ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported that Mu'awiya had said to them:Do you know that I clipped some hair from the head of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at al- Marwa with the help of a clipper? I said: I do not know it except as it verdict against you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ، بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ قَصَّرْتُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِشْقَصٍ وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمَرْوَةِ أَوْ رَأَيْتُهُ يُقَصَّرُ عَنْهُ بِمِشْقَصٍ وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمَرْوَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'ani abni jurayjin, haddathaniy alhasanu, bnu muslimin 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna mu'aawiyaaa bna aabiy sufyaana, aakhbarahu qaala qassartu 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimishqasin wahuwa 'alaa almarwaai aaw raaaytuhu yuqassaru 'anhu bimishqasin wahuwa 'alaa almarwaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbis (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Mu'awiya b. Abu Safyin had told him:I clipped the hair (from the head of) Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) with a clipper while he was at al-Marwa, or I saw him getting his hair clipped with a clipper as he was at al-Marwa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، وَعَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، - رضى الله عنهما - قَالاَ قَدِمْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ نَصْرُخُ بِالْحَجِّ صُرَاخًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu aasadin, haddathanaa wuhaybu bnu khaalidin, 'an daawuda, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an jaabirin, wa'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, - rda allh 'nhma - qaalaa qadimnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu nasrukhu bialhajji suraakhana ‏.‏
verses.translation: jibir and Abil Salld al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with them) reported:We went with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and we were pronouncing Talbiya for Hajj loudly
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْبَكْرَاوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَأَتَاهُ آتٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ وَابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ اخْتَلَفَا فِي الْمُتْعَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ جَابِرٌ فَعَلْنَاهُمَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ نَهَانَا عَنْهُمَا عُمَرُ فَلَمْ نَعُدْ لَهُمَا ‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haamidu bnu 'umara albakraawiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, 'an 'aasimin, 'an aabiy nadraaa, qaala kuntu 'inda jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi faaataahu atin faqaala iinna abna 'abbaasin waabna alzzubayri akhtalafaa fiy almut'atayni faqaala jaabirun fa'alnaahumaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma nahaanaa 'anhumaa 'umaru falam na'ud lahumaa ‏
verses.translation: Abd Nadra reported:While I was in the company of Jibir, a person came and said: There is difference of opinion amomg Ibn Abbas and Ibn Zubair about two Mut'as (benefits, Tamattul in Hajj and temporary marriage with women), whereupon jibir said: We have been doing this during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him), and then 'Umar forbade us to do so, and we never resorted to them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنِي سَلِيمُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ مَرْوَانَ الأَصْفَرِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، - رضى الله عنه - أَنَّ عَلِيًّا، قَدِمَ مِنَ الْيَمَنِ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بِمَ أَهْلَلْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَهْلَلْتُ بِإِهْلاَلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْلاَ أَنَّ مَعِيَ الْهَدْىَ لأَحْلَلْتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa abnu mahdiyyin, haddathaniy saliymu bnu hayyaana, 'an marwaana alaasfari, 'an aanasin, - rda allh 'nh - aanna 'aliyyana, qadima mina alyamani faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ bima aahlalta ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala aahlaltu biiihlaali alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ lawlaa aanna ma'iya alhadaa laahlaltu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him) came from the Yemen, and the Apostle (ﷺ) said:With (what intention) have you put on Ihram? He said: I have put on Ibram in accordance with the intention with which Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) has put on Ibram, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Had there not been the sacrificial animals with me, I would have put off Ihram (after performing 'Umra)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي رِوَايَةِ بَهْزٍ ‏ "‏ لَحَلَلْتُ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, h wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu haashimin, haddathanaa bahzun, qaalaa haddathanaa saliymu bnu hayyaana, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ghayra aanna fiy riwaayaai bahzin ‏ "‏ lahalaltu‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Salim b. Hayyin with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ سَعِيدٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، - رضى الله عنه - يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَيُهِلَّنَّ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ بِفَجِّ الرَّوْحَاءِ حَاجًّا أَوْ مُعْتَمِرًا أَوْ لَيَثْنِيَنَّهُمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, - qaala sa'iydun haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - haddathaniy alzzuhriyyu, 'an hanzalaaa alaaslamiyyi, qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, - rda allh 'nh - yuhaddithu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi layuhillanna abnu maryama bifajji alrrawhaa'i haajjana aaw mu'tamirana aaw layathniyannahumaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni shihaabin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu qaala ‏"‏ waalladhiy nafsu muhammadin biyadihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hanzala al-Aslami reported:I heard Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) as narrating from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life. Ibn Maryam (Jesus Christ) would certainly pronounce Talbiya for Hajj or for Umra or for both (simultaneously as a Qiran) In the valley of Rauha
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، - رضى الله عنه - يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an hanzalaaa bni 'aliyyin alaaslamiyyi, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, - rda allh 'nh - yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythihimaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hanzala b. 'Ali al-Aslaml reported that he had heard Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) as saying that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said:By Him In Whose Hand is my life; the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، أَنَّ أَنَسًا، - رضى الله عنه - أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اعْتَمَرَ أَرْبَعَ عُمَرٍ كُلُّهُنَّ فِي ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ إِلاَّ الَّتِي مَعَ حَجَّتِهِ عُمْرَةً مِنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ أَوْ زَمَنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فِي ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ وَعُمْرَةً مِنَ الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ فِي ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ وَعُمْرَةً مِنْ جِعْرَانَةَ حَيْثُ قَسَمَ غَنَائِمَ حُنَيْنٍ فِي ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ وَعُمْرَةً مَعَ حَجَّتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haddaabu bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, aanna aanasana, - rda allh 'nh - aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm a'tamara aarba'a 'umarin kulluhunna fiy dhiy alqa'daai iilaaa allatiy ma'a hajjatihi 'umraaan mina alhudaybiyaai aaw zamana alhudaybiyaai fiy dhiy alqa'daai wa'umraaan mina al'aami almuqbili fiy dhiy alqa'daai wa'umraaan min ji'raanaaa haythu qasama ghanaaiima hunaynin fiy dhiy alqa'daai wa'umraaan ma'a hajjatihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Qatida saia. that Anas (Allah be pleased with him) had informed him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed four 'Umras, all during the month of Dhu'l-Qa'da except the one he performed along with Hajj (and these are) the Umra that he performed from al-Hudaibiya or during the time of (the truce of) Hudaibiya in the month of Dhu'l-Qa'da then the Umra of the next year in the month of Dhu'l-Qa'da, then the Umra for which b'e had started from ji'rana, the place where he distributed the spoils of (the battle of) Hunain in the month of Dhu'l-Qa'da, and then the 'Umra that he performed along with his Hajj (on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسًا كَمْ حَجَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ حَجَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَاعْتَمَرَ أَرْبَعَ عُمَرٍ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ هَدَّابٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathaniy 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, qaala saaaltu aanasana kam hajja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala hajjaaan waahidaaan waa'tamara aarba'a 'umarin ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bimithli hadiythi haddaabin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Qatada said:I asked Anas (Allah be pleased with him) as to how many Pilgrimages had been performed by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he replied: One Hajj and four `Umras were performed by him. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ كَمْ غَزَوْتَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ سَبْعَ عَشْرَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَرْقَمَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَزَا تِسْعَ عَشْرَةَ وَأَنَّهُ حَجَّ بَعْدَ مَا هَاجَرَ حَجَّةً وَاحِدَةً حَجَّةَ الْوَدَاعِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ وَبِمَكَّةَ أُخْرَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa zuhayrun, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala saaaltu zayda bna aarqama kam ghazawta ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala sab'a 'ashraaa ‏.‏ qaala wahaddathaniy zaydu bnu aarqama aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghazaa tis'a 'ashraaa waaannahu hajja ba'da maa haajara hajjaaan waahidaaan hajjaaa alwadaa'i ‏.‏ qaala aabuw iishaaqa wabimakkaaa aukhraa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu lshaq said:I asked Zaid b. Arqam: In how many military expeditions have you participated with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said: In seventeen (expeditions). He (Abu Ishaq) said: Zaid b. Arqam reported to me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had led nineteen expeditions. And he performed Hajj only once after Migration, and that was the Farewell Pilgrimage. Abu Ishaq also said: The second (Hajj) he performed at Mecca (before his Migration to Medina)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ الْبُرْسَانِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءً، يُخْبِرُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَنَا وَابْنُ، عُمَرَ مُسْتَنِدَيْنِ إِلَى حُجْرَةِ عَائِشَةَ وَإِنَّا لَنَسْمَعُ ضَرْبَهَا بِالسِّوَاكِ تَسْتَنُّ - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَعْتَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَجَبٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ أَىْ أُمَّتَاهُ أَلاَ تَسْمَعِينَ مَا يَقُولُ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَتْ وَمَا يَقُولُ قُلْتُ يَقُولُ اعْتَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَجَبٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ لَعَمْرِي مَا اعْتَمَرَ فِي رَجَبٍ وَمَا اعْتَمَرَ مِنْ عُمْرَةٍ إِلاَّ وَإِنَّهُ لَمَعَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَابْنُ عُمَرَ يَسْمَعُ فَمَا قَالَ لاَ وَلاَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ سَكَتَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin albursaaniyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala sami'tu 'ataa'an, yukhbiru qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, qaala kuntu aanaa waabnu, 'umara mustanidayni iilaa hujraai 'aaiishaaa waiinnaa lanasma'u darbahaa bialssiwaaki tastannu - qaala - faqultu yaa aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani aa'tamara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy rajabin qaala na'am ‏.‏ faqultu li'aaiishaaa aaa aummataahu aalaa tasma'iyna maa yaquwlu aabuw 'abdi alrrahmani qaalat wamaa yaquwlu qultu yaquwlu a'tamara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy rajabin ‏.‏ faqaalat yaghfiru alllahu laabiy 'abdi alrrahmani la'amriy maa a'tamara fiy rajabin wamaa a'tamara min 'umraain iilaaa waiinnahu lama'ahu ‏.‏ qaala waabnu 'umara yasma'u famaa qaala laa walaa na'am ‏.‏ sakata ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ataa reported that 'Urwa b. Zubair (Allah be pleased with him) had informed him (this):I and Ibn 'Umar were reclining against the (wall) of the apartment of A'isha and we were listening to the sound produced by the brushing of her teeth. I said Abu Abd al-Rahman (the kunya of 'Abdullah b. Umar), did Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) perform 'Umra in the month of Rijab? He said: Yes. I said to 'A'isha: Mother, are you listening to what Abu Abd al-Rabman is saying? She said: What is he Saying? I said: He is saying that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) performed 'Umra during the month of Rajab, whereupon she said: May Allah grant pardon to Abu Abd al-Rahman I By my life he (the Holy Prophet) did not perform 'Umra during the month of Rajab. And never was there an Umra performed by him (the Holy Prophet) in which he ('Abdullah b. 'Umar) did not join him. Ibn 'Umar heard this and said nothing to affirm It or to deny it, but kept quiet
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
