verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الأُمَوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالاَ، جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ غَدَوْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ مِنًى إِلَى عَرَفَاتٍ مِنَّا الْمُلَبِّي وَمِنَّا الْمُكَبِّرُ ‏. ‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu hanbalin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, h wahaddathanaa sa'iydu bnu yahyaa alaumawiyyu, haddathaniy aabiy qaalaa, jamiy'ana haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, aabiy salamaaa 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an aabiyhi, qaala ghadawnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min minana iilaa 'arafaatin minnaa almulabbiy waminnaa almukabbiru ‏. ‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them). He said:As we proceeded in the morning along with AUbs Messenger (ﷺ) from Mina to 'Arafat, some of us prounced Talbiya, and some pronounced Takbir (Allah-o-Akbar)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَيَعْقُوبُ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، قَالُوا أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَدَاةِ عَرَفَةَ فَمِنَّا الْمُكَبِّرُ وَمِنَّا الْمُهَلِّلُ فَأَمَّا نَحْنُ فَنُكَبِّرُ قَالَ قُلْتُ وَاللَّهِ لَعَجَبًا مِنْكُمْ كَيْفَ لَمْ تَقُولُوا لَهُ مَاذَا رَأَيْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصْنَعُ
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, wahaaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, waya'quwbu alddawraqiyyu, qaaluwa aakhbaranaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy salamaaa, 'an 'umara bni husaynin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, aabiy salamaaa 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghadaaai 'arafaaa faminnaa almukabbiru waminnaa almuhallilu faaammaa nahnu fanukabbiru qaala qultu waalllahi la'ajabana minkum kayfa lam taquwluwa lahu maadhaa raaayta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasna'u
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them):We were along with Allah's Messenger (way peace he upon him) in the morning of 'Arafa (9th of Dhu'l-Hijja). Some of us pronounced Takbir and some of us Tahlil La ilaha ill-Allah). And to those of us who pronounced Takbir, I said: By Allah, how strange it is that you did not care to ask him: What did you see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) doing (on this occasion)?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الثَّقَفِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ وَهُمَا غَادِيَانِ مِنْ مِنًى إِلَى عَرَفَةَ كَيْفَ كُنْتُمْ تَصْنَعُونَ فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ كَانَ يُهِلُّ الْمُهِلُّ مِنَّا فَلاَ يُنْكَرُ عَلَيْهِ وَيُكَبِّرُ الْمُكَبِّرُ مِنَّا فَلاَ يُنْكَرُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an muhammadi bni aabiy bakrin althhaqafiyyi, aannahu saaala aanasa bna maalikin wahumaa ghaadiyaani min minana iilaa 'arafaaa kayfa kuntum tasna'uwna fiy hadhaa alyawmi ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala kaana yuhillu almuhillu minnaa falaa yunkaru 'alayhi wayukabbiru almukabbiru minnaa falaa yunkaru 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. Abu Bakr al-Thaqafi asked Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him), while on their way from Mina to 'Arafa in the morning:What did you do on this day in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Thereupon he said: One of us pronounced Tahlil, and he met with no disapproval, and one of us pronounced Takbir, and he also met with no disapproval
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ غَدَاةَ عَرَفَةَ مَا تَقُولُ فِي التَّلْبِيَةِ هَذَا الْيَوْمَ قَالَ سِرْتُ هَذَا الْمَسِيرَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابِهِ فَمِنَّا الْمُكَبِّرُ وَمِنَّا الْمُهَلِّلُ وَلاَ يَعِيبُ أَحَدُنَا عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy surayju bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu rajaa'in, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, haddathaniy muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin, qaala qultu laanasi bni maalikin ghadaaaa 'arafaaa maa taquwlu fiy alttalbiyaai hadhaa alyawma qaala sirtu hadhaa almasiyra ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaashaabihi faminnaa almukabbiru waminnaa almuhallilu walaa ya'iybu aahadunaa 'alaa saahibihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. Abu Bakr reported:I said to Anas b. Malik in the morning of 'Arafa: What do you say as to pronouncing Talbiya on this day? He said: I travelled with Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) and his Companions in this journey. Some of us pronounced Takbir and some of us pronounced Tahlil, and none of us found fault with his companion
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ دَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ عَرَفَةَ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بِالشِّعْبِ نَزَلَ فَبَالَ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وَلَمْ يُسْبِغِ الْوُضُوءَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ الصَّلاَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الصَّلاَةُ أَمَامَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَكِبَ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ الْمُزْدَلِفَةَ نَزَلَ فَتَوَضَّأَ فَأَسْبَغَ الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَصَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ ثُمَّ أَنَاخَ كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ بَعِيرَهُ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ ثُمَّ أُقِيمَتِ الْعِشَاءُ فَصَلاَّهَا وَلَمْ يُصَلِّ بَيْنَهُمَا شَيْئًا
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, aannahu sami'ahu yaquwlu dafa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min 'arafaaa hattaa iidhaa kaana bialshhi'bi nazala fabaala thumma tawaddaaa walam yusbighi alwuduw'a faqultu lahu alssalaaaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ alssalaaau aamaamaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ farakiba falammaa jaa'a almuzdalifaaa nazala fatawaddaaa faaasbagha alwuduw'a thumma auqiymati alssalaaau fasallaa almaghriba thumma aanaakha kullu iinsaanin ba'iyrahu fiy manzilihi thumma auqiymati al'ishaa'u fasalaaahaa walam yusalli baynahumaa shayiana
verses.translation: Kuraib, the freed slave of Ibn Abbas, narrated from Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) that he had heard him saying:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) proceeded from 'Arafa, and as he approached the creek of a hill, he got down (from his camel) and urinated, and then performed a light ablution. I said to him: Prayer, whereupon he said: The prayer awaits you (at Muzdalifa). So he rode again, and as he came to Muzdalifa, he got down and performed ablution well. Then Iqima was pronounced for prayer, and he 'observed the sunset prayer. Then every person made his camel kneel down there, and then Iqama was pronounced for 'Isha' prayer and he observed it, and he (the Holy Prophet) did not observe any prayer (either Sunan or Nawifil) in between them (He observed the Fard of sunset and 'Isha' prayers successively)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، مَوْلَى الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ انْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ الدَّفْعَةِ مِنْ عَرَفَاتٍ إِلَى بَعْضِ تِلْكَ الشِّعَابِ لِحَاجَتِهِ فَصَبَبْتُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَاءِ فَقُلْتُ أَتُصَلِّي فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمُصَلَّى أَمَامَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, mawlaa alzzubayri 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, qaala ansarafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da alddaf'aai min 'arafaatin iilaa ba'di tilka alshhi'aabi lihaajatihi fasababtu 'alayhi mina almaa'i faqultu aatusalliy faqaala ‏ "‏ almusallaa aamaamaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on his way back from 'Arafat got down in one of these creeks (to answer the call of nature), and after he had done that I poured water (over his hands) and said: Are you going to pray? Thereupon he said: The place of prayer is ahead of you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ، يَقُولُ أَفَاضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ عَرَفَاتٍ فَلَمَّا انْتَهَى إِلَى الشِّعْبِ نَزَلَ فَبَالَ - وَلَمْ يَقُلْ أُسَامَةُ أَرَاقَ الْمَاءَ - قَالَ فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءًا لَيْسَ بِالْبَالِغِ - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الصَّلاَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الصَّلاَةُ أَمَامَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ سَارَ حَتَّى بَلَغَ جَمْعًا فَصَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu almubaaraki, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa abnu almubaaraki, 'an iibraahiyma bni 'uqbaaa, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin qaala sami'tu ausaamaaa bna zaydin, yaquwlu aafaada rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min 'arafaatin falammaa antahaa iilaa alshhi'bi nazala fabaala - walam yaqul ausaamaau aaraaqa almaa'a - qaala fada'aa bimaa'in fatawaddaaa wuduw'ana laysa bialbaalighi - qaala - faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi alssalaaaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ alssalaaau aamaamaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma saara hattaa balagha jam'ana fasallaa almaghriba waal'ishaa'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) narrated:AHah's Messenger (ﷺ) was on his way back from 'Arafat and as he reached the creek (of a hillock) he got down and urinated (Usama did not say that he poured water), but said: He (the Holy Prophet) called for water and performed ablution, but it was not a thorough one. I said: Messenger of Allah, the prayer! Thereupon he said: Prayer awaits you ahead (at Muzdalifa). He then proceeded, until he reached Muzdalifa and observed sunset and 'Isha' prayers (together) there
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي كُرَيْبٌ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ كَيْفَ صَنَعْتُمْ حِينَ رَدِفْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَشِيَّةَ عَرَفَةَ فَقَالَ جِئْنَا الشِّعْبَ الَّذِي يُنِيخُ النَّاسُ فِيهِ لِلْمَغْرِبِ فَأَنَاخَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَاقَتَهُ وَبَالَ - وَمَا قَالَ أَهَرَاقَ الْمَاءَ - ثُمَّ دَعَا بِالْوَضُوءِ فَتَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءًا لَيْسَ بِالْبَالِغِ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الصَّلاَةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ الصَّلاَةُ أَمَامَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَكِبَ حَتَّى جِئْنَا الْمُزْدَلِفَةَ فَأَقَامَ الْمَغْرِبَ ثُمَّ أَنَاخَ النَّاسُ فِي مَنَازِلِهِمْ وَلَمْ يَحُلُّوا حَتَّى أَقَامَ الْعِشَاءَ الآخِرَةَ فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ حَلُّوا قُلْتُ فَكَيْفَ فَعَلْتُمْ حِينَ أَصْبَحْتُمْ قَالَ رَدِفَهُ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَانْطَلَقْتُ أَنَا فِي سُبَّاقِ قُرَيْشٍ عَلَى رِجْلَىَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa zuhayrun aabuw khaythamaaa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu 'uqbaaa, aakhbaraniy kuraybun, aannahu saaala ausaamaaa bna zaydin kayfa sana'tum hiyna radifta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ashiyyaaa 'arafaaa faqaala jiinaa alshhi'ba alladhiy yuniykhu alnnaasu fiyhi lilmaghribi faaanaakha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm naaqatahu wabaala - wamaa qaala aaharaaqa almaa'a - thumma da'aa bialwaduw'i fatawaddaaa wuduw'ana laysa bialbaalighi faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi alssalaaaa ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ alssalaaau aamaamaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ farakiba hattaa jiinaa almuzdalifaaa faaaqaama almaghriba thumma aanaakha alnnaasu fiy manaazilihim walam yahulluwa hattaa aaqaama al'ishaa'a alakhiraaa fasallaa thumma halluwa qultu fakayfa fa'altum hiyna aasbahtum qaala radifahu alfadlu bnu 'abbaasin waantalaqtu aanaa fiy subbaaqi qurayshin 'alaa rijlaaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Kuraib reported that he asked Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) What did you do in the evening of 'Arafa as you rode behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said:We came to a valley where people generally halted their (camels) for the sunset prayer. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) halted his camel and urinated (and he did not say that he had poured water). He then called for water and performed light ablution. I said: Messenger of Allah, the prayer! Thereupon he said: Prayer awaits you (at Muzdalifa). and he rode on until we came to Muzdalifa. Then he offered the sunset prayer. and the people halted their camels at their places, and did not untie them until Iqama was pronounced for the 'Isha' prayer and he observed the prayer, and then they untied (their camels). I said: What did you do in the morning? He said: Al-Fadl b. Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) sat behind him (the Holy Prophet) in the morning, whereas I proceeded on foot with the Quraish who had gone ahead
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا أَتَى النَّقْبَ الَّذِي يَنْزِلُهُ الأُمَرَاءُ نَزَلَ فَبَالَ - وَلَمْ يَقُلْ أَهْرَاقَ - ثُمَّ دَعَا بِوَضُوءٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءًا خَفِيفًا فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الصَّلاَةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ الصَّلاَةُ أَمَامَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an muhammadi bni 'uqbaaa, 'an kuraybin, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lammaa aataa alnnaqba alladhiy yanziluhu alaumaraa'u nazala fabaala - walam yaqul aahraaqa - thumma da'aa biwaduw'in fatawaddaaa wuduw'ana khafiyfana faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi alssalaaaa ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ alssalaaau aamaamaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) reported that when Allah's Messenger (may peace jbe upod him) came to the valley where the rich (people of Mecca) used to get down. he got down. and urinated (and he did not mention about pouring water) ; he then called for water and performed a light ablution. I said:Messenger of Allah, the prayer I Thereupon he said: Prayer awaits you ahead
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، مَوْلَى سِبَاعٍ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ رَدِيفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ أَفَاضَ مِنْ عَرَفَةَ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ الشِّعْبَ أَنَاخَ رَاحِلَتَهُ ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَى الْغَائِطِ فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ صَبَبْتُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الإِدَاوَةِ فَتَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ رَكِبَ ثُمَّ أَتَى الْمُزْدَلِفَةَ فَجَمَعَ بِهَا بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ataa'in, mawlaa sibaa'in 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, aannahu kaana radiyfa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna aafaada min 'arafaaa falammaa jaa'a alshhi'ba aanaakha raahilatahu thumma dhahaba iilaa alghaaiiti falammaa raja'a sababtu 'alayhi mina aliidaawaai fatawaddaaa thumma rakiba thumma aataa almuzdalifaaa fajama'a bihaa bayna almaghribi waal'ishaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) reported that he sat behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on his ride as he came back from 'Arafa. And as he came to the valley, he halted his camel, and then went to the wilderness (to urinate). And when he came back, I poured water on him from the jug and he performed ablution, and then rode on until he came to Muzdalifa and there he combined the sunset and 'Isha' prayers
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَفَاضَ مِنْ عَرَفَةَ وَأُسَامَةُ رِدْفُهُ قَالَ أُسَامَةُ فَمَازَالَ يَسِيرُ عَلَى هَيْئَتِهِ حَتَّى أَتَى جَمْعًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa 'abdu almaliki bnu aabiy sulaymaana, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aafaada min 'arafaaa waausaamaau ridfuhu qaala ausaamaau famaazaala yasiyru 'alaa hayiatihi hattaa aataa jam'ana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon, him) came back from 'Arafa and Usama (Allah be pleased with him) was seated behind him. Usama said that he (the Holy Prophet) continued the journey in this very state until he came to Muzdalifa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، - قَالَ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سُئِلَ أُسَامَةُ وَأَنَا شَاهِدٌ، أَوْ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْدَفَهُ مِنْ عَرَفَاتٍ قُلْتُ كَيْفَ كَانَ يَسِيرُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ أَفَاضَ مِنْ عَرَفَةَ قَالَ كَانَ يَسِيرُ الْعَنَقَ فَإِذَا وَجَدَ فَجْوَةً نَصَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, jamiy'ana 'an hammaadi bni zaydin, - qaala aabuw alrrabiy'i haddathanaa hammaadun, - haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, qaala suiila ausaamaau waaanaa shaahidun, aaw qaala saaaltu ausaamaaa bna zaydin wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aardafahu min 'arafaatin qultu kayfa kaana yasiyru rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna aafaada min 'arafaaa qaala kaana yasiyru al'anaqa faiidhaa wajada fajwaaan nassa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hisham (Allah be pleased with him) reported from his father:Usama (Allah be pleased with him) was asked in my presence or I asked Usama b. Zaid andhe rode behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he came back from 'Arafat. I said (to him): How did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) journey as he came back from 'Arafat? Thereupon he said: He made it (his riding camel) walk at a slow speed, and when he found an open space, he made it walk briskly
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَحُمَيْدُ، بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ حُمَيْدٍ قَالَ هِشَامٌ وَالنَّصُّ فَوْقَ الْعَنَقِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, wa'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, wahumaydu, bnu 'abdi alrrahmani 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wazaada fiy hadiythi humaydin qaala hishaamun waalnnassu fawqa al'anaqi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Urwa with the same chain of transmitters. and in the hadith narrated by Humaid there is an addition (of these words):" Hisham said: Al-nass (speed of camel) is faster than al-'anaq
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimi bni, 'abdi alllahi 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa almaghriba waal'ishaa'a bialmuzdalifaai jamiy'ana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed the sunset and 'Isha' prayers together at Muzdalifa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ قَالَ جَمَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ بِجَمْعٍ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُمَا سَجْدَةٌ وَصَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ ثَلاَثَ رَكَعَاتٍ وَصَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏ فَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يُصَلِّي بِجَمْعٍ كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى لَحِقَ بِاللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aannaaakhbarahu aanna aabaahu qaala jama'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna almaghribi waal'ishaa'i bijam'in laysa baynahumaa sajdaaun wasallaa almaghriba thalaatha raka'aatin wasallaa al'ishaa'a rak'atayni ‏.‏ fakaana 'abdu alllahi yusalliy bijam'in kadhalika hattaa lahiqa bialllahi ta'aalaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubaidullah b. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) combined the sunset and 'Isha', prayers at Muzdalifa and there was no prostration (i. e. any rak'ahs of Sunan or Nawafil prayers) in between them. He observed three rak'ahs of the sunset prayer and two rak'ahs of the 'Isha' prayer, and 'Abdullah (b. 'Umar) observed the prayers in this very manner (at Muzdalifa) until he met his Lord
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، وَسَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، أَنَّهُ صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ بِجَمْعٍ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِإِقَامَةٍ ثُمَّ حَدَّثَ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّهُ صَلَّى مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ وَحَدَّثَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَنَعَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, wasalamaaa bni kuhaylin 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, aannahu sallaa almaghriba bijam'in waal'ishaa'a biiiqaamaain thumma haddatha 'ani abni 'umara aannahu sallaa mithla dhalika wahaddatha abnu 'umara aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sana'a mithla dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that he observed the sunset and 'Isha' prayers at Muzdalifa with (one) iqama. He narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) that he observed prayers like this and Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) narrated that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did like this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ صَلاَّهُمَا بِإِقَامَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala salaaahumaa biiiqaamaain waahidaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Shu'ba reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters and said:He (the Holy Prophet) observed the two prayers (together) with one iqama
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا الثَّوْرِيُّ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ جَمَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ بِجَمْعٍ صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ ثَلاَثًا وَالْعِشَاءَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ بِإِقَامَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa althhawriyyu, 'an salamaaa bni kuhaylin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala jama'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna almaghribi waal'ishaa'i bijam'in sallaa almaghriba thalaathana waal'ishaa'a rak'atayni biiiqaamaain waahidaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar rep rte that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) combined the sunset and 'Isha ' prayers at Muzdalifa. He observed three rak'ahs of the sunset prayer and two rak'ahs of the 'Isha' prayer with one Iqama
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي، خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ قَالَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ أَفَضْنَا مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ حَتَّى أَتَيْنَا جَمْعًا فَصَلَّى بِنَا الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِإِقَامَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَقَالَ هَكَذَا صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي هَذَا الْمَكَانِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu aabiy, khaalidin 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala qaala sa'iydu bnu jubayrin aafadnaa ma'a abni 'umara hattaa aataynaa jam'ana fasallaa binaa almaghriba waal'ishaa'a biiiqaamaain waahidaain thumma ansarafa faqaala hakadhaa sallaa binaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hadhaa almakaani ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported:We came back along with Ibn 'Umar till we reached Muzdalifa. There he led us in the sunset and 'Isha' prayers with one iqama and we then proceeded and he said: This is how Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in prayer at this place
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، - عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى صَلاَةً إِلاَّ لِمِيقَاتِهَا إِلاَّ صَلاَتَيْنِ صَلاَةَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ بِجَمْعٍ وَصَلَّى الْفَجْرَ يَوْمَئِذٍ قَبْلَ مِيقَاتِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waaabuw kuraybin jamiy'ana 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, - 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'umaaraaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala maa raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa salaaaan iilaaa limiyqaatihaa iilaaa salaatayni salaaaa almaghribi waal'ishaa'i bijam'in wasallaa alfajra yawmaiidhin qabla miyqaatihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'bdullah (b. 'Umar) reported:I have never seen Allah's Messenger, (ﷺ) but observing the prayers at their appointed times except two prayers, sunset and 'Isha, ' at Muzdalifa (where he deferred the sunset prayer to combine it with 'Isha' and he observed the dawn prayer before its stipulated time on that day (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ قَبْلَ وَقْتِهَا بِغَلَسٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'an jariyrin, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala qabla waqtihaa bighalasin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted by Al-A`mash with a slight variation of words, i.e. he said before its time when it was still dark
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَفْلَحُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حُمَيْدٍ - عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتِ اسْتَأْذَنَتْ سَوْدَةُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةَ الْمُزْدَلِفَةِ تَدْفَعُ قَبْلَهُ وَقَبْلَ حَطْمَةِ النَّاسِ وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَةً ثَبِطَةً - يَقُولُ الْقَاسِمُ وَالثَّبِطَةُ الثَّقِيلَةُ - قَالَ فَأَذِنَ لَهَا فَخَرَجَتْ قَبْلَ دَفْعِهِ وَحَبَسَنَا حَتَّى أَصْبَحْنَا فَدَفَعْنَا بِدَفْعِهِ وَلأَنْ أَكُونَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَمَا اسْتَأْذَنَتْهُ سَوْدَةُ فَأَكُونَ أَدْفَعُ بِإِذْنِهِ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ مَفْرُوحٍ بِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa aaflahu, - ya'niy abna humaydin - 'ani alqaasimi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalati astaadhanat sawdaau rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laylaaa almuzdalifaai tadfa'u qablahu waqabla hatmaai alnnaasi wakaanati amraaaaan thabitaaan - yaquwlu alqaasimu waalthhabitaau althhaqiylaau - qaala faaadhina lahaa fakharajat qabla daf'ihi wahabasanaa hattaa aasbahnaa fadafa'naa bidaf'ihi walaan aakuwna astaadhantu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kamaa astaadhanathu sawdaau faaakuwna aadfa'u biiidhnihi aahabbu iilaaaa min mafruwhin bihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:Sauda (the wife of the Holy Prophet) who was bulky sought the permission of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the night of Muzdalifa to move from (that place) ahead of him and before the multitude (set forth). He (Allah's Apostle) gave her the permission. So she set forth before his (Holy Prophet's) departure. But we stayed there until it was dawn and we moved on, when he departed. And if I were to seek the permission of Allah's Messenger. (ﷺ) as Sauda had sought permission, I could have also gone with his permission and it would have been better for me than that for which I was happy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الثَّقَفِيِّ، - قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَتْ سَوْدَةُ امْرَأَةً ضَخْمَةً ثَبِطَةً فَاسْتَأْذَنَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تُفِيضَ مِنْ جَمْعٍ بِلَيْلٍ فَأَذِنَ لَهَا فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَلَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَمَا اسْتَأْذَنَتْهُ سَوْدَةُ وَكَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ لاَ تُفِيضُ إِلاَّ مَعَ الإِمَامِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, jamiy'ana 'ani althhaqafiyyi, - qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, - haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'ani alqaasimi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaanat sawdaau amraaaaan dakhmaaan thabitaaan faastaadhanat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan tufiyda min jam'in bilaylin faaadhina lahaa faqaalat 'aaiishaau falaytaniy kuntu astaadhantu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kamaa astaadhanathu sawdaau wakaanat 'aaiishaau laa tufiydu iilaaa ma'a aliimaami ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that (hadrat) Sauda was a bulky lady, so she sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to proceed from Muzdalifa (to Mina) in the (latter part of the) night. He granted her permission. 'A'isha said:I wish I had also sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as Sauda had. sought permission from him. 'A'isha did not proceed but with the Imam
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ وَدِدْتُ أَنِّي كُنْتُ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَمَا اسْتَأْذَنَتْهُ سَوْدَةُ فَأُصَلِّي الصُّبْحَ بِمِنًى فَأَرْمِي الْجَمْرَةَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ النَّاسُ ‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لِعَائِشَةَ فَكَانَتْ سَوْدَةُ اسْتَأْذَنَتْهُ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ إِنَّهَا كَانَتِ امْرَأَةً ثَقِيلَةً ثَبِطَةً فَاسْتَأْذَنَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَذِنَ لَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'ani alqaasimi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat wadidtu aanniy kuntu astaadhantu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kamaa astaadhanathu sawdaau faausalliy alssubha biminana faaarmiy aljamraaa qabla aan yaatiya alnnaasu ‏.‏ faqiyla li'aaiishaaa fakaanat sawdaau astaadhanathu qaalat na'am iinnahaa kaanati amraaaaan thaqiylaaan thabitaaan faastaadhanat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaadhina lahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha said:I wish I had sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as Sauda had sought, and observed the dawn prayer at Mina and stoned at al-Jamra before the people had come there. It was said to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her): Did Sauda seek permission from him (the Holy Prophet)? She said: Yes. She was a bulky lady and so she sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (to proceed to mina from Muzdalifa ahead of him), and he granted her permission
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, kilaahumaa 'an sufyaana, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Qasim with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، مَوْلَى أَسْمَاءَ قَالَ قَالَتْ لِي أَسْمَاءُ وَهْىَ عِنْدَ دَارِ الْمُزْدَلِفَةِ هَلْ غَابَ الْقَمَرُ قُلْتُ لاَ ‏.‏ فَصَلَّتْ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ قَالَتْ يَا بُنَىَّ هَلْ غَابَ الْقَمَرُ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَتِ ارْحَلْ بِي ‏.‏ فَارْتَحَلْنَا حَتَّى رَمَتِ الْجَمْرَةَ ثُمَّ صَلَّتْ فِي مَنْزِلِهَا فَقُلْتُ لَهَا أَىْ هَنْتَاهْ لَقَدْ غَلَّسْنَا ‏.‏ قَالَتْ كَلاَّ أَىْ بُنَىَّ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَذِنَ لِلظُّعُنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'ani abni jurayjin, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi, mawlaa aasmaa'a qaala qaalat liy aasmaa'u wahaa 'inda daari almuzdalifaai hal ghaaba alqamaru qultu laa ‏.‏ fasallat saa'aaan thumma qaalat yaa bunaaaa hal ghaaba alqamaru qultu na'am ‏.‏ qaalati arhal biy ‏.‏ faartahalnaa hattaa ramati aljamraaa thumma sallat fiy manzilihaa faqultu lahaa aaa hantaah laqad ghallasnaa ‏.‏ qaalat kalaaa aaa bunaaaa iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aadhina lilzzu'uni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah, the freed slave of (Hadrat) Asma', reported:Asma' (Allah be pleased with her), as she was in the house at Muzdalifa, asked me whether the moon had set. I said: No. She prayed for some time, and again said: My son has the moon set? I said: Yes. And she said: Set forth along with me, and so we set forth until (we reached Mini) and the stoned at al-Jamra. She then prayed in her place. I said to her: Respected lady, we set forth (in the very early part of dawn) when it was dark, whereupon she said: My son, there is no harm in it; Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had granted permission to women
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي رِوَايَتِهِ قَالَتْ لاَ أَىْ بُنَىَّ إِنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَذِنَ لِظُعُنِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, 'ani abni jurayjin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wafiy riwaayatihi qaalat laa aaa bunaaaa iinna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aadhina lizu'unihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Juraij with the same chain of transmitters, and In his narration (the words are):" She (Asma') said: My son, Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) granted permission to women
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شَوَّالٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، دَخَلَ عَلَى أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ فَأَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ بِهَا مِنْ جَمْعٍ بِلَيْلٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, h wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, jamiy'ana 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, aanna abna shawwaalin, aakhbarahu aannahu, dakhala 'alaa aummi habiybaaa faaakhbarathu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha bihaa min jam'in bilaylin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Shawwal (the freed slave of Umm Habiba) reported that he went to Umm Habiba (the wife of Allah's Apostle) who informed him that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) sent her from Muzdalifa during the night
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ شَوَّالٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ، حَبِيبَةَ قَالَتْ كُنَّا نَفْعَلُهُ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نُغَلِّسُ مِنْ جَمْعٍ إِلَى مِنًى ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ النَّاقِدِ نُغَلِّسُ مِنْ مُزْدَلِفَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu diynaarin, h wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an saalimi bni shawwaalin, 'an aummi, habiybaaa qaalat kunnaa naf'aluhu 'alaa 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm nughallisu min jam'in iilaa minana ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai alnnaaqidi nughallisu min muzdalifaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated from Umm Habiba:We used to set forth from Muzdalifa to Mina, (very early in the dawn) when it was dark. And in the narration of Naqid (the words are):" We set from Muzdalifa in the darkness (of the dawn)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الثَّقَلِ - أَوْ قَالَ فِي الضَّعَفَةِ - مِنْ جَمْعٍ بِلَيْلٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, jamiy'ana 'an hammaadin, - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy yaziyda, qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu ba'athaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy althhaqali - aaw qaala fiy aldda'afaai - min jam'in bilaylin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me from Muzdalifa ahead (of the caravan) along with the luggage or with the weak ones during (the latter part of the) night
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي، يَزِيدَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ أَنَا مِمَّنْ، قَدَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ضَعَفَةِ أَهْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu aabiy, yaziyda aannahu sami'a abna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu aanaa mimman, qaddama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy da'afaai aahlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported:I was among those (i. e. women and children) whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent forth with the weak members of his family
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ فِيمَنْ قَدَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ضَعَفَةِ أَهْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, haddathanaa 'amrunw, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala kuntu fiyman qaddama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy da'afaai aahlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted by Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَ بِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِسَحَرٍ مِنْ جَمْعٍ فِي ثَقَلِ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَبَلَغَكَ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ بَعَثَ بِي بِلَيْلٍ طَوِيلٍ قَالَ لاَ إِلاَّ كَذَلِكَ بِسَحَرٍ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَهُ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ رَمَيْنَا الْجَمْرَةَ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ ‏.‏ وَأَيْنَ صَلَّى الْفَجْرَ قَالَ لاَ إِلاَّ كَذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, aanna abna 'abbaasin, qaala ba'atha biy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bisaharin min jam'in fiy thaqali nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qultu aabalaghaka aanna abna 'abbaasin qaala ba'atha biy bilaylin tawiylin qaala laa iilaaa kadhalika bisaharin ‏.‏ qultu lahu faqaala abnu 'abbaasin ramaynaa aljamraaa qabla alfajri ‏.‏ waaayna sallaa alfajra qaala laa iilaaa kadhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ata' reported from Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me from Muzdalifa along with his luggage (in the very early part of @he dawn). I (Ibn Juraij, one of the narrators) said (to 'Ati'): Has this (news) reached you that Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) had said:" He (Allah's Messenger) had sent me in the latter part of the night"? Thereupon he said: No, it was the dawn. I (again) said to him: (Did you hear) Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) having said this (too):" We stoned al-Jamra before the dawn prayer"? So where did he observe the dawn prayer? He said: No. But he said only so much (as described above)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ كَانَ يُقَدِّمُ ضَعَفَةَ أَهْلِهِ فَيَقِفُونَ عِنْدَ الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ بِاللَّيْلِ فَيَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ مَا بَدَا لَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَدْفَعُونَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقِفَ الإِمَامُ وَقَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْفَعَ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقْدَمُ مِنًى لِصَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقْدَمُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَإِذَا قَدِمُوا رَمَوُا الْجَمْرَةَ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ أَرْخَصَ فِي أُولَئِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna saalima bna 'abdi alllahi, aakhbarahu aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara kaana yuqaddimu da'afaaa aahlihi fayaqifuwna 'inda almash'ari alharaami bialmuzdalifaai bialllayli fayadhkuruwna alllaha maa badaa lahum thumma yadfa'uwna qabla aan yaqifa aliimaamu waqabla aan yadfa'a faminhum man yaqdamu minana lisalaaai alfajri waminhum man yaqdamu ba'da dhalika faiidhaa qadimuwa ramawua aljamraaa wakaana abnu 'umara yaquwlu aarkhasa fiy auwlaiika rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim b. 'Abdullah reported that 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) used to send ahead of him the weak members of his household to stay during the night at Mash'ar al-Haram at Muzdalifa. They remembered Allah so long as they could afford, and then they proceeded before the stay of the Imam, and before his return. So some of them reached Mina for the dawn prayer and some of them reached there after that; and as they reached there, they stoned al-Jamra; and Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) used to say:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has granted this concession to them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ رَمَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ جَمْرَةَ الْعَقَبَةِ مِنْ بَطْنِ الْوَادِي بِسَبْعِ حَصَيَاتٍ يُكَبِّرُ مَعَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّ أُنَاسًا يَرْمُونَهَا مِنْ فَوْقِهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ هَذَا وَالَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُهُ مَقَامُ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَيْهِ سُورَةُ الْبَقَرَةِ
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda, qaala ramaa 'abdu alllahi bnu mas'uwdin jamraaa al'aqabaai min batni alwaadiy bisab'i hasayaatin yukabbiru ma'a kulli hasaaain ‏.‏ qaala faqiyla lahu iinna aunaasana yarmuwnahaa min fawqihaa ‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu mas'uwdin hadhaa waalladhiy laa iilaha ghayruhu maqaamu alladhiy aunzilat 'alayhi suwraau albaqaraai
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid reported that 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud (Allah be pleased with them) threw seven pebbles at Jamrat al-'Aqaba from the heart of the valley. He pronounced Takbir with every pebble. It was said to him that people fling stones from the upper side (of the valley), whereupon 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud (Allah he pleased with them) said:By him, besides Whom there is no other god, that is the place (of flinging stones) of one upon whom Surah al-Baqara was revealed (the Holy Prophet)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مِنْجَابُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَجَّاجَ بْنَ يُوسُفَ، يَقُولُ وَهُوَ يَخْطُبُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ أَلِّفُوا الْقُرْآنَ كَمَا أَلَّفَهُ جِبْرِيلُ السُّورَةُ الَّتِي يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا الْبَقَرَةُ وَالسُّورَةُ الَّتِي يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا النِّسَاءُ وَالسُّورَةُ الَّتِي يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا آلُ عِمْرَانَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَقِيتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِقَوْلِهِ فَسَبَّهُ وَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ فَأَتَى جَمْرَةَ الْعَقَبَةِ فَاسْتَبْطَنَ الْوَادِيَ فَاسْتَعْرَضَهَا فَرَمَاهَا مِنْ بَطْنِ الْوَادِي بِسَبْعِ حَصَيَاتٍ يُكَبِّرُ مَعَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنَّ النَّاسَ يَرْمُونَهَا مِنْ فَوْقِهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ هَذَا وَالَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُهُ مَقَامُ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَيْهِ سُورَةُ الْبَقَرَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa minjaabu bnu alhaarithi alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu mushirin, 'ani alaa'mashi, qaala sami'tu alhajjaaja bna yuwsufa, yaquwlu wahuwa yakhtubu 'alaa alminbari aallifuwa alqurana kamaa aallafahu jibriylu alssuwraau allatiy yudhkaru fiyhaa albaqaraau waalssuwraau allatiy yudhkaru fiyhaa alnnisaa'u waalssuwraau allatiy yudhkaru fiyhaa alu 'imraana ‏.‏ qaala falaqiytu iibraahiyma faaakhbartuhu biqawlihi fasabbahu waqaala haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu yaziyda aannahu kaana ma'a 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin faaataa jamraaa al'aqabaai faastabtana alwaadiya faasta'radahaa faramaahaa min batni alwaadiy bisab'i hasayaatin yukabbiru ma'a kulli hasaaain - qaala - faqultu yaa aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani iinna alnnaasa yarmuwnahaa min fawqihaa ‏.‏ faqaala hadhaa waalladhiy laa iilaha ghayruhu maqaamu alladhiy aunzilat 'alayhi suwraau albaqaraai ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'mash reported:I heard Hajjaj b. Yusuf saying as he was delivering sermon on the pulpit: Observe the order of the (Holy) Qur'an which has been observed by Gabriel. (Thus state the surahs in this manner)" one in which mention has been made of al-Baqara,"" one in which mention has been made of women (Surah al-Nisa')" and then the surah in which mention has been made of the Family of 'Imrin. He (the (narrator) said: I met Ibrahim and informed him about these words of his (the statement of Hajjaj b. Yusuf). He cursed him and said: Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid has narrated to me that when he was in the company of 'Abdullah b. Mas'udd (Allah be pleased with them) he came to Jamrat al-'Aqaba and then entered the heart of the valley and faced towards it (the Jamra) and then flung seven pebbles at it from the heart of the valley pronouncing Takbir with every pebble. I said: Abu 'Abd al-Rahman, people fling pebbles at it (Jamra) from the upper side, whereupon he said: By Him besides Whom there is no god, that is the place (of flinging pebbles of one) upon whom Surah al-Baqara was revealed;
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَجَّاجَ، يَقُولُ لاَ تَقُولُوا سُورَةُ الْبَقَرَةِ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّا الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ مُسْهِرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy ya'quwbu alddawraqiyyu, haddathanaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, kilaahumaa 'ani alaa'mashi, qaala sami'tu alhajjaaja, yaquwlu laa taquwluwa suwraau albaqaraai ‏.‏ waaqtassaa alhadiytha bimithli hadiythi abni mushirin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'mash reported:I heard Hajjaj saying I Do not say Surah al-Baqara. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ يَزِيدَ أَنَّهُ حَجَّ مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ فَرَمَى الْجَمْرَةَ بِسَبْعِ حَصَيَاتٍ وَجَعَلَ الْبَيْتَ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ وَمِنًى عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَقَالَ هَذَا مَقَامُ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَيْهِ سُورَةُ الْبَقَرَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, bni yaziyda aannahu hajja ma'a 'abdi alllahi qaala faramaa aljamraaa bisab'i hasayaatin waja'ala albayta 'an yasaarihi waminana 'an yamiynihi waqaala hadhaa maqaamu alladhiy aunzilat 'alayhi suwraau albaqaraai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid reported that he performed Hajj along with 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) and he flung seven pebbles at al-Jamra (from a position) that the House was on his left and Mina was on his right and said:That is the place (of flinging pebbles of one) upon whom Surah al-Baqara was revealed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَلَمَّا أَتَى جَمْرَةَ الْعَقَبَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aannahu qaala falammaa aataa jamraaa al'aqabaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith nas been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters except with this variation of (words):As he came to Jamrat al-'Aqaba
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُحَيَّاةِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَعْلَى أَبُو الْمُحَيَّاةِ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ قِيلَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ نَاسًا يَرْمُونَ الْجَمْرَةَ مِنْ فَوْقِ الْعَقَبَةِ - قَالَ - فَرَمَاهَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ مِنْ بَطْنِ الْوَادِي ثُمَّ قَالَ مِنْ هَا هُنَا وَالَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُهُ رَمَاهَا الَّذِي أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَيْهِ سُورَةُ الْبَقَرَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw almuhayyaaai, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu ya'laa aabuw almuhayyaaai, 'an salamaaa bni kuhaylin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, bni yaziyda qaala qiyla li'abdi alllahi iinna naasana yarmuwna aljamraaa min fawqi al'aqabaai - qaala - faramaahaa 'abdu alllahi min batni alwaadiy thumma qaala min haa hunaa waalladhiy laa iilaha ghayruhu ramaahaa alladhiy aunzilat 'alayhi suwraau albaqaraai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid reported:It was said to 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with bird) that people threw pebbles at the Jamra from the upper side of 'Aqaba, whereas he threw stones at it from the heart of the valley, whereupon he said: By Him besides Whom there is no god, it is at this very place that one upon whom was revealed Surah al-Baqara threw stones at it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ يُونُسَ، - قَالَ ابْنُ خَشْرَمٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، - عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرًا، يَقُولُ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْمِي عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لِتَأْخُذُوا مَنَاسِكَكُمْ فَإِنِّي لاَ أَدْرِي لَعَلِّي لاَ أَحُجُّ بَعْدَ حَجَّتِي هَذِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'aliyyu bnu khashramin, jamiy'ana 'an 'iysaa bni yuwnusa, - qaala abnu khashramin aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, - 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabirana, yaquwlu raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yarmiy 'alaa raahilatihi yawma alnnahri wayaquwlu ‏ "‏ litaakhudhuwa manaasikakum faiinniy laa aadriy la'alliy laa aahujju ba'da hajjatiy hadhihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported:I saw Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) flinging pebbles while riding his camel on the Day of Nahr, and he was saying: Learn your rituals (by seeing me performing them), for I do not know whether I would be performing Hajj after this Hajj of mine
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي، أُنَيْسَةَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ جَدَّتِهِ أُمِّ الْحُصَيْنِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُهَا تَقُولُ، حَجَجْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَجَّةَ الْوَدَاعِ فَرَأَيْتُهُ حِينَ رَمَى جَمْرَةَ الْعَقَبَةِ وَانْصَرَفَ وَهُوَ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ وَمَعَهُ بِلاَلٌ وَأُسَامَةُ أَحَدُهُمَا يَقُودُ بِهِ رَاحِلَتَهُ وَالآخَرُ رَافِعٌ ثَوْبَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الشَّمْسِ - قَالَتْ - فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَوْلاً كَثِيرًا ثُمَّ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنْ أُمِّرَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَبْدٌ مُجَدَّعٌ - حَسِبْتُهَا قَالَتْ - أَسْوَدُ يَقُودُكُمْ بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى فَاسْمَعُوا لَهُ وَأَطِيعُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, 'an zaydi bni aabiy, aunaysaaa 'an yahyaa bni husaynin, 'an jaddatihi aummi alhusayni, qaala sami'tuhaa taquwlu, hajajtu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hajjaaa alwadaa'i faraaaytuhu hiyna ramaa jamraaa al'aqabaai waansarafa wahuwa 'alaa raahilatihi wama'ahu bilaalun waausaamaau aahaduhumaa yaquwdu bihi raahilatahu waalakharu raafi'un thawbahu 'alaa raasi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alshhamsi - qaalat - faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qawlaan kathiyrana thumma sami'tuhu yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iin aummira 'alaykum 'abdun mujadda'un - hasibtuhaa qaalat - aaswadu yaquwdukum bikitaabi alllahi ta'aalaa faasma'uwa lahu waaatiy'uwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm al-Husain (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I performed Hajj along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage and saw him when he flung pebbles at Jamrat al-'Aqaba and returned while he was riding the camel, and Bilal and Usama were with him. One of them was leading his camel, while the other was raising his cloth over the head of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to protect him from the sun. She (further) said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said so many things, and I heard him saying: If a slave having some limb of his missing and having dark complexion is appointed to govern you according to the Book of Allah the Exalted. listen to him and obey him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ، بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، عَنْ أُمِّ الْحُصَيْنِ، جَدَّتِهِ قَالَتْ حَجَجْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَجَّةَ الْوَدَاعِ فَرَأَيْتُ أُسَامَةَ وَبِلاَلاً وَأَحَدُهُمَا آخِذٌ بِخِطَامِ نَاقَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالآخَرُ رَافِعٌ ثَوْبَهُ يَسْتُرُهُ مِنَ الْحَرِّ حَتَّى رَمَى جَمْرَةَ الْعَقَبَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ وَاسْمُ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ خَالِدُ بْنُ أَبِي يَزِيدَ وَهُوَ خَالُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ رَوَى عَنْهُ وَكِيعٌ وَحَجَّاجٌ الأَعْوَرُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aahmadu bnu hanbalin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu salamaaa, 'an aabiy 'abdi alrrahiymi, 'an zaydi, bni aabiy aunaysaaa 'an yahyaa bni alhusayni, 'an aummi alhusayni, jaddatihi qaalat hajajtu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hajjaaa alwadaa'i faraaaytu ausaamaaa wabilaalaan waaahaduhumaa akhidhun bikhitaami naaqaai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalakharu raafi'un thawbahu yasturuhu mina alharri hattaa ramaa jamraaa al'aqabaai ‏.‏ qaala muslimun waasmu aabiy 'abdi alrrahiymi khaalidu bnu aabiy yaziyda wahuwa khaalu muhammadi bni salamaaa rawaa 'anhu wakiy'un wahajjaajun alaa'waru ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm al-Husain (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I performed Hajj along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage and saw Usama and Bilal (too), one of whom had caught hold of the lose string of the she-camel of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) while the other one was raising his cloth (over his head) protecting him from the heat, till he flung pebbles at Jamrat al-'Aqaba
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَمَى الْجَمْرَةَ بِمِثْلِ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala abnu haatimin haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaranaa aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ramaa aljamraaa bimithli hasaa alkhadhfi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:I saw Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) throwing stones (at Jamrat al 'Aqaba) like pelting of small pebbles
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، وَابْنُ، إِدْرِيسَ عَنِ ابْنِ، جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ رَمَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْجَمْرَةَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ضُحًى وَأَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin alaahmaru, waabnu, iidriysa 'ani abni, jurayjin 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala ramaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aljamraaa yawma alnnahri duhana waaammaa ba'du faiidhaa zaalati alshhamsu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) flung pebbles at jamra on the Day of Nahr after sunrise, and after that (i. e. on the 11th, 12th and 13th of Dhu'l-Hijja when the sun had declined)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported a hadith like this from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْجَزَرِيُّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الاِسْتِجْمَارُ تَوٌّ وَرَمْىُ الْجِمَارِ تَوٌّ وَالسَّعْىُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ تَوٌّ وَالطَّوَافُ تَوٌّ وَإِذَا اسْتَجْمَرَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَسْتَجْمِرْ بِتَوٍّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, - wahuwa abnu 'ubaydi alllahi aljazariyyu - 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alaistijmaaru tawwun waramau aljimaari tawwun waalssa'au bayna alssafaa waalmarwaai tawwun waalttawaafu tawwun waiidhaa astajmara aahadukum falyastajmir bitawwin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (b. Abdullab) (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Odd number of stones are to be used for cleaning (the private parts after answering the call of nature), and casting of pebbles at the Jamras is to be done by odd numbers (seven), and (the number) of circuits between al-Safa' and al-Marwa is also odd (seven), and the number of circuits (around the Ka'ba) is also odd (seven). Whenever any one of you is required to use stones (for cleaning the private parts) he should use odd number of stones (three, five or seven)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحَلَقَ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ وَقَصَّرَ بَعْضُهُمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ - مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ ثُمَّ قَالَ - وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa laythun, 'an naafi'in, aanna 'abda alllahi, qaala halaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahalaqa taaiifaaun min aashaabihi waqassara ba'duhum ‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ rahima alllahu almuhalliqiyna - marraaan aaw marratayni thumma qaala - waalmuqassiriyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got his head shaved (after slaughtering the sacrificial animal on the 10th of Dhu'l-Hijja), and so did a group of Companions, while some of them got their hair clipped. Abdullah said:Allah's Messenger (may peace'be upon him) observed once or twice:" May Allah have mercy upon those who get their heads shaved." And he also said:" Upon those too who got their hair clipped
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمِ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمِ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma arhami almuhalliqiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa waalmuqassiriyna yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma arhami almuhalliqiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa waalmuqassiriyna yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ waalmuqassiriyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having observed:O Allah, have mercy upon those who get their heads shaved. They (the Companions) said: Messenger of Allah, (what about those) who have got their hair clipped? He said: O Allah, have mercy upon those who have got their heads shaved. They (again) said: Allah's Messenger, (what about those) who have got their hair clipped? Thereupon he said: (O Allah, have mercy upon those) who have got their hair clipped
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: aakhbaranaa aabuw iishaaqa, iibraahiymu bnu muhammadi bni sufyaana 'an muslimi bni alhajjaaji, qaala haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ rahima alllahu almuhalliqiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa waalmuqassiriyna yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ rahima alllahu almuhalliqiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa waalmuqassiriyna yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ rahima alllahu almuhalliqiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa waalmuqassiriyna yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ waalmuqassiriyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:May Allah have mercy upon those who have got their heads shaved. They said: Messenger of Allah, (what about) those who got their hair clipped? He said: May Allah have mercy upon those who have got their heads shaved. They said: Messenger of Allah, (what about those who have got their hair clipped)? He said: May Allah have mercy upon those who got their hair shaved. They said: Messenger of Allah, (what about) those who got their hair clipped? He said: (O Allah, have mercy upon) those who got their hair clipped
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ فَلَمَّا كَانَتِ الرَّابِعَةُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala fiy alhadiythi falammaa kaanati alrraabi'aau qaala ‏ "‏ waalmuqassiriyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubaidullah reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters and (it is said) that it was on the fourth turn that he (the Holy Prophet) said:(May Allah have mercy upon) those who got their hair clipped
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ فُضَيْلٍ، - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، - حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْمُحَلِّقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلِلْمُقَصِّرِينَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْمُحَلِّقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلِلْمُقَصِّرِينَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْمُحَلِّقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلِلْمُقَصِّرِينَ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلِلْمُقَصِّرِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu, numayrin waaabuw kuraybin jamiy'ana 'ani abni fudaylin, - qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, - haddathanaa 'umaaraau, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alllahumma aghfir lilmuhalliqiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi walilmuqassiriyna qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aghfir lilmuhalliqiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi walilmuqassiriyna qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aghfir lilmuhalliqiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi walilmuqassiriyna qaala ‏"‏ walilmuqassiriyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having said:O Allah, grant pardon to those who got their heads shaved. They (Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: Messenger of Allah, (what about those) who get their hair cut? He said: O Allah, grant pardon to those who get their heads shaved. They said: Messenger of Allah, (what about those) who got their hair clipped? He said: O Allah, grant pardon to those who get their heads shaved. They said: Messenger of Allah, (what about those) who get their hair clipped? He said: (O Allah, grant pardon to) those who get their hair clipped
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aumayyaau bnu bistaama, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa rawhun, 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bima'naa hadiythi aabiy zur'aaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَأَبُو دَاوُدَ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، عَنْ جَدَّتِهِ، أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ دَعَا لِلْمُحَلِّقِينَ ثَلاَثًا وَلِلْمُقَصِّرِينَ مَرَّةً ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ وَكِيعٌ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, waaabuw daawuda alttayaalisiyyu 'an shu'baaa, 'an yahyaa bni alhusayni, 'an jaddatihi, aannahaa sami'ati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i da'aa lilmuhalliqiyna thalaathana walilmuqassiriyna marraaan ‏.‏ walam yaqul wakiy'un fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Yahya b. al-Husain reported on the authority of his grandfather that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) invoked blessing on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage three times for those who got their heads shaved and once for those who got their hair clipped. In the narration transmitted by Waki' there is no mention of the Farewell Pilgrimage
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيُّ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَلَقَ رَأْسَهُ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, wahuwa abnu 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyyu h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa haatimun, - ya'niy abna iismaa'iyla - kilaahumaa 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm halaqa raasahu fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got his head shaved on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَى مِنًى فَأَتَى الْجَمْرَةَ فَرَمَاهَا ثُمَّ أَتَى مَنْزِلَهُ بِمِنًى وَنَحَرَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِلْحَلاَّقِ ‏ "‏ خُذْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَشَارَ إِلَى جَانِبِهِ الأَيْمَنِ ثُمَّ الأَيْسَرِ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ يُعْطِيهِ النَّاسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hafsu bnu ghiyaathin, 'an hishaamin, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aataa minana faaataa aljamraaa faramaahaa thumma aataa manzilahu biminana wanahara thumma qaala lilhalaaaqi ‏ "‏ khudh ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaashaara iilaa jaanibihi alaaymani thumma alaaysari thumma ja'ala yu'tiyhi alnnaasa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased wish him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Mina; he went to the Jamra and threw pebbles at it, after which he went to his lodging in Mina, and sacrificed the animal. He then called for a barber and, turning his right side to him, let him shave him; after which he tiimed his left side. He then gave (these hair) to the people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالُوا أَخْبَرَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ، غِيَاثٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَمَّا أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ لِلْحَلاَّقِ ‏"‏ هَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى الْجَانِبِ الأَيْمَنِ هَكَذَا فَقَسَمَ شَعَرَهُ بَيْنَ مَنْ يَلِيهِ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ أَشَارَ إِلَى الْحَلاَّقِ وَإِلَى الْجَانِبِ الأَيْسَرِ فَحَلَقَهُ فَأَعْطَاهُ أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ ‏.‏ وَأَمَّا فِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي كُرَيْبٍ قَالَ فَبَدَأَ بِالشِّقِّ الأَيْمَنِ فَوَزَّعَهُ الشَّعَرَةَ وَالشَّعَرَتَيْنِ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ ثُمَّ قَالَ بِالأَيْسَرِ فَصَنَعَ بِهِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَا هُنَا أَبُو طَلْحَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَدَفَعَهُ إِلَى أَبِي طَلْحَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin waaabuw kuraybin qaaluwa aakhbaranaa hafsu bnu, ghiyaathin 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi aammaa aabuw bakrin faqaala fiy riwaayatihi lilhalaaaqi ‏"‏ haa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaashaara biyadihi iilaa aljaanibi alaaymani hakadhaa faqasama sha'arahu bayna man yaliyhi - qaala - thumma aashaara iilaa alhalaaaqi waiilaa aljaanibi alaaysari fahalaqahu faaa'taahu aumma sulaymin ‏.‏ waaammaa fiy riwaayaai aabiy kuraybin qaala fabadaaa bialshhiqqi alaaymani fawazza'ahu alshha'araaa waalshha'aratayni bayna alnnaasi thumma qaala bialaaysari fasana'a bihi mithla dhalika thumma qaala ‏"‏ haa hunaa aabuw talhaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadafa'ahu iilaa aabiy talhaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Bakr reported:(He called for) the barber and, pointing towards the right side of his head, said: (Start from) here, and then distributed his hair among those who were near him. He then pointed to the barber (to shave) the left side and he shaved it, and he gave (these hair) to Umm Sulaim (Allah be pleased with her). And in the narration of Abu Kuraib (the words are):" He started from the right half (of his head), and he distributed a hair or two among the people. and then (asked the barber) to shave the left side and he did similarly, and he (the Holy Prophet) said: Here is Abu Talha and he gave these (hair) to Abu Talha
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ، بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَمَى جَمْرَةَ الْعَقَبَةِ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ إِلَى الْبُدْنِ فَنَحَرَهَا وَالْحَجَّامُ جَالِسٌ وَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ عَنْ رَأْسِهِ فَحَلَقَ شِقَّهُ الأَيْمَنَ فَقَسَمَهُ فِيمَنْ يَلِيهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ احْلِقِ الشِّقَّ الآخَرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an muhammadin, 'an aanasi, bni maalikin aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ramaa jamraaa al'aqabaai thumma ansarafa iilaa albudni fanaharahaa waalhajjaamu jaalisun waqaala biyadihi 'an raasihi fahalaqa shiqqahu alaaymana faqasamahu fiyman yaliyhi thumma qaala ‏"‏ ahliqi alshhiqqa alakhara ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aayna aabuw talhaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaa'taahu iiyyaahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) threw stones at Jamrat al-'Aqaba. He then want to his sacrificial animal and sacrificed it, and there was sitting the barber, and he pointed with his hand towards his head, and he shaved the right half of it, and he (the Holy Prophet) distributed them (the hair) among those who were near him. And he again said:Shave the other half, and said: Where is Abu Talha and gave it (the hair) to him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
