verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، سَمِعْتُ هِشَامَ بْنَ حَسَّانَ، يُخْبِرُ عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا رَمَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْجَمْرَةَ وَنَحَرَ نُسُكَهُ وَحَلَقَ نَاوَلَ الْحَالِقَ شِقَّهُ الأَيْمَنَ فَحَلَقَهُ ثُمَّ دَعَا أَبَا طَلْحَةَ الأَنْصَارِيَّ فَأَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ ثُمَّ نَاوَلَهُ الشِّقَّ الأَيْسَرَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ احْلِقْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَحَلَقَهُ فَأَعْطَاهُ أَبَا طَلْحَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اقْسِمْهُ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, sami'tu hishaama bna hassaana, yukhbiru 'ani abni siyriyna, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala lammaa ramaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aljamraaa wanahara nusukahu wahalaqa naawala alhaaliqa shiqqahu alaaymana fahalaqahu thumma da'aa aabaa talhaaa alaansaariyya faaa'taahu iiyyaahu thumma naawalahu alshhiqqa alaaysara faqaala ‏"‏ ahliq ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fahalaqahu faaa'taahu aabaa talhaaa faqaala ‏"‏ aqsimhu bayna alnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had thrown pebbles at the Jamra and had sacrificed the animal, he turned (the right side) of his head towards the barber, and i. e shaved it. He then called Abu Talha al-Ansari and gave it to him. He then turned his left side and asked him (the barber) to shave. And he (the barber) shaved. and gave it to Abu Talha and told him to distribute it amongst the people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ، طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، قَالَ وَقَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ بِمِنًى لِلنَّاسِ يَسْأَلُونَهُ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَمْ أَشْعُرْ فَحَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنْحَرَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اذْبَحْ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَمْ أَشْعُرْ فَنَحَرْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْمِ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ شَىْءٍ قُدِّمَ وَلاَ أُخِّرَ إِلاَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ افْعَلْ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'iysaa bni, talhaaa bni 'ubaydi alllahi 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amriw bni al'aasi, qaala waqafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i biminana lilnnaasi yasaaluwnahu fajaa'a rajulun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi lam aash'ur fahalaqtu qabla aan aanhara ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ adhbah walaa haraja ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma jaa'ahu rajulun akharu faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi lam aash'ur fanahartu qabla aan aarmiya faqaala ‏"‏ armi walaa haraja ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala famaa suiila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an shaa'in quddima walaa aukhhira iilaaa qaala ‏"‏ af'al walaa haraja ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stopped during the Farewell Pilgrimage at Mina for people who had something to ask. A man came and said:Messenger of Allah, being ignorant. I shaved before sacrificing, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Now sacrifice (the animal) and there is no harm (for you). Then another man came and he said: Messenger of Allah, being ignorant, I sacrificed before throwing the pebbles, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: (Now) throw the pebbles, and there is no harm (for you). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was not asked about anything which had been done before or after (its proper time) but he said: Do it, and no harm is there (for you)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عِيسَى بْنُ طَلْحَةَ التَّيْمِيُّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، يَقُولُ وَقَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ فَطَفِقَ نَاسٌ يَسْأَلُونَهُ فَيَقُولُ الْقَائِلُ مِنْهُمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي لَمْ أَكُنْ أَشْعُرُ أَنَّ الرَّمْىَ قَبْلَ النَّحْرِ فَنَحَرْتُ قَبْلَ الرَّمْىِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَارْمِ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَطَفِقَ آخَرُ يَقُولُ إِنِّي لَمْ أَشْعُرْ أَنَّ النَّحْرَ قَبْلَ الْحَلْقِ فَحَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنْحَرَ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ انْحَرْ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا سَمِعْتُهُ يُسْأَلُ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنْ أَمْرٍ مِمَّا يَنْسَى الْمَرْءُ وَيَجْهَلُ مِنْ تَقْدِيمِ بَعْضِ الأُمُورِ قَبْلَ بَعْضٍ وَأَشْبَاهِهَا إِلاَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ افْعَلُوا ذَلِكَ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy 'iysaa bnu talhaaa alttaymiyyu, aannahu sami'a 'abda alllahi bna 'amriw bni al'aasi, yaquwlu waqafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa raahilatihi fatafiqa naasun yasaaluwnahu fayaquwlu alqaaiilu minhum yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy lam aakun aash'uru aanna alrramaa qabla alnnahri fanahartu qabla alrramai ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ faarmi walaa haraja ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala watafiqa akharu yaquwlu iinniy lam aash'ur aanna alnnahra qabla alhalqi fahalaqtu qabla aan aanhara ‏.‏ fayaquwlu ‏"‏ anhar walaa haraja ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala famaa sami'tuhu yusaalu yawmaiidhin 'an aamrin mimmaa yansaa almar'u wayajhalu min taqdiymi ba'di alaumuwri qabla ba'din waaashbaahihaa iilaaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ af'aluwa dhalika walaa haraja ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As (Allah be pleased with them) reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stopped while riding his camel and the people began to ask him. One of the inquirers said: Messenger of Allah, I did not know that pebbles should be thrown before sacrificing the animal, and by mistake I sacrificed the animal before throwing pebbles, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: (Now) throw pebbles and there is no harm in it. Then another (person) came saying: I did not know that the animal was to be sacrificed before shaving, but I got myself shaved before sacrificing the animal, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Sacrifice the animal (now) and there is no harm in it. He (the narrator) said: I did not hear that anything was asked on that day (shout a matter) which a person forgot and could not observe the sequence or anything like it either due to forgetfulness or ignorance, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (about that): Do it; there is no harm in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، إِلَى آخِرِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hasanun alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, bimithli hadiythi yuwnusa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, iilaa akhirihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي عِيسَى بْنُ طَلْحَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَا هُوَ يَخْطُبُ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ مَا كُنْتُ أَحْسِبُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَّ كَذَا وَكَذَا قَبْلَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ثُمَّ جَاءَ آخَرُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كُنْتُ أَحْسِبُ أَنَّ كَذَا قَبْلَ كَذَا وَكَذَا لِهَؤُلاَءِ الثَّلاَثِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ افْعَلْ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala sami'tu abna shihaabin, yaquwlu haddathaniy 'iysaa bnu talhaaa, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'amriw bni al'aasi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm baynaa huwa yakhtubu yawma alnnahri faqaama iilayhi rajulun faqaala maa kuntu aahsibu yaa rasuwla alllahi aanna kadhaa wakadhaa qabla kadhaa wakadhaa thumma jaa'a akharu faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi kuntu aahsibu aanna kadhaa qabla kadhaa wakadhaa lihauulaa'i althhalaathi qaala ‏ "‏ af'al walaa haraja ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Amr b. al-'As (Allah be pleased with them) reported:As Allah's Apostle. (ﷺ) was delivering sermon on the Day of Nahr, a man stood up before him and said: Messenger of Allah, I did not know that such and such (rite was to be performed) before such and such (rite). Then another man came and said: Messenger of Allah, I thought that such and such (rite) should precede such and such (rite), and then another man came and said: Messenger of Allah, I had thought that such and such was before such and such, and such and such (is the sequence) of the three (rites, viz. throwing of pebbles, sacrificing of animal and shaving of one's head). He said to all these three: Do now (if you have not observed the cequence) ; there is no harm in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الأُمَوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي جَمِيعًا، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَمَّا رِوَايَةُ ابْنِ بَكْرٍ فَكَرِوَايَةِ عِيسَى إِلاَّ قَوْلَهُ لِهَؤُلاَءِ الثَّلاَثِ ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ ذَلِكَ وَأَمَّا يَحْيَى الأُمَوِيُّ فَفِي رِوَايَتِهِ حَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنْحَرَ نَحَرْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ ‏.‏ وَأَشْبَاهَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, h wahaddathaniy sa'iydu bnu yahyaa alaumawiyyu, haddathaniy aabiy jamiy'ana, 'ani abni jurayjin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi aammaa riwaayaau abni bakrin fakariwaayaai 'iysaa iilaaa qawlahu lihauulaa'i althhalaathi ‏.‏ faiinnahu lam yadhkur dhalika waaammaa yahyaa alaumawiyyu fafiy riwaayatihi halaqtu qabla aan aanhara nahartu qabla aan aarmiya ‏.‏ waaashbaaha dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Juraij with the same chain of transmitters. And the narration of Ibn Bakr is like one transmitted by 'Isa but with this (variation):" There are not these words in it: To all these three rites (throwing of pebbles sacrificing of animal and shaving of one's head)." And so far as the narration of Yahya al-Umawi (the words are): I got (my head) shaved before I sacrificed the animal, and I sacrified the animal before throwing pebbles, and like that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ حَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَذْبَحَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاذْبَحْ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ذَبَحْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْمِ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'iysaa bni talhaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, qaala aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulun faqaala halaqtu qabla aan aadhbaha ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faadhbah walaa haraja ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala dhabahtu qabla aan aarmiya ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ armi walaa haraja ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Adullah b. 'Amr (b. al-'As) (Allah be pleased with him) reported that a person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said:I got (my head) shaved before sacrificing the, animal, whereupon be (the Holy Prophet) said: Sacrifice the animal (now) ; there is no harm in it. He (the person said): I sacripced the animal before throwingpebbles. whereupon he said: Throw pebbles (now) ; there is no harm in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى نَاقَةٍ بِمِنًى فَجَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa naaqaain biminana fajaa'ahu rajulun ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi abni 'uyaynaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are):I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the back of the camel at Mina, and a person came to him," and the rest of the hadith Is like that transmitted by Ibn 'Uyaina
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُهْزَاذَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، الْمُبَارَكِ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَفْصَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ وَهُوَ وَاقِفٌ عِنْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي حَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْمِ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏ وَأَتَاهُ آخَرُ فَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَبَحْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْمِ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَتَاهُ آخَرُ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَفَضْتُ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْمِ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا رَأَيْتُهُ سُئِلَ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنْ شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ افْعَلُوا وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni quhzaadha, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu alhasani, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, almubaaraki aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu aabiy hafsaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'iysaa bni talhaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, 'amriw bni al'aasi qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaataahu rajulun yawma alnnahri wahuwa waaqifun 'inda aljamraai faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy halaqtu qabla aan aarmiya ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ armi walaa haraja ‏"‏ waaataahu akharu faqaala iinniy dhabahtu qabla aan aarmiya ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ armi walaa haraja ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaataahu akharu faqaala iinniy aafadtu iilaa albayti qabla aan aarmiya ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ armi walaa haraja ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala famaa raaaytuhu suiila yawmaiidhin 'an shaa'in iilaaa qaala ‏"‏ af'aluwa walaa haraja ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-As (Allah be pleased with them) said:As Allah's Messenger (may peace be'upon him) was standing near the jamra, a person came to him on the Day of Nahr and said: Messenger of Allah, I got (my head shaved) before throwing pebbles, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Throw pebbles (now) ; there is no harm in it. Another man (then) came and said: I have sacrificed before throwing the stones. He said: Throw stones (now) and there is no harm. Another came to him and said: I have observed the circumambulation of Ifada of the House before throwing pebbles. He said: Throw pebbles (now) ; there is no harm in it, He (the narrator) said: I did not see that he (the Holy Prophet) was asked about anything on that day, but he said: Do, and there is no harm in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قِيلَ لَهُ فِي الذَّبْحِ وَالْحَلْقِ وَالرَّمْىِ وَالتَّقْدِيمِ وَالتَّأْخِيرِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qiyla lahu fiy aldhhabhi waalhalqi waalrramai waalttaqdiymi waalttaakhiyri faqaala ‏ "‏ laa haraja ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that it was said to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about sacrificing of animals, shaving of one's head, throwing of pebbles, and (the order of) precedence and succession, and he said:There is no harm in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَفَاضَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ بِمِنًى ‏.‏ قَالَ نَافِعٌ فَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يُفِيضُ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ فَيُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ بِمِنًى وَيَذْكُرُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aafaada yawma alnnahri thumma raja'a fasallaa alzzuhra biminana ‏.‏ qaala naafi'un fakaana abnu 'umara yufiydu yawma alnnahri thumma yarji'u fayusalliy alzzuhra biminana wayadhkuru aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fa'alahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed the circumambulation of Ifada on the Day of Nabr (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja), and then came back and observed the noon prayer at Mina. Nafi' (one of the narrators) said that Ibn Umar used to observe the circumambulation of Ifada on the Day of Nahr, and then return and observe the noon prayer at Mina, and mentioned that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الأَزْرَقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ قُلْتُ أَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ شَىْءٍ، عَقَلْتَهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَيْنَ صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ قَالَ بِمِنًى ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَأَيْنَ صَلَّى الْعَصْرَ يَوْمَ النَّفْرِ قَالَ بِالأَبْطَحِ - ثُمَّ قَالَ - افْعَلْ مَا يَفْعَلُ أُمَرَاؤُكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu yuwsufa alaazraqu, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni rufay'in, qaala saaaltu aanasa bna maalikin qultu aakhbirniy 'an shaa'in, 'aqaltahu 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aayna sallaa alzzuhra yawma alttarwiyaai qaala biminana ‏.‏ qultu faaayna sallaa al'asra yawma alnnafri qaala bialaabtahi - thumma qaala - af'al maa yaf'alu aumaraauuka ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-'Aziz b. Rufai' (Allah be pleased with him) said:I asked Anas b. Malik to tell me about something he knew about Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), viz. where he observed the noon prayer on Yaum al-Tarwiya. He said: At Mina. I said: Where did he observe the afternoon prayer on the Yaum an-Nafr? and he said: It was at al-Abtah. He then said: Do as your rulers do
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الرَّازِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ كَانُوا يَنْزِلُونَ الأَبْطَحَ
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu mihraana alrraaziyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, 'an ma'marin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabaa bakrin wa'umara kaanuwa yanziluwna alaabtaha
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr and 'Umar observed halt at al-Abtah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا صَخْرُ بْنُ جُوَيْرِيَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، كَانَ يَرَى التَّحْصِيبَ سُنَّةً وَكَانَ يُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ يَوْمَ النَّفْرِ بِالْحَصْبَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَافِعٌ قَدْ حَصَّبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْخُلَفَاءُ بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimi bni maymuwnin, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa sakhru bnu juwayriyaaa, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara, kaana yaraa alttahsiyba sunnaaan wakaana yusalliy alzzuhra yawma alnnafri bialhasbaai ‏.‏ qaala naafi'un qad hassaba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalkhulafaa'u ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' reported that Ibn 'Umar regarded halt at Muhassab as Sunnah (of the Holy Prophet) and observed the noon prayer on Yaum al-Nafr at that place. Nafi' said:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) halted at Muhassab and the Caliphs did the same after him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ نُزُولُ الأَبْطَحِ لَيْسَ بِسُنَّةٍ إِنَّمَا نَزَلَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَنَّهُ كَانَ أَسْمَحَ لِخُرُوجِهِ إِذَا خَرَجَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat nuzuwlu alaabtahi laysa bisunnaain iinnamaa nazalahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laannahu kaana aasmaha likhuruwjihi iidhaa kharaja ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported.:Halt at al-Abtah is not the Sunnah. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) halted there simply because it was easier for him to depart from there, when he left
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، الزَّهْرَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كَامِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبٌ الْمُعَلِّمُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa hafsu bnu ghiyaathin, h wahaddathaniyhi aabuw alrrabiy'i, alzzahraaniyyu haddathanaa hammaadun ya'niy abna zaydin, h wahaddathanaahu aabuw kaamilin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa habiybun almu'allimu, kulluhum 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ، وَعُمَرَ، وَابْنَ، عُمَرَ كَانُوا يَنْزِلُونَ الأَبْطَحَ ‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ وَقَالَتْ إِنَّمَا نَزَلَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَنَّهُ كَانَ مَنْزِلاً أَسْمَحَ لِخُرُوجِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, aanna aabaa bakrin, wa'umara, waabna, 'umara kaanuwa yanziluwna alaabtaha ‏.‏ qaala alzzuhriyyu waaakhbaraniy 'urwaau, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa lam takun taf'alu dhalika waqaalat iinnamaa nazalahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laannahu kaana manzilaan aasmaha likhuruwjihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim reported that Abu Bakr, 'Umar and Ibn Umar used to halt at Abtah. 'Urwa narrated from 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) that he did not observe this practice and said:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) halted there, for it is a place from where it was easy to depart
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ، عَبْدَةَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَيْسَ التَّحْصِيبُ بِشَىْءٍ إِنَّمَا هُوَ مَنْزِلٌ نَزَلَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara, waaahmadu bnu, 'abdaaa - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin - haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'amrinw, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala laysa alttahsiybu bishaa'in iinnamaa huwa manzilun nazalahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported:Halt at Muhassab is not something (significant from the point of view of the Shari'ah). It is a place of halt where Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) halted
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ، عُيَيْنَةَ قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو رَافِعٍ لَمْ يَأْمُرْنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أَنْزِلَ الأَبْطَحَ حِينَ خَرَجَ مِنْ مِنًى وَلَكِنِّي جِئْتُ فَضَرَبْتُ فِيهِ قُبَّتَهُ فَجَاءَ فَنَزَلَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي رِوَايَةِ صَالِحٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ قُتَيْبَةَ قَالَ عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ وَكَانَ عَلَى ثَقَلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wazuhayru bnu harbin jamiy'ana 'ani abni, 'uyaynaaa qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, qaala qaala aabuw raafi'in lam yaamurniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan aanzila alaabtaha hiyna kharaja min minana walakinniy jiitu fadarabtu fiyhi qubbatahu fajaa'a fanazala ‏.‏ qaala aabuw bakrin fiy riwaayaai saalihin qaala sami'tu sulaymaana bna yasaarin ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai qutaybaaa qaala 'an aabiy raafi'in wakaana 'alaa thaqali alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Rafi' reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not command me to observe halt at al-Abtah when be departed from Mina, but I came and set up his (the Holy Prcphet's) tent (of my own accord) ; and he (Allah's Apostle) came and observed halt. This hadith is narrated through another chain of transmitters from Abu Rafi' who was (in charge) of the luggage of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَنْزِلُ غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِخَيْفِ بَنِي كِنَانَةَ حَيْثُ تَقَاسَمُوا عَلَى الْكُفْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ nanzilu ghadana iin shaa'a alllahu bikhayfi baniy kinaanaaa haythu taqaasamuwa 'alaa alkufri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleated with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:God willing, we will get down tomorrow, at Khaif of Banu Kinanah, the place where they had taken an oath on unbelief
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ بِمِنًى ‏ "‏ نَحْنُ نَازِلُونَ غَدًا بِخَيْفِ بَنِي كِنَانَةَ حَيْثُ تَقَاسَمُوا عَلَى الْكُفْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَذَلِكَ إِنَّ قُرَيْشًا وَبَنِي كِنَانَةَ تَحَالَفَتْ عَلَى بَنِي هَاشِمٍ وَبَنِي الْمُطَّلِبِ أَنْ لاَ يُنَاكِحُوهُمْ وَلاَ يُبَايِعُوهُمْ حَتَّى يُسْلِمُوا إِلَيْهِمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْنِي بِذَلِكَ الْمُحَصَّبَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, haddathaniy alaawzaa'iyyu, haddathaniy alzzuhriyyu, haddathaniy aabuw salamaaa, haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, qaala qaala lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu biminana ‏ "‏ nahnu naaziluwna ghadana bikhayfi baniy kinaanaaa haythu taqaasamuwa 'alaa alkufri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wadhalika iinna qurayshana wabaniy kinaanaaa tahaalafat 'alaa baniy haashimin wabaniy almuttalibi aan laa yunaakihuwhum walaa yubaayi'uwhum hattaa yuslimuwa iilayhim rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'niy bidhalika almuhassaba ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to us as we were at Mina: We would observe halt tomorrow at-Khaif of Banu Kinanah, where (the polytheists) had taken an oath on unbelief, and that was that the Quraish and Banu Kinanah had, pledged against Banu Hashim and Banu Muttalib that they would neither marry nor do any transaction with them unless they deliver Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) to them. And (this pledge was) taken at this (place) Muhassab
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْزِلُنَا - إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ إِذَا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ - الْخَيْفُ حَيْثُ تَقَاسَمُوا عَلَى الْكُفْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa shabaabaau, haddathaniy warqaa'u, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ manzilunaa - iin shaa'a alllahu iidhaa fataha alllahu - alkhayfu haythu taqaasamuwa 'alaa alkufri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:God willing, when Allah has granted us victory, our halt tomorrow will be at Khaif, where they (the unbelievers of Mecca) had taken an oath on unbelief
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ الْعَبَّاسَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، اسْتَأْذَنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَبِيتَ بِمَكَّةَ لَيَالِيَ مِنًى مِنْ أَجْلِ سِقَايَتِهِ فَأَذِنَ لَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, waaabuw ausaamaaa qaalaa haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, h. wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, haddathaniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna al'abbaasa bna 'abdi almuttalibi, astaadhana rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yabiyta bimakkaaa layaaliya minana min aajli siqaayatihi faaadhina lahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that al-'A'bbas b. Abd al-Muttalib (Allah be pleased with him) sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to spend in Mecca the nights (which be was required to spend) at Mina on account of his office of supplier of water, and he (the Holy Prophet) granted him permission
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، حَاتِمٍ وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ عُمَرَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, h wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu, haatimin wa'abdu bnu humaydin jamiy'ana 'an muhammadi bni bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, kilaahumaa 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, bni 'umara bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by 'Ubaidullah b. Umar with the the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ الضَّرِيرُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ الطَّوِيلُ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيِّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ جَالِسًا مَعَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عِنْدَ الْكَعْبَةِ فَأَتَاهُ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَقَالَ مَا لِي أَرَى بَنِي عَمِّكُمْ يَسْقُونَ الْعَسَلَ وَاللَّبَنَ وَأَنْتُمْ تَسْقُونَ النَّبِيذَ أَمِنْ حَاجَةٍ بِكُمْ أَمْ مِنْ بُخْلٍ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ مَا بِنَا مِنْ حَاجَةٍ وَلاَ بُخْلٍ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ وَخَلْفَهُ أُسَامَةُ فَاسْتَسْقَى فَأَتَيْنَاهُ بِإِنَاءٍ مِنْ نَبِيذٍ فَشَرِبَ وَسَقَى فَضْلَهُ أُسَامَةَ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَحْسَنْتُمْ وَأَجْمَلْتُمْ كَذَا فَاصْنَعُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلاَ نُرِيدُ تَغْيِيرَ مَا أَمَرَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu alminhaali alddariyru, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa humaydun alttawiylu, 'an bakri bni 'abdi alllahi almuzaniyyi, qaala kuntu jaalisana ma'a abni 'abbaasin 'inda alka'baai faaataahu aa'raabiyyun faqaala maa liy aaraa baniy 'ammikum yasquwna al'asala waalllabana waaantum tasquwna alnnabiydha aamin haajaain bikum aam min bukhlin faqaala abnu 'abbaasin alhamdu lillahi maa binaa min haajaain walaa bukhlin qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa raahilatihi wakhalfahu ausaamaau faastasqaa faaataynaahu biiinaa'in min nabiydhin fashariba wasaqaa fadlahu ausaamaaa waqaala ‏ "‏ aahsantum waaajmaltum kadhaa faasna'uwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falaa nuriydu taghyiyra maa aamara bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Bakr b. 'Abdullah al-Muzani said:While I was sitting along with Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) near the Ka'ba, there came a bedouin to him and said: What is the matter that I see that the progeny of your uncle supply honey and milk (as drink to the travellers), whereas you supply al-nabidh (water sweetened with dates)? Is it due to your poverty or due to your close-fistedness? Thereupon Ibn 'Abbas said: Allah be praised, it is neither due to poverty nor due to close-fistedness (but due to the fact) that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came here riding his she-came, and there was sitting behind him Usama. He asked for water, and we gave him a cup full of nabidh and he drank it, and gave the remaining (part) to Usama; and he (the Holy Prophet) said: You have done Food, You have done well. So continue doing like it So we do not like to change what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had commanded us to do
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ أَمَرَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أَقُومَ عَلَى بُدْنِهِ وَأَنْ أَتَصَدَّقَ بِلَحْمِهَا وَجُلُودِهَا وَأَجِلَّتِهَا وَأَنْ لاَ أُعْطِيَ الْجَزَّارَ مِنْهَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَحْنُ نُعْطِيهِ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an 'abdi alkariymi, 'an mujaahidin, 'an 'abdi, alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa 'an 'aliyyin, qaala aamaraniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan aaquwma 'alaa budnihi waaan aatasaddaqa bilahmihaa wajuluwdihaa waaajillatihaa waaan laa au'tiya aljazzaara minhaa qaala ‏ "‏ nahnu nu'tiyhi min 'indinaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: All (Allah be pleased with him) reperted:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put me in charge of his sacrificial animals, that I should give their flesh. skins and saddle cloths as sadaqa, but not to give anything to the butcher, saying: We would pay him ourselves
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ الْجَزَرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaaluwa haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'abdi alkariymi aljazariyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abd al-Karim al-Jazari with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي كِلاَهُمَا، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي، لَيْلَى عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا أَجْرُ الْجَازِرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, waqaala, iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma aakhbaranaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabiy kilaahumaa, 'ani abni aabiy najiyhin, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni aabiy, laylaa 'an 'aliyyin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm walaysa fiy hadiythihimaa aajru aljaaziri ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him) with another chain of transmitters, but there is no mention of the wages of the butcher in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَرْزُوقٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، أَنَّ مُجَاهِدًا، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ أَخْبَرَهُ ‏.‏ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَقُومَ عَلَى بُدْنِهِ وَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَقْسِمَ بُدْنَهُ كُلَّهَا لُحُومَهَا وَجُلُودَهَا وَجِلاَلَهَا فِي الْمَسَاكِينِ وَلاَ يُعْطِيَ فِي جِزَارَتِهَا مِنْهَا شَيْئًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimi bni maymuwnin, wamuhammadu bnu marzuwqin, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy alhasanu bnu muslimin, aanna mujaahidana, aakhbarahu aanna 'abda alrrahmani bna aabiy laylaa aakhbarahu aanna 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin aakhbarahu ‏.‏ aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aamarahu aan yaquwma 'alaa budnihi waaamarahu aan yaqsima budnahu kullahaa luhuwmahaa wajuluwdahaa wajilaalahaa fiy almasaakiyni walaa yu'tiya fiy jizaaratihaa minhaa shayiana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali b. Abi Talib (Allah be pleased with him) reported:Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) put him in charge of his sacrificial animals, and commanded him to distribute the whole of their meat, hides, and saddle cloths to the poor, and not to give to the butcher anything out of them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ، الْكَرِيمِ بْنُ مَالِكٍ الْجَزَرِيُّ أَنَّ مُجَاهِدًا، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَهُ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'abdu, alkariymi bnu maalikin aljazariyyu aanna mujaahidana, aakhbarahu aanna 'abda alrrahmani bna aabiy laylaa aakhbarahu aanna 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin aakhbarahu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aamarahu bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Hadrat 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ نَحَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ الْبَدَنَةَ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ وَالْبَقَرَةَ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa maalikun, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an aabiy alzzubayri 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi qaala naharnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama alhudaybiyaai albadanaaa 'an sab'aain waalbaqaraaa 'an sab'aain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported:In the year of Hudaibiya (6 H ), we, along with Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him), sacrificed a camel for seven persons and a cow for seven persons
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُهِلِّينَ بِالْحَجِّ فَأَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نَشْتَرِكَ فِي الإِبِلِ وَالْبَقَرِ كُلُّ سَبْعَةٍ مِنَّا فِي بَدَنَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, h. wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm muhilliyna bialhajji faaamaranaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan nashtarika fiy aliibili waalbaqari kullu sab'aain minnaa fiy badanaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported:We set out in the state of Ihram for Hajj along, with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He commanded us that seven persons should join in a camel and a cow for offering sacrifice
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَزْرَةُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَجَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَحَرْنَا الْبَعِيرَ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ وَالْبَقَرَةَ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa 'azraau bnu thaabitin, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala hajajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fanaharnaa alba'iyra 'an sab'aain waalbaqaraaa 'an sab'aain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported:We performed Hajj along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and we sacrificed a camel on behalf of seven persons, and a cow on behalf of seven persons
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ اشْتَرَكْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ كُلُّ سَبْعَةٍ فِي بَدَنَةٍ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لِجَابِرٍ أَيُشْتَرَكُ فِي الْبَدَنَةِ مَا يُشْتَرَكُ فِي الْجَزُورِ قَالَ مَا هِيَ إِلاَّ مِنَ الْبُدْنِ ‏.‏ وَحَضَرَ جَابِرٌ الْحُدَيْبِيَةَ قَالَ نَحَرْنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ سَبْعِينَ بَدَنَةً اشْتَرَكْنَا كُلُّ سَبْعَةٍ فِي بَدَنَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, qaala ashtaraknaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alhajji waal'umraai kullu sab'aain fiy badanaain faqaala rajulun lijaabirin aayushtaraku fiy albadanaai maa yushtaraku fiy aljazuwri qaala maa hiya iilaaa mina albudni ‏.‏ wahadara jaabirun alhudaybiyaaa qaala naharnaa yawmaiidhin sab'iyna badanaaan ashtaraknaa kullu sab'aain fiy badanaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported:We joined Allah's Apostle (may pea, @. e be upon him) in Hajj and Umra and seven persons shared in the sacrifice of an animal. A person said to Jabir (Allah be pleased with him): Can seven persons share in the sacrifice of al-Badnah (a camel) as he shares in al- Jazur (a cow)? He, (Jabir) said: It (al-Jazur) is nothing but one among the budun. Jabir was present at Hudaibiya and he said: We sacrificed on that day seventy camel, and seven men shared in each sacrifice (of camel)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ حَجَّةِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَأَمَرَنَا إِذَا أَحْلَلْنَا أَنْ نُهْدِيَ وَيَجْتَمِعَ النَّفَرُ مِنَّا فِي الْهَدِيَّةِ وَذَلِكَ حِينَ أَمَرَهُمْ أَنْ يَحِلُّوا مِنْ ‏.‏ حَجِّهِمْ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaranaa aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yuhaddithu 'an hajjaai alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala faaamaranaa iidhaa aahlalnaa aan nuhdiya wayajtami'a alnnafaru minnaa fiy alhadiyyaai wadhalika hiyna aamarahum aan yahilluwa min ‏.‏ hajjihim fiy hadhaa alhadiythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them), describing the Hajj of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:He (the Holy Prophet) commanded us as we had entered into the state of Ihram to sacrifice the animals (as a rite of Hajj) and a group (of person; amongst us, i. e. seven) shared in the sacrifice of one (camel or cow), and it happened at that time when he commanded them to put off Ihram for Hajj (after performing 'Umra)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ كُنَّا نَتَمَتَّعُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْعُمْرَةِ فَنَذْبَحُ الْبَقَرَةَ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ نَشْتَرِكُ فِيهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an 'abdi almaliki, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabiri bni, 'abdi alllahi qaala kunnaa natamatta'u ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bial'umraai fanadhbahu albaqaraaa 'an sab'aain nashtariku fiyhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jaibir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported:We performed Hajj Tamattu' along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we slaughtered a cow on behalf of seven persons sharing in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ ذَبَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ عَائِشَةَ بَقَرَةً يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu zakariyyaa'a bni aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala dhabaha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an 'aaiishaaa baqaraaan yawma alnnahri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sacrificed a cow on behalf of 'A'isha on the Day of Nahr (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ، بْنُ يَحْيَى الأُمَوِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ يَقُولُ نَحَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ نِسَائِهِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ بَقَرَةً فِي حَجَّتِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, h wahaddathaniy sa'iydu, bnu yahyaa alaumawiyyu haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi, alllahi yaquwlu nahara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an nisaaiihi ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi abni bakrin 'an 'aaiishaaa baqaraaan fiy hajjatihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sacrificed (animals) on behalf of his wives, and in the hadith transmitted by Ibn Abu Bakr (the words are):" A cow on behalf of 'A'isha on the occasion of the Hajj
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، أَتَى عَلَى رَجُلٍ وَهُوَ يَنْحَرُ بَدَنَتَهُ بَارِكَةً فَقَالَ ابْعَثْهَا قِيَامًا مُقَيَّدَةً سُنَّةَ نَبِيِّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an yuwnusa, 'an ziyaadi bni jubayrin, aanna abna 'umara, aataa 'alaa rajulin wahuwa yanharu badanatahu baarikaaan faqaala ab'athhaa qiyaamana muqayyadaaan sunnaaa nabiyyikum sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ziyad b. Jubair reported that Ibn 'Umar came upon a person who was slaughtering (sacrificing) his camel and had made him kneel down. So he told him to make it stand up festered (and then sacrifice it) according to the Sunnah of the Prophet (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَعَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُهْدِي مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَأَفْتِلُ قَلاَئِدَ هَدْيِهِ ثُمَّ لاَ يَجْتَنِبُ شَيْئًا مِمَّا يَجْتَنِبُ الْمُحْرِمُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, wa'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhdiy mina almadiynaai faaaftilu qalaaiida hadyihi thumma laa yajtanibu shayiana mimmaa yajtanibu almuhrimu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent the sacrificial animals from Medina. I wove garlands for his sacrificial animals (and then he hung them round their necks), and he would not avoid doing anything which the Muhrim avoids
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Shihab
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَخَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالُوا أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ، بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَىَّ أَفْتِلُ قَلاَئِدَ هَدْىِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h. wahaddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, wakhalafu bnu hishaamin, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaaluwa aakhbaranaa hammaadu, bnu zaydin 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaaanniy aanzuru iilaaaa aaftilu qalaaiida hadai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha narrated (in another hadith narrated through another chain of transmitters) these words:"As if I am seeing myself weaving the garlands for the sacrificial animals of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ، تَقُولُ كُنْتُ أَفْتِلُ قَلاَئِدَ هَدْىِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدَىَّ هَاتَيْنِ ثُمَّ لاَ يَعْتَزِلُ شَيْئًا وَلاَ يَتْرُكُهُ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu 'aaiishaaa, taquwlu kuntu aaftilu qalaaiida hadai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadaaaa haatayni thumma laa ya'tazilu shayiana walaa yatrukuhu
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. al-Qasim reported on the authority of his father that he heard 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) saying:I used to weave garlands for the sacrificial animals of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with these hands of mine, but he (Allah's Apostle) neither avoided anything nor gave up anything (which a Muhrim should avoid or give up)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَفْلَحُ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ فَتَلْتُ قَلاَئِدَ بُدْنِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدَىَّ ثُمَّ أَشْعَرَهَا وَقَلَّدَهَا ثُمَّ بَعَثَ بِهَا إِلَى الْبَيْتِ وَأَقَامَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَمَا حَرُمَ عَلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ كَانَ لَهُ حِلاًّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa aaflahu, 'ani alqaasimi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat fataltu qalaaiida budni rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadaaaa thumma aash'arahaa waqalladahaa thumma ba'atha bihaa iilaa albayti waaaqaama bialmadiynaai famaa haruma 'alayhi shaa'un kaana lahu hilaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:I wove the garlands for the sacrificial animals of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with my own bands, and then he (the Holy Prophet) marked them, and garlanded them, and then sent them to the House, and stayed at Medina and nothing was forbidden to him which was lawful for him (before)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، وَيَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، قَالَ ابْنُ حُجْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، وَأَبِي، قِلاَبَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَبْعَثُ بِالْهَدْىِ أَفْتِلُ قَلاَئِدَهَا بِيَدَىَّ ثُمَّ لاَ يُمْسِكُ عَنْ شَىْءٍ لاَ يُمْسِكُ عَنْهُ الْحَلاَلُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, waya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma alddawraqiyyu, qaala abnu hujrin haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an aayyuwba, 'ani alqaasimi, waaabiy, qilaabaaa 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yab'athu bialhadai aaftilu qalaaiidahaa biyadaaaa thumma laa yumsiku 'an shaa'in laa yumsiku 'anhu alhalaalu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent the sacrificial animals and I wove garlands for them with my own 'hands, and he did not refrain from doing anything which he did not avoid in the state of non-Muhrim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، قَالَتْ أَنَا فَتَلْتُ، تِلْكَ الْقَلاَئِدَ مِنْ عِهْنٍ كَانَ عِنْدَنَا فَأَصْبَحَ فِينَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَلاَلاً يَأْتِي مَا يَأْتِي الْحَلاَلُ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ أَوْ يَأْتِي مَا يَأْتِي الرَّجُلُ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa husaynu bnu alhasani, haddathanaa abnu 'awnin, 'ani alqaasimi, 'an aummi almuuminiyna, qaalat aanaa fataltu, tilka alqalaaiida min 'ihnin kaana 'indanaa faaasbaha fiynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm halaalaan yaatiy maa yaatiy alhalaalu min aahlihi aaw yaatiy maa yaatiy alrrajulu min aahlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Qasim reported the Mother of the Faithful (Hadrat 'A'isha Siddiqa) (Allah be pleased with her) as saying:I used to weave these garlands from the multicoloured wool which was with us. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in the state of non Muhrim among us, and he would do all that was lawful for a lion-Muhrim with his wife
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي أَفْتِلُ الْقَلاَئِدَ لِهَدْىِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْغَنَمِ فَيَبْعَثُ بِهِ ثُمَّ يُقِيمُ فِينَا حَلاَلاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat laqad raaaytuniy aaftilu alqalaaiida lihadai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alghanami fayab'athu bihi thumma yuqiymu fiynaa halaalaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:I recall how I wove garlands for the sacrificial animals (the goats) of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He sent them and then stayed with us as a non-Muhrim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ رُبَّمَا فَتَلْتُ الْقَلاَئِدَ لِهَدْىِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيُقَلِّدُ هَدْيَهُ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُ بِهِ ثُمَّ يُقِيمُ لاَ يَجْتَنِبُ شَيْئًا مِمَّا يَجْتَنِبُ الْمُحْرِمُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waaabuw kuraybin qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat rubbamaa fataltu alqalaaiida lihadai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fayuqallidu hadyahu thumma yab'athu bihi thumma yuqiymu laa yajtanibu shayiana mimmaa yajtanibu almuhrimu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah, be pleased, with her) reported:I often wove garlands for the sacrificial animals of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he garlanded his sacrificial animals, and then he sent them and stayed in the ouse) avoiding nothing which a Muhrim avoids
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أَهْدَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّةً إِلَى الْبَيْتِ غَنَمًا فَقَلَّدَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waaabuw kuraybin qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat aahdaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm marraaan iilaa albayti ghanamana faqalladahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon, him) sent some goats as sacrificial animals to the House and He garlanded them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جُحَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنَّا نُقَلِّدُ الشَّاءَ فَنُرْسِلُ بِهَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَلاَلٌ لَمْ يَحْرُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathaniy muhammadu bnu juhaadaaa, 'ani alhakami, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kunnaa nuqallidu alshhaa'a fanursilu bihaa warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm halaalun lam yahrum 'alayhi minhu shaa'un ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:We used to garland the goats and send them (to Mecca), and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed back in Medina as a non-Muhrim ard nothing was forbidden for him (which is forbidden for a Muhrim)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ زِيَادٍ كَتَبَ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ مَنْ أَهْدَى هَدْيًا حَرُمَ عَلَيْهِ مَا يَحْرُمُ عَلَى الْحَاجِّ حَتَّى يُنْحَرَ الْهَدْىُ وَقَدْ بَعَثْتُ بِهَدْيِي فَاكْتُبِي إِلَىَّ بِأَمْرِكِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَمْرَةُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ لَيْسَ كَمَا قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَا فَتَلْتُ قَلاَئِدَ هَدْىِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدَىَّ ثُمَّ قَلَّدَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ ثُمَّ بَعَثَ بِهَا مَعَ أَبِي فَلَمْ يَحْرُمْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَىْءٌ أَحَلَّهُ اللَّهُ لَهُ حَتَّى نُحِرَ الْهَدْىُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an 'amraaa, binti 'abdi alrrahmani aannahaa aakhbarathu aanna abna ziyaadin kataba iilaa 'aaiishaaa aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin qaala man aahdaa hadyana haruma 'alayhi maa yahrumu 'alaa alhaajji hattaa yunhara alhadau waqad ba'athtu bihadyiy faaktubiy iilaaaa biaamriki ‏.‏ qaalat 'amraau qaalat 'aaiishaau laysa kamaa qaala abnu 'abbaasin aanaa fataltu qalaaiida hadai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadaaaa thumma qalladahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihi thumma ba'atha bihaa ma'a aabiy falam yahrum 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shaa'un aahallahu alllahu lahu hattaa nuhira alhadau ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amra daughter of Abd al-Rahman reported that Ibn Ziyad had written to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with him) that 'Abdullah b. Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) bad said that he who sent a sacrificial animal (to Mecca) for him was forbidden what is forbidden for a pilgrim (in the state of Ihram) until the animal is sacrificed I have myself sent my sacrificial animal (to Mecca), so write to me your opinion. Amra reported 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) as saying:It is not as Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) had asserted, for I wove the garlands for the sacrificial animals of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with my own hands. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then garlanded them with his own hands, and then sent them with my father, and nothing was forbidden for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which had been made lawful for him by Allah until the animals were sacrificed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ، وَهْىَ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْحِجَابِ تُصَفِّقُ وَتَقُولُ كُنْتُ أَفْتِلُ قَلاَئِدَ هَدْىِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدَىَّ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُ بِهَا وَمَا يُمْسِكُ عَنْ شَىْءٍ مِمَّا يُمْسِكُ عَنْهُ الْمُحْرِمُ حَتَّى يُنْحَرَ هَدْيُهُ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa iismaa'iylu bnu aabiy khaalidin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an masruwqin, qaala sami'tu 'aaiishaaa, wahaa min waraa'i alhijaabi tusaffiqu wataquwlu kuntu aaftilu qalaaiida hadai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadaaaa thumma yab'athu bihaa wamaa yumsiku 'an shaa'in mimmaa yumsiku 'anhu almuhrimu hattaa yunhara hadyuhu
verses.translation: Masruq reported:I heard 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) clapping her hands behind the curtain and saying: I used to weave garlands for the sacrificial animals of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with my own hands, and then he (the Holy Prophet) sent them (to Mecca), and he did not avoid doing anything which a Muhritn avoids until his animal was sacrificed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، بِمِثْلِهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, haddathanaa daawudu, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, kilaahumaa 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, bimithlihi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى رَجُلاً يَسُوقُ بَدَنَةً فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا وَيْلَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ أَوْ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa rajulaan yasuwqu badanaaan faqaala ‏"‏ arkabhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnahaa badanaaun ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ arkabhaa waylaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fiy althhaaniyaai aaw fiy althhaalithaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) rerorted that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw a person who was driving a sacrificial camel (and told him to ride on it. Thereupon he said:Messenger of Allah, it is a sacrificial camel. He told him again to ride on it; (when he received the same reply) he said: Woe to you, (he uttered these words on the second or the third reply)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِزَامِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَسُوقُ بَدَنَةً مُقَلَّدَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa almughiyraau bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alhizaamiyyu, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala baynamaa rajulun yasuwqu badanaaan muqalladaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by A'raj with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are):" Whereas the person was driving a sacrificial camel which was garlanded
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَسُوقُ بَدَنَةً مُقَلَّدَةً قَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَيْلَكَ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ بَدَنَةٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَيْلَكَ ارْكَبْهَا وَيْلَكَ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an muhammadin, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala baynamaa rajulun yasuwqu badanaaan muqalladaaan qaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ waylaka arkabhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala badanaaun yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ waylaka arkabhaa waylaka arkabhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam b. Munabbih reported:It is one out of these (narrations) that Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us from Muhammad the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he narrated to us traditions out of which is that he said: When there was a person who was driving a garlanded sacrificial camel, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Woe to you; ride on it. He said: Messenger of Allah, it is a sacrificial animal, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Woe to you, ride on it; woe to you, ride on it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَسُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ وَأَظُنُّنِي قَدْ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ، أَنَسٍ ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَجُلٍ يَسُوقُ بَدَنَةً فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wasurayju bnu yuwnusa, qaalaa haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa humaydun, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, qaala waaazunnuniy qad sami'tuhu min, aanasin h. wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an humaydin, 'an thaabitin albunaaniyyi, 'an aanasin, qaala marra rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm birajulin yasuwqu badanaaan faqaala ‏"‏ arkabhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala iinnahaa badanaaun ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ arkabhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ marratayni aaw thalaathana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to pass by a person who was driving a sacrificial camel, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said:Ride on It. He said: It is a sacrificial camel. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said twice or thrice: Ride on it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَخْنَسِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ مُرَّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِبَدَنَةٍ أَوْ هَدِيَّةٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ أَوْ هَدِيَّةٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an mis'arin, 'an bukayri bni alaakhnasi, 'an aanasin, qaala sami'tuhu yaquwlu murra 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bibadanaain aaw hadiyyaain faqaala ‏"‏ arkabhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala iinnahaa badanaaun aaw hadiyyaaun ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ waiin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:Someone happened to pass by Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) with a sacrificial camel, or a sacrificial animal, whereupon he said: Ride on it. He said: It is a sacrificial camel, or animal, whereupon he said: (Ride) even if (it is a sacrificial camel)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي بُكَيْرُ بْنُ الأَخْنَسِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ مُرَّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِبَدَنَةٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu bishrin, 'an mis'arin, haddathaniy bukayru bnu alaakhnasi, qaala sami'tu aanasana, yaquwlu murra 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bibadanaain ‏.‏ fadhakara mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported:There happened to pass (a person) with a sacrificial camel by Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، سُئِلَ عَنْ رُكُوبِ الْهَدْىِ، فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ ارْكَبْهَا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ إِذَا أُلْجِئْتَ إِلَيْهَا حَتَّى تَجِدَ ظَهْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, suiila 'an rukuwbi alhadai, faqaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ arkabhaa bialma'ruwfi iidhaa auljiita iilayhaa hattaa tajida zahrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that he was asked about riding on a sacrificial animal, and he said:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Ride on it gently, when you have need for it, until you find (another) mount
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ جَابِرًا عَنْ رُكُوبِ الْهَدْىِ، فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ ارْكَبْهَا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ حَتَّى تَجِدَ ظَهْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, qaala saaaltu jaabirana 'an rukuwbi alhadai, faqaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ arkabhaa bialma'ruwfi hattaa tajida zahrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Zubair reported:I asked Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) about riding on the sacrificial animal, to which he replied: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Ride on them gently until you find another mount
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ الضُّبَعِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْهُذَلِيُّ، قَالَ انْطَلَقْتُ أَنَا وَسِنَانُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، مُعْتَمِرَيْنِ قَالَ وَانْطَلَقَ سِنَانٌ مَعَهُ بِبَدَنَةٍ يَسُوقُهَا فَأَزْحَفَتْ عَلَيْهِ بِالطَّرِيقِ فَعَيِيَ بِشَأْنِهَا إِنْ هِيَ أُبْدِعَتْ كَيْفَ يَأْتِي بِهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَئِنْ قَدِمْتُ الْبَلَدَ لأَسْتَحْفِيَنَّ عَنْ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَضْحَيْتُ فَلَمَّا نَزَلْنَا الْبَطْحَاءَ قَالَ انْطَلِقْ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ نَتَحَدَّثْ إِلَيْهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَكَرَ لَهُ شَأْنَ بَدَنَتِهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَلَى الْخَبِيرِ سَقَطْتَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِسِتَّ عَشْرَةَ بَدَنَةً مَعَ رَجُلٍ وَأَمَّرَهُ فِيهَا - قَالَ - فَمَضَى ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ بِمَا أُبْدِعَ عَلَىَّ مِنْهَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ انْحَرْهَا ثُمَّ اصْبُغْ نَعْلَيْهَا فِي دَمِهَا ثُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ عَلَى صَفْحَتِهَا وَلاَ تَأْكُلْ مِنْهَا أَنْتَ وَلاَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ رُفْقَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwaarithi bnu sa'iydin, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi aldduba'iyyi, haddathaniy muwsaa bnu salamaaa alhudhaliyyu, qaala antalaqtu aanaa wasinaanu bnu salamaaa, mu'tamirayni qaala waantalaqa sinaanun ma'ahu bibadanaain yasuwquhaa faaazhafat 'alayhi bialttariyqi fa'ayiya bishaanihaa iin hiya aubdi'at kayfa yaatiy bihaa ‏.‏ faqaala laiin qadimtu albalada laastahfiyanna 'an dhalika ‏.‏ qaala faaadhaytu falammaa nazalnaa albathaa'a qaala antaliq iilaa abni 'abbaasin natahaddath iilayhi ‏.‏ qaala fadhakara lahu shaana badanatihi ‏.‏ faqaala 'alaa alkhabiyri saqatta ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bisitta 'ashraaa badanaaan ma'a rajulin waaammarahu fiyhaa - qaala - famadaa thumma raja'a faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa aasna'u bimaa aubdi'a 'alaaaa minhaa qaala ‏ "‏ anharhaa thumma asbugh na'layhaa fiy damihaa thumma aj'alhu 'alaa safhatihaa walaa taakul minhaa aanta walaa aahadun min aahli rufqatika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Musa b. Salama al-Hudhali reported:I and Sinan b. Salama proceeded (to Mecca to perform Umra. Sinan had a sacrificial camel with him which he was driving. The camel stopped in the way being completely exhausted and this state of it made him (Sinan) helpless. (He thought) if it stops proceeding further how he would be able to take it, along with him and said: I would definitely find out (the religious verdict) about it. I moved on in the morning and as we encamped at al-Batha', (Sinan) said: Come (along with me) to Ibn 'Abbis (Allah be pleased with them) so that we should narrate to him (this incident), and he (Sinan) reported to him the incident of the sacrificial camel. He (Ibn Abbas) said: You have referred (the matter) to the well informed person. (Now listen) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent sixteen sacrificial camels with a man whom he put in change of them. He set out and came back and said: Messenger of Allah, what should I do with those who are completely exhausted and become powerless to move on, whereupon he said: Slaughter them, and dye their hoofs in their blood, and put them on the sides of their humps, but neither you nor anyone among those who are with you must eat any part of them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ بِثَمَانَ عَشْرَةَ بَدَنَةً مَعَ رَجُلٍ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَوَّلَ الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, 'an muwsaa bni salamaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha bithamaana 'ashraaa badanaaan ma'a rajulin ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bimithli hadiythi 'abdi alwaarithi walam yadhkur aawwala alhadiythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent eighteen sacrificial camels with a person. The rest of the hadith is the same, and the first part (of the above-mentioned hadith) is not mentioned
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
