verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَلِيًّا الأَزْدِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَلَّمَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا اسْتَوَى عَلَى بَعِيرِهِ خَارِجًا إِلَى سَفَرٍ كَبَّرَ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَجَعَ قَالَهُنَّ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِيهِنَّ ‏"‏ آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, qaala qaala abnu jurayjin aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aanna 'aliyyana alaazdiyya, aakhbarahu aanna abna 'umara 'allamahum aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa astawaa 'alaa ba'iyrihi khaarijana iilaa safarin kabbara thalaathana thumma qaala ‏"‏ subhaana alladhiy sakhhara lanaa hadhaa wamaa kunnaa lahu muqriniyna waiinnaa iilaa rabbinaa lamunqalibuwna alllahumma iinnaa nasaaluka fiy safarinaa hadhaa albirra waalttaqwaa wamina al'amali maa tardaa alllahumma hawwin 'alaynaa safaranaa hadhaa waatwi 'annaa bu'dahu alllahumma aanta alssaahibu fiy alssafari waalkhaliyfaau fiy alaahli alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika min wa'thaa'i alssafari wakaabaai almanzari wasuw'i almunqalabi fiy almaali waalaahli ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waiidhaa raja'a qaalahunna ‏.‏ wazaada fiyhinna ‏"‏ ayibuwna taaiibuwna 'aabiduwna lirabbinaa haamiduwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mounted his camel while setting out on a journey, he glorified Allah (uttered Allah-o-Akbar) thrice, and then said:Hallowed is He Who subdued for us this (ride) and we were not ourselves powerful enough to use It as a ride, and we are going to return to our Lord. O Allah, we seek virtue and piety from Thee in this journey of ours and the act which pleaseth Thee. O Allah, lighten this journey of ours, and make its distance easy for us. O Allah, Thou art (our) companion during the journey, and guardian of (our) family. O Allah, I seek refuge with Thee from hardships of the journey, gloominess of the sights, and finding of evil changes in property and family on return. And he (the Holy Prophet) uttered (these words), and made this addition to them: We are returning, repentant, worshipping our Lord. and praising Him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ سَرْجِسَ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَافَرَ يَتَعَوَّذُ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ وَالْحَوْرِ بَعْدَ الْكَوْرِ وَدَعْوَةِ الْمَظْلُومِ وَسُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an 'aasimin alaahwali, 'an 'abdi, alllahi bni sarjisa qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa saafara yata'awwadhu min wa'thaa'i alssafari wakaabaai almunqalabi waalhawri ba'da alkawri wada'waai almazluwmi wasuw'i almanzari fiy alaahli waalmaali‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Sarjis (Allah be pleased with him) reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set forth on a journey, he sought refuge (with Allah) from the hardships of the travelling, and finding of evil changes on return, and disgrace after honour, and the curse of the oppressed and a gloomy sad scene in family and property
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَازِمٍ قَالَ يَبْدَأُ بِالأَهْلِ إِذَا رَجَعَ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَتِهِمَا جَمِيعًا ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, jamiy'ana 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathaniy haamidu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, kilaahumaa 'an 'aasimin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi 'abdi alwaahidi fiy almaali waalaahli ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai muhammadi bni khaazimin qaala yabdaau bialaahli iidhaa raja'a ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayatihimaa jamiy'ana ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika min wa'thaa'i alssafari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadlth like this has been narrated on the authority of Asim With the same chain of transmitters except (this difference) that the hadith transmitted by 'Abd al-Wahid (one of the narrators) the (word)" property" precedes the family, and in the hadith transmitted by Mahammad b. Khazim (the word)" family" precedes (theword" Property" ), on returning home, in the narrations of both the narrators (these words are found):" O Allah I seek refuge with Thee from the hardships of the journey
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، ح . وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَفَلَ مِنَ الْجُيُوشِ أَوِ السَّرَايَا أَوِ الْحَجِّ أَوِ الْعُمْرَةِ إِذَا أَوْفَى عَلَى ثَنِيَّةٍ أَوْ فَدْفَدٍ كَبَّرَ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ سَاجِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, h . wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa qafala mina aljuyuwshi aawi alssaraayaa aawi alhajji aawi al'umraai iidhaa aawfaa 'alaa thaniyyaain aaw fadfadin kabbara thalaathana thumma qaala ‏ "‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa 'alaa kulli shaa'in qadiyrun ayibuwna taaiibuwna 'aabiduwna saajiduwna lirabbinaa haamiduwna sadaqa alllahu wa'dahu wanasara 'abdahu wahazama alaahzaaba wahdahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came back from the battle or from expeditions or from Hajj or Umra and as he reached the top of the hillock or upon the elevated hard ground, he uttered Allah-o- Akbar thrice, and then said:There is no god but Allah. He is One, there is no partner with Him, His is the sovereignty and His is the praise and He is Potent over everything. (We are) returning, repenting, worshipping, prostrating before our Lord, and we praise Him Allah fulfilled His promise and helped His servant, and routed the confederates alone
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ إِلاَّ حَدِيثَ أَيُّوبَ فَإِنَّ فِيهِ التَّكْبِيرَ مَرَّتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'niy abna 'ulayyaaa - 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa ma'nun, 'an maalikin, h wahaddathanaa abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku, kulluhum 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi iilaaa hadiytha aayyuwba faiinna fiyhi alttakbiyra marratayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters (but with one alteration) that here Allah-o-Akbar is mentioned twice
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ أَقْبَلْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَا وَأَبُو طَلْحَةَ ‏.‏ وَصَفِيَّةُ رَدِيفَتُهُ عَلَى نَاقَتِهِ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِظَهْرِ الْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy iishaaqa, qaala qaala aanasu bnu maalikin aaqbalnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanaa waaabuw talhaaa ‏.‏ wasafiyyaau radiyfatuhu 'alaa naaqatihi hattaa iidhaa kunnaa bizahri almadiynaai qaala ‏ "‏ ayibuwna taaiibuwna 'aabiduwna lirabbinaa haamiduwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falam yazal yaquwlu dhalika hattaa qadimnaa almadiynaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported:I and Abu Talha (both) came back along with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Safiyyah (the wife of the Holy Prophet) rode behind him on his camel and as we came to the out- skirts of Medina he said: (We are those) who return, who repent, who worship our Lord, who praise (Him), and he went on uttering this until we entered Medina
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa humaydu bnu mas'adaaa, haddathanaa bishru bnu almufaddali, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy iishaaqa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَاخَ بِالْبَطْحَاءِ الَّتِي بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ فَصَلَّى بِهَا ‏.‏ وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanaakha bialbathaa'i allatiy bidhiy alhulayfaai fasallaa bihaa ‏.‏ wakaana 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara yaf'alu dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made (his camel) kneel down (i, e. halt at the stony ground of Dhu'l-Hulaifa) and prayed there, and so did Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ الْمِصْرِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يُنِيخُ بِالْبَطْحَاءِ الَّتِي بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ الَّتِي كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُنِيخُ بِهَا وَيُصَلِّي بِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri almisriyyu, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala haddathanaa laythun, 'an naafi'in, qaala kaana abnu 'umara yuniykhu bialbathaa'i allatiy bidhiy alhulayfaai allatiy kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuniykhu bihaa wayusalliy bihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' reported that 'Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) used to halt his camel in the stony ground at Dhu'l-Hulaifa, where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to make a halt (and pray)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الْمُسَيَّبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسٌ، - يَعْنِي أَبَا ضَمْرَةَ - عَنْ مُوسَى، بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، كَانَ إِذَا صَدَرَ مِنَ الْحَجِّ أَوِ الْعُمْرَةِ أَنَاخَ بِالْبَطْحَاءِ الَّتِي بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ الَّتِي كَانَ يُنِيخُ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu iishaaqa almusayyabiyyu, haddathaniy aanasun, - ya'niy aabaa damraaa - 'an muwsaa, bni 'uqbaaa 'an naafi'in, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, kaana iidhaa sadara mina alhajji aawi al'umraai aanaakha bialbathaa'i allatiy bidhiy alhulayfaai allatiy kaana yuniykhu bihaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' reported that when 'Abdullah b. 'Umar returned from Hajj or 'Umra he made his camel kneel down (i. e. halted) in the stony ground of Dhu'l-Hulaifa where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had made his camel halt
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - عَنْ مُوسَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُقْبَةَ - عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ فِي مُعَرَّسِهِ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّكَ بِبَطْحَاءَ مُبَارَكَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, haddathanaa haatimun, - wahuwa abnu iismaa'iyla - 'an muwsaa, - wahuwa abnu 'uqbaaa - 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm autiya fiy mu'arrasihi bidhiy alhulayfaai faqiyla lahu iinnaka bibathaa'a mubaarakaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim (b. Abdullah b. 'Umar) reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them) that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was visited by (someone, i. e. an angel) during the fag end of the night at Dhu'l-Hulaifa, and it was said to him:Verily it is a blessed stony-ground
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكَّارِ بْنِ الرَّيَّانِ، وَسُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِسُرَيْجٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ وَهُوَ فِي مُعَرَّسِهِ مِنْ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ فِي بَطْنِ الْوَادِي فَقِيلَ إِنَّكَ بِبَطْحَاءَ مُبَارَكَةٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُوسَى وَقَدْ أَنَاخَ بِنَا سَالِمٌ بِالْمُنَاخِ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الَّذِي كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يُنِيخُ بِهِ يَتَحَرَّى مُعَرَّسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ أَسْفَلُ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الَّذِي بِبَطْنِ الْوَادِي بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْقِبْلَةِ وَسَطًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakkaari bni alrrayyaani, wasurayju bnu yuwnusa, - waalllafzu lisurayjin - qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, aakhbaraniy muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an aabiyhi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm autiya wahuwa fiy mu'arrasihi min dhiy alhulayfaai fiy batni alwaadiy faqiyla iinnaka bibathaa'a mubaarakaain ‏.‏ qaala muwsaa waqad aanaakha binaa saalimun bialmunaakhi mina almasjidi alladhiy kaana 'abdu alllahi yuniykhu bihi yataharraa mu'arrasa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa aasfalu mina almasjidi alladhiy bibatni alwaadiy baynahu wabayna alqiblaai wasatana min dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim b. Abdullah b. Umar reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them) that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came to Dhu'l- Hulaifa in the heart of the valley at the fag end of the night, and it was said to him:It is a blessed stony ground. Musa (one of the narrators) said: Salim made his came) halt at the mosque where 'Abdullah made his camel halt as seeking the place of stay of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). It is, in fact, situated at a lower plain than the mosque, which stands in the heart of the valley, and it is between it (the mosque) (and Qibla) that that place (where Allah's Apostle used to get down for rest and prayer) is situated
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ح . وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ بَعَثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقُ فِي الْحَجَّةِ الَّتِي أَمَّرَهُ عَلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَبْلَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ فِي رَهْطٍ يُؤَذِّنُونَ فِي النَّاسِ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ لاَ يَحُجُّ بَعْدَ الْعَامِ مُشْرِكٌ وَلاَ يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَكَانَ حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ يَقُولُ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ يَوْمُ الْحَجِّ الأَكْبَرِ ‏.‏ مِنْ أَجْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, h . wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa alttujiybiyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, aanna abna shihaabin, aakhbarahu 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala ba'athaniy aabuw bakrin alssiddiyqu fiy alhajjaai allatiy aammarahu 'alayhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qabla hajjaai alwadaa'i fiy rahtin yuuadhhinuwna fiy alnnaasi yawma alnnahri laa yahujju ba'da al'aami mushrikun walaa yatuwfu bialbayti 'uryaanun ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin fakaana humaydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani yaquwlu yawmu alnnahri yawmu alhajji alaakbari ‏.‏ min aajli hadiythi aabiy hurayraaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported:Abu Bakr Siddiq (Allah be pleased with him) sent me during Hajj before the Farewell Pilgrimage for which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had appointed him an Amir, among a group of people whom he had ordered to make announcement to the people on the Day of Nahr:" After this year no polytheist may perform the Pilgrimage and no naked person may circumambulate the House." Ibn Shihab stated that Humaid b. Abd al-Rahman said that according to this narration of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) the day of Hajj al-Akbar (Great Hajj) is this Day of Nahr (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يُونُسَ بْنَ يُوسُفَ، يَقُولُ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ يَوْمٍ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ أَنْ يُعْتِقَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ عَبْدًا مِنَ النَّارِ مِنْ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ وَإِنَّهُ لَيَدْنُو ثُمَّ يُبَاهِي بِهِمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ فَيَقُولُ مَا أَرَادَ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy makhramaau bnu bukayrin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu yuwnusa bna yuwsufa, yaquwlu 'ani abni almusayyabi, qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa min yawmin aakthara min aan yu'tiqa alllahu fiyhi 'abdana mina alnnaari min yawmi 'arafaaa waiinnahu layadnuw thumma yubaahiy bihimu almalaaiikaaa fayaquwlu maa aaraada hauulaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no day when God sets free more servants from Hell than the Day of 'Arafa. He draws near, then praises them to the angels, saying: What do these want?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْعُمْرَةُ إِلَى الْعُمْرَةِ كَفَّارَةٌ لِمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَالْحَجُّ الْمَبْرُورُ لَيْسَ لَهُ جَزَاءٌ إِلاَّ الْجَنَّةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an sumaaain, mawlaa aabiy bakri bni 'abdi alrrahmani 'an aabiy saalihin alssammaani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ al'umraau iilaa al'umraai kaffaaraaun limaa baynahumaa waalhajju almabruwru laysa lahu jazaa'un iilaaa aljannaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:An Umra is an expiation for the sins committed between it and the next, and Hajj which is accepted will receive no other reward than Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الأُمَوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu wazuhayru bnu harbin qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi almaliki alaumawiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu, al'aziyzi bnu almukhtaari 'an suhaylin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, jamiy'ana 'an sufyaana, kullu hauulaa'i 'an sumaaain, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏bimithli hadiythi maalikin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَتَى هَذَا الْبَيْتَ فَلَمْ يَرْفُثْ وَلَمْ يَفْسُقْ رَجَعَ كَمَا وَلَدَتْهُ أُمُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala, zuhayrun haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man aataa hadhaa albayta falam yarfuth walam yafsuq raja'a kamaa waladathu aummuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who came to this House (Ka'ba) (with the intention of performing Pilgrimage), and neither spoke indecently nor did he act wickedly. would return (free from sin) as on the (very first day) his mother bore him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ، وَأَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ، بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، وَسُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمْ جَمِيعًا ‏ "‏ مَنْ حَجَّ فَلَمْ يَرْفُثْ وَلَمْ يَفْسُقْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, 'an aabiy 'awaanaaa, waaabiy alaahwasi, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri, bnu aabiy shaybaaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an mis'arin, wasufyaana, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, kullu hauulaa'i 'an mansuwrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wafiy hadiythihim jamiy'ana ‏ "‏ man hajja falam yarfuth walam yafsuq ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mainsur with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are):" He who performed Pilgrimage but neither spoke indecently nor acted wickedly
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa hushaymun, 'an sayyaarin, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ حُسَيْنٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَنْزِلُ فِي دَارِكَ بِمَكَّةَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ وَهَلْ تَرَكَ لَنَا عَقِيلٌ مِنْ رِبَاعٍ أَوْ دُورٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ عَقِيلٌ وَرِثَ أَبَا طَالِبٍ هُوَ وَطَالِبٌ وَلَمْ يَرِثْهُ جَعْفَرٌ وَلاَ عَلِيٌّ شَيْئًا لأَنَّهُمَا كَانَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ وَكَانَ عَقِيلٌ وَطَالِبٌ كَافِرَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, bnu yaziyda 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna 'aliyya bna husaynin, aakhbarahu aanna 'amraw bna 'uthmaana bni 'affaana aakhbarahu 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydi bni haarithaaa, aannahu qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aatanzilu fiy daarika bimakkaaa faqaala ‏ "‏ wahal taraka lanaa 'aqiylun min ribaa'in aaw duwrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wakaana 'aqiylun waritha aabaa taalibin huwa wataalibun walam yarithhu ja'farun walaa 'aliyyun shayiana laannahumaa kaanaa muslimayni wakaana 'aqiylun wataalibun kaafirayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usama b. Zaid b. Haritha (Allah be pleased with him) said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ):Will you stay in your house at Mecca (which you abandoned at the time of migration)? Thereupon he said: Has 'Aqil left for as any land or house? And 'Aqil and Talib became the Inheritors of Abu Talib's (property), and neither Ja'far nor 'Ali inherited anything from him, for both (Ja'far and 'Ali) were Muslims whereas 'Aqil and Talib were non-Muslims
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الرَّازِيُّ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ، الرَّزَّاقِ - قَالَ ابْنُ مِهْرَانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، - عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيْنَ تَنْزِلُ غَدًا وَذَلِكَ فِي حَجَّتِهِ حِينَ دَنَوْنَا مِنْ مَكَّةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ وَهَلْ تَرَكَ لَنَا عَقِيلٌ مَنْزِلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu mihraana alrraaziyyu, waabnu aabiy 'umara, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, jamiy'ana 'an 'abdi, alrrazzaaqi - qaala abnu mihraana haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, - 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'aliyyi bni husaynin, 'an 'amriw bni 'uthmaana, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aayna tanzilu ghadana wadhalika fiy hajjatihi hiyna danawnaa min makkaaa ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ wahal taraka lanaa 'aqiylun manzilaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) said:Allah's Messenger, God willing, where will you stay tomorrow? And it was at the time of the Conquest (of Mecca). Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Has 'Aqil left any accommodation for us?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَفْصَةَ، وَزَمْعَةُ، بْنُ صَالِحٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ، بْنِ زَيْدٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيْنَ تَنْزِلُ غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَذَلِكَ زَمَنَ الْفَتْحِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَهَلْ تَرَكَ لَنَا عَقِيلٌ مِنْ مَنْزِلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy hafsaaa, wazam'aau, bnu saalihin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu shihaabin, 'an 'aliyyi bni husaynin, 'an 'amriw bni 'uthmaana, 'an ausaamaaa, bni zaydin aannahu qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aayna tanzilu ghadana iin shaa'a alllahu wadhalika zamana alfathi ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ wahal taraka lanaa 'aqiylun min manzilin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usama b. Zaid :Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) said: Allah's Messenger, God willing, where will you stay tomorrow? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Has 'Aqil left any accommodation for us?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، يَسْأَلُ السَّائِبَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ يَقُولُ هَلْ سَمِعْتَ فِي الإِقَامَةِ، بِمَكَّةَ شَيْئًا فَقَالَ السَّائِبُ سَمِعْتُ الْعَلاَءَ بْنَ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لِلْمُهَاجِرِ إِقَامَةُ ثَلاَثٍ بَعْدَ الصَّدَرِ بِمَكَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ كَأَنَّهُ يَقُولُ لاَ يَزِيدُ عَلَيْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - ya'niy abna bilaalin - 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni humaydin, aannahu sami'a 'umara bna 'abdi al'aziyzi, yasaalu alssaaiiba bna yaziyda yaquwlu hal sami'ta fiy aliiqaamaai, bimakkaaa shayiana faqaala alssaaiibu sami'tu al'alaa'a bna alhadramiyyi, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ lilmuhaajiri iiqaamaau thalaathin ba'da alssadari bimakkaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ kaaannahu yaquwlu laa yaziydu 'alayhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-'Ali' b. al-Hadrami reported Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon as saying:For a Mahijir, it is only three (days') stay at Mecca, after completing (the Hajj or 'Umra) that is allowed, and it seemed as if he was saying that he should not (stay) beyond this (period)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، يَقُولُ لِجُلَسَائِهِ مَا سَمِعْتُمْ فِي، سُكْنَى مَكَّةَ فَقَالَ السَّائِبُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ سَمِعْتُ الْعَلاَءَ، - أَوْ قَالَ الْعَلاَءَ بْنَ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ - قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يُقِيمُ الْمُهَاجِرُ بِمَكَّةَ بَعْدَ قَضَاءِ نُسُكِهِ ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni humaydin, qaala sami'tu 'umara bna 'abdi al'aziyzi, yaquwlu lijulasaaiihi maa sami'tum fiy, suknaa makkaaa faqaala alssaaiibu bnu yaziyda sami'tu al'alaa'a, - aaw qaala al'alaa'a bna alhadramiyyi - qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yuqiymu almuhaajiru bimakkaaa ba'da qadaa'i nusukihi thalaathana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-'Ala' b. al-Hadrami reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The Muhijir should stay at Mecca after performing the rituals (of Hajj) but for three (days) only
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، يَسْأَلُ السَّائِبَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ فَقَالَ السَّائِبُ سَمِعْتُ الْعَلاَءَ بْنَ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ ثَلاَثُ لَيَالٍ يَمْكُثُهُنَّ الْمُهَاجِرُ بِمَكَّةَ بَعْدَ الصَّدَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa hasanun alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, jamiy'ana 'an ya'quwba bni iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni humaydin, aannahu sami'a 'umara bna 'abdi al'aziyzi, yasaalu alssaaiiba bna yaziyda faqaala alssaaiibu sami'tu al'alaa'a bna alhadramiyyi, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ thalaathu layaalin yamkuthuhunna almuhaajiru bimakkaaa ba'da alssadari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-'Ala' b. al-Hadrami reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:It is only for three nights that a Muhajir should stay at Mecca after the completion of the rituals of Hajj
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، وَأَمْلاَهُ، عَلَيْنَا إِمْلاَءً أَخْبَرَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ حُمَيْدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ السَّائِبَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ الْعَلاَءَ بْنَ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَكْثُ الْمُهَاجِرِ بِمَكَّةَ بَعْدَ قَضَاءِ نُسُكِهِ ثَلاَثٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, waaamlaahu, 'alaynaa iimlaa'an aakhbaraniy iismaa'iylu bnu muhammadi bni sa'din, aanna humayda bna 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, aakhbarahu aanna alssaaiiba bna yaziyda aakhbarahu aanna al'alaa'a bna alhadramiyyi aakhbarahu 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ makthu almuhaajiri bimakkaaa ba'da qadaa'i nusukihi thalaathun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-" Ala' b. al-Hadrami reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The stay at Mecca after the completion of his rituals (of Hajj) is only for three days
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa alddahhaaku bnu makhladin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Juraij narrated this hadith with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ ‏"‏ لاَ هِجْرَةَ وَلَكِنْ جِهَادٌ وَنِيَّةٌ وَإِذَا اسْتُنْفِرْتُمْ فَانْفِرُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ هَذَا الْبَلَدَ حَرَّمَهُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ فَهُوَ حَرَامٌ بِحُرْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَحِلَّ الْقِتَالُ فِيهِ لأَحَدٍ قَبْلِي وَلَمْ يَحِلَّ لِي إِلاَّ سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ فَهُوَ حَرَامٌ بِحُرْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لاَ يُعْضَدُ شَوْكُهُ وَلاَ يُنَفَّرُ صَيْدُهُ وَلاَ يَلْتَقِطُ إِلاَّ مَنْ عَرَّفَهَا وَلاَ يُخْتَلَى خَلاَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْعَبَّاسُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ فَإِنَّهُ لِقَيْنِهِمْ وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an mujaahidin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alfathi fathi makkaaa ‏"‏ laa hijraaa walakin jihaadun waniyyaaun waiidhaa astunfirtum faanfiruwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala yawma alfathi fathi makkaaa ‏"‏ iinna hadhaa albalada harramahu alllahu yawma khalaqa alssamawaati waalaarda fahuwa haraamun bihurmaai alllahi iilaa yawmi alqiyaamaai waiinnahu lam yahilla alqitaalu fiyhi laahadin qabliy walam yahilla liy iilaaa saa'aaan min nahaarin fahuwa haraamun bihurmaai alllahi iilaa yawmi alqiyaamaai laa yu'dadu shawkuhu walaa yunaffaru sayduhu walaa yaltaqitu iilaaa man 'arrafahaa walaa yukhtalaa khalaahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala al'abbaasu yaa rasuwla alllahi iilaaa aliidhkhira faiinnahu liqaynihim walibuyuwtihim ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iilaaa aliidhkhira ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying on the Day of Victory over Mecca:There is no Hijra (emigration) but only Jihad and good intention; and when you are called to battle, then go forth. He also said on the Day of Victory over Mecca: Allah made this town sacred on the day He created the earth and the heavens; so it is -sacred by the sacred- ness conferred on it by Allah until the Day of Resurrection and fighting in it was not lawful to anyone before me, and it was made lawful for me only during an hour on one day, for it is sacred by the sacredness conferred on it by Allah until the Day of Resurrection. Its thorns are not to be cut, its game is not to be molested, and the things dropped are to be picked up only by one who makes a public announcement of it, and its fresh herbage is not to be cut. Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) said: Messenger of Allah, exception may be made in case of rush, for it is useful for their blacksmiths and for their houses. He (the Holy Prophet) conceding the suggestion of 'Abbas) said: Except rush
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُفَضَّلٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏"‏ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَدَلَ الْقِتَالِ ‏"‏ الْقَتْلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَلْتَقِطُ لُقَطَتَهُ إِلاَّ مَنْ عَرَّفَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa mufaddalun, 'an mansuwrin, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi bimithlihi walam yadhkur ‏"‏ yawma khalaqa alssamawaati waalaarda ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala badala alqitaali ‏"‏ alqatla ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ laa yaltaqitu luqatatahu iilaaa man 'arrafahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Mansur, but he did not mention:" On that very day He created the heavens and the earth," and he (the narrator) substituted the word" fighting" (qital) for" killing" (qatl), and further said:" No one is to pick up the dropped thing except one who makes a public announcement of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْعَدَوِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِعَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ وَهُوَ يَبْعَثُ الْبُعُوثَ إِلَى مَكَّةَ ائْذَنْ لِي أَيُّهَا الأَمِيرُ أُحَدِّثْكَ قَوْلاً قَامَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْغَدَ مِنْ يَوْمِ الْفَتْحِ سَمِعَتْهُ أُذُنَاىَ وَوَعَاهُ قَلْبِي وَأَبْصَرَتْهُ عَيْنَاىَ حِينَ تَكَلَّمَ بِهِ أَنَّهُ حَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ مَكَّةَ حَرَّمَهَا اللَّهُ وَلَمْ يُحَرِّمْهَا النَّاسُ فَلاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرِئٍ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ أَنْ يَسْفِكَ بِهَا دَمًا وَلاَ يَعْضِدَ بِهَا شَجَرَةً فَإِنْ أَحَدٌ تَرَخَّصَ بِقِتَالِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهَا فَقُولُوا لَهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَذِنَ لِرَسُولِهِ وَلَمْ يَأْذَنْ لَكُمْ وَإِنَّمَا أَذِنَ لِي فِيهَا سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ وَقَدْ عَادَتْ حُرْمَتُهَا الْيَوْمَ كَحُرْمَتِهَا بِالأَمْسِ وَلْيُبَلِّغِ الشَّاهِدُ الْغَائِبَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لأَبِي شُرَيْحٍ مَا قَالَ لَكَ عَمْرٌو قَالَ أَنَا أَعْلَمُ بِذَلِكَ مِنْكَ يَا أَبَا شُرَيْحٍ إِنَّ الْحَرَمَ لاَ يُعِيذُ عَاصِيًا وَلاَ فَارًّا بِدَمٍ وَلاَ فَارًّا بِخَرْبَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin, 'an aabiy shurayhin al'adawiyyi, aannahu qaala li'amriw bni sa'iydin wahuwa yab'athu albu'uwtha iilaa makkaaa aidhan liy aayyuhaa alaamiyru auhaddithka qawlaan qaama bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alghada min yawmi alfathi sami'athu audhunaaaa wawa'aahu qalbiy waaabsarathu 'aynaaaa hiyna takallama bihi aannahu hamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi thumma qaala ‏ "‏ iinna makkaaa harramahaa alllahu walam yuharrimhaa alnnaasu falaa yahillu laimriiin yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri aan yasfika bihaa damana walaa ya'dida bihaa shajaraaan faiin aahadun tarakhhasa biqitaali rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiyhaa faquwluwa lahu iinna alllaha aadhina lirasuwlihi walam yaadhan lakum waiinnamaa aadhina liy fiyhaa saa'aaan min nahaarin waqad 'aadat hurmatuhaa alyawma kahurmatihaa bialaamsi walyuballighi alshhaahidu alghaaiiba ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqiyla laabiy shurayhin maa qaala laka 'amrunw qaala aanaa aa'lamu bidhalika minka yaa aabaa shurayhin iinna alharama laa yu'iydhu 'aasiyana walaa faarrana bidamin walaa faarrana bikharbaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Shuraih al-'Adawi reported that he said to Amr b. Sa'id when he was sending troops to Mecca:Let me tell you something. O Commander, which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the day following, the Conquest which my ears heard and my heart has retained, and my eyes saw as he spoke it. He praised Allah and extolled Him and then said: Allah, not men, has made Mecca sacred; so it is not permissible for any person believing in Allah and the Last Day to shed blood in it, or lop a tree in it. If anyone seeks a concession on the basis of fighting of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), tell him that Allah permitted His Messenger, but not you, and He gave him permission only for an hour on one day, and its sacredness was restored on the very day like that of yesterday. Let him who is present convey the information to him who is absent. It was said to Abu Shuraih: What did Amr say to you? He said: I am better informed of that than you, Abu Shuraih, but the sacred territory does not grant protection to one who is disobedient, or one who runs away after shedding blood, or one who runs away after committing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ، - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، - حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، - هُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ لَمَّا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَكَّةَ قَامَ فِي النَّاسِ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَبَسَ عَنْ مَكَّةَ الْفِيلَ وَسَلَّطَ عَلَيْهَا رَسُولَهُ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَإِنَّهَا لَنْ تَحِلَّ لأَحَدٍ كَانَ قَبْلِي وَإِنَّهَا أُحِلَّتْ لِي سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ وَإِنَّهَا لَنْ تَحِلَّ لأَحَدٍ بَعْدِي فَلاَ يُنَفَّرُ صَيْدُهَا وَلاَ يُخْتَلَى شَوْكُهَا وَلاَ تَحِلُّ سَاقِطَتُهَا إِلاَّ لِمُنْشِدٍ وَمَنْ قُتِلَ لَهُ قَتِيلٌ فَهُوَ بِخَيْرِ النَّظَرَيْنِ إِمَّا أَنْ يُفْدَى وَإِمَّا أَنْ يُقْتَلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْعَبَّاسُ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّا نَجْعَلُهُ فِي قُبُورِنَا وَبُيُوتِنَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ أَبُو شَاهٍ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ فَقَالَ اكْتُبُوا لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اكْتُبُوا لأَبِي شَاهٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْوَلِيدُ فَقُلْتُ لِلأَوْزَاعِيِّ مَا قَوْلُهُ اكْتُبُوا لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ هَذِهِ الْخُطْبَةَ الَّتِي سَمِعَهَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, jamiy'ana 'ani alwaliydi, - qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, - haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, haddathaniy yahyaa bnu aabiy kathiyrin, haddathaniy aabuw salamaaa, - huwa abnu 'abdi alrrahmani - haddathaniy aabuw hurayraaa, qaala lammaa fataha alllahu 'azza wajalla 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm makkaaa qaama fiy alnnaasi fahamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi thumma qaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha habasa 'an makkaaa alfiyla wasallata 'alayhaa rasuwlahu waalmuuminiyna waiinnahaa lan tahilla laahadin kaana qabliy waiinnahaa auhillat liy saa'aaan min nahaarin waiinnahaa lan tahilla laahadin ba'diy falaa yunaffaru sayduhaa walaa yukhtalaa shawkuhaa walaa tahillu saaqitatuhaa iilaaa limunshidin waman qutila lahu qatiylun fahuwa bikhayri alnnazarayni iimmaa aan yufdaa waiimmaa aan yuqtala ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala al'abbaasu iilaaa aliidhkhira yaa rasuwla alllahi faiinnaa naj'aluhu fiy qubuwrinaa wabuyuwtinaa ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iilaaa aliidhkhira ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaama aabuw shaahin rajulun min aahli alyamani faqaala aktubuwa liy yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aktubuwa laabiy shaahin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala alwaliydu faqultu lilaawzaa'iyyi maa qawluhu aktubuwa liy yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala hadhihi alkhutbaaa allatiy sami'ahaa min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira, (Allah be pleased with him) reported. When Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, granted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) victory over Mecca, he stood before people and praised and extolled Allah and then said:Verily Allah held back the elephants from Mecca and gave the domination of it to His Messenger and believers, and it (this territory) was not violable to anyone before me and it was made violable to me for an hour of a day, and it shall not be violable to anyone after me. So neither molest the game, nor weed out thorns from it. And it is not lawful for anyone to pick up a thing dropped but one who makes public announcement of it. And it a relative of anyone is killed he is entitled to opt for one of two things. Either he should be paid blood-money or he can take life as (a just retribution). 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) said: Allah's Messenger, but Idhkhir (a kind of herbage), for we use it for our graves and for our houses, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: With the exception of Idhkhir. A person known as Abu Shah, one of the people of Yemen, stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, (kindly) write it for me. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said I Write it for Abu Shah. Walid said: I asked al-Auzai': What did his saying mean:" Write it for me, Messenger of Allah"? He said: This very address that he had heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ خُزَاعَةَ قَتَلُوا رَجُلاً مِنْ بَنِي لَيْثٍ عَامَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ بِقَتِيلٍ مِنْهُمْ قَتَلُوهُ فَأُخْبِرَ بِذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَكِبَ رَاحِلَتَهُ فَخَطَبَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ حَبَسَ عَنْ مَكَّةَ الْفِيلَ وَسَلَّطَ عَلَيْهَا رَسُولَهُ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَلاَ وَإِنَّهَا لَمْ تَحِلَّ لأَحَدٍ قَبْلِي وَلَنْ تَحِلَّ لأَحَدٍ بَعْدِي أَلاَ وَإِنَّهَا أُحِلَّتْ لِي سَاعَةً مِنَ النَّهَارِ أَلاَ وَإِنَّهَا سَاعَتِي هَذِهِ حَرَامٌ لاَ يُخْبَطُ شَوْكُهَا وَلاَ يُعْضَدُ شَجَرُهَا وَلاَ يَلْتَقِطُ سَاقِطَتَهَا إِلاَّ مُنْشِدٌ وَمَنْ قُتِلَ لَهُ قَتِيلٌ فَهُوَ بِخَيْرِ النَّظَرَيْنِ إِمَّا أَنْ يُعْطَى - يَعْنِي الدِّيَةَ - وَإِمَّا أَنْ يُقَادَ أَهْلُ الْقَتِيلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ يُقَالُ لَهُ أَبُو شَاهٍ فَقَالَ اكْتُبْ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اكْتُبُوا لأَبِي شَاهٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ فَإِنَّا نَجْعَلُهُ فِي بُيُوتِنَا وَقُبُورِنَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an shaybaana, 'an yahyaa, aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu iinna khuzaa'aaa qataluwa rajulaan min baniy laythin 'aama fathi makkaaa biqatiylin minhum qataluwhu faaukhbira bidhalika rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm farakiba raahilatahu fakhataba faqaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha 'azza wajalla habasa 'an makkaaa alfiyla wasallata 'alayhaa rasuwlahu waalmuuminiyna aalaa waiinnahaa lam tahilla laahadin qabliy walan tahilla laahadin ba'diy aalaa waiinnahaa auhillat liy saa'aaan mina alnnahaari aalaa waiinnahaa saa'atiy hadhihi haraamun laa yukhbatu shawkuhaa walaa yu'dadu shajaruhaa walaa yaltaqitu saaqitatahaa iilaaa munshidun waman qutila lahu qatiylun fahuwa bikhayri alnnazarayni iimmaa aan yu'taa - ya'niy alddiyaaa - waiimmaa aan yuqaada aahlu alqatiyli ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fajaa'a rajulun min aahli alyamani yuqaalu lahu aabuw shaahin faqaala aktub liy yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aktubuwa laabiy shaahin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala rajulun min qurayshin iilaaa aliidhkhira faiinnaa naj'aluhu fiy buyuwtinaa waqubuwrinaa ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iilaaa aliidhkhira ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported:The people of the Khuza'ah tribe killed a man of the tribe of Laith in the Year of Victory as a retaliation for one whom they had killed (whom the people of the tribe of Laith had killed). It was reported to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He mounted his camel and delivered this address: Verily Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, held back the Ele- phants from Mecca, and gave its domination to His Messenger and believers. Behold, it was not violable for anyone before me and it will not be violable for anyone after me. Behold, it was made violable for me for an hour of a day; and at this very hour it has again been made inviolable (for me as well as for others). So its thorns are not to be cut, its trees are not to be lopped, and (no one is allowed to) pick up a thing dropped, but the one who makes an announcement of it. And one whose fellow is killed is allowed to opt between two alternatives: either he should receive blood-money or get the life of the (murderer) in return. He (the narrator said): A person from the Yemen, who was called Abu Shah, came to him and said: Messenger of Allah, write it down for me, whereupon he (Allah's Messenger) said: Write it down for Abu Shah. One of the persons from among the Quraish also said: Except Idhkhir, for we use it in our houses ant our graves. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Except Idhkhir
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لأَحَدِكُمْ أَنْ يَحْمِلَ بِمَكَّةَ السِّلاَحَ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa abnu aa'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yahillu laahadikum aan yahmila bimakkaaa alssilaaha‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported:I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) say: It is not permissible for any one of you to carry weapons in Mecca
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، أَمَّا الْقَعْنَبِيُّ فَقَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ وَأَمَّا قُتَيْبَةُ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ وَقَالَ يَحْيَى - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قُلْتُ لِمَالِكٍ أَحَدَّثَكَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ مَكَّةَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ وَعَلَى رَأْسِهِ مِغْفَرٌ فَلَمَّا نَزَعَهُ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ ابْنُ خَطَلٍ مُتَعَلِّقٌ بِأَسْتَارِ الْكَعْبَةِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اقْتُلُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَالِكٌ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa alqa'nabiyyu, wayahyaa bnu yahyaa, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, aammaa alqa'nabiyyu faqaala qaraatu 'alaa maaliki bni aanasin waaammaa qutaybaau faqaala haddathanaa maalikun waqaala yahyaa - waalllafzu lahu - qultu limaalikin aahaddathaka abnu shihaabin 'an aanasi bni maalikin aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala makkaaa 'aama alfathi wa'alaa raasihi mighfarun falammaa naza'ahu jaa'ahu rajulun faqaala abnu khatalin muta'alliqun biaastaari alka'baai ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ aqtuluwhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala maalikun na'am ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) entered Mecca in the Year of Victory with a helmet on his head; and when he took it off, a man came to him and said:Ibn Khatal is hanging on to the curtains of the Ka'ba, whereupon he said: Kill him. Malik (one of the narrators) attested this statement having been made
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الثَّقَفِيُّ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ الدُّهْنِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ مَكَّةَ - وَقَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ دَخَلَ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ - وَعَلَيْهِ عِمَامَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ بِغَيْرِ إِحْرَامٍ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ قُتَيْبَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin althhaqafiyyu, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala, qutaybaau haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu 'ammaarin aldduhniyyu, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala makkaaa - waqaala qutaybaau dakhala yawma fathi makkaaa - wa'alayhi 'imaamaaun sawdaa'u bighayri iihraamin ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai qutaybaaa qaala haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri 'an jaabirin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered Mecca and Qutaiba (another narrator) stated that he entered Mecca in the Year of Victory, wearing a black turban, but not wearing the Ihram
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ الأَوْدِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عَمَّارٍ الدُّهْنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ وَعَلَيْهِ عِمَامَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu hakiymin alaawdiyyu, aakhbaranaa shariykun, 'an 'ammaarin aldduhniyyi, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala yawma fathi makkaaa wa'alayhi 'imaamaaun sawdaa'u ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) entered on the day of Victory of Mecca wearing a black turban on his head
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مُسَاوِرٍ، الْوَرَّاقِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطَبَ النَّاسَ وَعَلَيْهِ عِمَامَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaalaa aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, 'an musaawirin, alwarraaqi 'an ja'fari bni 'amriw bni huraythin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khataba alnnaasa wa'alayhi 'imaamaaun sawdaa'u ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amr b. Huraith reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed the people (on the day of the Victory of Mecca) with a black turban on his head
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَالْحَسَنُ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ مُسَاوِرٍ الْوَرَّاقِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي وَفِي، رِوَايَةِ الْحُلْوَانِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَعْفَرَ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَعَلَيْهِ عِمَامَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ قَدْ أَرْخَى طَرَفَيْهَا بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waalhasanu alhulwaaniyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an musaawirin alwarraaqi, qaala haddathaniy wafiy, riwaayaai alhulwaaniyyi qaala sami'tu ja'fara bna 'amriw bni huraythin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kaaanniy aanzuru iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alminbari wa'alayhi 'imaamaaun sawdaa'u qad aarkhaa tarafayhaa bayna katifayhi ‏.‏ walam yaqul aabuw bakrin 'alaa alminbari ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ja'far b. 'Amr b. Huraith reported his father as saying:As if I am seeing Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the pulpit with a black turban on his head, and its two ends hanging between his shoulders. Abu Bakr (another narrator) did not make mention of:" Upon the pulpit
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى الْمَازِنِيِّ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَرَّمَ مَكَّةَ وَدَعَا لأَهْلِهَا وَإِنِّي حَرَّمْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ كَمَا حَرَّمَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ مَكَّةَ وَإِنِّي دَعَوْتُ فِي صَاعِهَا وَمُدِّهَا بِمِثْلَىْ مَا دَعَا بِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لأَهْلِ مَكَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy abna muhammadin alddaraawardiyya - 'an 'amriw bni yahyaa almaaziniyyi, 'an 'abbaadi bni tamiymin, 'an 'ammihi 'abdi alllahi bni zaydi bni 'aasimin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna iibraahiyma harrama makkaaa wada'aa laahlihaa waiinniy harramtu almadiynaaa kamaa harrama iibraahiymu makkaaa waiinniy da'awtu fiy saa'ihaa wamuddihaa bimithlaa maa da'aa bihi iibraahiymu laahli makkaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Zaid b. 'Asim (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Verily Ibrahim declared Mecca sacred and supplicated (for blessings to be showered) upon its inhabitants, and I declare Medina to be sacred as lbrahim had declared Mecca to be sacred. I have supplicated (Allah for His blessings to be showered) in its sa' and its mudd (two standards of weight and measurement) twice as did Ibrahim for the inhabitants of Mecca
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْمُخْتَارِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى، - هُوَ الْمَازِنِيُّ - بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَمَّا حَدِيثُ وُهَيْبٍ فَكَرِوَايَةِ الدَّرَاوَرْدِيِّ ‏"‏ بِمِثْلَىْ مَا دَعَا بِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَمَّا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ وَعَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ فَفِي رِوَايَتِهِمَا ‏"‏ مِثْلَ مَا دَعَا بِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi ya'niy abna almukhtaari, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, haddathaniy sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, h wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma aakhbaranaa almakhzuwmiyyu, haddathanaa wuhaybun, kulluhum 'an 'amriw bni yahyaa, - huwa almaaziniyyu - bihadhaa aliisnaadi aammaa hadiythu wuhaybin fakariwaayaai alddaraawardiyyi ‏"‏ bimithlaa maa da'aa bihi iibraahiymu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaammaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin wa'abdu al'aziyzi bnu almukhtaari fafiy riwaayatihimaa ‏"‏ mithla maa da'aa bihi iibraahiymu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُضَرَ - عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ أَبِي، بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَرَّمَ مَكَّةَ وَإِنِّي أُحَرِّمُ مَا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَيْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يُرِيدُ الْمَدِينَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa bakrun, - ya'niy abna mudara - 'ani abni alhaadi, 'an aabiy, bakri bni muhammadin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amriw bni 'uthmaana, 'an raafi'i bni khadiyjin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna iibraahiyma harrama makkaaa waiinniy auharrimu maa bayna laabatayhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ yuriydu almadiynaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Rafi' b. Khadij reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Ibrahim declared Mecca as sacred and I declare sacred the area between its two stony grounds (lava lands by which he meant Medina)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، أَنَّ مَرْوَانَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ، خَطَبَ النَّاسَ فَذَكَرَ مَكَّةَ وَأَهْلَهَا وَحُرْمَتَهَا وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْمَدِينَةَ وَأَهْلَهَا وَحُرْمَتَهَا فَنَادَاهُ رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ فَقَالَ مَا لِي أَسْمَعُكَ ذَكَرْتَ مَكَّةَ وَأَهْلَهَا وَحُرْمَتَهَا وَلَمْ تَذْكُرِ الْمَدِينَةَ وَأَهْلَهَا وَحُرْمَتَهَا وَقَدْ حَرَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَيْهَا وَذَلِكَ عِنْدَنَا فِي أَدِيمٍ خَوْلاَنِيٍّ إِنْ شِئْتَ أَقْرَأْتُكَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَكَتَ مَرْوَانُ ثُمَّ قَالَ قَدْ سَمِعْتُ بَعْضَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an 'utbaaa bni muslimin, 'an naafi'i bni jubayrin, aanna marwaana bna alhakami, khataba alnnaasa fadhakara makkaaa waaahlahaa wahurmatahaa walam yadhkuri almadiynaaa waaahlahaa wahurmatahaa fanaadaahu raafi'u bnu khadiyjin faqaala maa liy aasma'uka dhakarta makkaaa waaahlahaa wahurmatahaa walam tadhkuri almadiynaaa waaahlahaa wahurmatahaa waqad harrama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa bayna laabatayhaa wadhalika 'indanaa fiy aadiymin khawlaaniyyin iin shiita aaqraatukahu ‏.‏ qaala fasakata marwaanu thumma qaala qad sami'tu ba'da dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' b. Jubair reported that Marwan b. al-Hakam (Allah be pleased with him) addressed people and made mention of Mecca and its inhabitants and its sacredness, but he made no mention of Medina, its inhabitants and its sacredness. Rafi' b. Khadij called to him and said:What is this that I hear you making mention of Mecca and its inhabitants and its sacredness, but you did not make mention of Medina and its inhabitants and its sacredness, while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has also declared sacred (the area) between its two lava lands (Medina)? And (we have record of this) with us written on Khaulani parchment. If you like, I can read it out to you. Thereupon Marwan became silent, and then Said: I too have heard some part of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي أَحْمَدَ، - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَسْدِيُّ، - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَرَّمَ مَكَّةَ وَإِنِّي حَرَّمْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ مَا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَيْهَا لاَ يُقْطَعُ عِضَاهُهَا وَلاَ يُصَادُ صَيْدُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, kilaahumaa 'an aabiy aahmada, - qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alaasdiyyu, - haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna iibraahiyma harrama makkaaa waiinniy harramtu almadiynaaa maa bayna laabatayhaa laa yuqta'u 'idaahuhaa walaa yusaadu sayduhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Ibrahim declared Mecca as sacred; I declare Medina, that between the two mountains, as inviolable. No tree should be lopped and no game is to be molested
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنِّي أُحَرِّمُ مَا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَىِ الْمَدِينَةِ أَنْ يُقْطَعَ عِضَاهُهَا أَوْ يُقْتَلَ صَيْدُهَا - وَقَالَ - الْمَدِينَةُ خَيْرٌ لَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ لاَ يَدَعُهَا أَحَدٌ رَغْبَةً عَنْهَا إِلاَّ أَبْدَلَ اللَّهُ فِيهَا مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ وَلاَ يَثْبُتُ أَحَدٌ عَلَى لأْوَائِهَا وَجَهْدِهَا إِلاَّ كُنْتُ لَهُ شَفِيعًا أَوْ شَهِيدًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu hakiymin, haddathaniy 'aamiru bnu sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinniy auharrimu maa bayna laabataai almadiynaai aan yuqta'a 'idaahuhaa aaw yuqtala sayduhaa - waqaala - almadiynaau khayrun lahum law kaanuwa ya'lamuwna laa yada'uhaa aahadun raghbaaan 'anhaa iilaaa aabdala alllahu fiyhaa man huwa khayrun minhu walaa yathbutu aahadun 'alaa lawaaiihaa wajahdihaa iilaaa kuntu lahu shafiy'ana aaw shahiydana yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:I have declared sacred the territory between the two lava plains of Medina, so its trees should not be cut down, or its game killed; and he also said: Medina is best for them if they knew. No one leaves it through dislike of it without Allah putting in it someone better than he in place of him; and no one will stay there in spite of its hardships and distress without my being an intercessor or witness on behalf of him on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ وَزَادَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ ‏ "‏ وَلاَ يُرِيدُ أَحَدٌ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ بِسُوءٍ إِلاَّ أَذَابَهُ اللَّهُ فِي النَّارِ ذَوْبَ الرَّصَاصِ أَوْ ذَوْبَ الْمِلْحِ فِي الْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa marwaanu bnu mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu hakiymin alaansaariyyu, aakhbaraniy 'aamiru bnu sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏.‏ thumma dhakara mithla hadiythi abni numayrin wazaada fiy alhadiythi ‏ "‏ walaa yuriydu aahadun aahla almadiynaai bisuw'in iilaaa aadhaabahu alllahu fiy alnnaari dhawba alrrasaasi aaw dhawba almilhi fiy almaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, and then the (above-mentioned) hadith was narrated with this addition:" None should nurse ill-will towards the people of Medina, or Allah will melt him in fire like the melting of lead or the dissolution of salt in water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الْعَقَدِيِّ، - قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ، سَعْدٍ أَنَّ سَعْدًا، رَكِبَ إِلَى قَصْرِهِ بِالْعَقِيقِ فَوَجَدَ عَبْدًا يَقْطَعُ شَجَرًا أَوْ يَخْبِطُهُ فَسَلَبَهُ فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ سَعْدٌ جَاءَهُ أَهْلُ الْعَبْدِ فَكَلَّمُوهُ أَنْ يَرُدَّ عَلَى غُلاَمِهِمْ أَوْ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا أَخَذَ مِنْ غُلاَمِهِمْ فَقَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ أَنْ أَرُدَّ شَيْئًا نَفَّلَنِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَأَبَى أَنْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, jamiy'ana 'ani al'aqadiyyi, - qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa 'abdu almaliki bnu 'amrinw, - haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu ja'farin, 'an iismaa'iyla bni muhammadin, 'an 'aamiri bni, sa'din aanna sa'dana, rakiba iilaa qasrihi bial'aqiyqi fawajada 'abdana yaqta'u shajarana aaw yakhbituhu fasalabahu falammaa raja'a sa'dun jaa'ahu aahlu al'abdi fakallamuwhu aan yarudda 'alaa ghulaamihim aaw 'alayhim maa aakhadha min ghulaamihim faqaala ma'aadha alllahi aan aarudda shayiana naffalaniyhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ waaabaa aan yarudda 'alayhim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Sa'd reported that Sa'd rode to his castle in al-'Aqiq and found a slave cutting down the trees, or beating off their leaves, so he stripped him off his belongings. When Sa'd returned, there came to him the masters of the slave and negotiated with him asking him to return to their slave or to them what he had taken from their slave, whereupon he said:God forbid that I should return anything which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has given me as spoil, and refused to return anything to them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، - قَالَ ابْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، - أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرٍو، مَوْلَى الْمُطَّلِبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَنْطَبٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَبِي طَلْحَةَ ‏"‏ الْتَمِسْ لِي غُلاَمًا مِنْ غِلْمَانِكُمْ يَخْدُمُنِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ بِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ يُرْدِفُنِي وَرَاءَهُ فَكُنْتُ أَخْدُمُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُلَّمَا نَزَلَ وَقَالَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ حَتَّى إِذَا بَدَا لَهُ أُحُدٌ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَذَا جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَشْرَفَ عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحَرِّمُ مَا بَيْنَ جَبَلَيْهَا مِثْلَ مَا حَرَّمَ بِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ مَكَّةَ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي مُدِّهِمْ وَصَاعِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waabnu, hujrin jamiy'ana 'an iismaa'iyla, - qaala abnu aayyuwba haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, - aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu aabiy 'amrinw, mawlaa almuttalibi bni 'abdi alllahi bni hantabin aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laabiy talhaaa ‏"‏ altamis liy ghulaamana min ghilmaanikum yakhdumuniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fakharaja biy aabuw talhaaa yurdifuniy waraa'ahu fakuntu aakhdumu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kullamaa nazala waqaala fiy alhadiythi thumma aaqbala hattaa iidhaa badaa lahu auhudun qaala ‏"‏ hadhaa jabalun yuhibbunaa wanuhibbuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falammaa aashrafa 'alaa almadiynaai qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma iinniy auharrimu maa bayna jabalayhaa mithla maa harrama bihi iibraahiymu makkaaa alllahumma baarik lahum fiy muddihim wasaa'ihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Abu Talha (Allah be pleased with him):Find for me a servant from amongst your boys to serve me. Abu Talha went out along with me and made me sit behind him. And I used to serve Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whenever he got down from the camel. And in one hadith he said: He proceeded and when (the mountain of) Uhud was within sight, he said: This is the mountain which loves us and we love it. And as he came close to Medina he said: O Allah, I declare (the area) between the two mountains of it (Medina) sacred just as Ibrahim declared Mecca as sacred. O Allah, bless them (the people of Medina) in their mudd and sa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيُّ - عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي أُحَرِّمُ مَا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَيْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaalaa haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyyu - 'an 'amriw bni aabiy 'amrinw, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ iinniy auharrimu maa bayna laabatayhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported a hadith like this from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) except with this variation that he said:" I declare sacred the area between its two lava mountains
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَحَرَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ قَالَ نَعَمْ مَا بَيْنَ كَذَا إِلَى كَذَا فَمَنْ أَحْدَثَ فِيهَا حَدَثًا - قَالَ - ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي هَذِهِ شَدِيدَةٌ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَحْدَثَ فِيهَا حَدَثًا فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ لاَ يَقْبَلُ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ صَرْفًا وَلاَ عَدْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ ابْنُ أَنَسٍ أَوْ آوَى مُحْدِثًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu haamidu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, haddathanaa 'aasimun, qaala qultu laanasi bni maalikin aaharrama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa qaala na'am maa bayna kadhaa iilaa kadhaa faman aahdatha fiyhaa hadathana - qaala - thumma qaala liy hadhihi shadiydaaun ‏ "‏ man aahdatha fiyhaa hadathana fa'alayhi la'naau alllahi waalmalaaiikaai waalnnaasi aajma'iyna laa yaqbalu alllahu minhu yawma alqiyaamaai sarfana walaa 'adlaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqaala abnu aanasin aaw awaa muhdithana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Asim reported:I asked Anas b. Malik whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had declared Medina as sacred. He said: Yes. (the area) between so and so. He who made any innovation in it, and further said to me: It is something serious to make any innovation in it (and he who does it) there is upon him the curse of Allah, and that of the angels and of all the people, Allah will not accept from him on the Day of Resurrection either obligatory acts or the surpererogatory acts. Ibn Anas said: Or he accommodates an innovator
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسًا أَحَرَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ قَالَ نَعَمْ هِيَ حَرَامٌ لاَ يُخْتَلَى خَلاَهَا فَمَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa 'aasimun alaahwalu, qaala saaaltu aanasana aaharrama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa qaala na'am hiya haraamun laa yukhtalaa khalaahaa faman fa'ala dhalika fa'alayhi la'naau alllahi waalmalaaiikaai waalnnaasi aajma'iyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Asim reported:I asked Anas (Allah be pleased with him) whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had declared Medina as sacred. He said: Yes, it is sacred, so its tree is not to be cut; and he who did that let the curse of Allah and that of the angels and of all people be upon him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي مِكْيَالِهِمْ وَبَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي صَاعِهِمْ وَبَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي مُدِّهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, fiymaa quriia 'alayhi 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi, alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma baarik lahum fiy mikyaalihim wabaarik lahum fiy saa'ihim wabaarik lahum fiy muddihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Allah bless them in their measurements, bless them in their sa's and bless them in their mudd
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ السَّامِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ يُونُسَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ بِالْمَدِينَةِ ضِعْفَىْ مَا بِمَكَّةَ مِنَ الْبَرَكَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waiibraahiymu bnu muhammadin alssaamiyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, haddathanaa aabiy qaala, sami'tu yuwnusa, yuhaddithu 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alllahumma aj'al bialmadiynaai di'faa maa bimakkaaa mina albarakaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik (Allah he pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:O Allah, increase in Medina twice the blessings (Thou showered) on Mecca
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
