verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waabnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu li'amrinw - qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu, 'uyaynaaa 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu shaddaadin wadhukira almutalaa'inaani 'inda abni 'abbaasin faqaala abnu shaddaadin aahumaa allladhaani qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ law kuntu raajimana aahadana bighayri bayyinaain larajamtuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala abnu 'abbaasin laa tilka amraaaaun aa'lanat ‏.‏ qaala abnu aabiy 'umara fiy riwaayatihi 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b Shaddad reported that mention was made about the invokers of curses before Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them). Ibn Shaddad said:Are these the two about whom Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said." If I were to stone one without evidence, I would have definitely stoned her"? Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) said: She is not this woman; but she is the one who (committed adultery) openly
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 19 — The Book of Invoking Curses
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَادَةَ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ الرَّجُلَ يَجِدُ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً أَيَقْتُلُهُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَعْدٌ بَلَى وَالَّذِي أَكْرَمَكَ بِالْحَقِّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اسْمَعُوا إِلَى مَا يَقُولُ سَيِّدُكُمْ ‏"‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy alddaraawardiyya - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna sa'da bna 'ubaadaaa alaansaariyya, qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraaayta alrrajula yajidu ma'a amraaatihi rajulaan aayaqtuluhu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala sa'dun balaa waalladhiy aakramaka bialhaqqi ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ asma'uwa iilaa maa yaquwlu sayyidukum ‏"‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Sa'd b. 'Ubada al-Ansari said:Messenger of Allah, tell me if a man finds his wife with another person, should he kill him? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: No. Sa'd said: Why not? I swear by Him Who has honored you with the Truth. There upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Listen to what your chief says
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 19 — The Book of Invoking Curses
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَادَةَ، قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنْ وَجَدْتُ مَعَ امْرَأَتِي رَجُلاً أَأُمْهِلُهُ حَتَّى آتِيَ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu 'iysaa, haddathanaa maalikun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna sa'da bna 'ubaadaaa, qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iin wajadtu ma'a amraaatiy rajulaan aaaumhiluhu hattaa atiya biaarba'aai shuhadaa'a qaala ‏ "‏ na'am ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Sa'd b. Ubada (Allah be pleased with him) said:Messenger of Allah, if I were to find with my wife a man, should I wait until I bring four witnesses? He said: Yes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 19 — The Book of Invoking Curses
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوْ وَجَدْتُ مَعَ أَهْلِي رَجُلاً لَمْ أَمَسَّهُ حَتَّى آتِيَ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ كَلاَّ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ إِنْ كُنْتُ لأُعَاجِلُهُ بِالسَّيْفِ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اسْمَعُوا إِلَى مَا يَقُولُ سَيِّدُكُمْ إِنَّهُ لَغَيُورٌ وَأَنَا أَغْيَرُ مِنْهُ وَاللَّهُ أَغْيَرُ مِنِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, 'an sulaymaana bni bilaalin, haddathaniy suhaylun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala sa'du bnu 'ubaadaaa yaa rasuwla alllahi law wajadtu ma'a aahliy rajulaan lam aamassahu hattaa atiya biaarba'aai shuhadaa'a qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala kalaaa waalladhiy ba'athaka bialhaqqi iin kuntu lau'aajiluhu bialssayfi qabla dhalika ‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ asma'uwa iilaa maa yaquwlu sayyidukum iinnahu laghayuwrun waaanaa aaghyaru minhu waalllahu aaghyaru minniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Sa'd b. Ubada (Allah be pleased with him) said:Messenger of Allah, if I were to find with my wife a man, should I not touch him before bringing four witnesses? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Yes. He said: By no means. By Him Who has sent you with the Truth, I would hasten with my sword to him before that. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Listen to what your chief says. He is jealous of his honour, I am more jealous than he (is) and God is more jealous than I
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 19 — The Book of Invoking Curses
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كَامِلٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ، - كَاتِبِ الْمُغِيرَةِ - عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ لَوْ رَأَيْتُ رَجُلاً مَعَ امْرَأَتِي لَضَرَبْتُهُ بِالسَّيْفِ غَيْرَ مُصْفِحٍ عَنْهُ ‏.‏ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَتَعْجَبُونَ مِنْ غَيْرَةِ سَعْدٍ فَوَاللَّهِ لأَنَا أَغْيَرُ مِنْهُ وَاللَّهُ أَغْيَرُ مِنِّي مِنْ أَجْلِ غَيْرَةِ اللَّهِ حَرَّمَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَلاَ شَخْصَ أَغْيَرُ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَلاَ شَخْصَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ الْعُذْرُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ بَعَثَ اللَّهُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنْذِرِينَ وَلاَ شَخْصَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ الْمِدْحَةُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, waaabuw kaamilin fudaylu bnu husaynin aljahdariyyu - waalllafzu laabiy kaamilin - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an warraadin, - kaatibi almughiyraai - 'ani almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, qaala qaala sa'du bnu 'ubaadaaa law raaaytu rajulaan ma'a amraaatiy ladarabtuhu bialssayfi ghayra musfihin 'anhu ‏.‏ fabalagha dhalika rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ aata'jabuwna min ghayraai sa'din fawaalllahi laanaa aaghyaru minhu waalllahu aaghyaru minniy min aajli ghayraai alllahi harrama alfawaahisha maa zahara minhaa wamaa batana walaa shakhsa aaghyaru mina alllahi walaa shakhsa aahabbu iilayhi al'udhru mina alllahi min aajli dhalika ba'atha alllahu almursaliyna mubashhiriyna wamundhiriyna walaa shakhsa aahabbu iilayhi almidhaau mina alllahi min aajli dhalika wa'ada alllahu aljannaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: AI-Mughira b. Shu'ba (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Sa'd b. 'Ubada (Allah be pleased with him) said:If I were to see a man with my wife, I would have struck him with the sword, and not with the flat part (side) of it. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard of that, he said: Are you surprised at Sa'd's jealousy of his honour? By Allah, I am more jealous of my honour than he, and Allah is more jealous than I. Because of His jealousy Allah has prohibited abomination, both open and secret And no person is more jealous of his honour than Allah, and no persons, is more fond of accepting an excuse than Allah, on account of which He has sent messengers, announcers of glad tidings and warners; and no one is more fond of praise than Allah on account of which Allah has promised Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 19 — The Book of Invoking Curses
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ غَيْرَ مُصْفِحٍ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ عَنْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa husaynu bnu 'aliyyin, 'an zaaiidaaa, 'an 'abdi almaliki, bni 'umayrin bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏ waqaala ghayra musfihin ‏.‏ walam yaqul 'anhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority, of 'Abd al-Malik b. Umair with the same chain of narraters but with a slight change of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 19 — The Book of Invoking Curses
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِقُتَيْبَةَ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي فَزَارَةَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنَّ امْرَأَتِي وَلَدَتْ غُلاَمًا أَسْوَدَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلْ لَكَ مِنْ إِبِلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَمَا أَلْوَانُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ حُمْرٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ فِيهَا مِنْ أَوْرَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لَوُرْقًا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَنَّى أَتَاهَا ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَسَى أَنْ يَكُونَ نَزَعَهُ عِرْقٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَهَذَا عَسَى أَنْ يَكُونَ نَزَعَهُ عِرْقٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu wazuhayru bnu harbin - waalllafzu liqutaybaaa - qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala jaa'a rajulun min baniy fazaaraaa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala iinna amraaatiy waladat ghulaamana aaswada ‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hal laka min iibilin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ famaa aalwaanuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala humrun ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ hal fiyhaa min aawraqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala iinna fiyhaa lawurqana ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaannaa aataahaa dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'asaa aan yakuwna naza'ahu 'irqun ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ wahadhaa 'asaa aan yakuwna naza'ahu 'irqun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported:There came a person to the Prophet (may peace he upon him) ) from Banu Fazara and said: My wife has given birth to a child who is black, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Have you any camels? He said: Yes. He again said: What is this colour? He said: They are red. He said: Is there a dusky one among them? He said: Yes, there are dusky ones among them He said: How has it come about? He said: It is perhaps the strain to which it has reverted, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: It is perhaps the strain to which he (the child) has reverted
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 19 — The Book of Invoking Curses
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلَدَتِ امْرَأَتِي غُلاَمًا أَسْوَدَ وَهُوَ حِينَئِذٍ يُعَرِّضُ بِأَنْ يَنْفِيَهُ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِي آخِرِ الْحَدِيثِ وَلَمْ يُرَخِّصْ لَهُ فِي الاِنْتِفَاءِ مِنْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala abnu raafi'in haddathanaa waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h wahaddathanaa abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu, aabiy fudaykin aakhbaranaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, jamiy'ana 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi abni 'uyaynaaa ‏.‏ ghayra aanna fiy, hadiythi ma'marin faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi waladati amraaatiy ghulaamana aaswada wahuwa hiynaiidhin yu'arridu biaan yanfiyahu ‏.‏ wazaada fiy akhiri alhadiythi walam yurakhhis lahu fiy alaintifaa'i minhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ma'mar, the (words are):" Messenger of Allah, my wife has given birth to a dark-complexioned boy, and he at that time was intending to disown him." And this addition has been made at the end of the hadith:" He (the Holy Prophet) did not permit him to disown him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 19 — The Book of Invoking Curses
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِحَرْمَلَةَ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ، وَهْبٍ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّصلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ امْرَأَتِي وَلَدَتْ غُلاَمًا أَسْوَدَ وَإِنِّي أَنْكَرْتُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلْ لَكَ مِنْ إِبِلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَلْوَانُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ حُمْرٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلْ فِيهَا مِنْ أَوْرَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَأَنَّى هُوَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لَعَلَّهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ يَكُونُ نَزَعَهُ عِرْقٌ لَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَهَذَا لَعَلَّهُ يَكُونُ نَزَعَهُ عِرْقٌ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu liharmalaaa - qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu, wahbin aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannasla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna amraaatiy waladat ghulaamana aaswada waiinniy aankartuhu ‏.‏ faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hal laka min iibilin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ maa aalwaanuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala humrun ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fahal fiyhaa min aawraqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ faaannaa huwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala la'allahu yaa rasuwla alllahi yakuwnu naza'ahu 'irqun lahu ‏.‏ faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ wahadhaa la'allahu yakuwnu naza'ahu 'irqun lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported:A desert Arab came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: My wife has given birth to a dark-complexioned child and I have disowned him. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Have you any camels? He said: Yes. He said: What is their colour? He said? They are red. He said: Is there anyone dusky among them? He said: Yes. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: How has it come about? He said: Messenger of Allah, it is perhaps due to the strain to which it has reverted, whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said: It (the birth) of the black child may be due to the strain to which he (the child) might have reverted
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 19 — The Book of Invoking Curses
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُجَيْنٌ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، كَانَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa hujaynun, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aannahu qaala balaghanaa aanna aabaa hurayraaa, kaana yuhaddithu 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwi hadiythihim‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِمَالِكٍ حَدَّثَكَ نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ شِرْكًا لَهُ فِي عَبْدٍ فَكَانَ لَهُ مَالٌ يَبْلُغُ ثَمَنَ الْعَبْدِ قُوِّمَ عَلَيْهِ قِيمَةَ الْعَدْلِ فَأُعْطِيَ شُرَكَاؤُهُ حِصَصَهُمْ وَعَتَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْعَبْدُ وَإِلاَّ فَقَدْ عَتَقَ مِنْهُ مَا عَتَقَ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qultu limaalikin haddathaka naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man aa'taqa shirkana lahu fiy 'abdin fakaana lahu maalun yablughu thamana al'abdi quwwima 'alayhi qiymaaa al'adli faau'tiya shurakaauuhu hisasahum wa'ataqa 'alayhi al'abdu waiilaaa faqad 'ataqa minhu maa 'ataqa‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger may peace be upon him) as saying:If anyone emancipates his share ina slave and has enough money to pay the full price for him, a fair price for the slave should be fixed, his partners given their shares, and the slave be thus emancipated, otherwise he is emancipated only to the extent of the first man's share
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، الأَيْلِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, jamiy'ana 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, h wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu, almuthannaa haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, qaala sami'tu yahyaa bna sa'iydin, h wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy iismaa'iylu bnu aumayyaaa, h wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin, alaayliyyu haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy ausaamaau, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, 'ani abni aabiy dhiibin, kullu hauulaa'i 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, bima'naa hadiythi maalikin 'an naafi'in.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ نَهِيكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فِي الْمَمْلُوكِ بَيْنَ الرَّجُلَيْنِ فَيُعْتِقُ أَحَدُهُمَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَضْمَنُ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu ja'farin haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'ani alnnadri bni aanasin, 'an bashiyri bni nahiykin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fiy almamluwki bayna alrrajulayni fayu'tiqu aahaduhumaa qaala ‏ "‏ yadmanu‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The slave who is jointly owned by two persons, and is emancipated by one of them, (this one) has liability (upon him to secure complete freedom for that slave)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ نَهِيكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ شِقْصًا لَهُ فِي عَبْدٍ فَخَلاَصُهُ فِي مَالِهِ إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ مَالٌ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ اسْتُسْعِيَ الْعَبْدُ غَيْرَ مَشْقُوقٍ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'ani abni aabiy 'aruwbaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'ani alnnadri bni aanasin, 'an bashiyri bni nahiykin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man aa'taqa shiqsana lahu fiy 'abdin fakhalaasuhu fiy maalihi iin kaana lahu maalun faiin lam yakun lahu maalun astus'iya al'abdu ghayra mashquwqin 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased witli him) reported Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) as saying:If anyone emancipates a share in a slave, he is to be completely emancipated if he has money; but if he has none, the slave will be required to work to pay for his freedom, but must not be over-burhened
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ يُونُسَ - عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ، أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ قُوِّمَ عَلَيْهِ الْعَبْدُ قِيمَةَ عَدْلٍ ثُمَّ يُسْتَسْعَى فِي نَصِيبِ الَّذِي لَمْ يُعْتِقْ غَيْرَ مَشْقُوقٍ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, - ya'niy abna yuwnusa - 'an sa'iydi bni, aabiy 'aruwbaaa bihadhaa aliisnaadi wazaada ‏ "‏ iin lam yakun lahu maalun quwwima 'alayhi al'abdu qiymaaa 'adlin thumma yustas'aa fiy nasiybi alladhiy lam yu'tiq ghayra mashquwqin 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sa'id b. Abu 'Aruba with the same chain of transmitters but with the addition:" If he (one of the joint owners emancipating the slave) has not (enough) money (to secure freedom for the other half) a fair price for the slave should be fixed, and he will be required to work to pay for his freedom, but must not be over-burdened
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ وَذَكَرَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ قُوِّمَ عَلَيْهِ قِيمَةَ عَدْلٍ
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, haddathanaa aabiy qaala, sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu bihadhaa aliisnaadi bima'naa hadiythi abni aabiy 'aruwbaaa wadhakara fiy alhadiythi quwwima 'alayhi qiymaaa 'adlin
verses.translation: A hadith like this is reported on the authority of the same chain of transmitters but with a slight change of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا أَرَادَتْ أَنْ تَشْتَرِيَ، جَارِيَةً تُعْتِقُهَا فَقَالَ أَهْلُهَا نَبِيعُكِهَا عَلَى أَنَّ وَلاَءَهَا لَنَا ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَمْنَعُكِ ذَلِكَ فَإِنَّمَا الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa aaraadat aan tashtariya, jaariyaaan tu'tiquhaa faqaala aahluhaa nabiy'ukihaa 'alaa aanna walaa'ahaa lanaa ‏.‏ fadhakarat dhalika lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ laa yamna'uki dhalika faiinnamaa alwalaa'u liman aa'taqa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that 'A'isha decided to buy a slave-girl and then set her free, but her masters said:We are prepared to sell her to you on the condition that her right of inheritance would vest with you. She (Hadrat A'isha) made a mention of that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whereupon he said: This should not stand in your way. The right of inheritance vests in one who emancipates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ بَرِيرَةَ جَاءَتْ عَائِشَةَ تَسْتَعِينُهَا فِي كِتَابَتِهَا وَلَمْ تَكُنْ قَضَتْ مِنْ كِتَابَتِهَا شَيْئًا فَقَالَتْ لَهَا عَائِشَةُ ارْجِعِي إِلَى أَهْلِكِ فَإِنْ أَحَبُّوا أَنْ أَقْضِيَ عَنْكِ كِتَابَتَكِ وَيَكُونَ وَلاَؤُكِ لِي ‏.‏ فَعَلْتُ فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ بَرِيرَةُ لأَهْلِهَا فَأَبَوْا وَقَالُوا إِنْ شَاءَتْ أَنْ تَحْتَسِبَ عَلَيْكِ فَلْتَفْعَلْ وَيَكُونَ لَنَا وَلاَؤُكِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ابْتَاعِي فَأَعْتِقِي ‏.‏ فَإِنَّمَا الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَالُ أُنَاسٍ يَشْتَرِطُونَ شُرُوطًا لَيْسَتْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ مَنِ اشْتَرَطَ شَرْطًا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ لَهُ وَإِنْ شَرَطَ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ شَرْطُ اللَّهِ أَحَقُّ وَأَوْثَقُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, aanna 'aaiishaaa, aakhbarathu aanna bariyraaa jaa'at 'aaiishaaa tasta'iynuhaa fiy kitaabatihaa walam takun qadat min kitaabatihaa shayiana faqaalat lahaa 'aaiishaau arji'iy iilaa aahliki faiin aahabbuwa aan aaqdiya 'anki kitaabataki wayakuwna walaauuki liy ‏.‏ fa'altu fadhakarat dhalika bariyraau laahlihaa faaabawa waqaaluwa iin shaa'at aan tahtasiba 'alayki faltaf'al wayakuwna lanaa walaauuki ‏.‏ fadhakarat dhalika lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ abtaa'iy faaa'tiqiy ‏.‏ faiinnamaa alwalaa'u liman aa'taqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ maa baalu aunaasin yashtarituwna shuruwtana laysat fiy kitaabi alllahi mani ashtarata shartana laysa fiy kitaabi alllahi falaysa lahu waiin sharata miaiaaa marraain shartu alllahi aahaqqu waaawthaqu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pjeased with her) reported that Barira came to her in order to seek her help in securing freedom, but she had (so far) paid nothing out of that sum stipulated in the contract. 'A'isba said to her. Go to your family (who owns you), and if they like that I should pay the amount (of the contract) on your behalf (for purchasing your freedom), then I shall have the right in your inheritance. (If they accepted it) I am prepared (to make this payment). Barira made a mention of that to the (members of) her family, but they refused and said:If she (Hadrat 'A'isha) wants to do good to You for the sake of Allah, she may do it, but the right of inheritance will be ours. She (Hadrat 'A'isha) made a mention of that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he said to her: Buy her, and emancipate her, for the right of inheritance vests with one who emancipates (the slave). Allah's Messenger, may peace be upon him) then stood up and said: What has happened to the people that they lay down conditions which are not (found) in the Book of Allah? And he who laid down a condition not found in the Book of Allah, that is not valid. even if it is laid down hundred times. The condition laid down by Allah is the most weighty and the most valid
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ جَاءَتْ بَرِيرَةُ إِلَىَّ فَقَالَتْ يَا عَائِشَةُ إِنِّي كَاتَبْتُ أَهْلِي عَلَى تِسْعِ أَوَاقٍ فِي كُلِّ عَامٍ أُوقِيَّةٌ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ وَزَادَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَمْنَعُكِ ذَلِكِ مِنْهَا ابْتَاعِي وَأَعْتِقِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ ثُمَّ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي النَّاسِ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, bni alzzubayri 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa qaalat jaa'at bariyraau iilaaaa faqaalat yaa 'aaiishaau iinniy kaatabtu aahliy 'alaa tis'i aawaaqin fiy kulli 'aamin auwqiyyaaun ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi alllaythi wazaada faqaala ‏"‏ laa yamna'uki dhaliki minhaa abtaa'iy waaa'tiqiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala fiy alhadiythi thumma qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alnnaasi fahamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi thumma qaala ‏"‏ aammaa ba'du ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported:Barira came to me and said: 'A'isha, I have entered into contract for securing freedom with my family (who owns me) for nine 'uqiyas (of silver), one 'uqiya every year The rest of the hadith is the same (but with this addition):" This (the problem of the right of inheritance) should not stand in your way. Buy her, and set her free. He said in a hadith: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up among men, extolled Allah, praised Him, and then said:" for
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ، بْنُ عُرْوَةَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَتْ عَلَىَّ بَرِيرَةُ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ أَهْلِي كَاتَبُونِي عَلَى تِسْعِ أَوَاقٍ فِي تِسْعِ سِنِينَ فِي كُلِّ سَنَةٍ أُوقِيَّةٌ ‏.‏ فَأَعِينِينِي ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا إِنْ شَاءَ أَهْلُكِ أَنْ أَعُدَّهَا لَهُمْ عَدَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأُعْتِقَكِ وَيَكُونَ الْوَلاَءُ لِي فَعَلْتُ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لأَهْلِهَا فَأَبَوْا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ الْوَلاَءُ لَهُمْ فَأَتَتْنِي فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ قَالَتْ فَانْتَهَرْتُهَا فَقَالَتْ لاَهَا اللَّهِ إِذَا قَالَتْ ‏.‏ فَسَمِعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَنِي فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اشْتَرِيهَا وَأَعْتِقِيهَا وَاشْتَرِطِي لَهُمُ الْوَلاَءَ فَإِنَّ الْوَلاَءَ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَفَعَلْتُ - قَالَتْ - ثُمَّ خَطَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَشِيَّةً فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ بِمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَمَا بَالُ أَقْوَامٍ يَشْتَرِطُونَ شُرُوطًا لَيْسَتْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ مَا كَانَ مِنْ شَرْطٍ لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فَهُوَ بَاطِلٌ وَإِنْ كَانَ مِائَةَ شَرْطٍ كِتَابُ اللَّهِ أَحَقُّ وَشَرْطُ اللَّهِ أَوْثَقُ مَا بَالُ رِجَالٍ مِنْكُمْ يَقُولُ أَحَدُهُمْ أَعْتِقْ فُلاَنًا وَالْوَلاَءُ لِي إِنَّمَا الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i alhamdaaniyyu haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa hishaamu, bnu 'urwaaa aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat dakhalat 'alaaaa bariyraau faqaalat iinna aahliy kaatabuwniy 'alaa tis'i aawaaqin fiy tis'i siniyna fiy kulli sanaain auwqiyyaaun ‏.‏ faaa'iyniyniy ‏.‏ faqultu lahaa iin shaa'a aahluki aan aa'uddahaa lahum 'addaaan waahidaaan waau'tiqaki wayakuwna alwalaa'u liy fa'altu ‏.‏ fadhakarat dhalika laahlihaa faaabawa iilaaa aan yakuwna alwalaa'u lahum faaatatniy fadhakarat dhalika qaalat faantahartuhaa faqaalat laahaa alllahi iidhaa qaalat ‏.‏ fasami'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalaniy faaakhbartuhu faqaala ‏"‏ ashtariyhaa waaa'tiqiyhaa waashtaritiy lahumu alwalaa'a faiinna alwalaa'a liman aa'taqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fafa'altu - qaalat - thumma khataba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ashiyyaaan fahamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi bimaa huwa aahluhu thumma qaala ‏"‏ aammaa ba'du famaa baalu aaqwaamin yashtarituwna shuruwtana laysat fiy kitaabi alllahi maa kaana min shartin laysa fiy kitaabi alllahi 'azza wajalla fahuwa baatilun waiin kaana miaiaaa shartin kitaabu alllahi aahaqqu washartu alllahi aawthaqu maa baalu rijaalin minkum yaquwlu aahaduhum aa'tiq fulaanana waalwalaa'u liy iinnamaa alwalaa'u liman aa'taqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:Barira came to me and said: My family (owners) have made contract with me (for granting freedom) for nine 'uqiyas (of silver) payable in nine years, one 'uqiya every year. Help me (in making this payment). I said to her: If your family so desires, I am prepared to make them the full payment in one instalment, and thus secure freedom for you, but the right of inheritance will vest in me, if I do so. She (Barira) made a mention of that to her family, but they refused (except) on the condition that the right of inheritance would vest in them. She came to me and made mention of if She ('A'isha) said: I scolded her. She (Barira) said: By Allah, it is not possible (they will never agree to it). And as she was saying it, Allah's messenger (ﷺ) heard, and he asked me, I informed him and he said: Buy her and emancipate her, and let the right of inherit- ance vest in them, for they cannot claim it (rightfully) since the right of inherritance vests with one who emancipates (the slave; therefore, these people have no right to lay such false claims). And I did so. She ('A'isha) said: Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivered a sermon in the evening. He extolled Allah and praised Him with what He deserves, and then said afterwards,: What has happened to the people that they lay down conditions which are not found in the Book of Allah? And the condition which is not found in the Book of Allah is invalid, even if its number is one hundred. The Book of Allah is more true (than any other deed) and the condition laid down by Allah is more binding (than any other condition). What has happened to the people among you that someone among you says:" Emancipate so and so, but the right of inheritance vests in me"? Verily, the right of inheritance vests in one who emancipates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ قَالَ وَكَانَ زَوْجُهَا عَبْدًا فَخَيَّرَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا وَلَوْ كَانَ حُرًّا لَمْ يُخَيِّرْهَا ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏ "‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu numayrin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'an jariyrin, kulluhum 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi aabiy ausaamaaa ghayra aanna fiy, hadiythi jariyrin qaala wakaana zawjuhaa 'abdana fakhayyarahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faakhtaarat nafsahaa walaw kaana hurrana lam yukhayyirhaa ‏.‏ walaysa fiy hadiythihim ‏ "‏ aammaa ba'du ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hisham b. 'Urwa narrated a hadith like this with the same chain of trans- mitters except (with this change) that in the hadith transmitted on the authority of jartr (the words are):Her (Barira's) husband was a slave, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave her the option (either to retain her matrimonial relation with her husband or sever it off). She opted to break off (and secure freedom for her even from the matrimonial alliance). And if he were free he would not have given her the option. In the hadith narrated on the authority (of this chain of transmitters) these words are not found: Amma ba'du
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ فِي بَرِيرَةَ ثَلاَثُ قَضِيَّاتٍ أَرَادَ أَهْلُهَا أَنْ يَبِيعُوهَا وَيَشْتَرِطُوا وَلاَءَهَا فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اشْتَرِيهَا وَأَعْتِقِيهَا فَإِنَّ الْوَلاَءَ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَعَتَقَتْ فَخَيَّرَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَكَانَ النَّاسُ يَتَصَدَّقُونَ عَلَيْهَا وَتُهْدِي لَنَا ‏.‏ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هُوَ عَلَيْهَا صَدَقَةٌ وَهُوَ لَكُمْ هَدِيَّةٌ فَكُلُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana fiy bariyraaa thalaathu qadiyyaatin aaraada aahluhaa aan yabiy'uwhaa wayashtarituwa walaa'ahaa fadhakartu dhalika lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ ashtariyhaa waaa'tiqiyhaa faiinna alwalaa'a liman aa'taqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat wa'ataqat fakhayyarahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faakhtaarat nafsahaa ‏.‏ qaalat wakaana alnnaasu yatasaddaquwna 'alayhaa watuhdiy lanaa ‏.‏ fadhakartu dhalika lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ huwa 'alayhaa sadaqaaun wahuwa lakum hadiyyaaun fakuluwhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. al. Qasim reported on the authority of his father:'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: There were three issues which were clarified in case of Barira: her owners had decided to sell her on the condition that the right of her inheritance would vest with them. She ('A'isha) said: I made a mention of that to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he said: Buy her and emancipate her, for verily the right of inheritance vests with one who emancipates. She said that she emancipated (her) and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave her the option (either to retain her matrimonial alliance or break it after emancipation). She (taking advantage of the option) opted for herself (the severing of matrimonial alliance). 'A'isha said: The people used to give her charity and she gave us that as gift. I made a mention of it to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon he said: That is charity for her but gift for you, so take that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، ‏.‏ أَنَّهَا اشْتَرَتْ بَرِيرَةَ مِنْ أُنَاسٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ ‏.‏ وَاشْتَرَطُوا الْوَلاَءَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ وَلِيَ النِّعْمَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَخَيَّرَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ زَوْجُهَا عَبْدًا وَأَهْدَتْ لِعَائِشَةَ لَحْمًا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ صَنَعْتُمْ لَنَا مِنْ هَذَا اللَّحْمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ تُصُدِّقَ بِهِ عَلَى بَرِيرَةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هُوَ لَهَا صَدَقَةٌ وَلَنَا هَدِيَّةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa husaynu bnu 'aliyyin, 'an zaaiidaaa, 'an simaakin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, ‏.‏ aannahaa ashtarat bariyraaa min aunaasin mina alaansaari ‏.‏ waashtaratuwa alwalaa'a faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alwalaa'u liman waliya alnni'maaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wakhayyarahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaana zawjuhaa 'abdana waaahdat li'aaiishaaa lahmana faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ law sana'tum lanaa min hadhaa alllahmi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau tusuddiqa bihi 'alaa bariyraaa ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ huwa lahaa sadaqaaun walanaa hadiyyaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah's be pleased with her) reported that she had bought Barira from the people of Ansar, but they laid down the condition that the right of inheritance (would vest in them), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The right of inheritance vests with one who shows favour (who emancipates) and Allah's Messenger (may peacebe upon him) gave her the choice (either to retain) her matrimonial alliance or break it). Her husband was a slave. She (Barira also) gave 'A'isha some meat as gift. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I wish you could prepare (cook) for us out of this meat. 'A'isha said, It has been given as charity to Barira, whereupon he said: That is charity for her and gift for us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ، الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْقَاسِمِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا أَرَادَتْ أَنْ تَشْتَرِيَ، بَرِيرَةَ لِلْعِتْقِ فَاشْتَرَطُوا وَلاَءَهَا فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اشْتَرِيهَا وَأَعْتِقِيهَا فَإِنَّ الْوَلاَءَ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأُهْدِيَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَحْمٌ فَقَالُوا لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَذَا تُصُدِّقَ بِهِ عَلَى بَرِيرَةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هُوَ لَهَا صَدَقَةٌ وَهُوَ لَنَا هَدِيَّةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَخُيِّرَتْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ وَكَانَ زَوْجُهَا حُرًّا ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ زَوْجِهَا فَقَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu 'abda, alrrahmani bna alqaasimi qaala sami'tu alqaasima, yuhaddithu 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa aaraadat aan tashtariya, bariyraaa lil'itqi faashtaratuwa walaa'ahaa fadhakarat dhalika lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ ashtariyhaa waaa'tiqiyhaa faiinna alwalaa'a liman aa'taqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waauhdiya lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lahmun faqaaluwa lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hadhaa tusuddiqa bihi 'alaa bariyraaa ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ huwa lahaa sadaqaaun wahuwa lanaa hadiyyaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wakhuyyirat ‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alrrahmani wakaana zawjuhaa hurrana ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau thumma saaaltuhu 'an zawjihaa faqaala laa aadriy ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:She wanted to buy Barira with a view to emancipating her. They (the sellers) laid down the condition that the right of inheritance would vest (with them). She (Hadrat 'A'isha) made a mention of that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereupon he said: Buy her and emancipate her for the right of inheritance vests with one who emancipates. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was given meat as gift. They (his Companions) said to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): This was given as charity to Barira, whereupon he said: That is charity for her but gift for us. And she was given option (to retain her matrimonial alliance or to break it). Abd al-Rahman said: Her husband was a free man. Shu'ba said: I then asked him (one of the narrators) about Barira's husband (whether he had been a free mart or a slave), whereupon he said: I do not know
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ النَّوْفَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aahmadu bnu 'uthmaana alnnawfaliyyu, haddathanaa aabuw daawuda, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي هِشَامٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُغِيرَةُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، وَأَبُو هِشَامٍ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ رُومَانَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ زَوْجُ بَرِيرَةَ عَبْدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin jamiy'ana 'an aabiy hishaamin, qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa mughiyraau bnu salamaaa almakhzuwmiyyu, waaabuw hishaamin haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an yaziyda bni ruwmaana, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana zawju bariyraaa 'abdana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that the husband of Barira was a slave
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي، عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ فِي بَرِيرَةَ ثَلاَثُ سُنَنٍ خُيِّرَتْ عَلَى زَوْجِهَا حِينَ عَتَقَتْ وَأُهْدِيَ لَهَا لَحْمٌ فَدَخَلَ عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْبُرْمَةُ عَلَى النَّارِ فَدَعَا بِطَعَامٍ فَأُتِيَ بِخُبْزٍ وَأُدُمٍ مِنْ أُدُمِ الْبَيْتِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَمْ أَرَ بُرْمَةً عَلَى النَّارِ فِيهَا لَحْمٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ذَلِكَ لَحْمٌ تُصُدِّقَ بِهِ عَلَى بَرِيرَةَ فَكَرِهْنَا أَنْ نُطْعِمَكَ مِنْهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هُوَ عَلَيْهَا صَدَقَةٌ وَهُوَ مِنْهَا لَنَا هَدِيَّةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهَا ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy maaliku bnu aanasin, 'an rabiy'aaa bni aabiy, 'abdi alrrahmani 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa qaalat kaana fiy bariyraaa thalaathu sunanin khuyyirat 'alaa zawjihaa hiyna 'ataqat waauhdiya lahaa lahmun fadakhala 'alaaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalburmaau 'alaa alnnaari fada'aa bita'aamin faautiya bikhubzin waaudumin min audumi albayti faqaala ‏"‏ aalam aara burmaaan 'alaa alnnaari fiyhaa lahmun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa balaa yaa rasuwla alllahi dhalika lahmun tusuddiqa bihi 'alaa bariyraaa fakarihnaa aan nut'imaka minhu ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ huwa 'alayhaa sadaqaaun wahuwa minhaa lanaa hadiyyaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiyhaa ‏"‏ iinnamaa alwalaa'u liman aa'taqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her). the wife of Allah's Apostle (may Peace be upon him) said:Three are the Sunan (usages) (that we came to know in case of Bairara). She was given option in regard to her husband when she was emancipated. Sbe was given meat as charity. Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) visited me when an earthen pot with meat in it was placed on the fire. He asked for food and be was given bread with ordinary meat (usually cooked in the) house. Thereupon he (Allah's Messenger) said: Don't I see the earthen pot on fire with meat in it? They said: Yes. Allah's Messenger, there is meat in it which was given as charity to Barira. We did not deem it advisable that we should give you that to eat, whereupon he said: It is charity for her, but it is gift for us. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) also said: The right of inheritance vests with one who emancipates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُهَيْلُ بْنُ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أَرَادَتْ عَائِشَةُ أَنْ تَشْتَرِيَ، جَارِيَةً تُعْتِقُهَا فَأَبَى أَهْلُهَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الْوَلاَءُ فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَمْنَعُكِ ذَلِكِ فَإِنَّمَا الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, 'an sulaymaana bni bilaalin, haddathaniy suhaylu bnu aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala aaraadat 'aaiishaau aan tashtariya, jaariyaaan tu'tiquhaa faaabaa aahluhaa iilaaa aan yakuwna lahumu alwalaa'u fadhakarat dhalika lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ laa yamna'uki dhaliki faiinnamaa alwalaa'u liman aa'taqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported:'A'isha (Allah be pleated with her) thought of buying a slave-girl and emancipating her, but her owners refused to (sell her but on the condition) that the right of inheritance would vest in them. She made a mention of that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). whereupon he said: Let this (condition) not stand in your way for the right of inheritance vests with one who emancipates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الْوَلاَءِ وَعَنْ هِبَتِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ النَّاسُ كُلُّهُمْ عِيَالٌ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an bay'i alwalaa'i wa'an hibatihi ‏.‏ qaala muslimun alnnaasu kulluhum 'iyaalun 'alaa 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin fiy hadhaa alhadiythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) forbade the selling and making a gift of the right of inheritance of a slave. Imam Muslim said:All the persons depend upon Abdullah b. Dinar in regard to this hadith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُثْمَانَ - كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، دِينَارٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ الثَّقَفِيَّ لَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ الْبَيْعُ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْهِبَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu sa'iydin, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, h wahaddathanaa abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku, - ya'niy abna 'uthmaana - kullu hauulaa'i 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, diynaarin 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi ghayra aanna althhaqafiyya laysa fiy hadiythihi 'an 'ubaydi alllahi iilaaa albay'u walam yadhkuri alhibaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) through another chain of transmitters but with this change that in tba hadith narrated by al-Thaqafi from Ubaidullah there is only a mention of selling (or right of inheritance, al-Wala' ) but not that of making a gift
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ كَتَبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى كُلِّ بَطْنٍ عُقُولَهُ ثُمَّ كَتَبَ ‏ "‏ أَنَّهُ لاَ يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَتَوَالَى مَوْلَى رَجُلٍ مُسْلِمٍ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أُخْبِرْتُ أَنَّهُ لَعَنَ فِي صَحِيفَتِهِ مَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu kataba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa kulli batnin 'uquwlahu thumma kataba ‏ "‏ aannahu laa yahillu limuslimin aan yatawaalaa mawlaa rajulin muslimin bighayri iidhnihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma aukhbirtu aannahu la'ana fiy sahiyfatihi man fa'ala dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) made it obligatory for every tribe (the payment) of blood-wit; he then also made it explicit that it is not permissible for a Muslim to make himself the ally (of the slave emancipated by another) Muslim without his permission. He (the narrator further added):I was informed that he (the Holy Prophet) cursed the one who did that (and it was recorded) in his Sahifa (in a document)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ تَوَلَّى قَوْمًا بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ مَوَالِيهِ فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةِ لاَ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ عَدْلٌ وَلاَ صَرْفٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyya - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man tawallaa qawmana bighayri iidhni mawaaliyhi fa'alayhi la'naau alllahi waalmalaaiikaai laa yuqbalu minhu 'adlun walaa sarfun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:He who takes anyone as his ally without the consent of his previous master, there will be the curse of Allah and that of His angels upon him, and neither, any obligatory act of his nor the supererogatory one will be accepted (by Allah)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجُعْفِيُّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ تَوَلَّى قَوْمًا بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ مَوَالِيهِ فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ لاَ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَدْلٌ وَلاَ صَرْفٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَنْ وَالَى غَيْرَ مَوَالِيهِ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa husaynu bnu 'aliyyin alju'fiyyu, 'an zaaiidaaa, 'an sulaymaana, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ man tawallaa qawmana bighayri iidhni mawaaliyhi fa'alayhi la'naau alllahi waalmalaaiikaai waalnnaasi aajma'iyna laa yuqbalu minhu yawma alqiyaamaai 'adlun walaa sarfun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi iibraahiymu bnu diynaarin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏"‏ waman waalaa ghayra mawaaliyhi bighayri iidhnihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:He who took the freed slave as his ally without the consent of his previous master, there is upon him the curse of Allah and that of His angels and that of the whole mankind, and there will not be accepted from him his obligatory acts or supercrogatory acts on the Day of Resurrection. This hadith is narrated through the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight change of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فَقَالَ مَنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّ عِنْدَنَا، شَيْئًا نَقْرَأُهُ إِلاَّ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَهَذِهِ الصَّحِيفَةَ - قَالَ وَصَحِيفَةٌ مُعَلَّقَةٌ فِي قِرَابِ سَيْفِهِ - فَقَدْ كَذَبَ ‏.‏ فِيهَا أَسْنَانُ الإِبِلِ وَأَشْيَاءُ مِنَ الْجِرَاحَاتِ وَفِيهَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْمَدِينَةُ حَرَمٌ مَا بَيْنَ عَيْرٍ إِلَى ثَوْرٍ فَمَنْ أَحْدَثَ فِيهَا حَدَثًا أَوْ آوَى مُحْدِثًا فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ لاَ يَقْبَلُ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ صَرْفًا وَلاَ عَدْلاً وَذِمَّةُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَاحِدَةٌ يَسْعَى بِهَا أَدْنَاهُمْ وَمَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ أَوِ انْتَمَى إِلَى غَيْرِ مَوَالِيهِ فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ لاَ يَقْبَلُ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ صَرْفًا وَلاَ عَدْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala khatabanaa 'aliyyu bnu aabiy taalibin faqaala man za'ama aanna 'indanaa, shayiana naqraauhu iilaaa kitaaba alllahi wahadhihi alssahiyfaaa - qaala wasahiyfaaun mu'allaqaaun fiy qiraabi sayfihi - faqad kadhaba ‏.‏ fiyhaa aasnaanu aliibili waaashyaa'u mina aljiraahaati wafiyhaa qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ almadiynaau haramun maa bayna 'ayrin iilaa thawrin faman aahdatha fiyhaa hadathana aaw awaa muhdithana fa'alayhi la'naau alllahi waalmalaaiikaai waalnnaasi aajma'iyna laa yaqbalu alllahu minhu yawma alqiyaamaai sarfana walaa 'adlaan wadhimmaau almuslimiyna waahidaaun yas'aa bihaa aadnaahum wamani adda'aa iilaa ghayri aabiyhi aawi antamaa iilaa ghayri mawaaliyhi fa'alayhi la'naau alllahi waalmalaaiikaai waalnnaasi aajma'iyna laa yaqbalu alllahu minhu yawma alqiyaamaai sarfana walaa 'adlaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibrahim al-Taimi reported on the authority of his father:'Ali b. Abu Talib (Allah be pleased with him) addressed us and said: He who thinks that we (the members of the Prophet's family) read anything else besides the Book of Allah and this Sahifa (and he said that Sahifa was tied to the scabbard of the sword) tells a lie. (This Sahifa) contains (problems) pertaining to the ages of the camels and (the recompense) of the injuries, and it also records the words of the Prophet (ﷺ): Medina is a sacred territory from 'Ayr to Thaur (it is most probably Uhud). He who innovates (an act or practice) or gives protection to an innovator, there is a curse of Allah and that of His angels and that of the whole humanity upon him. Allah will not accdpt from him (as a recompense) any obligatory act or supererogatory act, and the responsibility of the Muslims is a joint responsibility; even the lowest in rank can undertake the responsibility (on behalf of others), and he who claims anyone else as his father besides his own father or makes one his ally other than the one (who freed him), there is a curse of Allah. that of His angels and that of the wholemankind upon him. Allah will not accept the obligatory act of the supererogatery act (as a recompense) from him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ - حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ ابْنِ مَرْجَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ رَقَبَةً مُؤْمِنَةً أَعْتَقَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ إِرْبٍ مِنْهَا إِرْبًا مِنْهُ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa al'anaziyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni sa'iydin, - wahuwa abnu aabiy hindin - haddathaniy iismaa'iylu bnu aabiy hakiymin, 'an sa'iydi abni marjaanaaa, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man aa'taqa raqabaaan muuminaaan aa'taqa alllahu bikulli iirbin minhaa iirbana minhu mina alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:If anyone emancipates a Muslim slave, Allah will set free from Hell an organ of his body for every organ of his (slave's) body
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ رُشَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُطَرِّفٍ أَبِي غَسَّانَ، الْمَدَنِيِّ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ ابْنِ مَرْجَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ رَقَبَةً أَعْتَقَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ عُضْوٍ مِنْهَا عُضْوًا مِنْ أَعْضَائِهِ مِنَ النَّارِ حَتَّى فَرْجَهُ بِفَرْجِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa daawudu bnu rushaydin, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, 'an muhammadi bni mutarrifin aabiy ghassaana, almadaniyyi 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'aliyyi bni husaynin, 'an sa'iydi abni marjaanaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man aa'taqa raqabaaan aa'taqa alllahu bikulli 'udwin minhaa 'udwana min aa'daaiihi mina alnnaari hattaa farjahu bifarjihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace benpon him) as saying:He who emancipates a slave, Allah will set free from Hell every limb (of his body) for every limb of his (slave's) body, even his private parts
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ ابْنِ مَرْجَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ رَقَبَةً مُؤْمِنَةً أَعْتَقَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ عُضْوٍ مِنْهُ عُضْوًا مِنَ النَّارِ حَتَّى يُعْتِقَ فَرْجَهُ بِفَرْجِهِ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni alhaadi, 'an 'umara bni 'aliyyi bni husaynin, 'an sa'iydi abni marjaanaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man aa'taqa raqabaaan muuminaaan aa'taqa alllahu bikulli 'udwin minhu 'udwana mina alnnaari hattaa yu'tiqa farjahu bifarjihi‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who emancipates a believing slave. Allah will set free from Fire his every limb for every limb of his (slave's), even his private parts for his
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْعُمَرِيُّ - حَدَّثَنَا وَاقِدٌ، - يَعْنِي أَخَاهُ - حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ ابْنُ مَرْجَانَةَ، - صَاحِبُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَيُّمَا امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ أَعْتَقَ امْرَأً مُسْلِمًا اسْتَنْقَذَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ عُضْوٍ مِنْهُ عُضْوًا مِنْهُ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْطَلَقْتُ حِينَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَدِيثَ مِنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ فَذَكَرْتُهُ لِعَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ فَأَعْتَقَ عَبْدًا لَهُ قَدْ أَعْطَاهُ بِهِ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَشْرَةَ آلاَفِ دِرْهَمٍ أَوْ أَلْفَ دِينَارٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy humaydu bnu mas'adaaa, haddathanaa bishru bnu almufaddali, haddathanaa 'aasimun, - wahuwa abnu muhammadin al'umariyyu - haddathanaa waaqidun, - ya'niy aakhaahu - haddathaniy sa'iydu abnu marjaanaaa, - saahibu 'aliyyi bni husaynin - qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aayyumaa amriiin muslimin aa'taqa amraaan muslimana astanqadha alllahu bikulli 'udwin minhu 'udwana minhu mina alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faantalaqtu hiyna sami'tu alhadiytha min aabiy hurayraaa fadhakartuhu li'aliyyi bni alhusayni faaa'taqa 'abdana lahu qad aa'taahu bihi abnu ja'farin 'ashraaa alaafi dirhamin aaw aalfa diynaarin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A Muslim who emancipates a Muslim (slave). Allah will save from Fire every limb of his for every limb (of the slave). Sa'id b. Marjana said: When I heard this hadith from Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him), I went away and made a mention of it to 'Ali b. Husain and he at once emancipated the slave for which Ibn ja'far was prepared to pay ten thousand dirhams or one thousand dinars
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَجْزِي وَلَدٌ وَالِدًا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَجِدَهُ مَمْلُوكًا فَيَشْتَرِيَهُ فَيُعْتِقَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ ‏"‏ وَلَدٌ وَالِدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa yajziy waladun waalidana iilaaa aan yajidahu mamluwkana fayashtariyahu fayu'tiqahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai abni aabiy shaybaaa ‏"‏ waladun waalidahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A son does not repay what he owes his father unless he buys him (the father) in case he is a slave and then emancipates him. In the narration transmitted by Ibn Abu Shaiba there is a slight change of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — The Book of Emancipating Slaves
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ الزُّبَيْرِيُّ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ وَقَالُوا ‏ "‏ وَلَدٌ وَالِدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa aabuw aahmada alzzubayriyyu, kulluhum 'an sufyaana, 'an suhaylin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu waqaaluwa ‏ "‏ waladun waalidahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ، حَبَّانَ عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْمُلاَمَسَةِ وَالْمُنَابَذَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an muhammadi bni yahyaa bni, habbaana 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani almulaamasaai waalmunaabadhaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (two types of transactions) Mulamasa and Munabadha
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported like this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, waaabuw ausaamaaa h wahaddathanaa muhammadu, bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, kulluhum 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an khubaybi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an hafsi bni 'aasimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a hadith like this through another chain cf transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - عَنْ سُهَيْلِ، بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani - 'an suhayli, bni aabiy saalihin 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو، بْنُ دِينَارٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ مِينَاءَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ نُهِيَ عَنْ بَيْعَتَيْنِ، الْمُلاَمَسَةِ وَالْمُنَابَذَةِ ‏.‏ أَمَّا الْمُلاَمَسَةُ فَأَنْ يَلْمِسَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا ثَوْبَ صَاحِبِهِ بِغَيْرِ تَأَمُّلٍ وَالْمُنَابَذَةُ أَنْ يَنْبِذَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا ثَوْبَهُ إِلَى الآخَرِ وَلَمْ يَنْظُرْ وَاحِدٌ مِنْهُمَا إِلَى ثَوْبِ صَاحِبِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw, bnu diynaarin 'an 'ataa'i bni miynaa'a, aannahu sami'ahu yuhaddithu, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu qaala nuhiya 'an bay'atayni, almulaamasaai waalmunaabadhaai ‏.‏ aammaa almulaamasaau faaan yalmisa kullu waahidin minhumaa thawba saahibihi bighayri taaammulin waalmunaabadhaau aan yanbidha kullu waahidin minhumaa thawbahu iilaa alakhari walam yanzur waahidun minhumaa iilaa thawbi saahibihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported:Two types of trarisactions have been forbidden (by the Holy Prophet), al-Mlulamasa and al-Munabadha. As far as Mulamasa transaction is concerned, it is that every one of them (the parties entering into transaction) should touch the garment of the other without careful consideration, and al-Munabadha is that every one of them should throw his cloth to the other and one of them should not see the cloth of his friend
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِحَرْمَلَةَ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ، وَهْبٍ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ، الْخُدْرِيَّ قَالَ نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعَتَيْنِ وَلِبْسَتَيْنِ نَهَى عَنِ الْمُلاَمَسَةِ وَالْمُنَابَذَةِ فِي الْبَيْعِ ‏.‏ وَالْمُلاَمَسَةُ لَمْسُ الرَّجُلِ ثَوْبَ الآخَرِ بِيَدِهِ بِاللَّيْلِ أَوْ بِالنَّهَارِ وَلاَ يَقْلِبُهُ إِلاَّ بِذَلِكَ وَالْمُنَابَذَةُ أَنْ يَنْبِذَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ بِثَوْبِهِ وَيَنْبِذَ الآخَرُ إِلَيْهِ ثَوْبَهُ وَيَكُونُ ذَلِكَ بَيْعَهُمَا مِنْ غَيْرِ نَظَرٍ وَلاَ تَرَاضٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu liharmalaaa - qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu, wahbin aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'aamiru bnu sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, aanna aabaa sa'iydin, alkhudriyya qaala nahaanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an bay'atayni walibsatayni nahaa 'ani almulaamasaai waalmunaabadhaai fiy albay'i ‏.‏ waalmulaamasaau lamsu alrrajuli thawba alakhari biyadihi bialllayli aaw bialnnahaari walaa yaqlibuhu iilaaa bidhalika waalmunaabadhaau aan yanbidha alrrajulu iilaa alrrajuli bithawbihi wayanbidha alakharu iilayhi thawbahu wayakuwnu dhalika bay'ahumaa min ghayri nazarin walaa taraadin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us (from), two types of business transactions and two ways of dressing. He forbade Mulamasa and Munabadha in transactions. Mulamasa means the touching of another's garment with his hand, whether at night or by day, without turning it over except this much. Munabadha means that a man throws his garment to another and the other throws his garment, and thus confirming their contract without the inspection of mutual agreement
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab through the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعِ الْحَصَاةِ وَعَنْ بَيْعِ الْغَرَرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa, wayahyaa bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw ausaamaaa 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, haddathaniy aabuw alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an bay'i alhasaaai wa'an bay'i algharari ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade a transaction determined by throwing stones, and the type which involves some uncertainty
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ، سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ حَبَلِ الْحَبَلَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu, sa'iydin haddathanaa laythun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu nahaa 'an bay'i habali alhabalaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. 'Umar) (Allah be pleased with him) said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the transaction called habal al-habala
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ أَهْلُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ يَتَبَايَعُونَ لَحْمَ الْجَزُورِ إِلَى حَبَلِ الْحَبَلَةِ ‏.‏ وَحَبَلُ الْحَبَلَةِ أَنْ تُنْتَجَ النَّاقَةُ ثُمَّ تَحْمِلَ الَّتِي نُتِجَتْ فَنَهَاهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
