verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala kaana aahlu aljaahiliyyaai yatabaaya'uwna lahma aljazuwri iilaa habali alhabalaai ‏.‏ wahabalu alhabalaai aan tuntaja alnnaaqaau thumma tahmila allatiy nutijat fanahaahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the people of pre-Islamic days used to sell the meat of the slaughtered camel up to habal al-habala. And habal al-habala implies that a she-camel should give birth and then the (born one should grow young) and become pregnant. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade them that (this transaction)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَبِعْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَيْعِ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yabi' ba'dukum 'alaa bay'i ba'din ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having said this:One amongst you should not enter into a transaction when another is bargaining
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَبِعِ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى بَيْعِ أَخِيهِ وَلاَ يَخْطُبْ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ أَخِيهِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَأْذَنَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yabi'i alrrajulu 'alaa bay'i aakhiyhi walaa yakhtub 'alaa khitbaai aakhiyhi iilaaa aan yaadhana lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A person should not enter into a transaction when his brother is already making a transaction and he should not make a proposal of marriage when his brother has already made a proposal except when he gives permission
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَسُمِ الْمُسْلِمُ عَلَى سَوْمِ أَخِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yasumi almuslimu 'alaa sawmi aakhiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A Muslim should not purchase (in opposition) to his brother
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، وَسُهَيْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح. وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي، صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَابِتٍ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ يَسْتَامَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى سَوْمِ أَخِيهِ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ الدَّوْرَقِيِّ عَلَى سِيمَةِ أَخِيهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aahmadu bnu iibraahiyma alddawraqiyyu, haddathaniy 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani al'alaa'i, wasuhaylin 'an aabiyhimaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h. wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy, saalihin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h. wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'adiyyin, - wahuwa abnu thaabitin - 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa aan yastaama alrrajulu 'alaa sawmi aakhiyhi ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai alddawraqiyyi 'alaa siymaai aakhiyhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters but with a slight change of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يُتَلَقَّى الرُّكْبَانُ لِبَيْعٍ وَلاَ يَبِعْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَيْعِ بَعْضٍ وَلاَ تَنَاجَشُوا وَلاَ يَبِعْ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ وَلاَ تُصَرُّوا الإِبِلَ وَالْغَنَمَ فَمَنِ ابْتَاعَهَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَهُوَ بِخَيْرِ النَّظَرَيْنِ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَحْلُبَهَا فَإِنْ رَضِيَهَا أَمْسَكَهَا وَإِنْ سَخِطَهَا رَدَّهَا وَصَاعًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yutalaqqaa alrrukbaanu libay'in walaa yabi' ba'dukum 'alaa bay'i ba'din walaa tanaajashuwa walaa yabi' haadirun libaadin walaa tusarruwa aliibila waalghanama famani abtaa'ahaa ba'da dhalika fahuwa bikhayri alnnazarayni ba'da aan yahlubahaa faiin radiyahaa aamsakahaa waiin sakhitahaa raddahaa wasaa'ana min tamrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (may peace'be upon him) as saying:Do not go out to meet riders to enter into transaction with them; none of you must buy in opposition to another, nor must you bid against one another; a townsman must not sell for a man from the desert, and do not tie up udders of carnels and sheep, and he who buys them after that has been done has two courses open to him: after he has milked them he may keep them if he is pleased with them, or he may return them along with a sit of dates if he is displeased with them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَابِتٍ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ التَّلَقِّي لِلرُّكْبَانِ وَأَنْ يَبِيعَ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ وَأَنْ تَسْأَلَ الْمَرْأَةُ طَلاَقَ أُخْتِهَا وَعَنِ النَّجْشِ وَالتَّصْرِيَةِ وَأَنْ يَسْتَامَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى سَوْمِ أَخِيهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'adiyyin, - wahuwa abnu thaabitin - 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alttalaqqiy lilrrukbaani waaan yabiy'a haadirun libaadin waaan tasaala almaraaau talaaqa aukhtihaa wa'ani alnnajshi waalttasriyaai waaan yastaama alrrajulu 'alaa sawmi aakhiyhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the (people) meeting the caravan (for entering into business transaction with them), and the selling of goods by a townsman on behalf of a man of the desert, and seeking by a woman the divorce of her sister (from her husband), and outbidding (against one another), and tying up the udders (of animals), and buying of (things) in opposition to one's brother
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ، بْنُ جَرِيرٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالُوا، جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ فِي حَدِيثِ غُنْدَرٍ وَوَهْبٍ نُهِيَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw bakri bnu naafi'in, haddathanaa ghundarun, h wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa wahbu, bnu jariyrin h wahaddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi bnu 'abdi alssamadi, haddathanaa aabiy qaaluwa, jamiy'ana haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ fiy hadiythi ghundarin wawahbin nuhiya ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi 'abdi alssamadi aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi mu'aadhin 'an shu'baaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ النَّجْشِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alnnajshi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the outbidding (against another)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي كُلُّهُمْ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ تُتَلَقَّى السِّلَعُ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ الأَسْوَاقَ ‏.‏ وَهَذَا لَفْظُ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ التَّلَقِّي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa ya'niy abna sa'iydin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy kulluhum, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa aan tutalaqqaa alssila'u hattaa tablugha alaaswaaqa ‏.‏ wahadhaa lafzu abni numayrin ‏.‏ waqaala alakharaani iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alttalaqqiy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not go out to meet merchandise in the way, (wait) until it is brought into the market. This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn Numair but with a slight change of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, waiishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni mahdiyyin, 'an maalikin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi abni numayrin 'an 'ubaydi alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of 'Ubaidullah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنِ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي، عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنْ تَلَقِّي الْبُيُوعِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu mubaarakin, 'ani alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiy, 'uthmaana 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu nahaa 'an talaqqiy albuyuw'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Do not meet the traders (in the way)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُتَلَقَّى الْجَلَبُ ‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an hishaamin, 'ani abni siyriyna, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yutalaqqaa aljalabu ‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) as saying:Do not meet the merchandise (in the way)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي هِشَامٌ، الْقُرْدُوسِيُّ عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَلَقَّوُا الْجَلَبَ ‏.‏ فَمَنْ تَلَقَّاهُ فَاشْتَرَى مِنْهُ فَإِذَا أَتَى سَيِّدُهُ السُّوقَ فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu sulaymaana, 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy hishaamun, alqurduwsiyyu 'ani abni siyriyna, qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa talaqqawua aljalaba ‏.‏ faman talaqqaahu faashtaraa minhu faiidhaa aataa sayyiduhu alssuwqa fahuwa bialkhiyaari‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not meet the merchant in the way and enter into business transaction with him, and whoever meets him and buys from him (and in case it is done, see) that when the owner of (merchandise) comes into the market (and finds that he has been paid less price) he has the option (to declare the transaction null and void)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَبِعْ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ زُهَيْرٌ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْ يَبِيعَ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ ‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, yablughu bihi alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yabi' haadirun libaadin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala zuhayrun 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu nahaa aan yabiy'a haadirun libaadin ‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported it directly from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ):The townsman'should not sell for a man from the desert (with a view to taking advantage of his ignorance of the market conditions of the city). And Zuhair reported from the Prophet (ﷺ) that he forbade the townsman to sell on behalf of the man from the desert
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تُتَلَقَّى الرُّكْبَانُ وَأَنْ يَبِيعَ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ مَا قَوْلُهُ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ قَالَ لاَ يَكُنْ لَهُ سِمْسَارًا
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani abni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan tutalaqqaa alrrukbaanu waaan yabiy'a haadirun libaadin ‏.‏ qaala faqultu laibni 'abbaasin maa qawluhu haadirun libaadin qaala laa yakun lahu simsaarana
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The riders (carrying merchandise) should not be met in the way, and townsman should not sell for a man of the desert. The narrator reported. I said to Ibn 'Abbas: What do these words really imply-" The townsman for the man of the desert"? He said: That he should work as a broker on his behalf
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَبِعْ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ دَعُوا النَّاسَ يَرْزُقِ اللَّهُ بَعْضَهُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ‏"‏ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي رِوَايَةِ يَحْيَى ‏"‏ يُرْزَقُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, h. wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa yabi' haadirun libaadin da'uwa alnnaasa yarzuqi alllahu ba'dahum min ba'din‏"‏ ‏.‏ ghayra aanna fiy riwaayaai yahyaa ‏"‏ yurzaqu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The townsman should not sell for a man from the desert, leave the people alone, Allah will give them provision from one another. Yahya reported it with a slight change of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported a similar hadith from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ، بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ نُهِينَا أَنْ يَبِيعَ، حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ ‏.‏ وَإِنْ كَانَ أَخَاهُ أَوْ أَبَاهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni siyriyna, 'an aanasi, bni maalikin qaala nuhiynaa aan yabiy'a, haadirun libaadin ‏.‏ waiin kaana aakhaahu aaw aabaahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported:We were forbidden that a townsman should sell for a man of the desert, even if he is his brother or father
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ،ح ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ نُهِينَا عَنْ أَنْ يَبِيعَ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'ani abni 'awnin, 'an muhammadin, 'an aanasin, h ‏.‏ wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhun, haddathanaa abnu 'awnin, 'an muhammadin, qaala qaala aanasu bnu maalikin nuhiynaa 'an aan yabiy'a haadirun libaadin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) said:We were forbidden that a townsman should sell for a man of the desert
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنِ اشْتَرَى شَاةً مُصَرَّاةً فَلْيَنْقَلِبْ بِهَا فَلْيَحْلُبْهَا فَإِنْ رَضِيَ حِلاَبَهَا أَمْسَكَهَا وَإِلاَّ رَدَّهَا وَمَعَهَا صَاعٌ مِنْ تَمْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa daawudu bnu qaysin, 'an muwsaa bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mani ashtaraa shaaaan musarraaaan falyanqalib bihaa falyahlubhaa faiin radiya hilaabahaa aamsakahaa waiilaaa raddahaa wama'ahaa saa'un min tamrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be'upon him) as saying:He who bought a goat having its udder tied up should go back with it, milk it, and, if he is satisfied with its milk, he should retair it, otherwise he should return it along with a sa' of dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ ابْتَاعَ شَاةً مُصَرَّاةً فَهُوَ فِيهَا بِالْخِيَارِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِنْ شَاءَ أَمْسَكَهَا وَإِنْ شَاءَ رَدَّهَا وَرَدَّ مَعَهَا صَاعًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyya - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mani abtaa'a shaaaan musarraaaan fahuwa fiyhaa bialkhiyaari thalaathaaa aayyaamin iin shaa'a aamsakahaa waiin shaa'a raddahaa waradda ma'ahaa saa'ana min tamrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who buys a goat with its udder tied up has the option to retain the goat if he so desires or return it within three days, and in case he returns it he should do so along with a sa' of dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَبَلَةَ بْنِ أَبِي رَوَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، - يَعْنِي الْعَقَدِيَّ - حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ اشْتَرَى شَاةً مُصَرَّاةً فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَإِنْ رَدَّهَا رَدَّ مَعَهَا صَاعًا مِنْ طَعَامٍ لاَ سَمْرَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'amriw bni jabalaaa bni aabiy rawwaadin, haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin, - ya'niy al'aqadiyya - haddathanaa qurraau, 'an muhammadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mani ashtaraa shaaaan musarraaaan fahuwa bialkhiyaari thalaathaaa aayyaamin faiin raddahaa radda ma'ahaa saa'ana min ta'aamin laa samraa'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:lie who buys a goat having its udder tied up has the option to return it within three days. If he returns it he should pay a sa' of dates. Wheat is not essential
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنِ اشْتَرَى شَاةً مُصَرَّاةً فَهُوَ بِخَيْرِ النَّظَرَيْنِ إِنْ شَاءَ أَمْسَكَهَا وَإِنْ شَاءَ رَدَّهَا وَصَاعًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ لاَ سَمْرَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mani ashtaraa shaaaan musarraaaan fahuwa bikhayri alnnazarayni iin shaa'a aamsakahaa waiin shaa'a raddahaa wasaa'ana min tamrin laa samraa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who buys a goat having its udder tied up has two courses left for him. He may retain it, and if he desires may return it along with a sa' of dates and not wheat
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ اشْتَرَى مِنَ الْغَنَمِ فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, 'an aayyuwba, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ mani ashtaraa mina alghanami fahuwa bialkhiyaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ayyub narrated with the same chain of transmitters but with this change of words:" He who buys a goat has the option
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا مَا أَحَدُكُمُ اشْتَرَى لِقْحَةً مُصَرَّاةً أَوْ شَاةً مُصَرَّاةً فَهُوَ بِخَيْرِ النَّظَرَيْنِ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَحْلُبَهَا إِمَّا هِيَ وَإِلاَّ فَلْيَرُدَّهَا وَصَاعًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa maa aahadukumu ashtaraa liqhaaan musarraaaan aaw shaaaan musarraaaan fahuwa bikhayri alnnazarayni ba'da aan yahlubahaa iimmaa hiya waiilaaa falyaruddahaa wasaa'ana min tamrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam b. Munabbih said:Out of the ahadith which Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported to us from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) one is this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If one among you buys a she-camel having its udder tied up he has the two options for him after milking it either (to retain it) or return it with a sa' of dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ ابْتَاعَ طَعَامًا فَلاَ يَبِعْهُ حَتَّى يَسْتَوْفِيَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَأَحْسِبُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, waqutaybaau, qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mani abtaa'a ta'aamana falaa yabi'hu hattaa yastawfiyahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin waaahsibu kulla shaa'in mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who buys foodgrain should not sell it until he has taken possession of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ، أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، - وَهُوَ الثَّوْرِيُّ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَمْرِو، بْنِ دِينَارٍ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, waaahmadu bnu 'abdaaa, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu, aabiy shaybaaa waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, - wahuwa althhawriyyu - kilaahumaa 'an 'amriw, bni diynaarin bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated through the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنِ ابْتَاعَ طَعَامًا فَلاَ يَبِعْهُ حَتَّى يَقْبِضَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَأَحْسِبُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الطَّعَامِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala abnu raafi'in haddathanaa waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani abni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mani abtaa'a ta'aamana falaa yabi'hu hattaa yaqbidahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin waaahsibu kulla shaa'in bimanzilaai altta'aami ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who buys food-rain should not sell it until he has taken possession of it. Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) said: I regard everything like food (so far as this principle is concerned)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ ابْتَاعَ طَعَامًا فَلاَ يَبِعْهُ حَتَّى يَسْتَوْفِيَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa alqa'nabiyyu, haddathanaa maalikun, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mani abtaa'a ta'aamana falaa yabi'hu hattaa yastawfiyahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who buys foodgrain should not sell it until he has taken full possession of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كُنَّا فِي زَمَانِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبْتَاعُ الطَّعَامَ فَيَبْعَثُ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ يَأْمُرُنَا بِانْتِقَالِهِ مِنَ الْمَكَانِ الَّذِي ابْتَعْنَاهُ فِيهِ إِلَى مَكَانٍ سِوَاهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ نَبِيعَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala kunnaa fiy zamaani rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nabtaa'u altta'aama fayab'athu 'alaynaa man yaamurunaa biantiqaalihi mina almakaani alladhiy abta'naahu fiyhi iilaa makaanin siwaahu qabla aan nabiy'ahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported:We used to buy foodgrains during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He (the Holy Prophet) would then send to us one who commanded us to take them (the foodgrains) to a place other than the one where we had bought them before we sold it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ اشْتَرَى طَعَامًا فَلاَ يَبِعْهُ حَتَّى يَسْتَوْفِيَهُ وَيَقْبِضَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, haddathaniy 'umaru bnu muhammadin, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mani ashtaraa ta'aamana falaa yabi'hu hattaa yastawfiyahu wayaqbidahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who bought foodgrain should not sell it until he had taken full possession of it (after measuring it)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، وَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنِ ابْتَاعَ طَعَامًا فَلاَ يَبِعْهُ حَتَّى يَقْبِضَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, waqaala 'aliyyun haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, aannahu sami'a abna 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mani abtaa'a ta'aamana falaa yabi'hu hattaa yaqbidahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying,:He who bought foodgrain should not sell it until he had taken possession of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، قَالَ قَدْ رَأَيْتُ النَّاسَ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا ابْتَاعُوا الطَّعَامَ جِزَافًا يُضْرَبُونَ فِي أَنْ يَبِيعُوهُ فِي مَكَانِهِمْ وَذَلِكَ حَتَّى يُئْوُوهُ إِلَى رِحَالِهِمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَحَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ كَانَ يَشْتَرِي الطَّعَامَ جِزَافًا فَيَحْمِلُهُ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna aabaahu, qaala qad raaaytu alnnaasa fiy 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa abtaa'uwa altta'aama jizaafana yudrabuwna fiy aan yabiy'uwhu fiy makaanihim wadhalika hattaa yuiwuwhu iilaa rihaalihim ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin wahaddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara aanna aabaahu kaana yashtariy altta'aama jizaafana fayahmiluhu iilaa aahlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported his father havingsaid this:I saw people being beaten during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in case they bought the foodgrain in bulk, and then sold them at that spot before taking it to their places. This hadith is narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah b. Abdullah b. 'Umar through another chain of transmitters (and the words are):" His father (Ibn 'Umar) used to buy foodgrains in bulk and then carried them to his people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ حُبَابٍ، عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنِ اشْتَرَى طَعَامًا فَلاَ يَبِعْهُ حَتَّى يَكْتَالَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏"‏ مَنِ ابْتَاعَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin waaabuw kuraybin qaaluwa haddathanaa zaydu bnu hubaabin, 'ani alddahhaaki bni 'uthmaana, 'an bukayri bni 'abdi alllahi bni alaashajji, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ mani ashtaraa ta'aamana falaa yabi'hu hattaa yaktaalahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai aabiy bakrin ‏"‏ mani abtaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who bought foodgrain should not sell it until he had measured it. In the narration of Abu Bakr there the word is Ibta' instead of Ishtara
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، بْنُ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِمَرْوَانَ أَحْلَلْتَ بَيْعَ الرِّبَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَرْوَانُ مَا فَعَلْتُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَحْلَلْتَ بَيْعَ الصِّكَاكِ وَقَدْ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعِ الطَّعَامِ حَتَّى يُسْتَوْفَى ‏.‏ قَالَ فَخَطَبَ مَرْوَانُ النَّاسَ فَنَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى حَرَسٍ يَأْخُذُونَهَا مِنْ أَيْدِي النَّاسِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu alhaarithi almakhzuwmiyyu, haddathanaa alddahhaaku, bnu 'uthmaana 'an bukayri bni 'abdi alllahi bni alaashajji, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu qaala limarwaana aahlalta bay'a alrribaa ‏.‏ faqaala marwaanu maa fa'altu ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw hurayraaa aahlalta bay'a alssikaaki waqad nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an bay'i altta'aami hattaa yustawfaa ‏.‏ qaala fakhataba marwaanu alnnaasa fanahaa 'an bay'ihaa ‏.‏ qaala sulaymaanu fanazartu iilaa harasin yaakhudhuwnahaa min aaydiy alnnaasi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be please with him) is reported to have said to Marwan:Have you made lawful the transactions involving interest? Thereupon Marwan said: I have not done that. Thereupon Abu Huraira (ﷺ) said: You have made lawful the transactions with the help of documents only, whereas Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the transaction of foodgrains until full possession is taken of them. Marwan then addressed the people and forbade them to enter into such transactions (as are done with the help of documents). Sulaiman said: I saw the sentinels snatching (these documents) from the people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا ابْتَعْتَ طَعَامًا فَلاَ تَبِعْهُ حَتَّى تَسْتَوْفِيَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa rawhun, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, haddathaniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iidhaa abta'ta ta'aamana falaa tabi'hu hattaa tastawfiyahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When you purchase foodgrains, do not sell them until you have taken possession of them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا الزُّبَيْرِ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعِ الصُّبْرَةِ مِنَ التَّمْرِ لاَ يُعْلَمُ مَكِيلَتُهَا بِالْكَيْلِ الْمُسَمَّى مِنَ التَّمْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amriw bni sarhin aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy abnu jurayjin, aanna aabaa alzzubayri, aakhbarahu qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an bay'i alssubraai mina alttamri laa yu'lamu makiylatuhaa bialkayli almusammaa mina alttamri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) is reported to have said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of a heap of dates the weight of which is unknown in accordance with the known weight of dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ مِنَ التَّمْرِ ‏.‏ فِي آخِرِ الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi ghayra aannahu lam yadhkur mina alttamri ‏.‏ fiy akhiri alhadiythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) but with this variation that no mention is made of the dates (which one finds) at the end of the previous hadith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْبَيِّعَانِ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا بِالْخِيَارِ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ مَا لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقَا إِلاَّ بَيْعَ الْخِيَارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ albayyi'aani kullu waahidin minhumaa bialkhiyaari 'alaa saahibihi maa lam yatafarraqaa iilaaa bay'a alkhiyaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Both parties in a business transaction have the right to annul it so long as they have not separated; except in transactions which have been made subject to the right of parties to annul them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي كُلُّهُمْ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح. وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ - جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى، بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, wahuwa alqattaanu h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy kulluhum, 'an 'ubaydi, alllahi 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h. wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, h wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, - wahuwa abnu zaydin - jamiy'ana 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h. wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, qaala sami'tu yahyaa, bnu sa'iydin h wahaddathanaa abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku, kilaahumaa 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi maalikin 'an naafi'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا تَبَايَعَ الرَّجُلاَنِ فَكُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا بِالْخِيَارِ مَا لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقَا وَكَانَا جَمِيعًا أَوْ يُخَيِّرُ أَحَدُهُمَا الآخَرَ فَإِنْ خَيَّرَ أَحَدُهُمَا الآخَرَ فَتَبَايَعَا عَلَى ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْبَيْعُ وَإِنْ تَفَرَّقَا بَعْدَ أَنْ تَبَايَعَا وَلَمْ يَتْرُكْ وَاحِدٌ مِنْهُمَا الْبَيْعَ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْبَيْعُ ‏"‏ ‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa tabaaya'a alrrajulaani fakullu waahidin minhumaa bialkhiyaari maa lam yatafarraqaa wakaanaa jamiy'ana aaw yukhayyiru aahaduhumaa alakhara faiin khayyara aahaduhumaa alakhara fatabaaya'aa 'alaa dhalika faqad wajaba albay'u waiin tafarraqaa ba'da aan tabaaya'aa walam yatruk waahidun minhumaa albay'a faqad wajaba albay'u ‏"‏ ‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with thcm) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When two persons enter into a transaction, each of them has the right to annul it so long as they are not separated and are together (at the place of transaction) ; or if one gives the other the right (to annul the transaction) But if one gives the other the option, the transaction is made on this condition (i. e. one has the right to annul the transaction), it becomes binding. And if they are separated after they have made the bargain and none of them annulled it, even then the transaction is binding
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَمْلَى عَلَىَّ نَافِعٌ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا تَبَايَعَ الْمُتَبَايِعَانِ بِالْبَيْعِ فَكُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا بِالْخِيَارِ مِنْ بَيْعِهِ مَا لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقَا أَوْ يَكُونُ بَيْعُهُمَا عَنْ خِيَارٍ فَإِذَا كَانَ بَيْعُهُمَا عَنْ خِيَارٍ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ زَادَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ قَالَ نَافِعٌ فَكَانَ إِذَا بَايَعَ رَجُلاً فَأَرَادَ أَنْ لاَ يُقِيلَهُ قَامَ فَمَشَى هُنَيَّةً ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, kilaahumaa 'an sufyaana, - qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aamlaa 'alaaaa naafi'un sami'a 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa tabaaya'a almutabaayi'aani bialbay'i fakullu waahidin minhumaa bialkhiyaari min bay'ihi maa lam yatafarraqaa aaw yakuwnu bay'uhumaa 'an khiyaarin faiidhaa kaana bay'uhumaa 'an khiyaarin faqad wajaba ‏"‏ ‏.‏ zaada abnu aabiy 'umara fiy riwaayatihi qaala naafi'un fakaana iidhaa baaya'a rajulaan faaaraada aan laa yuqiylahu qaama famashaa hunayyaaan thumma raja'a iilayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When two persons enter into a transac. tion, each one of them has the right to annul it so long as they are not separated, or their transaction gives one another (as a condition) the right of annulling, and if their transaction, has the right of annulling it the transaction becomes binding. Ibn Abi Umar made this addition that whenever he (Ibn Umar) entered into a transaction with a person with the intention of not breaking it, he walked a while and then returned to him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، و يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ وَقُتَيْبَةُ وَابْنُ حُجْرٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ، عُمَرَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كُلُّ بَيِّعَيْنِ لاَ بَيْعَ بَيْنَهُمَا حَتَّى يَتَفَرَّقَا إِلاَّ بَيْعُ الْخِيَارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, w yahyaa bnu aayyuwba waqutaybaau waabnu hujrin qaala yahyaa bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, aannahu sami'a abna, 'umara yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ kullu bayyi'ayni laa bay'a baynahumaa hattaa yatafarraqaa iilaaa bay'u alkhiyaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no transaction between two persons entering a transaction until they separate, but only when there is an option to annul it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ، عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَلِيلِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْبَيِّعَانِ بِالْخِيَارِ مَا لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقَا فَإِنْ صَدَقَا وَبَيَّنَا بُورِكَ لَهُمَا فِي بَيْعِهِمَا وَإِنْ كَذَبَا وَكَتَمَا مُحِقَتْ بَرَكَةُ بَيْعِهِمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa 'amruw bnu, 'aliyyin haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, wa'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aabiy alkhaliyli, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi, 'an hakiymi bni hizaamin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ albayyi'aani bialkhiyaari maa lam yatafarraqaa faiin sadaqaa wabayyanaa buwrika lahumaa fiy bay'ihimaa waiin kadhabaa wakatamaa muhiqat barakaau bay'ihimaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hakim b. Hazim (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Both parties in a business transaction have the right to annul it so long as they have not separated; and if they speak the truth and make everything clear they will be blessed in their transaction; but if they tell a lie and conceal anything the blessing on their transaction will be blotted out
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ وُلِدَ حَكِيمُ بْنُ حِزَامٍ فِي جَوْفِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَعَاشَ مِائَةً وَعِشْرِينَ سَنَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna alhaarithi, yuhaddithu 'an hakiymi bni hizaamin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi ‏.‏ qaala muslimu bnu alhajjaaji wulida hakiymu bnu hizaamin fiy jawfi alka'baai wa'aasha miaiaaan wa'ishriyna sanaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Hakim b. Hizam (Imam Muslim) said:Hakim b. Hizam was born inside the Ka'ba and lived for one hundred and twenty years
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ، عُمَرَ يَقُولُ ذَكَرَ رَجُلٌ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ يُخْدَعُ فِي الْبُيُوعِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ بَايَعْتَ فَقُلْ لاَ خِلاَبَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَكَانَ إِذَا بَايَعَ يَقُولُ لاَ خِيَابَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wayahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaala yahyaa bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, aannahu sami'a abna, 'umara yaquwlu dhakara rajulun lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu yukhda'u fiy albuyuw'i faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man baaya'ta faqul laa khilaabaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fakaana iidhaa baaya'a yaquwlu laa khiyaabaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Dinar narrated that he heard Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) saying:A man mentioned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he was deceived in a business transaction, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When you enter into a transaction, say: There should be no attempt to deceive
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا فَكَانَ إِذَا بَايَعَ يَقُولُ لاَ خِيَابَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa sufyaanu, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu, almuthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu walaysa fiy hadiythihimaa fakaana iidhaa baaya'a yaquwlu laa khiyaabaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Dinar with the same chain of transmitters but these words are not found in it." When he buys he should say:There should be no attempt to deceive
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرِ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلاَحُهَا نَهَى الْبَائِعَ وَالْمُبْتَاعَ
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an bay'i althhamari hattaa yabduwa salaahuhaa nahaa albaaii'a waalmubtaa'a
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of fruits until they were clearly in good condition, he forbade it both to the seller and to the buyer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Another chain on the authority of Ibn 'Umar narrated the same as the above hadith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ النَّخْلِ حَتَّى يَزْهُوَ وَعَنِ السُّنْبُلِ حَتَّى يَبْيَضَّ وَيَأْمَنَ الْعَاهَةَ نَهَى الْبَائِعَ وَالْمُشْتَرِيَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an bay'i alnnakhli hattaa yazhuwa wa'ani alssunbuli hattaa yabyadda wayaamana al'aahaaa nahaa albaaii'a waalmushtariya ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of palm-trees (i. e. their trults) until the dates began to ripen, and ears of corn until they were white and were safe from blight. He forbade the seller and the buyer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَبْتَاعُوا الثَّمَرَ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلاَحُهُ وَتَذْهَبَ عَنْهُ الآفَةُ قَالَ يَبْدُوَ صَلاَحُهُ حُمْرَتُهُ وَصُفْرَتُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa tabtaa'uwa althhamara hattaa yabduwa salaahuhu watadhhaba 'anhu alafaau qaala yabduwa salaahuhu humratuhu wasufratuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not buy fruit until its good condition becomes clear, and (the danger) of blight is no more. He said: Its good condition becoming clear implies that it becomes red or yellow
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلاَحُهُ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَا بَعْدَهُ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, 'an yahyaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi hattaa yabduwa salaahuhu lam yadhkur maa ba'dahu
verses.translation: This hadith is reported or the authority of Yahya with the same chain of transmitters up to" until its good condition becomes clear," but lie did not mention what follows (these words)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi 'abdi alwahhaabi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hafsu bnu maysaraaa, haddathaniy muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi maalikin wa'ubaydi alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi, reported on the authority of Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) a hadith like that narrated before
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَبِيعُوا الثَّمَرَ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلاَحُهُ ‏"‏ ‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wayahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaala yahyaa bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, aannahu sami'a abna 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tabiy'uwa althhamara hattaa yabduwa salaahuhu ‏"‏ ‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger' (ﷺ) as saying:Do not buy fruits (on the trees) until their good condition becomes clear
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ فَقِيلَ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ مَا صَلاَحُهُ قَالَ تَذْهَبُ عَاهَتُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, 'an sufyaana, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wazaada fiy hadiythi shu'baaa faqiyla laibni 'umara maa salaahuhu qaala tadhhabu 'aahatuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba it was stated that Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) was asked what good condition implied. He said:When (the danger of) blight is no more
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَهَى - أَوْ نَهَانَا - رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرِ حَتَّى يَطِيبَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, h. wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala nahaa - aaw nahaanaa - rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an bay'i althhamari hattaa yatiyba ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (or forbade us) the sale of fruits until they are ripe in a good condition
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ النَّوْفَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرِ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلاَحُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'uthmaana alnnawfaliyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa rawhun, qaalaa haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu diynaarin, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an bay'i althhamari hattaa yabduwa salaahuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding the sale of fruit until its good condition is obvious
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْبَخْتَرِيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ بَيْعِ النَّخْلِ، فَقَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعِ النَّخْلِ حَتَّى يَأْكُلَ مِنْهُ أَوْ يُؤْكَلَ وَحَتَّى يُوزَنَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ مَا يُوزَنُ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ عِنْدَهُ حَتَّى يَحْزَرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, 'an aabiy albakhtariyyi, qaala saaaltu abna 'abbaasin 'an bay'i alnnakhli, faqaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an bay'i alnnakhli hattaa yaakula minhu aaw yuukala wahattaa yuwzana ‏.‏ qaala faqultu maa yuwzanu faqaala rajulun 'indahu hattaa yahzara ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Bakhtari reported:I asked Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) about the sale of dates. He said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of dates of the trees until one eats them or they are eaten (i. e. they are fit to be eaten) or until they are weighed (or measured). I said: What does it imply:" Until it is weighed"? Thereupon a person who was with him (Ibn Abbas) said: Until he is able to keep it with him (after plucking them)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي، نُعْمٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَبْتَاعُوا الثِّمَارَ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلاَحُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni aabiy, nu'min 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tabtaa'uwa althhimaara hattaa yabduwa salaahuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not sell the fruits until their good condition becomes evident
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُمَا - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرِ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلاَحُهُ وَعَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرِ بِالتَّمْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, h wahaddathanaa abnu, numayrin wazuhayru bnu harbin - waalllafzu lahumaa - qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an bay'i althhamari hattaa yabduwa salaahuhu wa'an bay'i althhamari bialttamri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbidding the sale of fruits until their good condition becomes evident and the purchase of dates for dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَحَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَخَّصَ فِي بَيْعِ الْعَرَايَا ‏.‏ زَادَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ أَنْ تُبَاعَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala abnu 'umara wahaddathanaa zaydu bnu thaabitin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakhhasa fiy bay'i al'araayaa ‏.‏ zaada abnu numayrin fiy riwaayatihi aan tubaa'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Thabit (Allah be pleased with him) said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave a concession in case of the sale known as al-araya, there is an addition of the word an tuba'a in the hadith transmitted by Ibn Numair
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِحَرْمَلَةَ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَبْتَاعُوا الثَّمَرَ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلاَحُهُ وَلاَ تَبْتَاعُوا الثَّمَرَ بِالتَّمْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَحَدَّثَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ سَوَاءً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, - waalllafzu liharmalaaa - qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, waaabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tabtaa'uwa althhamara hattaa yabduwa salaahuhu walaa tabtaa'uwa althhamara bialttamri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin wahaddathaniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara 'an aabiyhi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu sawaa'an ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not buy the fruit until their condition is clear, and do not buy the fresh dates. A hadith like this has been reported by Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُجَيْنُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةُ أَنْ يُبَاعَ ثَمَرُ النَّخْلِ بِالتَّمْرِ وَالْمُحَاقَلَةُ أَنْ يُبَاعَ الزَّرْعُ بِالْقَمْحِ وَاسْتِكْرَاءُ الأَرْضِ بِالْقَمْحِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَبْتَاعُوا الثَّمَرَ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلاَحُهُ وَلاَ تَبْتَاعُوا الثَّمَرَ بِالتَّمْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ سَالِمٌ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ رَخَّصَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فِي بَيْعِ الْعَرِيَّةِ بِالرُّطَبِ أَوْ بِالتَّمْرِ وَلَمْ يُرَخِّصْ فِي غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa hujaynu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an bay'i almuzaabanaai waalmuhaaqalaai waalmuzaabanaau aan yubaa'a thamaru alnnakhli bialttamri waalmuhaaqalaau aan yubaa'a alzzar'u bialqamhi waastikraa'u alaardi bialqamhi ‏.‏ qaala waaakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ laa tabtaa'uwa althhamara hattaa yabduwa salaahuhu walaa tabtaa'uwa althhamara bialttamri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala saalimun aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi, 'an zaydi bni thaabitin, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu rakhhasa ba'da dhalika fiy bay'i al'ariyyaai bialrrutabi aaw bialttamri walam yurakhhis fiy ghayri dhalika
verses.translation: Sa'id b. al-Musayyib said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the transaction of Af Muzabana and Muhaqala. Muzabana means that fresh dates on the trees should be sold against dry dates. Muhaqala implies that the wheat in the ear should be sold against the wheat and getting the land on rent for the wheat (produced in it). He (the narrator) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) had aid:Do not sell fresh fruits on the trees until their good condition becomes manifest, and do not sell fresh dates on the trees against dry dates. Salim said: Abdullah informed me on the authority of Zaid b. Thabit, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having given concession afterwards in case of ariyya transactions by which dry dates can be exchanged with fresh dates, but he did not permit it in other cases
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ، بْنِ ثَابِتٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَخَّصَ لِصَاحِبِ الْعَرِيَّةِ أَنْ يَبِيعَهَا بِخَرْصِهَا مِنَ التَّمْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'an zaydi, bni thaabitin aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakhhasa lisaahibi al'ariyyaai aan yabiy'ahaa bikharsihaa mina alttamri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Thabit (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) having given concession in case of 'ariyya for selling dry dates (with) fresh dates after measuring them out
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَخَّصَ فِي الْعَرِيَّةِ يَأْخُذُهَا أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ بِخَرْصِهَا تَمْرًا يَأْكُلُونَهَا رُطَبًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, aannahu sami'a 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, yuhaddithu aanna zayda bna thaabitin, haddathahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakhhasa fiy al'ariyyaai yaakhudhuhaa aahlu albayti bikharsihaa tamrana yaakuluwnahaa rutabana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Thabit reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) give concession in case of 'ariyya transactions according to which the members of the household give dry dates according to a measure and then eat fresh dates (in exchange for it)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, qaala sami'tu yahyaa bna sa'iydin, yaquwlu aakhbaraniy naafi'un, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Nafi' with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَالْعَرِيَّةُ النَّخْلَةُ تُجْعَلُ لِلْقَوْمِ فَيَبِيعُونَهَا بِخَرْصِهَا تَمْرًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aannahu qaala waal'ariyyaau alnnakhlaau tuj'alu lilqawmi fayabiy'uwnahaa bikharsihaa tamrana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Yahya b. Sa'id reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters but with this change:'Ariyya implies that date-palm trees should be donated to the people and then they sell it with a measure of dry dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَخَّصَ فِي بَيْعِ الْعَرِيَّةِ بِخَرْصِهَا تَمْرًا ‏.‏ قَالَ يَحْيَى الْعَرِيَّةُ أَنْ يَشْتَرِيَ الرَّجُلُ ثَمَرَ النَّخَلاَتِ لِطَعَامِ أَهْلِهِ رُطَبًا بِخَرْصِهَا تَمْرًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, haddathaniy zaydu bnu thaabitin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakhhasa fiy bay'i al'ariyyaai bikharsihaa tamrana ‏.‏ qaala yahyaa al'ariyyaau aan yashtariya alrrajulu thamara alnnakhalaati lita'aami aahlihi rutabana bikharsihaa tamrana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b Thabit (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave concession in case of al-'ariyya transactions (for exchanging dates) for dates with measure. Yahya said:'Ariyya implies that a person should buy fresh dates on the tree for his family to eat against a measure of dry dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَخَّصَ فِي الْعَرَايَا أَنْ تُبَاعَ بِخَرْصِهَا كَيْلاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, haddathaniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, 'an zaydi bni thaabitin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakhhasa fiy al'araayaa aan tubaa'a bikharsihaa kaylaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Thabit (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) granting concession in case of 'ariyya transactions and that implies selling of (dry dates for fresh dates) according to a measure
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ أَنْ تُؤْخَذَ بِخَرْصِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala aan tuukhadha bikharsihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubaidullah reported this hadith with a slight change of words on the same authority (as quoted above)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَخَّصَ فِي بَيْعِ الْعَرَايَا بِخَرْصِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, h wahaddathaniyhi 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, kilaahumaa 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, bihadhaa aliisnaadi aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakhhasa fiy bay'i al'araayaa bikharsihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi, reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters stating that Allah's Messengtr (ﷺ) granted concession in case of 'ariyya transactions (for exchange of the same commodity) with measure
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ بَعْضِ، أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَهْلِ دَارِهِمْ مِنْهُمْ سَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرِ بِالتَّمْرِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ ذَلِكَ الرِّبَا تِلْكَ الْمُزَابَنَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ رَخَّصَ فِي بَيْعِ الْعَرِيَّةِ النَّخْلَةِ وَالنَّخْلَتَيْنِ يَأْخُذُهَا أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ بِخَرْصِهَا تَمْرًا يَأْكُلُونَهَا رُطَبًا ‏.‏
