verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa alqa'nabiyyu, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - ya'niy abna bilaalin - 'an yahyaa, - wahuwa abnu sa'iydin - 'an bushayri bni yasaarin, 'an ba'di, aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min aahli daarihim minhum sahlu bnu aabiy hathmaaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an bay'i althhamari bialttamri waqaala ‏ "‏ dhalika alrribaa tilka almuzaabanaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏ iilaaa aannahu rakhhasa fiy bay'i al'ariyyaai alnnakhlaai waalnnakhlatayni yaakhudhuhaa aahlu albayti bikharsihaa tamrana yaakuluwnahaa rutabana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Bashair b. Yasir reported on the authority of some of the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) among the members of his family among whom one was Sahl b. Abu Hathma that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade buying of fresh dates against dry dates and that it is Riba and this is Muzabana, but he made an exemption of 'ariyya (donations) of a tree or two in which case the members of a family sell dry dates and buy fresh dates for eating them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَصْحَابِ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا رَخَّصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْعِ الْعَرِيَّةِ بِخَرْصِهَا تَمْرًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa abnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an yahyaa, bni sa'iydin 'an bushayri bni yasaarin, 'an aashaabi, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahum qaaluwa rakhhasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy bay'i al'ariyyaai bikharsihaa tamrana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Bushair b. Yasar reported on the authority of some of the Companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he exempted the transactions, of 'ariyya (from the direct exchange of one kind) after measuring the dry dates (in exchange for fresh dates)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الثَّقَفِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَنِي بُشَيْرُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ بَعْضِ، أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَهْلِ دَارِهِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى غَيْرَ أَنَّ إِسْحَاقَ وَابْنَ الْمُثَنَّى جَعَلاَ مَكَانَ الرِّبَا الزَّبْنَ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الرِّبَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara, jamiy'ana 'ani althhaqafiyyi, qaala sami'tu yahyaa bna sa'iydin, yaquwlu aakhbaraniy bushayru bnu yasaarin, 'an ba'di, aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min aahli daarihi aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithli hadiythi sulaymaana bni bilaalin 'an yahyaa ghayra aanna iishaaqa waabna almuthannaa ja'alaa makaana alrribaa alzzabna waqaala abnu aabiy 'umara alrribaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Bushair b. Yasir reported on the authority of some of the Companions of Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon hinn) from among the members of his family that he forbade (the direct exchange of a commodity having different qualities) but with the change that Ishaq and Ibn al-Muthanna used the word Zabn in place of Riba and Ibn Abu 'Umar used the word Riba (interest)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ، سَعِيدٍ عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waabnu, numayrin qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an yahyaa bni, sa'iydin 'an bushayri bni yasaarin, 'an sahli bni aabiy hathmaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahwa hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Sahl b. Abu Hathma
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَحَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ، بْنِ كَثِيرٍ حَدَّثَنِي بُشَيْرُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ، مَوْلَى بَنِي حَارِثَةَ أَنَّ رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ، وَسَهْلَ بْنَ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ، حَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْمُزَابَنَةِ الثَّمَرِ بِالتَّمْرِ إِلاَّ أَصْحَابَ الْعَرَايَا فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ أَذِنَ لَهُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wahasanun alhulwaaniyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'ani alwaliydi, bni kathiyrin haddathaniy bushayru bnu yasaarin, mawlaa baniy haarithaaa aanna raafi'a bna khadiyjin, wasahla bna aabiy hathmaaa, haddathaahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani almuzaabanaai althhamari bialttamri iilaaa aashaaba al'araayaa faiinnahu qad aadhina lahum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Abu Hathma reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden Muzabana, i. e. exchange of fresh dates with dry dates. except in case of those to whom donations of some trees have been made. It is for them that concession has been given
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ قُلْتُ لِمَالِكٍ حَدَّثَكَ دَاوُدُ بْنُ الْحُصَيْنِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، - مَوْلَى ابْنِ أَبِي أَحْمَدَ - عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَخَّصَ فِي بَيْعِ الْعَرَايَا بِخَرْصِهَا فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ أَوْ فِي خَمْسَةِ - يَشُكُّ دَاوُدُ قَالَ خَمْسَةٌ أَوْ دُونَ خَمْسَةٍ - قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa maalikun, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala qultu limaalikin haddathaka daawudu bnu alhusayni, 'an aabiy sufyaana, - mawlaa abni aabiy aahmada - 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakhhasa fiy bay'i al'araayaa bikharsihaa fiymaa duwna khamsaai aawsuqin aaw fiy khamsaai - yashukku daawudu qaala khamsaaun aaw duwna khamsaain - qaala na'am ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having given exemption of 'ariyya transactions measuring less than five wasqs or up to five wasqs (the narrator Dawud is in doubt whether it was five or less than five)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةُ بَيْعُ الثَّمَرِ بِالتَّمْرِ كَيْلاً وَبَيْعُ الْكَرْمِ بِالزَّبِيبِ كَيْلاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani almuzaabanaai waalmuzaabanaau bay'u althhamari bialttamri kaylaan wabay'u alkarmi bialzzabiybi kaylaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden Muzabana, and Muzabana implies the selling of fresh dates for dry dates by measuring them out and the selling of raisins by measure for grapes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، بِشْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْمُزَابَنَةِ بَيْعِ ثَمَرِ النَّخْلِ بِالتَّمْرِ كَيْلاً وَبَيْعِ الْعِنَبِ بِالزَّبِيبِ كَيْلاً وَبَيْعِ الزَّرْعِ بِالْحِنْطَةِ كَيْلاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu, bishrin haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, aanna 'abda alllahi, aakhbarahu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani almuzaabanaai bay'i thamari alnnakhli bialttamri kaylaan wabay'i al'inabi bialzzabiybi kaylaan wabay'i alzzar'i bialhintaai kaylaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Umar) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade Muzabana, i. e. buying of fresh dates (on) the trees for dry dates by measure, and the buying of grapes for raisins by measure and the selling of field of corn for corn by measure
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ مَعِينٍ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةُ بَيْعُ ثَمَرِ النَّخْلِ بِالتَّمْرِ كَيْلاً وَبَيْعُ الزَّبِيبِ بِالْعِنَبِ كَيْلاً وَعَنْ كُلِّ ثَمَرٍ بِخَرْصِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu ma'iynin, wahaaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, wahusaynu bnu 'iysaa, qaaluwa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani almuzaabanaai waalmuzaabanaau bay'u thamari alnnakhli bialttamri kaylaan wabay'u alzzabiybi bial'inabi kaylaan wa'an kulli thamarin bikharsihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden Muzabana, and Muzabana is the selling of dry dates by measure for fresh dates and the selling of raisins by measure for grapes and selling of all Ports of fruits on the basis of calculation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةُ أَنْ يُبَاعَ مَا فِي رُءُوسِ النَّخْلِ بِتَمْرٍ بِكَيْلٍ مُسَمًّى إِنْ زَادَ فَلِي وَإِنْ نَقَصَ فَعَلَىَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu iibraahiyma - 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani almuzaabanaai waalmuzaabanaau aan yubaa'a maa fiy ru'uwsi alnnakhli bitamrin bikaylin musammana iin zaada faliy waiin naqasa fa'alaaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden Muzabana, and Muzabana implies the selling of dry dates for fresh dates on the tree with a definite measure (making it clear) that in case it increases, it belongs to me and if it is less, it is my responsibility
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Ayyub
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمُزَابَنَةِ أَنْ يَبِيعَ ثَمَرَ حَائِطِهِ إِنْ كَانَتْ نَخْلاً بِتَمْرٍ كَيْلاً وَإِنْ كَانَ كَرْمًا أَنْ يَبِيعَهُ بِزَبِيبٍ كَيْلاً وَإِنْ كَانَ زَرْعًا أَنْ يَبِيعَهُ بِكَيْلِ طَعَامٍ ‏.‏ نَهَى عَنْ ذَلِكَ كُلِّهِ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ قُتَيْبَةَ أَوْ كَانَ زَرْعًا
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani almuzaabanaai aan yabiy'a thamara haaiitihi iin kaanat nakhlaan bitamrin kaylaan waiin kaana karmana aan yabiy'ahu bizabiybin kaylaan waiin kaana zar'ana aan yabiy'ahu bikayli ta'aamin ‏.‏ nahaa 'an dhalika kullihi ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai qutaybaaa aaw kaana zar'ana
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Umar) (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden Mazabana, and it implies that one should sell the fresh fruits of his orchard (for dry fruits) or, if it is fresh dates, for dry dates with a measure, or if it is grapes for raisins or if it is corn in the field for dry corn with a measure He (the Holy Prophet) in fact forbade all such transactions. Qutaiba has narrated it with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي الضَّحَّاكُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathanaahu abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaraniy alddahhaaku, h wahaddathaniyhi suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hafsu bnu maysaraaa, haddathaniy muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, kulluhum 'an naafi'in, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwa hadiythihim
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Nafi with another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ بَاعَ نَخْلاً قَدْ أُبِّرَتْ فَثَمَرَتُهَا لِلْبَائِعِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُبْتَاعُ ‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man baa'a nakhlaan qad aubbirat fathamaratuhaa lilbaaii'i iilaaa aan yashtarita almubtaa'u ‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:If anyone buys palm-trees after they have been fecundated the fruit belongs to the seller unless the buyer makes a proviso
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيُّمَا نَخْلٍ اشْتُرِيَ أُصُولُهَا وَقَدْ أُبِّرَتْ فَإِنَّ ثَمَرَهَا لِلَّذِي أَبَّرَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الَّذِي اشْتَرَاهَا‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, jamiy'ana 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aayyumaa nakhlin ashturiya ausuwluhaa waqad aubbirat faiinna thamarahaa lilladhiy aabbarahaa iilaaa aan yashtarita alladhiy ashtaraahaa‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi reported on the authority of Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Whichever tree is bought with its roots, and if it is fecundatedits fruit would belong to one who has grafted it except when the provision is laid down by the buyer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيُّمَا امْرِئٍ أَبَّرَ نَخْلاً ثُمَّ بَاعَ أَصْلَهَا فَلِلَّذِي أَبَّرَ ثَمَرُ النَّخْلِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُبْتَاعُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa abnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aayyumaa amriiin aabbara nakhlaan thumma baa'a aaslahaa falilladhiy aabbara thamaru alnnakhli iilaaa aan yashtarita almubtaa'u ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Whosoever grafts the tree and then sells its roots, its fruit will belong to one who grafts it except when provision is laid down by the buyer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, h wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, kilaahumaa 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Nafi, with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ، سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنِ ابْتَاعَ نَخْلاً بَعْدَ أَنْ تُؤَبَّرَ فَثَمَرَتُهَا لِلَّذِي بَاعَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُبْتَاعُ وَمَنِ ابْتَاعَ عَبْدًا فَمَالُهُ لِلَّذِي بَاعَهُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُبْتَاعُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu, sa'iydin haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ mani abtaa'a nakhlaan ba'da aan tuuabbara fathamaratuhaa lilladhiy baa'ahaa iilaaa aan yashtarita almubtaa'u wamani abtaa'a 'abdana famaaluhu lilladhiy baa'ahu iilaaa aan yashtarita almubtaa'u ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Massenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who buys a tree after it has been fecundated, its fruit belongs to one who sells it except when the provision has been laid down by the buyer (that it will belong to him), and he who buys a slave, his property belongs to one who sells him except when a provision has been laid down by the buyer (that it will be transferred to him with the slave)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wazuhayru bnu harbin qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of al Zuhri
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna aabaahu, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported on the authority of his father as Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالُوا جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْمُخَابَرَةِ وَعَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرِ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلاَحُهُ وَلاَ يُبَاعُ إِلاَّ بِالدِّينَارِ وَالدِّرْهَمِ إِلاَّ الْعَرَايَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaaluwa jamiy'ana haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani almuhaaqalaai waalmuzaabanaai waalmukhaabaraai wa'an bay'i althhamari hattaa yabduwa salaahuhu walaa yubaa'u iilaaa bialddiynaari waalddirhami iilaaa al'araayaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden Muhaqala. and Muzabana, Mukhibara and the sale of fruits until their good condition becomes clear, and (he commanded) that (commodities) should not be sold but for the dinar and dirham except in case of araya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، وَأَبِي، الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'aasimin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, 'an 'ataa'in, waaabiy, alzzubayri aannahumaa sami'aa jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the types of sales as described before
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْجَزَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْمُخَابَرَةِ وَالْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةِ وَعَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرَةِ حَتَّى تُطْعِمَ وَلاَ تُبَاعُ إِلاَّ بِالدَّرَاهِمِ وَالدَّنَانِيرِ إِلاَّ الْعَرَايَا ‏.‏ قَالَ عَطَاءٌ فَسَّرَ لَنَا جَابِرٌ قَالَ أَمَّا الْمُخَابَرَةُ فَالأَرْضُ الْبَيْضَاءُ يَدْفَعُهَا الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ فَيُنْفِقُ فِيهَا ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُ مِنَ الثَّمَرِ ‏.‏ وَزَعَمَ أَنَّ الْمُزَابَنَةَ بَيْعُ الرُّطَبِ فِي النَّخْلِ بِالتَّمْرِ كَيْلاً ‏.‏ وَالْمُحَاقَلَةُ فِي الزَّرْعِ عَلَى نَحْوِ ذَلِكَ يَبِيعُ الزَّرْعَ الْقَائِمَ بِالْحَبِّ كَيْلاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa makhladu bnu yaziyda aljazariyyu, haddathanaa abnu, jurayjin aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani almukhaabaraai waalmuhaaqalaai waalmuzaabanaai wa'an bay'i althhamaraai hattaa tut'ima walaa tubaa'u iilaaa bialddaraahimi waalddanaaniyri iilaaa al'araayaa ‏.‏ qaala 'ataa'un fassara lanaa jaabirun qaala aammaa almukhaabaraau faalaardu albaydaa'u yadfa'uhaa alrrajulu iilaa alrrajuli fayunfiqu fiyhaa thumma yaakhudhu mina althhamari ‏.‏ waza'ama aanna almuzaabanaaa bay'u alrrutabi fiy alnnakhli bialttamri kaylaan ‏.‏ waalmuhaaqalaau fiy alzzar'i 'alaa nahwi dhalika yabiy'u alzzar'a alqaaiima bialhabbi kaylaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Mukhabara and Muhaqala, and Muzabana, and the sale of the fruit until it is fit for eating, and its sale but with dirham and dinar. Exception is made in case of 'araya. Ata' said:Jabir explained (these terms) for us. As for Mukhabara it is this that a wasteland is given by a person to another and he makes an investment in it and then gets a share in the produce. According to him (Jabir), Muzabana is the sell of fresh dates on the tree for dry dates with a measure, and Muhaqala in agriculture implies that one should sell the standing crop for grains with a measure
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي خَلَفٍ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الْمَكِّيُّ، وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ عِنْدَ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْمُخَابَرَةِ وَأَنْ تُشْتَرَى النَّخْلُ حَتَّى تُشْقِهَ - وَالإِشْقَاهُ أَنْ يَحْمَرَّ أَوْ يَصْفَرَّ أَوْ يُؤْكَلَ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ - وَالْمُحَاقَلَةُ أَنْ يُبَاعَ الْحَقْلُ بِكَيْلٍ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ مَعْلُومٍ وَالْمُزَابَنَةُ أَنْ يُبَاعَ النَّخْلُ بِأَوْسَاقٍ مِنَ التَّمْرِ وَالْمُخَابَرَةُ الثُّلُثُ وَالرُّبُعُ وَأَشْبَاهُ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ زَيْدٌ قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ أَسَمِعْتَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَذْكُرُ هَذَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu aahmada bni aabiy khalafin, kilaahumaa 'an zakariyyaa'a, qaala abnu aabiy khalafin haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu 'adiyyin, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an zaydi bni aabiy aunaysaaa, haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi almakkiyyu, wahuwa jaalisun 'inda 'ataa'i bni aabiy rabaahin 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani almuhaaqalaai waalmuzaabanaai waalmukhaabaraai waaan tushtaraa alnnakhlu hattaa tushqiha - waaliishqaahu aan yahmarra aaw yasfarra aaw yuukala minhu shaa'un - waalmuhaaqalaau aan yubaa'a alhaqlu bikaylin mina altta'aami ma'luwmin waalmuzaabanaau aan yubaa'a alnnakhlu biaawsaaqin mina alttamri waalmukhaabaraau althhuluthu waalrrubu'u waaashbaahu dhalika ‏.‏ qaala zaydun qultu li'ataa'i bni aabiy rabaahin aasami'ta jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi yadhkuru hadhaa 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala na'am ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding Muhaqala, and Muzabana, and Mukhabara, and the buying of date-palm until its fruit is ripened (ripening means that its colour becomes red or yellow, or it is fit for being eaten). And Muhaqala implies that crops in the field are bought for grains according to a customary measure. Muzabana implies that date-palm should be sold for dry dates by measuring them with wisqs, and al-Mukhabara is (a share), maybe one-third or one-fourth (in produce) or something like it. Zaid (one of the narrators) said to Ata' b. Abu Rabah (the other narrator):Did You bear Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) making a mention of it that he had heard it directly from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said: Yes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ، مِينَاءَ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُخَابَرَةِ وَعَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرَةِ حَتَّى تُشْقِحَ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِسَعِيدٍ مَا تُشْقِحُ قَالَ تَحْمَارُّ وَتَصْفَارُّ وَيُؤْكَلُ مِنْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu haashimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa saliymu bnu hayyaana, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu, miynaa'a 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani almuzaabanaai waalmuhaaqalaai waalmukhaabaraai wa'an bay'i althhamaraai hattaa tushqiha ‏.‏ qaala qultu lisa'iydin maa tushqihu qaala tahmaarru watasfaarru wayuukalu minhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding Muzabana and Muhaqala, and Mukhabara, and the sale of fruits until they are ripe. I (the narrator) said to Sa'id (the other narrator):What does ripening imply? He said: It meant that they become red or become yellow and are fit for eating
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَرِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ مِينَاءَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْمُعَاوَمَةِ وَالْمُخَابَرَةِ - قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا بَيْعُ السِّنِينَ هِيَ الْمُعَاوَمَةُ - وَعَنِ الثُّنْيَا وَرَخَّصَ فِي الْعَرَايَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, wamuhammadu bnu 'ubaydin alghubariyyu, - waalllafzu li'ubaydi alllahi - qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, wasa'iydi bni miynaa'a, 'an jaabiri bni, 'abdi alllahi qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani almuhaaqalaai waalmuzaabanaai waalmu'aawamaai waalmukhaabaraai - qaala aahaduhumaa bay'u alssiniyna hiya almu'aawamaau - wa'ani althhunyaa warakhhasa fiy al'araayaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding Muhaqala and Muzabana and Mu'awama and Mukhabara. (One of the narrators) 'said:Sale years ahead is Mu'awama, and making exceptional but he made an exemption of araya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لاَ يَذْكُرُ بَيْعُ السِّنِينَ هِيَ الْمُعَاوَمَةُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu 'ulayyaaa - 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi ghayra aannahu laa yadhkuru bay'u alssiniyna hiya almu'aawamaau ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). but he made no mention of transactions years (ahead) implying Mu'awama
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا رَبَاحُ بْنُ، أَبِي مَعْرُوفٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءً، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ كِرَاءِ الأَرْضِ وَعَنْ بَيْعِهَا السِّنِينَ وَعَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرِ حَتَّى يَطِيبَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi almajiydi, haddathanaa rabaahu bnu, aabiy ma'ruwfin qaala sami'tu 'ataa'an, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an kiraa'i alaardi wa'an bay'ihaa alssiniyna wa'an bay'i althhamari hattaa yatiyba ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade leasing of land, and selling ahead for years and selling of fruits before they become ripe
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ مَطَرٍ الْوَرَّاقِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ كِرَاءِ الأَرْضِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, - ya'niy abna zaydin - 'an matarin alwarraaqi, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an kiraa'i alaardi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden the renting of land
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، - لَقَبُهُ عَارِمٌ وَهُوَ أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ السَّدُوسِيُّ - حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَطَرٌ الْوَرَّاقُ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَلْيَزْرَعْهَا فَإِنْ لَمْ يَزْرَعْهَا فَلْيُزْرِعْهَا أَخَاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu alfadli, - laqabuhu 'aarimun wahuwa aabuw alnnu'maani alssaduwsiyyu - haddathanaa mahdiyyu bnu maymuwnin, haddathanaa matarun alwarraaqu, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man kaanat lahu aardun falyazra'haa faiin lam yazra'haa falyuzri'haa aakhaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who has land should cultivate it himself, but if he does not cultivate it himself, then he should let his brother cultivate it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِقْلٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ - عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ لِرِجَالٍ فُضُولُ أَرَضِينَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ فَضْلُ أَرْضٍ فَلْيَزْرَعْهَا أَوْ لِيَمْنَحْهَا أَخَاهُ فَإِنْ أَبَى فَلْيُمْسِكْ أَرْضَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhakamu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa hiqlun, - ya'niy abna ziyaadin - 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala kaana lirijaalin fuduwlu aaradiyna min aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man kaanat lahu fadlu aardin falyazra'haa aaw liyamnahhaa aakhaahu faiin aabaa falyumsik aardahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported some of the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had surplus of land. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:He, who has surplus land (in his possession) should cultivate it, or he should lend it to his brother for benefit, but if he refuses to accept it, he should retain it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ الرَّازِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَخْنَسِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُؤْخَذَ لِلأَرْضِ أَجْرٌ أَوْ حَظٌّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu mansuwrin alrraaziyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, aakhbaranaa alshhaybaaniyyu, 'an bukayri bni alaakhnasi, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yuukhadha lilaardi aajrun aaw hazzun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden taking of rent or share of land
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَلْيَزْرَعْهَا فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَزْرَعَهَا وَعَجَزَ عَنْهَا فَلْيَمْنَحْهَا أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ وَلاَ يُؤَاجِرْهَا إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man kaanat lahu aardun falyazra'haa faiin lam yastati' aan yazra'ahaa wa'ajaza 'anhaa falyamnahhaa aakhaahu almuslima walaa yuuaajirhaa iiyyaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who has land should cultivate it, but if he does not find it possible to cultivate it, or finds himself helpless to do so, he should lend it to his Muslim brother, but he should not accept rent from him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، قَالَ سَأَلَ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَطَاءً فَقَالَ أَحَدَّثَكَ جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَلْيَزْرَعْهَا أَوْ لِيُزْرِعْهَا أَخَاهُ وَلاَ يُكْرِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa hammaamun, qaala saaala sulaymaanu bnu muwsaa 'ataa'an faqaala aahaddathaka jaabiru bnu 'abdi alllahi aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man kaanat lahu aardun falyazra'haa aaw liyuzri'haa aakhaahu walaa yukrihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sulaiman b. Musa asked Ata':Did Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:" He who has land should cultivate it himself, or let his brother cultivate it, and should not give on rent"? He said: Yes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْمُخَابَرَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an jaabirin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani almukhaabaraai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having forbidden Mukhabara
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمُ بْنُ، حَيَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مِينَاءَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ فَضْلُ أَرْضٍ فَلْيَزْرَعْهَا أَوْ لِيُزْرِعْهَا أَخَاهُ وَلاَ تَبِيعُوهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لِسَعِيدٍ مَا قَوْلُهُ وَلاَ تَبِيعُوهَا يَعْنِي الْكِرَاءَ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi almajiydi, haddathanaa saliymu bnu, hayyaana haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu miynaa'a, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man kaana lahu fadlu aardin falyazra'haa aaw liyuzri'haa aakhaahu walaa tabiy'uwhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu lisa'iydin maa qawluhu walaa tabiy'uwhaa ya'niy alkiraa'a ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say:He who has surplus of land should either cultivate it himself, or let his brother cultivate it, an should not sell it. I (the narrator) said to Sa'id: What does his statement" do not sell it" mean? Does it imply" rent"? He said: Yes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُخَابِرُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنُصِيبُ مِنَ الْقِصْرِيِّ وَمِنْ كَذَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَلْيَزْرَعْهَا أَوْ فَلْيُحْرِثْهَا أَخَاهُ وَإِلاَّ فَلْيَدَعْهَا‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala kunnaa nukhaabiru 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fanusiybu mina alqisriyyi wamin kadhaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man kaanat lahu aardun falyazra'haa aaw falyuhrithhaa aakhaahu waiilaaa falyada'haa‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:We used to cultivate land on rent during the lifetime of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and we got a share out of the grain left in the ears after threshing them and something unspecified. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who has land should cultivate it or let his brother till it, otherwise he should leave it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ، - قَالَ ابْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، - حَدَّثَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا الزُّبَيْرِ الْمَكِّيَّ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ كُنَّا فِي زَمَانِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَأْخُذُ الأَرْضَ بِالثُّلُثِ أَوِ الرُّبُعِ بِالْمَاذِيَانَاتِ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَلْيَزْرَعْهَا فَإِنْ لَمْ يَزْرَعْهَا فَلْيَمْنَحْهَا أَخَاهُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَمْنَحْهَا أَخَاهُ فَلْيُمْسِكْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, jamiy'ana 'ani abni wahbin, - qaala abnu 'iysaa haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, - haddathaniy hishaamu bnu sa'din, aanna aabaa alzzubayri almakkiyya, haddathahu qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu kunnaa fiy zamaani rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm naakhudhu alaarda bialthhuluthi aawi alrrubu'i bialmaadhiyaanaati faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy dhalika faqaala ‏ "‏ man kaanat lahu aardun falyazra'haa faiin lam yazra'haa falyamnahhaa aakhaahu faiin lam yamnahhaa aakhaahu falyumsikhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported:We used to get land (on rent) during the lifetime of Allah's Messeuge, (ﷺ) with a share of one-third or one-fourth (of the produce from the land irrigated) with the help of canals. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up (to address) and said: HRe who has land should cultivate it, and if he does not cultivate it, he should lend it to his brother, and if he does not lend it to his brother, he should then retain it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَلْيَهَبْهَا أَوْ لِيُعِرْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu hammaadin, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an sulaymaana, haddathanaa aabuw sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man kaanat lahu aardun falyahabhaa aaw liyu'irhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah he pleased with him) reported:I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: He who has (surplus) land should donate it (to others), or lend it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْجَوَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمَّارُ بْنُ رُزَيْقٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَلْيَزْرَعْهَا أَوْ فَلْيُزْرِعْهَا رَجُلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa aabuw aljawwaabi, haddathanaa 'ammaaru bnu ruzayqin, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ falyazra'haa aaw falyuzri'haa rajulaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight change of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ - أَنَّ بُكَيْرًا، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ كِرَاءِ الأَرْضِ ‏.‏ قَالَ بُكَيْرٌ وَحَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ كُنَّا نُكْرِي أَرْضَنَا ثُمَّ تَرَكْنَا ذَلِكَ حِينَ سَمِعْنَا حَدِيثَ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, - wahuwa abnu alhaarithi - aanna bukayrana, haddathahu aanna 'abda alllahi bna aabiy salamaaa haddathahu 'ani alnnu'maani bni aabiy 'ayyaashin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an kiraa'i alaardi ‏.‏ qaala bukayrun wahaddathaniy naafi'un, aannahu sami'a abna 'umara, yaquwlu kunnaa nukriy aardanaa thumma taraknaa dhalika hiyna sami'naa hadiytha raafi'i bni khadiyjin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. `Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reportedthat Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden renting of land. Bukair (one of the narrators) said:Nafi` reported to me that he heard Ibn `Umar (Allah be pleased with them) saying: We usedto give land on rent; we then abandoned this practice when we heard the hadith of Rafi` b. Khadij
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعِ الأَرْضِ الْبَيْضَاءِ سَنَتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an bay'i alaardi albaydaa'i sanatayni aaw thalaathana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding the selling (renting of) uncultivated land for two years or three
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ عَتِيقٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعِ السِّنِينَ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ عَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرِ سِنِينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, waaabuw bakri bnu shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu wazuhayru bnu harbin qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an humaydin alaa'raji, 'an sulaymaana bni 'atiyqin, 'an jaabirin, qaala nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an bay'i alssiniyna ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai abni aabiy shaybaaa 'an bay'i althhamari siniyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbidding selling of (produce) in advance for two years, and in the narmtion of Ibu Abd Shaiba (the words are):" Selling of the fruits (on the tree) in advance for two years
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو تَوْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ، أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَلْيَزْرَعْهَا أَوْ لِيَمْنَحْهَا أَخَاهُ فَإِنْ أَبَى فَلْيُمْسِكْ أَرْضَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa aabuw tawbaaa, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau, 'an yahyaa bni, aabiy kathiyrin 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man kaanat lahu aardun falyazra'haa aaw liyamnahhaa aakhaahu faiin aabaa falyumsik aardahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who has land should cultivate it or lend it to his brother, but if he refuses, he should retain his land
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو تَوْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، أَنَّ يَزِيدَ بْنَ نُعَيْمٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَى عَنِ الْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْحُقُولِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَابَنَةُ الثَّمَرُ بِالتَّمْرِ ‏.‏ وَالْحُقُولُ كِرَاءُ الأَرْضِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa alhasanu alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa aabuw tawbaaa, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, aanna yaziyda bna nu'aymin, aakhbarahu aanna jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi aakhbarahu aannahu, sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yanhaa 'ani almuzaabanaai waalhuquwli ‏.‏ faqaala jaabiru bnu 'abdi alllahi almuzaabanaau althhamaru bialttamri ‏.‏ waalhuquwlu kiraa'u alaardi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding Muzabana, and Huqul. Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) said: Muzabana means the selling of fruits for dry dates and Huqul is the renting of land
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةِ ‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyya - 'an suhayli bni aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani almuhaaqalaai waalmuzaabanaai ‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding Muhaqala and Muzabana
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ أَبِي أَحْمَدَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْمُحَاقَلَةِ ‏.‏ وَالْمُزَابَنَةُ اشْتِرَاءُ الثَّمَرِ فِي رُءُوسِ النَّخْلِ ‏.‏ وَالْمُحَاقَلَةُ كِرَاءُ الأَرْضِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy maaliku bnu aanasin, 'an daawuda bni alhusayni, aanna aabaa sufyaana, mawlaa abni aabiy aahmada aakhbarahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya, yaquwlu nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani almuzaabanaai waalmuhaaqalaai ‏.‏ waalmuzaabanaau ashtiraa'u althhamari fiy ru'uwsi alnnakhli ‏.‏ waalmuhaaqalaau kiraa'u alaardi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden Mazabana and Muhaqala. Muzibana means the buying of fruits on the trees and Muhaqala is the renting of land
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، قَالَ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ كُنَّا لاَ نَرَى بِالْخِبْرِ بَأْسًا حَتَّى كَانَ عَامُ أَوَّلَ فَزَعَمَ رَافِعٌ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, qaala aabuw alrrabiy'i haddathanaa waqaala, yahyaa aakhbaranaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an 'amrinw, qaala sami'tu abna 'umara, yaquwlu kunnaa laa naraa bialkhibri baasana hattaa kaana 'aamu aawwala faza'ama raafi'un aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'anhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Amr reported:I heard Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) say: We did not see any harm in renting of the land, but as the first year was over Rafi' alleged Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having forbidden that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ، بْنُ دِينَارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ فَتَرَكْنَاهُ مِنْ أَجْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, h wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, waiibraahiymu, bnu diynaarin qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu 'ulayyaaa - 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa sufyaanu, kulluhum 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu wazaada fiy hadiythi abni 'uyaynaaa fataraknaahu min aajlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Amr b. Dinar with the same chain of transmitters but (in) the hadith transmitted on the authority of 'Uyainah (the words are):" We abandoned it (renting) on account of that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَلِيلِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ لَقَدْ مَنَعَنَا رَافِعٌ نَفْعَ أَرْضِنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy alkhaliyli, 'an mujaahidin, qaala qaala abnu 'umara laqad mana'anaa raafi'un naf'a aardinaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported:Rafi forbade us from benefitting from our land (in the form of rent)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، كَانَ يُكْرِي مَزَارِعَهُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَفِي إِمَارَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ وَصَدْرًا مِنْ خِلاَفَةِ مُعَاوِيَةَ حَتَّى بَلَغَهُ فِي آخِرِ خِلاَفَةِ مُعَاوِيَةَ أَنَّ رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ يُحَدِّثُ فِيهَا بِنَهْىٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنَا مَعَهُ فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَى عَنْ كِرَاءِ الْمَزَارِعِ ‏.‏ فَتَرَكَهَا ابْنُ عُمَرَ بَعْدُ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ إِذَا سُئِلَ عَنْهَا بَعْدُ قَالَ زَعَمَ رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara, kaana yukriy mazaari'ahu 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wafiy iimaaraai aabiy bakrin wa'umara wa'uthmaana wasadrana min khilaafaai mu'aawiyaaa hattaa balaghahu fiy akhiri khilaafaai mu'aawiyaaa aanna raafi'a bna khadiyjin yuhaddithu fiyhaa binahain 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadakhala 'alayhi waaanaa ma'ahu fasaaalahu faqaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yanhaa 'an kiraa'i almazaari'i ‏.‏ fatarakahaa abnu 'umara ba'du ‏.‏ wakaana iidhaa suiila 'anhaa ba'du qaala za'ama raafi'u bnu khadiyjin aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'anhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi reported that Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) rented his land during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and during the caliphate of Abu Bakr and that of Umar and that of Uthman (Allah be pleased with them) and during the early period of Muawiya's caliphate until at the end of Muawiya's reign, it reached him (Ibn 'Umar) that Rafi b. Khadij (Allah be pleased with him) narratted (a hadith) in which (there was a decree) of prohibition by Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He (Ibn 'Umar) went to him (Rafi b. Khadij) and I was with him and he asked him, whereupon he said:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to forbid the renting of land. So Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) abandoned it, and subsequently whenever he was asked about it, he said: Rafi b. Khadij (Allah be pleased with him) alleged that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ قَالَ فَتَرَكَهَا ابْنُ عُمَرَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَكَانَ لاَ يُكْرِيهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, h wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, kilaahumaa 'an aayyuwba, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu wazaada fiy hadiythi abni 'ulayyaaa qaala fatarakahaa abnu 'umara ba'da dhalika fakaana laa yukriyhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ayyub and he made an addition in the hadith narrated by Ibn Ulayya in which he said:Ibn Umar abandoned it afterwards and he did not rent it (the land)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ ذَهَبْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ إِلَى رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ حَتَّى أَتَاهُ بِالْبَلاَطِ فَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ كِرَاءِ الْمَزَارِعِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, qaala dhahabtu ma'a abni 'umara iilaa raafi'i bni khadiyjin hattaa aataahu bialbalaati faaakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an kiraa'i almazaari'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi reported:I went to Rafi b. Khadij in the company of Ibn 'Umar (All be pleased with them) until he (Ibn 'Umar) came to him at Balat (a place near Prophet's Mosque at Medina) and he (Rafi b. Khadij) informed him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden the renting of land
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، وَحَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ أَتَى رَافِعًا فَذَكَرَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy abnu aabiy khalafin, wahajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, qaalaa haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu 'adiyyin, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'amrinw, 'an zaydin, 'ani alhakami, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aannahu aataa raafi'ana fadhakara hadhaa alhadiytha 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi, reported from Ibn Umar (Allah be pleated with them) that he came to Rafi and he narrated this hadith from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَسَنِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ - حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، عَوْنٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، كَانَ يَأْجُرُ الأَرْضَ - قَالَ - فَنُبِّئَ حَدِيثًا عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ - قَالَ - فَانْطَلَقَ بِي مَعَهُ إِلَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَذَكَرَ عَنْ بَعْضِ عُمُومَتِهِ ذَكَرَ فِيهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنْ كِرَاءِ الأَرْضِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَرَكَهُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَلَمْ يَأْجُرْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa husaynun, - ya'niy abna hasani bni yasaarin - haddathanaa abnu, 'awnin 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara, kaana yaajuru alaarda - qaala - fanubbiia hadiythana 'an raafi'i bni khadiyjin - qaala - faantalaqa biy ma'ahu iilayhi - qaala - fadhakara 'an ba'di 'umuwmatihi dhakara fiyhi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu nahaa 'an kiraa'i alaardi ‏.‏ qaala fatarakahu abnu 'umara falam yaajurhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi, reported that Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) used to rent the land, and that he was conveyed the hadith transmitted on the authority of Rafi b. Khadij. He (the narrator) said:He then went to him along with me. He (Rafi) narrated from some of his uncles in which it was mentioned that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade the renting of land. Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) then abandoned this practice of renting
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ فَحَدَّثَهُ عَنْ بَعْضِ، عُمُومَتِهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, haddathanaa abnu 'awnin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala fahaddathahu 'an ba'di, 'umuwmatihi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، كَانَ يُكْرِي أَرَضِيهِ حَتَّى بَلَغَهُ أَنَّ رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ كَانَ يَنْهَى عَنْ كِرَاءِ الأَرْضِ فَلَقِيَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ يَا ابْنَ خَدِيجٍ مَاذَا تُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي كِرَاءِ الأَرْضِ قَالَ رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ سَمِعْتُ عَمَّىَّ - وَكَانَا قَدْ شَهِدَا بَدْرًا - يُحَدِّثَانِ أَهْلَ الدَّارِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ كِرَاءِ الأَرْضِ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ كُنْتُ أَعْلَمُ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ الأَرْضَ تُكْرَى ثُمَّ خَشِيَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَنْ يَكُونَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْدَثَ فِي ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلِمَهُ فَتَرَكَ كِرَاءَ الأَرْضِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi bni sa'din, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu khaalidin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aannahu qaala aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, kaana yukriy aaradiyhi hattaa balaghahu aanna raafi'a bna khadiyjin alaansaariyya kaana yanhaa 'an kiraa'i alaardi falaqiyahu 'abdu alllahi faqaala yaa abna khadiyjin maadhaa tuhaddithu 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy kiraa'i alaardi qaala raafi'u bnu khadiyjin li'abdi alllahi sami'tu 'ammaaaa - wakaanaa qad shahidaa badrana - yuhaddithaani aahla alddaari aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an kiraa'i alaardi ‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi laqad kuntu aa'lamu fiy 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna alaarda tukraa thumma khashiya 'abdu alllahi aan yakuwna rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahdatha fiy dhalika shayiana lam yakun 'alimahu fataraka kiraa'a alaardi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim b. Abdullah reported that AbduUah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) used to give land on rent until (this news) reached him that Rafi b. Khadij Ansari used to forbid the renting of land. Abdullah met him and said:Ibn Khadij, what is this that you narrate from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pertaining to renting of land? Rafi b. Khadij said to Abdullah: I heard it from two uncles of mine and they had participated in the Battle of Badr who narrated to the members of the family that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the renting of land. Abdullah said: I knew it that the land was rented during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Abdullah then apprehended that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) might have said something new in this connection (in regard to prohibition of renting) which I failed to know. So he abandoned the renting of land
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، وَيَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُحَاقِلُ الأَرْضَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنُكْرِيهَا بِالثُّلُثِ وَالرُّبُعِ وَالطَّعَامِ الْمُسَمَّى فَجَاءَنَا ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ رَجُلٌ مِنْ عُمُومَتِي فَقَالَ نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَمْرٍ كَانَ لَنَا نَافِعًا وَطَوَاعِيَةُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ أَنْفَعُ لَنَا نَهَانَا أَنْ نُحَاقِلَ بِالأَرْضِ فَنُكْرِيَهَا عَلَى الثُّلُثِ وَالرُّبُعِ وَالطَّعَامِ الْمُسَمَّى وَأَمَرَ رَبَّ الأَرْضِ أَنْ يَزْرَعَهَا أَوْ يُزْرِعَهَا وَكَرِهَ كِرَاءَهَا وَمَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, waya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu 'ulayyaaa - 'an aayyuwba, 'an ya'laa bni hakiymin, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'an raafi'i bni khadiyjin, qaala kunnaa nuhaaqilu alaarda 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fanukriyhaa bialthhuluthi waalrrubu'i waaltta'aami almusammaa fajaa'anaa dhaata yawmin rajulun min 'umuwmatiy faqaala nahaanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an aamrin kaana lanaa naafi'ana watawaa'iyaau alllahi warasuwlihi aanfa'u lanaa nahaanaa aan nuhaaqila bialaardi fanukriyahaa 'alaa althhuluthi waalrrubu'i waaltta'aami almusammaa waaamara rabba alaardi aan yazra'ahaa aaw yuzri'ahaa wakariha kiraa'ahaa wamaa siwaa dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Rafi b. Khadij (Allah be pleased with him) reported:We used to give on rent land during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). We rented it on the share of one-third or one-fourth of the (produce) along with a definite quantity of corn. One day a person from among my uncles came to us and said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us this act which was a source of benefit to us, but the obedience to Allah and to His Messenger (ﷺ) is more beneficial to us. He forbade us that we should rent land with one-third or one-fourth of (the produce) and the corn of a measure, and he commanded the owner of land that he should cultivate it or let it be cultivated by other (persons) but he showed disapproval of renting it or anything besides it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ كَتَبَ إِلَىَّ يَعْلَى بْنُ حَكِيمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُحَاقِلُ بِالأَرْضِ فَنُكْرِيهَا عَلَى الثُّلُثِ وَالرُّبُعِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, qaala kataba iilaaaa ya'laa bnu hakiymin qaala sami'tu sulaymaana bna yasaarin, yuhaddithu 'an raafi'i bni khadiyjin, qaala kunnaa nuhaaqilu bialaardi fanukriyhaa 'alaa althhuluthi waalrrubu'i ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bimithli hadiythi abni 'ulayyaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Rafi b. Khadij (Allah be pleased with him) reported:We used to give land on rent, and we rented it on one-third or one-fourth share. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ حَكِيمٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, h wahaddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdaau, kulluhum 'ani abni aabiy 'aruwbaaa, 'an ya'laa bni hakiymin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Another chain narrated the same as the above hadith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ، حَكِيمٍ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَمْ يَقُلْ عَنْ بَعْضِ عُمُومَتِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy jariyru bnu haazimin, 'an ya'laa bni, hakiymin bihadhaa aliisnaadi 'an raafi'i bni khadiyjin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm walam yaqul 'an ba'di 'umuwmatihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Rafi' b. Khadij with the same chain of transmitters, but in it no mention is made of some of his uncles
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُسْهِرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَمْرٍو الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي النَّجَاشِيِّ، مَوْلَى رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ عَنْ رَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ظُهَيْرَ بْنَ رَافِعٍ، - وَهُوَ عَمُّهُ - قَالَ أَتَانِي ظُهَيْرٌ فَقَالَ لَقَدْ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَمْرٍ كَانَ بِنَا رَافِقًا ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ وَمَا ذَاكَ مَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَهُوَ حَقٌّ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَأَلَنِي كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُونَ بِمَحَاقِلِكُمْ فَقُلْتُ نُؤَاجِرُهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عَلَى الرَّبِيعِ أَوِ الأَوْسُقِ مِنَ التَّمْرِ أَوِ الشَّعِيرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَلاَ تَفْعَلُوا ازْرَعُوهَا أَوْ أَزْرِعُوهَا أَوْ أَمْسِكُوهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa aabuw mushirin, haddathaniy yahyaa bnu hamzaaa, haddathaniy aabuw 'amrinw alaawzaa'iyyu, 'an aabiy alnnajaashiyyi, mawlaa raafi'i bni khadiyjin 'an raafi'in, aanna zuhayra bna raafi'in, - wahuwa 'ammuhu - qaala aataaniy zuhayrun faqaala laqad nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an aamrin kaana binaa raafiqana ‏.‏ faqultu wamaa dhaaka maa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fahuwa haqqun ‏.‏ qaala saaalaniy kayfa tasna'uwna bimahaaqilikum faqultu nuuaajiruhaa yaa rasuwla alllahi 'alaa alrrabiy'i aawi alaawsuqi mina alttamri aawi alshha'iyri ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ falaa taf'aluwa azra'uwhaa aaw aazri'uwhaa aaw aamsikuwhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Rafi (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Zuhair b. Rafi (who was his uncle) came to me and said:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade a practice which was useful for us. I said: What is this? (I believe) that whatrver Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) says is absolutely true. He (Zuhair) said that he (the Holy Prophet) asked me: What do you do with your cultivable lands? I said: Allah's Messenger, we rent those irrigated by canals for dry dates or barley. He said: Don't do that. Cultivate them or let them be cultivated (by others) or retain them yourself
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي النَّجَاشِيِّ، عَنْ رَافِعٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ عَنْ عَمِّهِ ظُهَيْرٍ
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an 'ikrimaaa bni 'ammaarin, 'an aabiy alnnajaashiyyi, 'an raafi'in, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa walam yadhkur 'an 'ammihi zuhayrin
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Rafi from the Prophet (ﷺ) about this, but he did not make mention of his uncle Zuhair
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ عَنْ كِرَاءِ الأَرْضِ، فَقَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ كِرَاءِ الأَرْضِ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ أَبِالذَّهَبِ وَالْوَرِقِ فَقَالَ أَمَّا بِالذَّهَبِ وَالْوَرِقِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an rabiy'aaa bni aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an hanzalaaa bni qaysin, aannahu saaala raafi'a bna khadiyjin 'an kiraa'i alaardi, faqaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an kiraa'i alaardi qaala faqultu aabialdhhahabi waalwariqi faqaala aammaa bialdhhahabi waalwariqi falaa baasa bihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hanzala b. Qais reported that he asked Rafi b. Khadij (Allah be pleased with him) about renting of land, whereupon he said:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the renting of land. I said: Is it forbidden (even if it is paid) in gold (dinar) and silver (dirham)? Thereupon he said: If it is paid in gold and silver, there is no harm in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي، عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ حَدَّثَنِي حَنْظَلَةُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ عَنْ كِرَاءِ الأَرْضِ، بِالذَّهَبِ وَالْوَرِقِ فَقَالَ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ إِنَّمَا كَانَ النَّاسُ يُؤَاجِرُونَ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمَاذِيَانَاتِ وَأَقْبَالِ الْجَدَاوِلِ وَأَشْيَاءَ مِنَ الزَّرْعِ فَيَهْلِكُ هَذَا وَيَسْلَمُ هَذَا وَيَسْلَمُ هَذَا وَيَهْلِكُ هَذَا فَلَمْ يَكُنْ لِلنَّاسِ كِرَاءٌ إِلاَّ هَذَا فَلِذَلِكَ زُجِرَ عَنْهُ ‏.‏ فَأَمَّا شَىْءٌ مَعْلُومٌ مَضْمُونٌ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, 'an rabiy'aaa bni aabiy, 'abdi alrrahmani haddathaniy hanzalaau bnu qaysin alaansaariyyu, qaala saaaltu raafi'a bna khadiyjin 'an kiraa'i alaardi, bialdhhahabi waalwariqi faqaala laa baasa bihi iinnamaa kaana alnnaasu yuuaajiruwna 'alaa 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa almaadhiyaanaati waaaqbaali aljadaawili waaashyaa'a mina alzzar'i fayahliku hadhaa wayaslamu hadhaa wayaslamu hadhaa wayahliku hadhaa falam yakun lilnnaasi kiraa'un iilaaa hadhaa falidhalika zujira 'anhu ‏.‏ faaammaa shaa'un ma'luwmun madmuwnun falaa baasa bihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hanzala b. Qais al-Ansri reported:I asked Rafi' b. Khadij about the renting of land for gold and silver, whereupon he said: There is no harm in it for the people let out land situated near canals and at the ends of the streamlets or portion of fields. (But it so happened) that at times this was destroyed and that was saved. whereas (on other occasions) this portion was saved and the other was destroyed and thus no rent was payable to the people (who let out lands) but for this one (which was saved). It was due to this that he (the Holy Prophet) prohibited it. But if there is something definite and reliable (e. g. money). there is no harm in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ، الزُّرَقِيِّ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ، يَقُولُ كُنَّا أَكْثَرَ الأَنْصَارِ حَقْلاً - قَالَ - كُنَّا نُكْرِي الأَرْضَ عَلَى أَنَّ لَنَا هَذِهِ وَلَهُمْ هَذِهِ فَرُبَّمَا أَخْرَجَتْ هَذِهِ وَلَمْ تُخْرِجْ هَذِهِ فَنَهَانَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ وَأَمَّا الْوَرِقُ فَلَمْ يَنْهَنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an hanzalaaa, alzzuraqiyyi aannahu sami'a raafi'a bna khadiyjin, yaquwlu kunnaa aakthara alaansaari haqlaan - qaala - kunnaa nukriy alaarda 'alaa aanna lanaa hadhihi walahum hadhihi farubbamaa aakhrajat hadhihi walam tukhrij hadhihi fanahaanaa 'an dhalika waaammaa alwariqu falam yanhanaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hanzala reported that he heard Rafi' b. Khadij (Allah be pleased with him) say:We were the major agriculturists of the Ansar and so we let out land (saying): The produce of this (part of land) would be ours and (the produce) of that would be theirs. But it so happened that at times this (land) gave harvest, but the other one produced nothing. So he (the Holy Prophet) forbade this. But so far as the payment in silver (dirham, a coin) is concerned, he did not forbid
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i, haddathanaa hammaadun, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, jamiy'ana 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
