verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي، شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَعْقِلٍ عَنِ الْمُزَارَعَةِ، فَقَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ثَابِتُ بْنُ الضَّحَّاكِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْمُزَارَعَةِ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ نَهَى عَنْهَا ‏.‏ وَقَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ مَعْقِلٍ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يُسَمِّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu ziyaadin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy, shaybaaa haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, kilaahumaa 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alssaaiibi, qaala saaaltu 'abda alllahi bna ma'qilin 'ani almuzaara'aai, faqaala aakhbaraniy thaabitu bnu alddahhaaki, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani almuzaara'aai ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai abni aabiy shaybaaa nahaa 'anhaa ‏.‏ waqaala saaaltu abna ma'qilin ‏.‏ walam yusammi 'abda alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. al Sa'ib reported:I asked Abdullah b. Ma'qil about Muzara'a (cultivating land on share basis in the produce). He said: Thabit b. Dahhak informed me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Muzara'a as Ibn Abu Shaiba forbade it with a slight change of words. He (the narrator) said: I asked Ibn Ma'qil but he did not name 'Abdullah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، قَالَ دَخَلْنَا عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْقِلٍ فَسَأَلْنَاهُ عَنِ الْمُزَارَعَةِ، فَقَالَ زَعَمَ ثَابِتٌ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْمُزَارَعَةِ وَأَمَرَ بِالْمُؤَاجَرَةِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu hammaadin, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an sulaymaana, alshhaybaaniyyi 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alssaaiibi, qaala dakhalnaa 'alaa 'abdi alllahi bni ma'qilin fasaaalnaahu 'ani almuzaara'aai, faqaala za'ama thaabitun aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani almuzaara'aai waaamara bialmuuaajaraai waqaala ‏ "‏ laa baasa bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. al-Sa'ib reported:We visited 'Abdullah b. Ma'qil and asked him about sharing of crops, whereupon he said: Thabit alleged that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Muzara'a and commanded leasing it out on rent (for money) and said: There is no harm in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ مُجَاهِدًا، قَالَ لِطَاوُسٍ انْطَلِقْ بِنَا إِلَى ابْنِ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ فَاسْمَعْ مِنْهُ الْحَدِيثَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ - فَانْتَهَرَهُ قَالَ إِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْهُ مَا فَعَلْتُهُ وَلَكِنْ حَدَّثَنِي مَنْ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنْهُمْ - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لأَنْ يَمْنَحَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ أَرْضَهُ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ عَلَيْهَا خَرْجًا مَعْلُومًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an 'amrinw, aanna mujaahidana, qaala litaawusin antaliq binaa iilaa abni raafi'i bni khadiyjin faasma' minhu alhadiytha 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm - qaala - faantaharahu qaala iinniy waalllahi law aa'lamu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'anhu maa fa'altuhu walakin haddathaniy man huwa aa'lamu bihi minhum - ya'niy abna 'abbaasin - aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laan yamnaha alrrajulu aakhaahu aardahu khayrun lahu min aan yaakhudha 'alayhaa kharjana ma'luwmana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mujahid said to Tiwus:Come along with me to Ibn Rafi b. Khadij in order to listen from him the hadith transmitted on the authority of his father (pertaining to the renting of land) from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He (Tawus) scolded him and said: By Allah, it I were to know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden it, I would have never done it. But it has been narrated to me by one who has better knowledge of it amongst them (and he meant Ibn 'Abbas) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: It is better if a person lends, his land to his brother (for cultivation) than that he gets recognised rent on it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، وَابْنُ، طَاوُسٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُخَابِرُ قَالَ عَمْرٌو فَقُلْتُ لَهُ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ لَوْ تَرَكْتَ هَذِهِ الْمُخَابَرَةَ فَإِنَّهُمْ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْمُخَابَرَةِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَىْ عَمْرُو أَخْبَرَنِي أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِذَلِكَ يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَنْهَ عَنْهَا إِنَّمَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَمْنَحُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ عَلَيْهَا خَرْجًا مَعْلُومًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, waabnu, taawusin 'an taawusin, aannahu kaana yukhaabiru qaala 'amrunw faqultu lahu yaa aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani law tarakta hadhihi almukhaabaraaa faiinnahum yaz'umuwna aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani almukhaabaraai ‏.‏ faqaala aaa 'amruw aakhbaraniy aa'lamuhum bidhalika ya'niy abna 'abbaasin aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm lam yanha 'anhaa iinnamaa qaala ‏ "‏ yamnahu aahadukum aakhaahu khayrun lahu min aan yaakhudha 'alayhaa kharjana ma'luwmana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Tawus reported that he let out his land on rent, whereupon Amr said:I said to him: Abu Abd al-Rahrman, I wish if you abandon this renting of land, for they alleged that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade Mukhabara. He siad: Amr, one who has informed me has the best knowledge of it among them (he meant Ibn Abbas). (He said) that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not prohibit it altogether, but said: Lending of land by one among you to his brother is better for him than getting a specified amount of produce from it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ جَمِيعًا عَنْ وَكِيعٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa althhaqafiyyu, 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma jamiy'ana 'an wakiy'in, 'an sufyaana, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'ani abni jurayjin, h wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, haddathanaa alfadlu bnu muwsaa, 'an shariykin, 'an shu'baaa, kulluhum 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، - قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، - أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لأَنْ يَمْنَحَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ أَرْضَهُ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ عَلَيْهَا كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لِشَىْءٍ مَعْلُومٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ هُوَ الْحَقْلُ وَهُوَ بِلِسَانِ الأَنْصَارِ الْمُحَاقَلَةُ
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu bnu humaydin, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, - qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, - aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani abni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laan yamnaha aahadukum aakhaahu aardahu khayrun lahu min aan yaakhudha 'alayhaa kadhaa wakadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ lishaa'in ma'luwmin ‏.‏ qaala waqaala abnu 'abbaasin huwa alhaqlu wahuwa bilisaani alaansaari almuhaaqalaau
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:If one among you lets out land to his brother, that is better for him than if he receives such and such (the definite thing). Ibn 'Abbis (Allah be pleased with them) said: It is Haql, and in the parlance of the Ansr it is Muhaqala
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ أَبِي زَيْدٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَإِنَّهُ أَنْ يَمْنَحَهَا أَخَاهُ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu ja'farin alrraqqiyyu, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'amrinw, 'an zaydi bni aabiy aunaysaaa, 'an 'abdi almaliki aabiy zaydin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni, 'abbaasin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man kaanat lahu aardun faiinnahu aan yamnahahaa aakhaahu khayrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:He who has land, it is better for him that he should let it out to his brother
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَلَ أَهْلَ خَيْبَرَ بِشَطْرِ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا مِنْ ثَمَرٍ أَوْ زَرْعٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu hanbalin, wazuhayru bnu harbin, - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aamala aahla khaybara bishatri maa yakhruju minhaa min thamarin aaw zar'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) contracted with the people of Khaibar the (trees) on the condition that he would have half the produce in fruits and harvest
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مُسْهِرٍ - أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ، اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ أَعْطَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْبَرَ بِشَطْرِ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْ ثَمَرٍ أَوْ زَرْعٍ فَكَانَ يُعْطِي أَزْوَاجَهُ كَلَّ سَنَةٍ مِائَةَ وَسْقٍ ثَمَانِينَ وَسْقًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ وَعِشْرِينَ وَسْقًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ فَلَمَّا وَلِيَ عُمَرُ قَسَمَ خَيْبَرَ خَيَّرَ أَزْوَاجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُقْطِعَ لَهُنَّ الأَرْضَ وَالْمَاءَ أَوْ يَضْمَنَ لَهُنَّ الأَوْسَاقَ كُلَّ عَامٍ فَاخْتَلَفْنَ فَمِنْهُنَّ مَنِ اخْتَارَ الأَرْضَ وَالْمَاءَ وَمِنْهُنَّ مَنِ اخْتَارَ الأَوْسَاقَ كُلَّ عَامٍ فَكَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَحَفْصَةُ مِمَّنِ اخْتَارَتَا الأَرْضَ وَالْمَاءَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, haddathanaa 'aliyyun, - wahuwa abnu mushirin - aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu, alllahi 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala aa'taa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khaybara bishatri maa yakhruju min thamarin aaw zar'in fakaana yu'tiy aazwaajahu kalla sanaain miaiaaa wasqin thamaaniyna wasqana min tamrin wa'ishriyna wasqana min sha'iyrin falammaa waliya 'umaru qasama khaybara khayyara aazwaaja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yuqti'a lahunna alaarda waalmaa'a aaw yadmana lahunna alaawsaaqa kulla 'aamin faakhtalafna faminhunna mani akhtaara alaarda waalmaa'a waminhunna mani akhtaara alaawsaaqa kulla 'aamin fakaanat 'aaiishaau wahafsaau mimmani akhtaarataa alaarda waalmaa'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) handed over the land of Khaibar (on the condition) of the share of produce of fruits and harvest, and he also gave to his wives every year one hundred wasqs: eighty wasqs of dates and twenty wasqs of barley. When 'Umar became the caliph he distributed the (lands and trees) of Khaibar, and gave option to the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) to earmark for themselves the land and water or stick to the wasqs (that they got) every year. They differed in this matter. Some of them opted for land and water, and some of them opted for wasqs every year. 'A'isha and Hafsa were among those who opted for land and water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَلَ أَهْلَ خَيْبَرَ بِشَطْرِ مَا خَرَجَ مِنْهَا مِنْ زَرْعٍ أَوْ ثَمَرٍ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فَكَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَحَفْصَةُ مِمَّنِ اخْتَارَتَا الأَرْضَ وَالْمَاءَ وَقَالَ خَيَّرَ أَزْوَاجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُقْطِعَ لَهُنَّ الأَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْمَاءَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, haddathaniy naafi'un, 'ani 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aamala aahla khaybara bishatri maa kharaja minhaa min zar'in aaw thamarin ‏.‏ waaqtassa alhadiytha binahwi hadiythi 'aliyyi bni mushirin walam yadhkur fakaanat 'aaiishaau wahafsaau mimmani akhtaarataa alaarda waalmaa'a waqaala khayyara aazwaaja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yuqti'a lahunna alaarda walam yadhkuri almaa'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) contracted with the people of Khaibar (land and trees on the condition that they should give) half of the yield from land and trees. The rest of the hadith is the same. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of AIi b. Mushir there is no mention of it, but that A'isha and Hafsa were those who opted for land and water, but he (the narrator) said:He (Hadrat 'Umar, gave option to the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) that land would be earmarked for them, but he made no mention of water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ اللَّيْثِيُّ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ لَمَّا افْتُتِحَتْ خَيْبَرُ سَأَلَتْ يَهُودُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُقِرَّهُمْ فِيهَا عَلَى أَنْ يَعْمَلُوا عَلَى نِصْفِ مَا خَرَجَ مِنْهَا مِنَ الثَّمَرِ وَالزَّرْعِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أُقِرُّكُمْ فِيهَا عَلَى ذَلِكَ مَا شِئْنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ وَابْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ وَزَادَ فِيهِ وَكَانَ الثَّمَرُ يُقْسَمُ عَلَى السُّهْمَانِ مِنْ نِصْفِ خَيْبَرَ فَيَأْخُذُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْخُمُسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy ausaamaau bnu zaydin alllaythiyyu, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala lammaa aftutihat khaybaru saaalat yahuwdu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yuqirrahum fiyhaa 'alaa aan ya'maluwa 'alaa nisfi maa kharaja minhaa mina althhamari waalzzar'i ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ auqirrukum fiyhaa 'alaa dhalika maa shiinaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma saaqa alhadiytha binahwi hadiythi abni numayrin waabni mushirin 'an 'ubaydi alllahi wazaada fiyhi wakaana althhamaru yuqsamu 'alaa alssuhmaani min nisfi khaybara fayaakhudhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alkhumusa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that when Khaibar had been conquered, the Jews asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to let them continue (cultivation in those lands) on half of the share of yield in fruits and crop, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:I will allow you to continue here, so long as we would desire. The rest of the hadith is the same, but with this addition:" The fruit would be distributed equal to the half of Khaibar. And out of hall of the produce of the land, Allah's Apostle (may peace be be upon him) got the fifth part
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ دَفَعَ إِلَى يَهُودِ خَيْبَرَ نَخْلَ خَيْبَرَ وَأَرْضَهَا عَلَى أَنْ يَعْتَمِلُوهَا مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَلِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَطْرُ ثَمَرِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi, alllahi bni 'umara 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu dafa'a iilaa yahuwdi khaybara nakhla khaybara waaardahaa 'alaa aan ya'tamiluwhaa min aamwaalihim walirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shatru thamarihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned to the Jews of Khaibar the date-palms of Khaibar and its land on the condition that they should work upon them with their own wealth (seeds, implements), and give half of the yield to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ رَافِعٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ أَجْلَى الْيَهُودَ وَالنَّصَارَى مِنْ أَرْضِ الْحِجَازِ وَأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا ظَهَرَ عَلَى خَيْبَرَ أَرَادَ إِخْرَاجَ الْيَهُودِ مِنْهَا وَكَانَتِ الأَرْضُ حِينَ ظُهِرَ عَلَيْهَا لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُسْلِمِينَ فَأَرَادَ إِخْرَاجَ الْيَهُودِ مِنْهَا فَسَأَلَتِ الْيَهُودُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُقِرَّهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى أَنْ يَكْفُوا عَمَلَهَا وَلَهُمْ نِصْفُ الثَّمَرِ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نُقِرُّكُمْ بِهَا عَلَى ذَلِكَ مَا شِئْنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَرُّوا بِهَا حَتَّى أَجْلاَهُمْ عُمَرُ إِلَى تَيْمَاءَ وَأَرِيحَاءَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, waiishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, - waalllafzu laibni raafi'in - qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, haddathaniy muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna 'umara, bna alkhattaabi aajlaa alyahuwda waalnnasaaraa min aardi alhijaazi waaanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lammaa zahara 'alaa khaybara aaraada iikhraaja alyahuwdi minhaa wakaanati alaardu hiyna zuhira 'alayhaa lillahi walirasuwlihi walilmuslimiyna faaaraada iikhraaja alyahuwdi minhaa fasaaalati alyahuwdu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yuqirrahum bihaa 'alaa aan yakfuwa 'amalahaa walahum nisfu althhamari faqaala lahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ nuqirrukum bihaa 'alaa dhalika maa shiinaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqarruwa bihaa hattaa aajlaahum 'umaru iilaa taymaa'a waaariyhaa'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that 'Umar b. al-Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) expelled the Jews and Christians from the land of Hijaz, and that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) conquered Khaibar he made up his mind to expel the Jews from it (the territory of Khaibar) because, when that land was conquered, it came under the sway of Allah, that of His Messenger (ﷺ) and that of the Muslims. The jews asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to let them continue there on the condition that they would work on it, and would get in turn half of the fruit (of the trees), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:We would let you continue there so long as we will desire. So they continued (to cultivate the lands) till 'Umar externed them to Taima' ang Ariha (two villages in Arabia, but out of Hijaz)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَغْرِسُ غَرْسًا إِلاَّ كَانَ مَا أُكِلَ مِنْهُ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ وَمَا سُرِقَ مِنْهُ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ وَمَا أَكَلَ السَّبُعُ مِنْهُ فَهُوَ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ وَمَا أَكَلَتِ الطَّيْرُ فَهُوَ لَهُ صَدَقَةً وَلاَ يَرْزَؤُهُ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ كَانَ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa min muslimin yaghrisu gharsana iilaaa kaana maa aukila minhu lahu sadaqaaun wamaa suriqa minhu lahu sadaqaaun wamaa aakala alssabu'u minhu fahuwa lahu sadaqaaun wamaa aakalati alttayru fahuwa lahu sadaqaaan walaa yarzauuhu aahadun iilaaa kaana lahu sadaqaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Never does a Muslim plants a tree except that he has the reward of charity for him, for what is eaten out of that is charity; what is stolen out of that, what the beasts eat out of that, what the birds eat out of that is charity for him. (In short) none incurs a loss to him but it becomes a charity on his part
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَى أُمِّ مُبَشِّرٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّةِ فِي نَخْلٍ لَهَا فَقَالَ لَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ غَرَسَ هَذَا النَّخْلَ أَمُسْلِمٌ أَمْ كَافِرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ بَلْ مُسْلِمٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَغْرِسُ مُسْلِمٌ غَرْسًا وَلاَ يَزْرَعُ زَرْعًا فَيَأْكُلَ مِنْهُ إِنْسَانٌ وَلاَ دَابَّةٌ وَلاَ شَىْءٌ إِلاَّ كَانَتْ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala 'alaa aummi mubashhirin alaansaariyyaai fiy nakhlin lahaa faqaala lahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man gharasa hadhaa alnnakhla aamuslimun aam kaafirun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat bal muslimun ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ laa yaghrisu muslimun gharsana walaa yazra'u zar'ana fayaakula minhu iinsaanun walaa daabbaaun walaa shaa'un iilaaa kaanat lahu sadaqaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited Umm Mubashshir al-Ansariya at her orchard of date-palms and said to her:Who has planted these trees of dates-a Muslim or a non-Musim? She said: A Muslim, of course, whereupon he said: Never a Muslim plants, or cultivates a land, and it out of that men eat, or the animals eat, or anything else eats, but that becomes charity on his (planter's) behalf
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَغْرِسُ رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ غَرْسًا وَلاَ زَرْعًا فَيَأْكُلَ مِنْهُ سَبُعٌ أَوْ طَائِرٌ أَوْ شَىْءٌ إِلاَّ كَانَ لَهُ فِيهِ أَجْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي خَلَفٍ طَائِرٌ شَىْءٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, waabnu aabiy khalafin, qaalaa haddathanaa rawhun, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yaghrisu rajulun muslimun gharsana walaa zar'ana fayaakula minhu sabu'un aaw taaiirun aaw shaa'un iilaaa kaana lahu fiyhi aajrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala abnu aabiy khalafin taaiirun shaa'un ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: Never does a Muslim plant, or cultivate, but has reward for him for what the beasts eat, or the birds eat or anything else eats out of that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى أُمِّ مَعْبَدٍ حَائِطًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أُمَّ مَعْبَدٍ مَنْ غَرَسَ هَذَا النَّخْلَ أَمُسْلِمٌ أَمْ كَافِرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ بَلْ مُسْلِمٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلاَ يَغْرِسُ الْمُسْلِمُ غَرْسًا فَيَأْكُلَ مِنْهُ إِنْسَانٌ وَلاَ دَابَّةٌ وَلاَ طَيْرٌ إِلاَّ كَانَ لَهُ صَدَقَةً إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu sa'iydi bni iibraahiyma, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu iishaaqa, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu diynaarin, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu dakhala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa aummi ma'badin haaiitana faqaala ‏"‏ yaa aumma ma'badin man gharasa hadhaa alnnakhla aamuslimun aam kaafirun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat bal muslimun ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ falaa yaghrisu almuslimu gharsana fayaakula minhu iinsaanun walaa daabbaaun walaa tayrun iilaaa kaana lahu sadaqaaan iilaa yawmi alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported:Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited the orchard of Umm Ma'sud and said: Umm Ma'bad. he who has planted this tree, is he a Muslim or a non-Muslim? She said: Of course, he is a Muslim, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: No Muslim who plants (trees) and from their fruits the human beings or the beasts or birds eat, but that would be taken as an act of charity on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمَّارُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ‏.‏ زَادَ عَمْرٌو فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، فَقَالاَ عَنْ أُمِّ مُبَشِّرٍ، وَفَى رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ فُضَيْلٍ عَنِ امْرَأَةِ، زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ رُبَّمَا قَالَ عَنْ أُمِّ مُبَشِّرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَرُبَّمَا لَمْ يَقُلْ وَكُلُّهُمْ قَالُوا عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ عَطَاءٍ وَأَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ وَعَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa hafsu bnu ghiyaathin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, waiishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma jamiy'ana 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa 'ammaaru bnu muhammadin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, kullu hauulaa'i 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, ‏.‏ zaada 'amrunw fiy riwaayatihi 'an 'ammaarin, waaabuw kuraybin fiy riwaayatihi 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, faqaalaa 'an aummi mubashhirin, wafaa riwaayaai abni fudaylin 'ani amraaaai, zaydi bni haarithaaa wafiy riwaayaai iishaaqa 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, qaala rubbamaa qaala 'an aummi mubashhirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ warubbamaa lam yaqul wakulluhum qaaluwa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwi hadiythi 'ataa'in waaabiy alzzubayri wa'amriw bni diynaarin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is transmitted on the authority of Abu Muawiya (but With a slight change of words)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَرِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَغْرِسُ غَرْسًا أَوْ يَزْرَعُ زَرْعًا فَيَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ طَيْرٌ أَوْ إِنْسَانٌ أَوْ بَهِيمَةٌ إِلاَّ كَانَ لَهُ بِهِ صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wamuhammadu bnu 'ubaydin alghubariyyu, - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa min muslimin yaghrisu gharsana aaw yazra'u zar'ana fayaakulu minhu tayrun aaw iinsaanun aaw bahiymaaun iilaaa kaana lahu bihi sadaqaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying Never does a Muslim plant trees or cultivate land and birds or a man or a beast eat out of them but that is a charity on his behalf
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ نَخْلاً لأُمِّ مُبَشِّرٍ - امْرَأَةٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ - فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ غَرَسَ هَذَا النَّخْلَ أَمُسْلِمٌ أَمْ كَافِرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا مُسْلِمٌ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa muslimu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aabaanu bnu yaziyda, haddathanaa qataadaau, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala nakhlaan laummi mubashhirin - amraaaain mina alaansaari - faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man gharasa hadhaa alnnakhla aamuslimun aam kaafirun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa muslimun ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited the date-palms of Umm Mubashshir (Allah be pleased with her), a lady from the Ansar, and said:Who planted this palm-a Muslim or an unbelievers The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا الزُّبَيْرِ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنْ بِعْتَ مِنْ أَخِيكَ ثَمَرًا ‏"‏‏.‏ ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو ضَمْرَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ بِعْتَ مِنْ أَخِيكَ ثَمَرًا فَأَصَابَتْهُ جَائِحَةٌ فَلاَ يَحِلُّ لَكَ أَنْ تَأْخُذَ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا بِمَ تَأْخُذُ مَالَ أَخِيكَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'ani abni jurayjin, aanna aabaa alzzubayri, aakhbarahu 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iin bi'ta min aakhiyka thamarana ‏"‏‏.‏ h. wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, haddathanaa aabuw damraaa, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ law bi'ta min aakhiyka thamarana faaasaabathu jaaiihaaun falaa yahillu laka aan taakhudha minhu shayiana bima taakhudhu maala aakhiyka bighayri haqqin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying:If You sell fruits to your brother (and Jabir b. Ahduthh reported through another chain of narrators: If you were to sell fruits to your brother) and these is a stricken with Calamity, it is not permissible for you to get anything from him. Why do you get the wealth of your brother, without jutification?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa hasanun alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani abni jurayjin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Juraij with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ ثَمَرِ النَّخْلِ حَتَّى تَزْهُوَ ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا لأَنَسٍ مَا زَهْوُهَا قَالَ تَحْمَرُّ وَتَصْفَرُّ ‏.‏ أَرَأَيْتَكَ إِنْ مَنَعَ اللَّهُ الثَّمَرَةَ بِمَ تَسْتَحِلُّ مَالَ أَخِيكَ
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an humaydin, 'an aanasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an bay'i thamari alnnakhli hattaa tazhuwa ‏.‏ faqulnaa laanasin maa zahwuhaa qaala tahmarru watasfarru ‏.‏ aaraaaytaka iin mana'a alllahu althhamaraaa bima tastahillu maala aakhiyka
verses.translation: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade the sale of the fruit of date-palms until it becomes mellow. We (some of the other narrators in the chain of transmitters) said:What does the word" mellow" mean? He said: (There the fruit) turns red or yellow. Don't you see if Allah had checked (the growth of) fruits; then what for the wealth of your brother would be permissible for you?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ، بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرَةِ حَتَّى تُزْهِيَ قَالُوا وَمَا تُزْهِيَ قَالَ تَحْمَرُّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِذَا مَنَعَ اللَّهُ الثَّمَرَةَ فَبِمَ تَسْتَحِلُّ مَالَ أَخِيكَ
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy maalikun, 'an humaydin alttawiyli, 'an aanasi, bni maalikin aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an bay'i althhamaraai hattaa tuzhiya qaaluwa wamaa tuzhiya qaala tahmarru ‏.‏ faqaala iidhaa mana'a alllahu althhamaraaa fabima tastahillu maala aakhiyka
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of fruits until these are mellow. They (the companions of Anas) said:What is meant by" mellow"? He said: It implies that these became red. He said: When Allah hinders the growth of fruits, (then) what for the wealth of your brother would become permissible for you?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ لَمْ يُثْمِرْهَا اللَّهُ فَبِمَ يَسْتَحِلُّ أَحَدُكُمْ مَالَ أَخِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin, 'an humaydin, 'an aanasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iin lam yuthmirhaa alllahu fabima yastahillu aahadukum maala aakhiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:If Allah does not fructify them, then what is permissible for one of you to take the wealth of his brother?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، وَعَبْدُ الْجَبَّارِ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِبِشْرٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ عَتِيقٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّوسلم أَمَرَ بِوَضْعِ الْجَوَائِحِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ - وَهْوَ صَاحِبُ مُسْلِمٍ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بِهَذَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa bishru bnu alhakami, waiibraahiymu bnu diynaarin, wa'abdu aljabbaari bnu al'alaa'i, - waalllafzu libishrin - qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an humaydin alaa'raji, 'an sulaymaana bni 'atiyqin, 'an jaabirin, aannawslm aamara biwad'i aljawaaiihi ‏.‏ qaala aabuw iishaaqa - wahwa saahibu muslimin - haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu bishrin 'an sufyaana bihadhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) commanded to make deductions in the payment of that stricken with a Calamity
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي، سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ أُصِيبَ رَجُلٌ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ثِمَارٍ ابْتَاعَهَا فَكَثُرَ دَيْنُهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَصَدَّقُوا عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَتَصَدَّقَ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَبْلُغْ ذَلِكَ وَفَاءَ دَيْنِهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِغُرَمَائِهِ ‏"‏ خُذُوا مَا وَجَدْتُمْ وَلَيْسَ لَكُمْ إِلاَّ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an bukayrin, 'an 'iyaadi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy, sa'iydin alkhudriyyi qaala ausiyba rajulun fiy 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy thimaarin abtaa'ahaa fakathura daynuhu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ tasaddaquwa 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fatasaddaqa alnnaasu 'alayhi falam yablugh dhalika wafaa'a daynihi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lighuramaaiihi ‏"‏ khudhuwa maa wajadtum walaysa lakum iilaaa dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleeased with him) reported that in the time of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a man suffered loss in fruits he had bought and his debt increased; so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told (the people) to give him charity and they gave him charity, but that was not enough to pay the debt in full, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to his creditors:" Take what you find, you will have nothing but alms
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yuwnusu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an bukayri bni alaashajji, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Bukair b. al-Ashajj with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي غَيْرُ، وَاحِدٍ، مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي أُوَيْسٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَخِي، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الرِّجَالِ، مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أُمَّهُ، عَمْرَةَ بِنْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ، تَقُولُ سَمِعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَوْتَ خُصُومٍ بِالْبَابِ عَالِيَةً أَصْوَاتُهُمَا وَإِذَا أَحَدُهُمَا يَسْتَوْضِعُ الآخَرَ وَيَسْتَرْفِقُهُ فِي شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَفْعَلُ ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَيْهِمَا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيْنَ الْمُتَأَلِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ لاَ يَفْعَلُ الْمَعْرُوفَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَلَهُ أَىُّ ذَلِكَ أَحَبَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy ghayru, waahidin, min aashaabinaa qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu aabiy auwaysin, haddathaniy aakhiy, 'an sulaymaana, - wahuwa abnu bilaalin - 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an aabiy alrrijaali, muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani aanna aummahu, 'amraaa binta 'abdi alrrahmani qaalat sami'tu 'aaiishaaa, taquwlu sami'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sawta khusuwmin bialbaabi 'aaliyaaan aaswaatuhumaa waiidhaa aahaduhumaa yastawdi'u alakhara wayastarfiquhu fiy shaa'in wahuwa yaquwlu waalllahi laa aaf'alu ‏.‏ fakharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alayhimaa faqaala ‏ "‏ aayna almutaaalliy 'alaa alllahi laa yaf'alu alma'ruwfa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aanaa yaa rasuwla alllahi falahu aaaau dhalika aahabba ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard the voices of altercation of two disputants at the door; both the voices were quite loud. The one demanded some remission and desired that the other one should show leniency to him, whereupon the (other one) was saying: By Allah will not do that. Then there came Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to them and said: Where is he who swears by Allah that he would not do good? He said: Massenger of Allah, it is I. He may do as he desires
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ تَقَاضَى ابْنَ أَبِي حَدْرَدٍ دَيْنًا كَانَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَارْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاتُهُمَا حَتَّى سَمِعَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي بَيْتِهِ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى كَشَفَ سِجْفَ حُجْرَتِهِ وَنَادَى كَعْبَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا كَعْبُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ بِيَدِهِ أَنْ ضَعِ الشَّطْرَ مِنْ دَيْنِكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ كَعْبٌ قَدْ فَعَلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قُمْ فَاقْضِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu ka'bi bni maalikin, aakhbarahu 'an aabiyhi, aannahu taqaadaa abna aabiy hadradin daynana kaana lahu 'alayhi fiy 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy almasjidi faartafa'at aaswaatuhumaa hattaa sami'ahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa fiy baytihi fakharaja iilayhimaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa kashafa sijfa hujratihi wanaadaa ka'ba bna maalikin faqaala ‏"‏ yaa ka'bu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala labbayka yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ faaashaara iilayhi biyadihi aan da'i alshhatra min daynika ‏.‏ qaala ka'bun qad fa'altu yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ qum faaqdihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Ka'ab b. Malik reported from his father that he pressed in the mosque Ibn Abu Hadrad for the payment of the debt that he owed to him during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). (In this altercation) their voices became loud, until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard them, while he was in the house, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out towards them, and he lifted the curtain of his apartment and he called upon Ka'b b. Malik and said:O Ka'b. He said: At thy beck and call, Allah's Messenger. He pointed out with the help of his hand to remit half of the loan due to him. Ka'b said: Allah's Messenger, I am ready to do that, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to Ibn Abu Hadrad): Stand up and make him the payment (of the rest)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ،لا عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ كَعْبَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، تَقَاضَى دَيْنًا لَهُ عَلَى ابْنِ أَبِي حَدْرَدٍ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, la 'an 'abdi alllahi bni ka'bi bni maalikin, aanna ka'ba bna maalikin, aakhbarahu aannahu, taqaadaa daynana lahu 'alaa abni aabiy hadradin bimithli hadiythi abni wahbin ‏.‏
verses.translation: The above hadith is narrated through another chain with a slight variation of words at the begining and the rest is of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ وَرَوَى اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ، هُرْمُزَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَهُ مَالٌ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي حَدْرَدٍ الأَسْلَمِيِّ فَلَقِيَهُ فَلَزِمَهُ فَتَكَلَّمَا حَتَّى ارْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاتُهُمَا فَمَرَّ بِهِمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا كَعْبُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ كَأَنَّهُ يَقُولُ النِّصْفَ فَأَخَذَ نِصْفًا مِمَّا عَلَيْهِ وَتَرَكَ نِصْفًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala muslimun warawaa alllaythu bnu sa'din, haddathaniy ja'faru bnu rabiy'aaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni, hurmuza 'an 'abdi alllahi bni ka'bi bni maalikin, 'an ka'bi bni maalikin, aannahu kaana lahu maalun 'alaa 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy hadradin alaaslamiyyi falaqiyahu falazimahu fatakallamaa hattaa artafa'at aaswaatuhumaa famarra bihimaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa ka'bu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaashaara biyadihi kaaannahu yaquwlu alnnisfa faaakhadha nisfana mimmaa 'alayhi wataraka nisfana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ka'b b. Malik reported that he made a demand for the payment of the debt that Ibn Abu Hadrad owed to him. This hadith is narrated through another chain of transmitters and (the words are):" He had to get the loan from Abdullah b. Hadrad al-Aslami. He met him and pressed him for payment. There was an altercation between them, until their voices became loud. There happened to pass by them Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he said: O Ka'b, and pointed out with his hand in such a way as he meant half. So he got half of what he (Ibn Abu Hadrad) owed to him and remitted the half
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - أَوْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ - ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مَالَهُ بِعَيْنِهِ عِنْدَ رَجُلٍ قَدْ أَفْلَسَ - أَوْ إِنْسَانٍ قَدْ أَفْلَسَ - فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ مِنْ غَيْرِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, aakhbaraniy aabuw bakri bnu muhammadi bni 'amriw bni hazmin, aanna 'umara bna 'abdi al'aziyzi, aakhbarahu aanna aabaa bakri bna 'abdi alrrahmani bni alhaarithi bni hishaamin aakhbarahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - aaw sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu - ‏ "‏ man aadraka maalahu bi'aynihi 'inda rajulin qad aaflasa - aaw iinsaanin qad aaflasa - fahuwa aahaqqu bihi min ghayrihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who found his property intact with a person (who bought it but who later on) became insolvent (or a person who became insolvent), he (the seller) is entitled to get it more than anyone else
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَحَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ زُهَيْرٍ وَقَالَ ابْنُ رُمْحٍ مِنْ بَيْنِهِمْ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ أَيُّمَا امْرِئٍ فُلِّسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, jamiy'ana 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, h wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i, wayahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, - ya'niy abna zaydin - h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, wayahyaa bnu sa'iydin, wahafsu bnu ghiyaathin, kullu hauulaa'i 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi zuhayrin waqaala abnu rumhin min baynihim fiy riwaayatihi aayyumaa amriiin fullisa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters (but with a slight variation of words and these are)" Whenever a man becomes poor
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ - عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ حَدِيثِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الرَّجُلِ الَّذِي يُعْدِمُ إِذَا وُجِدَ عِنْدَهُ الْمَتَاعُ وَلَمْ يُفَرِّقْهُ ‏ "‏ أَنَّهُ لِصَاحِبِهِ الَّذِي بَاعَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu sulaymaana, - wahuwa abnu 'ikrimaaa bni khaalidin almakhzuwmiyyu - 'ani abni jurayjin, haddathaniy abnu aabiy husaynin, aanna aabaa bakri bna muhammadi bni 'amriw bni hazmin, aakhbarahu aanna 'umara bna 'abdi al'aziyzi haddathahu 'an hadiythi aabiy bakri bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an hadiythi aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alrrajuli alladhiy yu'dimu iidhaa wujida 'indahu almataa'u walam yufarriqhu ‏ "‏ aannahu lisaahibihi alladhiy baa'ahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying about a person who becomes insolvent and (the thing bought by him) is found intact with him, that belongs to one who sold it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ نَهِيكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَفْلَسَ الرَّجُلُ فَوَجَدَ الرَّجُلُ مَتَاعَهُ بِعَيْنِهِ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, wa'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'ani alnnadri bni aanasin, 'an bashiyri bni nahiykin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa aaflasa alrrajulu fawajada alrrajulu mataa'ahu bi'aynihi fahuwa aahaqqu bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:When a man becomes insolvent (and the other) man (the seller) finds his commodity intact with him, he is more entitled to get it (than anyone else)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، أَيْضًا حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي كِلاَهُمَا، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ وَقَالاَ ‏ "‏ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ مِنَ الْغُرَمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa sa'iydun, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, aaydana haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy kilaahumaa, 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu waqaalaa ‏ "‏ fahuwa aahaqqu bihi mina alghuramaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters (but with a change of these words):" He is more entitled to get it than any other creditor
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، وَحَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، الْخُزَاعِيُّ - قَالَ حَجَّاجٌ مَنْصُورُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ - أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ خُثَيْمِ بْنِ عِرَاكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَفْلَسَ الرَّجُلُ فَوَجَدَ الرَّجُلُ عِنْدَهُ سِلْعَتَهُ بِعَيْنِهَا فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu aahmada bni aabiy khalafin, wahajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw salamaaa, alkhuzaa'iyyu - qaala hajjaajun mansuwru bnu salamaaa - aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an khuthaymi bni 'iraakin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa aaflasa alrrajulu fawajada alrrajulu 'indahu sil'atahu bi'aynihaa fahuwa aahaqqu bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When a inan becomes insolvent, and the other person (seller) finds his goods intact with him, he is more entitled to get them than anyone else
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ، حِرَاشٍ أَنَّ حُذَيْفَةَ، حَدَّثَهُمْ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَلَقَّتِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ رُوحَ رَجُلٍ مِمَّنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ فَقَالُوا أَعَمِلْتَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ شَيْئًا قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالُوا تَذَكَّرْ ‏.‏ قَالَ كُنْتُ أُدَايِنُ النَّاسَ فَآمُرُ فِتْيَانِي أَنْ يُنْظِرُوا الْمُعْسِرَ وَيَتَجَوَّزُوا عَنِ الْمُوسِرِ - قَالَ - قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ تَجَوَّزُوا عَنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa mansuwrun, 'an rib'iyyi bni, hiraashin aanna hudhayfaaa, haddathahum qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ talaqqati almalaaiikaau ruwha rajulin mimman kaana qablakum faqaaluwa aa'amilta mina alkhayri shayiana qaala laa ‏.‏ qaaluwa tadhakkar ‏.‏ qaala kuntu audaayinu alnnaasa faamuru fityaaniy aan yunziruwa almu'sira wayatajawwazuwa 'ani almuwsiri - qaala - qaala alllahu 'azza wajalla tajawwazuwa 'anhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying The angels took away the soul of a person who had lived among people who were before you. They (the angels) said:Did you do anything good? He said: No. they said: Try to recall. He said: I used to lend to people and order my servants to give respite to one in straitened circumstances and give allowance to the solvent, for Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, said (to the angels): You should ignore (his failing)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ حُجْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ، قَالَ اجْتَمَعَ حُذَيْفَةُ وَأَبُو مَسْعُودٍ فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ ‏ "‏ رَجُلٌ لَقِيَ رَبَّهُ فَقَالَ مَا عَمِلْتَ قَالَ مَا عَمِلْتُ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ إِلاَّ أَنِّي كُنْتُ رَجُلاً ذَا مَالٍ فَكُنْتُ أُطَالِبُ بِهِ النَّاسَ فَكُنْتُ أَقْبَلُ الْمَيْسُورَ وَأَتَجَاوَزُ عَنِ الْمَعْسُورِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ تَجَاوَزُوا عَنْ عَبْدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ هَكَذَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu laibni hujrin - qaalaa haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani almughiyraai, 'an nu'aymi bni aabiy hindin, 'an rib'iyyi bni hiraashin, qaala ajtama'a hudhayfaau waaabuw mas'uwdin faqaala hudhayfaau ‏ "‏ rajulun laqiya rabbahu faqaala maa 'amilta qaala maa 'amiltu mina alkhayri iilaaa aanniy kuntu rajulaan dhaa maalin fakuntu autaalibu bihi alnnaasa fakuntu aaqbalu almaysuwra waaatajaawazu 'ani alma'suwri ‏.‏ faqaala tajaawazuwa 'an 'abdiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw mas'uwdin hakadhaa sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa reported:A person met his Lord (after death) and He said: What (good) did you do? He said: I did no good except this that I was a rich man, and I demanded from the people (the repayment of debt that I advanced to them). I, however, accepted that which the solvent gave and remitted (the debt) of the insolvent, whereupon He (the Lord) said: You should ignore (the faults) of My servant. Abu Mas'ud (Allah be pleased with him) said: This is what I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ، عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً مَاتَ فَدَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ فَقِيلَ لَهُ مَا كُنْتَ تَعْمَلُ قَالَ فَإِمَّا ذَكَرَ وَإِمَّا ذُكِّرَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ أُبَايِعُ النَّاسَ فَكُنْتُ أُنْظِرُ الْمُعْسِرَ وَأَتَجَوَّزُ فِي السِّكَّةِ أَوْ فِي النَّقْدِ ‏.‏ فَغُفِرَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ وَأَنَا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni, 'umayrin 'an rib'iyyi bni hiraashin, 'an hudhayfaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aanna rajulaan maata fadakhala aljannaaa faqiyla lahu maa kunta ta'malu qaala faiimmaa dhakara waiimmaa dhukkira ‏.‏ faqaala iinniy kuntu aubaayi'u alnnaasa fakuntu aunziru almu'sira waaatajawwazu fiy alssikkaai aaw fiy alnnaqdi ‏.‏ faghufira lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw mas'uwdin waaanaa sami'tuhu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:A person died and he entered Paradise. It was said to him What (act) did you do? (Either he recalled it himself or he was made to recall), he said I used to enter into transactions with people and I gave respite to the insolvent and did not show any strictness in case of accepting a coin or demanding cash payment. (For these acts of his) he was granted pardon. Abu Mas'ud said: I heard this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ طَارِقٍ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ، بْنِ حِرَاشٍ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ ‏ "‏ أُتِيَ اللَّهُ بِعَبْدٍ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً فَقَالَ لَهُ مَاذَا عَمِلْتَ فِي الدُّنْيَا - قَالَ وَلاَ يَكْتُمُونَ اللَّهَ حَدِيثًا - قَالَ يَا رَبِّ آتَيْتَنِي مَالَكَ فَكُنْتُ أُبَايِعُ النَّاسَ وَكَانَ مِنْ خُلُقِي الْجَوَازُ فَكُنْتُ أَتَيَسَّرُ عَلَى الْمُوسِرِ وَأُنْظِرُ الْمُعْسِرَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ أَنَا أَحَقُّ بِذَا مِنْكَ تَجَاوَزُوا عَنْ عَبْدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُقْبَةُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيُّ وَأَبُو مَسْعُودٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ هَكَذَا سَمِعْنَاهُ مِنْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw sa'iydin alaashajju, haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin alaahmaru, 'an sa'di bni taariqin, 'an rib'iyyi, bni hiraashin 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala ‏ "‏ autiya alllahu bi'abdin min 'ibaadihi ataahu alllahu maalaan faqaala lahu maadhaa 'amilta fiy alddunyaa - qaala walaa yaktumuwna alllaha hadiythana - qaala yaa rabbi ataytaniy maalaka fakuntu aubaayi'u alnnaasa wakaana min khuluqiy aljawaazu fakuntu aatayassaru 'alaa almuwsiri waaunziru almu'sira ‏.‏ faqaala alllahu aanaa aahaqqu bidhaa minka tajaawazuwa 'an 'abdiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala 'uqbaau bnu 'aamirin aljuhaniyyu waaabuw mas'uwdin alaansaariyyu hakadhaa sami'naahu min fiy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa (Allah be pleased with him) reported:A servant from amongst the servants of Allah was brought to Him whom Allah had endowed with riches. He (Allah) said to him: What (did you do) in the world? (They cannot conceal anything from Allah) He (the person) said: O my Lord, You endowed me with Your riches. I used to enter into transactions with people. It was my nature to be lenient to (my debtors). I showed leniency to the solvent and gave respite to the insolvent, whereupon Allah said: I have more right than you to do this to connive at My servant. 'Uqba b. 'Amir al-Juhani and Abu Mas'ud said: This is what we heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ حُوسِبَ رَجُلٌ مِمَّنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ فَلَمْ يُوجَدْ لَهُ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ شَىْءٌ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُخَالِطُ النَّاسَ وَكَانَ مُوسِرًا فَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ غِلْمَانَهُ أَنْ يَتَجَاوَزُوا عَنِ الْمُعْسِرِ قَالَ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ نَحْنُ أَحَقُّ بِذَلِكَ مِنْهُ تَجَاوَزُوا عَنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waaabuw kuraybin waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ huwsiba rajulun mimman kaana qablakum falam yuwjad lahu mina alkhayri shaa'un iilaaa aannahu kaana yukhaalitu alnnaasa wakaana muwsirana fakaana yaamuru ghilmaanahu aan yatajaawazuwa 'ani almu'siri qaala qaala alllahu 'azza wajalla nahnu aahaqqu bidhalika minhu tajaawazuwa 'anhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Mas'ud (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A person from people who lived before you was called to account (by Allah at the Day of Judgment) and no good was found in his account except this that lie being a rich man had (financial) dealings with people and had commanded his servants to show leniency to the straitened ones. Upon this Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, said: We have more right to this, so overlook (his faults)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَاحِمٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، - قَالَ مَنْصُورٌ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، وَقَالَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ عَنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ كَانَ رَجُلٌ يُدَايِنُ النَّاسَ فَكَانَ يَقُولُ لِفَتَاهُ إِذَا أَتَيْتَ مُعْسِرًا فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يَتَجَاوَزُ عَنَّا ‏.‏ فَلَقِيَ اللَّهَ فَتَجَاوَزَ عَنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mansuwru bnu aabiy muzaahimin, wamuhammadu bnu ja'fari bni ziyaadin, - qaala mansuwrun haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, waqaala abnu ja'farin, aakhbaranaa iibraahiymu, wahuwa abnu sa'din 'ani abni, shihaabin 'ani 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ kaana rajulun yudaayinu alnnaasa fakaana yaquwlu lifataahu iidhaa aatayta mu'sirana fatajaawaz 'anhu la'alla alllaha yatajaawazu 'annaa ‏.‏ falaqiya alllaha fatajaawaza 'anhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There was a person who gave loans to the people and said to his men: When an insolvent comes to you show him leniency that Allah may overlook our (faults). So when he met Allah, He overlooked his faults (forgave him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna 'ubayda alllahi bna 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, haddathahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏.‏ bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْهَيْثَمِ، خَالِدُ بْنُ خِدَاشِ بْنِ عَجْلاَنَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا قَتَادَةَ، طَلَبَ غَرِيمًا لَهُ فَتَوَارَى عَنْهُ ثُمَّ وَجَدَهُ فَقَالَ إِنِّي مُعْسِرٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ آللَّهِ قَالَ آللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُنْجِيَهُ اللَّهُ مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فَلْيُنَفِّسْ عَنْ مُعْسِرٍ أَوْ يَضَعْ عَنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alhaythami, khaalidu bnu khidaashi bni 'ajlaana haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, aanna aabaa qataadaaa, talaba ghariymana lahu fatawaaraa 'anhu thumma wajadahu faqaala iinniy mu'sirun ‏.‏ faqaala alllahi qaala alllahi ‏.‏ qaala faiinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man sarrahu aan yunjiyahu alllahu min kurabi yawmi alqiyaamaai falyunaffis 'an mu'sirin aaw yada' 'anhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Abu Qatada reported that Abu Qatada (Allah be pleased with him) demanded (the payment of his debt) from his debtor but he disappeared; later on he found him and he said:I am hard up financially, whereupon he said: (Do you state it) by God? He said: By God. Upon this he (Qatada) said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who loves that Allah saves him from the torments of the Day of Resurrection should give respite to the insolvent or remit (his debt)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy jariyru bnu haazimin, 'an aayyuwba, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ayyob with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ‏.‏ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَطْلُ الْغَنِيِّ ظُلْمٌ وَإِذَا أُتْبِعَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَلَى مَلِيءٍ فَلْيَتْبَعْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, ‏.‏ aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ matlu alghaniyyi zulmun waiidhaa autbi'a aahadukum 'alaa maliy'in falyatba' ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Delay (in the payment of debt) on the part of a rich man is injustice, and when one of you is retired to a rich man, he should follow him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالاَ جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, qaalaa jamiy'ana haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعِ فَضْلِ الْمَاءِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni jurayjin, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an bay'i fadli almaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (, Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of excess water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعِ ضِرَابِ الْجَمَلِ وَعَنْ بَيْعِ الْمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ لِتُحْرَثَ ‏.‏ فَعَنْ ذَلِكَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an bay'i diraabi aljamali wa'an bay'i almaa'i waalaardi lituhratha ‏.‏ fa'an dhalika nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the hiring of a Camel to cover a she-Camel and from selling water and land to be tilled. So from all this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يُمْنَعُ فَضْلُ الْمَاءِ لِيُمْنَعَ بِهِ الْكَلأُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa laythun, kilaahumaa 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yumna'u fadlu almaa'i liyumna'a bihi alkalau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Excess water must not be withheld so that the growth of herbage may be hindered
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِحَرْمَلَةَ - أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَمْنَعُوا فَضْلَ الْمَاءِ لِتَمْنَعُوا بِهِ الْكَلأَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, - waalllafzu liharmalaaa - aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, waaabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tamna'uwa fadla almaa'i litamna'uwa bihi alkalaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not withhold excess of water, so that you may prevent the growth of herbage
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ النَّوْفَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي زِيَادُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ هِلاَلَ بْنَ أُسَامَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يُبَاعُ فَضْلُ الْمَاءِ لِيُبَاعَ بِهِ الْكَلأُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'uthmaana alnnawfaliyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin alddahhaaku bnu makhladin, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy ziyaadu bnu sa'din, aanna hilaala bna ausaamaaa, aakhbarahu aanna aabaa salamaaa bna 'abdi alrrahmani aakhbarahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yubaa'u fadlu almaa'i liyubaa'a bihi alkalau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The excess of water should not be sold in order to enable the sate of herbage
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ، عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ ثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ وَمَهْرِ الْبَغِيِّ وَحُلْوَانِ الْكَاهِنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy bakri bni, 'abdi alrrahmani 'an aabiy mas'uwdin alaansaariyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an thamani alkalbi wamahri albaghiyyi wahulwaani alkaahini ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Aba Mas'ud al-Ansari (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the charging of price of the dog, and earnings of a prostitute and sweets offered to a kahin
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ، بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ مِنْ رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ رُمْحٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri, bnu aabiy shaybaaa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi alllaythi min riwaayaai abni rumhin aannahu sami'a aabaa mas'uwdin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this is reported on the authority of Abu Mas'ud through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ السَّائِبَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ شَرُّ الْكَسْبِ مَهْرُ الْبَغِيِّ وَثَمَنُ الْكَلْبِ وَكَسْبُ الْحَجَّامِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin alqattaanu, 'an muhammadi bni yuwsufa, qaala sami'tu alssaaiiba bna yaziyda, yuhaddithu 'an raafi'i bni khadiyjin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ sharru alkasbi mahru albaghiyyi wathamanu alkalbi wakasbu alhajjaami ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Rafi b. Khadij (Allah be pleased with him) reported:I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The worst earning is the earning of a prostitute, the price of a dog and the earning of a cupper
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ قَارِظٍ، عَنِ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنِي رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ ثَمَنُ الْكَلْبِ خَبِيثٌ وَمَهْرُ الْبَغِيِّ خَبِيثٌ وَكَسْبُ الْحَجَّامِ خَبِيثٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, 'an yahyaa, bni aabiy kathiyrin haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu qaarizin, 'ani alssaaiibi bni yaziyda, haddathaniy raafi'u bnu khadiyjin, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ thamanu alkalbi khabiythun wamahru albaghiyyi khabiythun wakasbu alhajjaami khabiythun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Rafi b. Khadij reported Allah'& Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The price of a dog is evil, the earning of a prostitute is evil and the earning of a cupper is evil
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي، كَثِيرٍ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy, kathiyrin bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Rafi' b. Khadij through another chain of transmitters
