verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو هَانِئٍ الْخَوْلاَنِيُّ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُلَىَّ بْنَ رَبَاحٍ اللَّخْمِيَّ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ فَضَالَةَ بْنَ عُبَيْدٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، يَقُولُ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ بِخَيْبَرَ بِقِلاَدَةٍ فِيهَا خَرَزٌ وَذَهَبٌ وَهِيَ مِنَ الْمَغَانِمِ تُبَاعُ فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالذَّهَبِ الَّذِي فِي الْقِلاَدَةِ فَنُزِعَ وَحْدَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الذَّهَبُ بِالذَّهَبِ وَزْنًا بِوَزْنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amriw bni sarhin aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy aabuw haaniiin alkhawlaaniyyu aannahu sami'a 'ulaaaa bna rabaahin alllakhmiyya, yaquwlu sami'tu fadaalaaa bna 'ubaydin alaansaariyya, yaquwlu autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa bikhaybara biqilaadaain fiyhaa kharazun wadhahabun wahiya mina almaghaanimi tubaa'u faaamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialdhhahabi alladhiy fiy alqilaadaai fanuzi'a wahdahu thumma qaala lahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aldhhahabu bialdhhahabi waznana biwaznin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Fadala b. Ubaid al-Ansari reported:A necklace having gold and gems in it was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in Khaibar and it was one of the spoils of war and was put to sale. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The gold used in it should be separated, and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) further said: (Sell) gold for gold with equal weight
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ أَبِي شُجَاعٍ، سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ، أَبِي عِمْرَانَ عَنْ حَنَشٍ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ، عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، قَالَ اشْتَرَيْتُ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ قِلاَدَةً بِاثْنَىْ عَشَرَ دِينَارًا فِيهَا ذَهَبٌ وَخَرَزٌ فَفَصَّلْتُهَا فَوَجَدْتُ فِيهَا أَكْثَرَ مِنِ اثْنَىْ عَشَرَ دِينَارًا فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تُبَاعُ حَتَّى تُفَصَّلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an aabiy shujaa'in, sa'iydi bni yaziyda 'an khaalidi bni, aabiy 'imraana 'an hanashin alssan'aaniyyi, 'an fadaalaaa bni 'ubaydin, qaala ashtaraytu yawma khaybara qilaadaaan biathnaa 'ashara diynaarana fiyhaa dhahabun wakharazun fafassaltuhaa fawajadtu fiyhaa aakthara mini athnaa 'ashara diynaarana fadhakartu dhalika lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ laa tubaa'u hattaa tufassala ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Fadila b. 'Ubaid (Allah be pleased with him) reported:I bought on the day (of the Victory of Khaibar) a necklace for twelve dinars (gold coins). It was made of gold studded with gems. I separated (gold from gems) in it, and found (gold) of more (worth) than twelve dinars. I made a mention of it to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon he said: It should not be sold unless it is separated
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ، يَزِيدَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu mubaarakin, 'an sa'iydi bni, yaziyda bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this is narrated on the authority of Sa'id b. Yazid with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، عَنِ الْجُلاَحِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حَنَشٌ الصَّنْعَانِيُّ، عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ نُبَايِعُ الْيَهُودَ الْوُقِيَّةَ الذَّهَبَ بِالدِّينَارَيْنِ وَالثَّلاَثَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَبِيعُوا الذَّهَبَ بِالذَّهَبِ إِلاَّ وَزْنًا بِوَزْنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni aabiy ja'farin, 'ani aljulaahi aabiy kathiyrin, haddathaniy hanashun alssan'aaniyyu, 'an fadaalaaa bni 'ubaydin, qaala kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma khaybara nubaayi'u alyahuwda alwuqiyyaaa aldhhahaba bialddiynaarayni waalthhalaathaai faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tabiy'uwa aldhhahaba bialdhhahabi iilaaa waznana biwaznin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Fadala b. 'Ubaid reported:We were in the company of Allah's Messenger ( may peace be upon him) on the day (of the Victory of) Khaibar, and made transaction with the Jews for the 'uqiya of gold for the dinars or three (gold coins), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do not sell gold for gold but for equal weight
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ قُرَّةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمَعَافِرِيِّ، وَعَمْرِو، بْنِ الْحَارِثِ وَغَيْرِهِمَا أَنَّ عَامِرَ بْنَ يَحْيَى الْمَعَافِرِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ عَنْ حَنَشٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ فِي غَزْوَةٍ فَطَارَتْ لِي وَلأَصْحَابِي قِلاَدَةٌ فِيهَا ذَهَبٌ وَوَرِقٌ وَجَوْهَرٌ فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَشْتَرِيَهَا فَسَأَلْتُ فَضَالَةَ بْنَ عُبَيْدٍ فَقَالَ انْزِعْ ذَهَبَهَا فَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كِفَّةٍ وَاجْعَلْ ذَهَبَكَ فِي كِفَّةٍ ثُمَّ لاَ تَأْخُذَنَّ إِلاَّ مِثْلاً بِمِثْلٍ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلاَ يَأْخُذَنَّ إِلاَّ مِثْلاً بِمِثْلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'an qurraaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani alma'aafiriyyi, wa'amriw, bni alhaarithi waghayrihimaa aanna 'aamira bna yahyaa alma'aafiriyya, aakhbarahum 'an hanashin, aannahu qaala kunnaa ma'a fadaalaaa bni 'ubaydin fiy ghazwaain fataarat liy walaashaabiy qilaadaaun fiyhaa dhahabun wawariqun wajawharun faaaradtu aan aashtariyahaa fasaaaltu fadaalaaa bna 'ubaydin faqaala anzi' dhahabahaa faaj'alhu fiy kiffaain waaj'al dhahabaka fiy kiffaain thumma laa taakhudhanna iilaaa mithlaan bimithlin faiinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falaa yaakhudhanna iilaaa mithlaan bimithlin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hanash reported:We were along with Fadala b. Ubaid (Allah be pleased with him) in an expedition. There fell to my and my friend's lot a necklace made of gold, silver and jewels. I decided to buy that. I asked Fadala b. 'Ubaid, whereupon he said: Separate its gold and place it in one pan (of the balance) and place your gold in the other pan, and do not receive but equal for equal, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who believes in Allah and the Hereafter should not take but equal for equal
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ أَبَا النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ بُسْرَ بْنَ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ مَعْمَرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ أَرْسَلَ غُلاَمَهُ بِصَاعِ قَمْحٍ فَقَالَ بِعْهُ ثُمَّ اشْتَرِ بِهِ شَعِيرًا ‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ الْغُلاَمُ فَأَخَذَ صَاعًا وَزِيَادَةَ بَعْضِ صَاعٍ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ مَعْمَرًا أَخْبَرَهُ بِذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَعْمَرٌ لِمَ فَعَلْتَ ذَلِكَ انْطَلِقْ فَرُدَّهُ وَلاَ تَأْخُذَنَّ إِلاَّ مِثْلاً بِمِثْلٍ فَإِنِّي كُنْتُ أَسْمَعُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الطَّعَامُ بِالطَّعَامِ مِثْلاً بِمِثْلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ طَعَامُنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ الشَّعِيرَ ‏.‏ قِيلَ لَهُ فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِمِثْلِهِ قَالَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ يُضَارِعَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'an 'amriw bni alhaarithi, aanna aabaa alnnadri, haddathahu aanna busra bna sa'iydin haddathahu 'an ma'mari bni 'abdi alllahi, aannahu aarsala ghulaamahu bisaa'i qamhin faqaala bi'hu thumma ashtari bihi sha'iyrana ‏.‏ fadhahaba alghulaamu faaakhadha saa'ana waziyaadaaa ba'di saa'in falammaa jaa'a ma'marana aakhbarahu bidhalika faqaala lahu ma'marun lima fa'alta dhalika antaliq faruddahu walaa taakhudhanna iilaaa mithlaan bimithlin faiinniy kuntu aasma'u rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ altta'aamu bialtta'aami mithlaan bimithlin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wakaana ta'aamunaa yawmaiidhin alshha'iyra ‏.‏ qiyla lahu faiinnahu laysa bimithlihi qaala iinniy aakhaafu aan yudaari'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ma'mar b. Abdullah reported that he sent his slave with a sa' of wheat and said to him:Sell it, and then buy with it barley. The slave went away and he got a sa' (of barley) and a part of sa' over and above that. When he came to Ma'mar he informed him about that, whereupon Ma'mar said to him: Why did you do that? Go back and return that, and do not accept but weight, for weight, for I used to hear from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Wheat for wheat and like for like. He (one of the narrators) said: Our food in those days consisted of barley. It was said to him (Ma'mar) that (wheat) is not like that (barley). He replied: I am afraid these may not be similar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ بْنِ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، وَأَبَا سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ أَخَا بَنِي عَدِيٍّ الأَنْصَارِيَّ فَاسْتَعْمَلَهُ عَلَى خَيْبَرَ فَقَدِمَ بِتَمْرٍ جَنِيبٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَكُلُّ تَمْرِ خَيْبَرَ هَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا لَنَشْتَرِي الصَّاعَ بِالصَّاعَيْنِ مِنَ الْجَمْعِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَفْعَلُوا وَلَكِنْ مِثْلاً بِمِثْلٍ أَوْ بِيعُوا هَذَا وَاشْتَرُوا بِثَمَنِهِ مِنْ هَذَا وَكَذَلِكَ الْمِيزَانُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - ya'niy abna bilaalin - 'an 'abdi almajiydi bni suhayli bni 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahu sami'a sa'iyda bna almusayyabi, yuhaddithu aanna aabaa hurayraaa, waaabaa sa'iydin haddathaahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha aakhaa baniy 'adiyyin alaansaariyya faasta'malahu 'alaa khaybara faqadima bitamrin janiybin faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aakullu tamri khaybara hakadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa waalllahi yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaa lanashtariy alssaa'a bialssaa'ayni mina aljam'i ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa taf'aluwa walakin mithlaan bimithlin aaw biy'uwa hadhaa waashtaruwa bithamanihi min hadhaa wakadhalika almiyzaanu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira and Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) deputed a person from Banu 'Adi al-Ansari to collect revenue from Khaibar. He came with a fine quality of dates, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him:Are all the dates of Khaibar like this? He said: Allah's Messenger, it is not so. We buy one sa' of (fine quality of dates) for two sa's out of total output (including even the inferior quality of dates), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't do that, but like for like, or sell this (the inferior quality and receive the price) and then buy with the price of that, and that would make up the measure
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ بْنِ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَعْمَلَ رَجُلاً عَلَى خَيْبَرَ فَجَاءَهُ بِتَمْرٍ جَنِيبٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَكُلُّ تَمْرِ خَيْبَرَ هَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا لَنَأْخُذُ الصَّاعَ مِنْ هَذَا بِالصَّاعَيْنِ وَالصَّاعَيْنِ بِالثَّلاَثَةِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَلاَ تَفْعَلْ بِعِ الْجَمْعَ بِالدَّرَاهِمِ ثُمَّ ابْتَعْ بِالدَّرَاهِمِ جَنِيبًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an 'abdi almajiydi bni suhayli bni 'abdi, alrrahmani bni 'awfin 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, wa'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm asta'mala rajulaan 'alaa khaybara fajaa'ahu bitamrin janiybin faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aakullu tamri khaybara hakadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala laa waalllahi yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaa lanaakhudhu alssaa'a min hadhaa bialssaa'ayni waalssaa'ayni bialthhalaathaai ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ falaa taf'al bi'i aljam'a bialddaraahimi thumma abta' bialddaraahimi janiybana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) deputed a person to collect revenue from Khaibar. He brought fine quality of dates, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Are all the dates of Khaibar like this)? He said: No. We got one sa' (of fine dates) for two sa's (of inferior dates), and (similarly) two sa's for three sa's. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't do that rather sell the inferior quality of dates for dirhams (money), and then buy the superior quality with the help of dirhams
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ صَالِحٍ الْوُحَاظِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُمَا - جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَلاَّمٍ - أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْغَافِرِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ، يَقُولُ جَاءَ بِلاَلٌ بِتَمْرٍ بَرْنِيٍّ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مِنْ أَيْنَ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ بِلاَلٌ تَمْرٌ كَانَ عِنْدَنَا رَدِيءٌ فَبِعْتُ مِنْهُ صَاعَيْنِ بِصَاعٍ لِمَطْعَمِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ أَوَّهْ عَيْنُ الرِّبَا لاَ تَفْعَلْ وَلَكِنْ إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَشْتَرِيَ التَّمْرَ فَبِعْهُ بِبَيْعٍ آخَرَ ثُمَّ اشْتَرِ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لَمْ يَذْكُرِ ابْنُ سَهْلٍ فِي حَدِيثِهِ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu saalihin alwuhaaziyyu, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu sahlin alttamiymiyyu, wa'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, - waalllafzu lahumaa - jamiy'ana 'an yahyaa bni hassaana, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau, - wahuwa abnu salaaamin - aakhbaraniy yahyaa, - wahuwa abnu aabiy kathiyrin - qaala sami'tu 'uqbaaa bna 'abdi alghaafiri, yaquwlu sami'tu aabaa sa'iydin, yaquwlu jaa'a bilaalun bitamrin barniyyin faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ min aayna hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala bilaalun tamrun kaana 'indanaa radiy'un fabi'tu minhu saa'ayni bisaa'in limat'ami alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi 'inda dhalika ‏"‏ aawwah 'aynu alrribaa laa taf'al walakin iidhaa aaradta aan tashtariya alttamra fabi'hu bibay'in akhara thumma ashtari bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ lam yadhkuri abnu sahlin fiy hadiythihi 'inda dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd Sa'id reported:Bilal (Allah be pleased with him) came with fine quality of dates. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: From where (you have brought them)? Bilal said: We had inferior quality of dates and I exchanged two sa's (of inferior quality) with one sa (of fine quality) as food for Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Woe! it is in fact usury; therefore, don't do that. But when you intend to buy dates (of superior quality), sell (the inferior quality) in a separate bargain and then buy (the superior quality). And in the hadith transmitted by Ibn Sahl there is no mention of" whereupon
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي قَزَعَةَ، الْبَاهِلِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِتَمْرٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا هَذَا التَّمْرُ مِنْ تَمْرِنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بِعْنَا تَمْرَنَا صَاعَيْنِ بِصَاعٍ مِنْ هَذَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَذَا الرِّبَا فَرُدُّوهُ ثُمَّ بِيعُوا تَمْرَنَا وَاشْتَرُوا لَنَا مِنْ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, 'an aabiy qaza'aaa, albaahiliyyi 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bitamrin faqaala ‏"‏ maa hadhaa alttamru min tamrinaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala alrrajulu yaa rasuwla alllahi bi'naa tamranaa saa'ayni bisaa'in min hadhaa ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hadhaa alrribaa farudduwhu thumma biy'uwa tamranaa waashtaruwa lanaa min hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id (Allah be pleased with him) reported:Dates were brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he said: These dates are not like our dates, whereupon a man said: We sold two sa's of our dates (in order to get) one sa', of these (fine dates), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: That is interest; so return (these dates of fine quality), and get your (inferior dates) ; then sell our dates (for money) and buy for us (with the help of money) such (fine dates)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُرْزَقُ تَمْرَ الْجَمْعِ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ الْخِلْطُ مِنَ التَّمْرِ فَكُنَّا نَبِيعُ صَاعَيْنِ بِصَاعٍ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ صَاعَىْ تَمْرٍ بِصَاعٍ وَلاَ صَاعَىْ حِنْطَةٍ بِصَاعٍ وَلاَ دِرْهَمَ بِدِرْهَمَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an shaybaana, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala kunnaa nurzaqu tamra aljam'i 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa alkhiltu mina alttamri fakunnaa nabiy'u saa'ayni bisaa'in fabalagha dhalika rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ laa saa'aa tamrin bisaa'in walaa saa'aa hintaain bisaa'in walaa dirhama bidirhamayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id (Allah be pleased with him) reported:We were given to eat, during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), dates of different qualities mixed together, and we used to sell two sa's of these for one sa, (of fine quality of dates). This reached Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereupon he said: There should be no exchange of two sa's of (inferior) dates for one sa (of fine dates) and two sa's of (inferior) wheat for one sa' of (fine) wheat. and one dirham for two dirharms
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي، نَضْرَةَ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ الصَّرْفِ، فَقَالَ أَيَدًا بِيَدٍ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ ‏.‏ فَأَخْبَرْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ الصَّرْفِ فَقَالَ أَيَدًا بِيَدٍ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَوَقَالَ ذَلِكَ إِنَّا سَنَكْتُبُ إِلَيْهِ فَلاَ يُفْتِيكُمُوهُ قَالَ فَوَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ جَاءَ بَعْضُ فِتْيَانِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِتَمْرٍ فَأَنْكَرَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كَأَنَّ هَذَا لَيْسَ مِنْ تَمْرِ أَرْضِنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ كَانَ فِي تَمْرِ أَرْضِنَا - أَوْ فِي تَمْرِنَا - الْعَامَ بَعْضُ الشَّىْءِ فَأَخَذْتُ هَذَا وَزِدْتُ بَعْضَ الزِّيَادَةِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَضْعَفْتَ أَرْبَيْتَ لاَ تَقْرَبَنَّ هَذَا إِذَا رَابَكَ مِنْ تَمْرِكَ شَىْءٌ فَبِعْهُ ثُمَّ اشْتَرِ الَّذِي تُرِيدُ مِنَ التَّمْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an sa'iydin aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy, nadraaa qaala saaaltu abna 'abbaasin 'ani alssarfi, faqaala aayadana biyadin qultu na'am ‏.‏ qaala falaa baasa bihi ‏.‏ faaakhbartu aabaa sa'iydin faqultu iinniy saaaltu abna 'abbaasin 'ani alssarfi faqaala aayadana biyadin qultu na'am ‏.‏ qaala falaa baasa bihi ‏.‏ qaala aawaqaala dhalika iinnaa sanaktubu iilayhi falaa yuftiykumuwhu qaala fawaalllahi laqad jaa'a ba'du fityaani rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bitamrin faaankarahu faqaala ‏"‏ kaaanna hadhaa laysa min tamri aardinaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala kaana fiy tamri aardinaa - aaw fiy tamrinaa - al'aama ba'du alshhaa'i faaakhadhtu hadhaa wazidtu ba'da alzziyaadaai ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aad'afta aarbayta laa taqrabanna hadhaa iidhaa raabaka min tamrika shaa'un fabi'hu thumma ashtari alladhiy turiydu mina alttamri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Nadra reported:I asked Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) about the conversion (of gold and silver for silver and gold). We said: Is it hand to hand exchange? I said: Yes. whereupon he said: There is no harm in it. I informed Abu Sa'id about it, telling him that I had asked Ibn 'Abbas about it and he said: Is it hand to hand exchange? I said: Yes, whereupon he said: There is no harm in it. He (the narrator) said, or he said like it: We will soon write to him, and he will not give you this fatwa (religious verdict). He said: By Allah, someone of the boy-servants of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) brought dates, but he refused to accept them (on the plea) that those did not seem to be of the dates of our land. He said: Something had happened to the dates of our land, or our dates. So I got these dates (in exchange by giving) excess (of the dates of our land), whereupon he said: You made an addition for getting the fine dates (in exchange) which tantamounts, to interest; don't do that (in future). Whenever you find some doubt (as regards the deteriorating quality of) your dates, sell them, and then buy the dates that you like
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، أَخْبَرَنَا دَاوُدُ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ وَابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ الصَّرْفِ، فَلَمْ يَرَيَا بِهِ بَأْسًا فَإِنِّي لَقَاعِدٌ عِنْدَ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الصَّرْفِ فَقَالَ مَا زَادَ فَهُوَ رِبًا ‏.‏ فَأَنْكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِقَوْلِهِمَا فَقَالَ لاَ أُحَدِّثُكَ إِلاَّ مَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَاءَهُ صَاحِبُ نَخْلِهِ بِصَاعٍ مِنْ تَمْرٍ طَيِّبٍ وَكَانَ تَمْرُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَذَا اللَّوْنَ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَنَّى لَكَ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ انْطَلَقْتُ بِصَاعَيْنِ فَاشْتَرَيْتُ بِهِ هَذَا الصَّاعَ فَإِنَّ سِعْرَ هَذَا فِي السُّوقِ كَذَا وَسِعْرَ هَذَا كَذَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَيْلَكَ أَرْبَيْتَ إِذَا أَرَدْتَ ذَلِكَ فَبِعْ تَمْرَكَ بِسِلْعَةٍ ثُمَّ اشْتَرِ بِسِلْعَتِكَ أَىَّ تَمْرٍ شِئْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ فَالتَّمْرُ بِالتَّمْرِ أَحَقُّ أَنْ يَكُونَ رِبًا أَمِ الْفِ��َّةُ بِالْفِضَّةِ قَالَ فَأَتَيْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ بَعْدُ فَنَهَانِي وَلَمْ آتِ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ - قَالَ - فَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الصَّهْبَاءِ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْهُ بِمَكَّةَ فَكَرِهَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alaa'laa, aakhbaranaa daawudu, 'an aabiy nadraaa, qaala saaaltu abna 'umara waabna 'abbaasin 'ani alssarfi, falam yarayaa bihi baasana faiinniy laqaa'idun 'inda aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi fasaaaltuhu 'ani alssarfi faqaala maa zaada fahuwa ribana ‏.‏ faaankartu dhalika liqawlihimaa faqaala laa auhaddithuka iilaaa maa sami'tu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jaa'ahu saahibu nakhlihi bisaa'in min tamrin tayyibin wakaana tamru alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hadhaa alllawna faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aannaa laka hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala antalaqtu bisaa'ayni faashtaraytu bihi hadhaa alssaa'a faiinna si'ra hadhaa fiy alssuwqi kadhaa wasi'ra hadhaa kadhaa ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ waylaka aarbayta iidhaa aaradta dhalika fabi' tamraka bisil'aain thumma ashtari bisil'atika aaaaa tamrin shiita ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw sa'iydin faalttamru bialttamri aahaqqu aan yakuwna ribana aami alfi���aau bialfiddaai qaala faaataytu abna 'umara ba'du fanahaaniy walam ati abna 'abbaasin - qaala - fahaddathaniy aabuw alssahbaa'i aannahu saaala abna 'abbaasin 'anhu bimakkaaa fakarihahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Nadra reported:I asked Ibn Umar and Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) about the conversion of gold with gold but they did not find any harm in that. I was sitting in the company of Abd Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) and asked him about this exchange, and he said: Whatever is addition is an' interest. I refused to accept it on account of their statement (statement of Ibn 'Abbas and Ibn 'Umar). He said: I am not narrating to you except what I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). There came to him the owner of a date-palm with one sa' of fine dates, and the dates of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) were of that colour. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to him: Where did you get these dates? I went with two sa's of (inferior dates) and bought one sa' of (these fine dates), for that is the prevailing price (of inferior dates) in the market and that is the price (of the fine quality of dates in the market), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Woe be upon you! You have dealt in interest, when you decide to do it (i. e. exchange superior quality of dates for inferior quality) ; so you should sell your dates for another commodity (or currency) and then with the help of that commodity buy the dates you like. Abu Sa'ad said: When dates are exchanged for dates (with different qualities) there is the possibility (of the element of) interest (creeping into that) or when gold is exchanged for gold having different qualities. I subsequently came to Ibn 'Umar and he forbade me (to do it), but I did not come to Ibn 'Abbas; (Allah be pleased with them). He (the narrator) said: Abu as-Sahba' narrated to me: He asked Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) in Mecca, and he too disapproved of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ، عُيَيْنَةَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّادٍ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ الدِّينَارُ بِالدِّينَارِ وَالدِّرْهَمُ بِالدِّرْهَمِ مِثْلاً بِمِثْلٍ مَنْ زَادَ أَوِ ازْدَادَ فَقَدْ أَرْبَى ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ غَيْرَ هَذَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَقَدْ لَقِيتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُلْتُ أَرَأَيْتَ هَذَا الَّذِي تَقُولُ أَشَىْءٌ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْ وَجَدْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فَقَالَ لَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَمْ أَجِدْهُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنْ حَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الرِّبَا فِي النَّسِيئَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, wamuhammadu bnu haatimin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, jamiy'ana 'an sufyaana bni, 'uyaynaaa - waalllafzu laibni 'abbaadin - qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an aabiy saalihin, qaala sami'tu aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya, yaquwlu alddiynaaru bialddiynaari waalddirhamu bialddirhami mithlaan bimithlin man zaada aawi azdaada faqad aarbaa ‏.‏ faqultu lahu iinna abna 'abbaasin yaquwlu ghayra hadhaa ‏.‏ faqaala laqad laqiytu abna 'abbaasin faqultu aaraaayta hadhaa alladhiy taquwlu aashaa'un sami'tahu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaw wajadtahu fiy kitaabi alllahi 'azza wajalla faqaala lam aasma'hu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm walam aajidhu fiy kitaabi alllahi walakin haddathaniy ausaamaau bnu zaydin aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alrribaa fiy alnnasiyiaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Salih reported:I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) said: Dinar (gold) for gold and dirham for dirham can be (exchanged) with equal for equal; but he who gives more or demands more in fact deals in interest. I sald to him: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) says otherwise, whereupon he said: I met Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) and said: Do you see what you say; have you heard it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), or found it in the Book of Allah, the Glorious and Majestic? He said: I did not hear it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). and I did not find it in the Book of Allah (Glorious and Majestic), but Usama b. Zaid narrated it to me that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: There can be an element of interest in credit
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَمْرٍو - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا الرِّبَا فِي النَّسِيئَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu li'amrinw - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'ubaydi, alllahi bni aabiy yaziyda aannahu sami'a abna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu aakhbaraniy ausaamaau bnu zaydin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa alrribaa fiy alnnasiyiaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubaidullah b. Abu Yazid heard Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) as saying:Usama b. Zaid reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: There can be an element of interest in credit (when the payment is not equal)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ رِبًا فِيمَا كَانَ يَدًا بِيَدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'affaanu, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, qaalaa haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa abnu taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa ribana fiymaa kaana yadana biyadin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas; (Allah be pleased with them) reported on the authority of Usama b. Zaid Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having said this:There is no element of interest when the money or commodity is exchanged hand to hand
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِقْلٌ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي، رَبَاحٍ أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، لَقِيَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَرَأَيْتَ قَوْلَكَ فِي الصَّرْفِ أَشَيْئًا سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمْ شَيْئًا وَجَدْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ كَلاَّ لاَ أَقُولُ أَمَّا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَنْتُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ وَأَمَّا كِتَابُ اللَّهِ فَلاَ أَعْلَمُهُ وَلَكِنْ حَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلاَ إِنَّمَا الرِّبَا فِي النَّسِيئَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhakamu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa hiqlun, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'ataa'u bnu aabiy, rabaahin aanna aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya, laqiya abna 'abbaasin faqaala lahu aaraaayta qawlaka fiy alssarfi aashayiana sami'tahu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aam shayiana wajadtahu fiy kitaabi alllahi 'azza wajalla faqaala abnu 'abbaasin kalaaa laa aaquwlu aammaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaantum aa'lamu bihi waaammaa kitaabu alllahi falaa aa'lamuhu walakin haddathaniy ausaamaau bnu zaydin aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aalaa iinnamaa alrribaa fiy alnnasiyiaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ata' b. Abu Rabah reported:Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with them) met Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) and said to him: What do you say in regard to the conversion (of commodities or money) did you hear it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), or is it something which you found In Allah's Book, Majestic and Glorious? Thereupon Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleated with them) said: I don't say that. So far at Allah's Massenger (ﷺ) is concerned, you know him better, and to far as the Book of Allah to concerned, I do not know it (more than you do), but 'Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) narrated to me Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having said this: Beware, there can be an element of interest in credit
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعُثْمَانَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، قَالَ سَأَلَ شِبَاكٌ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَحَدَّثَنَا عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم آكِلَ الرِّبَا وَمُؤْكِلَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ وَكَاتِبَهُ وَشَاهِدَيْهِ قَالَ إِنَّمَا نُحَدِّثُ بِمَا سَمِعْنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu li'uthmaana - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala, 'uthmaanu haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mughiyraaa, qaala saaala shibaakun iibraahiyma fahaddathanaa 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala la'ana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm akila alrribaa wamuukilahu ‏.‏ qaala qultu wakaatibahu washaahidayhi qaala iinnamaa nuhaddithu bimaa sami'naa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) (Allah be pleased with him) said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cursed the one who accepted interest and the one who paid it I asked about the one who recorded it, and two witnesses to it. He (the narrator) said:We narrate what we have heard
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم آكِلَ الرِّبَا وَمُوكِلَهُ وَكَاتِبَهُ وَشَاهِدَيْهِ وَقَالَ هُمْ سَوَاءٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu alssabbaahi, wazuhayru bnu harbin, wa'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, qaaluwa haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala la'ana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm akila alrribaa wamuwkilahu wakaatibahu washaahidayhi waqaala hum sawaa'un ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cursed the accepter of interest and its payer, and one who records it, and the two witnesses, and he said:They are all equal
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ وَأَهْوَى النُّعْمَانُ بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ إِلَى أُذُنَيْهِ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْحَلاَلَ بَيِّنٌ وَإِنَّ الْحَرَامَ بَيِّنٌ وَبَيْنَهُمَا مُشْتَبِهَاتٌ لاَ يَعْلَمُهُنَّ كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ فَمَنِ اتَّقَى الشُّبُهَاتِ اسْتَبْرَأَ لِدِينِهِ وَعِرْضِهِ وَمَنْ وَقَعَ فِي الشُّبُهَاتِ وَقَعَ فِي الْحَرَامِ كَالرَّاعِي يَرْعَى حَوْلَ الْحِمَى يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَرْتَعَ فِيهِ أَلاَ وَإِنَّ لِكُلِّ مَلِكٍ حِمًى أَلاَ وَإِنَّ حِمَى اللَّهِ مَحَارِمُهُ أَلاَ وَإِنَّ فِي الْجَسَدِ مُضْغَةً إِذَا صَلَحَتْ صَلَحَ الْجَسَدُ كُلُّهُ وَإِذَا فَسَدَتْ فَسَدَ الْجَسَدُ كُلُّهُ أَلاَ وَهِيَ الْقَلْبُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin alhamdaaniyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, qaala sami'tuhu yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu waaahwaa alnnu'maanu biiisba'ayhi iilaa audhunayhi ‏ "‏ iinna alhalaala bayyinun waiinna alharaama bayyinun wabaynahumaa mushtabihaatun laa ya'lamuhunna kathiyrun mina alnnaasi famani attaqaa alshhubuhaati astabraaa lidiynihi wa'irdihi waman waqa'a fiy alshhubuhaati waqa'a fiy alharaami kaalrraa'iy yar'aa hawla alhimaa yuwshiku aan yarta'a fiyhi aalaa waiinna likulli malikin himana aalaa waiinna himaa alllahi mahaarimuhu aalaa waiinna fiy aljasadi mudghaaan iidhaa salahat salaha aljasadu kulluhu waiidhaa fasadat fasada aljasadu kulluhu aalaa wahiya alqalbu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir (Allah be pleased with him) reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon himn) as having said this (and Nu'man) pointed towards his ears with his fingers): What is lawful is evident and what is unlawful is evident, and in between them are the things doubtful which many people do not know. So he who guards against doubtful things keeps his religion and honour blameless, and he who indulges in doubtful things indulges in fact in unlawful things, just as a shepherd who pastures his animals round a preserve will soon pasture them in it. Beware, every king has a preserve, and the things God his declaced unlawful are His preserves. Beware, in the body there is a piece of flesh; if it is sound, the whole body is sound and if it is corrupt the whole body is corrupt, and hearken it is the heart
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, qaalaa haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zakariya with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، وَأَبِي، فَرْوَةَ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ حَدِيثَ زَكَرِيَّاءَ أَتَمُّ مِنْ حَدِيثِهِمْ وَأَكْثَرُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mutarrifin, waaabiy, farwaaa alhamdaaniyyi h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyya - 'ani abni 'ajlaana, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni sa'iydin, kulluhum 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa alhadiythi ghayra aanna hadiytha zakariyyaa'a aatammu min hadiythihim waaaktharu ‏.‏
verses.translation: AI-Nu'man b. Bashir reported it from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). The hadith narrated by Zakariya is, however, more complete and lengthy than the other ones
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدُ، بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ الشَّعْبِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ نُعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، صَاحِبَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَخْطُبُ النَّاسَ بِحِمْصَ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ الْحَلاَلُ بَيِّنٌ وَالْحَرَامُ بَيِّنٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ زَكَرِيَّاءَ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَقَعَ فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi bni sa'din, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy khaalidu, bnu yaziyda haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu aabiy hilaalin, 'an 'awni bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'aamirin alshha'biyyi, aannahu sami'a nu'maana bna bashiyri bni sa'din, saahiba rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa yakhtubu alnnaasa bihimsa wahuwa yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ alhalaalu bayyinun waalharaamu bayyinun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithli hadiythi zakariyyaa'a 'ani alshha'biyyi iilaa qawlihi ‏"‏ yuwshiku aan yaqa'a fiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir b. Sa'd, a Companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was heard delivering a sermon at Hims and was saying:I heard Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying: The lawful is evident and the unlawful is evident, the rest of the hadith is the same as related by Zakariya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَسِيرُ عَلَى جَمَلٍ لَهُ قَدْ أَعْيَا فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يُسَيِّبَهُ قَالَ فَلَحِقَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَا لِي وَضَرَبَهُ فَسَارَ سَيْرًا لَمْ يَسِرْ مِثْلَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِعْنِيهِ بِوُقِيَّةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لاَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِعْنِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَبِعْتُهُ بِوُقِيَّةٍ وَاسْتَثْنَيْتُ عَلَيْهِ حُمْلاَنَهُ إِلَى أَهْلِي فَلَمَّا بَلَغْتُ أَتَيْتُهُ بِالْجَمَلِ فَنَقَدَنِي ثَمَنَهُ ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ فَأَرْسَلَ فِي أَثَرِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتُرَانِي مَاكَسْتُكَ لآخُذَ جَمَلَكَ خُذْ جَمَلَكَ وَدَرَاهِمَكَ فَهُوَ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, 'an 'aamirin, haddathaniy jaabiru bnu 'abdi alllahi, aannahu kaana yasiyru 'alaa jamalin lahu qad aa'yaa faaaraada aan yusayyibahu qaala falahiqaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fada'aa liy wadarabahu fasaara sayrana lam yasir mithlahu qaala ‏"‏ bi'niyhi biwuqiyyaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu laa ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ bi'niyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fabi'tuhu biwuqiyyaain waastathnaytu 'alayhi humlaanahu iilaa aahliy falammaa balaghtu aataytuhu bialjamali fanaqadaniy thamanahu thumma raja'tu faaarsala fiy aathariy faqaala ‏"‏ aaturaaniy maakastuka lakhudha jamalaka khudh jamalaka wadaraahimaka fahuwa laka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that he was travelling on his camel which had grown jaded, and he decided to let it off. When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) met him and prayed for him and struck it, so it trotted as it had never trotted before. He said:Sell it to me for an 'uqaya. I said: No. He again said: Sell it to me. So I sold it to him for an 'uqaya, but made the stipulation that I should be allowed to ride back to my family. Then when I came to (my place) I took the camel to him and he paid me its price in ready money. I then went back and he sent: (someone) behind me (and as I came) he said: Do you see that I asked you to reduce price for buying your camel. Take your camel and your coins; these are yours
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ يُونُسَ - عَنْ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, - ya'niy abna yuwnusa - 'an zakariyyaa'a, 'an 'aamirin, haddathaniy jaabiru bnu 'abdi alllahi, bimithli hadiythi abni numayrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعُثْمَانَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ غَزَوْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَلاَحَقَ بِي وَتَحْتِي نَاضِحٌ لِي قَدْ أَعْيَا وَلاَ يَكَادُ يَسِيرُ قَالَ فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ مَا لِبَعِيرِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ عَلِيلٌ - قَالَ - فَتَخَلَّفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَزَجَرَهُ وَدَعَا لَهُ فَمَازَالَ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ الإِبِلِ قُدَّامَهَا يَسِيرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ كَيْفَ تَرَى بَعِيرَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ بِخَيْرٍ قَدْ أَصَابَتْهُ بَرَكَتُكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفَتَبِيعُنِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَاسْتَحْيَيْتُ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَنَا نَاضِحٌ غَيْرُهُ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَبِعْتُهُ إِيَّاهُ عَلَى أَنَّ لِي فَقَارَ ظَهْرِهِ حَتَّى أَبْلُغَ الْمَدِينَةَ - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي عَرُوسٌ فَاسْتَأْذَنْتُهُ فَأَذِنَ لِي فَتَقَدَّمْتُ النَّاسَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ حَتَّى انْتَهَيْتُ فَلَقِيَنِي خَالِي فَسَأَلَنِي عَنِ الْبَعِيرِ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِمَا صَنَعْتُ فِيهِ فَلاَمَنِي فِيهِ - قَالَ - وَقَدْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِي حِينَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُهُ ‏"‏ مَا تَزَوَّجْتَ أَبِكْرًا أَمْ ثَيِّبًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ تَزَوَّجْتُ ثَيِّبًا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفَلاَ تَزَوَّجْتَ بِكْرًا تُلاَعِبُكَ وَتُلاَعِبُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ تُوُفِّيَ وَالِدِي - أَوِ اسْتُشْهِدَ - وَلِي أَخَوَاتٌ صِغَارٌ فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أَتَزَوَّجَ إِلَيْهِنَّ مِثْلَهُنَّ فَلاَ تُؤَدِّبُهُنَّ وَلاَ تَقُومُ عَلَيْهِنَّ فَتَزَوَّجْتُ ثَيِّبًا لِتَقُومَ عَلَيْهِنَّ وَتُؤَدِّبَهُنَّ - قَالَ - فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ غَدَوْتُ إِلَيْهِ بِالْبَعِيرِ فَأَعْطَانِي ثَمَنَهُ وَرَدَّهُ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu li'uthmaana - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala, 'uthmaanu haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mughiyraaa, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala ghazawtu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fatalaahaqa biy watahtiy naadihun liy qad aa'yaa walaa yakaadu yasiyru qaala faqaala liy ‏"‏ maa liba'iyrika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu 'aliylun - qaala - fatakhallafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fazajarahu wada'aa lahu famaazaala bayna yadaai aliibili quddaamahaa yasiyru ‏.‏ qaala faqaala liy ‏"‏ kayfa taraa ba'iyraka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu bikhayrin qad aasaabathu barakatuka ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aafatabiy'uniyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faastahyaytu walam yakun lanaa naadihun ghayruhu qaala faqultu na'am ‏.‏ fabi'tuhu iiyyaahu 'alaa aanna liy faqaara zahrihi hattaa aablugha almadiynaaa - qaala - faqultu lahu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy 'aruwsun faastaadhantuhu faaadhina liy fataqaddamtu alnnaasa iilaa almadiynaai hattaa antahaytu falaqiyaniy khaaliy fasaaalaniy 'ani alba'iyri faaakhbartuhu bimaa sana'tu fiyhi falaamaniy fiyhi - qaala - waqad kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala liy hiyna astaadhantuhu ‏"‏ maa tazawwajta aabikrana aam thayyibana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu lahu tazawwajtu thayyibana ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aafalaa tazawwajta bikrana tulaa'ibuka watulaa'ibuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu lahu yaa rasuwla alllahi tuwuffiya waalidiy - aawi astushhida - waliy aakhawaatun sighaarun fakarihtu aan aatazawwaja iilayhinna mithlahunna falaa tuuaddibuhunna walaa taquwmu 'alayhinna fatazawwajtu thayyibana litaquwma 'alayhinna watuuaddibahunna - qaala - falammaa qadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa ghadawtu iilayhi bialba'iyri faaa'taaniy thamanahu waraddahu 'alaaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported:I went on an expedition with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He overtook me and I was on a water-carrying camel who had grown tired and did not walk (trot). He (the Holy Prophet) said to me: What is the matter with your camel? I said: It is sick. He (the Holy Prophet) stepped behind and drove it and prayed for it, and then it always moved ahead of other camels. He (then) said: How do you find your camel? I said: It is, by the grace of your prayer, all right. He said: Would you sell this (camel) to me? I felt shy (to say him," No" ) as we had no other camel for carrying water, but (later on) I said: Yes, and to I sold it to him on the condition that (I would be permitted) to ride it until I reached Madina. I said to him: Allah's Messenger, I am newly married, so I asked his permission (to go ahead of the caravan). He permitted me, and I reached Medina well in advance of other people, until I reached my destination. There my maternal uncle met me and asked me about the camel, and I told him what I had done with regard to it. He reproved me in this connection. He (Jabir) said: When I asked his permission (to go ahead of the caravan) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) inquired of me whether I had married a virgin or a non-virgin. I said to him: I have married a non-virgin. He said: Why did you not marry a virgin who would have played with you and you would have played with her? I said to him: Allah's Messenger, my father died (or he fell as a martyr), and I have small sisters to (look after), so I did not like the idea that I should marry a woman who is like them and thus be not able to teach them manners and look after them properly. So I have married a non-virgin so that she should be able to look after them and teach them manners, When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina, I went to him in the morning with the camel. He paid me its price and returned that (the camel) to me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ أَقْبَلْنَا مِنْ مَكَّةَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاعْتَلَّ جَمَلِي ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِقِصَّتِهِ وَفِيهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي ‏"‏ بِعْنِي جَمَلَكَ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ بَلْ هُوَ لَكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ بَلْ بِعْنِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ بَلْ هُوَ لَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ بَلْ بِعْنِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّ لِرَجُلٍ عَلَىَّ أُوقِيَّةَ ذَهَبٍ فَهُوَ لَكَ بِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قَدْ أَخَذْتُهُ فَتَبَلَّغْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِبِلاَلٍ ‏"‏ أَعْطِهِ أُوقِيَّةً مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَزِدْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَعْطَانِي أُوقِيَّةً مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَزَادَنِي قِيرَاطًا - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ لاَ تُفَارِقُنِي زِيَادَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ - فَكَانَ فِي كِيسٍ لِي فَأَخَذَهُ أَهْلُ الشَّامِ يَوْمَ الْحَرَّةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an jaabirin, qaala aaqbalnaa min makkaaa iilaa almadiynaai ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faa'talla jamaliy ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha biqissatihi wafiyhi thumma qaala liy ‏"‏ bi'niy jamalaka hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu laa bal huwa laka ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laa bal bi'niyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu laa bal huwa laka yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laa bal bi'niyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu faiinna lirajulin 'alaaaa auwqiyyaaa dhahabin fahuwa laka bihaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ qad aakhadhtuhu fataballagh 'alayhi iilaa almadiynaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala falammaa qadimtu almadiynaaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm libilaalin ‏"‏ aa'tihi auwqiyyaaan min dhahabin wazidhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faaa'taaniy auwqiyyaaan min dhahabin wazaadaniy qiyraatana - qaala - faqultu laa tufaariquniy ziyaadaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - qaala - fakaana fiy kiysin liy faaakhadhahu aahlu alshhaami yawma alharraai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:We went from Mecca to Medina with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when my camel fell ill, and the rest of the hadith is the same. (But it in also narrated in it: ) He (the Holy Prophet) said to me: Sell your camel to me. I said: No, but it is yours. He said: No. (it can't be), but sell it to me. I said: No, but, Allah's Messenger, it is yours. He said: No, it can't be, but sell it to me. I said: Then give me an 'uqaya of gold for I owe that to a person and then it would be yours. He (the Holy Prophet) said: I take it (for an 'uqiya of gold) and you reach Medina on it. As I reached Medina, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Bilal: Give him an 'uqiya of gold and make some extra payment too. He (Jabir) said: He gave me an 'uqiya of gold and made an addition of a qirat. He (Jabir) said: The addition made by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was with me (as a sacred trust for belssing) and lay with me in a pocket until the people of Syria took it on the Day of Harra
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي، نَضْرَةَ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ فَتَخَلَّفَ نَاضِحِي ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَقَالَ فِيهِ فَنَخَسَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي ‏"‏ ارْكَبْ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ أَيْضًا قَالَ فَمَا زَالَ يَزِيدُنِي وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ وَاللَّهُ يَغْفِرُ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu ziyaadin, haddathanaa aljurayriyyu, 'an aabiy, nadraaa 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy safarin fatakhallafa naadihiy ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha waqaala fiyhi fanakhasahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma qaala liy ‏"‏ arkab biasmi alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wazaada aaydana qaala famaa zaala yaziyduniy wayaquwlu ‏"‏ waalllahu yaghfiru laka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported:We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a journey and my camel meant for carrying water lagged behind. The rest of the hadith is the same and it is mentioned also: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pricked it and then said to me: Ride in the name of Allah. He constantly made addition (in prayers for me) and went on saying. May Allah forgive you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا أَتَى عَلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ أَعْيَا بَعِيرِي - قَالَ - فَنَخَسَهُ فَوَثَبَ - فَكُنْتُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ أَحْبِسُ خِطَامَهُ لأَسْمَعَ حَدِيثَهُ فَمَا أَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهِ فَلَحِقَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ بِعْنِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَبِعْتُهُ مِنْهُ بِخَمْسِ أَوَاقٍ - قَالَ - قُلْتُ عَلَى أَنَّ لِي ظَهْرَهُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلَكَ ظَهْرُهُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ أَتَيْتُهُ بِهِ فَزَادَنِي وُقِيَّةً ثُمَّ وَهَبَهُ لِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala lammaa aataa 'alaaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waqad aa'yaa ba'iyriy - qaala - fanakhasahu fawathaba - fakuntu ba'da dhalika aahbisu khitaamahu laasma'a hadiythahu famaa aaqdiru 'alayhi falahiqaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ bi'niyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fabi'tuhu minhu bikhamsi aawaaqin - qaala - qultu 'alaa aanna liy zahrahu iilaa almadiynaai ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ walaka zahruhu iilaa almadiynaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala falammaa qadimtu almadiynaaa aataytuhu bihi fazaadaniy wuqiyyaaan thumma wahabahu liy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported:My camel had grown tired as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me. He goaded it and it began to jump. After that I tried to restrain its rein so that I could listen to his (Prophet's) words, but I could not do that. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) met me and said: Sell it to me, and I sold it for five 'uqiyas. I said: On the condition that I may use it as a ride (for going back) to Medina. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Well, you may use it as a ride up till Medina. When I came to Medina I handed over that to him and he made an addition of an uqiya (to that amount which had been agreed upon) and then presented that (camel) to me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا بَشِيرُ بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ النَّاجِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَافَرْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ - أَظُنُّهُ قَالَ غَازِيًا - وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ وَزَادَ فِيهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا جَابِرُ أَتَوَفَّيْتَ الثَّمَنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَكَ الثَّمَنُ وَلَكَ الْجَمَلُ لَكَ الثَّمَنُ وَلَكَ الْجَمَلُ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uqbaau bnu mukramin al'ammiyyu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa bashiyru bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an aabiy almutawakkili alnnaajiyyi, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala saafartu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ba'di aasfaarihi - aazunnuhu qaala ghaaziyana - waaqtassa alhadiytha wazaada fiyhi qaala ‏"‏ yaa jaabiru aatawaffayta althhamana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laka althhamanu walaka aljamalu laka althhamanu walaka aljamalu‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd Mutawakkil al-Najl reported from Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) who said:I accompanied Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in one of his journeys (the narrator says, he said in Jihad), and he narrated the rest of the hadith, and made this addition: He (the Holy Prophet) said: Jabir, have you received the price? I said: Yes, whereupon he said: Yours is the price as well as the camel; yours is the price as well as the camel
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ اشْتَرَى مِنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعِيرًا بِوُقِيَّتَيْنِ وَدِرْهَمٍ أَوْ دِرْهَمَيْنِ - قَاَلَ - فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ صِرَارًا أَمَرَ بِبَقَرَةٍ فَذُبِحَتْ فَأَكَلُوا مِنْهَا فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ آتِيَ الْمَسْجِدَ فَأُصَلِّيَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَوَزَنَ لِي ثَمَنَ الْبَعِيرِ فَأَرْجَحَ لِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhaaribin, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu ashtaraa minniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'iyrana biwuqiyyatayni wadirhamin aaw dirhamayni - qaaala - falammaa qadima siraarana aamara bibaqaraain fadhubihat faaakaluwa minhaa falammaa qadima almadiynaaa aamaraniy aan atiya almasjida faausalliya rak'atayni wawazana liy thamana alba'iyri faaarjaha liy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bought a camel from me for two 'uqiyas and a dirham or two dirhams. As he reached Sirar (a village near Medina), he commanded a cow to be slaughtered and it was slaughtered, and they ate of that, and as he (the Holy Prophet) reached Medina he ordered me to go to the mosque and offer two rak'ahs of prayer, and he measured for me the price of the camel and even made an excess payment to me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَارِبٌ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذِهِ الْقِصَّةِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَاشْتَرَاهُ مِنِّي بِثَمَنٍ قَدْ سَمَّاهُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْوُقِيَّتَيْنِ وَالدِّرْهَمَ وَالدِّرْهَمَيْنِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَمَرَ بِبَقَرَةٍ فَنُحِرَتْ ثُمَّ قَسَمَ لَحْمَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, haddathanaa shu'baau, aakhbaranaa muhaaribun, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhihi alqissaai ghayra aannahu qaala faashtaraahu minniy bithamanin qad sammaahu ‏.‏ walam yadhkuri alwuqiyyatayni waalddirhama waalddirhamayni ‏.‏ waqaala aamara bibaqaraain fanuhirat thumma qasama lahmahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported this narration from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) but with this variation that he said:He (the Holy Prophet) bought the camel from me on a stipulated price. And he did not mention two 'uqiyas and a dirham or two dirhams, and he comanded a cow (to be slaughtered) and it was slaughtered, and he then distributed its flesh
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهُ ‏ "‏ قَدْ أَخَذْتُ جَمَلَكَ بِأَرْبَعَةِ دَنَانِيرَ وَلَكَ ظَهْرُهُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabirin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lahu ‏ "‏ qad aakhadhtu jamalaka biaarba'aai danaaniyra walaka zahruhu iilaa almadiynaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to him:I have taken your camelfor four dinars, and you may ride upon it to Medina
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ، أَنَسٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَسْلَفَ مِنْ رَجُلٍ بَكْرًا فَقَدِمَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِبِلٌ مِنْ إِبِلِ الصَّدَقَةِ فَأَمَرَ أَبَا رَافِعٍ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ الرَّجُلَ بَكْرَهُ فَرَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ أَبُو رَافِعٍ فَقَالَ لَمْ أَجِدْ فِيهَا إِلاَّ خِيَارًا رَبَاعِيًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَعْطِهِ إِيَّاهُ إِنَّ خِيَارَ النَّاسِ أَحْسَنُهُمْ قَضَاءً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amriw bni sarhin aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'an maaliki bni, aanasin 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy raafi'in, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm astaslafa min rajulin bakrana faqadimat 'alayhi iibilun min iibili alssadaqaai faaamara aabaa raafi'in aan yaqdiya alrrajula bakrahu faraja'a iilayhi aabuw raafi'in faqaala lam aajid fiyhaa iilaaa khiyaarana rabaa'iyana ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ aa'tihi iiyyaahu iinna khiyaara alnnaasi aahsanuhum qadaa'an ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Rafi' reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took from a man as a loan a young camel (below six years). Then the camels of Sadaqa were brought to him. He ordered Abu Rafi' to return to that person the young camel (as a return of the loan). Abu Rafi' returned to him and said:I did not find among them but better camels above the age of six. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Give that to him for the best men are those who are best in paying off the debt
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، سَمِعْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَسْلَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ اسْتَسْلَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَكْرًا ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَإِنَّ خَيْرَ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ أَحْسَنُهُمْ قَضَاءً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, 'an muhammadi bni ja'farin, sami'tu zayda bna aaslama, aakhbaranaa 'ataa'u bnu yasaarin, 'an aabiy raafi'in, mawlaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala astaslafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bakrana ‏.‏ bimithlihi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ faiinna khayra 'ibaadi alllahi aahsanuhum qadaa'an ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Rafi', the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), said:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took as a loan (the rest of the hadith is the same), but with this variation that he (the Holy Prophet) said: Good amongst the servants of Allah is he who is best in paying off the debt
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ لِرَجُلٍ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَقٌّ فَأَغْلَظَ لَهُ فَهَمَّ بِهِ أَصْحَابُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ لِصَاحِبِ الْحَقِّ مَقَالاً - فَقَالَ لَهُمُ - اشْتَرُوا لَهُ سِنًّا فَأَعْطُوهُ إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا لاَ نَجِدُ إِلاَّ سِنًّا هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ سِنِّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاشْتَرُوهُ فَأَعْطُوهُ إِيَّاهُ فَإِنَّ مِنْ خَيْرِكُمْ - أَوْ خَيْرَكُمْ - أَحْسَنُكُمْ قَضَاءً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaari bni 'uthmaana al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an salamaaa bni kuhaylin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala kaana lirajulin 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm haqqun faaaghlaza lahu fahamma bihi aashaabu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna lisaahibi alhaqqi maqaalaan - faqaala lahumu - ashtaruwa lahu sinnana faaa'tuwhu iiyyaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa iinnaa laa najidu iilaaa sinnana huwa khayrun min sinnihi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faashtaruwhu faaa'tuwhu iiyyaahu faiinna min khayrikum - aaw khayrakum - aahsanukum qadaa'an ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) owed (something) to a person. He behaved in an uncivil manner with him. This vexed the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ), whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: He who has a right is entitled to speak, and said to them (his Companions): Buy a camel for him and give that to him. They said: We do not find a camel (of that age) but one with better age than that. He said: Buy that and give that to him, for best of you or best amongst you are those who are best in paying off debt
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ اسْتَقْرَضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سِنًّا فَأَعْطَى سِنًّا فَوْقَهُ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ خِيَارُكُمْ مَحَاسِنُكُمْ قَضَاءً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an 'aliyyi bni saalihin, 'an salamaaa bni kuhaylin, 'an aabiy, salamaaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala astaqrada rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sinnana faaa'taa sinnana fawqahu waqaala ‏ "‏ khiyaarukum mahaasinukum qadaa'an ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took a camel on loan, and then returned him (the lender) the camel of a more mature age and said: Good among you are those who are good in clearing off the debt
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ يَتَقَاضَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعِيرًا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَعْطُوهُ سِنًّا فَوْقَ سِنِّهِ - وَقَالَ - خَيْرُكُمْ أَحْسَنُكُمْ قَضَاءً ‏"‏ ‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an salamaaa bni kuhaylin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala jaa'a rajulun yataqaadaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'iyrana faqaala ‏ "‏ aa'tuwhu sinnana fawqa sinnihi - waqaala - khayrukum aahsanukum qadaa'an ‏"‏ ‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported:There came a person demanding a camel from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Give him (the camel) of that age or of more mature age, and said: Best among you is one who is best in clearing off the debt
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَابْنُ، رُمْحٍ قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ قُتَيْبَةُ، بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ عَبْدٌ فَبَايَعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْهِجْرَةِ وَلَمْ يَشْعُرْ أَنَّهُ عَبْدٌ فَجَاءَ سَيِّدُهُ يُرِيدُهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بِعْنِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَاشْتَرَاهُ بِعَبْدَيْنِ أَسْوَدَيْنِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يُبَايِعْ أَحَدًا بَعْدُ حَتَّى يَسْأَلَهُ ‏"‏ أَعَبْدٌ هُوَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, waabnu, rumhin qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathaniyhi qutaybaau, bnu sa'iydin haddathanaa laythun, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala jaa'a 'abdun fabaaya'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alhijraai walam yash'ur aannahu 'abdun fajaa'a sayyiduhu yuriyduhu faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ bi'niyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faashtaraahu bi'abdayni aaswadayni thumma lam yubaayi' aahadana ba'du hattaa yasaalahu ‏"‏ aa'abdun huwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported:There came a slave and pledg- ed allegiance to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) on migration; he (the Holy Prophet) did not know that he was a slave. Then there came his master and demanded him back, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Sell him to me. And he bought him for two black slaves, and he did not afterwards take allegiance from anyone until he had asked him whether he was a slave (or a free man)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، - عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتِ اشْتَرَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ يَهُودِيٍّ طَعَامًا بِنَسِيئَةٍ فَأَعْطَاهُ دِرْعًا لَهُ رَهْنًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wamuhammadu bnu al'alaa'i - waalllafzu liyahyaa qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, - 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalati ashtaraa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min yahuwdiyyin ta'aamana binasiyiaain faaa'taahu dir'ana lahu rahnana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bought some grain from a Jew on credit and gave him a coat-of- mail of his as a pledge
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ، يُونُسَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتِ اشْتَرَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ يَهُودِيٍّ طَعَامًا وَرَهَنَهُ دِرْعًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, wa'aliyyu bnu khashramin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu, yuwnusa 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalati ashtaraa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min yahuwdiyyin ta'aamana warahanahu dir'ana min hadiydin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bought from a Jew grain (as loan) and pledged him his iron coat-of-mail
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ، زِيَادٍ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، قَالَ ذَكَرْنَا الرَّهْنَ فِي السَّلَمِ عِنْدَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ النَّخَعِيِّ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَسْوَدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اشْتَرَى مِنْ يَهُودِيٍّ طَعَامًا إِلَى أَجَلٍ وَرَهَنَهُ دِرْعًا لَهُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa almakhzuwmiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu, ziyaadin 'ani alaa'mashi, qaala dhakarnaa alrrahna fiy alssalami 'inda iibraahiyma alnnakha'iyyi faqaala haddathanaa alaaswadu bnu yaziyda 'an 'aaiishaaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ashtaraa min yahuwdiyyin ta'aamana iilaa aajalin warahanahu dir'ana lahu min hadiydin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bought from a Jew grain for a specified time; and gave him iron coat-of-mail of his as a pledge
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الأَسْوَدُ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa hafsu bnu ghiyaathin, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, qaala haddathaniy alaaswadu, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu ‏.‏ walam yadhkur min hadiydin‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her), through another chain ol transmitters, but no mention was made of (its being made) of iron
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ يَحْيَى - أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْمِنْهَالِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ وَهُمْ يُسْلِفُونَ فِي الثِّمَارِ السَّنَةَ وَالسَّنَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَسْلَفَ فِي تَمْرٍ فَلْيُسْلِفْ فِي كَيْلٍ مَعْلُومٍ وَوَزْنٍ مَعْلُومٍ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مَعْلُومٍ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, - waalllafzu liyahyaa qaala 'amrunw haddathanaa waqaala yahyaa - aakhbaranaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa 'ani abni aabiy najiyhin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni kathiyrin 'an aabiy alminhaali 'ani abni 'abbaasin qaala qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa wahum yuslifuwna fiy althhimaari alssanaaa waalssanatayni faqaala ‏ "‏ man aaslafa fiy tamrin falyuslif fiy kaylin ma'luwmin wawaznin ma'luwmin iilaa aajalin ma'luwmin‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that when Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) came to Medina, they were paying one and two years in advance for fruits, so he said:Those who pay in advance for anything must do so for a specified weight and for a definite time
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْمِنْهَالِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسُ يُسْلِفُونَ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَسْلَفَ فَلاَ يُسْلِفْ إِلاَّ فِي كَيْلٍ مَعْلُومٍ وَوَزْنٍ مَعْلُومٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'ani abni aabiy najiyhin, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi, bnu kathiyrin 'an aabiy alminhaali, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalnnaasu yuslifuwna faqaala lahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man aaslafa falaa yuslif iilaaa fiy kaylin ma'luwmin wawaznin ma'luwmin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to (Medina) and the people were paying in advance (for the fruits, etc.), he said to them:He who makes an advance payment should not make advance payment except for a specified measure and weight (and for a specified period)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏ "‏ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مَعْلُومٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waiismaa'iylu bnu saalimin jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, 'ani abni aabiy najiyhin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithla hadiythi 'abdi alwaarithi ‏.‏ walam yadhkur ‏ "‏ iilaa aajalin ma'luwmin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abu Najih has narrated a hadith like this with the same chain of transmitters, but he has not mentioned:" for a definite period
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، بِإِسْنَادِهِمْ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ يَذْكُرُ فِيهِ ‏ "‏ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مَعْلُومٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, kilaahumaa 'an sufyaana, 'ani abni aabiy najiyhin, biiisnaadihim mithla hadiythi abni 'uyaynaaa yadhkuru fiyhi ‏ "‏ iilaa aajalin ma'luwmin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Abu Najih through another chain of transmitters mentioning in it" for a specified period
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ - قَالَ كَانَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ مَعْمَرًا، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنِ احْتَكَرَ فَهُوَ خَاطِئٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لِسَعِيدٍ فَإِنَّكَ تَحْتَكِرُ قَالَ سَعِيدٌ إِنَّ مَعْمَرًا الَّذِي كَانَ يُحَدِّثُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ كَانَ يَحْتَكِرُ ‏.‏
