verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - ya'niy abna bilaalin - 'an yahyaa, - wahuwa abnu sa'iydin - qaala kaana sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi yuhaddithu aanna ma'marana, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mani ahtakara fahuwa khaatiiun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqiyla lisa'iydin faiinnaka tahtakiru qaala sa'iydun iinna ma'marana alladhiy kaana yuhaddithu hadhaa alhadiytha kaana yahtakiru ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ma`mar (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who hoards is a sinner. It was said to Sa`id (b. al-Musayyib): You also hoard. Sa`id said: Ma`mar who narrated this hadith also hoarded
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَحْتَكِرُ إِلاَّ خَاطِئٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'amrinw alaash'athiyyu, haddathanaa haatimu bnu iismaa'iyla, 'an muhammadi bni 'ajlaana, 'an muhammadi bni 'amriw bni 'ataa'in, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an ma'mari bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yahtakiru iilaaa khaatiiun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ma'mar b. Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:No one hoards but the sinner
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ وَحَدَّثَنِي بَعْضُ، أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْنٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرِ، بْنِ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ أَحَدِ بَنِي عَدِيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala iibraahiymu qaala muslimun wahaddathaniy ba'du, aashaabinaa 'an 'amriw bni 'awnin, aakhbaranaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'amriw bni yahyaa, 'an muhammadi bni 'amrinw, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an ma'mari, bni aabiy ma'marin aahadi baniy 'adiyyi bni ka'bin qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithli hadiythi sulaymaana bni bilaalin 'an yahyaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Sulaiman b. Bilal from Yahya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَفْوَانَ الأُمَوِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، بْنُ يَحْيَى قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الْحَلِفُ مَنْفَقَةٌ لِلسِّلْعَةِ مَمْحَقَةٌ لِلرِّبْحِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa aabuw safwaana alaumawiyyu, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, bnu yahyaa qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, kilaahumaa 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'ani abni almusayyabi, aannasami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alhalifu manfaqaaun lilssil'aai mamhaqaaun lilrribhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) said he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Swearing produces a ready sale for a commodity, but blots out the blessing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِيَّاكُمْ وَكَثْرَةَ الْحَلِفِ فِي الْبَيْعِ فَإِنَّهُ يُنَفِّقُ ثُمَّ يَمْحَقُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma - waalllafzu laibni aabiy shaybaaa - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'ani alwaliydi bni kathiyrin, 'an ma'badi bni ka'bi bni maalikin, 'an aabiy qataadaaa alaansaariyyi, aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iiyyaakum wakathraaa alhalifi fiy albay'i faiinnahu yunaffiqu thumma yamhaqu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Qatada al-Ansari (Allah be pleased with him) reported he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say:Beware of swearing; it produces a ready sale for a commodity, but blots out the blessing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي رَبْعَةٍ أَوْ نَخْلٍ فَلَيْسَ لَهُ أَنْ يَبِيعَ حَتَّى يُؤْذِنَ شَرِيكَهُ فَإِنْ رَضِيَ أَخَذَ وَإِنْ كَرِهَ تَرَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man kaana lahu shariykun fiy rab'aain aaw nakhlin falaysa lahu aan yabiy'a hattaa yuudhina shariykahu faiin radiya aakhadha waiin kariha taraka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who has a partner in a dwelling or a garden, it is not lawful for him to sell that until he is permitted by his partner. If he (the partner) agrees, he should go in for that, and if he disapproves of that, he should abandon (the idea of selling it)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ نُمَيْرٍ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالشُّفْعَةِ فِي كُلِّ شِرْكَةٍ لَمْ تُقْسَمْ رَبْعَةٍ أَوْ حَائِطٍ ‏.‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لَهُ أَنْ يَبِيعَ حَتَّى يُؤْذِنَ شَرِيكَهُ فَإِنْ شَاءَ أَخَذَ وَإِنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَ فَإِذَا بَاعَ وَلَمْ يُؤْذِنْهُ فَهْوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu laibni numayrin - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala qadaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialshhuf'aai fiy kulli shirkaain lam tuqsam rab'aain aaw haaiitin ‏.‏ laa yahillu lahu aan yabiy'a hattaa yuudhina shariykahu faiin shaa'a aakhadha waiin shaa'a taraka faiidhaa baa'a walam yuudhinhu fahwa aahaqqu bihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir bin 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) decreed pre-emption in every joint ownership and not divided-the one-it may be a dwelling or a garden. It is not lawful for him (for the partner) to sell that until his partner gives his consent. He (the partner) is entitled to buy it when he desires and he can abandon it if he so likes. And if he (the one partner) sells it without getting the consent of the (other partner), he has the greatest right to it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا الزُّبَيْرِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الشُّفْعَةُ فِي كُلِّ شِرْكٍ فِي أَرْضٍ أَوْ رَبْعٍ أَوْ حَائِطٍ لاَ يَصْلُحُ أَنْ يَبِيعَ حَتَّى يَعْرِضَ عَلَى شَرِيكِهِ فَيَأْخُذَ أَوْ يَدَعَ فَإِنْ أَبَى فَشَرِيكُهُ أَحَقُّ بِهِ حَتَّى يُؤْذِنَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'ani abni jurayjin, aanna aabaa alzzubayri, aakhbarahu aannahu, sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alshhuf'aau fiy kulli shirkin fiy aardin aaw rab'in aaw haaiitin laa yasluhu aan yabiy'a hattaa ya'rida 'alaa shariykihi fayaakhudha aaw yada'a faiin aabaa fashariykuhu aahaqqu bihi hattaa yuudhinahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is pre-emption in everything which is shared, be it land, or a dwelling or a garden. It is not proper to sell it until he informs his partner; he may go in for that, or he may abandon it; and it he (the partner intending to sell his share) does not do that, then his partner has the greatest right to it until he permits him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَمْنَعْ أَحَدُكُمْ جَارَهُ أَنْ يَغْرِزَ خَشَبَةً فِي جِدَارِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ مَا لِي أَرَاكُمْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ وَاللَّهِ لأَرْمِيَنَّ بِهَا بَيْنَ أَكْتَافِكُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yamna' aahadukum jaarahu aan yaghriza khashabaaan fiy jidaarihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma yaquwlu aabuw hurayraaa maa liy aaraakum 'anhaa mu'ridiyna waalllahi laarmiyanna bihaa bayna aaktaafikum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:None among you should prevent his neighbour from fixing a beam in his wall. Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) then said: What is this that I see you evading (this injunction of the Holy Prophet)? By Allah, I will certainly throw it between your shoulders (narrate this to you)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، بْنُ يَحْيَى قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ، الرَّزَّاقِ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, bnu yahyaa qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu, alrrazzaaqi aakhbaranaa ma'marun, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transrmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ اقْتَطَعَ شِبْرًا مِنَ الأَرْضِ ظُلْمًا طَوَّقَهُ اللَّهُ إِيَّاهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ سَبْعِ أَرَضِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'ani al'alaa'i bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'abbaasi bni sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi, 'an sa'iydi bni zaydi bni 'amriw bni nufaylin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mani aqtata'a shibrana mina alaardi zulmana tawwaqahu alllahu iiyyaahu yawma alqiyaamaai min sab'i aaradiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Zaid b. 'Amr b. Nufail (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who wrongly took a span of land, Allah shall make him carry around his neck seven earths
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَنَّحَدَّثَهُ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ، أَنَّ أَرْوَى، خَاصَمَتْهُ فِي بَعْضِ دَارِهِ فَقَالَ دَعُوهَا وَإِيَّاهَا فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَخَذَ شِبْرًا مِنَ الأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ حَقِّهِ طُوِّقَهُ فِي سَبْعِ أَرَضِينَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَتْ كَاذِبَةً فَأَعْمِ بَصَرَهَا وَاجْعَلْ قَبْرَهَا فِي دَارِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَأَيْتُهَا عَمْيَاءَ تَلْتَمِسُ الْجُدُرَ تَقُولُ أَصَابَتْنِي دَعْوَةُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ‏.‏ فَبَيْنَمَا هِيَ تَمْشِي فِي الدَّارِ مَرَّتْ عَلَى بِئْرٍ فِي الدَّارِ فَوَقَعَتْ فِيهَا فَكَانَتْ قَبْرَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, haddathaniy 'umaru bnu muhammadin, aannahaddathahu 'an sa'iydi bni zaydi bni 'amriw bni nufaylin, aanna aarwaa, khaasamathu fiy ba'di daarihi faqaala da'uwhaa waiiyyaahaa faiinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man aakhadha shibrana mina alaardi bighayri haqqihi tuwwiqahu fiy sab'i aaradiyna yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ alllahumma iin kaanat kaadhibaaan faaa'mi basarahaa waaj'al qabrahaa fiy daarihaa ‏.‏ qaala faraaaytuhaa 'amyaa'a taltamisu aljudura taquwlu aasaabatniy da'waau sa'iydi bni zaydin ‏.‏ fabaynamaa hiya tamshiy fiy alddaari marrat 'alaa biirin fiy alddaari fawaqa'at fiyhaa fakaanat qabrahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Zaid b. 'Amr b. Nufail (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Arwi (bint Uwais) disputed with him (in regard to a part of the land) of his hodse. He said:Leave it and take off your claim from it, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who took a span of land without his right would be made to wear around his neck seven earths on the Day of Resurrection. He (Sa'id b. Zaid) said: O Allah, make her blind if she has told a lie and make her grave in her house. He (the narrator) said: I saw her blind groping (her way) by touching the walls and saying: The curse of Sa'id b. Zaid has hit me. And it so happened that as she was walking in her house, she passed by a well in her house and fell therein and that be- came her grave
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ أَرْوَى بِنْتَ أُوَيْسٍ، ادَّعَتْ عَلَى سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ أَنَّهُ أَخَذَ شَيْئًا مِنْ أَرْضِهَا فَخَاصَمَتْهُ إِلَى مَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ أَنَا كُنْتُ آخُذُ مِنْ أَرْضِهَا شَيْئًا بَعْدَ الَّذِي سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَمَا سَمِعْتَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَخَذَ شِبْرًا مِنَ الأَرْضِ ظُلْمًا طُوِّقَهُ إِلَى سَبْعِ أَرَضِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَرْوَانُ لاَ أَسْأَلُكَ بَيِّنَةً بَعْدَ هَذَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَتْ كَاذِبَةً فَعَمِّ بَصَرَهَا وَاقْتُلْهَا فِي أَرْضِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا مَاتَتْ حَتَّى ذَهَبَ بَصَرُهَا ثُمَّ بَيْنَا هِيَ تَمْشِي فِي أَرْضِهَا إِذْ وَقَعَتْ فِي حُفْرَةٍ فَمَاتَتْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, aanna aarwaa binta auwaysin, adda'at 'alaa sa'iydi bni zaydin aannahu aakhadha shayiana min aardihaa fakhaasamathu iilaa marwaana bni alhakami ‏.‏ faqaala sa'iydun aanaa kuntu akhudhu min aardihaa shayiana ba'da alladhiy sami'tu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala wamaa sami'ta min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man aakhadha shibrana mina alaardi zulmana tuwwiqahu iilaa sab'i aaradiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala lahu marwaanu laa aasaaluka bayyinaaan ba'da hadhaa ‏.‏ faqaala alllahumma iin kaanat kaadhibaaan fa'ammi basarahaa waaqtulhaa fiy aardihaa ‏.‏ qaala famaa maatat hattaa dhahaba basaruhaa thumma baynaa hiya tamshiy fiy aardihaa iidh waqa'at fiy hufraain famaatat ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hisham b. Urwa reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him) that Arwa bint Uwais disputed with Sa'id b. Zaid that he had seized some of the land belonging to her. She brought this dispute before Marwan b. al-Hakam. Sa'id said:How could I take a part of her land, after what I heard from Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon'him)? He (Marwan) said: What did you hear from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: He who wrongly took a span of land would be made to wear around his neck seven earths. Marwan said: I do not ask any evidence from you after this. He (Sa'id) said: O Allah, make her blind if she has told a lie and kill her in her own land. He (the narrator) said: She did not die until she had lost her eyesight, and (one day) as she was walking in her land, she fell down into a pit and died
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَخَذَ شِبْرًا مِنَ الأَرْضِ ظُلْمًا فَإِنَّهُ يُطَوَّقُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ سَبْعِ أَرَضِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu zakariyyaa'a bni aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sa'iydi bni zaydin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man aakhadha shibrana mina alaardi zulmana faiinnahu yutawwaquhu yawma alqiyaamaai min sab'i aaradiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Zaid reported:I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) say: He who took a span of earth wrongly would be made to wear around his neck seven earths on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَأْخُذُ أَحَدٌ شِبْرًا مِنَ الأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ حَقِّهِ إِلاَّ طَوَّقَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَى سَبْعِ أَرَضِينَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yaakhudhu aahadun shibrana mina alaardi bighayri haqqihi iilaaa tawwaqahu alllahu iilaa sab'i aaradiyna yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) as saying:One should not take a span of land without having legitimate right to it, otherwise Allah would make him wear (around his neck) seven earths on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ شَدَّادٍ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ، إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ وَكَانَ، بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِهِ خُصُومَةٌ فِي أَرْضٍ وَأَنَّهُ دَخَلَ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهَا فَقَالَتْ يَا أَبَا سَلَمَةَ اجْتَنِبِ الأَرْضَ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ ظَلَمَ قِيدَ شِبْرٍ مِنَ الأَرْضِ طُوِّقَهُ مِنْ سَبْعِ أَرَضِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu iibraahiyma alddawraqiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alwaarithi - haddathanaa harbun, - wahuwa abnu shaddaadin - haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa abnu aabiy kathiyrin - 'an muhammadi bni, iibraahiyma aanna aabaa salamaaa, haddathahu wakaana, baynahu wabayna qawmihi khusuwmaaun fiy aardin waaannahu dakhala 'alaa 'aaiishaaa fadhakara dhalika lahaa faqaalat yaa aabaa salamaaa ajtanibi alaarda faiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man zalama qiyda shibrin mina alaardi tuwwiqahu min sab'i aaradiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. Ibrahim said that Abu Salama reported to him that there was between him and his people dispute over a piece of land, and he came to 'A'isha and mentioned that to her, whereupon she said:Abu Salama, abstain from getting this land, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who usurps even a span of land would be made to wear around his neck seven earths
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَبَّانُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبَانٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، دَخَلَ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa habbaanu bnu hilaalin, aakhbaranaa aabaanun, haddathanaa yahyaa, aanna muhammada bna iibraahiyma, haddathahu aanna aabaa salamaaa haddathahu aannahu, dakhala 'alaa 'aaiishaaa fadhakara mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Salama with another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِي الطَّرِيقِ جُعِلَ عَرْضُهُ سَبْعَ أَذْرُعٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw kaamilin, fudaylu bnu husaynin aljahdariyyu haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu almukhtaari, haddathanaa khaalidun alhadhhaa'u, 'an yuwsufa bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa akhtalaftum fiy alttariyqi ju'ila 'arduhu sab'a aadhru'in ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Haraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:When you disagree about a path, its breadth should be made seven cubits
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ، حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَرِثُ الْمُسْلِمُ الْكَافِرَ وَلاَ يَرِثُ الْكَافِرُ الْمُسْلِمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'aliyyi bni, husaynin 'an 'amriw bni 'uthmaana, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yarithu almuslimu alkaafira walaa yarithu alkaafiru almuslima ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usama b. Zaid reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A Muslim is not entitled to inherit from a non-Muslim, and a non-Muslim is not entitled to inherit from a Muslim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، - وَهُوَ النَّرْسِيُّ - حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَلْحِقُوا الْفَرَائِضَ بِأَهْلِهَا فَمَا بَقِيَ فَهُوَ لأَوْلَى رَجُلٍ ذَكَرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa bnu hammaadin, - wahuwa alnnarsiyyu - haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'ani abni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aalhiquwa alfaraaiida biaahlihaa famaa baqiya fahuwa laawlaa rajulin dhakarin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Give the shares to those who are entitled to them, and what remains over goes to the nearest male heir
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامَ الْعَيْشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلْحِقُوا الْفَرَائِضَ بِأَهْلِهَا فَمَا تَرَكَتِ الْفَرَائِضُ فَلأَوْلَى رَجُلٍ ذَكَرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aumayyaau bnu bistaama al'ayshiyyu, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa rawhu bnu alqaasimi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aalhiquwa alfaraaiida biaahlihaa famaa tarakati alfaraaiidu falaawlaa rajulin dhakarin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Give the shares to those who are entitled to them, and what is left from those wno are entitled to it goes to the nearest male heir
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ رَافِعٍ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اقْسِمُوا الْمَالَ بَيْنَ أَهْلِ الْفَرَائِضِ عَلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَمَا تَرَكَتِ الْفَرَائِضُ فَلأَوْلَى رَجُلٍ ذَكَرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, - waalllafzu laibni raafi'in - qaala iishaaqu haddathanaa waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani abni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aqsimuwa almaala bayna aahli alfaraaiidi 'alaa kitaabi alllahi famaa tarakati alfaraaiidu falaawlaa rajulin dhakarin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Tawus reported on the authority of Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) narrating that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Distribute the property amongst Ahl al-Fara'id, according to the Book of Allah, and what is left out of them goes to the nearest male heir
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ حُبَابٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ وُهَيْبٍ وَرَوْحِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i aabuw kuraybin alhamdaaniyyu, haddathanaa zaydu bnu hubaabin, 'an yahyaa, bni aayyuwba 'ani abni taawusin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi wuhaybin warawhi bni alqaasimi ‏.‏
verses.translation: There is another chain of Tawus reporting like the reports that were mentioned before the previous hadith chain through Tawus (the chains of Wuhaib and Rowh bin Qasim)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ، الْمُنْكَدِرِ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ مَرِضْتُ فَأَتَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ يَعُودَانِي مَاشِيَيْنِ فَأُغْمِيَ عَلَىَّ فَتَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ صَبَّ عَلَىَّ مِنْ وَضُوئِهِ فَأَفَقْتُ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ أَقْضِي فِي مَالِي فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَىَّ شَيْئًا حَتَّى نَزَلَتْ آيَةُ الْمِيرَاثِ ‏{‏ يَسْتَفْتُونَكَ قُلِ اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِي الْكَلاَلَةِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu muhammadi bni bukayrin alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an muhammadi bni, almunkadiri sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, qaala maridtu faaataaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin ya'uwdaaniy maashiyayni faaughmiya 'alaaaa fatawaddaaa thumma sabba 'alaaaa min waduwiihi faaafaqtu qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa aaqdiy fiy maaliy falam yarudda 'alaaaa shayiana hattaa nazalat ayaau almiyraathi ‏{‏ yastaftuwnaka quli alllahu yuftiykum fiy alkalaalaai‏}‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported:I fell sick and there came to me on foot Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr for inquiring after my health. I fainted. He (the Holy Prophet) performed ablution and then sprinkled over me the water of his ablution. I felt some relief and said: Allah's Messenger, how should I decide about my property? He said nothing to me in response until this verse pertaining to the law of inheritance was revealed:" They ask you for a decision; say: Allah gives you a decision concerning the person who has neither parents nor children" (iv)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ عَادَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي بَنِي سَلَمَةَ يَمْشِيَانِ فَوَجَدَنِي لاَ أَعْقِلُ فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ رَشَّ عَلَىَّ مِنْهُ فَأَفَقْتُ فَقُلْتُ كَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ فِي مَالِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏يُوصِيكُمُ اللَّهُ فِي أَوْلاَدِكُمْ لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ الأُنْثَيَيْنِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimi bni maymuwnin, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu almunkadiri, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala 'aadaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin fiy baniy salamaaa yamshiyaani fawajadaniy laa aa'qilu fada'aa bimaa'in fatawaddaaa thumma rashha 'alaaaa minhu faaafaqtu faqultu kayfa aasna'u fiy maaliy yaa rasuwla alllahi fanazalat ‏{‏yuwsiykumu alllahu fiy aawlaadikum lildhhakari mithlu hazzi alaunthayayni‏}‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported:Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and Abi Bakr (Allah be pleased with him) visited me on foot in Banu Salama, and found me unconscious. He (the Holy Prophet) called for water and performed ablution and sprinkled out of it (the water) over me. I felt relieved. I said: Allah's Messenger, what should I do with my property? And this verse was revealed:" Allah enjoins you concerning your children: for the male is equal of the portion of two females
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ عَادَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا مَرِيضٌ وَمَعَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مَاشِيَيْنِ فَوَجَدَنِي قَدْ أُغْمِيَ عَلَىَّ فَتَوَضَّأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ صَبَّ عَلَىَّ مِنْ وَضُوئِهِ فَأَفَقْتُ فَإِذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ فِي مَالِي فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَىَّ شَيْئًا حَتَّى نَزَلَتْ آيَةُ الْمِيرَاثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, - ya'niy abna mahdiyyin - haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala sami'tu muhammada bna almunkadiri, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu 'aadaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa mariydun wama'ahu aabuw bakrin maashiyayni fawajadaniy qad aughmiya 'alaaaa fatawaddaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma sabba 'alaaaa min waduwiihi faaafaqtu faiidhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa aasna'u fiy maaliy falam yarudda 'alaaaa shayiana hattaa nazalat ayaau almiyraathi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported:While I had been ill Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited me and Abu akr (Allah be pleased with him) was with him, and they both came walking on foot. He (the Holy Prophet) found me unconscious. Allahs Messenger (ﷺ) performed ablution and then sprinkled over me the water of his ablution. I felt relieved regained my consciousness) and found Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) there. I said: Allah's Messenger, what should I do with my property? He gave me no reply until the verse (iv. 177) relating to the law of inheritance was revealed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا مَرِيضٌ لاَ أَعْقِلُ فَتَوَضَّأَ فَصَبُّوا عَلَىَّ مِنْ وَضُوئِهِ فَعَقَلْتُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا يَرِثُنِي كَلاَلَةٌ ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ آيَةُ الْمِيرَاثِ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لِمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ ‏{‏ يَسْتَفْتُونَكَ قُلِ اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِي الْكَلاَلَةِ‏}‏ قَالَ هَكَذَا أُنْزِلَتْ
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa shu'baau, aakhbaraniy muhammadu bnu almunkadiri, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu dakhala 'alaaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa mariydun laa aa'qilu fatawaddaaa fasabbuwa 'alaaaa min waduwiihi fa'aqaltu faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnamaa yarithuniy kalaalaaun ‏.‏ fanazalat ayaau almiyraathi ‏.‏ faqultu limuhammadi bni almunkadiri ‏{‏ yastaftuwnaka quli alllahu yuftiykum fiy alkalaalaai‏}‏ qaala hakadhaa aunzilat
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported:Whilo I was ill Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me and found me unconscious. He (the Holy Prophet) performed ablution, and sprinkled over me the water of his ablution. I regained my consciousness and said: Allah's Messenger, my case of inheritance is that of Kalala. Then the verse pertaining to the inheritance ( of Kalala) was revealed. I (one of the narrators) said: I said to Muhammad b. Munkadir: (Do you mean this verse)" They ask you; say: Allah gives you decision in regard to Kalala" (iv. 177)? He said: Yes, it was thus revealed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، وَأَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ فِي حَدِيثِ وَهْبِ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ فَنَزَلَتْ آيَةُ الْفَرَائِضِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ النَّضْرِ وَالْعَقَدِيِّ فَنَزَلَتْ آيَةُ الْفَرْضِ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي رِوَايَةِ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ قَوْلُ شُعْبَةَ لاِبْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa alnnadru bnu shumaylin, waaabuw 'aamirin al'aqadiyyu h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, kulluhum 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ fiy hadiythi wahbi bni jariyrin fanazalat ayaau alfaraaiidi ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi alnnadri waal'aqadiyyi fanazalat ayaau alfardi ‏.‏ walaysa fiy riwaayaai aahadin minhum qawlu shu'baaa laibni almunkadiri ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba but with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ، أَبِي طَلْحَةَ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، خَطَبَ يَوْمَ جُمُعَةٍ فَذَكَرَ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَذَكَرَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنِّي لاَ أَدَعُ بَعْدِي شَيْئًا أَهَمَّ عِنْدِي مِنَ الْكَلاَلَةِ مَا رَاجَعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي شَىْءٍ مَا رَاجَعْتُهُ فِي الْكَلاَلَةِ وَمَا أَغْلَظَ لِي فِي شَىْءٍ مَا أَغْلَظَ لِي فِيهِ حَتَّى طَعَنَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ فِي صَدْرِي وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا عُمَرُ أَلاَ تَكْفِيكَ آيَةُ الصَّيْفِ الَّتِي فِي آخِرِ سُورَةِ النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِنِّي إِنْ أَعِشْ أَقْضِ فِيهَا بِقَضِيَّةٍ يَقْضِي بِهَا مَنْ يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَمَنْ لاَ يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hishaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an ma'daana bni, aabiy talhaaa aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi, khataba yawma jumu'aain fadhakara nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wadhakara aabaa bakrin thumma qaala iinniy laa aada'u ba'diy shayiana aahamma 'indiy mina alkalaalaai maa raaja'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy shaa'in maa raaja'tuhu fiy alkalaalaai wamaa aaghlaza liy fiy shaa'in maa aaghlaza liy fiyhi hattaa ta'ana biiisba'ihi fiy sadriy waqaala ‏ "‏ yaa 'umaru aalaa takfiyka ayaau alssayfi allatiy fiy akhiri suwraai alnnisaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waiinniy iin aa'ish aaqdi fiyhaa biqadiyyaain yaqdiy bihaa man yaqraau alqurana waman laa yaqraau alqurana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Talha reported:'Umar b. al-Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) delivered a sermon on Friday and made a mention of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he also made a mention of Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with him) and then said: I do not leave behind me any problem more difficult than that of Kalala. I did not refer to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) more repeatedly than in case of the problem of Kalala, and he (the Holy Prophet) never showed more annoyance to me than in regard to this problem, so much so that he struck my chest with his fingers and said: 'Umar, does the verse revealed in summer season, at the end of Sura al-Nisa' not suffice you? Hadrat 'Umar (then) said: If I live I would give such verdict about (Kalala) that everyone would be able to decide whether he reads the Qur'an or he does not
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ، رَافِعٍ عَنْ شَبَابَةَ بْنِ سَوَّارٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy 'aruwbaaa, h wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu, raafi'in 'an shabaabaaa bni sawwaarin, 'an shu'baaa, kilaahumaa 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ آخِرُ آيَةٍ أُنْزِلَتْ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏{‏ يَسْتَفْتُونَكَ قُلِ اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِي الْكَلاَلَةِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, 'ani abni aabiy khaalidin, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i, qaala akhiru ayaain aunzilat mina alqurani ‏{‏ yastaftuwnaka quli alllahu yuftiykum fiy alkalaalaai‏}‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the last verse revealed in the Holy Qur'an is:" They ask thee for a religious verdict; say: Allah gives you a religious verdict about Kalala (the person who has neither parents nor children)" (iv)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ، يَقُولُ آخِرُ آيَةٍ أُنْزِلَتْ آيَةُ الْكَلاَلَةِ وَآخِرُ سُورَةٍ أُنْزِلَتْ بَرَاءَةُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a bna 'aazibin, yaquwlu akhiru ayaain aunzilat ayaau alkalaalaai waakhiru suwraain aunzilat baraa'aau ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Ishaq said that he heard al-Bara' b. 'Azib (Allah be pleased with him say:The last verse revealed (in the Holy Quran) is that pertaining to Kalala, and the last sura revealed is Sura al-Bara'at
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ يُونُسَ - حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، أَنَّ آخِرَ، سُورَةٍ أُنْزِلَتْ تَامَّةً سُورَةُ التَّوْبَةِ وَأَنَّ آخِرَ آيَةٍ أُنْزِلَتْ آيَةُ الْكَلاَلَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, - wahuwa abnu yuwnusa - haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i, aanna akhira, suwraain aunzilat taammaaan suwraau alttawbaai waaanna akhira ayaain aunzilat ayaau alkalaalaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Ishaq said that he heard al-Bara' b. 'Azib (Allah be pleased with him) say:The last complete sura revealed (in the Holy Qur'an) is Sura Tauba (i e. al-Bara'at, ix.), and the last verse revealed is that pertaining to Kalala
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ آدَمَ - حَدَّثَنَا عَمَّارٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ رُزَيْقٍ - عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ آخِرُ سُورَةٍ أُنْزِلَتْ كَامِلَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa yahyaa, - ya'niy abna adama - haddathanaa 'ammaarun, - wahuwa abnu ruzayqin - 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i, bimithlihi ghayra aannahu qaala akhiru suwraain aunzilat kaamilaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Aba Ishaq reported this hadith on the authority of al-Bara' (Allah be pleased with him) with a slight variation of words, viz. the last sura that was revealed complete
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ الزُّبَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، السَّفَرِ عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ آخِرُ آيَةٍ أُنْزِلَتْ يَسْتَفْتُونَكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa aabuw aahmada alzzubayriyyu, haddathanaa maaliku bnu mighwalin, 'an aabiy, alssafari 'ani albaraa'i, qaala akhiru ayaain aunzilat yastaftuwnaka ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the last verse revealed was:" They ask of thee religious verdict.." (iv)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَفْوَانَ الأُمَوِيُّ، عَنْ يُونُسَ الأَيْلِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُؤْتَى بِالرَّجُلِ الْمَيِّتِ عَلَيْهِ الدَّيْنُ فَيَسْأَلُ ‏"‏ هَلْ تَرَكَ لِدَيْنِهِ مِنْ قَضَاءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَإِنْ حُدِّثَ أَنَّهُ تَرَكَ وَفَاءً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَإِلاَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ صَلُّوا عَلَى صَاحِبِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْفُتُوحَ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنَا أَوْلَى بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ فَمَنْ تُوُفِّيَ وَعَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ فَعَلَىَّ قَضَاؤُهُ وَمَنْ تَرَكَ مَالاً فَهُوَ لِوَرَثَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa aabuw safwaana alaumawiyyu, 'an yuwnusa alaayliyyi, h wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni, shihaabin 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yuutaa bialrrajuli almayyiti 'alayhi alddaynu fayasaalu ‏"‏ hal taraka lidaynihi min qadaa'in ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faiin hudditha aannahu taraka wafaa'an sallaa 'alayhi waiilaaa qaala ‏"‏ salluwa 'alaa saahibikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falammaa fataha alllahu 'alayhi alfutuwha qaala ‏"‏ aanaa aawlaa bialmuuminiyna min aanfusihim faman tuwuffiya wa'alayhi daynun fa'alaaaa qadaauuhu waman taraka maalaan fahuwa liwarathatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that when the body of a dead person having burden of debt upon him was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he would ask whether he had left property enough to clear off his debt, and if the property left had been sufficient for that (purpose), he observed funeral prayer for him, otherwise he said (to his companions):You observe prayer for your companion. But when Allah opened the gateways of victory for him, he said: I am nearer to the believers than themselves, so if anyone dies leaving a debt, its payment is my responsibility, and if anyone leaves a property, it goes to his heirs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَخِي ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylun, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa abnu aakhiy abni shihaabin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi hadhaa alhadiytha ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of al-Zuhri through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ إِنْ عَلَى الأَرْضِ مِنْ مُؤْمِنٍ إِلاَّ أَنَا أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِهِ فَأَيُّكُمْ مَا تَرَكَ دَيْنًا أَوْ ضَيَاعًا فَأَنَا مَوْلاَهُ وَأَيُّكُمْ تَرَكَ مَالاً فَإِلَى الْعَصَبَةِ مَنْ كَانَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa shabaabaau, qaala haddathaniy warqaa'u, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ waalladhiy nafsu muhammadin biyadihi iin 'alaa alaardi min muuminin iilaaa aanaa aawlaa alnnaasi bihi faaayyukum maa taraka daynana aaw dayaa'ana faaanaa mawlaahu waaayyukum taraka maalaan faiilaa al'asabaai man kaana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abn Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having said this:By Him in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, there is no believer on the earth with whom I am not the nearest among all the people. He who amongst you (dies) and leaves a debt, I am there to pay it, and he who amongst you (dies) leaving behind children I am there to look after them. And he who amongst You leaves behind property, that is for the inheritor whoever he is
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَنَا أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فَأَيُّكُمْ مَا تَرَكَ دَيْنًا أَوْ ضَيْعَةً فَادْعُونِي فَأَنَا وَلِيُّهُ وَأَيُّكُمْ مَا تَرَكَ مَالاً فَلْيُؤْثَرْ بِمَالِهِ عَصَبَتُهُ مَنْ كَانَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aanaa aawlaa alnnaasi bialmuuminiyna fiy kitaabi alllahi 'azza wajalla faaayyukum maa taraka daynana aaw day'aaan faad'uwniy faaanaa waliyyuhu waaayyukum maa taraka maalaan falyuuthar bimaalihi 'asabatuhu man kaana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam b. Munabbih reported:This is what Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us from Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him). And he narrated many ahadith, and one was this: Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him said: I am, according to the Book of Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, nearest to the believers of all the human beings. So whoever amongst you dies in debt or leaves behind destitute children, you should call me (for help) ), for I am his guardian. And who amongst you leaves property, his inheritor is entitled to get it, whoever he is
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ تَرَكَ مَالاً فَلِلْوَرَثَةِ وَمَنْ تَرَكَ كَلاًّ فَإِلَيْنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'adiyyin, aannahu sami'a aabaa haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ man taraka maalaan falilwarathaai waman taraka kalaaan faiilaynaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:He who leaves property, that is for the inheritors; and he who leaves behind destitute children, then it is my responsibility (to look after them)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 23 — The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، الرَّحْمَنِ - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِ غُنْدَرٍ ‏ "‏ وَمَنْ تَرَكَ كَلاًّ وَلِيتُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw bakri bnu naafi'in, haddathanaa ghundarun, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu, alrrahmani - ya'niy abna mahdiyyin - qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ ghayra aanna fiy, hadiythi ghundarin ‏ "‏ waman taraka kalaaan waliytuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ حَمَلْتُ عَلَى فَرَسٍ عَتِيقٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَأَضَاعَهُ صَاحِبُهُ فَظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ بَائِعُهُ بِرُخْصٍ فَسَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَبْتَعْهُ وَلاَ تَعُدْ فِي صَدَقَتِكَ فَإِنَّ الْعَائِدَ فِي صَدَقَتِهِ كَالْكَلْبِ يَعُودُ فِي قَيْئِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa maaliku bnu aanasin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an aabiyhi, aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi, qaala hamaltu 'alaa farasin 'atiyqin fiy sabiyli alllahi faaadaa'ahu saahibuhu fazanantu aannahu baaii'uhu birukhsin fasaaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an dhalika faqaala ‏ "‏ laa tabta'hu walaa ta'ud fiy sadaqatika faiinna al'aaiida fiy sadaqatihi kaalkalbi ya'uwdu fiy qayiihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) reported:I donated a pedigree horse in the path of Allah. Its possessor made it languish. I thought that he would sell it at a cheap price. I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it, whereupon he said: Don't buy it and do not get back your charity, for one who gets back the charity is like a dog who swallows its vomit
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ - عَنْ مَالِكِ، بْنِ أَنَسٍ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَبْتَعْهُ وَإِنْ أَعْطَاكَهُ بِدِرْهَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, - ya'niy abna mahdiyyin - 'an maaliki, bni aanasin bihadhaa aliisnaadi wazaada ‏ "‏ laa tabta'hu waiin aa'taakahu bidirhamin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Malik b. Anas with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition:" Don't buy that even if he gives you for one dirham
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ - عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ حَمَلَ عَلَى فَرَسٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَوَجَدَهُ عِنْدَ صَاحِبِهِ وَقَدْ أَضَاعَهُ وَكَانَ قَلِيلَ الْمَالِ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَشْتَرِيَهُ فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَشْتَرِهِ وَإِنْ أُعْطِيتَهُ بِدِرْهَمٍ فَإِنَّ مَثَلَ الْعَائِدِ فِي صَدَقَتِهِ كَمَثَلِ الْكَلْبِ يَعُودُ فِي قَيْئِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aumayyaau bnu bistaama, haddathanaa yaziydu, - ya'niy abna zuray'in - haddathanaa rawhun, - wahuwa abnu alqaasimi - 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'umara, aannahu hamala 'alaa farasin fiy sabiyli alllahi fawajadahu 'inda saahibihi waqad aadaa'ahu wakaana qaliyla almaali faaaraada aan yashtariyahu faaataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara dhalika lahu faqaala ‏ "‏ laa tashtarihi waiin au'tiytahu bidirhamin faiinna mathala al'aaiidi fiy sadaqatihi kamathali alkalbi ya'uwdu fiy qayiihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Aslam reported on the authority of his father that 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) donated a horse in the path of Allah. He found that it had languished in the hand of its possessor, and he was a man of meagre resources He (Hadrat 'Umar) intended to buy it. He came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said:Don't buy that even if you get it for a dirham for he who gets back the charity is like a dog which swallows its vomit
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ مَالِكٍ وَرَوْحٍ أَتَمُّ وَأَكْثَرُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aanna maalikin warawhin aatammu waaaktharu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters but with this (change) that the hadith transmitted on the authority of Malik and Rauh (he was the son of Qisirn) is more complete and lengthy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ حَمَلَ عَلَى فَرَسٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَوَجَدَهُ يُبَاعُ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَبْتَاعَهُ فَسَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَبْتَعْهُ وَلاَ تَعُدْ فِي صَدَقَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna 'umara, bna alkhattaabi hamala 'alaa farasin fiy sabiyli alllahi fawajadahu yubaa'u faaaraada aan yabtaa'ahu fasaaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an dhalika faqaala ‏ "‏ laa tabta'hu walaa ta'ud fiy sadaqatika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that 'Umar b. al-Khattib (Allah be pleased with him) donated a horse in the path of Allah and (later on) he found it being sold, and he decided to buy that. He asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about it. whereupon he (the Holy prophet) said:Don't buy that and do not get back what you gave in charity
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ، رُمْحٍ جَمِيعًا عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waabnu, rumhin jamiy'ana 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, h wahaddathanaa almuqaddamiyyu, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, wahuwa alqattaanu h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, kulluhum 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, kilaahumaa 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni, 'umara 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi maalikin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَبْدٍ - قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، حَمَلَ عَلَى فَرَسٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ رَآهَا تُبَاعُ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَشْتَرِيَهَا فَسَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَعُدْ فِي صَدَقَتِكَ يَا عُمَرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, - waalllafzu li'abdin - qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna 'umara, hamala 'alaa farasin fiy sabiyli alllahi thumma raahaa tubaa'u faaaraada aan yashtariyahaa fasaaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa ta'ud fiy sadaqatika yaa 'umaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim reported from Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) that 'Umar donated a horse in the path of Allah and then found it being sold, and he decided to buy that. He asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about it, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Umar, do not get back what you gave as charity
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى الرَّازِيُّ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، بْنُ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَرْجِعُ فِي صَدَقَتِهِ كَمَثَلِ الْكَلْبِ يَقِيءُ ثُمَّ يَعُودُ فِي قَيْئِهِ فَيَأْكُلُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa alrraaziyyu, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, bnu yuwnusa haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, 'an aabiy ja'farin, muhammadi bni 'aliyyin 'ani abni almusayyabi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mathalu alladhiy yarji'u fiy sadaqatihi kamathali alkalbi yaqiy'u thumma ya'uwdu fiy qayiihi fayaakuluhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having said this:He who gets back his charity is like a dog which vomits, and then returns to that and eats it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ، يَذْكُرُ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i aakhbaranaa abnu almubaaraki, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, qaala sami'tu muhammada bna 'aliyyi bni alhusayni, yadhkuru bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is also reported through another chain
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ - حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ ابْنَ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدَّثَهُ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ، نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa harbun, haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa abnu aabiy kathiyrin - haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'amrinw, aanna muhammada abna faatimaaa binti rasuwli alllahi, sla allh 'lyh wslm haddathahu bihadhaa aliisnaadi, nahwa hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this is reported on the authority of Muhammad son of Fatima (Allah be pleased with her) daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ - عَنْ بُكَيْرٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَتَصَدَّقُ بِصَدَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يَعُودُ فِي صَدَقَتِهِ كَمَثَلِ الْكَلْبِ يَقِيءُ ثُمَّ يَأْكُلُ قَيْأَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, - wahuwa abnu alhaarithi - 'an bukayrin, aannahu sami'a sa'iyda bna almusayyabi, yaquwlu sami'tu abna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinnamaa mathalu alladhiy yatasaddaqu bisadaqaain thumma ya'uwdu fiy sadaqatihi kamathali alkalbi yaqiy'u thumma yaakulu qayaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: The similitude of one who gives a charity and then gets it back is like that of a dog which vomits and then eats its vomit
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْعَائِدُ فِي هِبَتِهِ كَالْعَائِدِ فِي قَيْئِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ al'aaiidu fiy hibatihi kaal'aaiidi fiy qayiihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:One who gets back the gift is like one who eats vomit
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، بْنُ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْعَائِدُ فِي هِبَتِهِ كَالْكَلْبِ يَقِيءُ ثُمَّ يَعُودُ فِي قَيْئِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa almakhzuwmiyyu, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi, bnu taawusin 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ al'aaiidu fiy hibatihi kaalkalbi yaqiy'u thumma ya'uwdu fiy qayiihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Tawus reported on the authority of his father who reported from Ibn Abas (Allah be pleased with them) who reported from Allah's Messenger 'may peace be upon him) that he said:One who gets back his gift is like a dog which vomits and then swallows that vomit
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ وَعَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، يُحَدِّثَانِهِ عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِنَّ أَبَاهُ أَتَى بِهِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنِّي نَحَلْتُ ابْنِي هَذَا غُلاَمًا كَانَ لِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَكُلَّ وَلَدِكَ نَحَلْتَهُ مِثْلَ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَارْجِعْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi, alrrahmani wa'an muhammadi bni alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, yuhaddithaanihi 'ani alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, aannahu qaala iinna aabaahu aataa bihi rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala iinniy nahaltu abniy hadhaa ghulaamana kaana liy ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aakulla waladika nahaltahu mithla hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala laa ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ faarji'hu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir reported that his father brought him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:I have donated this slave of mine to my son. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Have you donated to every one of your sons (a slave) like this? He said: No. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) said: Then take him back
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ، عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ أَتَى بِي أَبِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنِّي نَحَلْتُ ابْنِي هَذَا غُلاَمًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَكُلَّ بَنِيكَ نَحَلْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَارْدُدْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an humaydi bni, 'abdi alrrahmani wamuhammadi bni alnnu'maani 'ani alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, qaala aataa biy aabiy iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala iinniy nahaltu abniy hadhaa ghulaamana ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aakulla baniyka nahalta ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faardudhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir reported:My father brought me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I have donated this slave to my son. whereupon he said: Have you made (such) donation to every one or your sons? He said: No. Thereupon he (the-Holy Prophet) said: Then take him back
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، رُمْحٍ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ، وَهْبٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ أَمَّا يُونُسُ وَمَعْمَرٌ فَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏"‏ أَكُلَّ بَنِيكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ وَابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ‏"‏ أَكُلَّ وَلَدِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَرِوَايَةُ اللَّيْثِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ وَحُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ بَشِيرًا جَاءَ بِالنُّعْمَانِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara, 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, waabnu, rumhin 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, h wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu, wahbin qaala aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ aammaa yuwnusu wama'marun fafiy hadiythihimaa ‏"‏ aakulla baniyka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi alllaythi waabni 'uyaynaaa ‏"‏ aakulla waladika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wariwaayaau alllaythi 'an muhammadi bni alnnu'maani wahumaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani aanna bashiyrana jaa'a bialnnu'maani ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with different chains of transmitters and a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ وَقَدْ أَعْطَاهُ أَبُوهُ غُلاَمًا فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا هَذَا الْغُلاَمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَعْطَانِيهِ أَبِي ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَكُلَّ إِخْوَتِهِ أَعْطَيْتَهُ كَمَا أَعْطَيْتَ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَرُدَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala haddathanaa alnnu'maanu bnu bashiyrin, qaala waqad aa'taahu aabuwhu ghulaamana faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa hadhaa alghulaamu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aa'taaniyhi aabiy ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fakulla iikhwatihi aa'taytahu kamaa aa'tayta hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faruddahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir reported that his father had donated a slave to him. Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) said:Who is this slave (how have you come to possess it)? Thereupon he (Nu'man b. Bashir) said: My father has donated it to me, whereupon he said: Have all brothers (of yours) been given this gift as given to you? He said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Then return him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ الْعَوَّامِ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ تَصَدَّقَ عَلَىَّ أَبِي بِبَعْضِ مَالِهِ فَقَالَتْ أُمِّي عَمْرَةُ بِنْتُ رَوَاحَةَ لاَ أَرْضَى حَتَّى تُشْهِدَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ أَبِي إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيُشْهِدَهُ عَلَى صَدَقَتِي فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَفَعَلْتَ هَذَا بِوَلَدِكَ كُلِّهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَاعْدِلُوا فِي أَوْلاَدِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ أَبِي فَرَدَّ تِلْكَ الصَّدَقَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abbaadu bnu al'awwaami, 'an husaynin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, qaala sami'tu alnnu'maana bna bashiyrin, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'an husaynin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, qaala tasaddaqa 'alaaaa aabiy biba'di maalihi faqaalat aummiy 'amraau bintu rawaahaaa laa aardaa hattaa tushhida rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faantalaqa aabiy iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm liyushhidahu 'alaa sadaqatiy faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aafa'alta hadhaa biwaladika kullihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ attaquwa alllaha waa'diluwa fiy aawlaadikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faraja'a aabiy faradda tilka alssadaqaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir reported:My father donated to me some of his property. My mother Amra bint Rawaha said: I shall not be pleased (with this act) until you make Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a witness to it. My father went to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in order to make him the witness of the donation given to me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Have you done the same with every son of yours? He said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Fear Allah, and observe equity in case of your children. My father returned and got back the gift
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّانَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَيَّانَ التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ، أَنَّ أُمَّهُ بِنْتَ رَوَاحَةَ، سَأَلَتْ أَبَاهُ بَعْضَ الْمَوْهِبَةِ مِنْ مَالِهِ لاِبْنِهَا فَالْتَوَى بِهَا سَنَةً ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُ فَقَالَتْ لاَ أَرْضَى حَتَّى تُشْهِدَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى مَا وَهَبْتَ لاِبْنِي ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَ أَبِي بِيَدِي وَأَنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ غُلاَمٌ فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أُمَّ هَذَا بِنْتَ رَوَاحَةَ أَعْجَبَهَا أَنْ أُشْهِدَكَ عَلَى الَّذِي وَهَبْتُ لاِبْنِهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا بَشِيرُ أَلَكَ وَلَدٌ سِوَى هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَكُلَّهُمْ وَهَبْتَ لَهُ مِثْلَ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلاَ تُشْهِدْنِي إِذًا فَإِنِّي لاَ أَشْهَدُ عَلَى جَوْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an aabiy hayyaana, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, h. wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa aabuw hayyaana alttaymiyyu, 'ani alshha'biyyi, haddathaniy alnnu'maanu bnu bashiyrin, aanna aummahu binta rawaahaaa, saaalat aabaahu ba'da almawhibaai min maalihi laibnihaa faaltawaa bihaa sanaaan thumma badaa lahu faqaalat laa aardaa hattaa tushhida rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa maa wahabta laibniy ‏.‏ faaakhadha aabiy biyadiy waaanaa yawmaiidhin ghulaamun faaataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna aumma hadhaa binta rawaahaaa aa'jabahaa aan aushhidaka 'alaa alladhiy wahabtu laibnihaa ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaa bashiyru aalaka waladun siwaa hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aakullahum wahabta lahu mithla hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ falaa tushhidniy iidhana faiinniy laa aashhadu 'alaa jawrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir reported that his mother bint Rawaha asked his (Nu'man's) father about donating some gifts from his property to his son. He deferred the matter by one year, and then set forth to do that. She (Nu'man's mother) said:I shall not be pleased unless you call Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as witness to what you confer as a gift on your son. (Nu'man said): So father took hold of my hand and I was at that time a boy, and came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). and said: Allah's Messenger, the mother of this son (of mine), daughter of Rawaha wishes that I should call you witness to what I confer as gift to her son. Allah's Messenger (may pease be upon him) said: Bashir, have you any other son besides this (son of yours)? He said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Have you given gifts to all of them like this? He said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Then call me not as witness, for I cannot be witness to an injustice
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَكَ بَنُونَ سِوَاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَكُلَّهُمْ أَعْطَيْتَ مِثْلَ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلاَ أَشْهَدُ عَلَى جَوْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
