verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ aalaka banuwna siwaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fakullahum aa'tayta mithla hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ falaa aashhadu 'alaa jawrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir, reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said:Have you, besides him, other sons? He said: Yes. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Have you given gifts to all of them like this (as you have given to Nu'man)? He said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: I cannot bear witness to an injustice
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لأَبِيهِ ‏ "‏ لاَ تُشْهِدْنِي عَلَى جَوْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an 'aasimin alaahwali, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala laabiyhi ‏ "‏ laa tushhidniy 'alaa jawrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to his father:Call me not as witness to an injustice
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، وَعَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَيَعْقُوبُ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَعْقُوبَ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ انْطَلَقَ بِي أَبِي يَحْمِلُنِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اشْهَدْ أَنِّي قَدْ نَحَلْتُ النُّعْمَانَ كَذَا وَكَذَا مِنْ مَالِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَكُلَّ بَنِيكَ قَدْ نَحَلْتَ مِثْلَ مَا نَحَلْتَ النُّعْمَانَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَشْهِدْ عَلَى هَذَا غَيْرِي - ثُمَّ قَالَ - أَيَسُرُّكَ أَنْ يَكُونُوا إِلَيْكَ فِي الْبِرِّ سَوَاءً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلاَ إِذًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, wa'abdu alaa'laa, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma waya'quwbu alddawraqiyyu jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa, - waalllafzu liya'quwba - qaala haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, bnu iibraahiyma 'an daawuda bni aabiy hindin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, qaala antalaqa biy aabiy yahmiluniy iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi ashhad aanniy qad nahaltu alnnu'maana kadhaa wakadhaa min maaliy ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aakulla baniyka qad nahalta mithla maa nahalta alnnu'maana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaashhid 'alaa hadhaa ghayriy - thumma qaala - aayasurruka aan yakuwnuwa iilayka fiy albirri sawaa'an ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala balaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ falaa iidhana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir (Allah be pleased with them) reported:My father took me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, bear witness that I have given such and such gift to Nu'man from my property, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Have you conferred upon all of your sons as you have conferred upon Nu'man? He said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Call someone else besides me as a witness. And he further said: Would it, please you that they (your children) should all behave virtuously towards you? He said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Then don't do that (i e. don't give gift to one to the exclusion of others)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ النَّوْفَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَزْهَرُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ نَحَلَنِي أَبِي نُحْلاً ثُمَّ أَتَى بِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيُشْهِدَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَكُلَّ وَلَدِكَ أَعْطَيْتَهُ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ تُرِيدُ مِنْهُمُ الْبِرَّ مِثْلَ مَا تُرِيدُ مِنْ ذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنِّي لاَ أَشْهَدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَوْنٍ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ مُحَمَّدًا فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا تَحَدَّثْنَا أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ قَارِبُوا بَيْنَ أَوْلاَدِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'uthmaana alnnawfaliyyu, haddathanaa aazharu, haddathanaa abnu 'awnin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, qaala nahalaniy aabiy nuhlaan thumma aataa biy iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm liyushhidahu faqaala ‏"‏ aakulla waladika aa'taytahu hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aalaysa turiydu minhumu albirra mithla maa turiydu min dhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala balaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinniy laa aashhadu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu 'awnin fahaddathtu bihi muhammadana faqaala iinnamaa tahaddathnaa aannahu qaala ‏"‏ qaaribuwa bayna aawlaadikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir reported:My father conferred a gift upon me, and then brought me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to make him a witness (to it). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Have you given such gift to every son of yours (as you have given to Nu'man)? He said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Don't you expect goodness from them as you expect from him? He said: Yes. of course. He (the Holy Prophet) said: I am not going to bear witness to it (as it is injustice). Ibn Aun (one of the narrators) said: I narrated this hadith to Muhammad (the other narrator) who said: Verily we narrated that lie (the Holy Prophet) had said: Observe equity amongst your children
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَتِ امْرَأَةُ بَشِيرٍ انْحَلِ ابْنِي غُلاَمَكَ وَأَشْهِدْ لِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنَّ ابْنَةَ فُلاَنٍ سَأَلَتْنِي أَنْ أَنْحَلَ ابْنَهَا غُلاَمِي وَقَالَتْ أَشْهِدْ لِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَهُ إِخْوَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفَكُلَّهُمْ أَعْطَيْتَ مِثْلَ مَا أَعْطَيْتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلَيْسَ يَصْلُحُ هَذَا ‏.‏ وَإِنِّي لاَ أَشْهَدُ إِلاَّ عَلَى حَقٍّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaalati amraaaau bashiyrin anhali abniy ghulaamaka waaashhid liy rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faaataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala iinna abnaaa fulaanin saaalatniy aan aanhala abnahaa ghulaamiy waqaalat aashhid liy rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aalahu iikhwaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aafakullahum aa'tayta mithla maa aa'taytahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ falaysa yasluhu hadhaa ‏.‏ waiinniy laa aashhadu iilaaa 'alaa haqqin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the wife of Bashir said (to her husband):Give to my son your slave as a gift, and make for me Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a witness He came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: The daughter of so and so (his wife Amra bint Rawaha) asked me to give my slave as a gift to her son, and call for me Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as a witness. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Has he (Nu'man) brothers? He (Bashir) said: Yes. He (further) said: Have you given to all others as you have given to him? He said: No. He said: Then it is not fair; and verily I cannot bear witness but only to what is just
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ، عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ أُعْمِرَ عُمْرَى لَهُ وَلِعَقِبِهِ فَإِنَّهَا لِلَّذِي أُعْطِيَهَا لاَ تَرْجِعُ إِلَى الَّذِي أَعْطَاهَا لأَنَّهُ أَعْطَى عَطَاءً وَقَعَتْ فِيهِ الْمَوَارِيثُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni, 'abdi alrrahmani 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aayyumaa rajulin au'mira 'umraa lahu wali'aqibihi faiinnahaa lilladhiy au'tiyahaa laa tarji'u iilaa alladhiy aa'taahaa laannahu aa'taa 'ataa'an waqa'at fiyhi almawaariythu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:"Any man who is given a gift for life, it belongs to him and his heirs. It belongs to the one to whom it is given, and does not go back to the one who gave it, because he has given it in such a way that it is subject to the rules of inheritance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَعْمَرَ رَجُلاً عُمْرَى لَهُ وَلِعَقِبِهِ فَقَدْ قَطَعَ قَوْلُهُ حَقَّهُ فِيهَا وَهِيَ لِمَنْ أُعْمِرَ وَلِعَقِبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ يَحْيَى قَالَ فِي أَوَّلِ حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ أُعْمِرَ عُمْرَى فَهِيَ لَهُ وَلِعَقِبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aannahu qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ man aa'mara rajulaan 'umraa lahu wali'aqibihi faqad qata'a qawluhu haqqahu fiyhaa wahiya liman au'mira wali'aqibihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ghayra aanna yahyaa qaala fiy aawwali hadiythihi ‏"‏ aayyumaa rajulin au'mira 'umraa fahiya lahu wali'aqibihi ‏"‏ ‏
verses.translation: Jaber b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upan him) as saying:He who conferred a life grant upon a person, it becomes his possession and that of his successors, for he surrendered his right in that by his declaration. (This property) now belongs to one to whom this lifelong grant has been made, and to his successors. Yahya narrated in the beginning of his narration: Whatever man is given a life grant, then it belongs to him and his posterity
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ الْعُمْرَى، وَسُنَّتِهَا، عَنْ حَدِيثِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيَّ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ أَعْمَرَ رَجُلاً عُمْرَى لَهُ وَلِعَقِبِهِ فَقَالَ قَدْ أَعْطَيْتُكَهَا وَعَقِبَكَ مَا بَقِيَ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهَا لِمَنْ أُعْطِيَهَا ‏.‏ وَإِنَّهَا لاَ تَرْجِعُ إِلَى صَاحِبِهَا مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُ أَعْطَى عَطَاءً وَقَعَتْ فِيهِ الْمَوَارِيثُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu bishrin al'abdiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy abnu shihaabin, 'ani al'umraa, wasunnatihaa, 'an hadiythi aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna jaabira bna 'abdi, alllahi alaansaariyya aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aayyumaa rajulin aa'mara rajulaan 'umraa lahu wali'aqibihi faqaala qad aa'taytukahaa wa'aqibaka maa baqiya minkum aahadun ‏.‏ faiinnahaa liman au'tiyahaa ‏.‏ waiinnahaa laa tarji'u iilaa saahibihaa min aajli aannahu aa'taa 'ataa'an waqa'at fiyhi almawaariythu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari (Allah be pleased with him) said:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Whoever a person conferred Umra (life grant) upon a person and he says: I confer upon you this and upon your descendants and anyone who survives you, and that becomes his possession and that of his posterity. It would become (a permanent possession) of those who were conferred upon this gift, and it would not return to its owner (donor), for he gave that as a gift in which accrued the right of inheritance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَبْدٍ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ، الرَّزَّاقِ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ إِنَّمَا الْعُمْرَى الَّتِي أَجَازَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَقُولَ هِيَ لَكَ وَلِعَقِبِكَ ‏.‏ فَأَمَّا إِذَا قَالَ هِيَ لَكَ مَا عِشْتَ ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهَا تَرْجِعُ إِلَى صَاحِبِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ وَكَانَ الزُّهْرِيُّ يُفْتِي بِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, - waalllafzu li'abdin - qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu, alrrazzaaqi aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an jaabirin, qaala iinnamaa al'umraa allatiy aajaaza rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yaquwla hiya laka wali'aqibika ‏.‏ faaammaa iidhaa qaala hiya laka maa 'ishta ‏.‏ faiinnahaa tarji'u iilaa saahibihaa ‏.‏ qaala ma'marun wakaana alzzuhriyyu yuftiy bihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) said:The Umra for which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave sanction that a person way say: This (property) is for you and for your descendants. And when he said: That is for you as long as you live, then it will return to its owner (after the death of the donee). Ma'mar said: Zuhri used to give religious verdict according to this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَضَى فِيمَنْ أُعْمِرَ عُمْرَى لَهُ وَلِعَقِبِهِ فَهِيَ لَهُ بَتْلَةً لاَ يَجُوزُ لِلْمُعْطِي فِيهَا شَرْطٌ وَلاَ ثُنْيَا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ لأَنَّهُ أَعْطَى عَطَاءً وَقَعَتْ فِيهِ الْمَوَارِيثُ فَقَطَعَتِ الْمَوَارِيثُ شَرْطَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, 'ani abni aabiy dhiibin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an jaabirin, - wahuwa abnu 'abdi alllahi - aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qadaa fiyman au'mira 'umraa lahu wali'aqibihi fahiya lahu batlaaan laa yajuwzu lilmu'tiy fiyhaa shartun walaa thunyaa ‏.‏ qaala aabuw salamaaa laannahu aa'taa 'ataa'an waqa'at fiyhi almawaariythu faqata'ati almawaariythu shartahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that whoever is conferred upon a life grant along with his descendants is entitled to make use of the property conferred so long as he lives and his successors (also enjoy this privilege). That (property) becomes the their defect belonging. The donor cannot (after declaring Umra) lay down any condition or make any exception. Abu Salama said:For he conferred a grant and as such it becomes heritage. and the right of inheritance abrogated his condition
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْعُمْرَى لِمَنْ وُهِبَتْ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, haddathaniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ al'umraa liman wuhibat lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (b. 'Abdullah) (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Life grant is for one upon whom it is bestowed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي، كَثِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy, kathiyrin haddathanaa aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported a hadith like this through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، يَرْفَعُهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, yarfa'uhu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported this hadith directly from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَمْسِكُوا عَلَيْكُمْ أَمْوَالَكُمْ وَلاَ تُفْسِدُوهَا فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ أَعْمَرَ عُمْرَى فَهِيَ لِلَّذِي أُعْمِرَهَا حَيًّا وَمَيِّتًا وَلِعَقِبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aamsikuwa 'alaykum aamwaalakum walaa tufsiduwhaa faiinnahu man aa'mara 'umraa fahiya lilladhiy au'mirahaa hayyana wamayyitana wali'aqibihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (b. 'Abdullah) (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said:Keep your property to yourselves and do not squander it, for he who conferred a life grant upon another that property will belong to him upon whom it is conferred whether he lives or dies, and (would pass on) to his successors (as heritage)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ وَكِيعٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي خَيْثَمَةَ وَفِي حَدِيثِ أَيُّوبَ مِنَ الزِّيَادَةِ قَالَ جَعَلَ الأَنْصَارُ يُعْمِرُونَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَمْسِكُوا عَلَيْكُمْ أَمْوَالَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu aabiy 'uthmaana, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an wakiy'in, 'an sufyaana, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi bnu 'abdi alssamadi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, 'an aayyuwba, kullu hauulaa'i 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bima'naa hadiythi aabiy khaythamaaa wafiy hadiythi aayyuwba mina alzziyaadaai qaala ja'ala alaansaaru yu'miruwna almuhaajiriyna faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aamsikuwa 'alaykum aamwaalakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Jabir through other chains of transmitters, but (with this addition of words) that thehadith transmitted on the authority of Ayyub (these words are found):" The Helpers (Ansar) conferred the benefit of 'Umra, upon the Emigrants (Muhajirin), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Keep your property to yourselves
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ رَافِعٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ أَعْمَرَتِ امْرَأَةٌ بِالْمَدِينَةِ حَائِطًا لَهَا ابْنًا لَهَا ثُمَّ تُوُفِّيَ وَتُوُفِّيَتْ بَعْدَهُ وَتَرَكَتْ وَلَدًا وَلَهُ إِخْوَةٌ بَنُونَ لِلْمُعْمِرَةِ فَقَالَ وَلَدُ الْمُعْمِرَةِ رَجَعَ الْحَائِطُ إِلَيْنَا وَقَالَ بَنُو الْمُعْمَرِ بَلْ كَانَ لأَبِينَا حَيَاتَهُ وَمَوْتَهُ ‏.‏ فَاخْتَصَمُوا إِلَى طَارِقٍ مَوْلَى عُثْمَانَ فَدَعَا جَابِرًا فَشَهِدَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْعُمْرَى لِصَاحِبِهَا فَقَضَى بِذَلِكَ طَارِقٌ ثُمَّ كَتَبَ إِلَى عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ فَأَخْبَرَهُ ذَلِكَ وَأَخْبَرَهُ بِشَهَادَةِ جَابِرٍ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ صَدَقَ جَابِرٌ ‏.‏ فَأَمْضَى ذَلِكَ طَارِقٌ ‏.‏ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ الْحَائِطَ لِبَنِي الْمُعْمَرِ حَتَّى الْيَوْمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, waiishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, - waalllafzu laibni raafi'in - qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala aa'marati amraaaaun bialmadiynaai haaiitana lahaa abnana lahaa thumma tuwuffiya watuwuffiyat ba'dahu watarakat waladana walahu iikhwaaun banuwna lilmu'miraai faqaala waladu almu'miraai raja'a alhaaiitu iilaynaa waqaala banuw almu'mari bal kaana laabiynaa hayaatahu wamawtahu ‏.‏ faakhtasamuwa iilaa taariqin mawlaa 'uthmaana fada'aa jaabirana fashahida 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bial'umraa lisaahibihaa faqadaa bidhalika taariqun thumma kataba iilaa 'abdi almaliki faaakhbarahu dhalika waaakhbarahu bishahaadaai jaabirin faqaala 'abdu almaliki sadaqa jaabirun ‏.‏ faaamdaa dhalika taariqun ‏.‏ faiinna dhalika alhaaiita libaniy almu'mari hattaa alyawmi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that a woman gave her garden as a life grant to her son. He died and later on she also died and left a son behind and brothers also, The sons of the woman making life grant said (to those who had been conferred upon this 'Umra):This garden has returned to us. The sons of the one who had been given life grant said: This belonged to our father, during his lifetime and in case of his death. They took their dispute to Tariq, the freed slave of 'Uthman. He called Jabir and he gave testimony of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Life grant belongs to one who is conferred upon this (privilege). Tariq gave this decision and then wrote to Abd al-Malik and informed him, Jabir bearing witness to it. Abd al-Malik said: Jabir has told the truth. Then Tariq gave a decree and, as a result thereof, it is to this day that the garden belongs to descendants of one who was conferred upon the life grant
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، أَنَّ طَارِقًا، قَضَى بِالْعُمْرَى لِلْوَارِثِ لِقَوْلِ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala aabuw bakrin, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'amrinw, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, aanna taariqana, qadaa bial'umraa lilwaarithi liqawli jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sulaiman b. Yasir reported that Jabir gave this verdict. The inheritor has a right (to inherit) the life grant according to the statement of Jabir (b. 'Abdullah) (Allah be pleased with him) which he narrated from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْعُمْرَى جَائِزَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ al'umraa jaaiizaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Life grant is permissible
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْعُمْرَى مِيرَاثٌ لأَهْلِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna alhaarithi - haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ al'umraa miyraathun laahlihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Life grant is the heritage of one upon whom it is conferred
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ نَهِيكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْعُمْرَى جَائِزَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'ani alnnadri bni aanasin, 'an bashiyri bni nahiykin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ al'umraa jaaiizaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Life grant is permissible
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مِيرَاثٌ لأَهْلِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ جَائِزَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi yahyaa bnu habiybin, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna alhaarithi - haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏"‏ miyraathun laahlihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw qaala ‏"‏ jaaiizaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عُمَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا حَقُّ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ لَهُ شَىْءٌ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُوصِيَ فِيهِ يَبِيتُ لَيْلَتَيْنِ إِلاَّ وَوَصِيَّتُهُ مَكْتُوبَةٌ عِنْدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw khaythamaaa, zuhayru bnu harbin wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa al'anaziyyu - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa abnu sa'iydin alqattaanu - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni, 'umara aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa haqqu amriiin muslimin lahu shaa'un yuriydu aan yuwsiya fiyhi yabiytu laylatayni iilaaa wawasiyyatuhu maktuwbaaun 'indahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:It is the duty of a Muslim who has something which is to be given as a bequest not to have it for two nights without having his will written down regarding it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي كِلاَهُمَا، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ ‏"‏ وَلَهُ شَىْءٌ يُوصِي فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُولاَ ‏"‏ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُوصِيَ فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, wa'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathaniy aabiy kilaahumaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aannahumaa qaalaa ‏"‏ walahu shaa'un yuwsiy fiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yaquwlaa ‏"‏ yuriydu aan yuwsiya fiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters. but with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ، حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ اللَّيْثِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ وَقَالُوا جَمِيعًا ‏"‏ لَهُ شَىْءٌ يُوصِي فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ إِلاَّ فِي حَدِيثِ أَيُّوبَ فَإِنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُوصِيَ فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ كَرِوَايَةِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun ya'niy abna zaydin, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu, harbin haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'niy abna 'ulayyaaa - kilaahumaa 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy ausaamaau bnu zaydin alllaythiyyu, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, - ya'niy abna sa'din - kulluhum 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi 'ubaydi alllahi waqaaluwa jamiy'ana ‏"‏ lahu shaa'un yuwsiy fiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ iilaaa fiy hadiythi aayyuwba faiinnahu qaala ‏"‏ yuriydu aan yuwsiya fiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ kariwaayaai yahyaa 'an 'ubaydi alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this have been narrated on the authority of Nafi', who based his narrations of the words of Ibn 'Umar but with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، - وَهْوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ - عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا حَقُّ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ لَهُ شَىْءٌ يُوصِي فِيهِ يَبِيتُ ثَلاَثَ لَيَالٍ إِلاَّ وَوَصِيَّتُهُ عِنْدَهُ مَكْتُوبَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ مَا مَرَّتْ عَلَىَّ لَيْلَةٌ مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ وَعِنْدِي وَصِيَّتِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, - wahwa abnu alhaarithi - 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa haqqu amriiin muslimin lahu shaa'un yuwsiy fiyhi yabiytu thalaatha layaalin iilaaa wawasiyyatuhu 'indahu maktuwbaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara maa marrat 'alaaaa laylaaun mundhu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala dhalika iilaaa wa'indiy wasiyyatiy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim reported on the authority of his father ('Abdullah b. Umar) that he (his father) had heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:It is not proper for a Muslim who has got something to bequeathe to spend even three nights without having his will written down with him regarding it. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said: Ever since I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say this I have not spent a night without having my will (written) along with me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylun, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, wa'abdu bnu humaydin qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi 'amriw bni alhaarithi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ عَادَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ مِنْ وَجَعٍ أَشْفَيْتُ مِنْهُ عَلَى الْمَوْتِ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بَلَغَنِي مَا تَرَى مِنَ الْوَجَعِ وَأَنَا ذُو مَالٍ وَلاَ يَرِثُنِي إِلاَّ ابْنَةٌ لِي وَاحِدَةٌ أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِثُلُثَىْ مَالِي قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِشَطْرِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ الثُّلُثُ وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ إِنَّكَ أَنْ تَذَرَ وَرَثَتَكَ أَغْنِيَاءَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَذَرَهُمْ عَالَةً يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ وَلَسْتَ تُنْفِقُ نَفَقَةً تَبْتَغِي بِهَا وَجْهَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ أُجِرْتَ بِهَا حَتَّى اللُّقْمَةُ تَجْعَلُهَا فِي فِي امْرَأَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أُخَلَّفُ بَعْدَ أَصْحَابِي قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تُخَلَّفَ فَتَعْمَلَ عَمَلاً تَبْتَغِي بِهِ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ ازْدَدْتَ بِهِ دَرَجَةً وَرِفْعَةً وَلَعَلَّكَ تُخَلَّفُ حَتَّى يُنْفَعَ بِكَ أَقْوَامٌ وَيُضَرَّ بِكَ آخَرُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمْضِ لأَصْحَابِي هِجْرَتَهُمْ وَلاَ تَرُدَّهُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِهِمْ لَكِنِ الْبَائِسُ سَعْدُ ابْنُ خَوْلَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَثَى لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَنْ تُوُفِّيَ بِمَكَّةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'aamiri bni sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, qaala 'aadaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i min waja'in aashfaytu minhu 'alaa almawti faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi balaghaniy maa taraa mina alwaja'i waaanaa dhuw maalin walaa yarithuniy iilaaa abnaaun liy waahidaaun aafaaatasaddaqu bithuluthaa maaliy qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu aafaaatasaddaqu bishatrihi qaala ‏"‏ laa althhuluthu waalthhuluthu kathiyrun iinnaka aan tadhara warathataka aaghniyaa'a khayrun min aan tadharahum 'aalaaan yatakaffafuwna alnnaasa walasta tunfiqu nafaqaaan tabtaghiy bihaa wajha alllahi iilaaa aujirta bihaa hattaa allluqmaau taj'aluhaa fiy fiy amraaatika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aukhallafu ba'da aashaabiy qaala ‏"‏ iinnaka lan tukhallafa fata'mala 'amalaan tabtaghiy bihi wajha alllahi iilaaa azdadta bihi darajaaan warif'aaan wala'allaka tukhallafu hattaa yunfa'a bika aaqwaamun wayudarra bika akharuwna alllahumma aamdi laashaabiy hijratahum walaa taruddahum 'alaa aa'qaabihim lakini albaaiisu sa'du abnu khawlaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala rathaa lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min aan tuwuffiya bimakkaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father (Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited me in my illness which brought me near death in the year of Hajjat-ul-Wada' (Farewell Pilgrimage). I said: Allah's Messenger, you can well see the pain with which I am afflicted and I am a man possessing wealth, and there is none to inherit me except only one daughter. Should I give two-thirds of my property as Sadaqa? He said: No. I said: Should I give half (of my property) as Sadaqa? He said: No. He (further) said: Give one-third (in charity) and that is quite enough. To leave your heirs rich is better than to leave them poor, begging from people; that you would never incur an expense seeking therewith the pleasure of Allah, but you would be rewarded therefor, even for a morsel of food that you put in the mouth of your wife. I said: Allah's Messenger. would I survive my companions? He (the Holy Prophet) said: If you survive them, then do such a deed by means of which you seek the pleasure of Allah, but you would increase in your status (in religion) and prestige; you may survive so that people would benefit from you, and others would be harmed by you. (The Holy Prophet) further said: Allah, complete for my Companions their migration, and not cause them to turn back upon their heels. Sa'd b. Khaula is, however, unfortunate. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) felt grief for him as he had died in Mecca
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma wa'abdu bnu humaydin qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الْحَفَرِيُّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ، إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَىَّ يَعُودُنِي ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ الزُّهْرِيِّ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قَوْلَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَعْدِ ابْنِ خَوْلَةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَكَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَمُوتَ بِالأَرْضِ الَّتِي هَاجَرَ مِنْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa aabuw daawuda alhafariyyu, 'an sufyaana, 'an sa'di bni, iibraahiyma 'an 'aamiri bni sa'din, 'an sa'din, qaala dakhala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaaaa ya'uwduniy ‏.‏ fadhakara bima'naa hadiythi alzzuhriyyi walam yadhkur qawla alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy sa'di abni khawlaaa ghayra aannahu qaala wakaana yakrahu aan yamuwta bialaardi allatiy haajara minhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Sa'd reported from S'ad (b. Abu Waqqas):Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited me to inquire after my health, the rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted on the authority of Zuhri, but lie did not make mention of the words of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in regard to Sa'd b. Khaula except this that he said:" He (the Holy Prophet) did not like death in the land from which lie had migrated
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سِمَاكُ، بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنِي مُصْعَبُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ مَرِضْتُ فَأَرْسَلْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ دَعْنِي أَقْسِمْ مَالِي حَيْثُ شِئْتُ فَأَبَى ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَالنِّصْفُ فَأَبَى ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَالثُّلُثُ قَالَ فَسَكَتَ بَعْدَ الثُّلُثِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَانَ بَعْدُ الثُّلُثُ جَائِزًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa simaaku, bnu harbin haddathaniy mus'abu bnu sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, qaala maridtu faaarsaltu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu da'niy aaqsim maaliy haythu shiitu faaabaa ‏.‏ qultu faalnnisfu faaabaa ‏.‏ qultu faalthhuluthu qaala fasakata ba'da althhuluthi ‏.‏ qaala fakaana ba'du althhuluthu jaaiizana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mus'ab b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father. I was ailing. I sent message to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying:Permit me to give away my property as I like. He refused. I (again) said: (Permit me) to give away half. He (again refused). I (again said): Then one-third. He (the Holy Prophet) observed silence after (I had asked permission to give away) one-third. He (the narrater) said: It was then that endowment of one-third became permissible
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فَكَانَ بَعْدُ الثُّلُثُ جَائِزًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an simaakin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏ walam yadhkur fakaana ba'du althhuluthu jaaiizana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Simak with the same chain of transmitters. But he did not mention:" It was then that one-third became permissible
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ عَادَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ أُوصِي بِمَالِي كُلِّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَالنِّصْفُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَبِالثُّلُثِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy alqaasimu bnu zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa husaynu bnu 'aliyyin, 'an zaaiidaaa, 'an 'abdi almaliki, bni 'umayrin 'an mus'abi bni sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, qaala 'aadaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu auwsiy bimaaliy kullihi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu faalnnisfu ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu aabialthhuluthi faqaala ‏"‏ na'am waalthhuluthu kathiyrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Sa'd reported his father as saying:Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited me during my illness. I said: I am willing away the whole of my property. He said: No. I said: Then half? He said: No. I said: Should I will away one-third? He said: Yes, and even one-third is enough
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْمَكِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ السَّخْتِيَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو، بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِمْيَرِيِّ، عَنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ، مِنْ وَلَدِ سَعْدٍ كُلُّهُمْ يُحَدِّثُهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَى سَعْدٍ يَعُودُهُ بِمَكَّةَ فَبَكَى قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا يُبْكِيكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ قَدْ خَشِيتُ أَنْ أَمُوتَ بِالأَرْضِ الَّتِي هَاجَرْتُ مِنْهَا كَمَا مَاتَ سَعْدُ ابْنُ خَوْلَةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اشْفِ سَعْدًا اللَّهُمَّ اشْفِ سَعْدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ لِي مَالاً كَثِيرًا وَإِنَّمَا يَرِثُنِي ابْنَتِي أَفَأُوصِي بِمَالِي كُلِّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَبِالثُّلُثَيْنِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَالنِّصْفُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَالثُّلُثُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الثُّلُثُ وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ إِنَّ صَدَقَتَكَ مِنْ مَالِكَ صَدَقَةٌ وَإِنَّ نَفَقَتَكَ عَلَى عِيَالِكَ صَدَقَةٌ وَإِنَّ مَا تَأْكُلُ امْرَأَتُكَ مِنْ مَالِكَ صَدَقَةٌ وَإِنَّكَ أَنْ تَدَعَ أَهْلَكَ بِخَيْرٍ - أَوْ قَالَ بِعَيْشٍ - خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَدَعَهُمْ يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy 'umara almakkiyyu, haddathanaa althhaqafiyyu, 'an aayyuwba alssakhtiyaaniyyi, 'an 'amriw, bni sa'iydin 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani alhimyariyyi, 'an thalaathaain, min waladi sa'din kulluhum yuhaddithuhu 'an aabiyhi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala 'alaa sa'din ya'uwduhu bimakkaaa fabakaa qaala ‏"‏ maa yubkiyka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala qad khashiytu aan aamuwta bialaardi allatiy haajartu minhaa kamaa maata sa'du abnu khawlaaa ‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alllahumma ashfi sa'dana alllahumma ashfi sa'dana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thalaatha miraarin ‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna liy maalaan kathiyrana waiinnamaa yarithuniy abnatiy aafaauwsiy bimaaliy kullihi qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fabialthhuluthayni qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faalnnisfu qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faalthhuluthu qaala ‏"‏ althhuluthu waalthhuluthu kathiyrun iinna sadaqataka min maalika sadaqaaun waiinna nafaqataka 'alaa 'iyaalika sadaqaaun waiinna maa taakulu amraaatuka min maalika sadaqaaun waiinnaka aan tada'a aahlaka bikhayrin - aaw qaala bi'ayshin - khayrun min aan tada'ahum yatakaffafuwna alnnaasa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala biyadihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Humaid b. 'Abd al-Rahman al-Himyari reported from three of the sons of Sa'd all of whom reported from their father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited Sa'd as he was ill in Mecca. He (Sa'd) wept. He (the Holy Prophet) said:What makes you weep? He said: I am afraid I may die in the land from where I migrated as Sa'd b. Khaula had died. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: O Allah, grant health to Sa'd. O Allah, grant health to Sad. He repeated it three times. He (Sa'd) said: Allah's Messenger, I own a large property and I have only one daughter as my inheritor. Should I not will away the whole of my property? He (the Holy Prophet) said: No. He said: (Should I not will away, ) two-thirds of the property? he (the Holy Prophet) said: No. He (Sa'd) (again) said: (Should I not will away) half (of my property)? He said: No. He (Sa'd) said: Then one-third? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: (Yes), one-third, and one-third is quite substanial. And what you spend as charity from your property is Sadaqa and flour spending on your family is also Sadaqa, and what your wife eats from your property is also Sadaqa, and that you leave your heirs well off (or he said: prospreous) is better than to leave them (poor and) begging from people. He (the Holy Prophet) pointed this with his hands
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِمْيَرِيِّ، عَنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ، مِنْ وَلَدِ سَعْدٍ قَالُوا مَرِضَ سَعْدٌ بِمَكَّةَ فَأَتَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُهُ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ الثَّقَفِيِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an 'amriw bni sa'iydin, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani alhimyariyyi, 'an thalaathaain, min waladi sa'din qaaluwa marida sa'dun bimakkaaa faaataahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'uwduhu ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythi althhaqafiyyi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Humaid b. Abd al-Rahmin al-Himayri reported on the authority of the three of the sons of Sa'd:They said: Sa'd fell ill in Mecca. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited him to inquire after his health. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ، بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ حَدَّثَنِي ثَلاَثَةٌ، مِنْ وَلَدِ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ كُلُّهُمْ يُحَدِّثُنِيهِ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ صَاحِبِهِ فَقَالَ مَرِضَ سَعْدٌ بِمَكَّةَ فَأَتَاهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُهُ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الْحِمْيَرِيِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an muhammadin, 'an humaydi, bni 'abdi alrrahmani haddathaniy thalaathaaun, min waladi sa'di bni maalikin kulluhum yuhaddithuniyhi bimithli hadiythi saahibihi faqaala marida sa'dun bimakkaaa faaataahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'uwduhu ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi 'amriw bni sa'iydin 'an humaydin alhimyariyyi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Humaid b. Abd al-Rahman reported this hadith on the authority of three of Sa'd's sons:Sa'd fell ill in Mecca and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited him. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى الرَّازِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى يَعْنِي ابْنَ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ النَّاسَ، غَضُّوا مِنَ الثُّلُثِ إِلَى الرُّبُعِ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الثُّلُثُ وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ ‏"‏ كَبِيرٌ أَوْ كَثِيرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa alrraaziyyu, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa ya'niy abna yuwnusa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, kulluhum 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala law aanna alnnaasa, ghadduwa mina althhuluthi iilaa alrrubu'i faiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ althhuluthu waalthhuluthu kathiyrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi wakiy'in ‏"‏ kabiyrun aaw kathiyrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) said:(I wish) if people would reduce from third to fourth (part for making a will of their property), for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: So far as the third (part) is concerned it is quite substantial. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Waki (the words are)" large" or" much
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ أَبِي مَاتَ وَتَرَكَ مَالاً وَلَمْ يُوصِ فَهَلْ يُكَفِّرُ عَنْهُ أَنْ أَتَصَدَّقَ عَنْهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rajulaan, qaala lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinna aabiy maata wataraka maalaan walam yuwsi fahal yukaffiru 'anhu aan aatasaddaqa 'anhu qaala ‏ "‏ na'am ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that a person said to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ):My father died and left behind property without making any will regarding it. Would he be relieved of the burden of his sins if I give sadaqa on his behalf? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ أُمِّيَ افْتُلِتَتْ نَفْسُهَا وَإِنِّي أَظُنُّهَا لَوْ تَكَلَّمَتْ تَصَدَّقَتْ فَلِيَ أَجْرٌ أَنْ أَتَصَدَّقَ عَنْهَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rajulaan, qaala lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinna aummiya aftulitat nafsuhaa waiinniy aazunnuhaa law takallamat tasaddaqat faliya aajrun aan aatasaddaqa 'anhaa qaala ‏ "‏ na'am ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that a man said to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ):My mother died all of a sudden, and I think if she (could have the opportunity) to speak she would have (made a will) regarding Sadaqa'. Will I be entitled to reward if I give charity on her behalf? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أُمِّيَ افْتُلِتَتْ نَفْسُهَا وَلَمْ تُوصِ وَأَظُنُّهَا لَوْ تَكَلَّمَتْ تَصَدَّقَتْ أَفَلَهَا أَجْرٌ إِنْ تَصَدَّقْتُ عَنْهَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rajulaan, aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna aummiya aftulitat nafsuhaa walam tuwsi waaazunnuhaa law takallamat tasaddaqat aafalahaa aajrun iin tasaddaqtu 'anhaa qaala ‏ "‏ na'am ‏"‏
verses.translation: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said:Allah's Messenger, my mother died all of a sudden without making any will. I think if (she could have the opportunity) to speak she would have made a Sadaqa. Would there be any reward for her if I give charity on her behalf? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ، بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ - ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَمَّا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ وَرَوْحٌ فَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا فَهَلْ لِي أَجْرٌ كَمَا قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ‏.‏ وَأَمَّا شُعَيْبٌ وَجَعْفَرٌ فَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا أَفَلَهَا أَجْرٌ كَرِوَايَةِ ابْنِ بِشْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, h wahaddathaniy alhakamu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa shu'aybu, bnu iishaaqa h wahaddathaniy aumayyaau bnu bistaama, haddathanaa yaziydu, - ya'niy abna zuray'in - haddathanaa rawhun, - wahuwa abnu alqaasimi - h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ja'faru bnu 'awnin, kulluhum 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi aammaa aabuw ausaamaaa warawhun fafiy hadiythihimaa fahal liy aajrun kamaa qaala yahyaa bnu sa'iydin ‏.‏ waaammaa shu'aybun waja'farun fafiy hadiythihimaa aafalahaa aajrun kariwaayaai abni bishrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham b. 'Urwa with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - وَابْنُ حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - هُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ إِلاَّ مِنْ صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, - ya'niy abna sa'iydin - waabnu hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - huwa abnu ja'farin - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa maata aliinsaanu anqata'a 'anhu 'amaluhu iilaaa min thalaathaain iilaaa min sadaqaain jaariyaain aaw 'ilmin yuntafa'u bihi aaw waladin saalihin yad'uw lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When a man dies, his acts come to an end, but three, recurring charity, or knowledge (by which people) benefit, or a pious son, who prays for him (for the deceased)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمُ بْنُ أَخْضَرَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ أَصَابَ عُمَرُ أَرْضًا بِخَيْبَرَ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتَأْمِرُهُ فِيهَا فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ أَرْضًا بِخَيْبَرَ لَمْ أُصِبْ مَالاً قَطُّ هُوَ أَنْفَسُ عِنْدِي مِنْهُ فَمَا تَأْمُرُنِي بِهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ شِئْتَ حَبَسْتَ أَصْلَهَا وَتَصَدَّقْتَ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَصَدَّقَ بِهَا عُمَرُ أَنَّهُ لاَ يُبَاعُ أَصْلُهَا وَلاَ يُبْتَاعُ وَلاَ يُورَثُ وَلاَ يُوهَبُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَصَدَّقَ عُمَرُ فِي الْفُقَرَاءِ وَفِي الْقُرْبَى وَفِي الرِّقَابِ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ وَالضَّيْفِ لاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَى مَنْ وَلِيَهَا أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْهَا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ أَوْ يُطْعِمَ صَدِيقًا غَيْرَ مُتَمَوِّلٍ فِيهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ مُحَمَّدًا فَلَمَّا بَلَغْتُ هَذَا الْمَكَانَ غَيْرَ مُتَمَوِّلٍ فِيهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ غَيْرَ مُتَأَثِّلٍ مَالاً ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَوْنٍ وَأَنْبَأَنِي مَنْ قَرَأَ هَذَا الْكِتَابَ أَنَّ فِيهِ غَيْرَ مُتَأَثِّلٍ مَالاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa sulaymu bnu aakhdara, 'ani abni 'awnin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala aasaaba 'umaru aardana bikhaybara faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yastaamiruhu fiyhaa faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy aasabtu aardana bikhaybara lam ausib maalaan qattu huwa aanfasu 'indiy minhu famaa taamuruniy bihi qaala ‏ "‏ iin shiita habasta aaslahaa watasaddaqta bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fatasaddaqa bihaa 'umaru aannahu laa yubaa'u aasluhaa walaa yubtaa'u walaa yuwrathu walaa yuwhabu ‏.‏ qaala fatasaddaqa 'umaru fiy alfuqaraa'i wafiy alqurbaa wafiy alrriqaabi wafiy sabiyli alllahi waabni alssabiyli waalddayfi laa junaaha 'alaa man waliyahaa aan yaakula minhaa bialma'ruwfi aaw yut'ima sadiyqana ghayra mutamawwilin fiyhi ‏.‏ qaala fahaddathtu bihadhaa alhadiythi muhammadana falammaa balaghtu hadhaa almakaana ghayra mutamawwilin fiyhi ‏.‏ qaala muhammadun ghayra mutaaathhilin maalaan ‏.‏ qaala abnu 'awnin waaanbaaaniy man qaraaa hadhaa alkitaaba aanna fiyhi ghayra mutaaathhilin maalaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported:Umar acquired a land at Khaibar. He came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and sought his advice in regard to it. He said: Allah's Messenger, I have acquired land in Khaibar. I have never acquired property more valuable for me than this, so what do you command me to do with it? Thereupon he (Allah's Apostle) said: If you like, you may keep the corpus intact and give its produce as Sadaqa. So 'Umar gave it as Sadaqa declaring that property must not be sold or inherited or given away as gift. And Umar devoted it to the poor, to the nearest kin, and to the emancipation of slaves, aired in the way of Allah and guests. There is no sin for one, who administers it if he eats something from it in a reasonable manner, or if he feeds his friends and does not hoard up goods (for himself). He (the narrator) said: I narrated this hadith to Muhammad, but as I reached the (words)" without hoarding (for himself) out of it." he (Muhammad' said:" without storing the property with a view to becoming rich." Ibn 'Aun said: He who read this book (pertaining to Waqf) informed me that in it (the words are)" without storing the property with a view to becoming rich
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَزْهَرُ السَّمَّانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ حَدِيثَ ابْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ وَأَزْهَرَ انْتَهَى عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ ‏ "‏ أَوْ يُطْعِمَ صَدِيقًا غَيْرَ مُتَمَوِّلٍ فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يُذْكَرْ مَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏ وَحَدِيثُ ابْنِ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ فِيهِ مَا ذَكَرَ سُلَيْمٌ قَوْلُهُ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ مُحَمَّدًا ‏.‏ إِلَى آخِرِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa aazharu alssammaanu, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, kulluhum 'ani abni 'awnin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ghayra aanna hadiytha abni aabiy zaaiidaaa waaazhara antahaa 'inda qawlihi ‏ "‏ aaw yut'ima sadiyqana ghayra mutamawwilin fiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yudhkar maa ba'dahu ‏.‏ wahadiythu abni aabiy 'adiyyin fiyhi maa dhakara sulaymun qawluhu fahaddathtu bihadhaa alhadiythi muhammadana ‏.‏ iilaa akhirihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Aun with the same chain of transmitters up to the words:" Or he may feed the friend withoiut hoarding from it" and he made no mention of what follows
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الْحَفَرِيُّ، عُمَرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، قَالَ أَصَبْتُ أَرْضًا مِنْ أَرْضِ خَيْبَرَ فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ أَصَبْتُ أَرْضًا لَمْ أُصِبْ مَالاً أَحَبَّ إِلَىَّ وَلاَ أَنْفَسَ عِنْدِي مِنْهَا ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمْ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فَحَدَّثْتُ مُحَمَّدًا وَمَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aabuw daawuda alhafariyyu, 'umaru bnu sa'din 'an sufyaana, 'ani abni 'awnin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'an 'umara, qaala aasabtu aardana min aardi khaybara faaataytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu aasabtu aardana lam ausib maalaan aahabba iilaaaa walaa aanfasa 'indiy minhaa ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bimithli hadiythihim walam yadhkur fahaddathtu muhammadana wamaa ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umar reported:I acquired land from the lands of Khaibar. I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I have acquired a piece of land. Never have I acquired land more loved by me and more cherished by me than this. The rest of the hadith is the same, but he made no mention of this:" I narrated it to Muhammad" and what follows
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى هَلْ أَوْصَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَلِمَ كُتِبَ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ الْوَصِيَّةُ أَوْ فَلِمَ أُمِرُوا بِالْوَصِيَّةِ قَالَ أَوْصَى بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an maaliki bni mighwalin, 'an talhaaa bni musarrifin, qaala saaaltu 'abda alllahi bna aabiy aawfaa hal aawsaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala laa ‏.‏ qultu falima kutiba 'alaa almuslimiyna alwasiyyaau aaw falima aumiruwa bialwasiyyaai qaala aawsaa bikitaabi alllahi 'azza wajalla ‏.‏
verses.translation: Talha b. Musarrif reported:I asked 'Abdullah b. Abu Aufa whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had made any will (in regard to his property). He said: NO. I said: Then why has making of will been made necessary for the Muslims, or why were they commanded to make will? Thereupon he said: He made the will according to the Book of Allah, the Exalted and Majestic
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ قُلْتُ فَكَيْفَ أُمِرَ النَّاسُ بِالْوَصِيَّةِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ قُلْتُ كَيْفَ كُتِبَ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ الْوَصِيَّةُ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, kilaahumaa 'an maaliki bni mighwalin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi wakiy'in qultu fakayfa aumira alnnaasu bialwasiyyaai wafiy hadiythi abni numayrin qultu kayfa kutiba 'alaa almuslimiyna alwasiyyaau
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Malik b. Mighwal with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of words. In the hadith related by Waki (the words are)" I said:How the people have been ordered about the will" ; and in the hadith of Ibn Numair (the words are):" How the will has been prescribed for the Muslims
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا تَرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دِينَارًا وَلاَ دِرْهَمًا وَلاَ شَاةً وَلاَ بَعِيرًا وَلاَ أَوْصَى بِشَىْءٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, waaabuw mu'aawiyaaa 'ani alaa'mashi, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy waaabuw mu'aawiyaaa qaalaa haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat maa taraka rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm diynaarana walaa dirhamana walaa shaaaan walaa ba'iyrana walaa aawsaa bishaa'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left neither dinar nor dirham (wealth in the form of cash), nor goats (and sheep), nor camels. And he made no will about anything (in regard to his material possessions, as he had none)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ يُونُسَ - جَمِيعًا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wa'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, kulluhum 'an jariyrin, h wahaddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, - wahuwa abnu yuwnusa - jamiy'ana 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ ذَكَرُوا عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا كَانَ وَصِيًّا فَقَالَتْ مَتَى أَوْصَى إِلَيْهِ فَقَدْ كُنْتُ مُسْنِدَتَهُ إِلَى صَدْرِي - أَوْ قَالَتْ حَجْرِي - فَدَعَا بِالطَّسْتِ فَلَقَدِ انْخَنَثَ فِي حَجْرِي وَمَا شَعَرْتُ أَنَّهُ مَاتَ فَمَتَى أَوْصَى إِلَيْهِ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaala aakhbaranaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'ani abni 'awnin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi bni yaziyda, qaala dhakaruwa 'inda 'aaiishaaa aanna 'aliyyana kaana wasiyyana faqaalat mataa aawsaa iilayhi faqad kuntu musnidatahu iilaa sadriy - aaw qaalat hajriy - fada'aa bialttasti falaqadi ankhanatha fiy hajriy wamaa sha'artu aannahu maata famataa aawsaa iilayhi
verses.translation: Aswad b. Yazid reported:It was mentioned before A'isha that will had been made (by the Holy Prophet) in favour of 'Ali (as the Prophet's first caliph), whereupon she said: When did he make will in his favour? I had been providing support to him (to the Holy Prophet) with my chest (or with my lap). He asked for a tray, when he fell in my lap (relaxing his body), and I did not realise that he had breathed his last. When did he make any will in his ('Ali's) favour?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِسَعِيدٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ وَمَا يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ ثُمَّ بَكَى حَتَّى بَلَّ دَمْعُهُ الْحَصَى ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ وَمَا يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ قَالَ اشْتَدَّ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَعُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ائْتُونِي أَكْتُبْ لَكُمْ كِتَابًا لاَ تَضِلُّوا بَعْدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَتَنَازَعُوا وَمَا يَنْبَغِي عِنْدَ نَبِيٍّ تَنَازُعٌ ‏.‏ وَقَالُوا مَا شَأْنُهُ أَهَجَرَ اسْتَفْهِمُوهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ دَعُونِي فَالَّذِي أَنَا فِيهِ خَيْرٌ أُوصِيكُمْ بِثَلاَثٍ أَخْرِجُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ مِنْ جَزِيرَةِ الْعَرَبِ وَأَجِيزُوا الْوَفْدَ بِنَحْوِ مَا كُنْتُ أُجِيزُهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَسَكَتَ عَنِ الثَّالِثَةِ أَوْ قَالَهَا فَأُنْسِيتُهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu - waalllafzu lisa'iydin - qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an sulaymaana alaahwali, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala qaala abnu 'abbaasin yawmu alkhamiysi wamaa yawmu alkhamiysi thumma bakaa hattaa balla dam'uhu alhasaa ‏.‏ faqultu yaa abna 'abbaasin wamaa yawmu alkhamiysi qaala ashtadda birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waja'uhu ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aituwniy aaktub lakum kitaabana laa tadilluwa ba'diy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fatanaaza'uwa wamaa yanbaghiy 'inda nabiyyin tanaazu'un ‏.‏ waqaaluwa maa shaanuhu aahajara astafhimuwhu ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ da'uwniy faalladhiy aanaa fiyhi khayrun auwsiykum bithalaathin aakhrijuwa almushrikiyna min jaziyraai al'arabi waaajiyzuwa alwafda binahwi maa kuntu aujiyzuhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wasakata 'ani althhaalithaai aaw qaalahaa faaunsiytuhaa ‏.‏ qaala aabuw iishaaqa iibraahiymu haddathanaa alhasanu bnu bishrin, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, bihadhaa alhadiythi
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that Ibn 'Abbas said:Thursday, (and then said): What is this Thursday? He then wept so much that his tears moistened the pebbles. I said: Ibn 'Abbas, what is (significant) about Thursday? He (Ibn 'Abbas) said: The illness of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took a serious turn (on this day), and he said: Come to me, so that I should write for you a document that you may not go astray after me. They (the Companions around him) disputed, and it is not meet to dispute in the presence of the Apostle. They said: How is lie (Allah's Apostle)? Has he lost his consciousness? Try to learn from him (this point). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Leave me. I am better in the state (than the one in which you are engaged). I make a will about three things: Turn out the polytheists from the territory of Arabia; show hospitality to the (foreign) delegations as I used to show them hospitality. He (the narrator) said: He (Ibn Abbas) kept silent on the third point, or he (the narrator) said: But I forgot that. This hadith was mentioned through another chain
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ وَمَا يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ تَسِيلُ دُمُوعُهُ حَتَّى رَأَيْتُ عَلَى خَدَّيْهِ كَأَنَّهَا نِظَامُ اللُّؤْلُؤِ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ائْتُونِي بِالْكَتِفِ وَالدَّوَاةِ - أَوِ اللَّوْحِ وَالدَّوَاةِ - أَكْتُبْ لَكُمْ كِتَابًا لَنْ تَضِلُّوا بَعْدَهُ أَبَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَهْجُرُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, 'an maaliki bni mighwalin, 'an talhaaa bni musarrifin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aannahu qaala yawmu alkhamiysi wamaa yawmu alkhamiysi ‏.‏ thumma ja'ala tasiylu dumuw'uhu hattaa raaaytu 'alaa khaddayhi kaaannahaa nizaamu allluuluui ‏.‏ qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aituwniy bialkatifi waalddawaaai - aawi alllawhi waalddawaaai - aaktub lakum kitaabana lan tadilluwa ba'dahu aabadana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yahjuru ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported from Ibn Abbas that he said:Thursday, and what about Thursday? Then tears began to flow until I saw them on his cheeks as it they were the strings of pearls. He (the narrator) said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Bring me a shoulder blade and ink-pot (or tablet and inkpot), so that I write for you a document (by following which) you would never go astray. They said: Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him) is in the state of unconsciousness
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، - قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، - أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا حُضِرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَفِي الْبَيْتِ رِجَالٌ فِيهِمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلُمَّ أَكْتُبْ لَكُمْ كِتَابًا لاَ تَضِلُّونَ بَعْدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ غَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَجَعُ وَعِنْدَكُمُ الْقُرْآنُ حَسْبُنَا كِتَابُ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَاخْتَلَفَ أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ فَاخْتَصَمُوا فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ قَرِّبُوا يَكْتُبْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كِتَابًا لَنْ تَضِلُّوا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ مَا قَالَ عُمَرُ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَكْثَرُوا اللَّغْوَ وَالاِخْتِلاَفَ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قُومُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَكَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ إِنَّ الرَّزِيَّةَ كُلَّ الرَّزِيَّةِ مَا حَالَ بَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ لَهُمْ ذَلِكَ الْكِتَابَ مِنِ اخْتِلاَفِهِمْ وَلَغَطِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, - qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, - aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala lammaa hudira rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wafiy albayti rijaalun fiyhim 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ halumma aaktub lakum kitaabana laa tadilluwna ba'dahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad ghalaba 'alayhi alwaja'u wa'indakumu alquranu hasbunaa kitaabu alllahi ‏.‏ faakhtalafa aahlu albayti faakhtasamuwa faminhum man yaquwlu qarribuwa yaktub lakum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kitaabana lan tadilluwa ba'dahu ‏.‏ waminhum man yaquwlu maa qaala 'umaru ‏.‏ falammaa aaktharuwa alllaghwa waalaikhtilaafa 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ quwmuwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'ubaydu alllahi fakaana abnu 'abbaasin yaquwlu iinna alrraziyyaaa kulla alrraziyyaai maa haala bayna rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wabayna aan yaktuba lahum dhalika alkitaaba mini akhtilaafihim walaghatihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was about to leave this world, there were persons (around him) in his house, 'Umar b. al-Kbattab being one of them. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Come, I may write for you a document; you would not go astray after that. Thereupon Umar said: Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is deeply afflicted with pain. You have the Qur'an with you. The Book of Allah is sufficient for us. Those who were present in the house differed. Some of them said: Bring him (the writing material) so that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) may write a document for you and you would never go astray after him And some among them said what 'Umar had (already) said. When they indulged in nonsense and began to dispute in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he said: Get up (and go away) 'Ubaidullah said: Ibn Abbas used to say: There was a heavy loss, indeed a heavy loss, that, due to their dispute and noise. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) could not write (or dictate) the document for them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ اسْتَفْتَى سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي نَذْرٍ كَانَ عَلَى أُمِّهِ تُوُفِّيَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقْضِيَهُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ فَاقْضِهِ عَنْهَا‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, wamuhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni, 'abbaasin aannahu qaala astaftaa sa'du bnu 'ubaadaaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy nadhrin kaana 'alaa aummihi tuwuffiyat qabla aan taqdiyahu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ faaqdihi 'anhaa‏"‏ ‏.‏
