verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported that Sa'd b. Ubida asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for a decision about a vow taken by his mother who had died before fulfilling it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Fulfil it on her behalf
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ وَائِلٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، ‏.‏ بِإِسْنَادِ اللَّيْثِ وَمَعْنَى حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an bakri bni waaiilin, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, ‏.‏ biiisnaadi alllaythi wama'naa hadiythihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with a different chains of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ أَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا يَنْهَانَا عَنِ النَّذْرِ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّهُ لاَ يَرُدُّ شَيْئًا وَإِنَّمَا يُسْتَخْرَجُ بِهِ مِنَ الشَّحِيحِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala, zuhayrun haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni murraaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala aakhadha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana yanhaanaa 'ani alnnadhri wayaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinnahu laa yaruddu shayiana waiinnamaa yustakhraju bihi mina alshhahiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar reported:Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) singled out one day forbidding us to take vows and said: It would not avert anything; it is by which something is extracted from the miserly person
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، دِينَارٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ النَّذْرُ لاَ يُقَدِّمُ شَيْئًا وَلاَ يُؤَخِّرُهُ وَإِنَّمَا يُسْتَخْرَجُ بِهِ مِنَ الْبَخِيلِ ‏"‏ ‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu aabiy hakiymin, 'an sufyaana, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, diynaarin 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ alnnadhru laa yuqaddimu shayiana walaa yuuakhhiruhu waiinnamaa yustakhraju bihi mina albakhiyli ‏"‏ ‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:The vow neither hastens anything nor defers anything, but is the means whereby (something) is extracted from the miserly person
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنِ النَّذْرِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّهُ لاَ يَأْتِي بِخَيْرٍ وَإِنَّمَا يُسْتَخْرَجُ بِهِ مِنَ الْبَخِيلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an mansuwrin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni murraaa, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu nahaa 'ani alnnadhri waqaala ‏ "‏ iinnahu laa yaatiy bikhayrin waiinnamaa yustakhraju bihi mina albakhiyli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade (people) taking vows, and said:It does not (necessarily) bring good (in the form of substantial, and tangible results), but it is the meant whereby something is extracted from the miserly persons
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُفَضَّلٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa mufaddalun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu, bnu almuthannaa waabnu bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, 'an sufyaana, kilaahumaa 'an mansuwrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwa hadiythi jariyrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mansur with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَنْذُرُوا فَإِنَّ النَّذْرَ لاَ يُغْنِي مِنَ الْقَدَرِ شَيْئًا وَإِنَّمَا يُسْتَخْرَجُ بِهِ مِنَ الْبَخِيلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy alddaraawardiyya - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tandhuruwa faiinna alnnadhra laa yughniy mina alqadari shayiana waiinnamaa yustakhraju bihi mina albakhiyli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Heraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not take vows, for a vow has no effect against Fate; it is only from the miserly that something is extracted
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْعَلاَءَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنِ النَّذْرِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّهُ لاَ يَرُدُّ مِنَ الْقَدَرِ وَإِنَّمَا يُسْتَخْرَجُ بِهِ مِنَ الْبَخِيلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu al'alaa'a, yuhaddithu 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu nahaa 'ani alnnadhri waqaala ‏ "‏ iinnahu laa yaruddu mina alqadari waiinnamaa yustakhraju bihi mina albakhiyli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding taking of vows, and said:It does not avert Fate, but is the means by which something is extracted from the miser
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ عَمْرٍو، - وَهْوَ ابْنُ أَبِي عَمْرٍو - عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ النَّذْرَ لاَ يُقَرِّبُ مِنِ ابْنِ آدَمَ شَيْئًا لَمْ يَكُنِ اللَّهُ قَدَّرَهُ لَهُ وَلَكِنِ النَّذْرُ يُوَافِقُ الْقَدَرَ فَيُخْرَجُ بِذَلِكَ مِنَ الْبَخِيلِ مَا لَمْ يَكُنِ الْبَخِيلُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُخْرِجَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'an 'amrinw, - wahwa abnu aabiy 'amrinw - 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alnnadhra laa yuqarribu mini abni adama shayiana lam yakuni alllahu qaddarahu lahu walakini alnnadhru yuwaafiqu alqadara fayukhraju bidhalika mina albakhiyli maa lam yakuni albakhiylu yuriydu aan yukhrija ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:The vow does not bring anything near to the son of Adam which Allah has not ordained for him, but (at times) the vow coincides with Destiny, and this is how something is extracted from the miserly person, which that miser was not willing to give
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - وَعَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyya - wa'abdu al'aziyzi - ya'niy alddaraawardiyya - kilaahumaa 'an 'amriw bni aabiy 'amrinw bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Amr b. Abu 'Amr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، قَالَ كَانَتْ ثَقِيفُ حُلَفَاءَ لِبَنِي عُقَيْلٍ فَأَسَرَتْ ثَقِيفُ رَجُلَيْنِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَسَرَ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاً مِنْ بَنِي عُقَيْلٍ وَأَصَابُوا مَعَهُ الْعَضْبَاءَ فَأَتَى عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ فِي الْوَثَاقِ قَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ ‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا شَأْنُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ بِمَ أَخَذْتَنِي وَبِمَ أَخَذْتَ سَابِقَةَ الْحَاجِّ فَقَالَ إِعْظَامًا لِذَلِكَ ‏"‏ أَخَذْتُكَ بِجَرِيرَةِ حُلَفَائِكَ ثَقِيفَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ عَنْهُ فَنَادَاهُ فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَحِيمًا رَقِيقًا فَرَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا شَأْنُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنِّي مُسْلِمٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ قُلْتَهَا وَأَنْتَ تَمْلِكُ أَمْرَكَ أَفْلَحْتَ كُلَّ الْفَلاَحِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَنَادَاهُ فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ ‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا شَأْنُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنِّي جَائِعٌ فَأَطْعِمْنِي وَظَمْآنُ فَأَسْقِنِي ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَذِهِ حَاجَتُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَفُدِيَ بِالرَّجُلَيْنِ - قَالَ - وَأُسِرَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَأُصِيبَتِ الْعَضْبَاءُ فَكَانَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ فِي الْوَثَاقِ وَكَانَ الْقَوْمُ يُرِيحُونَ نَعَمَهُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ بُيُوتِهِمْ فَانْفَلَتَتْ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ مِنَ الْوَثَاقِ فَأَتَتِ الإِبِلَ فَجَعَلَتْ إِذَا دَنَتْ مِنَ الْبَعِيرِ رَغَا فَتَتْرُكُهُ حَتَّى تَنْتَهِيَ إِلَى الْعَضْبَاءِ فَلَمْ تَرْغُ قَالَ وَنَاقَةٌ مُنَوَّقَةٌ فَقَعَدَتْ فِي عَجُزِهَا ثُمَّ زَجَرَتْهَا فَانْطَلَقَتْ وَنَذِرُوا بِهَا فَطَلَبُوهَا فَأَعْجَزَتْهُمْ - قَالَ - وَنَذَرَتْ لِلَّهِ إِنْ نَجَّاهَا اللَّهُ عَلَيْهَا لَتَنْحَرَنَّهَا فَلَمَّا قَدِمَتِ الْمَدِينَةَ رَآهَا النَّاسُ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا الْعَضْبَاءُ نَاقَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّهَا نَذَرَتْ إِنْ نَجَّاهَا اللَّهُ عَلَيْهَا لَتَنْحَرَنَّهَا ‏.‏ فَأَتَوْا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرُوا ذَلِكَ لَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بِئْسَمَا جَزَتْهَا نَذَرَتْ لِلَّهِ إِنْ نَجَّاهَا اللَّهُ عَلَيْهَا لَتَنْحَرَنَّهَا لاَ وَفَاءَ لِنَذْرٍ فِي مَعْصِيَةٍ وَلاَ فِيمَا لاَ يَمْلِكُ الْعَبْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ حُجْرٍ ‏"‏ لاَ نَذْرَ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aabiy almuhallabi, 'an 'imraana bni husaynin, qaala kaanat thaqiyfu hulafaa'a libaniy 'uqaylin faaasarat thaqiyfu rajulayni min aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaasara aashaabu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulaan min baniy 'uqaylin waaasaabuwa ma'ahu al'adbaa'a faaataa 'alayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa fiy alwathaaqi qaala yaa muhammadu ‏.‏ faaataahu faqaala ‏"‏ maa shaanuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala bima aakhadhtaniy wabima aakhadhta saabiqaaa alhaajji faqaala ii'zaamana lidhalika ‏"‏ aakhadhtuka bijariyraai hulafaaiika thaqiyfa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma ansarafa 'anhu fanaadaahu faqaala yaa muhammadu yaa muhammadu ‏.‏ wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rahiymana raqiyqana faraja'a iilayhi faqaala ‏"‏ maa shaanuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala iinniy muslimun ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ law qultahaa waaanta tamliku aamraka aaflahta kulla alfalaahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma ansarafa fanaadaahu faqaala yaa muhammadu yaa muhammadu ‏.‏ faaataahu faqaala ‏"‏ maa shaanuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala iinniy jaaii'un faaat'imniy wazamanu faaasqiniy ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ hadhihi haajatuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fafudiya bialrrajulayni - qaala - waausirati amraaaaun mina alaansaari waausiybati al'adbaa'u fakaanati almaraaau fiy alwathaaqi wakaana alqawmu yuriyhuwna na'amahum bayna yadaa buyuwtihim faanfalatat dhaata laylaain mina alwathaaqi faaatati aliibila faja'alat iidhaa danat mina alba'iyri raghaa fatatrukuhu hattaa tantahiya iilaa al'adbaa'i falam targhu qaala wanaaqaaun munawwaqaaun faqa'adat fiy 'ajuzihaa thumma zajarathaa faantalaqat wanadhiruwa bihaa fatalabuwhaa faaa'jazathum - qaala - wanadharat lillahi iin najjaahaa alllahu 'alayhaa latanharannahaa falammaa qadimati almadiynaaa raahaa alnnaasu ‏.‏ faqaaluwa al'adbaa'u naaqaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqaalat iinnahaa nadharat iin najjaahaa alllahu 'alayhaa latanharannahaa ‏.‏ faaatawa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakaruwa dhalika lahu ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ subhaana alllahi biisamaa jazathaa nadharat lillahi iin najjaahaa alllahu 'alayhaa latanharannahaa laa wafaa'a linadhrin fiy ma'siyaain walaa fiymaa laa yamliku al'abdu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai abni hujrin ‏"‏ laa nadhra fiy ma'siyaai alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Imran b. Husain reported that the tribe of Thaqif was the ally of Banu 'Uqail. Thaqif took two persons from amongst the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as prisoners. The Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took one person at Banu Uqail as prisoner, and captured al-'Adbi (the she-camel of the Holy Prophet) along with him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to him and he was tied with ropes. He said:Muhammad. He came near him and said: What is the matter with you? Thereupon he (the prisoner) said: Why have you taken me as prisoner and why have you caught hold of one proceeding the pilgrims (the she-camel as she carried the Prophet on her back and walked ahead of the multitude)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: (Yours is a great fault). I (my men) have caught hold of you for the crime of your allies, Banu Thaqif. He (the Holy Prophet) then turned away. He again called him and said: Muhammad, Muhammad, and since Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was very compassionate, and tenderhearted, he returned to him, and said: What is the matter with you? He said: I am a Muslim, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Had you said this when you had been the master of yourself, you would have gained every success. He then turned away. He (the prisoner) called him again saying: Muhammad, Muhammad. He came to him and said: What is the matter with you? He said: I am hungry, feed me, and I am thirsty, so provide me with drink. He (the Holy Prophet) said: That is (to satisfy) your want. He was then ransomed for two persons (who had been taken prisoner by Thaqif). He (the narrator) said: A woman of the Ansar had been taken prisoner and also al-Adbi' was caught. The woman had been tied with ropes. The people were giving rest to their animals before their houses. She escaped one night from the bondage and came to the camels. As she drew near the camels, they fretted and fumed and so she left them until she came to al-, Adbi'. It did not fret and fume; it was docile She rode upon its back and drove it away and she went off. When they (the enemies of Islam) were warned of this, they went in search of it, but it (the she-camel) exhausted them. She (the woman) took vow for Allah, that in case He would save her through it, she would offer that as a sacrifice. As she reached Medina, the people saw her and they said: Here is al-Adbi, the she-camel of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). She (the woman) said that she had taken a vow that if Allah would save her on its back, she would sacrifice it. They (the Prophet's Companions) came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said: Hallowed be Allah, how ill she rewarded it that she took vow to Allah that if He saves her on its back, she would sacrifice it! There is no fulfillment of the vow in an act of disobedience, nor in an act over which a person has no control. In the version of Ibn Hujr (the words are):" There is no vow in disobedience to Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيِّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ وَفِي حَدِيثِ حَمَّادٍ قَالَ كَانَتِ الْعَضْبَاءُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي عُقَيْلٍ وَكَانَتْ مِنْ سَوَابِقِ الْحَاجِّ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِ أَيْضًا فَأَتَتْ عَلَى نَاقِةٍ ذَلُولٍ مُجَرَّسَةٍ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ الثَّقَفِيِّ وَهِيَ نَاقَةٌ مُدَرَّبَةٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun ya'niy abna zaydin, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara 'an 'abdi alwahhaabi althhaqafiyyi, kilaahumaa 'an aayyuwba, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu wafiy hadiythi hammaadin qaala kaanati al'adbaa'u lirajulin min baniy 'uqaylin wakaanat min sawaabiqi alhaajji wafiy hadiythihi aaydana faaatat 'alaa naaqiain dhaluwlin mujarrasaain ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi althhaqafiyyi wahiya naaqaaun mudarrabaaun ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Ayyub with the same chain of transmitters and a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، حَدَّثَنِي ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَىَ شَيْخًا يُهَادَى بَيْنَ ابْنَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَالُ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَذَرَ أَنْ يَمْشِيَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَنْ تَعْذِيبِ هَذَا نَفْسَهُ لَغَنِيٌّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَرْكَبَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'an humaydin, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, h. wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa marwaanu bnu mu'aawiyaaa alfazaariyyu, haddathanaa humaydun, haddathaniy thaabitun, 'an aanasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaaa shaykhana yuhaadaa bayna abnayhi faqaala ‏"‏ maa baalu hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa nadhara aan yamshiya ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha 'an ta'dhiybi hadhaa nafsahu laghaniyyun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaamarahu aan yarkaba ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saw an old man being supported between his two sons. He (the Holy Prophet) said:What is the matter with him? They said: He had taken the vow to walk (on foot to the Ka'ba). Thereupon he (Allah's Apoitle) said: Allah is indifferent to his inflicting upon himself chastisement, and he commanded him to ride
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ عَمْرٍو، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي عَمْرٍو - عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَدْرَكَ شَيْخًا يَمْشِي بَيْنَ ابْنَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّأُ عَلَيْهِمَا فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا شَأْنُ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنَاهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ نَذْرٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ارْكَبْ أَيُّهَا الشَّيْخُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْكَ وَعَنْ نَذْرِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَاللَّفْظُ لِقُتَيْبَةَ وَابْنِ حُجْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'an 'amrinw, - wahuwa abnu aabiy 'amrinw - 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aadraka shaykhana yamshiy bayna abnayhi yatawakkaau 'alayhimaa faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa shaanu hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnaahu yaa rasuwla alllahi kaana 'alayhi nadhrun ‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ arkab aayyuhaa alshhaykhu faiinna alllaha ghaniyyun 'anka wa'an nadhrika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waalllafzu liqutaybaaa waabni hujrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) found an old man walking between his two sons supported by them, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: What is the matter with him? He (the narrator) said: Allah's Messenger, they are his sons and there is upon him the (fulfilment) of the vow, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Ride, old man, for Allah is not in need of you and your vow
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنْ عَمْرِو، بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy alddaraawardiyya - 'an 'amriw, bni aabiy 'amrinw bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Amr b. Abu 'Amr with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ صَالِحٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُفَضَّلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ فَضَالَةَ - حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ نَذَرَتْ أُخْتِي أَنْ تَمْشِيَ، إِلَى بَيْتِ اللَّهِ حَافِيَةً فَأَمَرَتْنِي أَنْ أَسْتَفْتِيَ لَهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَفْتَيْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لِتَمْشِ وَلْتَرْكَبْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu yahyaa bni saalihin almisriyyu, haddathanaa almufaddalu, - ya'niy abna fadaalaaa - haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'ayyaashin, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an aabiy alkhayri, 'an 'uqbaaa bni 'aamirin, aannahu qaala nadharat aukhtiy aan tamshiya, iilaa bayti alllahi haafiyaaan faaamaratniy aan aastaftiya lahaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faastaftaytuhu faqaala ‏ "‏ litamshi waltarkab ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Uqba b. Amir reported:My sister took a vow that she would walk bare foot to the house of Allah (Ka'ba). She asked me to inquire from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it. I sought his decision and he said: She should walk on foot and ride also
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَيُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالَ يُونُسُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ، عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ شُمَاسَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ كَفَّارَةُ النَّذْرِ كَفَّارَةُ الْيَمِينِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, wayuwnusu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, qaala yuwnusu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an ka'bi bni, 'alqamaaa 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni shumaasaaa, 'an aabiy alkhayri, 'an 'uqbaaa bni 'aamirin, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ kaffaaraau alnnadhri kaffaaraau alyamiyni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Uqba. b. Amir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The expiation of the (breach of) a vow is the same as that of the (breach of an oath)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَنْهَاكُمْ أَنْ تَحْلِفُوا بِآبَائِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا حَلَفْتُ بِهَا مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْهَا ذَاكِرًا وَلاَ آثِرًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amriw bni sarhin haddathanaa abnu wahbin, 'an yuwnusa, h wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimi bni, 'abdi alllahi 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu 'umara bna alkhattaabi, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha 'azza wajalla yanhaakum aan tahlifuwa biabaaiikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'umaru fawaalllahi maa halaftu bihaa mundhu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'anhaa dhaakirana walaa athirana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umar b. al-Khattib reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Allah, the Great and Majestic, forbids you to swear by your fathers. Umar said: By Allah. I have never sworn (by my father) since I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding it mentioning them" on my behalf" nor on behalf of someone else
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ، خَالِدٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ عُقَيْلٍ مَا حَلَفْتُ بِهَا مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَى عَنْهَا وَلاَ تَكَلَّمْتُ بِهَا ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ ذَاكِرًا وَلاَ آثِرًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu, khaalidin h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi 'uqaylin maa halaftu bihaa mundhu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yanhaa 'anhaa walaa takallamtu bihaa ‏.‏ walam yaqul dhaakirana walaa athirana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri except that in the hadith narrated on the authority of Uqail the words are:" I did not take oath by (anyone else except Allah) since I heard Allah's Messenger forbidding it. nor did I speak in such terms, and the narrator did not say," on my own behalf or on behalf of someone else
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عُمَرَ وَهُوَ يَحْلِفُ بِأَبِيهِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ رِوَايَةِ يُونُسَ وَمَعْمَرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, bnu 'uyaynaaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'umara wahuwa yahlifu biaabiyhi ‏.‏ bimithli riwaayaai yuwnusa wama'marin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) heard 'Umar while he was taking oath by his father. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ أَدْرَكَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فِي رَكْبٍ وَعُمَرُ يَحْلِفُ بِأَبِيهِ فَنَادَاهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَلاَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَنْهَاكُمْ أَنْ تَحْلِفُوا بِآبَائِكُمْ فَمَنْ كَانَ حَالِفًا فَلْيَحْلِفْ بِاللَّهِ أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ ‏"‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu aadraka 'umara bna alkhattaabi fiy rakbin wa'umaru yahlifu biaabiyhi fanaadaahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aalaa iinna alllaha 'azza wajalla yanhaakum aan tahlifuwa biabaaiikum faman kaana haalifana falyahlif bialllahi aaw liyasmut ‏"‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Umar) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) found, Umar b. al-Khattab amongst the riders and he was taking oath by his father Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called them (saying) ; Our Allah, the Exated and Majestic, has forbidden you that you take oath by your father. He who bag to take an oath, he must take it by Allah or keep quiet
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ، رَافِعٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْكَرِيمِ، ‏.‏ كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، بِمِثْلِ هَذِهِ الْقِصَّةِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathaniy bishru bnu hilaalin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'ani alwaliydi bni kathiyrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aumayyaaa, h wahaddathanaa abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku, waabnu aabiy dhiibin, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu, raafi'in 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'abdu alkariymi, ‏.‏ kullu hauulaa'i 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, bimithli hadhihi alqissaai 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ كَانَ حَالِفًا فَلاَ يَحْلِفْ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَكَانَتْ قُرَيْشٌ تَحْلِفُ بِآبَائِهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَحْلِفُوا بِآبَائِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wayahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaala yahyaa bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, aannahu sami'a abna 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man kaana haalifana falaa yahlif iilaaa bialllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wakaanat qurayshun tahlifu biabaaiihaa faqaala ‏"‏ laa tahlifuwa biabaaiikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who has to take an oath, he must not take oath but by Allah. The Quraish used to take oath by their fathers. So he (the Holy Prophet) said: Do not take oath by your fathers
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ مِنْكُمْ فَقَالَ فِي حَلِفِهِ بِاللاَّتِ ‏.‏ فَلْيَقُلْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ وَمَنْ قَالَ لِصَاحِبِهِ تَعَالَ أُقَامِرْكَ ‏.‏ فَلْيَتَصَدَّقْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, 'an yuwnusa, h wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy humaydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man halafa minkum faqaala fiy halifihi biallaaati ‏.‏ falyaqul laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏.‏ waman qaala lisaahibihi ta'aala auqaamirka ‏.‏ falyatasaddaq ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who takes an oath in the course of which he says: By Lat (and al-'Uzza), he should say: There is no god but Allah; and that if anyone says to his friend:" Come and I will gamble with you," he should pay sadaqa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَحَدِيثُ مَعْمَرٍ مِثْلُ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلْيَتَصَدَّقْ بِشَىْءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ ‏"‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ بِاللاَّتِ وَالْعُزَّى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو الْحُسَيْنِ مُسْلِمٌ هَذَا الْحَرْفُ - يَعْنِي قَوْلَهُ تَعَالَ أُقَامِرْكَ ‏.‏ فَلْيَتَصَدَّقْ - لاَ يَرْوِيهِ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ وَلِلزُّهْرِيِّ نَحْوٌ مِنْ تِسْعِينَ حَدِيثًا يَرْوِيهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ يُشَارِكُهُ فِيهِ أَحَدٌ بِأَسَانِيدَ جِيَادٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma wa'abdu bnu humaydin qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wahadiythu ma'marin mithlu hadiythi yuwnusa ghayra aannahu qaala ‏"‏ falyatasaddaq bishaa'in ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi alaawzaa'iyyi ‏"‏ man halafa biallaaati waal'uzzaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw alhusayni muslimun hadhaa alharfu - ya'niy qawlahu ta'aala auqaamirka ‏.‏ falyatasaddaq - laa yarwiyhi aahadun ghayru alzzuhriyyi qaala walilzzuhriyyi nahwun min tis'iyna hadiythana yarwiyhi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm laa yushaarikuhu fiyhi aahadun biaasaaniyda jiyaadin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَحْلِفُوا بِالطَّوَاغِي وَلاَ بِآبَائِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, 'an hishaamin, 'ani alhasani, 'an 'abdi, alrrahmani bni samuraaa qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tahlifuwa bialttawaaghiy walaa biabaaiikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. Samura reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not swear by idols, nor by your fathers
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِخَلَفٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ غَيْلاَنَ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، الأَشْعَرِيِّ قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَهْطٍ مِنَ الأَشْعَرِيِّينَ نَسْتَحْمِلُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَحْمِلُكُمْ وَمَا عِنْدِي مَا أَحْمِلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَبِثْنَا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِإِبِلٍ فَأَمَرَ لَنَا بِثَلاَثِ ذَوْدٍ غُرِّ الذُّرَى فَلَمَّا انْطَلَقْنَا قُلْنَا - أَوْ قَالَ بَعْضُنَا لِبَعْضٍ - لاَ يُبَارِكُ اللَّهُ لَنَا أَتَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَسْتَحْمِلُهُ فَحَلَفَ أَنْ لاَ يَحْمِلَنَا ثُمَّ حَمَلَنَا ‏.‏ فَأَتَوْهُ فَأَخْبَرُوهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَنَا حَمَلْتُكُمْ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ حَمَلَكُمْ وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لاَ أَحْلِفُ عَلَى يَمِينٍ ثُمَّ أَرَى خَيْرًا مِنْهَا إِلاَّ كَفَّرْتُ عَنْ يَمِينِي وَأَتَيْتُ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wayahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, - waalllafzu likhalafin - qaaluwa haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an ghaylaana bni jariyrin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, alaash'ariyyi qaala aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy rahtin mina alaash'ariyyiyna nastahmiluhu faqaala ‏"‏ waalllahi laa aahmilukum wamaa 'indiy maa aahmilukum 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala falabithnaa maa shaa'a alllahu thumma autiya biiibilin faaamara lanaa bithalaathi dhawdin ghurri aldhhuraa falammaa antalaqnaa qulnaa - aaw qaala ba'dunaa liba'din - laa yubaariku alllahu lanaa aataynaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nastahmiluhu fahalafa aan laa yahmilanaa thumma hamalanaa ‏.‏ faaatawhu faaakhbaruwhu faqaala ‏"‏ maa aanaa hamaltukum walakinna alllaha hamalakum waiinniy waalllahi iin shaa'a alllahu laa aahlifu 'alaa yamiynin thumma aaraa khayrana minhaa iilaaa kaffartu 'an yamiyniy waaataytu alladhiy huwa khayrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari reported:I came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) along with a group of Ash'arites requesting to give us a mount. He (the Holy Prophet) said: By Allah, I cannot provide you with a mount, and there is nothing with me which I should give you as a ride. He (the narrator) said: We stayed there as long as Allah willed. Then there were brought to him (to the Holy Prophet) camels. He (the Holy Prophet) then ordered to give us three white humped camels, We started and said (or some of us said to the others): Allah will not bless us. We came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) begging him to provide us with riding camels. He swore that he could not provide us with a mount, but later on he provided us with that. They (some of the Prophet's Companions) came and informed him about this (rankling of theirs), whereupon he said: It was not I who provided you with a mount, but Allah has provided you with that. So far as I am concerned, by Allah, if He so wills, I would not swear, but if, later on, I would see better than it, I (would break the vow) and expiate it and do that which is better
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بَرَّادٍ الأَشْعَرِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، - وَتَقَارَبَا فِي اللَّفْظِ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ أَرْسَلَنِي أَصْحَابِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَسْأَلُهُ لَهُمُ الْحُمْلاَنَ إِذْ هُمْ مَعَهُ فِي جَيْشِ الْعُسْرَةِ - وَهِيَ غَزْوَةُ تَبُوكَ - فَقُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَصْحَابِي أَرْسَلُونِي إِلَيْكَ لِتَحْمِلَهُمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَحْمِلُكُمْ عَلَى شَىْءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَوَافَقْتُهُ وَهُوَ غَضْبَانُ وَلاَ أَشْعُرُ فَرَجَعْتُ حَزِينًا مِنْ مَنْعِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمِنْ مَخَافَةِ أَنْ يَكُونَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ وَجَدَ فِي نَفْسِهِ عَلَىَّ فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَى أَصْحَابِي فَأَخْبَرْتُهُمُ الَّذِي قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ أَلْبَثْ إِلاَّ سُوَيْعَةً إِذْ سَمِعْتُ بِلاَلاً يُنَادِي أَىْ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ ‏.‏ فَأَجَبْتُهُ فَقَالَ أَجِبْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْعُوكَ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ خُذْ هَذَيْنِ الْقَرِينَيْنِ وَهَذَيْنِ الْقَرِينَيْنِ وَهَذَيْنِ الْقَرِينَيْنِ - لِسِتَّةِ أَبْعِرَةٍ ابْتَاعَهُنَّ حِينَئِذٍ مِنْ سَعْدٍ - فَانْطَلِقْ بِهِنَّ إِلَى أَصْحَابِكَ فَقُلْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ - أَوْ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - يَحْمِلُكُمْ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ فَارْكَبُوهُنَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى فَانْطَلَقْتُ إِلَى أَصْحَابِي بِهِنَّ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَحْمِلُكُمْ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ وَلَكِنْ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَدَعُكُمْ حَتَّى يَنْطَلِقَ مَعِي بَعْضُكُمْ إِلَى مَنْ سَمِعَ مَقَالَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ سَأَلْتُهُ لَكُمْ وَمَنْعَهُ فِي أَوَّلِ مَرَّةٍ ثُمَّ إِعْطَاءَهُ إِيَّاىَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ لاَ تَظُنُّوا أَنِّي حَدَّثْتُكُمْ شَيْئًا لَمْ يَقُلْهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا لِي وَاللَّهِ إِنَّكَ عِنْدَنَا لَمُصَدَّقٌ وَلَنَفْعَلَنَّ مَا أَحْبَبْتَ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ أَبُو مُوسَى بِنَفَرٍ مِنْهُمْ حَتَّى أَتَوُا الَّذِينَ سَمِعُوا قَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَنْعَهُ إِيَّاهُمْ ثُمَّ إِعْطَاءَهُمْ بَعْدُ فَحَدَّثُوهُمْ بِمَا حَدَّثَهُمْ بِهِ أَبُو مُوسَى سَوَاءً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu barraadin alaash'ariyyu, wamuhammadu bnu al'alaa'i alhamdaaniyyu, - wataqaarabaa fiy alllafzi - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala aarsalaniy aashaabiy iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aasaaluhu lahumu alhumlaana iidh hum ma'ahu fiy jayshi al'usraai - wahiya ghazwaau tabuwka - faqultu yaa nabiyya alllahi iinna aashaabiy aarsaluwniy iilayka litahmilahum ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ waalllahi laa aahmilukum 'alaa shaa'in ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wawaafaqtuhu wahuwa ghadbaanu walaa aash'uru faraja'tu haziynana min man'i rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wamin makhaafaai aan yakuwna rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad wajada fiy nafsihi 'alaaaa faraja'tu iilaa aashaabiy faaakhbartuhumu alladhiy qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falam aalbath iilaaa suway'aaan iidh sami'tu bilaalaan yunaadiy aaa 'abda alllahi bna qaysin ‏.‏ faaajabtuhu faqaala aajib rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yad'uwka ‏.‏ falammaa aataytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ khudh hadhayni alqariynayni wahadhayni alqariynayni wahadhayni alqariynayni - lisittaai aab'iraain abtaa'ahunna hiynaiidhin min sa'din - faantaliq bihinna iilaa aashaabika faqul iinna alllaha - aaw qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - yahmilukum 'alaa hauulaa'i faarkabuwhunna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw muwsaa faantalaqtu iilaa aashaabiy bihinna faqultu iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yahmilukum 'alaa hauulaa'i walakin waalllahi laa aada'ukum hattaa yantaliqa ma'iy ba'dukum iilaa man sami'a maqaalaaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna saaaltuhu lakum waman'ahu fiy aawwali marraain thumma ii'taa'ahu iiyyaaaa ba'da dhalika laa tazunnuwa aanniy haddathtukum shayiana lam yaqulhu ‏.‏ faqaaluwa liy waalllahi iinnaka 'indanaa lamusaddaqun walanaf'alanna maa aahbabta ‏.‏ faantalaqa aabuw muwsaa binafarin minhum hattaa aatawua alladhiyna sami'uwa qawla rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waman'ahu iiyyaahum thumma ii'taa'ahum ba'du fahaddathuwhum bimaa haddathahum bihi aabuw muwsaa sawaa'an ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported:My friends sent me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asking him to provide them with mounts as they were going along with him in jaish al-'Usrah (the army of destitutes or of meagre means or army setting out during the hard times and that is the occasion of the expedition of Tabuk) I said: Apostle of Allah, my friends have sent me to you so that you may provide them with mounts. He (the Holy Prophet) said: By Allah, I cannot provide you with anything to ride. And it so happened that he was at that time much perturbed. I little knew of it, so I came back with a heavy heart on account of the refusal of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and the fear that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) might have some feelings against me. I returned to my friends and informed them about what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said. I had hardly stayed for a little that I heard Bilal calling: 'Abdullah b. Qais. I responded to his call. He said: Hasten to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he is calling you, When I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) he said: Take this pair, this pair, and this pair (i. e. six camels which he had bought from Sa'd), and take them to y, our friends and say: Verily Allah (or he said: Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has provided you with these animals. So ride upon them. Abu Musa said: I went along with them to my friends and said: Verily Allah's messenger (ﷺ) has provided you with these animals for riding; but by Allah, I shall not leave you until some of you go along with me to him who had heard the talk of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then I asked him for you, and his refusal for the first time, and then his granting them to me subsequently; so you should not think that I narrated to you something which he did not say. They said to me: By Allah, in our opinion you are certainly truthful, and we would do as you like. So Abu Musa went along withsome of the menfrom them until they came to those who had heard the words of Allah's Messenger (may, peace be upon him) and his refusal to (provide) them with (animals) ; and subsequently his granting (the animals) to them; and they narrated to them exactly as Abu Masa had narrated to them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي، قِلاَبَةَ وَعَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ زَهْدَمٍ الْجَرْمِيِّ، - قَالَ أَيُّوبُ وَأَنَا لِحَدِيثِ الْقَاسِمِ، أَحْفَظُ مِنِّي لِحَدِيثِ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ - قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ أَبِي مُوسَى فَدَعَا بِمَائِدَتِهِ وَعَلَيْهَا لَحْمُ دَجَاجٍ فَدَخَلَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي تَيْمِ اللَّهِ أَحْمَرُ شَبِيهٌ بِالْمَوَالِي فَقَالَ لَهُ هَلُمَّ ‏.‏ فَتَلَكَّأَ فَقَالَ هَلُمَّ فَإِنِّي قَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُهُ يَأْكُلُ شَيْئًا فَقَذِرْتُهُ فَحَلَفْتُ أَنْ لاَ أَطْعَمَهُ فَقَالَ هَلُمَّ أُحَدِّثْكَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ إِنِّي أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَهْطٍ مِنَ الأَشْعَرِيِّينَ نَسْتَحْمِلُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَحْمِلُكُمْ وَمَا عِنْدِي مَا أَحْمِلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَبِثْنَا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَأُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَهْبِ إِبِلٍ فَدَعَا بِنَا فَأَمَرَ لَنَا بِخَمْسِ ذَوْدٍ غُرِّ الذُّرَى قَالَ فَلَمَّا انْطَلَقْنَا قَالَ بَعْضُنَا لِبَعْضٍ أَغْفَلْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمِينَهُ لاَ يُبَارَكُ لَنَا ‏.‏ فَرَجَعْنَا إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا أَتَيْنَاكَ نَسْتَحْمِلُكَ وَإِنَّكَ حَلَفْتَ أَنْ لاَ تَحْمِلَنَا ثُمَّ حَمَلْتَنَا أَفَنَسِيتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي وَاللَّهِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لاَ أَحْلِفُ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَأَرَى غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا إِلاَّ أَتَيْتُ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ وَتَحَلَّلْتُهَا فَانْطَلِقُوا فَإِنَّمَا حَمَلَكُمُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, - ya'niy abna zaydin - 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy, qilaabaaa wa'ani alqaasimi bni 'aasimin, 'an zahdamin aljarmiyyi, - qaala aayyuwbu waaanaa lihadiythi alqaasimi, aahfazu minniy lihadiythi aabiy qilaabaaa - qaala kunnaa 'inda aabiy muwsaa fada'aa bimaaiidatihi wa'alayhaa lahmu dajaajin fadakhala rajulun min baniy taymi alllahi aahmaru shabiyhun bialmawaaliy faqaala lahu halumma ‏.‏ fatalakkaaa faqaala halumma faiinniy qad raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaakulu minhu ‏.‏ faqaala alrrajulu iinniy raaaytuhu yaakulu shayiana faqadhirtuhu fahalaftu aan laa aat'amahu faqaala halumma auhaddithka 'an dhalika iinniy aataytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy rahtin mina alaash'ariyyiyna nastahmiluhu faqaala ‏"‏ waalllahi laa aahmilukum wamaa 'indiy maa aahmilukum 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falabithnaa maa shaa'a alllahu faautiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahbi iibilin fada'aa binaa faaamara lanaa bikhamsi dhawdin ghurri aldhhuraa qaala falammaa antalaqnaa qaala ba'dunaa liba'din aaghfalnaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yamiynahu laa yubaaraku lanaa ‏.‏ faraja'naa iilayhi faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaa aataynaaka nastahmiluka waiinnaka halafta aan laa tahmilanaa thumma hamaltanaa aafanasiyta yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ iinniy waalllahi iin shaa'a alllahu laa aahlifu 'alaa yamiynin faaaraa ghayrahaa khayrana minhaa iilaaa aataytu alladhiy huwa khayrun watahallaltuhaa faantaliquwa faiinnamaa hamalakumu alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ayyub said:We were sitting in the company of Abu Musa that he called for food and it consisted of flesh of fowl. It was then that a person from Banu Tamim visited him. His complexion was red having the resemblance of a slave. He said to him: Come and (join me in food). He showed reluctance. He (Abu Masa) said: Come on, for I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eating it (fowl's meat), whereupon that person said: I saw it eating something (of filth and rubbish) and I found it repugnant and took an oath that I would never eat that. He (Abu Muds) said: Come, so that I would narrate to you about that (the incident pertaining to vow). (And he narrated thus): I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with a group of people belonging to the tribe of Ash'ari, asking him to provide us with riding camels. He (the Holy Prophet) said: By Allah, I cannot provide you with riding animals. And there is nothing with me with which I can provide you a mount. We stayed (for some time) there as Allah willed, and there was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) booty of camels. He called us and commanded that we should be given five white humped camels. As we were about to go back, some of us said to the other: As we made Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forget oath, there would be no blessing for us (in his gift). We went back to him and said: Allah's Messenger, we came to you to provide us with riding animals and you took an oath that you would never equip us with mounts and then you have provided us with the riding beasts Allah's Messenger, have you forgotten? Thereupon he said: I swear by Allah that if Allah so wills, I shall not swear an oath, and then consider something else to be better than it without making atonement for my oath and doing the thing that is better. So you go; Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, has given you riding animals
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، وَالْقَاسِمِ، التَّمِيمِيِّ عَنْ زَهْدَمٍ الْجَرْمِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ بَيْنَ هَذَا الْحَىِّ مِنْ جَرْمٍ وَبَيْنَ الأَشْعَرِيِّينَ وُدٌّ وَإِخَاءٌ فَكُنَّا عِنْدَ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ فَقُرِّبَ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامٌ فِيهِ لَحْمُ دَجَاجٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi althhaqafiyyu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, waalqaasimi, alttamiymiyyi 'an zahdamin aljarmiyyi, qaala kaana bayna hadhaa alhaaai min jarmin wabayna alaash'ariyyiyna wuddun waiikhaa'un fakunnaa 'inda aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi faqurriba iilayhi ta'aamun fiyhi lahmu dajaajin ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Musa al-Ash'ari with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ التَّمِيمِيِّ، عَنْ زَهْدَمٍ الْجَرْمِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ زَهْدَمٍ الْجَرْمِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، وَالْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ زَهْدَمٍ الْجَرْمِيِّ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ أَبِي مُوسَى ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصُّوا جَمِيعًا الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu, numayrin 'an iismaa'iyla, abni 'ulayyaaa 'an aayyuwba, 'ani alqaasimi alttamiymiyyi, 'an zahdamin aljarmiyyi, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an zahdamin aljarmiyyi, h wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa 'affaanu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, waalqaasimi, 'an zahdamin aljarmiyyi, qaala kunnaa 'inda aabiy muwsaa ‏.‏ waaqtassuwa jamiy'ana alhadiytha bima'naa hadiythi hammaadi bni zaydin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zahdam al-Jarmi reported:We were in the company of Abu Musa. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا الصَّعْقُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَزْنٍ - حَدَّثَنَا مَطَرٌ الْوَرَّاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا زَهْدَمٌ الْجَرْمِيُّ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي مُوسَى وَهُوَ يَأْكُلُ لَحْمَ دَجَاجٍ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ وَزَادَ فِيهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي وَاللَّهِ مَا نَسِيتُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa alssa'qu, - ya'niy abna haznin - haddathanaa matarun alwarraaqu, haddathanaa zahdamun aljarmiyyu, qaala dakhaltu 'alaa aabiy muwsaa wahuwa yaakulu lahma dajaajin wasaaqa alhadiytha binahwi hadiythihim wazaada fiyhi qaala ‏ "‏ iinniy waalllahi maa nasiytuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zahdam al-Jarmi reported:I visited Abu Musa and lie was eating fowl's meat. The rest of the hadith is the same with this addition that he (the Holy Prophet) said: By Allah, I did not forget it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ ضُرَيْبِ بْنِ، نُقَيْرٍ الْقَيْسِيِّ عَنْ زَهْدَمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ أَتَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَسْتَحْمِلُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا عِنْدِي مَا أَحْمِلُكُمْ وَاللَّهِ مَا أَحْمِلُكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ بَعَثَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِثَلاَثَةِ ذَوْدٍ بُقْعِ الذُّرَى فَقُلْنَا إِنَّا أَتَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَسْتَحْمِلُهُ فَحَلَفَ أَنْ لاَ يَحْمِلَنَا فَأَتَيْنَاهُ فَأَخْبَرْنَاهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي لاَ أَحْلِفُ عَلَى يَمِينٍ أَرَى غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا إِلاَّ أَتَيْتُ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an sulaymaana alttaymiyyi, 'an duraybi bni, nuqayrin alqaysiyyi 'an zahdamin, 'an aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi, qaala aataynaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nastahmiluhu faqaala ‏"‏ maa 'indiy maa aahmilukum waalllahi maa aahmilukum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma ba'atha iilaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bithalaathaai dhawdin buq'i aldhhuraa faqulnaa iinnaa aataynaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nastahmiluhu fahalafa aan laa yahmilanaa faaataynaahu faaakhbarnaahu faqaala ‏"‏ iinniy laa aahlifu 'alaa yamiynin aaraa ghayrahaa khayrana minhaa iilaaa aataytu alladhiy huwa khayrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari reported:We came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) requesting him to provide us with riding camels. He (the Holy Prophet) said: There is nothing with me with which I should equip you. By Allah, I would not provide you with (riding camels). Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent to us three camels with spotted bumps. We said: We came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asking him to equip us with riding animals. He took an oath that he could not equip us. We came to him and informed him. He said: By Allah, I do not take an oath, but when I find the other thing better than that, I do that which is better
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو السَّلِيلِ، عَنْ زَهْدَمٍ، يُحَدِّثُهُ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ كُنَّا مُشَاةً فَأَتَيْنَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَسْتَحْمِلُهُ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa alttaymiyyu, haddathanaa almu'tamiru, 'an aabiyhi, haddathanaa aabuw alssaliyli, 'an zahdamin, yuhaddithuhu 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala kunnaa mushaaaan faaataynaa nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nastahmiluhu ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythi jariyrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported:We walked on foot and came to Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) asking him to provide us with mounts. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أَعْتَمَ رَجُلٌ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فَوَجَدَ الصِّبْيَةَ قَدْ نَامُوا فَأَتَاهُ أَهْلُهُ بِطَعَامِهِ فَحَلَفَ لاَ يَأْكُلُ مِنْ أَجْلِ صِبْيَتِهِ ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُ فَأَكَلَ فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَرَأَى غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا فَلْيَأْتِهَا وَلْيُكَفِّرْ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa marwaanu bnu mu'aawiyaaa alfazaariyyu, aakhbaranaa yaziydu bnu kaysaana, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala aa'tama rajulun 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma raja'a iilaa aahlihi fawajada alssibyaaa qad naamuwa faaataahu aahluhu bita'aamihi fahalafa laa yaakulu min aajli sibyatihi thumma badaa lahu faaakala faaataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara dhalika lahu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man halafa 'alaa yamiynin faraaaa ghayrahaa khayrana minhaa falyaatihaa walyukaffir 'an yamiynihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:A person sat late in the night with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and then came to his family and found that his children had gone to sleep. His wife brought food for him. but he took an oath that he would not eat because of his children (having gone to sleep without food) He then gave precedence (of breaking the vow and then expiating it) and ate the food He then came to Allah s Messenger (ﷺ) and made mention of that to him, whereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) said: He who took an oath and (later on) found something better than that should do that, and expiate for (breaking) his vow
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي، صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَرَأَى غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا فَلْيُكَفِّرْ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَلْيَفْعَلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy maalikun, 'an suhayli bni aabiy, saalihin 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man halafa 'alaa yamiynin faraaaa ghayrahaa khayrana minhaa falyukaffir 'an yamiynihi walyaf'al ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who took an oath and then found another thing better than (this) should expiate for the oath (broken) by him and do (the better thing)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي أُوَيْسٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُطَّلِبِ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَرَأَى غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا فَلْيَأْتِ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ وَلْيُكَفِّرْ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy auwaysin, haddathaniy 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu almuttalibi, 'an suhayli bni aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man halafa 'alaa yamiynin faraaaa ghayrahaa khayrana minhaa falyaati alladhiy huwa khayrun walyukaffir 'an yamiynihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who took an oath and (later on) found another thing better than that, he should do that which is better, and expiate for the vow (broken by him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - حَدَّثَنِي سُهَيْلٌ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ ‏ "‏ فَلْيُكَفِّرْ يَمِينَهُ وَلْيَفْعَلِ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy alqaasimu bnu zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, haddathaniy sulaymaanu, - ya'niy abna bilaalin - haddathaniy suhaylun, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi bima'naa hadiythi maalikin ‏ "‏ falyukaffir yamiynahu walyaf'ali alladhiy huwa khayrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters (with these words):" He should expiate for (breaking) the vow and do that which is better
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ رُفَيْعٍ - عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ طَرَفَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَ سَائِلٌ إِلَى عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ فَسَأَلَهُ نَفَقَةً فِي ثَمَنِ خَادِمٍ أَوْ فِي بَعْضِ ثَمَنِ خَادِمٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَيْسَ عِنْدِي مَا أُعْطِيكَ إِلاَّ دِرْعِي وَمِغْفَرِي فَأَكْتُبُ إِلَى أَهْلِي أَنْ يُعْطُوكَهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمْ يَرْضَ فَغَضِبَ عَدِيٌّ فَقَالَ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لاَ أُعْطِيكَ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ رَضِيَ فَقَالَ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَوْلاَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ ثُمَّ رَأَى أَتْقَى لِلَّهِ مِنْهَا فَلْيَأْتِ التَّقْوَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ مَا حَنَّثْتُ يَمِينِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, - ya'niy abna rufay'in - 'an tamiymi bni tarafaaa, qaala jaa'a saaiilun iilaa 'adiyyi bni haatimin fasaaalahu nafaqaaan fiy thamani khaadimin aaw fiy ba'di thamani khaadimin ‏.‏ faqaala laysa 'indiy maa au'tiyka iilaaa dir'iy wamighfariy faaaktubu iilaa aahliy aan yu'tuwkahaa ‏.‏ qaala falam yarda faghadiba 'adiyyun faqaala aamaa waalllahi laa au'tiyka shayiana thumma iinna alrrajula radiya faqaala aamaa waalllahi lawlaa aanniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man halafa 'alaa yamiynin thumma raaaa aatqaa lillahi minhaa falyaati alttaqwaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ maa hannathtu yamiyniy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Tamim b. Tarafa reported:A beggar came to 'Adi b. Hatim and he begged him to give him the price of a slave, or some portion of the price of the slave. He ('Adi) said: I have nothing to give you except my coat-of-mail and helmet. I will, however, write to my family to give that to you, but he did not agree to that. Thereupon 'Adi was enraged, and said: By Allah, I will not give you anything. The person (then) agreed to accept that, whereupon he said: By Allah, had I not heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying:" He who took an oath, but then found something more pious in the sight of Allah, he should (break the oath) and do that which is more pious," I would not have broken the oath (and thus paid you anything)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ طَرَفَةَ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَرَأَى غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا فَلْيَأْتِ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ وَلْيَتْرُكْ يَمِينَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni rufay'in, 'an tamiymi bni tarafaaa, 'an 'adiyyi bni haatimin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man halafa 'alaa yamiynin faraaaa ghayrahaa khayrana minhaa falyaati alladhiy huwa khayrun walyatruk yamiynahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Adi b. Hatim reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who took an oath, but he found something else better than that, should do that which is better and break his oath
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَرِيفٍ الْبَجَلِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ طَرِيفٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الطَّائِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا حَلَفَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَلَى الْيَمِينِ فَرَأَى خَيْرًا مِنْهَا فَلْيُكَفِّرْهَا وَلْيَأْتِ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, wamuhammadu bnu tariyfin albajaliyyu, - waalllafzu laibni tariyfin - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni rufay'in, 'an tamiymin alttaaiiyyi, 'an 'adiyyin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa halafa aahadukum 'alaa alyamiyni faraaaa khayrana minhaa falyukaffirhaa walyaati alladhiy huwa khayrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Adi reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When anyone amongst you takes an oath, but he finds (something) better than that he should expiate (the breaking of the oath), and do that which is better
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَرِيفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الطَّائِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu tariyfin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, bni rufay'in 'an tamiymin alttaaiiyyi, 'an 'adiyyi bni haatimin, aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is reported on the authority of Adi b. Hatim through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ طَرَفَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَدِيَّ بْنَ حَاتِمٍ، وَأَتَاهُ، رَجُلٌ يَسْأَلُهُ مِائَةَ دِرْهَمٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ تَسْأَلُنِي مِائَةَ دِرْهَمٍ وَأَنَا ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أُعْطِيكَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَوْلاَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ ثُمَّ رَأَى خَيْرًا مِنْهَا فَلْيَأْتِ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an simaaki bni harbin, 'an tamiymi bni tarafaaa, qaala sami'tu 'adiyya bna haatimin, waaataahu, rajulun yasaaluhu miaiaaa dirhamin ‏.‏ faqaala tasaaluniy miaiaaa dirhamin waaanaa abnu haatimin waalllahi laa au'tiyka ‏.‏ thumma qaala lawlaa aanniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man halafa 'alaa yamiynin thumma raaaa khayrana minhaa falyaati alladhiy huwa khayrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Tamim b. Tarafa reported that he heard 'Adi b. Hatim say that a person came to him and asked for one hundred dirhams. He ('Adi) said:You asked me for one hundred dirhams and I am the son of Hatim; by Allah, I will not give you. But then he said: (I would have done that) if I had not heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: He who takes an oath, but then finds something better than that, should do that which is better
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سِمَاكُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ تَمِيمَ بْنَ طَرَفَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَدِيَّ بْنَ حَاتِمٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَهُ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ وَزَادَ وَلَكَ أَرْبَعُمِائَةٍ فِي عَطَائِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa simaaku bnu harbin, qaala sami'tu tamiyma bna tarafaaa, qaala sami'tu 'adiyya bna haatimin, aanna rajulaan, saaalahu fadhakara mithlahu wazaada walaka aarba'umiaiaain fiy 'ataaiiy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Tamim b. Tarafa reported:I heard 'Adi b. Hatim say that a person asked that and then narrated (the hadith) like one (mentioned above), but he made this addition:" Here are four hundred (dirhams) for you out of my gift
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنُ سَمُرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ لاَ تَسْأَلِ الإِمَارَةَ فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ أُعْطِيتَهَا عَنْ مَسْأَلَةٍ وُكِلْتَ إِلَيْهَا وَإِنْ أُعْطِيتَهَا عَنْ غَيْرِ مَسْأَلَةٍ أُعِنْتَ عَلَيْهَا وَإِذَا حَلَفْتَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَرَأَيْتَ غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا فَكَفِّرْ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ وَائْتِ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو أَحْمَدَ الْجُلُودِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْعَبَّاسِ الْمَاسَرْجَسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، ‏.‏ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, haddathanaa alhasanu, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, bnu samuraaa qaala qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa 'abda alrrahmani bna samuraaa laa tasaali aliimaaraaa faiinnaka iin au'tiytahaa 'an masaalaain wukilta iilayhaa waiin au'tiytahaa 'an ghayri masaalaain au'inta 'alayhaa waiidhaa halafta 'alaa yamiynin faraaayta ghayrahaa khayrana minhaa fakaffir 'an yamiynika waaiti alladhiy huwa khayrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw aahmada aljuluwdiyyu haddathanaa aabuw al'abbaasi almaasarjasiyyu, haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, ‏.‏ bihadhaa alhadiythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. Samura reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me:Abd al-Rahman b. Samura, don't ask for authority for if it is granted to you for asking for it, you would be commissioned for it (without having the support of Allah), but if you are granted it without your asking for it. You would be helped (by Allah) in it. And when you take an oath and find something else better than that, expiate for (breaking) your oath, and do that which is better. This hadith has also been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Farrukh. The above hadith is narratted through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، وَمَنْصُورٍ، وَحُمَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ، وَيُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، وَهِشَامِ، بْنِ حَسَّانَ فِي آخَرِينَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ الْمُعْتَمِرِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ ذِكْرُ الإِمَارَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, haddathanaa hushaymun, 'an yuwnusa, wamansuwrin, wahumaydin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an simaaki bni 'atiyyaaa, wayuwnusa bni 'ubaydin, wahishaami, bni hassaana fiy akhariyna h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa almu'tamiru, 'an aabiyhi, h wahaddathanaa 'uqbaau bnu mukramin al'ammiyyu, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'aamirin, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, kulluhum 'ani alhasani, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni samuraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bihadhaa alhadiythi walaysa fiy hadiythi almu'tamiri 'an aabiyhi dhikru aliimaaraai ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Samura through another chain of transmitters but there is no mention of the word" authority
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، وَقَالَ، عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَمِينُكَ عَلَى مَا يُصَدِّقُكَ عَلَيْهِ صَاحِبُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَمْرٌو ‏"‏ يُصَدِّقُكَ بِهِ صَاحِبُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa hushaymu bnu bashiyrin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy saalihin, waqaala, 'amrunw haddathanaa hushaymu bnu bashiyrin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy saalihin, - 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yamiynuka 'alaa maa yusaddiquka 'alayhi saahibuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala 'amrunw ‏"‏ yusaddiquka bihi saahibuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Haraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Your oath should be about something regarding which your companion will believe you. 'Amr said: By which your companion will believe you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ، أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْيَمِينُ عَلَى نِيَّةِ الْمُسْتَحْلِفِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, 'an hushaymin, 'an 'abbaadi bni, aabiy saalihin 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alyamiynu 'alaa niyyaai almustahlifi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:An oath is to be interpreted according to the intention of the one who takes it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي الرَّبِيعِ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ لِسُلَيْمَانَ سِتُّونَ امْرَأَةً فَقَالَ لأَطُوفَنَّ عَلَيْهِنَّ اللَّيْلَةَ فَتَحْمِلُ كُلُّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ فَتَلِدُ كُلُّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ غُلاَمًا فَارِسًا يُقَاتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَمْ تَحْمِلْ مِنْهُنَّ إِلاَّ وَاحِدَةٌ فَوَلَدَتْ نِصْفَ إِنْسَانٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَوْ كَانَ اسْتَثْنَى لَوَلَدَتْ كُلُّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ غُلاَمًا فَارِسًا يُقَاتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, waaabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu fudaylu bnu husaynin - waalllafzu laabiy alrrabiy'i - qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, - wahuwa abnu zaydin - haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an muhammadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala kaana lisulaymaana sittuwna amraaaaan faqaala laatuwfanna 'alayhinna alllaylaaa fatahmilu kullu waahidaain minhunna fatalidu kullu waahidaain minhunna ghulaamana faarisana yuqaatilu fiy sabiyli alllahi falam tahmil minhunna iilaaa waahidaaun fawaladat nisfa iinsaanin faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ law kaana astathnaa lawaladat kullu waahidaain minhunna ghulaamana faarisana yuqaatilu fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that (Hadrat) Sulaiman had sixty wives. He (one day) said:I will visit each one of them every night, and every one of them will become pregnant and give birth to a male child who will be a horseman and fight in the cause of Allah. But (it so happened) that none of them became pregnant except one, but she gave birth to an incomplete child. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Had he said Insha' Allah (if God so wills), then every one of them would have given birth to a child who would have been a horseman and fought in the cause of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَرَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حُجَيْرٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ لأَطُوفَنَّ اللَّيْلَةَ عَلَى سَبْعِينَ امْرَأَةً كُلُّهُنَّ تَأْتِي بِغُلاَمٍ يُقَاتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ صَاحِبُهُ أَوِ الْمَلَكُ قُلْ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَقُلْ وَنَسِيَ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ تَأْتِ وَاحِدَةٌ مِنْ نِسَائِهِ إِلاَّ وَاحِدَةٌ جَاءَتْ بِشِقِّ غُلاَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَلَوْ قَالَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ لَمْ يَحْنَثْ وَكَانَ دَرَكًا لَهُ فِي حَاجَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
