verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu laibni aabiy 'umara - qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an hishaami bni hujayrin, 'an taawusin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ qaala sulaymaanu bnu daawuda nabiyyu alllahi laatuwfanna alllaylaaa 'alaa sab'iyna amraaaaan kulluhunna taatiy bighulaamin yuqaatilu fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala lahu saahibuhu aawi almalaku qul iin shaa'a alllahu ‏.‏ falam yaqul wanasiya ‏.‏ falam taati waahidaaun min nisaaiihi iilaaa waahidaaun jaa'at bishiqqi ghulaamin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ walaw qaala iin shaa'a alllahu ‏.‏ lam yahnath wakaana darakana lahu fiy haajatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) as saying that Sulaiman b. Dawud, the Messenger of Allah, observed:I will have an intercourse with seventy wives during the night; all of them will give birth to a male child who will fight in the cause of Allah. His companion or the ang I said to him: Say," If God wills." But he (Hadrat Sulaimin) did not say so, and he forgot it. And none of his wives gave birth to a child, but one who gave birth to a premature child. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Had he said Insha' Allah (if God so will). he would not have failed and his desire would have been materialised
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ أَوْ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu aaw nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported this hadith from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ بْنُ هَمَّامٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ لأُطِيفَنَّ اللَّيْلَةَ عَلَى سَبْعِينَ امْرَأَةً تَلِدُ كُلُّ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ غُلاَمًا يُقَاتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لَهُ قُلْ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَقُلْ ‏.‏ فَأَطَافَ بِهِنَّ فَلَمْ تَلِدْ مِنْهُنَّ إِلاَّ امْرَأَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ نِصْفَ إِنْسَانٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَوْ قَالَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ لَمْ يَحْنَثْ وَكَانَ دَرَكًا لِحَاجَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi bnu hammaamin, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani abni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala sulaymaanu bnu daawuda lautiyfanna alllaylaaa 'alaa sab'iyna amraaaaan talidu kullu amraaaain minhunna ghulaamana yuqaatilu fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏.‏ faqiyla lahu qul iin shaa'a alllahu ‏.‏ falam yaqul ‏.‏ faaataafa bihinna falam talid minhunna iilaaa amraaaaun waahidaaun nisfa iinsaanin ‏.‏ qaala faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ law qaala iin shaa'a alllahu ‏.‏ lam yahnath wakaana darakana lihaajatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Sulaiman b. Dawud said:I will certainly have intercourse with seventy wives during the night, and every wife amongst them will give birth to a child, who will fight in the cause of Allah. It was said to him: Say:" Insha' Allah" (God willing), but he did not say so and forgot it. He went round them but none of them give birth to a child except one woman and that too was an incomplete person. Upon this Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If he had said" Insha' Allah." he would not have failed, and his desire must have been fulfilled
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ لأَطُوفَنَّ اللَّيْلَةَ عَلَى تِسْعِينَ امْرَأَةً كُلُّهَا تَأْتِي بِفَارِسٍ يُقَاتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ صَاحِبُهُ قُلْ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَقُلْ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ فَطَافَ عَلَيْهِنَّ جَمِيعًا فَلَمْ تَحْمِلْ مِنْهُنَّ إِلاَّ امْرَأَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَجَاءَتْ بِشِقِّ رَجُلٍ وَايْمُ الَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لَوْ قَالَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ لَجَاهَدُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فُرْسَانًا أَجْمَعُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa shabaabaau, haddathaniy warqaa'u, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ qaala sulaymaanu bnu daawuda laatuwfanna alllaylaaa 'alaa tis'iyna amraaaaan kulluhaa taatiy bifaarisin yuqaatilu fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala lahu saahibuhu qul iin shaa'a alllahu ‏.‏ falam yaqul iin shaa'a alllahu ‏.‏ fataafa 'alayhinna jamiy'ana falam tahmil minhunna iilaaa amraaaaun waahidaaun fajaa'at bishiqqi rajulin waaymu alladhiy nafsu muhammadin biyadihi law qaala iin shaa'a alllahu ‏.‏ lajaahaduwa fiy sabiyli alllahi fursaanana aajma'uwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying that Sulaiman b. Dawud (once) said:I will go round in the night to my ninety wives, and every one of them will give birth to a child (who will grow up) as a horseman and fight in the cause of Allah His companions said to him: Say" Insha' Allah." but he did not say Inshii' Allah. He went round all of them but none of them became pregnant but one, and she gave birth to a premature child. And by Him in Whose hand is the life of Muhammad, if he had said, Insha' Allah (his wives would have given birth to the children who would all have grown up into horsemen and fought in the way of Allah)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي، الزِّنَادِ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلُّهَا تَحْمِلُ غُلاَمًا يُجَاهِدُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hafsu bnu maysaraaa, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an aabiy, alzzinaadi bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏ ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ kulluhaa tahmilu ghulaamana yujaahidu fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Zinad with the same chain of transmitters with a variation of (these words):" Every one of them giving birth to a child, who would have fought in the cause of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَاللَّهِ لأَنْ يَلَجَّ أَحَدُكُمْ بِيَمِينِهِ فِي أَهْلِهِ آثَمُ لَهُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَنْ يُعْطِيَ كَفَّارَتَهُ الَّتِي فَرَضَ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ waalllahi laan yalajja aahadukum biyamiynihi fiy aahlihi athamu lahu 'inda alllahi min aan yu'tiya kaffaaratahu allatiy farada alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam b. Munabbih reported:This is what Abu Huraira reported to us from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he narrated a hadith and (one) of them is that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I swear by Allah, it is more sinful in Allah's sight for one of you to persist in an oath regarding his family than payment of its expiation which Allah has imposed upon him (for breaking the oath)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ أَنْ أَعْتَكِفَ لَيْلَةً فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَأَوْفِ بِنَذْرِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaaluwa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa abnu sa'iydin alqattaanu - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna 'umara, qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy nadhartu fiy aljaahiliyyaai aan aa'takifa laylaaan fiy almasjidi alharaami ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ faaawfi binadhrika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that Umar (b. Khattab) said:Messenger of Allah, I had taken a vow during the days of Ignorance (Jahiliyya) that I would observe I'tikaf for a night in the Sacred Mosque. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Fulfil your vow
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ يَعْنِي الثَّقَفِيَّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، وَإِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ جَمِيعًا عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَبَلَةَ بْنِ أَبِي رَوَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، وَقَالَ، حَفْصٌ مِنْ بَيْنِهِمْ عَنْ عُمَرَ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَمَّا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ وَالثَّقَفِيُّ فَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا اعْتِكَافُ لَيْلَةٍ ‏.‏ وَأَمَّا فِي حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ فَقَالَ جَعَلَ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمًا يَعْتَكِفُهُ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ حَفْصٍ ذِكْرُ يَوْمٍ وَلاَ لَيْلَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw sa'iydin alaashajju, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi ya'niy althhaqafiyya, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, waiishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma jamiy'ana 'an hafsi bni ghiyaathin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'amriw bni jabalaaa bni aabiy rawwaadin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, kulluhum 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, waqaala, hafsun min baynihim 'an 'umara, bihadhaa alhadiythi aammaa aabuw ausaamaaa waalthhaqafiyyu fafiy hadiythihimaa a'tikaafu laylaain ‏.‏ waaammaa fiy hadiythi shu'baaa faqaala ja'ala 'alayhi yawmana ya'takifuhu ‏.‏ walaysa fiy hadiythi hafsin dhikru yawmin walaa laylaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is transmitted on the authority of Ibn Umar with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، أَنَّ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ نَافِعًا حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ بِالْجِعْرَانَةِ بَعْدَ أَنْ رَجَعَ مِنَ الطَّائِفِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ أَنْ أَعْتَكِفَ يَوْمًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ فَكَيْفَ تَرَى قَالَ ‏ "‏ اذْهَبْ فَاعْتَكِفْ يَوْمًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ أَعْطَاهُ جَارِيَةً مِنَ الْخُمْسِ فَلَمَّا أَعْتَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَبَايَا النَّاسِ سَمِعَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ أَصْوَاتَهُمْ يَقُولُونَ أَعْتَقَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَا هَذَا فَقَالُوا أَعْتَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَبَايَا النَّاسِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ اذْهَبْ إِلَى تِلْكَ الْجَارِيَةِ فَخَلِّ سَبِيلَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, aanna aayyuwba, haddathahu aanna naafi'ana haddathahu aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara haddathahu aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa bialji'raanaai ba'da aan raja'a mina alttaaiifi faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy nadhartu fiy aljaahiliyyaai aan aa'takifa yawmana fiy almasjidi alharaami fakayfa taraa qaala ‏ "‏ adhhab faa'takif yawmana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad aa'taahu jaariyaaan mina alkhumsi falammaa aa'taqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sabaayaa alnnaasi sami'a 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi aaswaatahum yaquwluwna aa'taqanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqaala maa hadhaa faqaaluwa aa'taqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sabaayaa alnnaasi ‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru yaa 'abda alllahi adhhab iilaa tilka aljaariyaai fakhalli sabiylahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that 'Umar b. Khattab asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was at ji'rana (a town near Mecca) on his way back from Ta'if:Messenger of Allah, I had taken a vow during the days of Ignorance that I would observe I'tikaf for one day in the Sacred Mosque. So what is your opinion? He said: Go and observe I'tikaf for a day. And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave him a slave girl out of the one-fifth (of the spoils of war meant for the Holy Prophet). And when Allah's Messenger (inay peace be upon him) set the war prisoners free. 'Umar b. Khattab heard their voice as they were saying: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has set as free. He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: What is this? They said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has set free the prisoners of war (which had fallen to the lot of people). Thereupon he (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Abdullah, go to that slave-girl and set her free
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ لَمَّا قَفَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ حُنَيْنٍ سَأَلَ عُمَرُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ نَذْرٍ كَانَ نَذَرَهُ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ اعْتِكَافِ يَوْمٍ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ جَرِيرِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala lammaa qafala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm min hunaynin saaala 'umaru rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an nadhrin kaana nadharahu fiy aljaahiliyyaai a'tikaafi yawmin ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bima'naa hadiythi jariyri bni haazimin ‏.‏
verses.translation: lbn 'Umar reported:When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came back from the Battle of Hunain, Umar asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the vow he had taken during the days of Ignorance that he would observe I'tikaf for a day. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ الضَّبِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ ذُكِرَ عِنْدَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عُمْرَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْجِعْرَانَةِ فَقَالَ لَمْ يَعْتَمِرْ مِنْهَا - قَالَ - وَكَانَ عُمَرُ نَذَرَ اعْتِكَافَ لَيْلَةٍ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ جَرِيرِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ وَمَعْمَرٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdaaa alddabbiyyu, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an naafi'in, qaala dhukira 'inda abni 'umara 'umraau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alji'raanaai faqaala lam ya'tamir minhaa - qaala - wakaana 'umaru nadhara a'tikaafa laylaain fiy aljaahiliyyaai ‏.‏ thumma dhakara nahwa hadiythi jariyri bni haazimin wama'marin 'an aayyuwba ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' reported:A mention of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observing 'Umra from ja'rina was made before Ibn 'Umar. He said: He did not enter into the state of Ihram from that (place), and Umar had taken a vow of observing I'tikaf for a night during the days of Ignorance. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، ‏.‏ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ فِي النَّذْرِ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا جَمِيعًا اعْتِكَافُ يَوْمٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu alminhaali, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu khalafin, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, 'an muhammadi bni iishaaqa, kilaahumaa 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, ‏.‏ bihadhaa alhadiythi fiy alnnadhri wafiy hadiythihimaa jamiy'ana a'tikaafu yawmin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ، عَنْ ذَكْوَانَ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ زَاذَانَ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ وَقَدْ أَعْتَقَ مَمْلُوكًا - قَالَ - فَأَخَذَ مِنَ الأَرْضِ عُودًا أَوْ شَيْئًا فَقَالَ مَا فِيهِ مِنَ الأَجْرِ مَا يَسْوَى هَذَا إِلاَّ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَطَمَ مَمْلُوكَهُ أَوْ ضَرَبَهُ فَكَفَّارَتُهُ أَنْ يُعْتِقَهُ ‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw kaamilin, fudaylu bnu husaynin aljahdariyyu haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an firaasin, 'an dhakwaana aabiy saalihin, 'an zaadhaana aabiy 'umara, qaala aataytu abna 'umara waqad aa'taqa mamluwkana - qaala - faaakhadha mina alaardi 'uwdana aaw shayiana faqaala maa fiyhi mina alaajri maa yaswaa hadhaa iilaaa aanniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man latama mamluwkahu aaw darabahu fakaffaaratuhu aan yu'tiqahu ‏"‏
verses.translation: Zadhan Abl Umar reported:I came to Ibn 'Umar as he had granted freedom to a stave. He (the narrator further) said: He took hold of a wood or something like it from the earth and said: It (freedom of a slave) has not the reward evert equal to it, but the fact that I heard Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) say: He who slaps his slave or beats him, the expiation for it is that he should set him free
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ذَكْوَانَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ زَاذَانَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، دَعَا بِغُلاَمٍ لَهُ فَرَأَى بِظَهْرِهِ أَثَرًا فَقَالَ لَهُ أَوْجَعْتُكَ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَنْتَ عَتِيقٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ شَيْئًا مِنَ الأَرْضِ فَقَالَ مَا لِي فِيهِ مِنَ الأَجْرِ مَا يَزِنُ هَذَا إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ ضَرَبَ غُلاَمًا لَهُ حَدًّا لَمْ يَأْتِهِ أَوْ لَطَمَهُ فَإِنَّ كَفَّارَتَهُ أَنْ يُعْتِقَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu ja'farin haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an firaasin, qaala sami'tu dhakwaana, yuhaddithu 'an zaadhaana, aanna abna 'umara, da'aa bighulaamin lahu faraaaa bizahrihi aatharana faqaala lahu aawja'tuka qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala faaanta 'atiyqun ‏.‏ qaala thumma aakhadha shayiana mina alaardi faqaala maa liy fiyhi mina alaajri maa yazinu hadhaa iinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man daraba ghulaamana lahu haddana lam yaatihi aaw latamahu faiinna kaffaaratahu aan yu'tiqahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zadhan reported that Ibn Umar called his slave and he found the marks (of beating) upon his back. He said to him:I have caused you pain. He said: No. But he (Ibn Umar) said: You are free. He then took hold of something from the earth and said: There is no reward for me even to the weight equal to it. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who beats a slave without cognizable offence of his or slaps him (without any serious fault), then expiation for it is that he should set him free
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ، بِإِسْنَادِ شُعْبَةَ وَأَبِي عَوَانَةَ أَمَّا حَدِيثُ ابْنِ مَهْدِيٍّ فَذَكَرَ فِيهِ ‏"‏ حَدًّا لَمْ يَأْتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ ‏"‏ مَنْ لَطَمَ عَبْدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْحَدَّ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, kilaahumaa 'an sufyaana, 'an firaasin, biiisnaadi shu'baaa waaabiy 'awaanaaa aammaa hadiythu abni mahdiyyin fadhakara fiyhi ‏"‏ haddana lam yaatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi wakiy'in ‏"‏ man latama 'abdahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkuri alhadda‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، قَالَ لَطَمْتُ مَوْلًى لَنَا فَهَرَبْتُ ثُمَّ جِئْتُ قُبَيْلَ الظُّهْرِ فَصَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ أَبِي فَدَعَاهُ وَدَعَانِي ثُمَّ قَالَ امْتَثِلْ مِنْهُ ‏.‏ فَعَفَا ثُمَّ قَالَ كُنَّا بَنِي مُقَرِّنٍ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْسَ لَنَا إِلاَّ خَادِمٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَلَطَمَهَا أَحَدُنَا فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَعْتِقُوهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا لَيْسَ لَهُمْ خَادِمٌ غَيْرُهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلْيَسْتَخْدِمُوهَا فَإِذَا اسْتَغْنَوْا عَنْهَا فَلْيُخَلُّوا سَبِيلَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an salamaaa bni kuhaylin, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni suwaydin, qaala latamtu mawlana lanaa faharabtu thumma jiitu qubayla alzzuhri fasallaytu khalfa aabiy fada'aahu wada'aaniy thumma qaala amtathil minhu ‏.‏ fa'afaa thumma qaala kunnaa baniy muqarrinin 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laysa lanaa iilaaa khaadimun waahidaaun falatamahaa aahadunaa fabalagha dhalika alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aa'tiquwhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa laysa lahum khaadimun ghayruhaa qaala ‏"‏ falyastakhdimuwhaa faiidhaa astaghnawa 'anhaa falyukhalluwa sabiylahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mu'awiya b. Suwaid reported:I slapped a slave belonging to us and then fled away. I came back just before noon and offered prayer behind my father. He called him (the slave) and me and said: Do as he has done to you. He granted pardon. He (my father) then said: We belonged to the family of Muqarrin during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him. and had only one slave-girl and one of us slapped her. This news reached Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he said: Set her free. They (the members of the family) said: There is no other servant except she. Thereupon he said: Then employ her and when you can afford to dispense with her services, then set her free
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ يَسَافٍ، قَالَ عَجِلَ شَيْخٌ فَلَطَمَ خَادِمًا لَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ سُوَيْدُ بْنُ مُقَرِّنٍ عَجَزَ عَلَيْكَ إِلاَّ حُرُّ وَجْهِهَا لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي سَابِعَ سَبْعَةٍ مِنْ بَنِي مُقَرِّنٍ مَا لَنَا خَادِمٌ إِلاَّ وَاحِدَةٌ لَطَمَهَا أَصْغَرُنَا فَأَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نُعْتِقَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin - qaalaa haddathanaa abnu iidriysa, 'an husaynin, 'an hilaali bni yasaafin, qaala 'ajila shaykhun falatama khaadimana lahu faqaala lahu suwaydu bnu muqarrinin 'ajaza 'alayka iilaaa hurru wajhihaa laqad raaaytuniy saabi'a sab'aain min baniy muqarrinin maa lanaa khaadimun iilaaa waahidaaun latamahaa aasgharunaa faaamaranaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan nu'tiqahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hilal b. Yasaf reported that a person got angry and slapped his slave-girl. Thereupon Suwaid b. Muqarrin said to him:You could find no other part (to slap) but the prominent part of her face. See I was one of the seven sons of Muqarrin, and we had but only one slave-girl. The youngest of us slapped her, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded us to set her free
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ يَسَافٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَبِيعُ الْبَزَّ فِي دَارِ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ مُقَرِّنٍ أَخِي النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ مُقَرِّنٍ فَخَرَجَتْ جَارِيَةٌ فَقَالَتْ لِرَجُلٍ مِنَّا كَلِمَةً فَلَطَمَهَا فَغَضِبَ سُوَيْدٌ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ إِدْرِيسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an husaynin, 'an hilaali bni yasaafin, qaala kunnaa nabiy'u albazza fiy daari suwaydi bni muqarrinin aakhiy alnnu'maani bni muqarrinin fakharajat jaariyaaun faqaalat lirajulin minnaa kalimaaan falatamahaa faghadiba suwaydun ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwa hadiythi abni iidriysa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hilal b. Yasaf reported:We used to sell cloth in the house of Suwaid b. Muqarrin, the brother of Nu'man b. Muqarrin. There came out a slave-girl, and she said something to a person amongst us, and he slapped her. Suwaid was enraged-the rest of the hadlth is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ مَا اسْمُكَ قُلْتُ شُعْبَةُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو شُعْبَةَ الْعِرَاقِيُّ عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ مُقَرِّنٍ أَنَّ جَارِيَةً لَهُ لَطَمَهَا إِنْسَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ سُوَيْدٌ أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ الصُّورَةَ مُحَرَّمَةٌ فَقَالَ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي وَإِنِّي لَسَابِعُ إِخْوَةٍ لِي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَا لَنَا خَادِمٌ غَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ فَعَمَدَ أَحَدُنَا فَلَطَمَهُ فَأَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نُعْتِقَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi bnu 'abdi alssamadi, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala qaala liy muhammadu bnu almunkadiri maa asmuka qultu shu'baau ‏.‏ faqaala muhammadun haddathaniy aabuw shu'baaa al'iraaqiyyu 'an suwaydi bni muqarrinin aanna jaariyaaan lahu latamahaa iinsaanun faqaala lahu suwaydun aamaa 'alimta aanna alssuwraaa muharramaaun faqaala laqad raaaytuniy waiinniy lasaabi'u iikhwaain liy ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wamaa lanaa khaadimun ghayru waahidin fa'amada aahadunaa falatamahu faaamaranaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan nu'tiqahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Suwaid b. Muqarrin reported that he had a slave-girl and a person (one of the members of the family) slapped her, whereupon Suwaid said to him:Don't you know that it is forbidden (to strike the) face. He said: You see I was the seventh one amongst my brothers during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and we had but only one servant. One of us got enraged and slapped him. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded us to set him free
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ مَا اسْمُكَ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, 'an wahbi bni jariyrin, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, qaala qaala liy muhammadu bnu almunkadiri maa asmuka fadhakara bimithli hadiythi 'abdi alssamadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Wahb b. Jarir reported:Shu'ba informed that Muhammad b. Munkadir said to me: What is your name? The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ - حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ الْبَدْرِيُّ كُنْتُ أَضْرِبُ غُلاَمًا لِي بِالسَّوْطِ فَسَمِعْتُ صَوْتًا مِنْ خَلْفِي ‏"‏ اعْلَمْ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ أَفْهَمِ الصَّوْتَ مِنَ الْغَضَبِ - قَالَ - فَلَمَّا دَنَا مِنِّي إِذَا هُوَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِذَا هُوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اعْلَمْ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ اعْلَمْ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَلْقَيْتُ السَّوْطَ مِنْ يَدِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اعْلَمْ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَقْدَرُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْكَ عَلَى هَذَا الْغُلاَمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لاَ أَضْرِبُ مَمْلُوكًا بَعْدَهُ أَبَدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, - ya'niy abna ziyaadin - haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala aabuw mas'uwdin albadriyyu kuntu aadribu ghulaamana liy bialssawti fasami'tu sawtana min khalfiy ‏"‏ a'lam aabaa mas'uwdin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falam aafhami alssawta mina alghadabi - qaala - falammaa danaa minniy iidhaa huwa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faiidhaa huwa yaquwlu ‏"‏ a'lam aabaa mas'uwdin a'lam aabaa mas'uwdin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faaalqaytu alssawta min yadiy faqaala ‏"‏ a'lam aabaa mas'uwdin aanna alllaha aaqdaru 'alayka minka 'alaa hadhaa alghulaami ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqultu laa aadribu mamluwkana ba'dahu aabadana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Mas'ud al-Badri reported:I was beating my slave with a whip when I heard a voice behind me: Understand, Abu Masud; but I did not recognise the voice due to intense anger. He (Abu Mas'ud) reported: As he came near me (I found) that he was the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was saying: Bear in mind, Abu Mas'ud; bear in mind. Abu Mas'ud. He (Aba Maslad) said: threw the whip from my hand. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Bear in mind, Abu Mas'ud; verily Allah has more dominance upon you than you have upon your slave. I (then) said: I would never beat my servant in future
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، - وَهُوَ الْمَعْمَرِيُّ - عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، الرَّزَّاقِ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِإِسْنَادِ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ فَسَقَطَ مِنْ يَدِي السَّوْطُ مِنْ هَيْبَتِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu humaydin, - wahuwa alma'mariyyu - 'an sufyaana, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu, alrrazzaaqi aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, biiisnaadi 'abdi alwaahidi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythihi ‏.‏ ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi jariyrin fasaqata min yadiy alssawtu min haybatihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authorityo A'mash but with this variation of words:" There fell from my hand the whip on account of his (the Prophet's) awe
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، التَّيْمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَضْرِبُ غُلاَمًا لِي فَسَمِعْتُ مِنْ خَلْفِي صَوْتًا ‏"‏ اعْلَمْ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ لَلَّهُ أَقْدَرُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْكَ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَالْتَفَتُّ فَإِذَا هُوَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هُوَ حُرٌّ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَا لَوْ لَمْ تَفْعَلْ لَلَفَحَتْكَ النَّارُ أَوْ لَمَسَّتْكَ النَّارُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an iibraahiyma, alttaymiyyi 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin alaansaariyyi, qaala kuntu aadribu ghulaamana liy fasami'tu min khalfiy sawtana ‏"‏ a'lam aabaa mas'uwdin lallahu aaqdaru 'alayka minka 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaltafattu faiidhaa huwa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi huwa hurrun liwajhi alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aamaa law lam taf'al lalafahatka alnnaaru aaw lamassatka alnnaaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari reported:When I was beating my servant, I heard a voice behind me (saying): Abu Mas'ud, bear in mind Allah has more dominance over you than you have upon him. I turned and (found him) to be Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I said: Allah's Messenger, I set him free for the sake of Allah. Thereupon he said: Had you not done that, (the gates of) Hell would have opened for you, or the fire would have burnt you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، أَبِي عَدِيٍّ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَضْرِبُ غُلاَمَهُ فَجَعَلَ يَقُولُ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ - قَالَ - فَجَعَلَ يَضْرِبُهُ فَقَالَ أَعُوذُ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَتَرَكَهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَاللَّهِ لَلَّهُ أَقْدَرُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْكَ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَعْتَقَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa abnu, aabiy 'adiyyin 'an shu'baaa, 'an sulaymaana, 'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin, aannahu kaana yadribu ghulaamahu faja'ala yaquwlu aa'uwdhu bialllahi - qaala - faja'ala yadribuhu faqaala aa'uwdhu birasuwli alllahi ‏.‏ fatarakahu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ waalllahi lallahu aaqdaru 'alayka minka 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faaa'taqahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Mas'ud reported that he had been beating his slave and he had been saying:I seek refuge with Allah, but he continued beating him, whereupon he said: I seek refuge with Allah's Messenger, and he spared him. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: By Allah, God has more dominance over you than you have over him (the slave). He said that he set him free
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قَوْلَهُ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ أَعُوذُ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi bishru bnu khaalidin, aakhbaranaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkur qawlahu aa'uwdhu bialllahi aa'uwdhu birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters, but made no mention of (these words) of his:I seek refuge with Allah, I seek refuge with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ غَزْوَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي نُعْمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَذَفَ مَمْلُوكَهُ بِالزِّنَا يُقَامُ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدُّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ كَمَا قَالَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni, numayrin haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa fudaylu bnu ghazwaana, qaala sami'tu 'abda alrrahmani bna aabiy nu'min, haddathaniy aabuw hurayraaa, qaala qaala aabuw alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man qadhafa mamluwkahu bialzzinaa yuqaamu 'alayhi alhaddu yawma alqiyaamaai iilaaa aan yakuwna kamaa qaala ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Abu'l-Qasim (one of the names of Allah's Messenger [may peace be upon him]) said:He who accused his slave of adultery, punishment would be imposed upon him on the Day of Resurrection, except in case the accusation was as he had said
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ، يُوسُفَ الأَزْرَقُ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ غَزْوَانَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا سَمِعْتُ أَبَا، الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيَّ التَّوْبَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu, yuwsufa alaazraqu kilaahumaa 'an fudayli bni ghazwaana, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythihimaa sami'tu aabaa, alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm nabiyya alttawbaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Ghazwan (and the words are):" I heard Abu'l-Qasim (ﷺ) as the Prophet of repentance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنِ الْمَعْرُورِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، قَالَ مَرَرْنَا بِأَبِي ذَرٍّ بِالرَّبَذَةِ وَعَلَيْهِ بُرْدٌ وَعَلَى غُلاَمِهِ مِثْلُهُ فَقُلْنَا يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ لَوْ جَمَعْتَ بَيْنَهُمَا كَانَتْ حُلَّةً ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ رَجُلٍ مِنْ إِخْوَانِي كَلاَمٌ وَكَانَتْ أَمُّهُ أَعْجَمِيَّةً فَعَيَّرْتُهُ بِأُمِّهِ فَشَكَانِي إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَقِيتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ إِنَّكَ امْرُؤٌ فِيكَ جَاهِلِيَّةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَنْ سَبَّ الرِّجَالَ سَبُّوا أَبَاهُ وَأُمُّهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ إِنَّكَ امْرُؤٌ فِيكَ جَاهِلِيَّةٌ هُمْ إِخْوَانُكُمْ جَعَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ تَحْتَ أَيْدِيكُمْ فَأَطْعِمُوهُمْ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ وَأَلْبِسُوهُمْ مِمَّا تَلْبَسُونَ وَلاَ تُكَلِّفُوهُمْ مَا يَغْلِبُهُمْ فَإِنْ كَلَّفْتُمُوهُمْ فَأَعِينُوهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'ani alma'ruwri bni suwaydin, qaala mararnaa biaabiy dharrin bialrrabadhaai wa'alayhi burdun wa'alaa ghulaamihi mithluhu faqulnaa yaa aabaa dharrin law jama'ta baynahumaa kaanat hullaaan ‏.‏ faqaala iinnahu kaana bayniy wabayna rajulin min iikhwaaniy kalaamun wakaanat aammuhu aa'jamiyyaaan fa'ayyartuhu biaummihi fashakaaniy iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm falaqiytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa dharrin iinnaka amruuun fiyka jaahiliyyaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi man sabba alrrijaala sabbuwa aabaahu waaummuhu ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa dharrin iinnaka amruuun fiyka jaahiliyyaaun hum iikhwaanukum ja'alahumu alllahu tahta aaydiykum faaat'imuwhum mimmaa taakuluwna waaalbisuwhum mimmaa talbasuwna walaa tukallifuwhum maa yaghlibuhum faiin kallaftumuwhum faaa'iynuwhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Ma'rur b. Suwaid said:We went to Abu Dharr (Ghifari) in Rabadha and he had a mantle over him, and his slave had one like it. We said: Abu Dharr, had you joined them together, it would have been a complete garment. Thereupon he said: There was an altercation between me and one of the persons among my brothers. His mother was a non-Arab. I reproached him for his mother. He complained against me to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). As I met Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) he said: Abu Dharr, you are a person who still has (in him the remnants) of the days (of Ignorance). Thereupon I said: Allah's Messenger, he who abuses (other) persons, they abuse (in return) his father and mother. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Abu Dharr, you are a person who still has (the remnants) of Ignorance in him They (your servants and slaves) are your brothers. Allah has put them in your care, so feed them with what you eat, clothe them with what you wear. and do not burden them beyond their capacities; but if you burden them (with an unbearable burden), then help them (by sharing their extra burden)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ زُهَيْرٍ وَأَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ بَعْدَ قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ إِنَّكَ امْرُؤٌ فِيكَ جَاهِلِيَّةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ عَلَى حَالِ سَاعَتِي مِنَ الْكِبَرِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ عَلَى حَالِ سَاعَتِكَ مِنَ الْكِبَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عِيسَى ‏"‏ فَإِنْ كَلَّفَهُ مَا يَغْلِبُهُ فَلْيَبِعْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ زُهَيْرٍ ‏"‏ فَلْيُعِنْهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏"‏ فَلْيَبِعْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلاَ ‏"‏ فَلْيُعِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ انْتَهَى عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ وَلاَ يُكَلِّفْهُ مَا يَغْلِبُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wazaada fiy hadiythi zuhayrin waaabiy mu'aawiyaaa ba'da qawlihi ‏"‏ iinnaka amruuun fiyka jaahiliyyaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu 'alaa haali saa'atiy mina alkibari qaala ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai aabiy mu'aawiyaaa ‏"‏ na'am 'alaa haali saa'atika mina alkibari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi 'iysaa ‏"‏ faiin kallafahu maa yaghlibuhu falyabi'hu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi zuhayrin ‏"‏ falyu'inhu 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walaysa fiy hadiythi aabiy mu'aawiyaaa ‏"‏ falyabi'hu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walaa ‏"‏ falyu'inhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ antahaa 'inda qawlihi ‏"‏ walaa yukallifhu maa yaghlibuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash but with a slight variation of words, e. g. in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Zuhair and Abu Mu'awiya after his words (these words of the Holy Prophet):" You are a person having the remnants of Ignorance in him." (these words also occur, that Abu Dharr) said: Even up to this time of my old age? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes. In the tradition transmitted on the authority of Abu Mu'awiya (the words are):" Yes, in this time of your old age." In the tradition transmitted on the authority of 'Isa (the words are):" If you burden him (with an unbearable burden), you should sell him (and get another slave who can easily undertake this burden)." In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Zuhair (the words are):" Help him in that (work)." In the hadith transmitted by Abu Mu'awiya (separately) there is no such word: Then sell him or help him." This hadith concludes with these words:" Do not burden him beyond his capacity
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ وَاصِلٍ الأَحْدَبِ، عَنِ الْمَعْرُورِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ أَبَا ذَرٍّ وَعَلَيْهِ حُلَّةٌ وَعَلَى غُلاَمِهِ مِثْلُهَا فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ قَالَ فَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ سَابَّ رَجُلاً عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَيَّرَهُ بِأُمِّهِ - قَالَ - فَأَتَى الرَّجُلُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّكَ امْرُؤٌ فِيكَ جَاهِلِيَّةٌ إِخْوَانُكُمْ وَخَوَلُكُمْ جَعَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ تَحْتَ أَيْدِيكُمْ فَمَنْ كَانَ أَخُوهُ تَحْتَ يَدَيْهِ فَلْيُطْعِمْهُ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ وَلْيُلْبِسْهُ مِمَّا يَلْبَسُ وَلاَ تُكَلِّفُوهُمْ مَا يَغْلِبُهُمْ فَإِنْ كَلَّفْتُمُوهُمْ فَأَعِينُوهُمْ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu ja'farin haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an waasilin alaahdabi, 'ani alma'ruwri bni suwaydin, qaala raaaytu aabaa dharrin wa'alayhi hullaaun wa'alaa ghulaamihi mithluhaa fasaaaltuhu 'an dhalika qaala fadhakara aannahu saabba rajulaan 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fa'ayyarahu biaummihi - qaala - faaataa alrrajulu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara dhalika lahu faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinnaka amruuun fiyka jaahiliyyaaun iikhwaanukum wakhawalukum ja'alahumu alllahu tahta aaydiykum faman kaana aakhuwhu tahta yadayhi falyut'imhu mimmaa yaakulu walyulbishu mimmaa yalbasu walaa tukallifuwhum maa yaghlibuhum faiin kallaftumuwhum faaa'iynuwhum 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ma'rur b. Suwaid reported:I saw Abu Dharr wearing clothes, and his slave wearing similar ones. I asked him about it, and he narrated that he had abused a person during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (may peace be upoe. him) and he reproached him for his mother. That person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and made mention of that to him. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: You are a person who has (remnants of) Ignorance in him. Your slaves are brothers of yours. Allah has placed them in your hand, and he who has his brother under him, he should feed him with what he eats, and dress him with what he dresses himself, and do not burden them beyond their capacities, and if you burden them, (beyond their capacities), then help them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو، بْنُ الْحَارِثِ أَنَّ بُكَيْرَ بْنَ الأَشَجِّ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ الْعَجْلاَنِ، مَوْلَى فَاطِمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لِلْمَمْلُوكِ طَعَامُهُ وَكِسْوَتُهُ وَلاَ يُكَلَّفُ مِنَ الْعَمَلِ إِلاَّ مَا يُطِيقُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amriw bni sarhin aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa 'amruw, bnu alhaarithi aanna bukayra bna alaashajji, haddathahu 'ani al'ajlaani, mawlaa faatimaaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ lilmamluwki ta'aamuhu wakiswatuhu walaa yukallafu mina al'amali iilaaa maa yutiyqu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:It is essential to feed the slave, clothe him (properly) and not burden him with work which is beyond his power
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا صَنَعَ لأَحَدِكُمْ خَادِمُهُ طَعَامَهُ ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ بِهِ وَقَدْ وَلِيَ حَرَّهُ وَدُخَانَهُ فَلْيُقْعِدْهُ مَعَهُ فَلْيَأْكُلْ فَإِنْ كَانَ الطَّعَامُ مَشْفُوهًا قَلِيلاً فَلْيَضَعْ فِي يَدِهِ مِنْهُ أُكْلَةً أَوْ أُكْلَتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ دَاوُدُ يَعْنِي لُقْمَةً أَوْ لُقْمَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa alqa'nabiyyu, haddathanaa daawudu bnu qaysin, 'an muwsaa bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa sana'a laahadikum khaadimuhu ta'aamahu thumma jaa'ahu bihi waqad waliya harrahu wadukhaanahu falyuq'idhu ma'ahu falyaakul faiin kaana altta'aamu mashfuwhana qaliylaan falyada' fiy yadihi minhu auklaaan aaw auklatayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala daawudu ya'niy luqmaaan aaw luqmatayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When the slave of anyone amongst you prepares food for him and he serves him after having sat close to (and undergoing the hardship of) heat and smoke, he should make him (the slave) sit along with him and make him eat (along with him), and if the food seems to run short, then he should spare some portion for him (from his own share) - (another narrator) Dawud said:" i. e. a morsel or two
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا نَصَحَ لِسَيِّدِهِ وَأَحْسَنَ عِبَادَةَ اللَّهِ فَلَهُ أَجْرُهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna al'abda iidhaa nasaha lisayyidihi waaahsana 'ibaadaaa alllahi falahu aajruhu marratayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When a slave looks to the welfare of his master and worships Allah well, he has two rewards for him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، وَهْوَ الْقَطَّانُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, wahwa alqattaanu h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, waaabuw ausaamaaa kulluhum 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy ausaamaau, jamiy'ana 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi maalikin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لِلْعَبْدِ الْمَمْلُوكِ الْمُصْلِحِ أَجْرَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ بِيَدِهِ لَوْلاَ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالْحَجُّ وَبِرُّ أُمِّي لأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أَمُوتَ وَأَنَا مَمْلُوكٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَبَلَغَنَا أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَحُجُّ حَتَّى مَاتَتْ أُمُّهُ لِصُحْبَتِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ لِلْعَبْدِ الْمُصْلِحِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْمَمْلُوكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala sami'tu sa'iyda bna almusayyabi, yaquwlu qaala aabuw hurayraaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ lil'abdi almamluwki almuslihi aajraani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waalladhiy nafsu aabiy hurayraaa biyadihi lawlaa aljihaadu fiy sabiyli alllahi waalhajju wabirru aummiy laahbabtu aan aamuwta waaanaa mamluwkun ‏.‏ qaala wabalaghanaa aanna aabaa hurayraaa lam yakun yahujju hattaa maatat aummuhu lisuhbatihaa ‏.‏ qaala aabuw alttaahiri fiy hadiythihi ‏"‏ lil'abdi almuslihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkuri almamluwka ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:For a faithful slave there are two rewards. By him in Whose hand is the life of Abu Huraira, but for Jihad in the cause of Allah, and Pilgrimage and kindness to my mother, I would have preferred to die as a slave. He (one of the narrators in the chain of transmitters) said: This news reached us that Abu Huraira did not perform Pilgrimage until his mother died for (keeping himself constantly) in her service
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَفْوَانَ الأُمَوِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ بَلَغَنَا وَمَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa aabuw safwaana alaumawiyyu, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkur balaghanaa wamaa ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Tahir but with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَدَّى الْعَبْدُ حَقَّ اللَّهِ وَحَقَّ مَوَالِيهِ كَانَ لَهُ أَجْرَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَدَّثْتُهَا كَعْبًا فَقَالَ كَعْبٌ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ حِسَابٌ وَلاَ عَلَى مُؤْمِنٍ مُزْهِدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa aaddaa al'abdu haqqa alllahi wahaqqa mawaaliyhi kaana lahu aajraani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fahaddathtuhaa ka'bana faqaala ka'bun laysa 'alayhi hisaabun walaa 'alaa muuminin muzhidin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When a slave fulfils obligation of Allah and obligation of his master, he has two rewards for him. I narrated this to Ka'b, and Ka'b said: (Such a slave) has no accountability, nor has a poor believer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: The above hadith has been reported through another chain of transmitters on the authority of Abu Huraira
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نِعِمَّا لِلْمَمْلُوكِ أَنْ يُتَوَفَّى يُحْسِنُ عِبَادَةَ اللَّهِ وَصَحَابَةَ سَيِّدِهِ نِعِمَّا لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ni'immaa lilmamluwki aan yutawaffaa yuhsinu 'ibaadaaa alllahi wasahaabaaa sayyidihi ni'immaa lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:It is good for a slave that he worships Allah well, and serves his master (well). It is good for him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِمَالِكٍ حَدَّثَكَ نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ شِرْكًا لَهُ فِي عَبْدٍ فَكَانَ لَهُ مَالٌ يَبْلُغُ ثَمَنَ الْعَبْدِ قُوِّمَ عَلَيْهِ قِيمَةَ الْعَدْلِ فَأَعْطَى شُرَكَاءَهُ حِصَصَهُمْ وَعَتَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْعَبْدُ وَإِلاَّ فَقَدْ عَتَقَ مِنْهُ مَا عَتَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qultu limaalikin haddathaka naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man aa'taqa shirkana lahu fiy 'abdin fakaana lahu maalun yablughu thamana al'abdi quwwima 'alayhi qiymaaa al'adli faaa'taa shurakaa'ahu hisasahum wa'ataqa 'alayhi al'abdu waiilaaa faqad 'ataqa minhu maa 'ataqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who gives up his share in a slave, and has enough money to pay the full price of the slave, then full emancipation devolves upon him; but if he has not the money, then he emancipated what he emancipated
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ شِرْكًا لَهُ مِنْ مَمْلُوكٍ فَعَلَيْهِ عِتْقُهُ كُلُّهُ إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ مَالٌ يَبْلُغُ ثَمَنَهُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ عَتَقَ مِنْهُ مَا عَتَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man aa'taqa shirkana lahu min mamluwkin fa'alayhi 'itquhu kulluhu iin kaana lahu maalun yablughu thamanahu faiin lam yakun lahu maalun 'ataqa minhu maa 'ataqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who emancipates his share in the slave, it is his responsibility to secure full freedom for him provided he (the slave) has enough money to pay the (remaining) price, but it he has not so much money he would be emancipated to the extent that the first man emancipated
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ نَصِيبًا لَهُ فِي عَبْدٍ فَكَانَ لَهُ مِنَ الْمَالِ قَدْرُ مَا يَبْلُغُ قِيمَتَهُ قُوِّمَ عَلَيْهِ قِيمَةَ عَدْلٍ وَإِلاَّ فَقَدْ عَتَقَ مِنْهُ مَا عَتَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, 'an naafi'in, mawlaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man aa'taqa nasiybana lahu fiy 'abdin fakaana lahu mina almaali qadru maa yablughu qiymatahu quwwima 'alayhi qiymaaa 'adlin waiilaaa faqad 'ataqa minhu maa 'ataqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who gives up his share in a slave, and he has money enough to meet the full price, a fair price for him should be fixed; otherwise be has emancipated him to the extent that he has emancipated
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏ "‏ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ فَقَدْ عَتَقَ مِنْهُ مَا عَتَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ إِلاَّ فِي حَدِيثِ أَيُّوبَ وَيَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ فَإِنَّهُمَا ذَكَرَا هَذَا الْحَرْفَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ وَقَالاَ لاَ نَدْرِي أَهُوَ شَىْءٌ فِي الْحَدِيثِ أَوْ قَالَهُ نَافِعٌ مِنْ قِبَلِهِ وَلَيْسَ فِي رِوَايَةِ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ إِلاَّ فِي حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu, bnu almuthannaa haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, qaala sami'tu yahyaa bna sa'iydin, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, wahuwa abnu zaydin h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'niy abna 'ulayyaaa - kilaahumaa 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy iismaa'iylu bnu aumayyaaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, 'ani abni aabiy dhiibin, h wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy ausaamaau, - ya'niy abna zaydin - kullu hauulaa'i 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa alhadiythi walaysa fiy hadiythihim ‏ "‏ waiin lam yakun lahu maalun faqad 'ataqa minhu maa 'ataqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ iilaaa fiy hadiythi aayyuwba wayahyaa bni sa'iydin faiinnahumaa dhakaraa hadhaa alharfa fiy alhadiythi waqaalaa laa nadriy aahuwa shaa'un fiy alhadiythi aaw qaalahu naafi'un min qibalihi walaysa fiy riwaayaai aahadin minhum sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ iilaaa fiy hadiythi alllaythi bni sa'din ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ عَبْدًا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ آخَرَ قُوِّمَ عَلَيْهِ فِي مَالِهِ قِيمَةَ عَدْلٍ لاَ وَكْسَ وَلاَ شَطَطَ ثُمَّ عَتَقَ عَلَيْهِ فِي مَالِهِ إِنْ كَانَ مُوسِرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waabnu aabiy 'umara, kilaahumaa 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, qaala abnu aabiy 'umara haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'amrinw, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man aa'taqa 'abdana baynahu wabayna akhara quwwima 'alayhi fiy maalihi qiymaaa 'adlin laa waksa walaa shatata thumma 'ataqa 'alayhi fiy maalihi iin kaana muwsirana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim b. 'Abdullah reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:He who emancipates a slave (shared) by him and another one, his full price may be justly assessed from his wealth, neither less nor more, and he (the slave) would be emancipated if he (the partner) would be solvent enough (to forgo the amount of his share)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ شِرْكًا لَهُ فِي عَبْدٍ عَتَقَ مَا بَقِيَ فِي مَالِهِ إِذَا كَانَ لَهُ مَالٌ يَبْلُغُ ثَمَنَ الْعَبْدِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man aa'taqa shirkana lahu fiy 'abdin 'ataqa maa baqiya fiy maalihi iidhaa kaana lahu maalun yablughu thamana al'abdi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:He who gives up his share in a slave, the remaining (share) will be paid out of his riches if his riches are enough to meet the price of the slave
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ نَهِيكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فِي الْمَمْلُوكِ بَيْنَ الرَّجُلَيْنِ فَيُعْتِقُ أَحَدُهُمَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَضْمَنُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'ani alnnadri bni aanasin, 'an bashiyri bni nahiykin, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fiy almamluwki bayna alrrajulayni fayu'tiqu aahaduhumaa qaala ‏ "‏ yadmanu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:In case the slave is owned by two persons, and one of them emancipates him, he will guarantee (his full freedom)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ شَقِيصًا مِنْ مَمْلُوكٍ فَهُوَ حُرٌّ مِنْ مَالِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi qaala ‏ "‏ man aa'taqa shaqiysana min mamluwkin fahuwa hurrun min maalihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are):" He who emancipates a portion in a slave, he should (secure full) freedom for him from his property
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ نَهِيكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ شَقِيصًا لَهُ فِي عَبْدٍ فَخَلاَصُهُ فِي مَالِهِ إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ مَالٌ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ اسْتُسْعِيَ الْعَبْدُ غَيْرَ مَشْقُوقٍ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'ani abni aabiy 'aruwbaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'ani alnnadri bni aanasin, 'an bashiyri bni nahiykin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man aa'taqa shaqiysana lahu fiy 'abdin fakhalaasuhu fiy maalihi iin kaana lahu maalun faiin lam yakun lahu maalun astus'iya al'abdu ghayra mashquwqin 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:He who emancipates his portion in a slave, full emancipation may be secured for him out of his property (if he has money) if he has enough property to meet (the required expenses), but if he has not enough property, the slave should be put to extra labour (in order to earn money for buying his freedom), but he should not be overburdened
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي، عَرُوبَةَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عِيسَى ‏ "‏ ثُمَّ يُسْتَسْعَى فِي نَصِيبِ الَّذِي لَمْ يُعْتِقْ غَيْرَ مَشْقُوقٍ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, wamuhammadu bnu bishrin, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'aliyyu bnu khashramin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, jamiy'ana 'ani abni aabiy, 'aruwbaaa bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi 'iysaa ‏ "‏ thumma yustas'aa fiy nasiybi alladhiy lam yu'tiq ghayra mashquwqin 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters (and the words are):" He will be required to work (in order to secure freedom) for that por- tion in which he has not been emancipated, without overburdening him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ، بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ ‏.‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَعْتَقَ سِتَّةَ مَمْلُوكِينَ لَهُ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ غَيْرُهُمْ فَدَعَا بِهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَزَّأَهُمْ أَثْلاَثًا ثُمَّ أَقْرَعَ بَيْنَهُمْ فَأَعْتَقَ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَرَقَّ أَرْبَعَةً وَقَالَ لَهُ قَوْلاً شَدِيدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wazuhayru bnu harbin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu 'ulayyaaa - 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aabiy almuhallabi, 'an 'imraana, bni husaynin ‏.‏ aanna rajulaan, aa'taqa sittaaa mamluwkiyna lahu 'inda mawtihi lam yakun lahu maalun ghayruhum fada'aa bihim rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fajazzaaahum aathlaathana thumma aaqra'a baynahum faaa'taqa athnayni waaaraqqa aarba'aaan waqaala lahu qawlaan shadiydana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Imran b. Husain reported that a person who had no other property emancipated six slaves of his at the time of his death. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called for them and divided them into three sections, cast lots amongst them, and set two free and kept four in slavery; and he (the Holy Prophet) spoke severely of him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي، عُمَرَ عَنِ الثَّقَفِيِّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ أَمَّا حَمَّادٌ فَحَدِيثُهُ كَرِوَايَةِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ وَأَمَّا الثَّقَفِيُّ فَفِي حَدِيثِهِ أَنَّ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ أَوْصَى عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ فَأَعْتَقَ سِتَّةَ مَمْلُوكِينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hammaadun, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy, 'umara 'ani althhaqafiyyi, kilaahumaa 'an aayyuwba, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ aammaa hammaadun fahadiythuhu kariwaayaai abni 'ulayyaaa waaammaa althhaqafiyyu fafiy hadiythihi aanna rajulaan mina alaansaari aawsaa 'inda mawtihi faaa'taqa sittaaa mamluwkiyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters (and the words are):" A person from among the Ansar willed away the freedom of six slaves of his at the time of his death
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ الضَّرِيرُ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ وَحَمَّادٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu minhaalin alddariyru, waaahmadu bnu 'abdaaa, qaalaa haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu hassaana, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an 'imraana bni husaynin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi abni 'ulayyaaa wahammaadin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Imran b. Husain through another chain of narrators
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْعَتَكِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ أَعْتَقَ غُلاَمًا لَهُ عَنْ دُبُرٍ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ غَيْرُهُ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ يَشْتَرِيهِ مِنِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَاشْتَرَاهُ نُعَيْمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بِثَمَانِمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ فَدَفَعَهَا إِلَيْهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ عَبْدًا قِبْطِيًّا مَاتَ عَامَ أَوَّلَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i, sulaymaanu bnu daawuda al'atakiyyu haddathanaa hammaadun, - ya'niy abna zaydin - 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna rajulaan, mina alaansaari aa'taqa ghulaamana lahu 'an duburin lam yakun lahu maalun ghayruhu fabalagha dhalika alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ man yashtariyhi minniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faashtaraahu nu'aymu bnu 'abdi alllahi bithamaanimiaiaai dirhamin fadafa'ahaa iilayhi ‏.‏ qaala 'amrunw sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi yaquwlu 'abdana qibtiyyana maata 'aama aawwala ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah said that a person among the Ansar declared his slave free after his death, as he had no other property. This news reached the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said:Who will buy him from me? And Nu'aim b. al-Nahham bought him for eight hundred dirhams and he handed them over to him, 'Amr (one of the narrators) said: I heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah as saying: He was a Coptic slave, and he died in the first year (of the Caliphate of 'Abdullah b. Zubair)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعَ عَمْرٌو، جَابِرًا يَقُولُ دَبَّرَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ غُلاَمًا لَهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ غَيْرُهُ فَبَاعَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ جَابِرٌ فَاشْتَرَاهُ ابْنُ النَّحَّامِ عَبْدًا قِبْطِيًّا مَاتَ عَامَ أَوَّلَ فِي إِمَارَةِ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, qaala sami'a 'amrunw, jaabirana yaquwlu dabbara rajulun mina alaansaari ghulaamana lahu lam yakun lahu maalun ghayruhu fabaa'ahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaala jaabirun faashtaraahu abnu alnnahhaami 'abdana qibtiyyana maata 'aama aawwala fiy iimaaraai abni alzzubayri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir is reported to have said:A person amongst the Ansar who had no other property declared a slave free after his death. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sold him, and Ibn al-Nahham bought him and he was a Coptic slave (who) died in the first year of the Caliphate of Ibn Zubair
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ، رُمْحٍ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمُدَبَّرِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waabnu, rumhin 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy almudabbari nahwa hadiythi hammaadin 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Jabir through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ بْنِ، سُهَيْلٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، ح. وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ، ذَكْوَانَ الْمُعَلِّمِ حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءٌ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح. وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ مَطَرٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ، أَبِي رَبَاحٍ وَأَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ وَعَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَهُمْ فِي، بَيْعِ الْمُدَبَّرِ ‏.‏ كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ قَالَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ حَمَّادٍ وَابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ جَابِرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa almughiyraau, - ya'niy alhizaamiyya - 'an 'abdi almajiydi bni, suhaylin 'an 'ataa'i bni aabiy rabaahin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, h. wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu haashimin, haddathanaa yahyaa, - ya'niy abna sa'iydin - 'ani alhusayni bni, dhakwaana almu'allimi haddathaniy 'ataa'un, 'an jaabirin, h. wahaddathaniy aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, haddathanaa mu'aadhun, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an matarin, 'an 'ataa'i bni, aabiy rabaahin waaabiy alzzubayri wa'amriw bni diynaarin aanna jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, haddathahum fiy, bay'i almudabbari ‏.‏ kullu hauulaa'i qaala 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bima'naa hadiythi hammaadin waabni 'uyaynaaa 'an 'amrinw 'an jaabirin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) through other chains of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
