verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ بُشَيْرِ، بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ، - قَالَ يَحْيَى وَحَسِبْتُ قَالَ - وَعَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ خَرَجَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَهْلِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ وَمُحَيِّصَةُ بْنُ مَسْعُودِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَا بِخَيْبَرَ تَفَرَّقَا فِي بَعْضِ مَا هُنَالِكَ ثُمَّ إِذَا مُحَيِّصَةُ يَجِدُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سَهْلٍ قَتِيلاً فَدَفَنَهُ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هُوَ وَحُوَيِّصَةُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَهْلٍ وَكَانَ أَصْغَرَ الْقَوْمِ فَذَهَبَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ لِيَتَكَلَّمَ قَبْلَ صَاحِبَيْهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كَبِّرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ الْكُبْرَ فِي السِّنِّ فَصَمَتَ فَتَكَلَّمَ صَاحِبَاهُ وَتَكَلَّمَ مَعَهُمَا فَذَكَرُوا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَقْتَلَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ أَتَحْلِفُونَ خَمْسِينَ يَمِينًا فَتَسْتَحِقُّونَ صَاحِبَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ ‏"‏ قَاتِلَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَكَيْفَ نَحْلِفُ وَلَمْ نَشْهَدْ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَتُبْرِئُكُمْ يَهُودُ بِخَمْسِينَ يَمِينًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَكَيْفَ نَقْبَلُ أَيْمَانَ قَوْمٍ كُفَّارٍ فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْطَى عَقْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an yahyaa, - wahuwa abnu sa'iydin - 'an bushayri, bni yasaarin 'an sahli bni aabiy hathmaaa, - qaala yahyaa wahasibtu qaala - wa'an raafi'i bni khadiyjin, aannahumaa qaalaa kharaja 'abdu alllahi bnu sahli bni zaydin wamuhayyisaau bnu mas'uwdi bni zaydin hattaa iidhaa kaanaa bikhaybara tafarraqaa fiy ba'di maa hunaalika thumma iidhaa muhayyisaau yajidu 'abda alllahi bna sahlin qatiylaan fadafanahu thumma aaqbala iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm huwa wahuwayyisaau bnu mas'uwdin wa'abdu alrrahmani bnu sahlin wakaana aasghara alqawmi fadhahaba 'abdu alrrahmani liyatakallama qabla saahibayhi faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ kabbiri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ alkubra fiy alssinni fasamata fatakallama saahibaahu watakallama ma'ahumaa fadhakaruwa lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maqtala 'abdi alllahi bni sahlin faqaala lahum ‏"‏ aatahlifuwna khamsiyna yamiynana fatastahiqquwna saahibakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw ‏"‏ qaatilakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa wakayfa nahlifu walam nashhad qaala ‏"‏ fatubriiukum yahuwdu bikhamsiyna yamiynana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa wakayfa naqbalu aaymaana qawmin kuffaarin falammaa raaaa dhalika rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aa'taa 'aqlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Abu Hathma and Rafi' b. Khadij reported that 'Abdullah b. Sahl b. Zaid and Muhayyisa b. Mas'ud b. Zaid went out and as they reached Khaibar they were separated. Then Muhayyisa found 'Abdullah b. Sahl having been killed. He buried him, and then came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). They were Huwayyisa b. Mas'ud and 'Abd al-Rahman b. Sahl, and he (the latter one) was the youngest of the people (those three who had come to seek an interview with the Holy Prophet) began to talk before his Companions (had spoken). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The eldest one (eldest in regard to age should speak). So he kept quiet, and his companions (Muhayyisa and Huwayyisa) began to speak, and he ('Abd al Rahman) spoke along with them and they narrated to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the murder of 'Abdullah b. Sahl. Thereupon he said to them: Are you prepared to take fifty oaths so that you may be entitled (to blood-wit) of your companion (or your man who has murdered)? They said: How can we take an oath on a matter which we have not witnessed? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Then the Jews will exonerate themselves by fifty oaths. They said: How can we accept the oaths of people who are unbelievers? When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw that, he himself paid his blood-wit
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ، وَرَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، أَنَّ مُحَيِّصَةَ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، وَعَبْدَ، اللَّهِ بْنَ سَهْلٍ انْطَلَقَا قِبَلَ خَيْبَرَ فَتَفَرَّقَا فِي النَّخْلِ فَقُتِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَهْلٍ فَاتَّهَمُوا الْيَهُودَ فَجَاءَ أَخُوهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ وَابْنَا عَمِّهِ حُوَيِّصَةُ وَمُحَيِّصَةُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَكَلَّمَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ فِي أَمْرِ أَخِيهِ وَهُوَ أَصْغَرُ مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كَبِّرِ الْكُبْرَ - أَوْ قَالَ - لِيَبْدَإِ الأَكْبَرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَتَكَلَّمَا فِي أَمْرِ صَاحِبِهِمَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يُقْسِمُ خَمْسُونَ مِنْكُمْ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ فَيُدْفَعُ بِرُمَّتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا أَمْرٌ لَمْ نَشْهَدْهُ كَيْفَ نَحْلِفُ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَتُبْرِئُكُمْ يَهُودُ بِأَيْمَانِ خَمْسِينَ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَوْمٌ كُفَّارٌ قَالَ فَوَدَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ قِبَلِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَهْلٌ فَدَخَلْتُ مِرْبَدًا لَهُمْ يَوْمًا فَرَكَضَتْنِي نَاقَةٌ مِنْ تِلْكَ الإِبِلِ رَكْضَةً بِرِجْلِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ حَمَّادٌ هَذَا أَوْ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an bushayri bni yasaarin, 'an sahli bni aabiy hathmaaa, waraafi'i bni khadiyjin, aanna muhayyisaaa bna mas'uwdin, wa'abda, alllahi bna sahlin antalaqaa qibala khaybara fatafarraqaa fiy alnnakhli faqutila 'abdu alllahi bnu sahlin faattahamuwa alyahuwda fajaa'a aakhuwhu 'abdu alrrahmani waabnaa 'ammihi huwayyisaau wamuhayyisaau iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fatakallama 'abdu alrrahmani fiy aamri aakhiyhi wahuwa aasgharu minhum faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ kabbiri alkubra - aaw qaala - liyabdaii alaakbaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fatakallamaa fiy aamri saahibihimaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yuqsimu khamsuwna minkum 'alaa rajulin minhum fayudfa'u birummatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa aamrun lam nashhadhu kayfa nahlifu qaala ‏"‏ fatubriiukum yahuwdu biaaymaani khamsiyna minhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi qawmun kuffaarun qaala fawadaahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min qibalihi ‏.‏ qaala sahlun fadakhaltu mirbadana lahum yawmana farakadatniy naaqaaun min tilka aliibili rakdaaan birijlihaa ‏.‏ qaala hammaadun hadhaa aaw nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl. b. Abu Hathma and Rafi' b. Khadij reported that Muhayyisa b. Mas'ud and 'Abdullah b. Sahl went towards Khaibar and they separated near the palm-trees. 'Abdullah b. Sahl was killed. They accused the Jews (for this act). And there came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) his brother (the brother of the slain person) 'Abd al-Rahman and his cousins Huwayyisa and Muhayyisa; and 'Abd al-Rahman talked to him about the matter pertaining to (the murder of) his brother, and he was the youngest among them. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Show regard for the greatness of the old, or he said: Let the eldest begin speaking. Then they (Huwayyisa and Muhayyisa) spoke about the matter of their companion (murder of their cousin, 'Abdullah b. Sahl). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Let fifty (persons) among you take oath for levelling the charge (of murder) against a person amongst them, and he would be surrendered to you. They said: We have not witnessed this matter ourselves. How can we then take oath? He (the Holy Prophet) said: The Jews will exonerate themselves by the oaths of fifty of them. They said: Messenger of Allah, they are non-believing people. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) paid the blood wit for him. Sahl said: As one day I entered the fold a she-camel amongst those camels hit me with its leg
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ، يَسَارٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ فَعَقَلَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ عِنْدِهِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ فِي حَدِيثِهِ فَرَكَضَتْنِي نَاقَةٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa alqawaariyriyyu, haddathanaa bishru bnu almufaddali, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an bushayri bni, yasaarin 'an sahli bni aabiy hathmaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ nahwahu ‏.‏ waqaala fiy hadiythihi fa'aqalahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min 'indihi ‏.‏ walam yaqul fiy hadiythihi farakadatniy naaqaaun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Abu Hathma has narrated this hadith through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words, but no mention has been made of the hitting by the she-camel
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِي الثَّقَفِيَّ - جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ، بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, - ya'niy althhaqafiyya - jamiy'ana 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an bushayri bni yasaarin, 'an sahli, bni aabiy hathmaaa binahwi hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sahl b. Abu Hathma through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سَهْلِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، وَمُحَيِّصَةَ بْنَ مَسْعُودِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّيْنِ، ثُمَّ مِنْ بَنِي حَارِثَةَ خَرَجَا إِلَى خَيْبَرَ فِي زَمَانِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ يَوْمَئِذٍ صُلْحٌ وَأَهْلُهَا يَهُودُ فَتَفَرَّقَا لِحَاجَتِهِمَا فَقُتِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَهْلٍ فَوُجِدَ فِي شَرَبَةٍ مَقْتُولاً فَدَفَنَهُ صَاحِبُهُ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَمَشَى أَخُو الْمَقْتُولِ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَهْلٍ وَمُحَيِّصَةُ وَحُوَيِّصَةُ فَذَكَرُوا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَأْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَحَيْثُ قُتِلَ فَزَعَمَ بُشَيْرٌ وَهُوَ يُحَدِّثُ عَمَّنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ تَحْلِفُونَ خَمْسِينَ يَمِينًا وَتَسْتَحِقُّونَ قَاتِلَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ ‏"‏ صَاحِبَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا شَهِدْنَا وَلاَ حَضَرْنَا ‏.‏ فَزَعَمَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَتُبْرِئُكُمْ يَهُودُ بِخَمْسِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ نَقْبَلُ أَيْمَانَ قَوْمٍ كُفَّارٍ فَزَعَمَ بُشَيْرٌ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَقَلَهُ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an bushayri bni yasaarin, aanna 'abda alllahi bna sahli bni zaydin, wamuhayyisaaa bna mas'uwdi bni zaydin alaansaariyyayni, thumma min baniy haarithaaa kharajaa iilaa khaybara fiy zamaani rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahiya yawmaiidhin sulhun waaahluhaa yahuwdu fatafarraqaa lihaajatihimaa faqutila 'abdu alllahi bnu sahlin fawujida fiy sharabaain maqtuwlaan fadafanahu saahibuhu thumma aaqbala iilaa almadiynaai famashaa aakhuw almaqtuwli 'abdu alrrahmani bnu sahlin wamuhayyisaau wahuwayyisaau fadhakaruwa lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shaana 'abdi alllahi wahaythu qutila faza'ama bushayrun wahuwa yuhaddithu 'amman aadraka min aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala lahum ‏"‏ tahlifuwna khamsiyna yamiynana watastahiqquwna qaatilakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw ‏"‏ saahibakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi maa shahidnaa walaa hadarnaa ‏.‏ faza'ama aannahu qaala ‏"‏ fatubriiukum yahuwdu bikhamsiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa naqbalu aaymaana qawmin kuffaarin faza'ama bushayrun aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aqalahu min 'indihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Bushair b. Yasar reported that 'Abdullah b. Sahl b. Zaid and Muhayyisa b. Mas'ud b. Zaid, both of them were Ansar belonging to the tribe of Banu Haritha, set out to Khaibar during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). There was peace during those days and (this place) was inhabited by the Jews. They parted company for their (respective) needs. 'Abdullab b. Sahl was killed, and his dead body was found in a tank. His companion (Muhayyisa) buried him and came to Medina, and the brothers of the slain 'Abd al-Rahman b. Sahl. and Muhayyisa and Huwayyisa told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the case of 'Abdullah and the place where he had been murdered. Bushair reported on the authority of one who had seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he had said to them:You take fifty oaths and you are entitled to blood-wit of (one) slain among you (or your companion). They said: Messenger of Allah, we neither saw (with our own eyes this murder) nor were we present there. Thereupon (Allah's Messenger is reported to have said): Then the Jews will exonerate themselves by taking fifty oaths. They said: Allah's Messenger, how can we accept the oath of unbelieving people? Bushair said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) paid the blood-wit himself
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ مِنْ بَنِي حَارِثَةَ يُقَالُ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَهْلِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ انْطَلَقَ هُوَ وَابْنُ عَمٍّ لَهُ يُقَالُ لَهُ مُحَيِّصَةُ بْنُ مَسْعُودِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ فَوَدَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ عِنْدِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَحْيَى فَحَدَّثَنِي بُشَيْرُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ قَالَ لَقَدْ رَكَضَتْنِي فَرِيضَةٌ مِنْ تِلْكَ الْفَرَائِضِ بِالْمِرْبَدِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an bushayri bni yasaarin, aanna rajulaan, mina alaansaari min baniy haarithaaa yuqaalu lahu 'abdu alllahi bnu sahli bni zaydin antalaqa huwa waabnu 'ammin lahu yuqaalu lahu muhayyisaau bnu mas'uwdi bni zaydin ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha binahwi hadiythi alllaythi iilaa qawlihi fawadaahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min 'indihi ‏.‏ qaala yahyaa fahaddathaniy bushayru bnu yasaarin qaala aakhbaraniy sahlu bnu aabiy hathmaaa qaala laqad rakadatniy fariydaaun min tilka alfaraaiidi bialmirbadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Bushair b. Yasar reported that a person from the Ansar belonging to the tribe of Banu Haritha who was called 'Abdullah b. Sahl b. Zaid set out and the son of his uncle called Muhayyisa b. Mas'ud b. Zaid, the rest of the hadith is the same up to the words:" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) paid the blood-wit himself." Bushair b. Yasar reported that Sahl b. Abu Hathma said: One camel amongst the camels paid as blood-wit kicked me while I was in the (camel) enclosure
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بُشَيْرُ، بْنُ يَسَارٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ نَفَرًا مِنْهُمُ انْطَلَقُوا إِلَى خَيْبَرَ فَتَفَرَّقُوا فِيهَا فَوَجَدُوا أَحَدَهُمْ قَتِيلاً ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَقَالَ فِيهِ فَكَرِهَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُبْطِلَ دَمَهُ فَوَدَاهُ مِائَةً مِنْ إِبِلِ الصَّدَقَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'ubaydin, haddathanaa bushayru, bnu yasaarin alaansaariyyu 'an sahli bni aabiy hathmaaa alaansaariyyi, aannahu aakhbarahu aanna nafarana minhumu antalaquwa iilaa khaybara fatafarraquwa fiyhaa fawajaduwa aahadahum qatiylaan ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha waqaala fiyhi fakariha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yubtila damahu fawadaahu miaiaaan min iibili alssadaqaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Bushair b. Yasar al-Ansari reported on the authority of Sahl b. Abu Hathma al-Ansari that some men (of his tribe went to Khaibar, and they were separated from one another, and they found one of them slain. The rest of the hadith is the same. And it was said in this connection:Allah's Messenger (may peace be him) did not approve of his blood go waste. He paid blood-wit of one hundred camels of Sadaqa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَالِكَ بْنَ أَنَسٍ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو لَيْلَى بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ رِجَالٍ، مِنْ كُبَرَاءِ قَوْمِهِ أَنَّ عَبْدَ، اللَّهِ بْنَ سَهْلٍ وَمُحَيِّصَةَ خَرَجَا إِلَى خَيْبَرَ مِنْ جَهْدٍ أَصَابَهُمْ فَأَتَى مُحَيِّصَةُ فَأَخْبَرَ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سَهْلٍ قَدْ قُتِلَ وَطُرِحَ فِي عَيْنٍ أَوْ فَقِيرٍ فَأَتَى يَهُودَ فَقَالَ أَنْتُمْ وَاللَّهِ قَتَلْتُمُوهُ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَاللَّهِ مَا قَتَلْنَاهُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ حَتَّى قَدِمَ عَلَى قَوْمِهِ فَذَكَرَ لَهُمْ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ هُوَ وَأَخُوهُ حُوَيِّصَةُ وَهُوَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْهُ وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَهْلٍ فَذَهَبَ مُحَيِّصَةُ لِيَتَكَلَّمَ وَهُوَ الَّذِي كَانَ بِخَيْبَرَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِمُحَيِّصَةَ ‏"‏ كَبِّرْ كَبِّرْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يُرِيدُ السِّنَّ فَتَكَلَّمَ حُوَيِّصَةُ ثُمَّ تَكَلَّمَ مُحَيِّصَةُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِمَّا أَنْ يَدُوا صَاحِبَكُمْ وَإِمَّا أَنْ يُؤْذِنُوا بِحَرْبٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَكَتَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَيْهِمْ فِي ذَلِكَ فَكَتَبُوا إِنَّا وَاللَّهِ مَا قَتَلْنَاهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِحُوَيِّصَةَ وَمُحَيِّصَةَ وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏"‏ أَتَحْلِفُونَ وَتَسْتَحِقُّونَ دَمَ صَاحِبِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَتَحْلِفُ لَكُمْ يَهُودُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا لَيْسُوا بِمُسْلِمِينَ ‏.‏ فَوَدَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ عِنْدِهِ فَبَعَثَ إِلَيْهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِائَةَ نَاقَةٍ حَتَّى أُدْخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الدَّارَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَهْلٌ فَلَقَدْ رَكَضَتْنِي مِنْهَا نَاقَةٌ حَمْرَاءُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa bishru bnu 'umara, qaala sami'tu maalika bna aanasin, yaquwlu haddathaniy aabuw laylaa bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni sahlin, 'an sahli bni aabiy hathmaaa, aannahu aakhbarahu 'an rijaalin, min kubaraa'i qawmihi aanna 'abda, alllahi bna sahlin wamuhayyisaaa kharajaa iilaa khaybara min jahdin aasaabahum faaataa muhayyisaau faaakhbara aanna 'abda alllahi bna sahlin qad qutila waturiha fiy 'aynin aaw faqiyrin faaataa yahuwda faqaala aantum waalllahi qataltumuwhu ‏.‏ qaaluwa waalllahi maa qatalnaahu ‏.‏ thumma aaqbala hattaa qadima 'alaa qawmihi fadhakara lahum dhalika thumma aaqbala huwa waaakhuwhu huwayyisaau wahuwa aakbaru minhu wa'abdu alrrahmani bnu sahlin fadhahaba muhayyisaau liyatakallama wahuwa alladhiy kaana bikhaybara faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm limuhayyisaaa ‏"‏ kabbir kabbir ‏"‏ ‏.‏ yuriydu alssinna fatakallama huwayyisaau thumma takallama muhayyisaau ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iimmaa aan yaduwa saahibakum waiimmaa aan yuudhinuwa biharbin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fakataba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilayhim fiy dhalika fakatabuwa iinnaa waalllahi maa qatalnaahu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lihuwayyisaaa wamuhayyisaaa wa'abdi alrrahmani ‏"‏ aatahlifuwna watastahiqquwna dama saahibikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fatahlifu lakum yahuwdu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa laysuwa bimuslimiyna ‏.‏ fawadaahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min 'indihi faba'atha iilayhim rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm miaiaaa naaqaain hattaa audkhilat 'alayhimu alddaara ‏.‏ faqaala sahlun falaqad rakadatniy minhaa naaqaaun hamraa'u ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Laila 'Abdullah b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Sahl reported that the elderly persons of (the tribe) had informed Sahl b. Abu Hathma that 'Abdullah b. Sahl and Muhayyisa went out to Khaibar under some distress which had afflicted them. Muhayyisa came and informed that Abdutlah b. Sahl had been killed, and (his dead body) had been thrown in a well or in a ditch. He came to the Jews and said:By Allah, it is you who have killed him. They said: By Allah, we have not killed him. He then came to his people, and made mention of that to them. Then came he and his brother Huwayyisa, and he was older than he, and 'Abd al-Rahman b. Sahl. Then Muhayyisa went to speak, and it was he who had accompanied ('Abdullah) to Khaibar, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Muhayyisa: Observe greatness of the great (he meant the seniority of age). Then Huwayyisa spoke and then Muhayyisa also spoke. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: They should either pay blood-wit for your companion, or be prepared for war. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wrote about it to them (to the Jews). They wrote: Verily, by Allah, we have not killed him. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Huwayyisa and Muhayyisa and Abd al-Rahman: Are you prepared to take oath in order to entitle yourselves for the blood-wit of your companion? They said: No. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Then the Jews will take oath (of their innocence). They said: They are not Muslims. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), however, himself paid the blood-wit to them and sent to them one hundred camels until they entered into their houses, Sahl said: One red she-camel among them kicked me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، حَرْمَلَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَسُلَيْمَانُ، بْنُ يَسَارٍ مَوْلَى مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَقَرَّ الْقَسَامَةَ عَلَى مَا كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaala aabuw alttaahiri haddathanaa waqaala, harmalaau aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, wasulaymaanu, bnu yasaarin mawlaa maymuwnaaa zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an rajulin min aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alaansaari aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaqarra alqasaamaaa 'alaa maa kaanat 'alayhi fiy aljaahiliyyaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sulaiman b. Yasar, the freed slave of Maimuna, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), narrated from one of the Ansari Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) retained (the practice) of Qasama as it was in the pre-Islamic days
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، شِهَابٍ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ وَقَضَى بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ نَاسٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فِي قَتِيلٍ ادَّعَوْهُ عَلَى الْيَهُودِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, qaala aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, haddathanaa abnu, shihaabin bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏ wazaada waqadaa bihaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna naasin mina alaansaari fiy qatiylin adda'awhu 'alaa alyahuwdi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition:" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) decided (according to Qasama) between the persons of Ansar (and yours) about a slain (Muslim) for which they made claim against the Jews
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَسُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، أَخْبَرَاهُ عَنْ نَاسٍ، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa hasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din - haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna aabaa salamaaa bna 'abdi alrrahmani, wasulaymaana bna yasaarin, aakhbaraahu 'an naasin, mina alaansaari 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi abni jurayjin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman and Sulaiman b. Yasar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، وَحُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ نَاسًا، مِنْ عُرَيْنَةَ قَدِمُوا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ فَاجْتَوَوْهَا فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنْ شِئْتُمْ أَنْ تَخْرُجُوا إِلَى إِبِلِ الصَّدَقَةِ فَتَشْرَبُوا مِنْ أَلْبَانِهَا وَأَبْوَالِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَفَعَلُوا فَصَحُّوا ثُمَّ مَالُوا عَلَى الرِّعَاءِ فَقَتَلُوهُمْ وَارْتَدُّوا عَنِ الإِسْلاَمِ وَسَاقُوا ذَوْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبَعَثَ فِي أَثْرِهِمْ فَأُتِيَ بِهِمْ فَقَطَعَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ وَسَمَلَ أَعْيُنَهُمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ فِي الْحَرَّةِ حَتَّى مَاتُوا
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa kilaahumaa 'an hushaymin, - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaala aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni suhaybin, wahumaydin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna naasana, min 'uraynaaa qadimuwa 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa faajtawawhaa faqaala lahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iin shiitum aan takhrujuwa iilaa iibili alssadaqaai fatashrabuwa min aalbaanihaa waaabwaalihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fafa'aluwa fasahhuwa thumma maaluwa 'alaa alrri'aa'i faqataluwhum waartadduwa 'ani aliislaami wasaaquwa dhawda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fabalagha dhalika alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faba'atha fiy aathrihim faautiya bihim faqata'a aaydiyahum waaarjulahum wasamala aa'yunahum watarakahum fiy alharraai hattaa maatuwa
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that some people belonging (to the tribe) of 'Uraina came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at Medina, but they found its climate uncogenial. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them:If you so like, you may go to the camels of Sadaqa and drink their milk and urine. They did so and were all right. They then fell upon the shepherds and killed them and turned apostates from Islam and drove off the camels of the Prophet (ﷺ). This news reached Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he sent (people) on their track and they were (brought) and handed over to him. He (the Holy Prophet) got their hands cut off, and their feet, and put out their eyes, and threw them on the stony ground until they died
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو رَجَاءٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسٌ، أَنَّ نَفَرًا، مِنْ عُكْلٍ ثَمَانِيَةً قَدِمُوا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبَايَعُوهُ عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ فَاسْتَوْخَمُوا الأَرْضَ وَسَقُمَتْ أَجْسَامُهُمْ فَشَكَوْا ذَلِكَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلاَ تَخْرُجُونَ مَعَ رَاعِينَا فِي إِبِلِهِ فَتُصِيبُونَ مِنْ أَبْوَالِهَا وَأَلْبَانِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا بَلَى ‏.‏ فَخَرَجُوا فَشَرِبُوا مِنْ أَبْوَالِهَا وَأَلْبَانِهَا فَصَحُّوا فَقَتَلُوا الرَّاعِيَ وَطَرَدُوا الإِبِلَ فَبَلغَ ذَلِكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبَعَثَ فِي آثَارِهِمْ فَأُدْرِكُوا فَجِيءَ بِهِمْ فَأَمَرَ بِهِمْ فَقُطِعَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُمْ وَسُمِرَ أَعْيُنُهُمْ ثُمَّ نُبِذُوا فِي الشَّمْسِ حَتَّى مَاتُوا ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ وَاطَّرَدُوا النَّعَمَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ وَسُمِّرَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ja'farin, muhammadu bnu alssabbaahi waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin - qaala haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an hajjaaji bni aabiy 'uthmaana, haddathaniy aabuw rajaa'in, mawlaa aabiy qilaabaaa 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, haddathaniy aanasun, aanna nafarana, min 'uklin thamaaniyaaan qadimuwa 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fabaaya'uwhu 'alaa aliislaami faastawkhamuwa alaarda wasaqumat aajsaamuhum fashakawa dhalika iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ aalaa takhrujuwna ma'a raa'iynaa fiy iibilihi fatusiybuwna min aabwaalihaa waaalbaanihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa balaa ‏.‏ fakharajuwa fasharibuwa min aabwaalihaa waaalbaanihaa fasahhuwa faqataluwa alrraa'iya wataraduwa aliibila fabalgha dhalika rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faba'atha fiy athaarihim faaudrikuwa fajiy'a bihim faaamara bihim faquti'at aaydiyhim waaarjuluhum wasumira aa'yunuhum thumma nubidhuwa fiy alshhamsi hattaa maatuwa ‏.‏ waqaala abnu alssabbaahi fiy riwaayatihi waattaraduwa alnna'ama ‏.‏ waqaala wasummirat aa'yunuhum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:Eight men of the tribe of 'Ukl came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and swore allegiance to him on Islam, but found the climate of that land uncogenial to their health and thus they became sick, and they made complaint of that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he said: Why don't you go to (the fold) of our camels along with our shepherd, and make use of their milk and urine. They said: Yes. They set out and drank their (camels') milk and urine and regained their health. They killed the shepherd and drove away the camels. This (news) reached Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he sent them on their track and they were caught and brought to him (the Holy Prophet). He commanded about them, and (thus) their hands and feet were cut off and their eyes were gouged and then they were thrown in the sun, until they died. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn al-Sabbah with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَدِمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَوْمٌ مِنْ عُكْلٍ أَوْ عُرَيْنَةَ فَاجْتَوَوُا الْمَدِينَةَ فَأَمَرَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِلِقَاحٍ وَأَمَرَهُمْ أَنْ يَشْرَبُوا مِنْ أَبْوَالِهَا وَأَلْبَانِهَا ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَسُمِرَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ وَأُلْقُوا فِي الْحَرَّةِ يَسْتَسْقُونَ فَلاَ يُسْقَوْنَ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy rajaa'in, mawlaa aabiy qilaabaaa qaala qaala aabuw qilaabaaa haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, qaala qadima 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qawmun min 'uklin aaw 'uraynaaa faajtawawua almadiynaaa faaamara lahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biliqaahin waaamarahum aan yashrabuwa min aabwaalihaa waaalbaanihaa ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi hajjaaji bni aabiy 'uthmaana ‏.‏ qaala wasumirat aa'yunuhum waaulquwa fiy alharraai yastasquwna falaa yusqawna
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that some people of the tribe of 'Ukl or 'Uraina came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and they found the climate of Medina uncogenial. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded them to the milch she-camels and commanded them to drink their urine and their milk. The rest of the hadith is the same (and the concluding words are):" Their eyes were pierced, and they were thrown on the stony ground. They were asking for water, but they were not given water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ النَّوْفَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَزْهَرُ السَّمَّانُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَجَاءٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ جَالِسًا خَلْفَ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فَقَالَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا تَقُولُونَ فِي الْقَسَامَةِ فَقَالَ عَنْبَسَةُ قَدْ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَقُلْتُ إِيَّاىَ حَدَّثَ أَنَسٌ قَدِمَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَوْمٌ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ أَيُّوبَ وَحَجَّاجٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ فَلَمَّا فَرَغْتُ قَالَ عَنْبَسَةُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ - قَالَ أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ - فَقُلْتُ أَتَتَّهِمُنِي يَا عَنْبَسَةُ قَالَ لاَ هَكَذَا حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ لَنْ تَزَالُوا بِخَيْرٍ يَا أَهْلَ الشَّامِ مَادَامَ فِيكُمْ هَذَا أَوْ مِثْلُ هَذَا
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu mu'aadhin, h wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'uthmaana alnnawfaliyyu, haddathanaa aazharu alssammaanu, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu 'awnin, haddathanaa aabuw rajaa'in, mawlaa aabiy qilaabaaa 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, qaala kuntu jaalisana khalfa 'umara bni 'abdi al'aziyzi faqaala lilnnaasi maa taquwluwna fiy alqasaamaai faqaala 'anbasaau qad haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin kadhaa wakadhaa faqultu iiyyaaaa haddatha aanasun qadima 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qawmun ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha binahwi hadiythi aayyuwba wahajjaajin ‏.‏ qaala aabuw qilaabaaa falammaa faraghtu qaala 'anbasaau subhaana alllahi - qaala aabuw qilaabaaa - faqultu aatattahimuniy yaa 'anbasaau qaala laa hakadhaa haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin lan tazaaluwa bikhayrin yaa aahla alshhaami maadaama fiykum hadhaa aaw mithlu hadhaa
verses.translation: Abu Qilaba reported:I was sitting behind 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz and he said to the people: What do you say about al-Qasama? Thereupon 'Anbasa said: Anas b Malik narrated to us such and such (hadith pertaining to al-Qasama). I said: This is what Anas had narrated to me: People came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and the rest of the hadith is the same. When I (Abu Qilaba) finished (the narration of this hadith), 'Anbasa said: Hallowed be Allah. I said: Do you blame me (for telling a lie)? He ('Anbasa) said: No. This is how Anas b Malik narrated to us. O people of Syria, you would not be deprived of good, so long as such (a person) or one like him lives amongst you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَبِي شُعَيْبٍ الْحَرَّانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مِسْكِينٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ بُكَيْرٍ الْحَرَّانِيُّ - أَخْبَرَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَدِمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَمَانِيَةُ نَفَرٍ مِنْ عُكْلٍ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ وَلَمْ يَحْسِمْهُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa alhasanu bnu aabiy shu'aybin alharraaniyyu, haddathanaa miskiynun, - wahuwa abnu bukayrin alharraaniyyu - aakhbaranaa alaawzaa'iyyu, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qadima 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thamaaniyaau nafarin min 'uklin ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythihim ‏.‏ wazaada fiy alhadiythi walam yahsimhum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:There came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eight persons from the tribe of 'Ukl, but with this addition that he did not cauterise (the wounds which hid been inflicted upon them while punishing them)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سِمَاكُ، بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَفَرٌ مِنْ عُرَيْنَةَ فَأَسْلَمُوا وَبَايَعُوهُ وَقَدْ وَقَعَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ الْمُومُ - وَهُوَ الْبِرْسَامُ - ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ وَزَادَ وَعِنْدَهُ شَبَابٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ قَرِيبٌ مِنْ عِشْرِينَ فَأَرْسَلَهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ وَبَعَثَ مَعَهُمْ قَائِفًا يَقْتَصُّ أَثَرَهُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa simaaku, bnu harbin 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni qurraaa, 'an aanasin, qaala aataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nafarun min 'uraynaaa faaaslamuwa wabaaya'uwhu waqad waqa'a bialmadiynaai almuwmu - wahuwa albirsaamu - thumma dhakara nahwa hadiythihim wazaada wa'indahu shabaabun mina alaansaari qariybun min 'ishriyna faaarsalahum iilayhim waba'atha ma'ahum qaaiifana yaqtassu aatharahum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:There came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) some ponple from 'Uraina. They embraced Islam and swore allegiance to him and there had spread at that time pleurisy. The rest of the hadith is the same (but with this addition):" There were by his (the Prophet's) side about twenty young men of the Ansar; he sent them (behind) them (culprits), and he also sent along with them one expert in following the track so that he might trace their footprints
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، وَفِي حَدِيثِ هَمَّامٍ قَدِمَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَهْطٌ مِنْ عُرَيْنَةَ وَفِي حَدِيثِ سَعِيدٍ مِنْ عُكْلٍ وَعُرَيْنَةَ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haddaabu bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasin, h. wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, wafiy hadiythi hammaamin qadima 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm rahtun min 'uraynaaa wafiy hadiythi sa'iydin min 'uklin wa'uraynaaa ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْفَضْلُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ الأَعْرَجُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ إِنَّمَا سَمَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْيُنَ أُولَئِكَ لأَنَّهُمْ سَمَلُوا أَعْيُنَ الرِّعَاءِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy alfadlu bnu sahlin alaa'raju, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu ghaylaana, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'an sulaymaana alttaymiyyi, 'an aanasin, qaala iinnamaa samala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aa'yuna auwlaiika laannahum samaluwa aa'yuna alrri'aa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pierced their eyes because they had pierced the eyes of the shepherds
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ يَهُودِيًّا، قَتَلَ جَارِيَةً عَلَى أَوْضَاحٍ لَهَا فَقَتَلَهَا بِحَجَرٍ - قَالَ - فَجِيءَ بِهَا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِهَا رَمَقٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏ "‏ أَقَتَلَكِ فُلاَنٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَشَارَتْ بِرَأْسِهَا أَنْ لاَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهَا الثَّانِيَةَ فَأَشَارَتْ بِرَأْسِهَا أَنْ لاَ ثُمَّ سَأَلَهَا الثَّالِثَةَ فَقَالَتْ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ وَأَشَارَتْ بِرَأْسِهَا فَقَتَلَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ حَجَرَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an hishaami bni zaydin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna yahuwdiyyana, qatala jaariyaaan 'alaa aawdaahin lahaa faqatalahaa bihajarin - qaala - fajiy'a bihaa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wabihaa ramaqun faqaala lahaa ‏ "‏ aaqatalaki fulaanun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaashaarat biraasihaa aan laa thumma qaala lahaa althhaaniyaaa faaashaarat biraasihaa aan laa thumma saaalahaa althhaalithaaa faqaalat na'am ‏.‏ waaashaarat biraasihaa faqatalahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna hajarayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that a Jew killed a girl with a stone for her silver ornaments. She was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when there was yet some life in her. He (the Holy Prophet) said to her:Has so and so killed you? She indicated with the nod of her head: No. He said for the second time, and she again said: No with the nod of her head. He asked for the third time, and she said: Yes with the nod of her head and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded to crush his head between two stones
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ إِدْرِيسَ فَرَضَخَ رَأْسَهُ بَيْنَ حَجَرَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun ya'niy abna alhaarithi, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu iidriysa, kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwahu wafiy hadiythi abni iidriysa faradakha raasahu bayna hajarayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters and in the hadith narrated on the authority of Ibn Idris (the words are):" He (commanded) to crush his head between two stones
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الْيَهُودِ قَتَلَ جَارِيَةً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ عَلَى حُلِيٍّ لَهَا ثُمَّ أَلْقَاهَا فِي الْقَلِيبِ وَرَضَخَ رَأْسَهَا بِالْحِجَارَةِ فَأُخِذَ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَمَرَ بِهِ أَنْ يُرْجَمَ حَتَّى يَمُوتَ فَرُجِمَ حَتَّى مَاتَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasin, aanna rajulaan, mina alyahuwdi qatala jaariyaaan mina alaansaari 'alaa huliyyin lahaa thumma aalqaahaa fiy alqaliybi waradakha raasahaa bialhijaaraai faaukhidha faautiya bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaamara bihi aan yurjama hattaa yamuwta farujima hattaa maata ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that a Jew killed a girl of the Ansar for her ornaments and then threw her in a well and smashed her head with a stone. He was caught and brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he commanded that he should be stoned to death. So he was stoned until he died
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy ma'marun, 'an aayyuwba, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ayyub with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ جَارِيَةً، وُجِدَ رَأْسُهَا قَدْ رُضَّ بَيْنَ حَجَرَيْنِ فَسَأَلُوهَا مَنْ صَنَعَ هَذَا بِكِ فُلاَنٌ فُلاَنٌ حَتَّى ذَكَرُوا يَهُودِيًّا فَأَوْمَتْ بِرَأْسِهَا فَأُخِذَ الْيَهُودِيُّ فَأَقَرَّ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُرَضَّ رَأْسُهُ بِالْحِجَارَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haddaabu bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna jaariyaaan, wujida raasuhaa qad rudda bayna hajarayni fasaaaluwhaa man sana'a hadhaa biki fulaanun fulaanun hattaa dhakaruwa yahuwdiyyana faaawmat biraasihaa faaukhidha alyahuwdiyyu faaaqarra faaamara bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yuradda raasuhu bialhijaaraai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:A girl was found with her head crushed between two stones. They asked her as to who had done that-has so and so (done it) until they mentioned a Jew. She indicated with the nod of her head (that it was so). So the Jew was caught, and he made confession (of his guilt). And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that his head be smashed with stones
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، قَالَ قَاتَلَ يَعْلَى ابْنُ مُنْيَةَ أَوِ ابْنُ أُمَيَّةَ رَجُلاً فَعَضَّ أَحَدُهُمَا صَاحِبَهُ فَانْتَزَعَ يَدَهُ مِنْ فَمِهِ فَنَزَعَ ثَنِيَّتَهُ - وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى ثَنِيَّتَيْهِ - فَاخْتَصَمَا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيَعَضُّ أَحَدُكُمْ كَمَا يَعَضُّ الْفَحْلُ لاَ دِيَةَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an zuraaraaa, 'an 'imraana bni husaynin, qaala qaatala ya'laa abnu munyaaa aawi abnu aumayyaaa rajulaan fa'adda aahaduhumaa saahibahu faantaza'a yadahu min famihi fanaza'a thaniyyatahu - waqaala abnu almuthannaa thaniyyatayhi - faakhtasamaa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ aaya'addu aahadukum kamaa ya'addu alfahlu laa diyaaa lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Imran b. Husain reported:Ya'la b. Munya or Ibn Umayya fought with a person, and the one bit the hand of the other. And he tried to draw his hand from his mouth and thus his foreteeth ware pulled out. They referred their dispute to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon he said: Does any one of you bite as the camel bites? So there is no blood-wit for it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ يَعْلَى، عَنْ يَعْلَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni ya'laa, 'an ya'laa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ya'la
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ هِشَامٍ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، عَضَّ ذِرَاعَ رَجُلٍ فَجَذَبَهُ فَسَقَطَتْ ثَنِيَّتُهُ فَرُفِعَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَبْطَلَهُ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ لَحْمَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, haddathanaa mu'aadhun, - ya'niy abna hishaamin - haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an zuraaraaa bni aawfaa, 'an 'imraana bni husaynin, aanna rajulaan, 'adda dhiraa'a rajulin fajadhabahu fasaqatat thaniyyatuhu farufi'a iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaabtalahu waqaala ‏ "‏ aaradta aan taakula lahmahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Imran b. Husain reported that a person bit the arm of another person; he pulled it out and his foretooth fell down. This matter was taken to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and he turned it down saying:Did you want to eat his flesh?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ بُدَيْلٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَعْلَى، أَنَّ أَجِيرًا، لِيَعْلَى ابْنِ مُنْيَةَ عَضَّ رَجُلٌ ذِرَاعَهُ فَجَذَبَهَا فَسَقَطَتْ ثَنِيَّتُهُ فَرُفِعَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَبْطَلَهَا وَقَالَ ‏ " أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَقْضَمَهَا كَمَا يَقْضَمُ الْفَحْلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an budaylin, 'an 'ataa'i bni aabiy rabaahin, 'an safwaana bni ya'laa, aanna aajiyrana, liya'laa abni munyaaa 'adda rajulun dhiraa'ahu fajadhabahaa fasaqatat thaniyyatuhu farufi'a iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaabtalahaa waqaala ‏ " aaradta aan taqdamahaa kamaa yaqdamu alfahlu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Safwan b. Ya'la reported that a person bit the arm of the servant of Ya'la b. Munya. He pulled it and his foretooth fell. The matter was referred to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he turned it down and said:Did you intend to bite his hand, as the camel bites?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ النَّوْفَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَيْشُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ، بْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، عَضَّ يَدَ رَجُلٍ فَانْتَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَسَقَطَتْ ثَنِيَّتُهُ أَوْ ثَنَايَاهُ فَاسْتَعْدَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا تَأْمُرُنِي تَأْمُرُنِي أَنْ آمُرَهُ أَنْ يَدَعَ يَدَهُ فِي فِيكَ تَقْضَمُهَا كَمَا يَقْضَمُ الْفَحْلُ ادْفَعْ يَدَكَ حَتَّى يَعَضَّهَا ثُمَّ انْتَزِعْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'uthmaana alnnawfaliyyu, haddathanaa qurayshu bnu aanasin, 'ani abni 'awnin, 'an muhammadi, bni siyriyna 'an 'imraana bni husaynin, aanna rajulaan, 'adda yada rajulin faantaza'a yadahu fasaqatat thaniyyatuhu aaw thanaayaahu faasta'daa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa taamuruniy taamuruniy aan amurahu aan yada'a yadahu fiy fiyka taqdamuhaa kamaa yaqdamu alfahlu adfa' yadaka hattaa ya'addahaa thumma antazi'haa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Imran b. Husain reported that a person bit the hand of a person. He withdrew his hand and his foretooth or foreteeth fell down. He (the man who lost his teeth) referred the matter to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he said, What do you want me to do? Do you ask me that I should order him to put his hand in your mouth, and you should bite it as the camel bites? (If you want retaliation, then the only way out is) that you put your hand in his mouth (allow him) to bite that and then draw it away
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءٌ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَعْلَى ابْنِ، مُنْيَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ وَقَدْ عَضَّ يَدَ رَجُلٍ فَانْتَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَسَقَطَتْ ثَنِيَّتَاهُ - يَعْنِي الَّذِي عَضَّهُ - قَالَ فَأَبْطَلَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَقْضَمَهُ كَمَا يَقْضَمُ الْفَحْلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa 'ataa'un, 'an safwaana bni ya'laa abni, munyaaa 'an aabiyhi, qaala aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulun waqad 'adda yada rajulin faantaza'a yadahu fasaqatat thaniyyataahu - ya'niy alladhiy 'addahu - qaala faaabtalahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala ‏ "‏ aaradta aan taqdamahu kamaa yaqdamu alfahlu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Safwan b. Ya'la b. Munya reported on the authority of his father that there came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) a person who had bitten the hand of another person and who had withdrawn his hand (and as a result thereof) his foreteeth had fallen (those which had bitten). The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) turned down his (claim), and said:Do you wish to bite as the camel bites?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، أَخْبَرَنِي صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَعْلَى بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ غَزَوْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَزْوَةَ تَبُوكَ - قَالَ وَكَانَ يَعْلَى يَقُولُ تِلْكَ الْغَزْوَةُ أَوْثَقُ عَمَلِي عِنْدِي - فَقَالَ عَطَاءٌ قَالَ صَفْوَانُ قَالَ يَعْلَى كَانَ لِي أَجِيرٌ فَقَاتَلَ إِنْسَانًا فَعَضَّ أَحَدُهُمَا يَدَ الآخَرِ - قَالَ لَقَدْ أَخْبَرَنِي صَفْوَانُ أَيُّهُمَا عَضَّ الآخَرَ - فَانْتَزَعَ الْمَعْضُوضُ يَدَهُ مِنْ فِي الْعَاضِّ فَانْتَزَعَ إِحْدَى ثَنِيَّتَيْهِ فَأَتَيَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَهْدَرَ ثَنِيَّتَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, aakhbaraniy safwaanu bnu ya'laa bni aumayyaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala ghazawtu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghazwaaa tabuwka - qaala wakaana ya'laa yaquwlu tilka alghazwaau aawthaqu 'amaliy 'indiy - faqaala 'ataa'un qaala safwaanu qaala ya'laa kaana liy aajiyrun faqaatala iinsaanana fa'adda aahaduhumaa yada alakhari - qaala laqad aakhbaraniy safwaanu aayyuhumaa 'adda alakhara - faantaza'a alma'duwdu yadahu min fiy al'aaddi faantaza'a iihdaa thaniyyatayhi faaatayaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaahdara thaniyyatahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Safwan b. Ya'la b. Umayya thus reported from his father:I participated in the expedition to Tabuk with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). And Ya'la used to say: That was the most weighty of my deeds, in my opinion. Safwan said that Ya'la had stated: I had a servant; he quarrelled with another person, and the one bit the hand of the other. ('Ata' said that Safwan had told him which one had bitten the hand of the other.) So he whose hand was bitten drew ill from (the mouth) of the one who had bitten it and (in this scuffle) one of his foreteeth was also drawn out. They both came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he declared his (claim for the compensation of) tooth as invalid
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'amruw bnu zuraaraaa, aakhbaranaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Juraij with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ أُخْتَ الرُّبَيِّعِ أُمَّ حَارِثَةَ، جَرَحَتْ إِنْسَانًا فَاخْتَصَمُوا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْقِصَاصَ الْقِصَاصَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ الرَّبِيعِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيُقْتَصُّ مِنْ فُلاَنَةَ وَاللَّهِ لاَ يُقْتَصُّ مِنْهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ يَا أُمَّ الرَّبِيعِ الْقِصَاصُ كِتَابُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ لاَ وَاللَّهِ لاَ يُقْتَصُّ مِنْهَا أَبَدًا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا زَالَتْ حَتَّى قَبِلُوا الدِّيَةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنْ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ مَنْ لَوْ أَقْسَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ لأَبَرَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'affaanu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa hammaadun, aakhbaranaa thaabitun, 'an aanasin, aanna aukhta alrrubayyi'i aumma haarithaaa, jarahat iinsaanana faakhtasamuwa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alqisaasa alqisaasa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat aummu alrrabiy'i yaa rasuwla alllahi aayuqtassu min fulaanaaa waalllahi laa yuqtassu minhaa ‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ subhaana alllahi yaa aumma alrrabiy'i alqisaasu kitaabu alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat laa waalllahi laa yuqtassu minhaa aabadana ‏.‏ qaala famaa zaalat hattaa qabiluwa alddiyaaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna min 'ibaadi alllahi man law aaqsama 'alaa alllahi laabarrahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Umm Haritha, the sister of Rubayyi' (she was the father's sister of Hadrat Anas) injured a person (she broke his teeth). The dispute was referred to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Retribution, retribution. Umm Rubayyi' said: Messenger of Allah, will retribution be taken from so and so? By Allah, it shall not be taken from her (i. e. from Umm Haritha). Thereupon Allah's Apostle said: Hallowed be Allah. O Umm Rubayyi', Qisas (retribution is a command, prescribed) in the Book of Allah. She said: No, by Allah, Qisas will never be taken from her; and she went on saying this until they (the relatives of the one who had been injured) accepted the blood-wit. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Verily there are amongst the servants of Allah (such pious persons) who, if they take oath of Allah, He honours it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ وَوَكِيعٌ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ دَمُ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ بِإِحْدَى ثَلاَثٍ الثَّيِّبُ الزَّانِ وَالنَّفْسُ بِالنَّفْسِ وَالتَّارِكُ لِدِينِهِ الْمُفَارِقُ لِلْجَمَاعَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa hafsu bnu ghiyaathin, waaabuw mu'aawiyaaa wawakiy'un 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni murraaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yahillu damu amriiin muslimin yashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waaanniy rasuwlu alllahi iilaaa biiihdaa thalaathin althhayyibu alzzaani waalnnafsu bialnnafsi waalttaariku lidiynihi almufaariqu liljamaa'aai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:It is not permissible to take the life of a Muslim who bears testimony (to the fact that there is no god but Allah, and I am the Messenger of Allah, but in one of the three cases: the married adulterer, a life for life, and the deserter of his Din (Islam), abandoning the community
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'aliyyu bnu khashramin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَحْمَدَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَامَ فِينَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُهُ لاَ يَحِلُّ دَمُ رَجُلٍ مُسْلِمٍ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ ثَلاَثَةُ نَفَرٍ التَّارِكُ الإِسْلاَمَ الْمُفَارِقُ لِلْجَمَاعَةِ أَوِ الْجَمَاعَةَ - شَكَّ فِيهِ أَحْمَدُ - وَالثَّيِّبُ الزَّانِي وَالنَّفْسُ بِالنَّفْسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الأَعْمَشُ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ، إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَحَدَّثَنِي عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu hanbalin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, - waalllafzu laahmada - qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, bnu mahdiyyin 'an sufyaana, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni murraaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaama fiynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ waalladhiy laa iilaha ghayruhu laa yahillu damu rajulin muslimin yashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waaanniy rasuwlu alllahi iilaaa thalaathaau nafarin alttaariku aliislaama almufaariqu liljamaa'aai aawi aljamaa'aaa - shakka fiyhi aahmadu - waalthhayyibu alzzaaniy waalnnafsu bialnnafsi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala alaa'mashu fahaddathtu bihi, iibraahiyma fahaddathaniy 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and said: By Him besides Whom there is no god but He, the blood of a Muslim who bears the testimony that there is no god but Allah, and I am His Messenger, may be lawfully shed only in case of three persons: the one who abandons Islam, and deserts the community [Ahmad, one of the narrators, is doubtful whether the Prophet (ﷺ) used the word li'l-jama'ah or al-jama'ah), and the married adulterer, and life for life
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، وَالْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِالإِسْنَادَيْنِ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرَا فِي الْحَدِيثِ قَوْلَهُ ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, waalqaasimu bnu zakariyyaa'a, qaalaa haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an shaybaana, 'ani alaa'mashi, bialiisnaadayni jamiy'ana ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi sufyaana walam yadhkuraa fiy alhadiythi qawlahu ‏ "‏ waalladhiy laa iilaha ghayruhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of narrators but with a slight variation of words, i. e. he did not say:By Him besides Whom there is no god
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تُقْتَلُ نَفْسٌ ظُلْمًا إِلاَّ كَانَ عَلَى ابْنِ آدَمَ الأَوَّلِ كِفْلٌ مِنْ دَمِهَا لأَنَّهُ كَانَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ سَنَّ الْقَتْلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, - waalllafzu laibni aabiy shaybaaa - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni murraaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi, alllahi qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tuqtalu nafsun zulmana iilaaa kaana 'alaa abni adama alaawwali kiflun min damihaa laannahu kaana aawwala man sanna alqatla ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported:Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having said: No person who is killed unjustly, but the share of (this offence of his also) falls upon the first son of Adam, for he was the first to introduce killing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، وَعِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ وَعِيسَى بْنِ يُونُسَ ‏ "‏ لأَنَّهُ سَنَّ الْقَتْلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لَمْ يَذْكُرَا أَوَّلَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, wa'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wafiy hadiythi jariyrin wa'iysaa bni yuwnusa ‏ "‏ laannahu sanna alqatla ‏"‏ ‏.‏ lam yadhkuraa aawwala ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jarir and 'Isa b. Yunus with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ وَكِيعٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَوَكِيعٌ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَوَّلُ مَا يُقْضَى بَيْنَ النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي الدِّمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, jamiy'ana 'an wakiy'in, 'ani alaa'mashi, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, wawakiy'un 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aawwalu maa yuqdaa bayna alnnaasi yawma alqiyaamaai fiy alddimaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. (Mas'ud) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The first (thing) that will be decided among people on the Day of Judgment will pertain to bloodshed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - ح وَحَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، الْمُثَنَّى وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ بَعْضَهُمْ قَالَ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ‏"‏ يُقْضَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَبَعْضُهُمْ قَالَ ‏"‏ يُحْكَمُ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu habiybin, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna alhaarithi - h wahaddathaniy bishru bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, h wahaddathanaa abnu, almuthannaa waabnu bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, kulluhum 'an shu'baaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi ghayra aanna ba'dahum qaala 'an shu'baaa ‏"‏ yuqdaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waba'duhum qaala ‏"‏ yuhkamu bayna alnnaasi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، - وَتَقَارَبَا فِي اللَّفْظِ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي، بَكْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الزَّمَانَ قَدِ اسْتَدَارَ كَهَيْئَتِهِ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ السَّنَةُ اثْنَا عَشَرَ شَهْرًا مِنْهَا أَرْبَعَةٌ حُرُمٌ ثَلاَثَةٌ مُتَوَالِيَاتٌ ذُو الْقَعْدَةِ وَذُو الْحِجَّةِ وَالْمُحَرَّمُ وَرَجَبٌ شَهْرُ مُضَرَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ جُمَادَى وَشَعْبَانَ - ثُمَّ قَالَ - أَىُّ شَهْرٍ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ - قَالَ - فَسَكَتَ حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ بِغَيْرِ اسْمِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ ذَا الْحِجَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَىُّ بَلَدٍ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ - قَالَ - فَسَكَتَ حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ بِغَيْرِ اسْمِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ الْبَلْدَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَىُّ يَوْمٍ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ - قَالَ - فَسَكَتَ حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ بِغَيْرِ اسْمِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ دِمَاءَكُمْ وَأَمْوَالَكُمْ - قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ وَأَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ - وَأَعْرَاضَكُمْ حَرَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ كَحُرْمَةِ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا فِي بَلَدِكُمْ هَذَا فِي شَهْرِكُمْ هَذَا وَسَتَلْقَوْنَ رَبَّكُمْ فَيَسْأَلُكُمْ عَنْ أَعْمَالِكُمْ فَلاَ تَرْجِعُنَّ بَعْدِي كُفَّارًا - أَوْ ضُلاَّلاً - يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ أَلاَ لِيُبَلِّغِ الشَّاهِدُ الْغَائِبَ فَلَعَلَّ بَعْضَ مَنْ يُبَلَّغُهُ يَكُونُ أَوْعَى لَهُ مِنْ بَعْضِ مَنْ سَمِعَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ هَلْ بَلَّغْتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ حَبِيبٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ ‏"‏ وَرَجَبُ مُضَرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏"‏ فَلاَ تَرْجِعُوا بَعْدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wayahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, - wataqaarabaa fiy alllafzi - qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi althhaqafiyyu, 'an aayyuwba, 'ani abni siyriyna, 'ani abni aabiy bakraaa, 'an aabiy, bakraaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏"‏ iinna alzzamaana qadi astadaara kahayiatihi yawma khalaqa alllahu alssamawaati waalaarda alssanaau athnaa 'ashara shahrana minhaa aarba'aaun hurumun thalaathaaun mutawaaliyaatun dhuw alqa'daai wadhuw alhijjaai waalmuharramu warajabun shahru mudara alladhiy bayna jumaadaa washa'baana - thumma qaala - aaaau shahrin hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu - qaala - fasakata hattaa zanannaa aannahu sayusammiyhi bighayri asmihi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aalaysa dhaa alhijjaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa balaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaaaau baladin hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu - qaala - fasakata hattaa zanannaa aannahu sayusammiyhi bighayri asmihi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aalaysa albaldaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa balaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaaaau yawmin hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu - qaala - fasakata hattaa zanannaa aannahu sayusammiyhi bighayri asmihi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aalaysa yawma alnnahri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa balaa yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinna dimaa'akum waaamwaalakum - qaala muhammadun waaahsibuhu qaala - waaa'raadakum haraamun 'alaykum kahurmaai yawmikum hadhaa fiy baladikum hadhaa fiy shahrikum hadhaa wasatalqawna rabbakum fayasaalukum 'an aa'maalikum falaa tarji'unna ba'diy kuffaarana - aaw dulaaalaan - yadribu ba'dukum riqaaba ba'din aalaa liyuballighi alshhaahidu alghaaiiba fala'alla ba'da man yuballaghuhu yakuwnu aaw'aa lahu min ba'di man sami'ahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ aalaa hal ballaghtu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu habiybin fiy riwaayatihi ‏"‏ warajabu mudara ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai aabiy bakrin ‏"‏ falaa tarji'uwa ba'diy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Bakra reported that (in the Farewell Address) Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:Time has completed a cycle and come to the state of the day when Allah created the heavens and the earth. The year is constituted of twelve months, of which four are sacred; three of them consecutive, viz. Dhu'l-Qa'da, Dhu'l- Hijja and Muharram, and also Rajab the month of Mudar which comes between Jumada and Sha'ban. He (the Holy Prophet) then said: which month is this? We said Allah and His Messenger know best. He (the narrator) said: He (the Holy Prophet) remained silent for some time until we thought that he would give it a name other than that (by which it was known). He said: Is it not Dha'l-Hijja? We said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Which city is this? We said: Allah and His Messenger know best. He (the Holy Prophety remained silent until we thought that he would give it another name. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Is it not the Balda (the city of Mecca)? We said: Yes. He said: What day is this? We said: Allah and His Messenger know best. He (the Holy Prophet) remained silent until we thought that he would give it another name. He said: Is it not the Day of Sacrifice? We said: Allah's Messenger. yes. Thereupon he said: Your blood, your property (Muhammad, one of the narrators, said: I think, he also said this) and your honour are sacred to you like the sacredness of this day of yours, in this city of yours, and in this month of yours. You will soon meet your Lord and He will ask you about your deeds. So do not turn after me unbelievers (or misguided), some of you striking the necks of the others. Behold I let him who is present convey to him who is absent, for many a one whom a message is conveyed has a more retentive memory than one who hears. He again said: Behold! have I not delivered (the message) to you? This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا كَانَ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمُ قَعَدَ عَلَى بَعِيرِهِ وَأَخَذَ إِنْسَانٌ بِخِطَامِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَدْرُونَ أَىَّ يَوْمٍ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ سِوَى اسْمِهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ بِيَوْمِ النَّحْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَىُّ شَهْرٍ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ بِذِي الْحِجَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَىُّ بَلَدٍ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ - قَالَ - حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ سِوَى اسْمِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ بِالْبَلْدَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ دِمَاءَكُمْ وَأَمْوَالَكُمْ وَأَعْرَاضَكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ حَرَامٌ كَحُرْمَةِ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا فِي شَهْرِكُمْ هَذَا فِي بَلَدِكُمْ هَذَا فَلْيُبَلِّغِ الشَّاهِدُ الْغَائِبَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ انْكَفَأَ إِلَى كَبْشَيْنِ أَمْلَحَيْنِ فَذَبَحَهُمَا وَإِلَى جُزَيْعَةٍ مِنَ الْغَنَمِ فَقَسَمَهَا بَيْنَنَا ‏.‏
