verses.translit: haddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'awnin, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy bakraaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala lammaa kaana dhalika alyawmu qa'ada 'alaa ba'iyrihi waaakhadha iinsaanun bikhitaamihi faqaala ‏"‏ aatadruwna aaaaa yawmin hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu ‏.‏ hattaa zanannaa aannahu sayusammiyhi siwaa asmihi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aalaysa biyawmi alnnahri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa balaa yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaaaau shahrin hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aalaysa bidhiy alhijjaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa balaa yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaaaau baladin hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu - qaala - hattaa zanannaa aannahu sayusammiyhi siwaa asmihi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aalaysa bialbaldaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa balaa yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinna dimaa'akum waaamwaalakum waaa'raadakum 'alaykum haraamun kahurmaai yawmikum hadhaa fiy shahrikum hadhaa fiy baladikum hadhaa falyuballighi alshhaahidu alghaaiiba ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma ankafaaa iilaa kabshayni aamlahayni fadhabahahumaa waiilaa juzay'aain mina alghanami faqasamahaa baynanaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Bakra reported that when it was that day (the 10th of Dhu'l-Hijja) he mounted his camel and a person caught its nosestring, whereupon he said:Do you know which day is this? They said: Allah and His Messenger know best. (The Prophet [may peace be upon him] kept silent) until we thought that he would give that another name. He said: Is it not the day of Nahr (Sacrifice) (10th of Dhu'l- Hijja)? We said: Allah's Messenger, yes. He (again) said: Which month is it? We said: Allah and His Messenger knows best. He said: Is it not Dhu'l-Hijja? We said: Allah's Messenger, yes. He said: Which city is this? We said: Allah and His Messenger know best. He (the narrator) said (that the Prophet kept silent until we thought that he would give it another name besides its (original) name. He said: Is it not Balda (the city of Mecca)? We said: Yes, Allah's Messenger. He (then) said: Verily your blood (lives) and your property and your honour are as sacred unto you as sacred is this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this city of yours. Let him who is present convey it to one who is absent. He then turned his attention towards two multicoloured (black and white) rams and slaughtered them, and two goats, and distributed them amongst us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، قَالَ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ لَمَّا كَانَ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمُ جَلَسَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى بَعِيرٍ - قَالَ - وَرَجُلٌ آخِذٌ بِزِمَامِهِ - أَوْ قَالَ بِخِطَامِهِ - فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ زُرَيْعٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu mas'adaaa, 'ani abni 'awnin, qaala qaala muhammadun qaala 'abdu alrrahmani bnu aabiy bakraaa 'an aabiyhi qaala lammaa kaana dhalika alyawmu jalasa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa ba'iyrin - qaala - warajulun akhidhun bizimaamihi - aaw qaala bikhitaamihi - fadhakara nahwa hadiythi yaziyda bni zuray'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Bakra reported that when it was the day of (Dhu'l-Hijja) Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) mounted the camel and addressed and a person had been holding its nosestring. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، وَعَنْ رَجُلٍ، آخَرَ هُوَ فِي نَفْسِي أَفْضَلُ مِنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَبَلَةَ وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ خِرَاشٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ بِإِسْنَادِ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ - وَسَمَّى الرَّجُلَ حُمَيْدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ قَالَ خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَىُّ يَوْمٍ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَاقُوا الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لاَ يَذْكُرُ ‏"‏ وَأَعْرَاضَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلاَ يَذْكُرُ ثُمَّ انْكَفَأَ إِلَى كَبْشَيْنِ وَمَا بَعْدَهُ وَقَالَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ ‏"‏ كَحُرْمَةِ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا فِي شَهْرِكُمْ هَذَا فِي بَلَدِكُمْ هَذَا إِلَى يَوْمِ تَلْقَوْنَ رَبَّكُمْ أَلاَ هَلْ بَلَّغْتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اشْهَدْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimi bni maymuwnin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa qurraau bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu siyriyna, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy bakraaa, wa'an rajulin, akhara huwa fiy nafsiy aafdalu min 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy bakraaa h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'amriw bni jabalaaa waaahmadu bnu khiraashin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin 'abdu almaliki bnu 'amrinw haddathanaa qurraau biiisnaadi yahyaa bni sa'iydin - wasammaa alrrajula humayda bna 'abdi alrrahmani - 'an aabiy bakraaa qaala khatabanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alnnahri faqaala ‏"‏ aaaau yawmin hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wasaaquwa alhadiytha bimithli hadiythi abni 'awnin ghayra aannahu laa yadhkuru ‏"‏ waaa'raadakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walaa yadhkuru thumma ankafaaa iilaa kabshayni wamaa ba'dahu waqaala fiy alhadiythi ‏"‏ kahurmaai yawmikum hadhaa fiy shahrikum hadhaa fiy baladikum hadhaa iilaa yawmi talqawna rabbakum aalaa hal ballaghtu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma ashhad ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Bakra through another chain of transmitters (and the words are):" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed us on the day of Nahr (Sacrifice) and said: What day is this? And the rest of the hadith is the same except that he did not make mention of" your honour," and also did not make mention of this: He then turned his attention towards two rams and what follows, and in a hadith (the words pertaining to sacred- ness are recorded in this way):" Like the sacredness of this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this city of yours to the day when you will meet your Lord. Behold, have I not conveyed (the Message of God)? They said: Yes. He said: O Allah, bear witness
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو يُونُسَ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ، حَرْبٍ أَنَّ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنَ وَائِلٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ إِنِّي لَقَاعِدٌ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ يَقُودُ آخَرَ بِنِسْعَةٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا قَتَلَ أَخِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَقَتَلْتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ لَوْ لَمْ يَعْتَرِفْ أَقَمْتُ عَلَيْهِ الْبَيِّنَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَتَلْتُهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ كَيْفَ قَتَلْتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ كُنْتُ أَنَا وَهُوَ نَخْتَبِطُ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ فَسَبَّنِي فَأَغْضَبَنِي فَضَرَبْتُهُ بِالْفَأْسِ عَلَى قَرْنِهِ فَقَتَلْتُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلْ لَكَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ تُؤَدِّيهِ عَنْ نَفْسِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مَا لِي مَالٌ إِلاَّ كِسَائِي وَفَأْسِي ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَتَرَى قَوْمَكَ يَشْتَرُونَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَا أَهْوَنُ عَلَى قَوْمِي مِنْ ذَاكَ ‏.‏ فَرَمَى إِلَيْهِ بِنِسْعَتِهِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ دُونَكَ صَاحِبَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ بِهِ الرَّجُلُ فَلَمَّا وَلَّى قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنْ قَتَلَهُ فَهُوَ مِثْلُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ قُلْتَ ‏"‏ إِنْ قَتَلَهُ فَهُوَ مِثْلُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَخَذْتُهُ بِأَمْرِكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَمَا تُرِيدُ أَنْ يَبُوءَ بِإِثْمِكَ وَإِثْمِ صَاحِبِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ - لَعَلَّهُ قَالَ - بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ ذَاكَ كَذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَمَى بِنِسْعَتِهِ وَخَلَّى سَبِيلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa aabuw yuwnusa, 'an simaaki bni, harbin aanna 'alqamaaa bna waaiilin, haddathahu aanna aabaahu haddathahu qaala iinniy laqaa'idun ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh jaa'a rajulun yaquwdu akhara binis'aain faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi hadhaa qatala aakhiy ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaqataltahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala iinnahu law lam ya'tarif aaqamtu 'alayhi albayyinaaa ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏ qataltuhu qaala ‏"‏ kayfa qataltahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala kuntu aanaa wahuwa nakhtabitu min shajaraain fasabbaniy faaaghdabaniy fadarabtuhu bialfaasi 'alaa qarnihi faqataltuhu ‏.‏ faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hal laka min shaa'in tuuaddiyhi 'an nafsika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala maa liy maalun iilaaa kisaaiiy wafaasiy ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fataraa qawmaka yashtaruwnaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aanaa aahwanu 'alaa qawmiy min dhaaka ‏.‏ faramaa iilayhi binis'atihi ‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ duwnaka saahibaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faantalaqa bihi alrrajulu falammaa wallaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iin qatalahu fahuwa mithluhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faraja'a faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnahu balaghaniy aannaka qulta ‏"‏ iin qatalahu fahuwa mithluhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaakhadhtuhu biaamrika ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aamaa turiydu aan yabuw'a biiithmika waiithmi saahibika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala yaa nabiyya alllahi - la'allahu qaala - balaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinna dhaaka kadhaaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faramaa binis'atihi wakhallaa sabiylahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Alqama b. Wa'il reported on the authority of his-father:While I was sitting in the company of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), a person came there dragging another one with the help of a strap and said: Allah's Messenger, this man has killed my brother. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Did you kill him? And the other man said: (In case he did not make a confession of this, I shall brine, a witness against him). He (the murderer) said: Yes, I have killed him. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Why did you kill him? He said: I and he won striking down the leaves of a tree and he abused me and enraged me, and to I struck his head with an axe and killed him, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Have you anything with you to pay blood-wit on your behalf? He said: I do not possess any property but this robe of mine and this axe of mine. He (the Holy, Prophet) said: Do you think your people will pay ransom for you? He said: I am more insignificant among my people than this (that I would not be able to get this benefit from my tribe). He (the Holy Prophet) threw the strap towards him (the claimant of the blood-wit) saying: Take away your man. The man took him away, and as he returned, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If he kills him, he will be like him. He returned and said: Allah's Messenger, it has reached me that you have said that" If he killed him, he would be like him." I caught hold of him according to your command, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't you like that he should take upon him (the burden) of your sin and the sin of your companion (your brother)? He said: Allah's Apostle, why not? The Messenger of Allah (may peace be. upon him) said: If it is so, then let it be. He threw away the strap (around the offender) and set him free
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، بْنُ سَالِمٍ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَجُلٍ قَتَلَ رَجُلاً فَأَقَادَ وَلِيَّ الْمَقْتُولِ مِنْهُ فَانْطَلَقَ بِهِ وَفِي عُنُقِهِ نِسْعَةٌ يَجُرُّهَا فَلَمَّا أَدْبَرَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْقَاتِلُ وَالْمَقْتُولُ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَتَى رَجُلٌ الرَّجُلَ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَقَالَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَلَّى عَنْهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِحَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَشْوَعَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّمَا سَأَلَهُ أَنْ يَعْفُوَ عَنْهُ فَأَبَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa iismaa'iylu, bnu saalimin 'an 'alqamaaa bni waaiilin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm birajulin qatala rajulaan faaaqaada waliyya almaqtuwli minhu faantalaqa bihi wafiy 'unuqihi nis'aaun yajurruhaa falammaa aadbara qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alqaatilu waalmaqtuwlu fiy alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaataa rajulun alrrajula faqaala lahu maqaalaaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakhallaa 'anhu ‏.‏ qaala iismaa'iylu bnu saalimin fadhakartu dhalika lihabiybi bni aabiy thaabitin faqaala haddathaniy abnu aashwa'a aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm iinnamaa saaalahu aan ya'fuwa 'anhu faaabaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Alaqama b. Wa'il reported on the authority of his father that a person was brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who had killed another person, and the heir of the person slain had dragged him (to the Holy Prophet) with a strap around his neck. As he turned away Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The killer and the killed are (doomed) to fire. A person came to the other person (the heir of the deceased) and he reported to him the words of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and so he let him off. Isma'il b. Salim said: I made a mention of it to Habib b. Abu Thabit and he said: Ibn Ashwa' reported to me that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had asked him to pardon him, but he refused
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ امْرَأَتَيْنِ، مِنْ هُذَيْلٍ رَمَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا الأُخْرَى فَطَرَحَتْ جَنِينَهَا فَقَضَى فِيهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِغُرَّةٍ عَبْدٍ أَوْ أَمَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna amraaatayni, min hudhaylin ramat iihdaahumaa alaukhraa fatarahat janiynahaa faqadaa fiyhi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bighurraain 'abdin aaw aamaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that among two women of the tribe of Hudhail one flung a stone upon the other causing an abortion to her so Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) gave judgment that a male or a female slave of best quality be given as compensation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي جَنِينِ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْ بَنِي لِحْيَانَ سَقَطَ مَيِّتًا بِغُرَّةٍ عَبْدٍ أَوْ أَمَةٍ ثُمَّ إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ الَّتِي قُضِيَ عَلَيْهَا بِالْغُرَّةِ تُوُفِّيَتْ فَقَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِأَنَّ مِيرَاثَهَا لِبَنِيهَا وَزَوْجِهَا وَأَنَّ الْعَقْلَ عَلَى عَصَبَتِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'ani abni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa aannahu qaala qadaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy janiyni amraaaain min baniy lihyaana saqata mayyitana bighurraain 'abdin aaw aamaain thumma iinna almaraaaa allatiy qudiya 'alayhaa bialghurraai tuwuffiyat faqadaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biaanna miyraathahaa libaniyhaa wazawjihaa waaanna al'aqla 'alaa 'asabatihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave judgment in case of the abortion of a woman of Banu Lihyan (that the offender and near relative should give compensation in the form of) good quality of a slave or a slave-girl. And the woman about whom the judgment was given for compensation died and thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave judgment that her inheritance goes to her sons and her husband, and the payment of the blood-wit lies with the family of (one who struck her)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ اقْتَتَلَتِ امْرَأَتَانِ مِنْ هُذَيْلٍ فَرَمَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا الأُخْرَى بِحَجَرٍ فَقَتَلَتْهَا وَمَا فِي بَطْنِهَا فَاخْتَصَمُوا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ دِيَةَ جَنِينِهَا غُرَّةٌ عَبْدٌ أَوْ وَلِيدَةٌ وَقَضَى بِدِيَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ عَلَى عَاقِلَتِهَا وَوَرَّثَهَا وَلَدَهَا وَمَنْ مَعَهُمْ فَقَالَ حَمَلُ بْنُ النَّابِغَةِ الْهُذَلِيُّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ أَغْرَمُ مَنْ لاَ شَرِبَ وَلاَ أَكَلَ وَلاَ نَطَقَ وَلاَ اسْتَهَلَّ فَمِثْلُ ذَلِكَ يُطَلُّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا هَذَا مِنْ إِخْوَانِ الْكُهَّانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ مِنْ أَجْلِ سَجْعِهِ الَّذِي سَجَعَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, h wahaddathanaa harmalaau bnu yahyaa alttujiybiyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'ani abni almusayyabi, waaabiy, salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala aqtatalati amraaataani min hudhaylin faramat iihdaahumaa alaukhraa bihajarin faqatalathaa wamaa fiy batnihaa faakhtasamuwa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqadaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna diyaaa janiynihaa ghurraaun 'abdun aaw waliydaaun waqadaa bidiyaai almaraaai 'alaa 'aaqilatihaa wawarrathahaa waladahaa waman ma'ahum faqaala hamalu bnu alnnaabighaai alhudhaliyyu yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa aaghramu man laa shariba walaa aakala walaa nataqa walaa astahalla famithlu dhalika yutallu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinnamaa hadhaa min iikhwaani alkuhhaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ min aajli saj'ihi alladhiy saja'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that two women of the tribe of Hudhail fought with each other and one of them flung a stone at the other, killing her and what was in her womb. The case was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he gave judgment that the diyat (indemnity) of her unborn child is a male or a female slave of the best quality, and he also decided that the diyat of the woman is to be paid by her relative on the father's side, and he (the Holy Prophet) made her sons and those who were with them her heirs. Hamal b. al-Nabigha al-Hudhali said:Messenger of Allah, why should I play blood-wit for one who neither drank, nor ate, nor spoke, nor made any noise; it is like a nonentity (it is, therefore, not justifiable to demand blood-wit for it). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He seems to be one of the brothers of soothsavers on account of the rhymed speech which he has composed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي، سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ اقْتَتَلَتِ امْرَأَتَانِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِقِصَّتِهِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ وَوَرَّثَهَا وَلَدَهَا وَمَنْ مَعَهُمْ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فَقَالَ قَائِلٌ كَيْفَ نَعْقِلُ وَلَمْ يُسَمِّ حَمَلَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy, salamaaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala aqtatalati amraaataani ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha biqissatihi walam yadhkur wawarrathahaa waladahaa waman ma'ahum ‏.‏ waqaala faqaala qaaiilun kayfa na'qilu walam yusammi hamala bna maalikin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that two women fought-the rest of the hadith is the same but herein no mention has been made of:He made her son and those who were with them her heirs. Someone said: Why should we pay blood-wit? And he did not name Hamal b. Malik
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ نُضَيْلَةَ الْخُزَاعِيِّ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ ضَرَبَتِ امْرَأَةٌ ضَرَّتَهَا بِعَمُودِ فُسْطَاطٍ وَهِيَ حُبْلَى فَقَتَلَتْهَا - قَالَ - وَإِحْدَاهُمَا لِحْيَانِيَّةٌ - قَالَ - فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دِيَةَ الْمَقْتُولَةِ عَلَى عَصَبَةِ الْقَاتِلَةِ وَغُرَّةً لِمَا فِي بَطْنِهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ عَصَبَةِ الْقَاتِلَةِ أَنَغْرَمُ دِيَةَ مَنْ لاَ أَكَلَ وَلاَ شَرِبَ وَلاَ اسْتَهَلَّ فَمِثْلُ ذَلِكَ يُطَلُّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَسَجْعٌ كَسَجْعِ الأَعْرَابِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَجَعَلَ عَلَيْهِمُ الدِّيَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'ubaydi bni nudaylaaa alkhuzaa'iyyi, 'ani almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, qaala darabati amraaaaun darratahaa bi'amuwdi fustaatin wahiya hublaa faqatalathaa - qaala - waiihdaahumaa lihyaaniyyaaun - qaala - faja'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm diyaaa almaqtuwlaai 'alaa 'asabaai alqaatilaai waghurraaan limaa fiy batnihaa ‏.‏ faqaala rajulun min 'asabaai alqaatilaai aanaghramu diyaaa man laa aakala walaa shariba walaa astahalla famithlu dhalika yutallu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aasaj'un kasaj'i alaa'raabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala waja'ala 'alayhimu alddiyaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Mughira b. Shu'ba reported that a woman struck her co-wife with a tent-pole and she was pregnant and she killed her. One of them belonged to the tribe of Lihyan. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made the relatives of the murderer responsible for the payment of blood-wit on her behalf, and fixed a slave or a female slave as the indemnity for what was in her womb. One of the persons amongst the relatives of the murderer said:Should we pay indemnity for one who, neither ate, nor drank, nor made any noise, who was just like a nonentity? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) remarked: He speaks rhymed phrases like the people of the desert. He did impose indemnity upon them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُفَضَّلٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ نُضَيْلَةَ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، ‏.‏ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، قَتَلَتْ ضَرَّتَهَا بِعَمُودِ فُسْطَاطٍ فَأُتِيَ فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَضَى عَلَى عَاقِلَتِهَا بِالدِّيَةِ وَكَانَتْ حَامِلاً فَقَضَى فِي الْجَنِينِ بِغُرَّةٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ بَعْضُ عَصَبَتِهَا أَنَدِي مَنْ لاَ طَعِمَ وَلاَ شَرِبَ وَلاَ صَاحَ فَاسْتَهَلَّ وَمِثْلُ ذَلِكَ يُطَلُّ قَالَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ سَجْعٌ كَسَجْعِ الأَعْرَابِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa mufaddalun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'ubaydi bni nudaylaaa, 'ani almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, ‏.‏ aanna amraaaaan, qatalat darratahaa bi'amuwdi fustaatin faautiya fiyhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqadaa 'alaa 'aaqilatihaa bialddiyaai wakaanat haamilaan faqadaa fiy aljaniyni bighurraain ‏.‏ faqaala ba'du 'asabatihaa aanadiy man laa ta'ima walaa shariba walaa saaha faastahalla wamithlu dhalika yutallu qaala faqaala ‏ "‏ saj'un kasaj'i alaa'raabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Mughira b. Shu'ba reported:A woman killed her fellow-wife with a tent-pole. Her case was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he gave judgment that blood-wit should be paid by the relatives (of the offender) on the father's side. And as she was pregnant, he decided regarding her unborn child that a male or a female slave of good quality be given. Some of her offender's) relatives said: Should we make compensation for one who never ate, nor drank, nor made any noise, who was like a nonentity? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He was talking rhymed phrases like the rhymed phrases of desert Arabs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَ مَعْنَى حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ وَمُفَضَّلٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an sufyaana, 'an mansuwrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithla ma'naa hadiythi jariyrin wamufaddalin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mansur with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِإِسْنَادِهِمُ الْحَدِيثَ بِقِصَّتِهِ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِيهِ فَأَسْقَطَتْ فَرُفِعَ ذَلِكَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَضَى فِيهِ بِغُرَّةٍ وَجَعَلَهُ عَلَى أَوْلِيَاءِ الْمَرْأَةِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي الْحَدِيثِ دِيَةَ الْمَرْأَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaaluwa haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu ja'farin 'an shu'baaa, 'an mansuwrin, biiisnaadihimu alhadiytha biqissatihi ‏.‏ ghayra aanna fiyhi faaasqatat farufi'a dhalika iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqadaa fiyhi bighurraain waja'alahu 'alaa aawliyaa'i almaraaai ‏.‏ walam yadhkur fiy alhadiythi diyaaa almaraaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mansur transmitted this hadith with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، قَالَ اسْتَشَارَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ النَّاسَ فِي إِمْلاَصِ الْمَرْأَةِ فَقَالَ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ شَهِدْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَضَى فِيهِ بِغُرَّةٍ عَبْدٍ أَوْ أَمَةٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ائْتِنِي بِمَنْ يَشْهَدُ مَعَكَ قَالَ فَشَهِدَ لَهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani almiswari bni makhramaaa, qaala astashaara 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi alnnaasa fiy iimlaasi almaraaai faqaala almughiyraau bnu shu'baaa shahidtu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qadaa fiyhi bighurraain 'abdin aaw aamaain ‏.‏ qaala faqaala 'umaru aitiniy biman yashhadu ma'aka qaala fashahida lahu muhammadu bnu maslamaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Miswar b. Makhrama reported that 'Umar b. Khattab consulted people about the diyat of abortion of an unboam child. Mughira b. Shu'ba said:I bear witness to the fact that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave judgment about it that a good quality of slave or female slave should be given for it. Thereupon 'Umar said: Bring one who may bear witness to you. Then Muhammad b. Maslama bore witness to him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْطَعُ السَّارِقَ فِي رُبْعِ دِينَارٍ فَصَاعِدًا
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaala abnu aabiy 'umara haddathanaa waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqta'u alssaariqa fiy rub'i diynaarin fasaa'idana
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cut off the hand of a thief for a quarter of a dinar rid upwards
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu bnu kathiyrin, waiibraahiymu bnu sa'din kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, ‏.‏ bimithlihi fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَحَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِلْوَلِيدِ وَحَرْمَلَةَ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، وَعَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تُقْطَعُ يَدُ السَّارِقِ إِلاَّ فِي رُبْعِ دِينَارٍ فَصَاعِدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, wahaddathanaa alwaliydu bnu shujaa'in, - waalllafzu lilwaliydi waharmalaaa - qaaluwa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, wa'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tuqta'u yadu alssaariqi iilaaa fiy rub'i diynaarin fasaa'idana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The hand of a thief should not be cut off but for a quarter of a dinar and upwards
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِهَارُونَ وَأَحْمَدَ - قَالَ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ عَائِشَةَ، تُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ تُقْطَعُ الْيَدُ إِلاَّ فِي رُبْعِ دِينَارٍ فَمَا فَوْقَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, wahaaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, - waalllafzu lihaaruwna waaahmada - qaala aabuw alttaahiri aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy makhramaau, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'an 'amraaa, aannahaa sami'at 'aaiishaaa, tuhaddithu aannahaa sami'at rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa tuqta'u alyadu iilaaa fiy rub'i diynaarin famaa fawqahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The hand (of a thief) should not be cut off but for a quarter of a dinar and what is above that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ الْهَادِ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ تُقْطَعُ يَدُ السَّارِقِ إِلاَّ فِي رُبْعِ دِينَارٍ فَصَاعِدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy bishru bnu alhakami al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin, 'an yaziyda bni 'abdi alllahi, bni alhaadi 'an aabiy bakri bni muhammadin, 'an 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa sami'ati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa tuqta'u yadu alssaariqi iilaaa fiy rub'i diynaarin fasaa'idana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that she heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:The hand of the thief may not be cut off but for a quarter of a dinar and upwards
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، - مِنْ وَلَدِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ - عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْهَادِ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waiishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, jamiy'ana 'an aabiy 'aamirin al'aqadiyyi, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu ja'farin, - min waladi almiswari bni makhramaaa - 'an yaziyda bni, 'abdi alllahi bni alhaadi bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Yazid b. 'Abdullah b. al-Had with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرُّؤَاسِيُّ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمْ تُقْطَعْ يَدُ سَارِقٍ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ ثَمَنِ الْمِجَنِّ حَجَفَةٍ أَوْ تُرْسٍ وَكِلاَهُمَا ذُو ثَمَنٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa humaydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alrruuaasiyyu, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat lam tuqta' yadu saariqin fiy 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy aaqalla min thamani almijanni hajafaain aaw tursin wakilaahumaa dhuw thamanin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the hand of the thief was not cut off for less than the price of a shield, iron coat or armour and both of them are valuable
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَحُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، الرُّؤَاسِيِّ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ وَأَبِي أُسَامَةَ وَهُوَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ذُو ثَمَنٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, wahumaydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahiymi bnu sulaymaana, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, kulluhum 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi abni numayrin 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, alrruuaasiyyi wafiy hadiythi 'abdi alrrahiymi waaabiy ausaamaaa wahuwa yawmaiidhin dhuw thamanin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham through another chain of transmitters, and in the hadith narrated by 'Abd al-Rahim and Abu Usama (the words are):" That (the shield) was valuable those days
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَطَعَ سَارِقًا فِي مِجَنٍّ قِيمَتُهُ ثَلاَثَةُ دَرَاهِمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qata'a saariqana fiy mijannin qiymatuhu thalaathaau daraahima ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him) cut off the hand of a thief (in case of the theft) of a shield the price of which was three dirhams
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ، رُمْحٍ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ السَّخْتِيَانِيِّ، وَأَيُّوبَ، بْنِ مُوسَى وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ ح. وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، وَمُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ الْجُمَحِيِّ، وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، وَمَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، وَأُسَامَةَ، بْنِ زَيْدٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مَالِكٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ بَعْضَهُمْ قَالَ قِيمَتُهُ وَبَعْضُهُمْ قَالَ ثَمَنُهُ ثَلاَثَةُ دَرَاهِمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waabnu, rumhin 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, h wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu almuthannaa qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, wahuwa alqattaanu h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, kulluhum 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu ya'niy abna 'ulayyaaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an aayyuwba alssakhtiyaaniyyi, waaayyuwba, bni muwsaa waiismaa'iyla bni aumayyaaa h. wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aayyuwba, waiismaa'iyla bni aumayyaaa, wa'ubaydi alllahi, wamuwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy iismaa'iylu bnu aumayyaaa, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'an hanzalaaa bni aabiy sufyaana aljumahiyyi, wa'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, wamaaliki bni aanasin, waausaamaaa, bni zaydin alllaythiyyi kulluhum 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi yahyaa 'an maalikin ghayra aanna ba'dahum qaala qiymatuhu waba'duhum qaala thamanuhu thalaathaau daraahima ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through some other chains of transmitters but with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ السَّارِقَ يَسْرِقُ الْبَيْضَةَ فَتُقْطَعُ يَدُهُ وَيَسْرِقُ الْحَبْلَ فَتُقْطَعُ يَدُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ la'ana alllahu alssaariqa yasriqu albaydaaa fatuqta'u yaduhu wayasriqu alhabla fatuqta'u yaduhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Let there be the curse of Allah upon the thief who steals an egg and his hand is cut off, and steals a rope and his hand is cut off
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عِيسَى، بْنِ يُونُسَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنْ سَرَقَ حَبْلاً وَإِنْ سَرَقَ بَيْضَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'aliyyu bnu khashramin, kulluhum 'an 'iysaa, bni yuwnusa 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ghayra aannahu yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iin saraqa hablaan waiin saraqa baydaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنَ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ قُرَيْشًا، أَهَمَّهُمْ شَأْنُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْمَخْزُومِيَّةِ الَّتِي سَرَقَتْ فَقَالُوا مَنْ يُكَلِّمُ فِيهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا وَمَنْ يَجْتَرِئُ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ أُسَامَةُ حِبُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَكَلَّمَهُ أُسَامَةُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَتَشْفَعُ فِي حَدٍّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَاخْتَطَبَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّمَا أَهْلَكَ الَّذِينَ قَبْلَكُمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهِمُ الشَّرِيفُ تَرَكُوهُ وَإِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهِمُ الضَّعِيفُ أَقَامُوا عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ لَوْ أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ سَرَقَتْ لَقَطَعْتُ يَدَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ رُمْحٍ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا هَلَكَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'ana 'aaiishaaa, aanna qurayshana, aahammahum shaanu almaraaai almakhzuwmiyyaai allatiy saraqat faqaaluwa man yukallimu fiyhaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa waman yajtariiu 'alayhi iilaaa ausaamaau hibbu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fakallamahu ausaamaau ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aatashfa'u fiy haddin min huduwdi alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaama faakhtataba faqaala ‏"‏ aayyuhaa alnnaasu iinnamaa aahlaka alladhiyna qablakum aannahum kaanuwa iidhaa saraqa fiyhimu alshhariyfu tarakuwhu waiidhaa saraqa fiyhimu aldda'iyfu aaqaamuwa 'alayhi alhadda waaymu alllahi law aanna faatimaaa binta muhammadin saraqat laqata'tu yadahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi abni rumhin ‏"‏ iinnamaa halaka alladhiyna min qablikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that the Quraish had been anxious about the Makhzumi woman who had committed theft, and said:Who will speak to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about her? They said: Who dare it, but Usama, the loved one of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? So Usama spoke to him. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do you intercede regarding one of the punishments prescribed by Allah? He then stood up and addressed (people) saying: O people, those who have gone before you were destroyed, because if any one of high rank committed theft amongst them, they spared him; and it anyone of low rank committed theft, they inflicted the prescribed punishment upon him. By Allah, if Fatima, daughter of Muhammad, were to steal, I would have her hand cut off. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Rumh (the words are):" Verily those before you perished
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِحَرْمَلَةَ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ، وَهْبٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ قُرَيْشًا أَهَمَّهُمْ شَأْنُ الْمَرْأَةِ الَّتِي سَرَقَتْ فِي عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةِ الْفَتْحِ فَقَالُوا مَنْ يُكَلِّمُ فِيهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا وَمَنْ يَجْتَرِئُ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ حِبُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَأُتِيَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَلَّمَهُ فِيهَا أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ فَتَلَوَّنَ وَجْهُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَشْفَعُ فِي حَدٍّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ أُسَامَةُ اسْتَغْفِرْ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْعَشِيُّ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاخْتَطَبَ فَأَثْنَى عَلَى اللَّهِ بِمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنَّمَا أَهْلَكَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهِمُ الشَّرِيفُ تَرَكُوهُ وَإِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهِمُ الضَّعِيفُ أَقَامُوا عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ وَإِنِّي وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَوْ أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ سَرَقَتْ لَقَطَعْتُ يَدَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِتِلْكَ الْمَرْأَةِ الَّتِي سَرَقَتْ فَقُطِعَتْ يَدُهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ يُونُسُ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَحَسُنَتْ تَوْبَتُهَا بَعْدُ وَتَزَوَّجَتْ وَكَانَتْ تَأْتِينِي بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَأَرْفَعُ حَاجَتَهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu liharmalaaa - qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu, wahbin qaala aakhbaraniy yuwnusu bnu yaziyda, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna qurayshana aahammahum shaanu almaraaai allatiy saraqat fiy 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghazwaai alfathi faqaaluwa man yukallimu fiyhaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa waman yajtariiu 'alayhi iilaaa ausaamaau bnu zaydin hibbu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faautiya bihaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakallamahu fiyhaa ausaamaau bnu zaydin fatalawwana wajhu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aatashfa'u fiy haddin min huduwdi alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala lahu ausaamaau astaghfir liy yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ falammaa kaana al'ashiyyu qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faakhtataba faaathnaa 'alaa alllahi bimaa huwa aahluhu thumma qaala ‏"‏ aammaa ba'du faiinnamaa aahlaka alladhiyna min qablikum aannahum kaanuwa iidhaa saraqa fiyhimu alshhariyfu tarakuwhu waiidhaa saraqa fiyhimu aldda'iyfu aaqaamuwa 'alayhi alhadda waiinniy waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi law aanna faatimaaa binta muhammadin saraqat laqata'tu yadahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma aamara bitilka almaraaai allatiy saraqat faquti'at yaduhaa ‏.‏ qaala yuwnusu qaala abnu shihaabin qaala 'urwaau qaalat 'aaiishaau fahasunat tawbatuhaa ba'du watazawwajat wakaanat taatiyniy ba'da dhalika faaarfa'u haajatahaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that the Quraish were concerned about the woman who had committed theft during the lifetime of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), in the expedition of Victory (of Mecca). They said:Who would speak to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about her? They (again) said: Who can dare do this but Usama b. Zaid, the loved one of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? She was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Usama b. Zaid spoke about her to him (interceded on her behalf). The color of the face of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) changed, and he said: Do you intercede in one of the prescribed punishments of Allah? He (Usama) said: 'Messenger of Allah, seek forgiveness for me.' When it was dusk. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and gave an address. He (first) glorified Allah as He deserves, and then said: Now to our topic. This (injustice) destroyed those before you that when any one of (high) rank committed theft among them, they spared him, and when any weak one among them committed theft, they inflicted the prescribed punishment upon him. By Him in Whose Hand is my life, even if Fatima daughter of Muhammad were to commit theft, I would have cut off her hand. He (the Holy Prophet) then commanded about that woman who had committed theft, and her hand was cut off. `A'isha (further) said: Hers was a good repentance, and she later on married and used to come to me after that, and I conveyed her needs (and problems) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مَخْزُومِيَّةٌ تَسْتَعِيرُ الْمَتَاعَ وَتَجْحَدُهُ فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تُقْطَعَ يَدُهَا فَأَتَى أَهْلُهَا أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ فَكَلَّمُوهُ فَكَلَّمَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهَا ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ وَيُونُسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaanati amraaaaun makhzuwmiyyaaun tasta'iyru almataa'a watajhaduhu faaamara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan tuqta'a yaduhaa faaataa aahluhaa ausaamaaa bna zaydin fakallamuwhu fakallama rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiyhaa ‏.‏ thumma dhakara nahwa hadiythi alllaythi wayuwnusa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that a woman from the tribe of Makhzum used to borrow things (from people) and then denied (having taken them). Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) commanded her hand to be cut off. Her relatives came to Usama b. Zaid and spoke to him (requesting him to intercede on her behalf). He spoke to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about her. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، مِنْ بَنِي مَخْزُومٍ سَرَقَتْ فَأُتِيَ بِهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَاذَتْ بِأُمِّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَاللَّهِ لَوْ كَانَتْ فَاطِمَةُ لَقَطَعْتُ يَدَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُطِعَتْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, aanna amraaaaan, min baniy makhzuwmin saraqat faautiya bihaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fa'aadhat biaummi salamaaa zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ waalllahi law kaanat faatimaau laqata'tu yadahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faquti'at ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jaibir reported that a woman from the tribe of Makhzum committed theft. She was brought to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and she sought refuge (intercession) from Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:By Allah, even if she were Fatima, I would have her hand cut off. And thus her hand was cut off
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ حِطَّانَ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيِّ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خُذُوا عَنِّي خُذُوا عَنِّي قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلاً الْبِكْرُ بِالْبِكْرِ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَنَفْىُ سَنَةٍ وَالثَّيِّبُ بِالثَّيِّبِ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَالرَّجْمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an mansuwrin, 'ani alhasani, 'an hittaana, bni 'abdi alllahi alrraqaashiyyi 'an 'ubaadaaa bni alssaamiti, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ khudhuwa 'anniy khudhuwa 'anniy qad ja'ala alllahu lahunna sabiylaan albikru bialbikri jaldu miaiaain wanafau sanaain waalthhayyibu bialthhayyibi jaldu miaiaain waalrrajmu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubada b. as-Samit reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Receive (teaching) from me, receive (teaching) from me. Allah has ordained a way for those (women). When an unmarried male commits adultery with an unmarried female (they should receive) one hundred lashes and banishment for one year. And in case of married male committing adultery with a married female, they shall receive one hundred lashes and be stoned to death
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa mansuwrun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: The above hadith is likewise narrated through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ حِطَّانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ كَانَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كُرِبَ لِذَلِكَ وَتَرَبَّدَ لَهُ وَجْهُهُ - قَالَ - فَأُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ فَلُقِيَ كَذَلِكَ فَلَمَّا سُرِّيَ عَنْهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ خُذُوا عَنِّي فَقَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلاً الثَّيِّبُ بِالثَّيِّبِ وَالْبِكْرُ بِالْبِكْرِ الثَّيِّبُ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ ثُمَّ رَجْمٌ بِالْحِجَارَةِ وَالْبِكْرُ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ ثُمَّ نَفْىُ سَنَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin jamiy'ana 'an 'abdi alaa'laa, qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'ani alhasani, 'an hittaana bni 'abdi alllahi alrraqaashiyyi, 'an 'ubaadaaa bni alssaamiti, qaala kaana nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aunzila 'alayhi kuriba lidhalika watarabbada lahu wajhuhu - qaala - faaunzila 'alayhi dhaata yawmin faluqiya kadhalika falammaa surriya 'anhu qaala ‏ "‏ khudhuwa 'anniy faqad ja'ala alllahu lahunna sabiylaan althhayyibu bialthhayyibi waalbikru bialbikri althhayyibu jaldu miaiaain thumma rajmun bialhijaaraai waalbikru jaldu miaiaain thumma nafau sanaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubada b. as-Samit reported that whenever Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) received revelation, he felt its rigour and the complexion of his face changed. One day revelation descended upon him, he felt the same rigour. When it was over and he felt relief, he said:Take from me. Verily Allah has ordained a way for them (the women who commit fornication),: (When) a married man (commits adultery) with a married woman, and an unmarried male with an unmarried woman, then in case of married (persons) there is (a punishment) of one hundred lashes and then stoning (to death). And in case of unmarried persons, (the punishment) is one hundred lashes and exile for one year
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي كِلاَهُمَا، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏ "‏ الْبِكْرُ يُجْلَدُ وَيُنْفَى وَالثَّيِّبُ يُجْلَدُ وَيُرْجَمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لاَ يَذْكُرَانِ سَنَةً وَلاَ مِائَةً ‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy kilaahumaa, 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ ghayra aanna fiy, hadiythihimaa ‏ "‏ albikru yujladu wayunfaa waalthhayyibu yujladu wayurjamu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ laa yadhkuraani sanaaan walaa miaiaaan ‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters except with this variation that the unmarried is to be lashed and exiled, and the married one is to be lashed and stoned. There is neither any mention of one year nor that of one hundred
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ عَلَى مِنْبَرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ بَعَثَ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنْزَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْكِتَابَ فَكَانَ مِمَّا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ قَرَأْنَاهَا وَوَعَيْنَاهَا وَعَقَلْنَاهَا فَرَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَجَمْنَا بَعْدَهُ فَأَخْشَى إِنْ طَالَ بِالنَّاسِ زَمَانٌ أَنْ يَقُولَ قَائِلٌ مَا نَجِدُ الرَّجْمَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَيَضِلُّوا بِتَرْكِ فَرِيضَةٍ أَنْزَلَهَا اللَّهُ وَإِنَّ الرَّجْمَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ عَلَى مَنْ زَنَى إِذَا أَحْصَنَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ إِذَا قَامَتِ الْبَيِّنَةُ أَوْ كَانَ الْحَبَلُ أَوْ الاِعْتِرَافُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, aannahu sami'a 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu qaala 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi wahuwa jaalisun 'alaa minbari rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinna alllaha qad ba'atha muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm bialhaqqi waaanzala 'alayhi alkitaaba fakaana mimmaa aunzila 'alayhi ayaau alrrajmi qaraanaahaa wawa'aynaahaa wa'aqalnaahaa farajama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm warajamnaa ba'dahu faaakhshaa iin taala bialnnaasi zamaanun aan yaquwla qaaiilun maa najidu alrrajma fiy kitaabi alllahi fayadilluwa bitarki fariydaain aanzalahaa alllahu waiinna alrrajma fiy kitaabi alllahi haqqun 'alaa man zanaa iidhaa aahsana mina alrrijaali waalnnisaa'i iidhaa qaamati albayyinaau aaw kaana alhabalu aaw alai'tiraafu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported that 'Umar b. Khattab sat on the pulpit of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:Verily Allah sent Muhammad (ﷺ) with truth and He sent down the Book upon him, and the verse of stoning was included in what was sent down to him. We recited it, retained it in our memory and understood it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) awarded the punishment of stoning to death (to the married adulterer and adulteress) and, after him, we also awarded the punishment of stoning, I am afraid that with the lapse of time, the people (may forget it) and may say: We do not find the punishment of stoning in the Book of Allah, and thus go astray by abandoning this duty prescribed by Allah. Stoning is a duty laid down in Allah's Book for married men and women who commit adultery when proof is established, or it there is pregnancy, or a confession
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَتَى رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَنَادَاهُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي زَنَيْتُ ‏.‏ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَتَنَحَّى تِلْقَاءَ وَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي زَنَيْتُ ‏.‏ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ حَتَّى ثَنَى ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ فَلَمَّا شَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ دَعَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَبِكَ جُنُونٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلْ أَحْصَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اذْهَبُوا بِهِ فَارْجُمُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi bni sa'din, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, wasa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu qaala aataa rajulun mina almuslimiyna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa fiy almasjidi fanaadaahu faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy zanaytu ‏.‏ faaa'rada 'anhu fatanahhaa tilqaa'a wajhihi faqaala lahu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy zanaytu ‏.‏ faaa'rada 'anhu hattaa thanaa dhalika 'alayhi aarba'a marraatin falammaa shahida 'alaa nafsihi aarba'a shahaadaatin da'aahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aabika junuwnun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fahal aahsanta ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ adhhabuwa bihi faarjumuwhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that a person from amongst the Muslims came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was in the mosque. He called him saying:Allah's Messenger. I have committed adultery. He (the Holy Prophet) turned away from him, He (again) came round facing him and said to him: Allah's Messenger, I have committed adultery. He (the Holy Prophet) turned away until he did that four times, and as he testified four times against his own self, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called him and said: Are you mad? He said: No. He (again) said: Are you married? He said: Yes. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Take him and stone him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَأَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ فَكُنْتُ فِيمَنْ رَجَمَهُ فَرَجَمْنَاهُ بِالْمُصَلَّى فَلَمَّا أَذْلَقَتْهُ الْحِجَارَةُ هَرَبَ فَأَدْرَكْنَاهُ بِالْحَرَّةِ فَرَجَمْنَاهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala abnu shihaabin faaakhbaraniy man, sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu fakuntu fiyman rajamahu farajamnaahu bialmusallaa falammaa aadhlaqathu alhijaaraau haraba faaadraknaahu bialharraai farajamnaahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Shihab (one of the narrators) said:One who had heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah saying this informed me thus: I was one of those who stoned him. We stoned him at the place of prayer (either that of 'Id or a funeral). When the stones hurt him, he ran away. We caught him in the Harra and stoned him (to death)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَرَوَاهُ اللَّيْثُ أَيْضًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ خَالِدِ بْنِ مُسَافِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَيْضًا وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا جَمِيعًا قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ كَمَا ذَكَرَ عُقَيْلٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: warawaahu alllaythu aaydana 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni khaalidi bni musaafirin, 'ani abni shihaabin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi aaydana wafiy hadiythihimaa jamiy'ana qaala abnu shihaabin aakhbaraniy man sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi kamaa dhakara 'uqaylun ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، وَابْنُ، جُرَيْجٍ كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ نَحْوَ رِوَايَةِ عُقَيْلٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, waabnu, jurayjin kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ nahwa riwaayaai 'uqaylin 'ani alzzuhriyyi 'an sa'iydin waaabiy salamaaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through other chains of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ، حَرْبٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ حِينَ جِيءَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ قَصِيرٌ أَعْضَلُ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ رِدَاءٌ فَشَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ أَنَّهُ زَنَى فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَلَعَلَّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ قَدْ زَنَى الأَخِرُ - قَالَ - فَرَجَمَهُ ثُمَّ خَطَبَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ كُلَّمَا نَفَرْنَا غَازِينَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ خَلَفَ أَحَدُهُمْ لَهُ نَبِيبٌ كَنَبِيبِ التَّيْسِ يَمْنَحُ أَحَدُهُمُ الْكُثْبَةَ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ إِنْ يُمْكِنِّي مِنْ أَحَدِهِمْ لأُنَكِّلَنَّهُ عَنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw kaamilin, fudaylu bnu husaynin aljahdariyyu haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an simaaki bni, harbin 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala raaaytu maa'iza bna maalikin hiyna jiy'a bihi iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulun qasiyrun aa'dalu laysa 'alayhi ridaa'un fashahida 'alaa nafsihi aarba'a marraatin aannahu zanaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ fala'allaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa waalllahi iinnahu qad zanaa alaakhiru - qaala - farajamahu thumma khataba faqaala ‏"‏ aalaa kullamaa nafarnaa ghaaziyna fiy sabiyli alllahi khalafa aahaduhum lahu nabiybun kanabiybi alttaysi yamnahu aahaduhumu alkuthbaaa aamaa waalllahi iin yumkinniy min aahadihim launakkilannahu 'anhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported:As he was being brought to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) I saw Ma'iz b. Malik-a short-statured person with strong sinews, having no cloak around him. He bore witness against his own self four times that he had committed adultery, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Perhaps (you kissed her or embraced her). He said: No. by God, one deviating (from the path of virtue) has committed adultery. He then got him stoned (to death), and then delivered the address: Behold, as we set out for Jihad in the cause of Allah, one of you lagged behind and shrieked like the bleating of a male goat, and gave a small quantity of milk. By Allah, in case I get hold of him, I shall certainly punish him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ، يَقُولُ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَجُلٍ قَصِيرٍ أَشْعَثَ ذِي عَضَلاَتٍ عَلَيْهِ إِزَارٌ وَقَدْ زَنَى فَرَدَّهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كُلَّمَا نَفَرْنَا غَازِينَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ تَخَلَّفَ أَحَدُكُمْ يَنِبُّ نَبِيبَ التَّيْسِ يَمْنَحُ إِحْدَاهُنَّ الْكُثْبَةَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يُمْكِنِّي مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ إِلاَّ جَعَلْتُهُ نَكَالاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ نَكَّلْتُهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَدَّثْتُهُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ رَدَّهُ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu ja'farin haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an simaaki bni harbin, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna samuraaa, yaquwlu autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm birajulin qasiyrin aash'atha dhiy 'adalaatin 'alayhi iizaarun waqad zanaa faraddahu marratayni thumma aamara bihi farujima faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ kullamaa nafarnaa ghaaziyna fiy sabiyli alllahi takhallafa aahadukum yanibbu nabiyba alttaysi yamnahu iihdaahunna alkuthbaaa iinna alllaha laa yumkinniy min aahadin minhum iilaaa ja'altuhu nakaalaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw nakkaltuhu ‏.‏ qaala fahaddathtuhu sa'iyda bna jubayrin faqaala iinnahu raddahu aarba'a marraatin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported that there was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a short-statured person with thick uncombed hair, muscular body, having a mantle around him and he had committed adultery. He turned him away twice and then made pronouncement about him and he was stoned. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:We set out for Jihad in the cause of Allah and one of you lagged behind and shrieked like the bleating of a male goat and one of then (goats' gave a small quantity of milk. In case Allah gives me power over one of them, I will punish him (in such a way that it may have a deterrent effect upon others). In another narration transmitted on the authority of Sa'id b Jubair (the words are), that He (the Holy Prophet) turned him away four times
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ جَعْفَرٍ وَوَافَقَهُ شَبَابَةُ عَلَى قَوْلِهِ فَرَدَّهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي عَامِرٍ فَرَدَّهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa shabaabaau, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'aamirin al'aqadiyyu, kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, 'an simaakin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi abni ja'farin wawaafaqahu shabaabaau 'alaa qawlihi faraddahu marratayni ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi aabiy 'aamirin faraddahu marratayni aaw thalaathana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Samura through another chain of transmitters with the difference that along with the mentioning (of the fact) that he (the Holy Prophet) turned him away twice, or thrice
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِقُتَيْبَةَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ‏"‏ أَحَقٌّ مَا بَلَغَنِي عَنْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَمَا بَلَغَكَ عَنِّي قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ وَقَعْتَ بِجَارِيَةِ آلِ فُلاَنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَشَهِدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu - waalllafzu liqutaybaaa - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa 'an simaakin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala limaa'izi bni maalikin ‏"‏ aahaqqun maa balaghaniy 'anka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wamaa balaghaka 'anniy qaala ‏"‏ balaghaniy aannaka waqa'ta bijaariyaai ali fulaanin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala fashahida aarba'a shahaadaatin ‏.‏ thumma aamara bihi farujima ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to Ma'iz b. Malik:Is it true what has reached me about you? He said: What has reached you about me? He said: It has reached me that you have committed (adultery) with the slave-girl of so and so? He said: Yes. He (the narrator) said: He testified four times. He (the Holy Prophet) then made pronouncement about him and he was stoned (to death)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي، سَعِيدٍ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنْ أَسْلَمَ يُقَالُ لَهُ مَاعِزُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ فَاحِشَةً فَأَقِمْهُ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَرَدَّهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِرَارًا قَالَ ثُمَّ سَأَلَ قَوْمَهُ فَقَالُوا مَا نَعْلَمُ بِهِ بَأْسًا إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ أَصَابَ شَيْئًا يَرَى أَنَّهُ لاَ يُخْرِجُهُ مِنْهُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُقَامَ فِيهِ الْحَدُّ - قَالَ - فَرَجَعَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَمَرَنَا أَنْ نَرْجُمَهُ - قَالَ - فَانْطَلَقْنَا بِهِ إِلَى بَقِيعِ الْغَرْقَدِ - قَالَ - فَمَا أَوْثَقْنَاهُ وَلاَ حَفَرْنَا لَهُ - قَالَ - فَرَمَيْنَاهُ بِالْعَظْمِ وَالْمَدَرِ وَالْخَزَفِ - قَالَ - فَاشْتَدَّ فَاشْتَدَدْنَا خَلْفَهُ حَتَّى أَتَى عُرْضَ الْحَرَّةِ فَانْتَصَبَ لَنَا فَرَمَيْنَاهُ بِجَلاَمِيدِ الْحَرَّةِ - يَعْنِي الْحِجَارَةَ - حَتَّى سَكَتَ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطِيبًا مِنَ الْعَشِيِّ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَوَكُلَّمَا انْطَلَقْنَا غُزَاةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ تَخَلَّفَ رَجُلٌ فِي عِيَالِنَا لَهُ نَبِيبٌ كَنَبِيبِ التَّيْسِ عَلَىَّ أَنْ لاَ أُوتَى بِرَجُلٍ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ نَكَّلْتُ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا اسْتَغْفَرَ لَهُ وَلاَ سَبَّهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathaniy 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa daawudu, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy, sa'iydin aanna rajulaan, min aaslama yuqaalu lahu maa'izu bnu maalikin aataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala iinniy aasabtu faahishaaan faaaqimhu 'alaaaa ‏.‏ faraddahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm miraarana qaala thumma saaala qawmahu faqaaluwa maa na'lamu bihi baasana iilaaa aannahu aasaaba shayiana yaraa aannahu laa yukhrijuhu minhu iilaaa aan yuqaama fiyhi alhaddu - qaala - faraja'a iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaamaranaa aan narjumahu - qaala - faantalaqnaa bihi iilaa baqiy'i algharqadi - qaala - famaa aawthaqnaahu walaa hafarnaa lahu - qaala - faramaynaahu bial'azmi waalmadari waalkhazafi - qaala - faashtadda faashtadadnaa khalfahu hattaa aataa 'urda alharraai faantasaba lanaa faramaynaahu bijalaamiydi alharraai - ya'niy alhijaaraaa - hattaa sakata - qaala - thumma qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khatiybana mina al'ashiyyi faqaala ‏ "‏ aawakullamaa antalaqnaa ghuzaaaan fiy sabiyli alllahi takhallafa rajulun fiy 'iyaalinaa lahu nabiybun kanabiybi alttaysi 'alaaaa aan laa auwtaa birajulin fa'ala dhalika iilaaa nakkaltu bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala famaa astaghfara lahu walaa sabbahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported that a person belonging to the clan of Aslam, who was called Ma, iz b. Malik, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:I have committed immorality (adultery), so inflict punishment upon me. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) turned him away again and again. He then asked his people (about the state of his mind). They said: We do not know of any ailment of his except that he has committed something about which he thinks that he would not be able to relieve himself of its burden but with the Hadd being imposed upon him. He (Ma'iz) came back to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he commanded us to stone him. We took him to the Baqi' al-Gharqad (the graveyard of Medina). We neither tied him nor dug any ditch for him. We attacked him with bones, with clods and pebbles.
