He ran away and we ran after him until he came upon the ston ground (al-Harra) and stopped there and we stoned him with heavy stones of the Harra until he became motionless (lie died). He (the Holy Prophet) then addressed (us) in the evening saying Whenever we set forth on an expedition in the cause of Allah, some one of those connected with us shrieked (under the pressure of sexual lust) as the bleating of a male goat. It is essential that if a person having committed such a deed is brought to me, I should punish him. He neither begged forgiveness for him nor cursed him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ مَعْنَاهُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْعَشِيِّ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَمَا بَالُ أَقْوَامٍ إِذَا غَزَوْنَا يَتَخَلَّفُ أَحَدُهُمْ عَنَّا لَهُ نَبِيبٌ كَنَبِيبِ التَّيْسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ ‏"‏ فِي عِيَالِنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa daawudu, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithla ma'naahu ‏.‏ waqaala fiy alhadiythi faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm mina al'ashiyyi fahamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi thumma qaala ‏"‏ aammaa ba'du famaa baalu aaqwaamin iidhaa ghazawnaa yatakhallafu aahaduhum 'annaa lahu nabiybun kanabiybi alttaysi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yaqul ‏"‏ fiy 'iyaalinaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Dawud narrated the hadith with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are):Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) stood tip (to address the audience) in the evening and praised Allah, glorified Him and then said: What about the people, that as we set out on an expedition, one of you remained behind us and he shrieked like the bleating of a male goat? But he did not mention (these words): People connected with us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ دَاوُدَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ بَعْضَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ فَاعْتَرَفَ بِالزِّنَى ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa surayju bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu zakariyyaa'a bni aabiy zaaiidaaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu hishaamin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, kilaahumaa 'an daawuda, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ ba'da hadhaa alhadiythi ‏.‏ ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi sufyaana faa'tarafa bialzzinaa thalaatha marraatin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Dawud with the same chain of transmitters but with this variation that in the hadith narrated by Sufyan (the words are):" He made a confession of having committed adultery, thrice
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَعْلَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ - عَنْ غَيْلاَنَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَامِعٍ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ - عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ جَاءَ مَاعِزُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ طَهِّرْنِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَيْحَكَ ارْجِعْ فَاسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ وَتُبْ إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَجَعَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ طَهِّرْنِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَيْحَكَ ارْجِعْ فَاسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ وَتُبْ إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَجَعَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ طَهِّرْنِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَتِ الرَّابِعَةُ قَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فِيمَ أُطَهِّرُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مِنَ الزِّنَى ‏.‏ فَسَأَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَبِهِ جُنُونٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأُخْبِرَ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِمَجْنُونٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشَرِبَ خَمْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ فَاسْتَنْكَهَهُ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ مِنْهُ رِيحَ خَمْرٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَزَنَيْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ فَكَانَ النَّاسُ فِيهِ فِرْقَتَيْنِ قَائِلٌ يَقُولُ لَقَدْ هَلَكَ لَقَدْ أَحَاطَتْ بِهِ خَطِيئَتُهُ وَقَائِلٌ يَقُولُ مَا تَوْبَةٌ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ تَوْبَةِ مَاعِزٍ أَنَّهُ جَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ فِي يَدِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ اقْتُلْنِي بِالْحِجَارَةِ - قَالَ - فَلَبِثُوا بِذَلِكَ يَوْمَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثَةً ثُمَّ جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُمْ جُلُوسٌ فَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ جَلَسَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اسْتَغْفِرُوا لِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالُوا غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَقَدْ تَابَ تَوْبَةً لَوْ قُسِمَتْ بَيْنَ أُمَّةٍ لَوَسِعَتْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ جَاءَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ غَامِدٍ مِنَ الأَزْدِ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ طَهِّرْنِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَيْحَكِ ارْجِعِي فَاسْتَغْفِرِي اللَّهَ وَتُوبِي إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ أَرَاكَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُرَدِّدَنِي كَمَا رَدَّدْتَ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ إِنَّهَا حُبْلَى مِنَ الزِّنَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ آنْتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ حَتَّى تَضَعِي مَا فِي بَطْنِكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَفَلَهَا رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ حَتَّى وَضَعَتْ قَالَ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ قَدْ وَضَعَتِ الْغَامِدِيَّةُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذًا لاَ نَرْجُمَهَا وَنَدَعَ وَلَدَهَا صَغِيرًا لَيْسَ لَهُ مَنْ يُرْضِعُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ إِلَىَّ رَضَاعُهُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَجَمَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i alhamdaaniyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu ya'laa, - wahuwa abnu alhaarithi almuhaaribiyyu - 'an ghaylaana, - wahuwa abnu jaami'in almuhaaribiyyu - 'an 'alqamaaa bni marthadin, 'an sulaymaana, bni buraydaaa 'an aabiyhi, qaala jaa'a maa'izu bnu maalikin iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi tahhirniy ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ wayhaka arji' faastaghfiri alllaha watub iilayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faraja'a ghayra ba'iydin thumma jaa'a faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi tahhirniy ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ wayhaka arji' faastaghfiri alllaha watub iilayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faraja'a ghayra ba'iydin thumma jaa'a faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi tahhirniy ‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm mithla dhalika hattaa iidhaa kaanati alrraabi'aau qaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ fiyma autahhiruka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala mina alzzinaa ‏.‏ fasaaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aabihi junuwnun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaukhbira aannahu laysa bimajnuwnin ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aashariba khamrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaama rajulun faastankahahu falam yajid minhu riyha khamrin ‏.‏ qaala faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aazanayta ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala na'am ‏.‏ faaamara bihi farujima fakaana alnnaasu fiyhi firqatayni qaaiilun yaquwlu laqad halaka laqad aahaatat bihi khatiyiatuhu waqaaiilun yaquwlu maa tawbaaun aafdala min tawbaai maa'izin aannahu jaa'a iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fawada'a yadahu fiy yadihi thumma qaala aqtulniy bialhijaaraai - qaala - falabithuwa bidhalika yawmayni aaw thalaathaaan thumma jaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahum juluwsun fasallama thumma jalasa faqaala ‏"‏ astaghfiruwa limaa'izi bni maalikin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqaaluwa ghafara alllahu limaa'izi bni maalikin ‏.‏ - qaala - faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laqad taaba tawbaaan law qusimat bayna aummaain lawasi'athum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma jaa'athu amraaaaun min ghaamidin mina alaazdi faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi tahhirniy ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ wayhaki arji'iy faastaghfiriy alllaha watuwbiy iilayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat aaraaka turiydu aan turaddidaniy kamaa raddadta maa'iza bna maalikin ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ wamaa dhaaki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat iinnahaa hublaa mina alzzinaa ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ anti ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat na'am ‏.‏ faqaala lahaa ‏"‏ hattaa tada'iy maa fiy batniki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fakafalahaa rajulun mina alaansaari hattaa wada'at qaala faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala qad wada'ati alghaamidiyyaau ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iidhana laa narjumahaa wanada'a waladahaa saghiyrana laysa lahu man yurdi'uhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaama rajulun mina alaansaari faqaala iilaaaa radaa'uhu yaa nabiyya alllahi ‏.‏ qaala farajamahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sulaiman b. Buraida reported on the authority of his father that Ma, iz b. Malik came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said to him:Messenger of Allah, purify me, whereupon he said: Woe be upon you, go back, ask forgiveness of Allah and turn to Him in repentance. He (the narrator) said that he went back not far, then came and said: Allah's Messenger, purify me. whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Woe be upon you, go back and ask forgiveness of Allah and turn to Him in repentance. He (the narrator) said that he went back not far, when he came and said: Allah's Messenger, purify me. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said as he had said before. When it was the fourth time, Allah's Messenger (may, peace be upon him) said: From what am I to purify you? He said: From adultery, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked if he had been mad. He was informed that he was not mad. He said: Has he drunk wine? A person stood up and smelt his breath but noticed no smell of wine. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Have you committed adultery? He said: Yes. He made pronouncement about him and he was stoned to death. The people had been (divided) into two groups about him (Ma'iz). One of them said: He has been undone for his sins had encompassed him, whereas another said: There is no repentance more excellent than the repentance of Ma'iz, for he came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and placing his hand in his (in the Holy Prophet's) hand said: Kill me with stones. (This controversy about Ma'iz) remained for two or three days. Then came Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to them (his Companions) as they were sitting. He greeted them with salutation and then sat down and said: Ask forgiveness for Ma'iz b. Malik. They said: May Allah forgive Ma'iz b. Malik. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He (Ma'iz) has made such a repentance that if that were to be divided among a people, it would have been enough for all of them. He (the narrator) said: Then a woman of Ghamid, a branch of Azd, came to him and said: Messenger of of Allah, purify me, whereupon he said: Woe be upon you; go back and beg forgiveness from Allah and turn to Him in repentance. She said: I find that you intend to send me back as you sent back Ma'iz. b. Malik. He (the Holy, Prophet) said: What has happened to you? She said that she had become pregnant as a result of fornication. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Is it you (who has done that)? She said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) said to her: (You will not be punished) until you deliver what is there in your womb. One of the Ansar became responsible for her until she was delivered (of the child). He (that Ansari) came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said the woman of Ghamid has given birth to a child. He (the Holy Prophet) said: In that case we shall not stone her and so leave her infant with none to suckle him. One of the Ansar got up and said: Allah's Apostle, let the responsibility of his suckling be upon me. She was then stoned to death
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ - وَتَقَارَبَا فِي لَفْظِ الْحَدِيثِ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا بَشِيرُ بْنُ الْمُهَاجِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ الأَسْلَمِيَّ، أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَزَنَيْتُ وَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ تُطَهِّرَنِي ‏.‏ فَرَدَّهُ فَلَمَّا كَانَ مِنَ الْغَدِ أَتَاهُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ زَنَيْتُ ‏.‏ فَرَدَّهُ الثَّانِيَةَ فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَعْلَمُونَ بِعَقْلِهِ بَأْسًا تُنْكِرُونَ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا مَا نَعْلَمُهُ إِلاَّ وَفِيَّ الْعَقْلِ مِنْ صَالِحِينَا فِيمَا نُرَى فَأَتَاهُ الثَّالِثَةَ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَيْضًا فَسَأَلَ عَنْهُ فَأَخْبَرُوهُ أَنَّهُ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ وَلاَ بِعَقْلِهِ فَلَمَّا كَانَ الرَّابِعَةَ حَفَرَ لَهُ حُفْرَةً ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَاءَتِ الْغَامِدِيَّةُ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ زَنَيْتُ فَطَهِّرْنِي ‏.‏ وَإِنَّهُ رَدَّهَا فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْغَدُ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لِمَ تَرُدُّنِي لَعَلَّكَ أَنْ تَرُدَّنِي كَمَا رَدَدْتَ مَاعِزًا فَوَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَحُبْلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِمَّا لاَ فَاذْهَبِي حَتَّى تَلِدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا وَلَدَتْ أَتَتْهُ بِالصَّبِيِّ فِي خِرْقَةٍ قَالَتْ هَذَا قَدْ وَلَدْتُهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبِي فَأَرْضِعِيهِ حَتَّى تَفْطِمِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا فَطَمَتْهُ أَتَتْهُ بِالصَّبِيِّ فِي يَدِهِ كِسْرَةُ خُبْزٍ فَقَالَتْ هَذَا يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ قَدْ فَطَمْتُهُ وَقَدْ أَكَلَ الطَّعَامَ ‏.‏ فَدَفَعَ الصَّبِيَّ إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَحُفِرَ لَهَا إِلَى صَدْرِهَا وَأَمَرَ النَّاسَ فَرَجَمُوهَا فَيُقْبِلُ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بِحَجَرٍ فَرَمَى رَأْسَهَا فَتَنَضَّحَ الدَّمُ عَلَى وَجْهِ خَالِدٍ فَسَبَّهَا فَسَمِعَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَبَّهُ إِيَّاهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَهْلاً يَا خَالِدُ فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَقَدْ تَابَتْ تَوْبَةً لَوْ تَابَهَا صَاحِبُ مَكْسٍ لَغُفِرَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا وَدُفِنَتْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi, alllahi bni numayrin - wataqaarabaa fiy lafzi alhadiythi - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa bashiyru bnu almuhaajiri, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu buraydaaa, 'an aabiyhi, aanna maa'iza bna maalikin alaaslamiyya, aataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy qad zalamtu nafsiy wazanaytu waiinniy auriydu aan tutahhiraniy ‏.‏ faraddahu falammaa kaana mina alghadi aataahu faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy qad zanaytu ‏.‏ faraddahu althhaaniyaaa faaarsala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa qawmihi faqaala ‏"‏ aata'lamuwna bi'aqlihi baasana tunkiruwna minhu shayiana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa maa na'lamuhu iilaaa wafiyya al'aqli min saalihiynaa fiymaa nuraa faaataahu althhaalithaaa faaarsala iilayhim aaydana fasaaala 'anhu faaakhbaruwhu aannahu laa baasa bihi walaa bi'aqlihi falammaa kaana alrraabi'aaa hafara lahu hufraaan thumma aamara bihi farujima ‏.‏ qaala fajaa'ati alghaamidiyyaau faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy qad zanaytu fatahhirniy ‏.‏ waiinnahu raddahaa falammaa kaana alghadu qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi lima tarudduniy la'allaka aan taruddaniy kamaa radadta maa'izana fawaalllahi iinniy lahublaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iimmaa laa faadhhabiy hattaa talidiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falammaa waladat aatathu bialssabiyyi fiy khirqaain qaalat hadhaa qad waladtuhu ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ adhhabiy faaardi'iyhi hattaa taftimiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falammaa fatamathu aatathu bialssabiyyi fiy yadihi kisraau khubzin faqaalat hadhaa yaa nabiyya alllahi qad fatamtuhu waqad aakala altta'aama ‏.‏ fadafa'a alssabiyya iilaa rajulin mina almuslimiyna thumma aamara bihaa fahufira lahaa iilaa sadrihaa waaamara alnnaasa farajamuwhaa fayuqbilu khaalidu bnu alwaliydi bihajarin faramaa raasahaa fatanaddaha alddamu 'alaa wajhi khaalidin fasabbahaa fasami'a nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sabbahu iiyyaahaa faqaala ‏"‏ mahlaan yaa khaalidu fawaalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laqad taabat tawbaaan law taabahaa saahibu maksin laghufira lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma aamara bihaa fasallaa 'alayhaa wadufinat ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Buraida reported on the authority of his father that Ma'iz b. Malik al-Aslami came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:Allah's Messenger, I have wronged myself; I have committed adultery and I earnestly desire that you should purify me. He turned him away. On the following day, he (Ma'iz) again came to him and said: Allah's Messenger, I have committed adultery. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned him away for the second time, and sent him to his people saying: Do you know if there is anything wrong with his mind. They denied of any such thing in him and said: We do not know him but as a wise good man among us, so far as we can judge. He (Ma'iz) came for the third time, and he (the Holy Prophet) sent him as he had done before. He asked about him and they informed him that there was nothing wrong with him or with his mind. When it was the fourth time, a ditch was dug for him and he (the Holy Prophet) pronounced judg- ment about him and he wis stoned. He (the narrator) said: There came to him (the Holy Prophet) a woman from Ghamid and said: Allah's Messenger, I have committed adultery, so purify me. He (the Holy Prophet) turned her away. On the following day she said: Allah's Messenger, Why do you turn me away? Perhaps, you turn me away as you turned away Ma'iz. By Allah, I have become pregnant. He said: Well, if you insist upon it, then go away until you give birth to (the child). When she was delivered she came with the child (wrapped) in a rag and said: Here is the child whom I have given birth to. He said: Go away and suckle him until you wean him. When she had weaned him, she came to him (the Holy Prophet) with the child who was holding a piece of bread in his hand. She said: Allah's Apostle, here is he as I have weaned him and he eats food. He (the Holy Prophet) entrusted the child to one of the Muslims and then pronounced punishment. And she was put in a ditch up to her chest and he commanded people and they stoned her. Khalid b Walid came forward with a stone which he flung at her head and there spurted blood on the face of Khalid and so he abused her. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) heard his (Khalid's) curse that he had huried upon her. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Khalid, be gentle. By Him in Whose Hand is my life, she has made such a repentance that even if a wrongful tax-collector were to repent, he would have been forgiven. Then giving command regarding her, he prayed over her and she was buried
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ، مَالِكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ هِشَامٍ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا الْمُهَلَّبِ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ، بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ أَتَتْ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ حُبْلَى مِنَ الزِّنَى فَقَالَتْ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ أَصَبْتُ حَدًّا فَأَقِمْهُ عَلَىَّ فَدَعَا نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلِيَّهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَحْسِنْ إِلَيْهَا فَإِذَا وَضَعَتْ فَائْتِنِي بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَفَعَلَ فَأَمَرَ بِهَا نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَشُكَّتْ عَلَيْهَا ثِيَابُهَا ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَرُجِمَتْ ثُمَّ صَلَّى عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ تُصَلِّي عَلَيْهَا يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ وَقَدْ زَنَتْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ تَابَتْ تَوْبَةً لَوْ قُسِمَتْ بَيْنَ سَبْعِينَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ لَوَسِعَتْهُمْ وَهَلْ وَجَدْتَ تَوْبَةً أَفْضَلَ مِنْ أَنْ جَادَتْ بِنَفْسِهَا لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw ghassaana, maaliku bnu 'abdi alwaahidi almisma'iyyu haddathanaa mu'aadhun, - ya'niy abna hishaamin - haddathaniy aabiy, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, haddathaniy aabuw qilaabaaa, aanna aabaa almuhallabi, haddathahu 'an 'imraana, bni husaynin aanna amraaaaan, min juhaynaaa aatat nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahiya hublaa mina alzzinaa faqaalat yaa nabiyya alllahi aasabtu haddana faaaqimhu 'alaaaa fada'aa nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waliyyahaa faqaala ‏"‏ aahsin iilayhaa faiidhaa wada'at faaitiniy bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fafa'ala faaamara bihaa nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fashukkat 'alayhaa thiyaabuhaa thumma aamara bihaa farujimat thumma sallaa 'alayhaa faqaala lahu 'umaru tusalliy 'alayhaa yaa nabiyya alllahi waqad zanat faqaala ‏"‏ laqad taabat tawbaaan law qusimat bayna sab'iyna min aahli almadiynaai lawasi'athum wahal wajadta tawbaaan aafdala min aan jaadat binafsihaa lillahi ta'aalaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Imran b. Husain reported that a woman from Juhaina came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and she had become pregnant because of adultery. She said:Allah's Apostle, I have done something for which (prescribed punishment) must be imposed upon me, so impose that. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) called her master and said: Treat her well, and when she delivers bring her to me. He did accordingly. Then Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) pronounced judgment about her and her clothes were tied around her and then he commanded and she was stoned to death. He then prayed over her (dead body). Thereupon Umar said to him: Allah's Apostle, you offer prayer for her, whereas she had committed adultery! Thereupon he said: She has made such a repentance that if it were to be divided among seventy men of Medina, it would be enough. Have you found any repentance better than this that she sacr ficed her life for Allah, the Majestic?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانٌ الْعَطَّارُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'affaanu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa aabaanun al'attaaru, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy kathiyrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Yahya b. Abu Kathir
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِيَهُودِيٍّ وَيَهُودِيَّةٍ قَدْ زَنَيَا فَانْطَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى جَاءَ يَهُودَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا تَجِدُونَ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ عَلَى مَنْ زَنَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نُسَوِّدُ وُجُوهَهُمَا وَنُحَمِّلُهُمَا وَنُخَالِفُ بَيْنَ وُجُوهِهِمَا وَيُطَافُ بِهِمَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأْتُوا بِالتَّوْرَاةِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجَاءُوا بِهَا فَقَرَءُوهَا حَتَّى إِذَا مَرُّوا بِآيَةِ الرَّجْمِ وَضَعَ الْفَتَى الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ يَدَهُ عَلَى آيَةِ الرَّجْمِ وَقَرَأَ مَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا وَمَا وَرَاءَهَا فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ وَهْوَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُرْهُ فَلْيَرْفَعْ يَدَهُ فَرَفَعَهَا فَإِذَا تَحْتَهَا آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ فَأَمَرَ بِهِمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرُجِمَا ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ كُنْتُ فِيمَنْ رَجَمَهُمَا فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ يَقِيهَا مِنَ الْحِجَارَةِ بِنَفْسِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alhakamu bnu muwsaa aabuw saalihin, haddathanaa shu'aybu bnu iishaaqa, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm autiya biyahuwdiyyin wayahuwdiyyaain qad zanayaa faantalaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa jaa'a yahuwda faqaala ‏"‏ maa tajiduwna fiy alttawraaai 'alaa man zanaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa nusawwidu wujuwhahumaa wanuhammiluhumaa wanukhaalifu bayna wujuwhihimaa wayutaafu bihimaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faatuwa bialttawraaai iin kuntum saadiqiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fajaa'uwa bihaa faqara'uwhaa hattaa iidhaa marruwa biayaai alrrajmi wada'a alfataa alladhiy yaqraau yadahu 'alaa ayaai alrrajmi waqaraaa maa bayna yadayhaa wamaa waraa'ahaa faqaala lahu 'abdu alllahi bnu salaamin wahwa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm murhu falyarfa' yadahu farafa'ahaa faiidhaa tahtahaa ayaau alrrajmi faaamara bihimaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm farujimaa ‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara kuntu fiyman rajamahumaa falaqad raaaytuhu yaqiyhaa mina alhijaaraai binafsihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that a Jew and a Jewess were brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who had committed adultery. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to the Jews and said:What do you find in Torah for one who commits adultery? They said: We darken their faces and make them ride on the donkey with their faces turned to the opposite direction (and their backs touching each other), and then they are taken round (the city). He said: Bring Torah if you are truthful. They brought it and recited it until when they came to the verse pertaining to stoning, the person who was reading placed his hand on the verse pertaining to stoning, and read (only that which was) between his hands and what was subsequent to that. Abdullah b. Salim who was at that time with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Command him (the reciter) to lift his hand. He lifted it and there was, underneath that, the verse pertaining to stoning. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pronounced judgment about both of them and they were stoned. Abdullah b. 'Umar said: I was one of those who stoned them, and I saw him (the Jew) protecting her (the Jewess) with his body
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي رِجَالٌ، مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ مِنْهُمْ مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ أَنَّ نَافِعًا، أَخْبَرَهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجَمَ فِي الزِّنَى يَهُودِيَّيْنِ رَجُلاً وَامْرَأَةً زَنَيَا فَأَتَتِ الْيَهُودُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهِمَا ‏.‏ وَسَاقُوا الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'niy abna 'ulayyaaa - 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy rijaalun, min aahli al'ilmi minhum maaliku bnu aanasin aanna naafi'ana, aakhbarahum 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajama fiy alzzinaa yahuwdiyyayni rajulaan waamraaaaan zanayaa faaatati alyahuwdu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihimaa ‏.‏ wasaaquwa alhadiytha binahwihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stoned to death the Jews, both male and female, who had committed adultery. The Jews brought them to Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him). The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عُمَرَ أَنَّ الْيَهُودَ، جَاءُوا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ وَامْرَأَةٍ قَدْ زَنَيَا ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni, 'umara aanna alyahuwda, jaa'uwa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm birajulin minhum waamraaaain qad zanayaa ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha binahwi hadiythi 'ubaydi alllahi 'an naafi'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that the Jews brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a man and a woman who had committed adultery. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ مُرَّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَهُودِيٍّ مُحَمَّمًا مَجْلُودًا فَدَعَاهُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَكَذَا تَجِدُونَ حَدَّ الزَّانِي فِي كِتَابِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَدَعَا رَجُلاً مِنْ عُلَمَائِهِمْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْشُدُكَ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ التَّوْرَاةَ عَلَى مُوسَى أَهَكَذَا تَجِدُونَ حَدَّ الزَّانِي فِي كِتَابِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ وَلَوْلاَ أَنَّكَ نَشَدْتَنِي بِهَذَا لَمْ أُخْبِرْكَ نَجِدُهُ الرَّجْمَ وَلَكِنَّهُ كَثُرَ فِي أَشْرَافِنَا فَكُنَّا إِذَا أَخَذْنَا الشَّرِيفَ تَرَكْنَاهُ وَإِذَا أَخَذْنَا الضَّعِيفَ أَقَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ قُلْنَا تَعَالَوْا فَلْنَجْتَمِعْ عَلَى شَىْءٍ نُقِيمُهُ عَلَى الشَّرِيفِ وَالْوَضِيعِ فَجَعَلْنَا التَّحْمِيمَ وَالْجَلْدَ مَكَانَ الرَّجْمِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَوَّلُ مَنْ أَحْيَا أَمْرَكَ إِذْ أَمَاتُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ يَا أَيُّهَا الرَّسُولُ لاَ يَحْزُنْكَ الَّذِينَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْكُفْرِ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏ إِنْ أُوتِيتُمْ هَذَا فَخُذُوهُ‏}‏ يَقُولُ ائْتُوا مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِنْ أَمَرَكُمْ بِالتَّحْمِيمِ وَالْجَلْدِ فَخُذُوهُ وَإِنْ أَفْتَاكُمْ بِالرَّجْمِ فَاحْذَرُوا ‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَحْكُمْ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْكَافِرُونَ‏}‏ ‏{‏ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَحْكُمْ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ‏}‏ ‏{‏ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَحْكُمْ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ‏}‏ فِي الْكُفَّارِ كُلُّهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa kilaahumaa 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni murraaa, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, qaala murra 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyahuwdiyyin muhammamana majluwdana fada'aahum sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ hakadhaa tajiduwna hadda alzzaaniy fiy kitaabikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa na'am ‏.‏ fada'aa rajulaan min 'ulamaaiihim faqaala ‏"‏ aanshuduka bialllahi alladhiy aanzala alttawraaaa 'alaa muwsaa aahakadhaa tajiduwna hadda alzzaaniy fiy kitaabikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa walawlaa aannaka nashadtaniy bihadhaa lam aukhbirka najiduhu alrrajma walakinnahu kathura fiy aashraafinaa fakunnaa iidhaa aakhadhnaa alshhariyfa taraknaahu waiidhaa aakhadhnaa aldda'iyfa aaqamnaa 'alayhi alhadda qulnaa ta'aalawa falnajtami' 'alaa shaa'in nuqiymuhu 'alaa alshhariyfi waalwadiy'i faja'alnaa alttahmiyma waaljalda makaana alrrajmi ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alllahumma iinniy aawwalu man aahyaa aamraka iidh aamaatuwhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaamara bihi farujima faaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ yaa aayyuhaa alrrasuwlu laa yahzunka alladhiyna yusaari'uwna fiy alkufri‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏ iin auwtiytum hadhaa fakhudhuwhu‏}‏ yaquwlu aituwa muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm faiin aamarakum bialttahmiymi waaljaldi fakhudhuwhu waiin aaftaakum bialrrajmi faahdharuwa ‏.‏ faaanzala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏ waman lam yahkum bimaa aanzala alllahu faauwlaiika humu alkaafiruwna‏}‏ ‏{‏ waman lam yahkum bimaa aanzala alllahu faauwlaiika humu alzzaalimuwna‏}‏ ‏{‏ waman lam yahkum bimaa aanzala alllahu faauwlaiika humu alfaasiquwna‏}‏ fiy alkuffaari kulluhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported:There happened to pass by Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) a Jew blackened and lashed. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) called them (the Jews) and said: Is this the punishment that you find in your Book (Torah) as a prescribed punishment for adultery? They said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) called one of the scholars amongst them and said: I ask you in the name of Allah Who sent down the Torah on Moses if that is the prescribed punishment for adultery that you find in your Book. He said: No. Had you not asked me in the name of Allah, I would not have given you this information. We find stoning to death (as punishment prescribed in the Torah). But this (crime) became quite common amongst our aristocratic class. So when we caught hold of any rich person (indulging in this offence) we spared him, but when we caught hold of a helpless person we imposed the prescribed punishment upon him. We then said: Let us argree (on a punishment) which we can inflict both upon the rich and the poor. So We decided to blacken the face with coal and flog as a substitute punishment for stoning. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Allah, I am the first to revive Thy command when they had made it dead. He then commanded and he (the offender) was stoned to death. Allah, the Majestic and Glorious, sent down (this verse):" O Messenger, (the behaviour of) those who vie with one another in denying the truth should not grieve you..." up to" is vouchsafed unto you, accept it" (v. 41) 2176 It was said (by the Jews): Go to Muhammad; it he commands you to blacken the face and award flogging (as punishment for adultery), then accept it, but it he gives verdict for stoning, then avoid it. It was (then) that Allah, the Majestic and Great, sent down (these verses):" And they who do not judge in accordance with what Allah has revealed are, indeed, deniers of the truth" (v. 44) ;" And they who do not judge in accordance with what Allah has revealed-they, they indeed are the wrongdoers" (v. 45) ;" And they who do not judge in accordance with what God has revealed-they are the iniquitous (v. 47). (All these verses) were revealed in connection with the non-believers
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرُجِمَ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَا بَعْدَهُ مِنْ نُزُولِ الآيَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, waaabuw sa'iydin alaashajju qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwahu iilaa qawlihi faaamara bihi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm farujima ‏.‏ walam yadhkur maa ba'dahu min nuzuwli alayaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash up to the words:" Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) pronounced judgment and he was stoned (to death)" And he mentioned nothing subsequent to that pertaining to the revelation of verses
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ رَجَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاً مِنْ أَسْلَمَ وَرَجُلاً مِنَ الْيَهُودِ وَامْرَأَتَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, qaala qaala abnu jurayjin aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu rajama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulaan min aaslama warajulaan mina alyahuwdi waamraaatahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) stoned (to death) a person from Banu Aslam, and a Jew and his wife
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَامْرَأَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏ ghayra aannahu qaala waamraaaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Juraij with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، إِسْحَاقَ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى هَلْ رَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ بَعْدَ مَا أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةُ النُّورِ أَمْ قَبْلَهَا قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, haddathanaa sulaymaanu alshhaybaaniyyu, qaala saaaltu 'abda alllahi bna aabiy aawfaa h. wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an aabiy, iishaaqa alshhaybaaniyyi qaala saaaltu 'abda alllahi bna aabiy aawfaa hal rajama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala qultu ba'da maa aunzilat suwraau alnnuwri aam qablahaa qaala laa aadriy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Ishaq Shaibani said:I asked 'Abdullah b. Abu Aufi if Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) awarded (the punishment) of stoning (to death). He said: Yes. I said: After Sura al-Nur was revealed or before that? He said: I do not know
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عِيسَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا زَنَتْ أَمَةُ أَحَدِكُمْ فَتَبَيَّنَ زِنَاهَا فَلْيَجْلِدْهَا الْحَدَّ وَلاَ يُثَرِّبْ عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ إِنْ زَنَتْ فَلْيَجْلِدْهَا الْحَدَّ وَلاَ يُثَرِّبْ عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ إِنْ زَنَتِ الثَّالِثَةَ فَتَبَيَّنَ زِنَاهَا فَلْيَبِعْهَا وَلَوْ بِحَبْلٍ مِنْ شَعَرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'iysaa bnu hammaadin almisriyyu, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu sami'ahu yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iidhaa zanat aamaau aahadikum fatabayyana zinaahaa falyajlidhaa alhadda walaa yutharrib 'alayhaa thumma iin zanat falyajlidhaa alhadda walaa yutharrib 'alayhaa thumma iin zanati althhaalithaaa fatabayyana zinaahaa falyabi'haa walaw bihablin min sha'arin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When the slave-woman of any of you commits adultery and this (offence of hers) becomes clear, she should be flogged (as the prescribed) punishment, but hurl no reproach at her. If she commits adultery again, she should (again be punished) by flogging, but hurl no reproach upon her. If she commits fornication for the third time and it becomes clear, then he should sell her, even if only for a rope of hair
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ الْبُرْسَانِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ، بْنُ زَيْدٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ أَنَّ ابْنَ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي جَلْدِ الأَمَةِ إِذَا زَنَتْ ثَلاَثًا ‏ "‏ ثُمَّ لْيَبِعْهَا فِي الرَّابِعَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin albursaaniyyu, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu hassaana, kilaahumaa 'an aayyuwba bni muwsaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, waabnu, numayrin 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, h wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy ausaamaau, bnu zaydin h wahaddathanaa hannaadu bnu alssariyyi, waaabuw kuraybin waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma 'an 'abdaaa bni sulaymaana, 'an muhammadi bni iishaaqa, kullu hauulaa'i 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaa aanna abna iishaaqa qaala fiy hadiythihi 'an sa'iydin 'an aabiyhi 'an aabiy hurayraaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy jaldi alaamaai iidhaa zanat thalaathana ‏ "‏ thumma lyabi'haa fiy alrraabi'aai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith his been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنِ الأَمَةِ إِذَا زَنَتْ وَلَمْ تُحْصِنْ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا ثُمَّ إِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا ثُمَّ إِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا ثُمَّ بِيعُوهَا وَلَوْ بِضَفِيرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ لاَ أَدْرِي أَبَعْدَ الثَّالِثَةِ أَوِ الرَّابِعَةِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَالضَّفِيرُ الْحَبْلُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa alqa'nabiyyu, haddathanaa maalikun, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi 'an aabiy hurayraaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm suiila 'ani alaamaai iidhaa zanat walam tuhsin qaala ‏ "‏ iin zanat faajliduwhaa thumma iin zanat faajliduwhaa thumma iin zanat faajliduwhaa thumma biy'uwhaa walaw bidafiyrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin laa aadriy aaba'da althhaalithaai aawi alrraabi'aai ‏.‏ waqaala alqa'nabiyyu fiy riwaayatihi qaala abnu shihaabin waalddafiyru alhablu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the slave-woman who committed adultery and was not protected (married). He said:If she commits adultery, then flog her and if she commits adultery again, then flog her and then sell her even for a rope. Ibn Shihab said: I do not know whether he said this (his statement pertaining to the sale of slave-woman) at the third or the fourth time. Ibn Shihab said that the word dafir (used in the text) means rope
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنِ الأَمَةِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمَا وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قَوْلَ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ وَالضَّفِيرُ الْحَبْلُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, qaala sami'tu maalikana, yaquwlu haddathaniy abnu shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, wazaydi bni khaalidin aljuhaniyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm suiila 'ani alaamaai ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythihimaa walam yadhkur qawla abni shihaabin waalddafiyru alhablu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira and Zaid b. Khalid al-Jubani, but in this no merition is made of the words of Ibn Shihab that dafir means rope
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ وَالشَّكُّ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا جَمِيعًا فِي بَيْعِهَا فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَوِ الرَّابِعَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an saalihin, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi, alllahi 'an aabiy hurayraaa, wazaydi bni khaalidin aljuhaniyyi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi maalikin waalshhakku fiy hadiythihimaa jamiy'ana fiy bay'ihaa fiy althhaalithaai aawi alrraabi'aai ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira and Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani in the same way as transmitted by Malik with this (difference) tnat there is a doubt whether her sale (that of the slave-girl committing adultery) was mentioned after the third or the fourth time
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ خَطَبَ عَلِيٌّ فَقَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَقِيمُوا عَلَى أَرِقَّائِكُمُ الْحَدَّ مَنْ أَحْصَنَ مِنْهُمْ وَمَنْ لَمْ يُحْصِنْ فَإِنَّ أَمَةً لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَنَتْ فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَجْلِدَهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَدِيثُ عَهْدٍ بِنِفَاسٍ فَخَشِيتُ إِنْ أَنَا جَلَدْتُهَا أَنْ أَقْتُلَهَا فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَحْسَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, haddathanaa sulaymaanu aabuw daawuda, haddathanaa zaaiidaau, 'ani alssuddiyyi, 'an sa'di bni 'ubaydaaa, 'an aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala khataba 'aliyyun faqaala yaa aayyuhaa alnnaasu aaqiymuwa 'alaa aariqqaaiikumu alhadda man aahsana minhum waman lam yuhsin faiinna aamaaan lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm zanat faaamaraniy aan aajlidahaa faiidhaa hiya hadiythu 'ahdin binifaasin fakhashiytu iin aanaa jaladtuhaa aan aaqtulahaa fadhakartu dhalika lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ aahsanta ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman reported that 'Ali, while delivering the address said:O people, impose the prescribed punishment upon your slaves, those who are married and those not married, for a slave-woman belonging to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had committed adultery, and he committed me to flog her. But she had recently given birth to a child and I was afraid that if I flogged her I might kill her. So I mentioned that to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he said: You have done well
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَنْ أَحْصَنَ مِنْهُمْ وَمَنْ لَمْ يُحْصِنْ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ ‏ "‏ اتْرُكْهَا حَتَّى تَمَاثَلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'ani alssuddiyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkur man aahsana minhum waman lam yuhsin ‏.‏ wazaada fiy alhadiythi ‏ "‏ atrukhaa hattaa tamaathala ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of as-Suddi with the same chain of trznsmitters, but he did not mention:" Those who are married and those who are not married." There is also an addition in it:" I spare her until she is all right
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِرَجُلٍ قَدْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ فَجَلَدَهُ بِجَرِيدَتَيْنِ نَحْوَ أَرْبَعِينَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَفَعَلَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَلَمَّا كَانَ عُمَرُ اسْتَشَارَ النَّاسَ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ أَخَفَّ الْحُدُودِ ثَمَانِينَ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ عُمَرُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm autiya birajulin qad shariba alkhamra fajaladahu bijariydatayni nahwa aarba'iyna ‏.‏ qaala wafa'alahu aabuw bakrin falammaa kaana 'umaru astashaara alnnaasa faqaala 'abdu alrrahmani aakhaffa alhuduwdi thamaaniyna ‏.‏ faaamara bihi 'umaru ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that a person who had drink wine was brought to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He gave him forty stripes with two lashes. Abu Bakr also did that, but when Umar (assumed the responsibilities) of the Caliphate, he consulted people and Abd al-Rahman said:The mildest punishment (for drinking) is eighty (stripes) and 'Umar their prescribed this punishment
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَجُلٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna alhaarithi - haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa qataadaau, qaala sami'tu aanasana, yaquwlu autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm birajulin ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ، بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَلَدَ فِي الْخَمْرِ بِالْجَرِيدِ وَالنِّعَالِ ثُمَّ جَلَدَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَرْبَعِينَ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا كَانَ عُمَرُ وَدَنَا النَّاسُ مِنَ الرِّيفِ وَالْقُرَى قَالَ مَا تَرَوْنَ فِي جَلْدِ الْخَمْرِ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ أَرَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَهَا كَأَخَفِّ الْحُدُودِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَلَدَ عُمَرُ ثَمَانِينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi, bni maalikin aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jalada fiy alkhamri bialjariydi waalnni'aali thumma jalada aabuw bakrin aarba'iyna ‏.‏ falammaa kaana 'umaru wadanaa alnnaasu mina alrriyfi waalquraa qaala maa tarawna fiy jaldi alkhamri faqaala 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'awfin aaraa aan taj'alahaa kaaakhaffi alhuduwdi ‏.‏ qaala fajalada 'umaru thamaaniyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) gave a beating with palm branches and shoes, and that Abu Bakr gave forty lashes. When Umar (became the Commander of the Faithful) and the people went near to pastures and towns, he said (to the Companions of the Holy Prophet). What is your opinion about lashing for drinking? Thereupon Abd al-Rahman b. Auf said:My opinion is that you fix it as the mildest punishment. Then 'Umar inflicted eighty stripes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hishaamun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّوسلم كَانَ يَضْرِبُ فِي الْخَمْرِ بِالنِّعَالِ وَالْجَرِيدِ أَرْبَعِينَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمَا وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الرِّيفَ وَالْقُرَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an hishaamin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, aannawslm kaana yadribu fiy alkhamri bialnni'aali waaljariydi aarba'iyna ‏.‏ thumma dhakara nahwa hadiythihimaa walam yadhkuri alrriyfa waalquraa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to strike forty times with shoes and palm branches (in case of drinking of) wine. The rest of the hadith is the same and there is no mention of pastures and towns
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الدَّانَاجِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ فَيْرُوزَ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَامِرٍ الدَّانَاجِ حَدَّثَنَا حُضَيْنُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ أَبُو سَاسَانَ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ وَأُتِيَ بِالْوَلِيدِ قَدْ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَزِيدُكُمْ فَشَهِدَ عَلَيْهِ رَجُلاَنِ أَحَدُهُمَا حُمْرَانُ أَنَّهُ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ وَشَهِدَ آخَرُ أَنَّهُ رَآهُ يَتَقَيَّأُ فَقَالَ عُثْمَانُ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَتَقَيَّأْ حَتَّى شَرِبَهَا فَقَالَ يَا عَلِيُّ قُمْ فَاجْلِدْهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ قُمْ يَا حَسَنُ فَاجْلِدْهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ وَلِّ حَارَّهَا مَنْ تَوَلَّى قَارَّهَا - فَكَأَنَّهُ وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ - فَقَالَ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ قُمْ فَاجْلِدْهُ ‏.‏ فَجَلَدَهُ وَعَلِيٌّ يَعُدُّ حَتَّى بَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ فَقَالَ أَمْسِكْ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ جَلَدَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْبَعِينَ وَجَلَدَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَرْبَعِينَ وَعُمَرُ ثَمَانِينَ وَكُلٌّ سُنَّةٌ وَهَذَا أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ ‏.‏ زَادَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ قَالَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ حَدِيثَ الدَّانَاجِ مِنْهُ فَلَمْ أَحْفَظْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu 'ulayyaaa - 'ani abni aabiy 'aruwbaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi alddaanaaji, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu hammaadin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu almukhtaari, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu fayruwza, mawlaa abni 'aamirin alddaanaaji haddathanaa hudaynu bnu almundhiri aabuw saasaana, qaala shahidtu 'uthmaana bna 'affaana waautiya bialwaliydi qad sallaa alssubha rak'atayni thumma qaala aaziydukum fashahida 'alayhi rajulaani aahaduhumaa humraanu aannahu shariba alkhamra washahida akharu aannahu raahu yataqayyaau faqaala 'uthmaanu iinnahu lam yataqayyaa hattaa sharibahaa faqaala yaa 'aliyyu qum faajlidhu ‏.‏ faqaala 'aliyyun qum yaa hasanu faajlidhu ‏.‏ faqaala alhasanu walli haarrahaa man tawallaa qaarrahaa - fakaaannahu wajada 'alayhi - faqaala yaa 'abda alllahi bna ja'farin qum faajlidhu ‏.‏ fajaladahu wa'aliyyun ya'uddu hattaa balagha aarba'iyna faqaala aamsik ‏.‏ thumma qaala jalada alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aarba'iyna wajalada aabuw bakrin aarba'iyna wa'umaru thamaaniyna wakullun sunnaaun wahadhaa aahabbu iilaaaa ‏.‏ zaada 'aliyyu bnu hujrin fiy riwaayatihi qaala iismaa'iylu waqad sami'tu hadiytha alddaanaaji minhu falam aahfazhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudain b. al-Mundhir Abu Sasan reported:I saw that Walid was brought to Uthmin b. 'Affan as he had prayed two rak'ahs of the dawn prayer, and then he said: I make an increase for you. And two men bore witness against him. One of them was Humran who said that he had drunk wine. The second one gave witness that he had seen him vomiting. Uthman said: He would not have vomited (wine) unless he had drunk it. He said: 'Ali, stand up and lash him. 'Ali said: Hasan, stand up and lash him. Thereupon Hasan said: Let him suffer the heat (of Caliphate) who has enjoyed its coolness. ('Ali felt annoyed at this remark) and he said: 'Abdullah b. Ja'far, stand up and flog him, and he began to flog him and 'Ali counted the stripes until these were forty. He (Hadrat 'Ali) said: Stop now, and then said: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) gave forty stripes, and Abu Bakr also gave forty stripes, and Umar gave eighty stripes, and all these fall under the category of the Sunnab, but this one (forty stripes) is dearer to me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ الضَّرِيرُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ عُمَيْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ مَا كُنْتُ أُقِيمُ عَلَى أَحَدٍ حَدًّا فَيَمُوتَ فِيهِ فَأَجِدَ مِنْهُ فِي نَفْسِي إِلاَّ صَاحِبَ الْخَمْرِ لأَنَّهُ إِنْ مَاتَ وَدَيْتُهُ لأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَسُنَّهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu minhaalin alddariyru, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa sufyaanu althhawriyyu, 'an aabiy hasiynin, 'an 'umayri bni sa'iydin, 'an 'aliyyin, qaala maa kuntu auqiymu 'alaa aahadin haddana fayamuwta fiyhi faaajida minhu fiy nafsiy iilaaa saahiba alkhamri laannahu iin maata wadaytuhu laanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lam yasunnahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali reported:If I impose Hadd on anyone, and he (in course of punish ment) dies, I would not mind except in case of a drunkard. If he dies. I would pay indemnity for him because the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has laid down no rule for it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, haddathanaa sufyaanu, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Sufyan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، قَالَ بَيْنَا نَحْنُ عِنْدَ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ إِذْ جَاءَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ جَابِرٍ فَحَدَّثَهُ فَأَقْبَلَ، عَلَيْنَا سُلَيْمَانُ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يُجْلَدُ أَحَدٌ فَوْقَ عَشَرَةِ أَسْوَاطٍ إِلاَّ فِي حَدٍّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'iysaa, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, 'an bukayri bni alaashajji, qaala baynaa nahnu 'inda sulaymaana bni yasaarin iidh jaa'ahu 'abdu alrrahmani bnu jaabirin fahaddathahu faaaqbala, 'alaynaa sulaymaanu faqaala haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu jaabirin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy burdaaa alaansaariyyi, aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yujladu aahadun fawqa 'asharaai aaswaatin iilaaa fiy haddin min huduwdi alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Barda Ansari reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:None should be given more than ten lashes, but in case of any Hadd out of the Huded of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَمْرٍو قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَجْلِسٍ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ تُبَايِعُونِي عَلَى أَنْ لاَ تُشْرِكُوا بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَلاَ تَزْنُوا وَلاَ تَسْرِقُوا وَلاَ تَقْتُلُوا النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ فَمَنْ وَفَى مِنْكُمْ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَمَنْ أَصَابَ شَيْئًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَعُوقِبَ بِهِ فَهُوَ كَفَّارَةٌ لَهُ وَمَنْ أَصَابَ شَيْئًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَسَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فَأَمْرُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنْ شَاءَ عَفَا عَنْهُ وَإِنْ شَاءَ عَذَّبَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma waabnu numayrin kulluhum 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, - waalllafzu li'amrinw qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy iidriysa, 'an 'ubaadaaa bni alssaamiti, qaala kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy majlisin faqaala ‏ "‏ tubaayi'uwniy 'alaa aan laa tushrikuwa bialllahi shayiana walaa taznuwa walaa tasriquwa walaa taqtuluwa alnnafsa allatiy harrama alllahu iilaaa bialhaqqi faman wafaa minkum faaajruhu 'alaa alllahi waman aasaaba shayiana min dhalika fa'uwqiba bihi fahuwa kaffaaraaun lahu waman aasaaba shayiana min dhalika fasatarahu alllahu 'alayhi faaamruhu iilaa alllahi iin shaa'a 'afaa 'anhu waiin shaa'a 'adhhabahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubida b. as-Samit reported:While we were in the company of Allah's Messenger (may peace be upoi him) he said: Swear allegiance to me that you will not associate anything with Allah, that you will not commit adultery, that you will not steal, that you will not take any life which it is forbidden by Allah to take but with (legal) justification; and whoever among you fulfils it, his reward is with Allah and he who commits any such thing and is punished for it, that will be all atonement for it And if anyone commits anything and Allah conceals (his faultfls), his matter rests with Allah. He may forgive if He likes, and He may punish him if He likes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ فَتَلاَ عَلَيْنَا آيَةَ النِّسَاءِ ‏{‏ أَنْ لاَ يُشْرِكْنَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا‏}‏ الآيَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wazaada fiy alhadiythi fatalaa 'alaynaa ayaaa alnnisaa'i ‏{‏ aan laa yushrikna bialllahi shayiana‏}‏ alayaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters with this addition:" He recited to us the verse pertaining to women, viz, that they will not associate anything with Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَشْعَثِ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ أَخَذَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَمَا أَخَذَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ أَنْ لاَ نُشْرِكَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَلاَ نَسْرِقَ وَلاَ نَزْنِيَ وَلاَ نَقْتُلَ أَوْلاَدَنَا وَلاَ يَعْضَهَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا ‏ "‏ فَمَنْ وَفَى مِنْكُمْ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَمَنْ أَتَى مِنْكُمْ حَدًّا فَأُقِيمَ عَلَيْهِ فَهُوَ كَفَّارَتُهُ وَمَنْ سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فَأَمْرُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنْ شَاءَ عَذَّبَهُ وَإِنْ شَاءَ غَفَرَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iismaa'iylu bnu saalimin, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa khaalidun, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aabiy alaash'athi alssan'aaniyyi, 'an 'ubaadaaa bni alssaamiti, qaala aakhadha 'alaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kamaa aakhadha 'alaa alnnisaa'i aan laa nushrika bialllahi shayiana walaa nasriqa walaa nazniya walaa naqtula aawlaadanaa walaa ya'daha ba'dunaa ba'dana ‏ "‏ faman wafaa minkum faaajruhu 'alaa alllahi waman aataa minkum haddana faauqiyma 'alayhi fahuwa kaffaaratuhu waman satarahu alllahu 'alayhi faaamruhu iilaa alllahi iin shaa'a 'adhhabahu waiin shaa'a ghafara lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubida b. as-Samit reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took (a pledge) from us as he took from the women that we will not associate anything with Allah and we will not steal, and we will not commit adultery, and we will not kill our children, and we will not bring calumny upon one another. And he who amongst you fulfils (this pledge), his reward rests with Allah, and he upon whom amongst you is imposed the prescribed punishment and that is carried out, that is his expiation (for that sin), and he whose (sins) were covered by Allah, his matter rests with Allah. He may punish him if He likes or may forgive him if He so likes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنِ الصُّنَابِحِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِنِّي لَمِنَ النُّقَبَاءِ الَّذِينَ بَايَعُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ بَايَعْنَاهُ عَلَى أَنْ لاَ نُشْرِكَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَلاَ نَزْنِيَ وَلاَ نَسْرِقَ وَلاَ نَقْتُلَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ وَلاَ نَنْتَهِبَ وَلاَ نَعْصِيَ فَالْجَنَّةُ إِنْ فَعَلْنَا ذَلِكَ فَإِنْ غَشِينَا مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا كَانَ قَضَاءُ ذَلِكَ إِلَى اللَّهِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ رُمْحٍ كَانَ قَضَاؤُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an aabiy alkhayri, 'ani alssunaabihiyyi, 'an 'ubaadaaa bni alssaamiti, aannahu qaala iinniy lamina alnnuqabaa'i alladhiyna baaya'uwa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala baaya'naahu 'alaa aan laa nushrika bialllahi shayiana walaa nazniya walaa nasriqa walaa naqtula alnnafsa allatiy harrama alllahu iilaaa bialhaqqi walaa nantahiba walaa na'siya faaljannaau iin fa'alnaa dhalika faiin ghashiynaa min dhalika shayiana kaana qadaa'u dhalika iilaa alllahi ‏.‏ waqaala abnu rumhin kaana qadaauuhu iilaa alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubida b. as-Samit repnrted:I was one of those headmen who swore allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that we will not associate anything with Allah, and will not commit adultery, and will not steal, and will not kill any soul which Allah has forbidden, but with justice nor plunder, nor disobey (Allah and His Apostle), then Paradise (will be the reward) in case we do these (acts) ; and if we commit any outrage (and that goes unpunished in the world), it is Allah Who would decide about it. Ibn Rumh said: Its judgment lies with Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ، سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْعَجْمَاءُ جَرْحُهَا جُبَارٌ وَالْبِئْرُ جُبَارٌ وَالْمَعْدِنُ جُبَارٌ وَفِي الرِّكَازِ الْخُمْسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu, sa'iydin haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, waaabiy, salamaaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ al'ajmaa'u jarhuhaa jubaarun waalbiiru jubaarun waalma'dinu jubaarun wafiy alrrikaazi alkhumsu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:No requital is payable for a wound caused by an animal, for (falling into) a well and a mine, and one-fifth (is the share of the government) in the buried treasure (treasure-trove)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَعَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عِيسَى - حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِإِسْنَادِ اللَّيْثِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wazuhayru bnu harbin wa'abdu alaa'laa bnu hammaadin kulluhum 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa iishaaqu, - ya'niy abna 'iysaa - haddathanaa maalikun, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, biiisnaadi alllaythi ‏.‏ mithla hadiythihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni, shihaabin 'ani abni almusayyabi, wa'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، بْنِ الْعَلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْبِئْرُ جَرْحُهَا جُبَارٌ وَالْمَعْدِنُ جَرْحُهُ جُبَارٌ وَالْعَجْمَاءُ جَرْحُهَا جُبَارٌ وَفِي الرِّكَازِ الْخُمْسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an aayyuwba bni muwsaa, 'ani alaaswadi, bni al'alaa'i 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ albiiru jarhuhaa jubaarun waalma'dinu jarhuhu jubaarun waal'ajmaa'u jarhuhaa jubaarun wafiy alrrikaazi alkhumsu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The wound caused (by falling) in the well, in the mine, and caused bv the animal has no requital for it; and there is one-fifth (for the government) in the buried treasure
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 29 — The Book of Legal Punishments
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَلاَّمٍ الْجُمَحِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الرَّبِيعُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُسْلِمٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu salaaamin aljumahiyyu, haddathanaa alrrabiy'u ya'niy abna muslimin, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa abnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, kilaahumaa 'an muhammadi bni ziyaadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْ يُعْطَى النَّاسُ بِدَعْوَاهُمْ لاَدَّعَى نَاسٌ دِمَاءَ رِجَالٍ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ وَلَكِنَّ الْيَمِينَ عَلَى الْمُدَّعَى عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amriw bni sarhin aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ law yu'taa alnnaasu bida'waahum laadda'aa naasun dimaa'a rijaalin waaamwaalahum walakinna alyamiyna 'alaa almudda'aa 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:If the people were given according to their claims, they would claim the lives of persons and their properties, but the oath must be taken by the defendant
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ ابْنِ، أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَضَى بِالْيَمِينِ عَلَى الْمُدَّعَى عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, 'an naafi'i bni 'umara, 'ani abni, aabiy mulaykaaa 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qadaa bialyamiyni 'alaa almudda'aa 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pronounced judgment on the basis of oath by the defendant
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ حُبَابٍ - حَدَّثَنِي سَيْفُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، أَخْبَرَنِي قَيْسُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَضَى بِيَمِينٍ وَشَاهِدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, qaalaa haddathanaa zaydun, - wahuwa abnu hubaabin - haddathaniy sayfu bnu sulaymaana, aakhbaraniy qaysu bnu sa'din, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qadaa biyamiynin washaahidin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pronounced judgment on the basis of an oath and a witness (by the plaintiff)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمِعَ جَلَبَةَ خَصْمٍ بِبَابِ حُجْرَتِهِ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ وَإِنَّهُ يَأْتِينِي الْخَصْمُ فَلَعَلَّ بَعْضَهُمْ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَبْلَغَ مِنْ بَعْضٍ فَأَحْسِبُ أَنَّهُ صَادِقٌ فَأَقْضِي لَهُ فَمَنْ قَضَيْتُ لَهُ بِحَقِّ مُسْلِمٍ فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ قِطْعَةٌ مِنَ النَّارِ فَلْيَحْمِلْهَا أَوْ يَذَرْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni, shihaabin aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, 'an zaynaba binti aabiy salamaaa, 'an aummi salamaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sami'a jalabaaa khasmin bibaabi hujratihi fakharaja iilayhim faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa aanaa basharun waiinnahu yaatiyniy alkhasmu fala'alla ba'dahum aan yakuwna aablagha min ba'din faaahsibu aannahu saadiqun faaaqdiy lahu faman qadaytu lahu bihaqqi muslimin faiinnamaa hiya qit'aaun mina alnnaari falyahmilhaa aaw yadharhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard the clamour of contenders at the door of his apartment. He went to them, and said:I am a human being and the claimants bring to me (the dispute) and perhaps some of them are more eloquent than the others. I judge him to be on the right, and thus decide in his favcur. So he whom I, by my judgment, (give the undue share) out of the right of a Muslim,. I give him a portion of Fire; he may burden himself with it or abandon it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ قَالَتْ سَمِعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَجَبَةَ خَصْمٍ بِبَابِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ ‏.‏
