verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwa hadiythi yuwnusa ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi ma'marin qaalat sami'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm lajabaaa khasmin bibaabi aummi salamaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ma'mar with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ إِلَىَّ وَلَعَلَّ بَعْضَكُمْ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَلْحَنَ بِحُجَّتِهِ مِنْ بَعْضٍ فَأَقْضِي لَهُ عَلَى نَحْوٍ مِمَّا أَسْمَعُ مِنْهُ فَمَنْ قَطَعْتُ لَهُ مِنْ حَقِّ أَخِيهِ شَيْئًا فَلاَ يَأْخُذْهُ فَإِنَّمَا أَقْطَعُ لَهُ بِهِ قِطْعَةً مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an zaynaba binti aabiy salamaaa, 'an aummi salamaaa, qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinnakum takhtasimuwna iilaaaa wala'alla ba'dakum aan yakuwna aalhana bihujjatihi min ba'din faaaqdiy lahu 'alaa nahwin mimmaa aasma'u minhu faman qata'tu lahu min haqqi aakhiyhi shayiana falaa yaakhudhhu faiinnamaa aaqta'u lahu bihi qit'aaan mina alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Salama reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:You bring to me, for (judgment) your disputes, some of you perhaps being more eloquent in their plea than others, so I give judgment on their behalf according to what I hear from them. (Bear in mind, in my judgment) if I slice off anything for him from the right of his brother, he should not accept that, for I sliced off for him a portion from the Hell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu, numayrin kilaahumaa 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَتْ هِنْدٌ بِنْتُ عُتْبَةَ امْرَأَةُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ رَجُلٌ شَحِيحٌ لاَ يُعْطِينِي مِنَ النَّفَقَةِ مَا يَكْفِينِي وَيَكْفِي بَنِيَّ إِلاَّ مَا أَخَذْتُ مِنْ مَالِهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمِهِ ‏.‏ فَهَلْ عَلَىَّ فِي ذَلِكَ مِنْ جُنَاحٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خُذِي مِنْ مَالِهِ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ مَا يَكْفِيكِ وَيَكْفِي بَنِيكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat dakhalat hindun bintu 'utbaaa amraaaau aabiy sufyaana 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna aabaa sufyaana rajulun shahiyhun laa yu'tiyniy mina alnnafaqaai maa yakfiyniy wayakfiy baniyya iilaaa maa aakhadhtu min maalihi bighayri 'ilmihi ‏.‏ fahal 'alaaaa fiy dhalika min junaahin faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ khudhiy min maalihi bialma'ruwfi maa yakfiyki wayakfiy baniyki ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Hind. the daughter of 'Utba, wife of Abu Sufyan, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Abu Sufyan is a miserly person. He does not give adequate maintenance for me and my children, but (I am constrained) to take from his wealth (some part of it) without his knowledge. Is there any sin for me? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Take from his property what is customary which may suffice you and your children
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَوَكِيعٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُثْمَانَ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, waaabuw kuraybin kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, wawakiy'in h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku, - ya'niy abna 'uthmaana - kulluhum 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chair of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ جَاءَتْ هِنْدٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهِ مَا كَانَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الأَرْضِ أَهْلُ خِبَاءٍ أَحَبَّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ أَنْ يُذِلَّهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ خِبَائِكَ وَمَا عَلَى ظَهْرِ الأَرْضِ أَهْلُ خِبَاءٍ أَحَبَّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ أَنْ يُعِزَّهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ خِبَائِكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَأَيْضًا وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ رَجُلٌ مُمْسِكٌ فَهَلْ عَلَىَّ حَرَجٌ أَنْ أُنْفِقَ عَلَى عِيَالِهِ مِنْ مَالِهِ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ حَرَجَ عَلَيْكِ أَنْ تُنْفِقِي عَلَيْهِمْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat jaa'at hindun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi waalllahi maa kaana 'alaa zahri alaardi aahlu khibaa'in aahabba iilaaaa min aan yudhillahumu alllahu min aahli khibaaiika wamaa 'alaa zahri alaardi aahlu khibaa'in aahabba iilaaaa min aan yu'izzahumu alllahu min aahli khibaaiika ‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ waaaydana waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna aabaa sufyaana rajulun mumsikun fahal 'alaaaa harajun aan aunfiqa 'alaa 'iyaalihi min maalihi bighayri iidhnihi faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa haraja 'alayki aan tunfiqiy 'alayhim bialma'ruwfi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Hind came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said:Messenger of Allah, by Allah, there was no other household upon the surface of the earth than your household about which I cherished Allah bringing disgrace upon it, (and now) there is no other household upon the surface of the earth than your household about which I cherish Allah granting it honour. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: It is so, by Him in Whose Hand is my life She said: Allah's Messenger, Abu Sufyan is a niggardly person. Is there any harm for me if I spend upon his children out of his wealth without his permission? Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: There is no harm for you if you spend upon them what is reasonable
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَخِي الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ جَاءَتْ هِنْدٌ بِنْتُ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهِ مَا كَانَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الأَرْضِ خِبَاءٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ أَنْ يَذِلُّوا مِنْ أَهْلِ خِبَائِكَ وَمَا أَصْبَحَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الأَرْضِ خِبَاءٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ أَنْ يَعِزُّوا مِنْ أَهْلِ خِبَائِكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَأَيْضًا وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ رَجُلٌ مِسِّيكٌ فَهَلْ عَلَىَّ حَرَجٌ مِنْ أَنْ أُطْعِمَ مِنَ الَّذِي لَهُ عِيَالَنَا فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ لاَ إِلاَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa abnu aakhiy alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ammihi, aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, qaalat jaa'at hindun bintu 'utbaaa bni rabiy'aaa faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi waalllahi maa kaana 'alaa zahri alaardi khibaa'un aahabba iilaaaa min aan yadhilluwa min aahli khibaaiika wamaa aasbaha alyawma 'alaa zahri alaardi khibaa'un aahabba iilaaaa min aan ya'izzuwa min aahli khibaaiika ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ waaaydana waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna aabaa sufyaana rajulun missiykun fahal 'alaaaa harajun min aan aut'ima mina alladhiy lahu 'iyaalanaa faqaala lahaa ‏"‏ laa iilaaa bialma'ruwfi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Hind, daughter of Utba h. Rabi', came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:Allah's Messenger, by Allah, there was no household upon the surface of the earth than your household about which I cherished that it should be disgraced. But today there is no household on the surface of the earth than your household about which I cherish that it be honoured Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. It will increase, by Him in Whose Hand is my life. She then said: Messenger of Allah, Abu Sufyan is a niggardly person; is there any harm for me if I spend out of that which belongs to him on our children? He said to her: No, but only that what is reasonable
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَرْضَى لَكُمْ ثَلاَثًا وَيَكْرَهُ لَكُمْ ثَلاَثًا فَيَرْضَى لَكُمْ أَنْ تَعْبُدُوهُ وَلاَ تُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا وَأَنْ تَعْتَصِمُوا بِحَبْلِ اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا وَلاَ تَفَرَّقُوا وَيَكْرَهُ لَكُمْ قِيلَ وَقَالَ وَكَثْرَةَ السُّؤَالِ وَإِضَاعَةَ الْمَالِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha yardaa lakum thalaathana wayakrahu lakum thalaathana fayardaa lakum aan ta'buduwhu walaa tushrikuwa bihi shayiana waaan ta'tasimuwa bihabli alllahi jamiy'ana walaa tafarraquwa wayakrahu lakum qiyla waqaala wakathraaa alssuuaali waiidaa'aaa almaali ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Verily Allah likes three things for you and He disapproves three things for you. He is pleased with you that you worship Him and associate nor anything with Him, that you hold fast the rope of Allah, and be not scattered; and He disapproves for you irrelevant talk, persistent questioning ane the wasting of wealth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَيَسْخَطُ لَكُمْ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ وَلاَ تَفَرَّقُوا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an suhaylin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ghayra aannahu qaala wayaskhatu lakum thalaathana ‏.‏ walam yadhkur walaa tafarraquwa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ، مَوْلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ عُقُوقَ الأُمَّهَاتِ وَوَأْدَ الْبَنَاتِ وَمَنْعًا وَهَاتِ وَكَرِهَ لَكُمْ ثَلاَثًا قِيلَ وَقَالَ وَكَثْرَةَ السُّؤَالِ وَإِضَاعَةَ الْمَالِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an warraadin, mawlaa almughiyraai bni shu'baaa 'ani almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha 'azza wajalla harrama 'alaykum 'uquwqa alaummahaati wawaada albanaati waman'ana wahaati wakariha lakum thalaathana qiyla waqaala wakathraaa alssuuaali waiidaa'aaa almaali ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Verity Allah, the Glorious and Majestic, has forbidden for you: disobedience to mothers, and burying alive daughters, withholding the right of others in spite of having the power to return that to them and demanding that (which is not one's legitimate right). And He disapproved three things for you; irrelevant talk, persistent questioning and wasting of wealth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَحَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy alqaasimu bnu zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an shaybaana, 'an mansuwrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏ ghayra aannahu qaala waharrama 'alaykum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ walam yaqul iinna alllaha harrama 'alaykum ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been trransmitted on the authority of Mansur with a slight vairiation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَشْوَعَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي كَاتِبُ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ كَتَبَ مُعَاوِيَةُ إِلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ اكْتُبْ إِلَىَّ بِشَىْءٍ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَرِهَ لَكُمْ ثَلاَثًا قِيلَ وَقَالَ وَإِضَاعَةَ الْمَالِ وَكَثْرَةَ السُّؤَالِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an khaalidin alhadhhaa'i, haddathaniy abnu aashwa'a, 'ani alshha'biyyi, haddathaniy kaatibu almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, qaala kataba mu'aawiyaau iilaa almughiyraai aktub iilaaaa bishaa'in sami'tahu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fakataba iilayhi aanniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha kariha lakum thalaathana qiyla waqaala waiidaa'aaa almaali wakathraaa alssuuaali ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sha'bi reported that the scribe of al-Mughira b. Shu'ba said:Mu'awiya wrote to Mughira: Write for me something which you heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; and he wrote: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying. Verily Allah disapproves three thingq for you: irrelevant talk, wasting of wealth and persistent questioning
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ، قَالَ كَتَبَ الْمُغِيرَةُ إِلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ سَلاَمٌ عَلَيْكَ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ ثَلاَثًا وَنَهَى عَنْ ثَلاَثٍ حَرَّمَ عُقُوقَ الْوَالِدِ وَوَأْدَ الْبَنَاتِ وَلاَ وَهَاتِ ‏.‏ وَنَهَى عَنْ ثَلاَثٍ قِيلٍ وَقَالٍ وَكَثْرَةِ السُّؤَالِ وَإِضَاعَةِ الْمَالِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa marwaanu bnu mu'aawiyaaa alfazaariyyu, 'an muhammadi bni suwqaaa, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu 'ubaydi alllahi althhaqafiyyu, 'an warraadin, qaala kataba almughiyraau iilaa mu'aawiyaaa salaamun 'alayka aammaa ba'du faiinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha harrama thalaathana wanahaa 'an thalaathin harrama 'uquwqa alwaalidi wawaada albanaati walaa wahaati ‏.‏ wanahaa 'an thalaathin qiylin waqaalin wakathraai alssuuaali waiidaa'aai almaali ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Warrad reported that al-Mughira wrote to Mu'awiya:Peace be upon you, and then coming to the poirt (I should say) that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily Allah has Prohibited three things and has forbidden three things. He has declared absolutely haram the disobedience of father, burying of daughters alive, and withholding that which you have power to return, and has forbidden three things: irrelevant talk, persistent questioning, and wasting of wealth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ الْهَادِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَيْسٍ، مَوْلَى عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا حَكَمَ الْحَاكِمُ فَاجْتَهَدَ ثُمَّ أَصَابَ فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا حَكَمَ فَاجْتَهَدَ ثُمَّ أَخْطَأَ فَلَهُ أَجْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin, 'an yaziyda bni 'abdi, alllahi bni ausaamaaa bni alhaadi 'an muhammadi bni iibraahiyma, 'an busri bni sa'iydin, 'an aabiy qaysin, mawlaa 'amriw bni al'aasi 'an 'amriw bni al'aasi, aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa hakama alhaakimu faajtahada thumma aasaaba falahu aajraani ‏.‏ waiidhaa hakama faajtahada thumma aakhtaaa falahu aajrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amr b. al-'As reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When a judge gives a decision, having tried his best to decide correctly and is right, there are two rewards for him; and if he gave a judgment after having tried his best (to arrive at a correct decision) but erred, there is one reward for him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ، مُحَمَّدٍ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ وَزَادَ فِي عَقِبِ الْحَدِيثِ قَالَ يَزِيدُ فَحَدَّثْتُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ فَقَالَ هَكَذَا حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu aabiy 'umara, kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni, muhammadin bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu wazaada fiy 'aqibi alhadiythi qaala yaziydu fahaddathtu hadhaa alhadiytha aabaa bakri bna muhammadi bni 'amriw bni hazmin faqaala hakadhaa haddathaniy aabuw salamaaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira with another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ الدِّمَشْقِيَّ - حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ الْهَادِ اللَّيْثِيُّ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ مِثْلَ رِوَايَةِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ بِالإِسْنَادَيْنِ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa marwaanu, - ya'niy abna muhammadin alddimashqiyya - haddathanaa alllaythu bnu sa'din, haddathaniy yaziydu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni ausaamaaa bni alhaadi alllaythiyyu, bihadhaa alhadiythi mithla riwaayaai 'abdi al'aziyzi bni muhammadin bialiisnaadayni jamiy'ana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Usama b. al-Had al-Laithi
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ كَتَبَ أَبِي - وَكَتَبْتُ لَهُ - إِلَى عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ وَهُوَ قَاضٍ بِسِجِسْتَانَ أَنْ لاَ، تَحْكُمَ بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَنْتَ غَضْبَانُ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَحْكُمْ أَحَدٌ بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ وَهُوَ غَضْبَانُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, bni aabiy bakraaa ‏.‏ qaala kataba aabiy - wakatabtu lahu - iilaa 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy bakraaa wahuwa qaadin bisijistaana aan laa, tahkuma bayna athnayni waaanta ghadbaanu faiinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yahkum aahadun bayna athnayni wahuwa ghadbaanu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakra reported:My father dictated (and I wrote for him) to Ubaidullah b. Abu Bakra while he was the judge of Sijistan: Do not judge between two persons when you are angry, for I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None of you should judge between two persons when he is angry
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي كِلاَهُمَا، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, h wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu, bnu almuthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy kilaahumaa, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa husaynu bnu 'aliyyin, 'an zaaiidaaa, kullu hauulaa'i 'an 'abdi almaliki, bni 'umayrin 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy bakraaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi aabiy 'awaanaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakra through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَوْنٍ الْهِلاَلِيُّ جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ ابْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَحْدَثَ فِي أَمْرِنَا هَذَا مَا لَيْسَ مِنْهُ فَهُوَ رَدٌّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ja'farin, muhammadu bnu alssabbaahi wa'abdu alllahi bnu 'awnin alhilaaliyyu jamiy'ana 'an iibraahiyma, bni sa'din qaala abnu alssabbaahi haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'di bni iibraahiyma bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, haddathanaa aabiy, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man aahdatha fiy aamrinaa hadhaa maa laysa minhu fahuwa raddun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who innovates things in our affairs for which there is no valid (reason) (commits sin) and these are to be rejected
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي عَامِرٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ، لَهُ ثَلاَثَةُ مَسَاكِنَ فَأَوْصَى بِثُلُثِ كُلِّ مَسْكَنٍ مِنْهَا قَالَ يُجْمَعُ ذَلِكَ كُلُّهُ فِي مَسْكَنٍ وَاحِدٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ عَمِلَ عَمَلاً لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْرُنَا فَهُوَ رَدٌّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, jamiy'ana 'an aabiy 'aamirin, qaala 'abdun haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu 'amrinw, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu ja'farin alzzuhriyyu, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, qaala saaaltu alqaasima bna muhammadin 'an rajulin, lahu thalaathaau masaakina faaawsaa bithuluthi kulli maskanin minhaa qaala yujma'u dhalika kulluhu fiy maskanin waahidin thumma qaala aakhbaratniy 'aaiishaau aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man 'amila 'amalaan laysa 'alayhi aamrunaa fahuwa raddun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'd b. Ibrahim reported:I asked Qasim b. Muhammad about a person who had three dwelling houses and he willed away the third part of every one of these houses; he (Qasim b. Muhammad) said: All of them could be combined in one house; and then said: 'A'isha informed me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who did any act for which there is no sanction from our behalf, that is to be rejected
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، الْجُهَنِيِّ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِخَيْرِ الشُّهَدَاءِ الَّذِي يَأْتِي بِشَهَادَتِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسْأَلَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amriw bni 'uthmaana, 'ani abni aabiy 'amraaa alaansaariyyi, 'an zaydi bni khaalidin, aljuhaniyyi aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aalaa aukhbirukum bikhayri alshhuhadaa'i alladhiy yaatiy bishahaadatihi qabla aan yusaalahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Should I not tell you of the best witnesses? He is the one who produces his evidence before he is asked for it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ بَيْنَمَا امْرَأَتَانِ مَعَهُمَا ابْنَاهُمَا جَاءَ الذِّئْبُ فَذَهَبَ بِابْنِ إِحْدَاهُمَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ هَذِهِ لِصَاحِبَتِهَا إِنَّمَا ذَهَبَ بِابْنِكِ أَنْتِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَتِ الأُخْرَى إِنَّمَا ذَهَبَ بِابْنِكِ ‏.‏ فَتَحَاكَمَتَا إِلَى دَاوُدَ فَقَضَى بِهِ لِلْكُبْرَى فَخَرَجَتَا عَلَى سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ فَأَخْبَرَتَاهُ فَقَالَ ائْتُونِي بِالسِّكِّينِ أَشُقُّهُ بَيْنَكُمَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَتِ الصُّغْرَى لاَ يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ هُوَ ابْنُهَا ‏.‏ فَقَضَى بِهِ لِلصُّغْرَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ وَاللَّهِ إِنْ سَمِعْتُ بِالسِّكِّينِ قَطُّ إِلاَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ مَا كُنَّا نَقُولُ إِلاَّ الْمُدْيَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathaniy shabaabaau, haddathaniy warqaa'u, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ baynamaa amraaataani ma'ahumaa abnaahumaa jaa'a aldhhiibu fadhahaba biabni iihdaahumaa ‏.‏ faqaalat hadhihi lisaahibatihaa iinnamaa dhahaba biabniki aanti ‏.‏ waqaalati alaukhraa iinnamaa dhahaba biabniki ‏.‏ fatahaakamataa iilaa daawuda faqadaa bihi lilkubraa fakharajataa 'alaa sulaymaana bni daawuda 'alayhimaa alssalaamu faaakhbarataahu faqaala aituwniy bialssikkiyni aashuqquhu baynakumaa ‏.‏ faqaalati alssughraa laa yarhamuka alllahu huwa abnuhaa ‏.‏ faqadaa bihi lilssughraa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qaala aabuw hurayraaa waalllahi iin sami'tu bialssikkiyni qattu iilaaa yawmaiidhin maa kunnaa naquwlu iilaaa almudyaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:While two women had been going along witn their two sons, a wolf came and made away with the child of one of them. One of them said to her companion: It is with your child that it (the wolf) has run away The other one said: It has run away with your child. They brought the matter to (Hadrat) Dawud (David) for decision and he made a decision in favour of the elder one. They then went to Sulaiman b. Dawud (may there be peace upon both of them) and told them (the story). He said: Bring me a knife so that I may cut him (the child) (into two parts) for you. The younger one said: No, it can't be, may Allah have mercy upon you, he (the child) belongs to her (the elder). So he gave a decision in favour of the younger one. abu Huraira said: If ever I heard of the word as-sikin at all, it was that day. We called it by no other name but al-Mudya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حَفْصٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَيْسَرَةَ الصَّنْعَانِيَّ - عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَ مَعْنَى حَدِيثِ وَرْقَاءَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathaniy hafsun, - ya'niy abna maysaraaa alssan'aaniyya - 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, h wahaddathanaa aumayyaau bnu bistaama, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa rawhun, - wahuwa abnu alqaasimi - 'an muhammadi bni 'ajlaana, jamiy'ana 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithla ma'naa hadiythi warqaa'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu az-Zinad with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 30 — The Book of Judicial Decisions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اشْتَرَى رَجُلٌ مِنْ رَجُلٍ عَقَارًا لَهُ فَوَجَدَ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي اشْتَرَى الْعَقَارَ فِي عَقَارِهِ جَرَّةً فِيهَا ذَهَبٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ الَّذِي اشْتَرَى الْعَقَارَ خُذْ ذَهَبَكَ مِنِّي إِنَّمَا اشْتَرَيْتُ مِنْكَ الأَرْضَ وَلَمْ أَبْتَعْ مِنْكَ الذَّهَبَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الَّذِي شَرَى الأَرْضَ إِنَّمَا بِعْتُكَ الأَرْضَ وَمَا فِيهَا - قَالَ - فَتَحَاكَمَا إِلَى رَجُلٍ فَقَالَ الَّذِي تَحَاكَمَا إِلَيْهِ أَلَكُمَا وَلَدٌ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا لِي غُلاَمٌ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ لِي جَارِيَةٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنْكِحُوا الْغُلاَمَ الْجَارِيَةَ وَأَنْفِقُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمَا مِنْهُ وَتَصَدَّقَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ashtaraa rajulun min rajulin 'aqaarana lahu fawajada alrrajulu alladhiy ashtaraa al'aqaara fiy 'aqaarihi jarraaan fiyhaa dhahabun faqaala lahu alladhiy ashtaraa al'aqaara khudh dhahabaka minniy iinnamaa ashtaraytu minka alaarda walam aabta' minka aldhhahaba ‏.‏ faqaala alladhiy sharaa alaarda iinnamaa bi'tuka alaarda wamaa fiyhaa - qaala - fatahaakamaa iilaa rajulin faqaala alladhiy tahaakamaa iilayhi aalakumaa waladun faqaala aahaduhumaa liy ghulaamun waqaala alakharu liy jaariyaaun ‏.‏ qaala aankihuwa alghulaama aljaariyaaa waaanfiquwa 'alaa aanfusikumaa minhu watasaddaqaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammim b. Munabbih said:Abu Huraira reported (so many) ahadith of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and one of them is this: A person bought from another person a piece of land, and the person who had, bought that land found in it an earthen ware which contained gold. The person who had bought the land said (to the seller of the land): Take your gold from me, for I bought only the land from you and not the gold. The man who had sold the land said: I sold the land to you and whatever was in it. They referred the matter to a person. One who was made as a judge said to them: Have you any issue? One of them said: I have a boy, and the other said: I have a young daughter He (the judge) said: Marry this young boy with the girl, and spend something on yourselves and also give (some) charity out of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ اللُّقَطَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اعْرِفْ عِفَاصَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا ثُمَّ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا وَإِلاَّ فَشَأْنَكَ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَضَالَّةُ الْغَنَمِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَكَ أَوْ لأَخِيكَ أَوْ لِلذِّئْبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَضَالَّةُ الإِبِلِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكَ وَلَهَا مَعَهَا سِقَاؤُهَا وَحِذَاؤُهَا تَرِدُ الْمَاءَ وَتَأْكُلُ الشَّجَرَ حَتَّى يَلْقَاهَا رَبُّهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَحْسِبُ قَرَأْتُ عِفَاصَهَا
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an rabiy'aaa bni aabiy 'abdi, alrrahmani 'an yaziyda, mawlaa almunba'ithi 'an zaydi bni khaalidin aljuhaniyyi, aannahu qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalahu 'ani allluqataai faqaala ‏"‏ a'rif 'ifaasahaa wawikaa'ahaa thumma 'arrifhaa sanaaan faiin jaa'a saahibuhaa waiilaaa fashaanaka bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fadaallaau alghanami qaala ‏"‏ laka aaw laakhiyka aaw lildhhiibi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fadaallaau aliibili qaala ‏"‏ maa laka walahaa ma'ahaa siqaauuhaa wahidhaauuhaa taridu almaa'a wataakulu alshhajara hattaa yalqaahaa rabbuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala yahyaa aahsibu qaraatu 'ifaasahaa
verses.translation: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani reported:A man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and asked him about picking up of stray articles. He said: Recognise (well) its bag and the strap (by which it is tied) then make announcement of that for a year. If its owner comes (within this time return that to him), otherwise it is yours. He (again) said: (What about) the lost goat? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: It is yours or for your brother, or for the wolf. He said: (What about) the lost camel? Thereupon he said: You have nothing to do with it; it has a leather bag along with it, and its shoes also. It comes to the watering-place, eats (the leaves of the) trees until its master finds him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالَ ابْنُ حُجْرٍ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهْوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ اللُّقَطَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً ثُمَّ اعْرِفْ وِكَاءَهَا وَعِفَاصَهَا ثُمَّ اسْتَنْفِقْ بِهَا فَإِنْ جَاءَ رَبُّهَا فَأَدِّهَا إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَضَالَّةُ الْغَنَمِ قَالَ ‏"‏ خُذْهَا فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ لَكَ أَوْ لأَخِيكَ أَوْ لِلذِّئْبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَضَالَّةُ الإِبِلِ قَالَ فَغَضِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى احْمَرَّتْ وَجْنَتَاهُ - أَوِ احْمَرَّ وَجْهُهُ - ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكَ وَلَهَا مَعَهَا حِذَاؤُهَا وَسِقَاؤُهَا حَتَّى يَلْقَاهَا رَبُّهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaala abnu hujrin aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahwa abnu ja'farin - 'an rabiy'aaa bni aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an yaziyda, mawlaa almunba'ithi 'an zaydi bni khaalidin aljuhaniyyi, aanna rajulaan, saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani allluqataai faqaala ‏"‏ 'arrifhaa sanaaan thumma a'rif wikaa'ahaa wa'ifaasahaa thumma astanfiq bihaa faiin jaa'a rabbuhaa faaaddihaa iilayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi fadaallaau alghanami qaala ‏"‏ khudhhaa faiinnamaa hiya laka aaw laakhiyka aaw lildhhiibi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi fadaallaau aliibili qaala faghadiba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa ahmarrat wajnataahu - aawi ahmarra wajhuhu - thumma qaala ‏"‏ maa laka walahaa ma'ahaa hidhaauuhaa wasiqaauuhaa hattaa yalqaahaa rabbuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani reported that a person asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about picking up of stray articles, whereupon he said:Make announcement about it for a year, and recognise well the strap and the bag (containing that) ; then spend that; and if its owner comes, make him the payment of that. He (the inquirer) said: Messenger of Allah, what about the lost goat? he said: Take it, for that is yours or for your brother, or for the wolf. He (again) said: (What about) the lost camel? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was enraged until his cheeks became red (or his face became red) and then said: You have nothing to do about that; it has feet and a leather bag (to quench its thirst) until its owner finds it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ، وَمَالِكُ، بْنُ أَنَسٍ وَعَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ وَغَيْرُهُمْ أَنَّ رَبِيعَةَ بْنَ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَهُمْ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ، مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ زَادَ قَالَ أَتَى رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا مَعَهُ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ اللُّقَطَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ عَمْرٌو فِي الْحَدِيثِ ‏ "‏ فَإِذَا لَمْ يَأْتِ لَهَا طَالِبٌ فَاسْتَنْفِقْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy sufyaanu althhawriyyu, wamaaliku, bnu aanasin wa'amruw bnu alhaarithi waghayruhum aanna rabiy'aaa bna aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, haddathahum bihadhaa aliisnaadi, mithla hadiythi maalikin ghayra aannahu zaada qaala aataa rajulun rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa ma'ahu fasaaalahu 'ani allluqataai ‏.‏ qaala waqaala 'amrunw fiy alhadiythi ‏ "‏ faiidhaa lam yaati lahaa taalibun faastanfiqhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Rabi'a b. Abu Abd al-Rahman with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition:" There came a person to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while I was with him, and he asked him about picking up of a stray article, and he said: When none comes to demand it, then spend that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ الأَوْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ، يَقُولُ أَتَى رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَاحْمَارَّ وَجْهُهُ وَجَبِينُهُ وَغَضِبَ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ بَعْدَ قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ‏"‏ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِئْ صَاحِبُهَا كَانَتْ وَدِيعَةً عِنْدَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aahmadu bnu 'uthmaana bni hakiymin alaawdiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, haddathaniy sulaymaanu, - wahuwa abnu bilaalin - 'an rabiy'aaa bni aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an yaziyda, mawlaa almunba'ithi qaala sami'tu zayda bna khaalidin aljuhaniyya, yaquwlu aataa rajulun rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwa hadiythi iismaa'iyla bni ja'farin ‏.‏ ghayra aannahu qaala faahmaarra wajhuhu wajabiynuhu waghadiba ‏.‏ wazaada ba'da qawlihi ‏"‏ thumma 'arrifhaa sanaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ‏"‏ faiin lam yajii saahibuhaa kaanat wadiy'aaan 'indaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani reported. There came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a person, the rest of the hadith is the same but with the variation (of these words):His face became red, his forehead too, and he felt annoyed; and made an addition after the words: He should make announcement of that for a year, and if its owner does not turn up, then it is a trust with you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ زَيْدَ بْنَ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ، صَاحِبَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ اللُّقَطَةِ الذَّهَبِ أَوِ الْوَرِقِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اعْرِفْ وِكَاءَهَا وَعِفَاصَهَا ثُمَّ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً فَإِنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفْ فَاسْتَنْفِقْهَا وَلْتَكُنْ وَدِيعَةً عِنْدَكَ فَإِنْ جَاءَ طَالِبُهَا يَوْمًا مِنَ الدَّهْرِ فَأَدِّهَا إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ضَالَّةِ الإِبِلِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكَ وَلَهَا دَعْهَا فَإِنَّ مَعَهَا حِذَاءَهَا وَسِقَاءَهَا تَرِدُ الْمَاءَ وَتَأْكُلُ الشَّجَرَ حَتَّى يَجِدَهَا رَبُّهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ الشَّاةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ خُذْهَا فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ لَكَ أَوْ لأَخِيكَ أَوْ لِلذِّئْبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - ya'niy abna bilaalin - 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an yaziyda, mawlaa almunba'ithi aannahu sami'a zayda bna khaalidin aljuhaniyya, saahiba rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu suiila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani allluqataai aldhhahabi aawi alwariqi faqaala ‏"‏ a'rif wikaa'ahaa wa'ifaasahaa thumma 'arrifhaa sanaaan faiin lam ta'rif faastanfiqhaa waltakun wadiy'aaan 'indaka faiin jaa'a taalibuhaa yawmana mina alddahri faaaddihaa iilayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wasaaalahu 'an daallaai aliibili faqaala ‏"‏ maa laka walahaa da'haa faiinna ma'ahaa hidhaa'ahaa wasiqaa'ahaa taridu almaa'a wataakulu alshhajara hattaa yajidahaa rabbuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wasaaalahu 'ani alshhaaai faqaala ‏"‏ khudhhaa faiinnamaa hiya laka aaw laakhiyka aaw lildhhiibi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani, the Companion ot Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the picking up of stray gold or silver, whereupon he said:Recognise well the strap and the bag (containing) that and then make an announcement regarding that for one year, but if none recognises it, then spend that and it would be a trust with you; and if someone comes one day to make demand of that, then pay that to him. He (the inquirer) asked about the lost camel, whereupon he said: You have nothing to do with that. Leave that alone, for it has feet and also a leather bag, it drinks water, and eats (the leaves) of the trees. He asked him about sheep, whereupon he said: Take it, it is for you, or for your brother, or for the wolf
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَبَّانُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَرَبِيعَةُ الرَّأْىِ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ، خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ضَالَّةِ الإِبِلِ ‏.‏ زَادَ رَبِيعَةُ فَغَضِبَ حَتَّى احْمَرَّتْ وَجْنَتَاهُ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ وَزَادَ ‏ "‏ فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا فَعَرَفَ عِفَاصَهَا وَعَدَدَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا فَأَعْطِهَا إِيَّاهُ وَإِلاَّ فَهْىَ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa habbaanu bnu hilaalin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, haddathaniy yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, warabiy'aau alrraaai bnu aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an yaziyda, mawlaa almunba'ithi 'an zaydi bni, khaalidin aljuhaniyyi aanna rajulaan, saaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an daallaai aliibili ‏.‏ zaada rabiy'aau faghadiba hattaa ahmarrat wajnataahu ‏.‏ waaqtassa alhadiytha binahwi hadiythihim wazaada ‏ "‏ faiin jaa'a saahibuhaa fa'arafa 'ifaasahaa wa'adadahaa wawikaa'ahaa faaa'tihaa iiyyaahu waiilaaa fahaa laka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani reported:A person asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about a lost camel; Rabi'a made this addition: He (the Holy Prophet) was so much annoyed that his cheeks became red." The rest of the hadith is the same. He (the narrator) made this addition:" If its (that of the article) owner comes and he recognises the bag (which contained it) and its number, and the strap. then give that to them, but if not, then it is for you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ، بْنُ نَافِعٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سُوَيْدَ، بْنَ غَفَلَةَ قَالَ خَرَجْتُ أَنَا وَزَيْدُ بْنُ صُوحَانَ، وَسَلْمَانُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، غَازِينَ فَوَجَدْتُ سَوْطًا فَأَخَذْتُهُ فَقَالاَ لِي دَعْهُ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لاَ وَلَكِنِّي أُعَرِّفُهُ فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهُ وَإِلاَّ اسْتَمْتَعْتُ بِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَبَيْتُ عَلَيْهِمَا فَلَمَّا رَجَعْنَا مِنْ غَزَاتِنَا قُضِيَ لِي أَنِّي حَجَجْتُ فَأَتَيْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ فَلَقِيتُ أُبَىَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِشَأْنِ السَّوْطِ وَبِقَوْلِهِمَا فَقَالَ إِنِّي وَجَدْتُ صُرَّةً فِيهَا مِائَةُ دِينَارٍ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَيْتُ بِهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا حَوْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَعَرَّفْتُهَا فَلَمْ أَجِدْ مَنْ يَعْرِفُهَا ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا حَوْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَعَرَّفْتُهَا فَلَمْ أَجِدْ مَنْ يَعْرِفُهَا ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا حَوْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَعَرَّفْتُهَا فَلَمْ أَجِدْ مَنْ يَعْرِفُهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ احْفَظْ عَدَدَهَا وَوِعَاءَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا وَإِلاَّ فَاسْتَمْتِعْ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَاسْتَمْتَعْتُ بِهَا ‏.‏ فَلَقِيتُهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بِمَكَّةَ فَقَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي بِثَلاَثَةِ أَحْوَالٍ أَوْ حَوْلٍ وَاحِدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, h wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri, bnu naafi'in - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an salamaaa bni kuhaylin, qaala sami'tu suwayda, bna ghafalaaa qaala kharajtu aanaa wazaydu bnu suwhaana, wasalmaanu bnu rabiy'aaa, ghaaziyna fawajadtu sawtana faaakhadhtuhu faqaalaa liy da'hu ‏.‏ faqultu laa walakinniy au'arrifuhu faiin jaa'a saahibuhu waiilaaa astamta'tu bihi ‏.‏ qaala faaabaytu 'alayhimaa falammaa raja'naa min ghazaatinaa qudiya liy aanniy hajajtu faaataytu almadiynaaa falaqiytu aubaaaa bna ka'bin faaakhbartuhu bishaani alssawti wabiqawlihimaa faqaala iinniy wajadtu surraaan fiyhaa miaiaau diynaarin 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaataytu bihaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ 'arrifhaa hawlaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fa'arraftuhaa falam aajid man ya'rifuhaa thumma aataytuhu ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ 'arrifhaa hawlaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fa'arraftuhaa falam aajid man ya'rifuhaa thumma aataytuhu ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ 'arrifhaa hawlaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fa'arraftuhaa falam aajid man ya'rifuhaa ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ ahfaz 'adadahaa wawi'aa'ahaa wawikaa'ahaa faiin jaa'a saahibuhaa waiilaaa faastamti' bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faastamta'tu bihaa ‏.‏ falaqiytuhu ba'da dhalika bimakkaaa faqaala laa aadriy bithalaathaai aahwaalin aaw hawlin waahidin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salama b. Kuhail reported:I heard Sowaid b. Ghafala say: I went out, and also Zaid b. Suhan and Salman b. Rabi'a for Jihad, and I found a whip and took it up. They said to me: Leave it. I said: No. but I will make announcement of it and if its owner comes (then I will return that), otherwise I will use it, and I refused them. When we returned from Jihad. by a good fortune for me, I performed Pilgrimage. I came to Medina and met Ubayy b. Ka'b, and related to him the affair of the whip and their opinion (the opinion of Zaid b. Suhan and Salman b. Rabi'a) about it (i. e. I should throw it). Thereupon he said: I found a money bag during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which contained one hundred dinars. I came to him along with it, and he said: Make an announcement of it for one year; so I announced it, but did not find anyone who could (claim it after) recognising it. I again came to him and he said: Make announcement for one year. So I made announcement of it, but I found none who could recognise it. I came to him he said: Make announcement of it for one year. I made announcement of that but did not find one who could recognise it, whereupon he said: Preserve (in your mind) its number, its bag and its strap, and if its owner comes (then return that to him), otherwise make use of it. So I made use of that. I (Shu'ba) met him (Salama b. Kuhail) after this in Mecca, and he said: I do not know whether he said three years or one year
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَلَمَةُ، بْنُ كُهَيْلٍ أَوْ أَخْبَرَ الْقَوْمَ، وَأَنَا فِيهِمْ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سُوَيْدَ بْنَ غَفَلَةَ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ زَيْدِ بْنِ صُوحَانَ وَسَلْمَانَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ فَوَجَدْتُ سَوْطًا ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِهِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ فَاسْتَمْتَعْتُ بِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ فَسَمِعْتُهُ بَعْدَ عَشْرِ سِنِينَ يَقُولُ عَرَّفَهَا عَامًا وَاحِدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu bishrin al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa shu'baau, aakhbaraniy salamaau, bnu kuhaylin aaw aakhbara alqawma, waaanaa fiyhim, qaala sami'tu suwayda bna ghafalaaa, qaala kharajtu ma'a zaydi bni suwhaana wasalmaana bni rabiy'aaa fawajadtu sawtana ‏.‏ waaqtassa alhadiytha bimithlihi iilaa qawlihi faastamta'tu bihaa ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau fasami'tuhu ba'da 'ashri siniyna yaquwlu 'arrafahaa 'aamana waahidana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Shu'ba reported:Salama b. Kuhail informed me or he informed people and I was among them. He said: I heard Sawaid b. Ghafala who reported: I went out along with Zaid b. Suhan and Salman b. Rabi'a, and found a whip, the rest of the hadith is the same up to the words:" I made use of that." Shu'ba said: I heard him say after ten years, that he made an announcement of it for one year
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي، شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي جَمِيعًا، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ حَاتِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَمْرٍو - عَنْ زَيْدِ، بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمْ جَمِيعًا ثَلاَثَةَ أَحْوَالٍ إِلاَّ حَمَّادَ بْنَ سَلَمَةَ فَإِنَّ فِي حَدِيثِهِ عَامَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثَةً ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ وَزَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ وَحَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ ‏"‏ فَإِنْ جَاءَ أَحَدٌ يُخْبِرُكَ بِعَدَدِهَا وَوِعَائِهَا وَوِكَائِهَا فَأَعْطِهَا إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ سُفْيَانُ فِي رِوَايَةِ وَكِيعٍ ‏"‏ وَإِلاَّ فَهِيَ كَسَبِيلِ مَالِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ ‏"‏ وَإِلاَّ فَاسْتَمْتِعْ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy, shaybaaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy jamiy'ana, 'an sufyaana, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu, bnu haatimin haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu ja'farin alrraqqiyyu, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, - ya'niy abna 'amrinw - 'an zaydi, bni aabiy aunaysaaa h wahaddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu bishrin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, kullu hauulaa'i 'an salamaaa bni kuhaylin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi shu'baaa ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythihim jamiy'ana thalaathaaa aahwaalin iilaaa hammaada bna salamaaa faiinna fiy hadiythihi 'aamayni aaw thalaathaaan ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi sufyaana wazaydi bni aabiy aunaysaaa wahammaadi bni salamaaa ‏"‏ faiin jaa'a aahadun yukhbiruka bi'adadihaa wawi'aaiihaa wawikaaiihaa faaa'tihaa iiyyaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wazaada sufyaanu fiy riwaayaai wakiy'in ‏"‏ waiilaaa fahiya kasabiyli maalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai abni numayrin ‏"‏ waiilaaa faastamti' bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Salama b. Kuhail through different chains of transmitters. In their ahadith, it is three years, except in the hadith of Hammid b. Salama it is two years or three years. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Sufyan and Zaid b. Abu Unaisa and Hammid b. Salama (the words are):" If someone comes and informs you about the number (of articles) of the bag and the straps, then give that to him." Sufyan has made this addition in the narration of Waki':" Otherwise it is like your property." And in the narration of Ibn Numair the words are:" Otherwise make use of that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَيُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَاطِبٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ لُقَطَةِ الْحَاجِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, wayuwnusu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an bukayri bni 'abdi alllahi bni alaashajji, 'an yahyaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni haatibin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'uthmaana alttaymiyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an luqataai alhaajji ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. 'Uthman al-Taimi reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade taking into custody the stray thing of the pilgrims
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَيُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ سَوَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَالِمٍ الْجَيْشَانِيِّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، الْجُهَنِيِّ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ آوَى ضَالَّةً فَهُوَ ضَالٌّ مَا لَمْ يُعَرِّفْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, wayuwnusu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an bakri bni sawaadaaa, 'an aabiy saalimin aljayshaaniyyi, 'an zaydi bni khaalidin, aljuhaniyyi 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ man awaa daallaaan fahuwa daallun maa lam yu'arrifhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as sayin.:He who found a stray article is himself led astray if he does not advertise it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَحْلُبَنَّ أَحَدٌ مَاشِيَةَ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ تُؤْتَى مَشْرُبَتُهُ فَتُكْسَرَ خِزَانَتُهُ فَيُنْتَقَلَ طَعَامُهُ إِنَّمَا تَخْزُنُ لَهُمْ ضُرُوعُ مَوَاشِيهِمْ أَطْعِمَتَهُمْ فَلاَ يَحْلُبَنَّ أَحَدٌ مَاشِيَةَ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maaliki bni aanasin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yahlubanna aahadun maashiyaaa aahadin iilaaa biiidhnihi aayuhibbu aahadukum aan tuutaa mashrubatuhu fatuksara khizaanatuhu fayuntaqala ta'aamuhu iinnamaa takhzunu lahum duruw'u mawaashiyhim aat'imatahum falaa yahlubanna aahadun maashiyaaa aahadin iilaaa biiidhnihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this:None (of you) should milk the animal of another, but with his permission. Does any one of you like that his chamber be raided, and his vaults be broken, and his foodstuff be removed? Verily the treasures for them (those who keep animals) are the udders of the animals which feed them. So none of you should milk the animal of another but with his permission
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي كِلاَهُمَا، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ،عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، وَابْنُ، جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ مُوسَى، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِهِمْ جَمِيعًا ‏"‏ فَيُنْتَثَلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ إِلاَّ اللَّيْثَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ فَإِنَّ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ فَيُنْتَقَلَ طَعَامُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ كَرِوَايَةِ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, jamiy'ana 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, h wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathaniy aabiy kilaahumaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'niy abna 'ulayyaaa - jamiy'ana 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aumayyaaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, 'an ma'marin, 'an aayyuwba, waabnu, jurayjin 'an muwsaa, kullu hauulaa'i 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi maalikin ghayra aanna fiy hadiythihim jamiy'ana ‏"‏ fayuntathala ‏"‏ ‏.‏ iilaaa alllaytha bna sa'din faiinna fiy hadiythihi ‏"‏ fayuntaqala ta'aamuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ kariwaayaai maalikin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْعَدَوِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعَتْ أُذُنَاىَ، وَأَبْصَرَتْ، عَيْنَاىَ حِينَ تَكَلَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ جَائِزَتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَمَا جَائِزَتُهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَوْمُهُ وَلَيْلَتُهُ وَالضِّيَافَةُ ثَلاَثَةُ أَيَّامٍ فَمَا كَانَ وَرَاءَ ذَلِكَ فَهُوَ صَدَقَةٌ عَلَيْهِ - وَقَالَ - مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin, 'an aabiy shurayhin al'adawiyyi, aannahu qaala sami'at audhunaaaa, waaabsarat, 'aynaaaa hiyna takallama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ man kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falyukrim dayfahu jaaiizatahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa wamaa jaaiizatuhu yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ yawmuhu walaylatuhu waalddiyaafaau thalaathaau aayyaamin famaa kaana waraa'a dhalika fahuwa sadaqaaun 'alayhi - waqaala - man kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falyaqul khayrana aaw liyasmut ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd Shuraib al-Adawi reported:My eare listened and my eye saw when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) spoke and said: He who believes In Allah and the eireafter should show respect to the guest even with utmost kindness and courtesy. They said: Messenger of Allah, what is this utmost kindness and courtesy? He replied: It is for a day and a night. Hospitality extends for three days, and what is beyond that is a Sadaqa for him; and he who believes in Allah and the Hereafter should say something good or keep quiet
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الضِّيَافَةُ ثَلاَثَةُ أَيَّامٍ وَجَائِزَتُهُ يَوْمٌ وَلَيْلَةٌ وَلاَ يَحِلُّ لِرَجُلٍ مُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يُقِيمَ عِنْدَ أَخِيهِ حَتَّى يُؤْثِمَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَكَيْفَ يُؤْثِمُهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ يُقِيمُ عِنْدَهُ وَلاَ شَىْءَ لَهُ يَقْرِيهِ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa 'abdu alhamiydi bnu ja'farin, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiy shurayhin alkhuzaa'iyyi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alddiyaafaau thalaathaau aayyaamin wajaaiizatuhu yawmun walaylaaun walaa yahillu lirajulin muslimin aan yuqiyma 'inda aakhiyhi hattaa yuuthimahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi wakayfa yuuthimuhu qaala ‏"‏ yuqiymu 'indahu walaa shaa'a lahu yaqriyhi bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Shuriah al-Khuza'i reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:(The period of the entertainment of a guest is three days, and utmost kindness and courtesy is for a day and a night. =" It is not permissible for a Muslim to stay with, his brother until he makes him sinful. They said: Messenger of Allah, how he would make him sinful? He (the Holy Prophet) said: He stays with him (so long) that nothing is left with him to entertain him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، - يَعْنِي الْحَنَفِيَّ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا شُرَيْحٍ الْخُزَاعِيَّ، يَقُولُ سَمِعَتْ أُذُنَاىَ، وَبَصُرَ، عَيْنِي وَوَعَاهُ قَلْبِي حِينَ تَكَلَّمَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ وَذَكَرَ فِيهِ ‏ "‏ وَلاَ يَحِلُّ لأَحَدِكُمْ أَنْ يُقِيمَ عِنْدَ أَخِيهِ حَتَّى يُؤْثِمَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ مَا فِي حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa aabuw bakrin, - ya'niy alhanafiyya - haddathanaa 'abdu alhamiydi, bnu ja'farin haddathanaa sa'iydun almaqburiyyu, aannahu sami'a aabaa shurayhin alkhuzaa'iyya, yaquwlu sami'at audhunaaaa, wabasura, 'ayniy wawa'aahu qalbiy hiyna takallama bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithli hadiythi alllaythi wadhakara fiyhi ‏ "‏ walaa yahillu laahadikum aan yuqiyma 'inda aakhiyhi hattaa yuuthimahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ bimithli maa fiy hadiythi wakiy'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id al-Maqburi reported:I heard Abu Shuraih al-Khuzill saying: My ears heard and my eyes saw and my mind retained it, when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) spok this, and he then narrated the hadith and made mention of this:" It is not permissible for any one of you to stay with his brother until he makes him sinful
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ تَبْعَثُنَا فَنَنْزِلُ بِقَوْمٍ فَلاَ يَقْرُونَنَا فَمَا تَرَى فَقَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنْ نَزَلْتُمْ بِقَوْمٍ فَأَمَرُوا لَكُمْ بِمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلضَّيْفِ فَاقْبَلُوا فَإِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا فَخُذُوا مِنْهُمْ حَقَّ الضَّيْفِ الَّذِي يَنْبَغِي لَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an aabiy alkhayri, 'an 'uqbaaa bni 'aamirin, aannahu qaala qulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaka tab'athunaa fananzilu biqawmin falaa yaqruwnanaa famaa taraa faqaala lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iin nazaltum biqawmin faaamaruwa lakum bimaa yanbaghiy lilddayfi faaqbaluwa faiin lam yaf'aluwa fakhudhuwa minhum haqqa alddayfi alladhiy yanbaghiy lahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Uqba b. Amir reported:We said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): You send us out and we come to the people who do not give us hospitality, so what is your opinion? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If you come to the people who order for you what is befitting a guest, accept it; but if they do not. take from them what befits them to give to a guest
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَشْهَبِ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ فِي سَفَرٍ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ عَلَى رَاحِلَةٍ لَهُ قَالَ فَجَعَلَ يَصْرِفُ بَصَرَهُ يَمِينًا وَشِمَالاً فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ فَضْلُ ظَهْرٍ فَلْيَعُدْ بِهِ عَلَى مَنْ لاَ ظَهْرَ لَهُ وَمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ فَضْلٌ مِنْ زَادٍ فَلْيَعُدْ بِهِ عَلَى مَنْ لاَ زَادَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَكَرَ مِنْ أَصْنَافِ الْمَالِ مَا ذَكَرَ حَتَّى رَأَيْنَا أَنَّهُ لاَ حَقَّ لأَحَدٍ مِنَّا فِي فَضْلٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa aabuw alaashhabi, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala baynamaa nahnu fiy safarin ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh jaa'a rajulun 'alaa raahilaain lahu qaala faja'ala yasrifu basarahu yamiynana washimaalaan faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man kaana ma'ahu fadlu zahrin falya'ud bihi 'alaa man laa zahra lahu waman kaana lahu fadlun min zaadin falya'ud bihi 'alaa man laa zaada lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fadhakara min aasnaafi almaali maa dhakara hattaa raaaynaa aannahu laa haqqa laahadin minnaa fiy fadlin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:While we were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey, a person came upon his mount and began to stare on the right and on the left, (it was at this moment) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who has an extra mount should give that to one who has no mount for him, and he who has surplus of provisions should give them to him who has no provisions, and he made mention of so many kinds of wealth until we were of the opinion that none of us has any right over the surplus
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 31 — The Book of Lost Property
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الأَزْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ الْيَمَامِيَّ - حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَمَّارٍ - حَدَّثَنَا إِيَاسُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةٍ فَأَصَابَنَا جَهْدٌ حَتَّى هَمَمْنَا أَنْ نَنْحَرَ بَعْضَ ظَهْرِنَا فَأَمَرَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَمَعْنَا مَزَاوِدَنَا فَبَسَطْنَا لَهُ نِطَعًا فَاجْتَمَعَ زَادُ الْقَوْمِ عَلَى النِّطَعِ قَالَ فَتَطَاوَلْتُ لأَحْزُرَهُ كَمْ هُوَ فَحَزَرْتُهُ كَرَبْضَةِ الْعَنْزِ وَنَحْنُ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً قَالَ فَأَكَلْنَا حَتَّى شَبِعْنَا جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ حَشَوْنَا جُرُبَنَا فَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَهَلْ مِنْ وَضُوءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ بِإِدَاوَةٍ لَهُ فِيهَا نُطْفَةٌ فَأَفْرَغَهَا فِي قَدَحٍ فَتَوَضَّأْنَا كُلُّنَا نُدَغْفِقُهُ دَغْفَقَةً أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ جَاءَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ ثَمَانِيَةٌ فَقَالُوا هَلْ مِنْ طَهُورٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَرِغَ الْوَضُوءُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu yuwsufa alaazdiyyu, haddathanaa alnnadru, - ya'niy abna muhammadin alyamaamiyya - haddathanaa 'ikrimaau, - wahuwa abnu 'ammaarin - haddathanaa iiyaasu bnu salamaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghazwaain faaasaabanaa jahdun hattaa hamamnaa aan nanhara ba'da zahrinaa faaamara nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fajama'naa mazaawidanaa fabasatnaa lahu nita'ana faajtama'a zaadu alqawmi 'alaa alnnita'i qaala fatataawaltu laahzurahu kam huwa fahazartuhu karabdaai al'anzi wanahnu aarba'a 'ashraaa miaiaaan qaala faaakalnaa hattaa shabi'naa jamiy'ana thumma hashawnaa jurubanaa faqaala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ fahal min waduw'in ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fajaa'a rajulun biiidaawaain lahu fiyhaa nutfaaun faaafraghahaa fiy qadahin fatawaddaanaa kullunaa nudaghfiquhu daghfaqaaan aarba'a 'ashraaa miaiaaan ‏.‏ qaala thumma jaa'a ba'da dhalika thamaaniyaaun faqaaluwa hal min tahuwrin faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ farigha alwaduw'u ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Iyas b. Salama reported on the authority of his father:We set out on an expedition with, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). We faced hardship (in getting provisions) until we decided to slaughter some of our riding animals. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), commanded us to pool our provisions of food. So we spread a sheet of leather and the provisions of the people were collected on it. I stretched myself to measure how much that was (the length and breadth of the sheet on which the provisions were laid). I measured it and (found) that it was (in length and breadth) of (so much size) on which a goat could sit. We were fourteen hundred persons. We (all) ate until we were fully satisfied and then filled our bags with provisions. Then Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Is there any water for performing ablution. Then there came a man with a small bucket containing some water. He threw it in a basin. We all fourteen hundred persons performed ablution using the water in plenty. Then there came after that eight persons and they said: Is there any water to perform ablution? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The ablution has already been performed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمُ بْنُ أَخْضَرَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، قَالَ كَتَبْتُ إِلَى نَافِعٍ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ الدُّعَاءِ، قَبْلَ الْقِتَالِ قَالَ فَكَتَبَ إِلَىَّ إِنَّمَا كَانَ ذَلِكَ فِي أَوَّلِ الإِسْلاَمِ قَدْ أَغَارَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى بَنِي الْمُصْطَلِقِ وَهُمْ غَارُّونَ وَأَنْعَامُهُمْ تُسْقَى عَلَى الْمَاءِ فَقَتَلَ مُقَاتِلَتَهُمْ وَسَبَى سَبْيَهُمْ وَأَصَابَ يَوْمَئِذٍ - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ - جُوَيْرِيَةَ - أَوْ قَالَ الْبَتَّةَ - ابْنَةَ الْحَارِثِ وَحَدَّثَنِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ وَكَانَ فِي ذَاكَ الْجَيْشِ
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, haddathanaa sulaymu bnu aakhdara, 'ani abni 'awnin, qaala katabtu iilaa naafi'in aasaaluhu 'ani alddu'aa'i, qabla alqitaali qaala fakataba iilaaaa iinnamaa kaana dhalika fiy aawwali aliislaami qad aaghaara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa baniy almustaliqi wahum ghaarruwna waaan'aamuhum tusqaa 'alaa almaa'i faqatala muqaatilatahum wasabaa sabyahum waaasaaba yawmaiidhin - qaala yahyaa aahsibuhu qaala - juwayriyaaa - aaw qaala albattaaa - abnaaa alhaarithi wahaddathaniy hadhaa alhadiytha 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara wakaana fiy dhaaka aljayshi
verses.translation: Ibn 'Aun reported:I wrote to Nafi' inquiring from him whether it was necessary to extend (to the disbelievers) an invitation to accept (Islam) before meeting them in fight. He wrote (in reply) to me that it was necessary in the early days of Islam. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made a raid upon Banu Mustaliq while they were unaware and their cattle were having a drink at the water. He killed those who fought and imprisoned others. On that very day, he captured Juwairiya bint al-Harith. Nafi' said that this tradition was related to him by Abdullah b. Umar who (himself) was among the raiding troops
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ وَقَالَ جُوَيْرِيَةَ بِنْتَ الْحَارِثِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَشُكَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'ani abni 'awnin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu waqaala juwayriyaaa binta alhaarithi ‏.‏ walam yashukka ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Aun and the name of Juwairiya bint al-Harith was mentioned beyond any doubt
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي عَلْقَمَةُ بْنُ مَرْثَدٍ، أَنَّ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ بُرَيْدَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا بَعَثَ أَمِيرًا أَوْ سَرِيَّةً دَعَاهُ فَأَوْصَاهُ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathaniy 'abdu alssamadi bnu 'abdi alwaarithi, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathaniy 'alqamaau bnu marthadin, aanna sulaymaana bna buraydaaa, haddathahu 'an aabiyhi, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa ba'atha aamiyrana aaw sariyyaaan da'aahu faaawsaahu ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bima'naa hadiythi sufyaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sulaiman b. Buraida repotted on the authority of his father that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an Amir with a detachment he called him and advised him. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ الْفَرَّاءُ، عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alwahhaabi alfarraa'u, 'ani alhusayni bni alwaliydi, 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا بَعَثَ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فِي بَعْضِ أَمْرِهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ بَشِّرُوا وَلاَ تُنَفِّرُوا وَيَسِّرُوا وَلاَ تُعَسِّرُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
