verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa 'an buraydi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa ba'atha aahadana min aashaabihi fiy ba'di aamrihi qaala ‏ "‏ bashhiruwa walaa tunaffiruwa wayassiruwa walaa tu'assiruwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Masa that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) deputed any of his Companions on a mission, he would say:Give tidings (to the people) ; do not create (in their minds) aversion (towards religion) ; show them leniency and do not be hard upon them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَهُ وَمُعَاذًا إِلَى الْيَمَنِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَسِّرَا وَلاَ تُعَسِّرَا وَبَشِّرَا وَلاَ تُنَفِّرَا وَتَطَاوَعَا وَلاَ تَخْتَلِفَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an shu'baaa, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaddihi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'athahu wamu'aadhana iilaa alyamani faqaala ‏ "‏ yassiraa walaa tu'assiraa wabashhiraa walaa tunaffiraa watataawa'aa walaa takhtalifaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has also been narrated by Sa'd b. Abu Burda through his father through his grandfather that the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) sent him and Mu'adh (on a mission) to the Yemen, and said (by way of advising them):Show leniency (to the people) ; don't be hard upon them; give them glad tidings (of Divine favours in this world and the Hereafter) ; and do not create aversion. Work in collaboration and don't be divided
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي خَلَفٍ عَنْ زَكَرِيَّاءَ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ ‏ "‏ وَتَطَاوَعَا وَلاَ تَخْتَلِفَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy khalafin 'an zakariyyaa'a bni 'adiyyin, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an zaydi bni aabiy aunaysaaa, kilaahumaa 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaddihi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi shu'baaa walaysa fiy hadiythi zaydi bni aabiy aunaysaaa ‏ "‏ watataawa'aa walaa takhtalifaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Buraida but for the last two words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَسِّرُوا وَلاَ تُعَسِّرُوا وَسَكِّنُوا وَلاَ تُنَفِّرُوا ‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, 'an aanasin, h. wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu, alwaliydi haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yassiruwa walaa tu'assiruwa wasakkinuwa walaa tunaffiruwa ‏"‏
verses.translation: The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) has been reported by Anas b. Malik to have said:Show leniency; do not be hard; give solace and do not create aversion
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ، بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ - يَعْنِي أَبَا قُدَامَةَ السَّرَخْسِيَّ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا جَمَعَ اللَّهُ الأَوَّلِينَ وَالآخِرِينَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُرْفَعُ لِكُلِّ غَادِرٍ لِوَاءٌ فَقِيلَ هَذِهِ غَدْرَةُ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, waaabuw ausaamaaa h wahaddathaniy zuhayru, bnu harbin wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin - ya'niy aabaa qudaamaaa alssarakhsiyya - qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - kulluhum 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa jama'a alllahu alaawwaliyna waalakhiriyna yawma alqiyaamaai yurfa'u likulli ghaadirin liwaa'un faqiyla hadhihi ghadraau fulaani bni fulaanin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:When Allah will gather together, on the Day of Judgment, all the earlier and later generations of mankind, a flag will be raised (to mark off) every person guilty of breach of faith, and it will be announced that this is the perfidy of so and so, son of so and so (to attract the attention of people to his guilt)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا صَخْرُ بْنُ جُوَيْرِيَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi, alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa sakhru bnu juwayriyaaa, kilaahumaa 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa alhadiythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar through some other Chains of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْغَادِرَ يَنْصِبُ اللَّهُ لَهُ لِوَاءً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيُقَالُ أَلاَ هَذِهِ غَدْرَةُ فُلاَنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin 'an iismaa'iyla bni ja'farin, 'an 'abdi, alllahi bni diynaarin aannahu sami'a 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alghaadira yansibu alllahu lahu liwaa'an yawma alqiyaamaai fayuqaalu aalaa hadhihi ghadraau fulaanin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters on the authority of the same narrator, with the wording:Allah will set up a flag for every person guilty of breach of faith on the Day of Judgment, and it will be announced: Look, this is the perfidy of so and so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ، وَسَالِمٍ، ابْنَىْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لِكُلِّ غَادِرٍ لِوَاءٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an hamzaaa, wasaalimin, abnaa 'abdi alllahi aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ likulli ghaadirin liwaa'un yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying:There will be a flag for every perfidious person on the Day of Judgment
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ، بْنُ خَالِدٍ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لِكُلِّ غَادِرٍ لِوَاءٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُقَالُ هَذِهِ غَدْرَةُ فُلاَنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, h wahaddathaniy bishru, bnu khaalidin aakhbaranaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, 'an sulaymaana, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ likulli ghaadirin liwaa'un yawma alqiyaamaai yuqaalu hadhihi ghadraau fulaanin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) as saying:There will be a flag for every perfidious person on the Day of Judgment, and it would be said: Here is the perfidy of so and so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏ "‏ يُقَالُ هَذِهِ غَدْرَةُ فُلاَنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa alnnadru bnu shumaylin, h wahaddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi, bnu sa'iydin haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, jamiy'ana 'an shu'baaa, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ walaysa fiy hadiythi 'abdi alrrahmani ‏ "‏ yuqaalu hadhihi ghadraau fulaanin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لِكُلِّ غَادِرٍ لِوَاءٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُعْرَفُ بِهِ يُقَالُ هَذِهِ غَدْرَةُ فُلاَنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, 'an yaziyda bni 'abdi al'aziyzi, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ likulli ghaadirin liwaa'un yawma alqiyaamaai yu'rafu bihi yuqaalu hadhihi ghadraau fulaanin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:There will be for every perfidious person on the Day of Judgment a flag by which he will be recognised. It will be announced: Here is the breach of faith of so and so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لِكُلِّ غَادِرٍ لِوَاءٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُعْرَفُ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ likulli ghaadirin liwaa'un yawma alqiyaamaai yu'rafu bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this:There would be a flag for every perfidious person on the Day of Judgment by which he will be recognised
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ خُلَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لِكُلِّ غَادِرٍ لِوَاءٌ عِنْدَ اسْتِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an khulaydin, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ likulli ghaadirin liwaa'un 'inda astihi yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:On the Day of Judgment there will be a flag fixed behind the buttocks of every person guilty of the breach of faith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُسْتَمِرُّ بْنُ الرَّيَّانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لِكُلِّ غَادِرٍ لِوَاءٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُرْفَعُ لَهُ بِقَدْرِ غَدْرِهِ أَلاَ وَلاَ غَادِرَ أَعْظَمُ غَدْرًا مِنْ أَمِيرِ عَامَّةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi bnu 'abdi alwaarithi, haddathanaa almustamirru bnu alrrayyaani, haddathanaa aabuw nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ likulli ghaadirin liwaa'un yawma alqiyaamaai yurfa'u lahu biqadri ghadrihi aalaa walaa ghaadira aa'zamu ghadrana min aamiyri 'aammaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:On the Day of Judgment there will be a flag for every person guilty of the breach of faith. It will be raised in proportion to the extent of his guilt; and there is no guilt of treachery more serious than the one committed by the ruler of men
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَلِيٍّ وَزُهَيْرٍ - قَالَ عَلِيٌّ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعَ عَمْرٌو، جَابِرًا يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْحَرْبُ خَدْعَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, - waalllafzu li'aliyyin wazuhayrin - qaala 'aliyyun aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala sami'a 'amrunw, jaabirana yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alharbu khad'aaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:War is a stratagem
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَهْمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏الْحَرْبُ خُدْعَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni sahmin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu almubaaraki, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏alharbu khud'aaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has also been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِزَامِيُّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَمَنَّوْا لِقَاءَ الْعَدُوِّ فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُوهُمْ فَاصْبِرُوا‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin al'aqadiyyu, 'ani almughiyraai, - wahuwa abnu 'abdi alrrahmani alhizaamiyyu - 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tamannawa liqaa'a al'aduwwi faiidhaa laqiytumuwhum faasbiruwa‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Do not desire an encounter with the enemy; but when you encounter them, be firm
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى، بْنُ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، عَنْ كِتَابِ، رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُقَالُ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي أَوْفَى فَكَتَبَ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ حِينَ سَارَ إِلَى الْحَرُورِيَّةِ يُخْبِرُهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ فِي بَعْضِ أَيَّامِهِ الَّتِي لَقِيَ فِيهَا الْعَدُوَّ يَنْتَظِرُ حَتَّى إِذَا مَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ قَامَ فِيهِمْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ لاَ تَتَمَنَّوْا لِقَاءَ الْعَدُوِّ وَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ الْعَافِيَةَ فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُوهُمْ فَاصْبِرُوا وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ تَحْتَ ظِلاَلِ السُّيُوفِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ وَمُجْرِيَ السَّحَابِ وَهَازِمَ الأَحْزَابِ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy muwsaa, bnu 'uqbaaa 'an aabiy alnnadri, 'an kitaabi, rajulin min aaslama min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuqaalu lahu 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy aawfaa fakataba iilaa 'umara bni 'ubaydi alllahi hiyna saara iilaa alharuwriyyaai yukhbiruhu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana fiy ba'di aayyaamihi allatiy laqiya fiyhaa al'aduwwa yantaziru hattaa iidhaa maalati alshhamsu qaama fiyhim faqaala ‏"‏ yaa aayyuhaa alnnaasu laa tatamannawa liqaa'a al'aduwwi waasaaluwa alllaha al'aafiyaaa faiidhaa laqiytumuwhum faasbiruwa waa'lamuwa aanna aljannaaa tahta zilaali alssuyuwfi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma munzila alkitaabi wamujriya alssahaabi wahaazima alaahzaabi ahzimhum waansurnaa 'alayhim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated by Abu Nadr that he learnt from a letter sent by a man from the Aslam tribe, who was a Companion of the Prophet (ﷺ) and whose name was 'Abdullah b. Abu Aufa, to 'Umar b. 'Ubaidullah when the latter marched upon Haruriyya (Khawarij) informing him that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in one of those days when lie was confronting the enemy waited until the sun had declined. Then he stood up (to address the people) and said:O ye men, do not wish for an encounter with the enemy. Pray to Allah to grant you security; (but) when you (have to) encounter them exercise patience, and you should know that Paradise is under the shadows of the swords. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up (again) and said: O Allah. Revealer of the Book, Disperser of the clouds, Defeater of the hordes, put our enemy to rout and help us against them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى، قَالَ دَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الأَحْزَابِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy aawfaa, qaala da'aa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alaahzaabi faqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma munzila alkitaabi sariy'a alhisaabi ahzimi alaahzaaba alllahumma ahzimhum wazalzilhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn Abu Aufa that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cursed the tribes (who had marched upon Medina with a combined force in 5 H) and said:O Allah, Revealer of the Book, swift in (taking) account, put the tribes to rout. O Lord, defeat them and shake them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعُ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي، خَالِدٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى، يَقُولُ دَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ خَالِدٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَازِمَ الأَحْزَابِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قَوْلَهُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'u bnu aljarraahi, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy, khaalidin qaala sami'tu abna aabiy aawfaa, yaquwlu da'aa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi khaalidin ghayra aannahu qaala ‏"‏ haazima alaahzaabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur qawlahu ‏"‏ alllahumma ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abu Aufa with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ ‏ "‏ مُجْرِيَ السَّحَابِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, 'an iismaa'iyla, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wazaada abnu aabiy 'umara fiy riwaayatihi ‏ "‏ mujriya alssahaabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Uyaina through another chain of transmitters (who added the words)" the Disperser of clouds" in his narration
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَشَأْ لاَ تُعْبَدْ فِي الأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaquwlu yawma auhudin ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinnaka iin tashaa laa tu'bad fiy alaardi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Anas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said on the day of the Battle of Uhud:O Allah, if Thou wilt (defeat Muslims), there will be none on the earth to worship Thee
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ، سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، وُجِدَتْ، فِي بَعْضِ مَغَازِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَقْتُولَةً فَأَنْكَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَتْلَ النِّسَاءِ وَالصِّبْيَانِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu, sa'iydin haddathanaa laythun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi, aanna amraaaaan, wujidat, fiy ba'di maghaaziy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maqtuwlaaan faaankara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qatla alnnisaa'i waalssibyaani‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah that a woman was found killed in one of the battles fought by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He disapproved of the killing of women and children
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ، اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ وُجِدَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مَقْتُولَةً فِي بَعْضِ تِلْكَ الْمَغَازِي فَنَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ قَتْلِ النِّسَاءِ وَالصِّبْيَانِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, waaabuw ausaamaaa qaalaa haddathanaa 'ubaydu, alllahi bnu 'umara 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala wujidati amraaaaun maqtuwlaaan fiy ba'di tilka almaghaaziy fanahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an qatli alnnisaa'i waalssibyaani ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated by Ibn 'Umar that a woman was found killed in one of these battles; so the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade the killing of women and children
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ الصَّعْبِ، بْنِ جَثَّامَةَ قَالَ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الذَّرَارِيِّ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ يُبَيَّتُونَ فَيُصِيبُونَ مِنْ نِسَائِهِمْ وَذَرَارِيِّهِمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هُمْ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wasa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alssa'bi, bni jathhaamaaa qaala suiila alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani aldhharaariyyi mina almushrikiyna yubayyatuwna fayusiybuwna min nisaaiihim wadharaariyyihim ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ hum minhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Sa'b b. Jaththama that the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ), when asked about the women and children of the polytheists being killed during the night raid, said:They are from them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ الصَّعْبِ بْنِ جَثَّامَةَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا نُصِيبُ فِي الْبَيَاتِ مِنْ ذَرَارِيِّ الْمُشْرِكِينَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ هُمْ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi, alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alssa'bi bni jathhaamaaa, qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaa nusiybu fiy albayaati min dharaariyyi almushrikiyna qaala ‏ "‏ hum minhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated by Sa'b b. Jaththama that he said (to the Holy Prophet):Messenger of Allah, we kill the children of the polytheists during the night raids. He said: They are from them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو، بْنُ دِينَارٍ أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ الصَّعْبِ بْنِ جَثَّامَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قِيلَ لَهُ لَوْ أَنَّ خَيْلاً أَغَارَتْ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَأَصَابَتْ مِنْ أَبْنَاءِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ هُمْ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw, bnu diynaarin aanna abna shihaabin, aakhbarahu 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alssa'bi bni jathhaamaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qiyla lahu law aanna khaylaan aaghaarat mina alllayli faaasaabat min aabnaa'i almushrikiyna qaala ‏ "‏ hum min abaaiihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'b b. Jaththama has narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) asked:What about the children of polytheists killed by the cavalry during the night raid? He said: They are from them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ، سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَرَّقَ نَخْلَ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ وَقَطَعَ وَهِيَ الْبُوَيْرَةُ ‏.‏ زَادَ قُتَيْبَةُ وَابْنُ رُمْحٍ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ مَا قَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ لِينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَائِمَةً عَلَى أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِيَ الْفَاسِقِينَ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu, sa'iydin haddathanaa laythun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm harraqa nakhla baniy alnnadiyri waqata'a wahiya albuwayraau ‏.‏ zaada qutaybaau waabnu rumhin fiy hadiythihimaa faaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ maa qata'tum min liynaain aaw taraktumuwhaa qaaiimaaan 'alaa ausuwlihaa fabiiidhni alllahi waliyukhziya alfaasiqiyna‏}‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered the date-palms of Banu Nadir to be burnt and cut. These palms were at Buwaira. Qutaibah and Ibn Rumh in their versions of the tradition have added:So Allah, the Glorious and Exalted, revealed the verse:" Whatever trees you have cut down or left standing on their trunks, it was with the permission of Allah so that He may disgrace the evil-doers" (lix)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَهَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ مُوسَى، بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَطَعَ نَخْلَ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ وَحَرَّقَ وَلَهَا يَقُولُ حَسَّانُ وَهَانَ عَلَى سَرَاةِ بَنِي لُؤَىٍّ حَرِيقٌ بِالْبُوَيْرَةِ مُسْتَطِيرُ وَفِي ذَلِكَ نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ مَا قَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ لِينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَائِمَةً عَلَى أُصُولِهَا‏}‏ الآيَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, wahannaadu bnu alssariyyi, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu almubaaraki, 'an muwsaa, bni 'uqbaaa 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qata'a nakhla baniy alnnadiyri waharraqa walahaa yaquwlu hassaanu wahaana 'alaa saraaai baniy luuaaain hariyqun bialbuwayraai mustatiyru wafiy dhalika nazalat ‏{‏ maa qata'tum min liynaain aaw taraktumuwhaa qaaiimaaan 'alaa ausuwlihaa‏}‏ alayaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) caused the date-palms of Banu Nadir to be cut down and burnt. It is in this connection that Hassan (the poet) said:It was easy for the nobles of Quraish to burn Buwaira whose sparks were flying in all directions, in the same connection was revealed the Qur'anic verse:" Whatever trees you have cut down or left standing on their trunks
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ السَّكُونِيُّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ حَرَّقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَخْلَ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa sahlu bnu 'uthmaana, aakhbaraniy 'uqbaau bnu khaalidin alssakuwniyyu, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala harraqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nakhla baniy alnnadiyri‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) burnt the date-palms of Banu Nadir
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ رَافِعٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ غَزَا نَبِيٌّ مِنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ فَقَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ لاَ يَتْبَعْنِي رَجُلٌ قَدْ مَلَكَ بُضْعَ امْرَأَةٍ وَهُوَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَبْنِيَ بِهَا وَلَمَّا يَبْنِ وَلاَ آخَرُ قَدْ بَنَى بُنْيَانًا وَلَمَّا يَرْفَعْ سُقُفَهَا وَلاَ آخَرُ قَدِ اشْتَرَى غَنَمًا أَوْ خَلِفَاتٍ وَهُوَ مُنْتَظِرٌ وِلاَدَهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَغَزَا فَأَدْنَى لِلْقَرْيَةِ حِينَ صَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ أَوْ قَرِيبًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لِلشَّمْسِ أَنْتِ مَأْمُورَةٌ وَأَنَا مَأْمُورٌ اللَّهُمَّ احْبِسْهَا عَلَىَّ شَيْئًا ‏.‏ فَحُبِسَتْ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَجَمَعُوا مَا غَنِمُوا فَأَقْبَلَتِ النَّارُ لِتَأْكُلَهُ فَأَبَتْ أَنْ تَطْعَمَهُ فَقَالَ فِيكُمْ غُلُولٌ فَلْيُبَايِعْنِي مِنْ كُلِّ قَبِيلَةٍ رَجُلٌ ‏.‏ فَبَايَعُوهُ فَلَصِقَتْ يَدُ رَجُلٍ بِيَدِهِ فَقَالَ فِيكُمُ الْغُلُولُ فَلْتُبَايِعْنِي قَبِيلَتُكَ ‏.‏ فَبَايَعَتْهُ - قَالَ - فَلَصِقَتْ بِيَدِ رَجُلَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثَةٍ فَقَالَ فِيكُمُ الْغُلُولُ أَنْتُمْ غَلَلْتُمْ - قَالَ - فَأَخْرَجُوا لَهُ مِثْلَ رَأْسِ بَقَرَةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ - قَالَ - فَوَضَعُوهُ فِي الْمَالِ وَهُوَ بِالصَّعِيدِ فَأَقْبَلَتِ النَّارُ فَأَكَلَتْهُ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ تَحِلَّ الْغَنَائِمُ لأَحَدٍ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى رَأَى ضَعْفَنَا وَعَجْزَنَا فَطَيَّبَهَا لَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa abnu almubaaraki, 'an ma'marin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu, bnu raafi'in - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ghazaa nabiyyun mina alaanbiyaa'i faqaala liqawmihi laa yatba'niy rajulun qad malaka bud'a amraaaain wahuwa yuriydu aan yabniya bihaa walammaa yabni walaa akharu qad banaa bunyaanana walammaa yarfa' suqufahaa walaa akharu qadi ashtaraa ghanamana aaw khalifaatin wahuwa muntazirun wilaadahaa ‏.‏ qaala faghazaa faaadnaa lilqaryaai hiyna salaaai al'asri aaw qariybana min dhalika faqaala lilshhamsi aanti maamuwraaun waaanaa maamuwrun alllahumma ahbishaa 'alaaaa shayiana ‏.‏ fahubisat 'alayhi hattaa fataha alllahu 'alayhi - qaala - fajama'uwa maa ghanimuwa faaaqbalati alnnaaru litaakulahu faaabat aan tat'amahu faqaala fiykum ghuluwlun falyubaayi'niy min kulli qabiylaain rajulun ‏.‏ fabaaya'uwhu falasiqat yadu rajulin biyadihi faqaala fiykumu alghuluwlu faltubaayi'niy qabiylatuka ‏.‏ fabaaya'athu - qaala - falasiqat biyadi rajulayni aaw thalaathaain faqaala fiykumu alghuluwlu aantum ghalaltum - qaala - faaakhrajuwa lahu mithla raasi baqaraain min dhahabin - qaala - fawada'uwhu fiy almaali wahuwa bialssa'iydi faaaqbalati alnnaaru faaakalathu ‏.‏ falam tahilla alghanaaiimu laahadin min qablinaa dhalika biaanna alllaha tabaaraka wata'aalaa raaaa da'fanaa wa'ajzanaa fatayyabahaa lanaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated by Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:One of the Prophets made a holy war. He said to his followers: One who has married a woman and wants to consummate to his marriage but has not yet done so; another who has built a house but has not yet erected its roof; and another who has bought goats and pregnantshe-camels and is waiting for their offspring-will not accommpany me. So he marched on and approached a village at or about the time of the Asr prayers. He said to the sun: Thou art subserviant (to Allah) and so am I. O Allah, stop it for me a little. It was stopped for him until Allah granted him victory. The people gathered the spoils of war (at one place). A fire approached the spoils to devour them, but it did not devour them. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Some of you have been guilty of misappropriation. So one man from each tribe should swear fealty to me. The did so (putting their hands into his). The hand of one man stuck to his hand and the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Your tribe is guilty of misappropriation. Let all the members of your tribe swear fealty to me one by one. They did so, when the hands of two or three persons got stuck with his hand. He said: You have misappropriated. So they took out gold equal in volume to the head of a cow. They-placed it among the spoils on the earth. Then the fire approached the spoils and devoured them. The spoils of war were not made lawful for any people before us, This is because Allah saw our weakness and humility and made them lawful for us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَخَذَ أَبِي مِنَ الْخُمْسِ سَيْفًا فَأَتَى بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ هَبْ لِي هَذَا ‏.‏ فَأَبَى فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الأَنْفَالِ قُلِ الأَنْفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ‏}‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an simaakin, 'an mus'abi bni sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, qaala aakhadha aabiy mina alkhumsi sayfana faaataa bihi alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala hab liy hadhaa ‏.‏ faaabaa faaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ yasaaluwnaka 'ani alaanfaali quli alaanfaalu lillahi waalrrasuwli‏}‏
verses.translation: A hadith has been narrated by Mus'ab b. Sa'd who heard it from his father as saying:My father took a sword from Khums and brought it to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: Grant it to me. He refused. At this Allah revealed (the Qur'anic verse):" They ask thee concerning the spoils of war. Say: The spoils of war are for Allah and the Apostle" (viii)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِيَّ أَرْبَعُ آيَاتٍ أَصَبْتُ سَيْفًا فَأَتَى بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ نَفِّلْنِيهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ضَعْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ضَعْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَخَذْتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَقَالَ نَفِّلْنِيهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ضَعْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ نَفِّلْنِيهِ أَأُجْعَلُ كَمَنْ لاَ غَنَاءَ لَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ضَعْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَخَذْتَهَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الأَنْفَالِ قُلِ الأَنْفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu ja'farin haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an simaaki bni harbin, 'an mus'abi bni sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, qaala nazalat fiyya aarba'u ayaatin aasabtu sayfana faaataa bihi alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi naffilniyhi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ da'hu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaama faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ da'hu min haythu aakhadhtahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaama faqaala naffilniyhi yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ da'hu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaama faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi naffilniyhi aaauj'alu kaman laa ghanaa'a lahu faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ da'hu min haythu aakhadhtaha ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fanazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏ yasaaluwnaka 'ani alaanfaali quli alaanfaalu lillahi waalrrasuwli‏}‏
verses.translation: A hadith has been narrated by Mus'ab b. Sa'd who heard it from his father as saying:" Four verses of the Qur'an have been revealed about me. I found a sword (among the spoils of war). It was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ). He (my father) said: Messenger of Allah, bestow it upon me. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: Place it there. Then he (my father) stood up and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: Place it from where you got it. (At this) he (my father) said again: Messenger of Allah, bestow it upon me Shall I be treated like one who has no share in (the booty)? The Apostle of Allah (may peace be upon him said: Place it from where you got it. At this was revealed the verse:" They ask thee about the spoils of war.... Say: The spoils of war are for Allah and the Messenger)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ بَعَثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَرِيَّةً وَأَنَا فِيهِمْ قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ فَغَنِمُوا إِبِلاً كَثِيرَةً فَكَانَتْ سُهْمَانُهُمُ اثْنَى عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا أَوْ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا وَنُفِّلُوا بَعِيرًا بَعِيرًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala ba'atha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm sariyyaaan waaanaa fiyhim qibala najdin faghanimuwa iibilaan kathiyraaan fakaanat suhmaanuhumu athnaa 'ashara ba'iyrana aaw aahada 'ashara ba'iyrana wanuffiluwa ba'iyrana ba'iyrana ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar that the Prophet (ﷺ) sent an expedition to Najd and I was among the troops. They got a large number of camels as a booty. Eleven or twelve camels fell to the lot of every fighter and each of them also got one extra camel
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ سَرِيَّةً قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ وَفِيهِمُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَأَنَّ سُهْمَانَهُمْ بَلَغَتِ اثْنَىْ عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا وَنُفِّلُوا سِوَى ذَلِكَ بَعِيرًا فَلَمْ يُغَيِّرْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha sariyyaaan qibala najdin wafiyhimu abnu 'umara waaanna suhmaanahum balaghati athnaa 'ashara ba'iyrana wanuffiluwa siwaa dhalika ba'iyrana falam yughayyirhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an expedition to Najd and Ibn Umar was also among the troops, and their share (of the spoils) came to twelve camels and they were given one camel over and above that. and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not make any change in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَرِيَّةً إِلَى نَجْدٍ فَخَرَجْتُ فِيهَا فَأَصَبْنَا إِبِلاً وَغَنَمًا فَبَلَغَتْ سُهْمَانُنَا اثْنَىْ عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا وَنَفَّلَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعِيرًا بَعِيرًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, wa'abdu alrrahiymi bnu sulaymaana, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sariyyaaan iilaa najdin fakharajtu fiyhaa faaasabnaa iibilaan waghanamana fabalaghat suhmaanunaa athnaa 'ashara ba'iyrana wanaffalanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'iyrana ba'iyrana ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated by Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent an expedition to Najd, and I (also) went with the troops. We got camels and goats as spoils of war, and our share amounted to twelve camels per head, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave an extra camel to each of us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، قَالَ كَتَبْتُ إِلَى نَافِعٍ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ النَّفَلِ، فَكَتَبَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّ4661 - وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'ani abni 'awnin, qaala katabtu iilaa naafi'in aasaaluhu 'ani alnnafali, fakataba iilaaaa aanna4661 - wahaddathanaa abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy muwsaa, h wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy ausaamaau bnu zaydin, kulluhum 'an naafi'in, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwa hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Aun said:I wrote to Nafi' asking him about Nafl (spoils of war) and be wrote to me that Ibn 'Umar was among that expedition. (The rest of the hadith is the same)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِسُرَيْجٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ نَفَّلَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَفَلاً سِوَى نَصِيبِنَا مِنَ الْخُمْسِ فَأَصَابَنِي شَارِفٌ وَالشَّارِفُ الْمُسِنُّ الْكَبِيرُ ‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa surayju bnu yuwnusa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, - waalllafzu lisurayjin - qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu, alllahi bnu rajaa'in 'an yuwnusa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala naffalanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nafalaan siwaa nasiybinaa mina alkhumsi faaasaabaniy shaarifun waalshhaarifu almusinnu alkabiyru ‏
verses.translation: A hadith has been narrated by Salim who learnt it from his father and said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave us an extra (camel) besides our share of Khums; (and in this extra share) I got a Sharif (and a Sharif is a big old camel)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ بَلَغَنِي عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ نَفَّلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَرِيَّةً بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ رَجَاءٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa hannaadu bnu alssariyyi, haddathanaa abnu almubaaraki, h wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, kilaahumaa 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala balaghaniy 'ani abni 'umara, qaala naffala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sariyyaaan binahwi hadiythi abni rajaa'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Shihab reported:It reached me through Ibn Umar that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave a share of spoils to the troop. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ، بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ كَانَ يُنَفِّلُ بَعْضَ مَنْ يَبْعَثُ مِنَ السَّرَايَا لأَنْفُسِهِمْ خَاصَّةً سِوَى قَسْمِ عَامَّةِ الْجَيْشِ وَالْخُمْسُ فِي ذَلِكَ وَاجِبٌ كُلِّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylu, bnu khaalidin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad kaana yunaffilu ba'da man yab'athu mina alssaraayaa laanfusihim khaassaaan siwaa qasmi 'aammaai aljayshi waalkhumsu fiy dhalika waajibun kullihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to give (from the spoils of war) to small troops seat on expeditions something more than the due share of each fighter in a large force. And Khums (one-fifth of the total spoils) was to be reserved (for Allah and His Apostle) in all cases
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ، كَثِيرِ بْنِ أَفْلَحَ عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، وَكَانَ، جَلِيسًا لأَبِي قَتَادَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'umara bni, kathiyri bni aaflaha 'an aabiy muhammadin alaansaariyyi, wakaana, jaliysana laabiy qataadaaa qaala qaala aabuw qataadaaa ‏.‏ waaqtassa alhadiytha ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Muammad al-Ansari, who was the close companion of Abu Qatada. narrated the hadith (which follows)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قَتَادَةَ أَنَّ أَبَا قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'umara bni kathiyrin, 'an aabiy muhammadin, mawlaa aabiy qataadaaa aanna aabaa qataadaaa, qaala ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Muhammad, the freed slave of Abu Qatada reported on the authority of Abu Qatda and narrated the hadith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَالِكَ بْنَ أَنَسٍ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ كَثِيرِ بْنِ أَفْلَحَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ حُنَيْنٍ فَلَمَّا الْتَقَيْنَا كَانَتْ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ جَوْلَةٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَأَيْتُ رَجُلاً مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ قَدْ عَلاَ رَجُلاً مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَاسْتَدَرْتُ إِلَيْهِ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُهُ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ فَضَرَبْتُهُ عَلَى حَبْلِ عَاتِقِهِ وَأَقْبَلَ عَلَىَّ فَضَمَّنِي ضَمَّةً وَجَدْتُ مِنْهَا رِيحَ الْمَوْتِ ثُمَّ أَدْرَكَهُ الْمَوْتُ فَأَرْسَلَنِي فَلَحِقْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ مَا لِلنَّاسِ فَقُلْتُ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ إِنَّ النَّاسَ رَجَعُوا وَجَلَسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ قَتَلَ قَتِيلاً لَهُ عَلَيْهِ بَيِّنَةٌ فَلَهُ سَلَبُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُمْتُ فَقُلْتُ مَنْ يَشْهَدُ لِي ثُمَّ جَلَسْتُ ثُمَّ قَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ فَقُمْتُ فَقُلْتُ مَنْ يَشْهَدُ لِي ثُمَّ جَلَسْتُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ذَلِكَ الثَّالِثَةَ فَقُمْتُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا لَكَ يَا أَبَا قَتَادَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَصَصْتُ عَلَيْهِ الْقِصَّةَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ صَدَقَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ سَلَبُ ذَلِكَ الْقَتِيلِ عِنْدِي فَأَرْضِهِ مِنْ حَقِّهِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقُ لاَهَا اللَّهِ إِذًا لاَ يَعْمِدُ إِلَى أَسَدٍ مِنْ أُسُدِ اللَّهِ يُقَاتِلُ عَنِ اللَّهِ وَعَنْ رَسُولِهِ فَيُعْطِيكَ سَلَبَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ صَدَقَ فَأَعْطِهِ إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَعْطَانِي قَالَ فَبِعْتُ الدِّرْعَ فَابْتَعْتُ بِهِ مَخْرَفًا فِي بَنِي سَلِمَةَ فَإِنَّهُ لأَوَّلُ مَالٍ تَأَثَّلْتُهُ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ كَلاَّ لاَ يُعْطِيهِ أُضَيْبِعَ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ وَيَدَعُ أَسَدًا مِنْ أُسُدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ لأَوَّلُ مَالٍ تَأَثَّلْتُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, qaala sami'tu maalika bna aanasin, yaquwlu haddathaniy yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'umara bni kathiyri bni aaflaha, 'an aabiy muhammadin, mawlaa aabiy qataadaaa 'an aabiy qataadaaa, qaala kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama hunaynin falammaa altaqaynaa kaanat lilmuslimiyna jawlaaun ‏.‏ qaala faraaaytu rajulaan mina almushrikiyna qad 'alaa rajulaan mina almuslimiyna faastadartu iilayhi hattaa aataytuhu min waraaiihi fadarabtuhu 'alaa habli 'aatiqihi waaaqbala 'alaaaa fadammaniy dammaaan wajadtu minhaa riyha almawti thumma aadrakahu almawtu faaarsalaniy falahiqtu 'umara bna alkhattaabi faqaala maa lilnnaasi faqultu aamru alllahi ‏.‏ thumma iinna alnnaasa raja'uwa wajalasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ man qatala qatiylaan lahu 'alayhi bayyinaaun falahu salabuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqumtu faqultu man yashhadu liy thumma jalastu thumma qaala mithla dhalika faqaala faqumtu faqultu man yashhadu liy thumma jalastu thumma qaala dhalika althhaalithaaa faqumtu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa laka yaa aabaa qataadaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqasastu 'alayhi alqissaaa faqaala rajulun mina alqawmi sadaqa yaa rasuwla alllahi salabu dhalika alqatiyli 'indiy faaardihi min haqqihi ‏.‏ waqaala aabuw bakrin alssiddiyqu laahaa alllahi iidhana laa ya'midu iilaa aasadin min ausudi alllahi yuqaatilu 'ani alllahi wa'an rasuwlihi fayu'tiyka salabahu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ sadaqa faaa'tihi iiyyaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaa'taaniy qaala fabi'tu alddir'a faabta'tu bihi makhrafana fiy baniy salimaaa faiinnahu laawwalu maalin taaathhaltuhu fiy aliislaami ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi alllaythi faqaala aabuw bakrin kalaaa laa yu'tiyhi audaybi'a min qurayshin wayada'u aasadana min ausudi alllahi ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi alllaythi laawwalu maalin taaathhaltuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Qatada reported:We accompanied the Messenger of Allah (my peace be upon him) on an expedition in the year of the Battle of Hunain. When we encountered the enemy, (some of the Muslims turned back (in fear). I saw that a man from the polytheists overpowered one of the Muslims. I turned round and attacked him from behind giving a blow between his neck and shoulder. He turned towards me and grappled with me in such a way that I began to see death staring me in the face. Then death overtook him and left me alone. I joined 'Umar b. al-Khattab who was saying: What has happened to the people (that they are retreating)? I said: It is the Decree of Allah. Then the people returned. (The battle ended in a victory for the Muslims) and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat down (to distribute the spoils of war). He said: One who has killed an enemy and can bring evidence to prove it will get his belongings. So I stood up and said: Who will give evidence for me? Then I sat down. Then he (the Holy Prophet) said like this. I stood up (again) and said: Who will bear witness for me? He (the Holy Prophet) made the same observation the third time, and I stood up (once again). Now the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: What has happened to you, O Abu Qatada? Then I related the (whole) story, to him. At this, one of the people said: He has told the truth. Messenger of Allah 1 The belongings of the enemy killed by him are with me. Persuade him to forgo his right (in my favour). (Objecting to this proposal) Abu Bakr said: BY Allah, this will not happen. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) will not like to deprive one of the lions from among the lions of Allah who fight in the cause of Allah and His Messenger and give thee his share of the booty. So the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) said: He (Abu Bakr) has told the truth, and so give the belongings to him (Abu Qatada). So he gave them to me. I sold the armour (which was a part of my share of the booty) and bought with the sale proceeds a garden in the street of Banu Salama. This was the first property I acquired after embracing Islam. In a version of the hadith narrated by Laith, the words uttered by Abu Bakr are:" No, never! He will not give it to a fox from the Quraish leaving aside a lion from the lions of Allah among...." And the hadith is closed with the words:" The first property I acquired
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ الْمَاجِشُونِ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ بَيْنَا أَنَا وَاقِفٌ، فِي الصَّفِّ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ نَظَرْتُ عَنْ يَمِينِي، وَشِمَالِي، فَإِذَا أَنَا بَيْنَ، غُلاَمَيْنِ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ حَدِيثَةٍ أَسْنَانُهُمَا تَمَنَّيْتُ لَوْ كُنْتُ بَيْنَ أَضْلَعَ مِنْهُمَا فَغَمَزَنِي أَحَدُهُمَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا عَمِّ هَلْ تَعْرِفُ أَبَا جَهْلٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ وَمَا حَاجَتُكَ إِلَيْهِ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي قَالَ أُخْبِرْتُ أَنَّهُ يَسُبُّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَئِنْ رَأَيْتُهُ لاَ يُفَارِقُ سَوَادِي سَوَادَهُ حَتَّى يَمُوتَ الأَعْجَلُ مِنَّا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَعَجَّبْتُ لِذَلِكَ فَغَمَزَنِي الآخَرُ فَقَالَ مِثْلَهَا - قَالَ - فَلَمْ أَنْشَبْ أَنْ نَظَرْتُ إِلَى أَبِي جَهْلٍ يَزُولُ فِي النَّاسِ فَقُلْتُ أَلاَ تَرَيَانِ هَذَا صَاحِبُكُمَا الَّذِي تَسْأَلاَنِ عَنْهُ قَالَ فَابْتَدَرَاهُ فَضَرَبَاهُ بِسَيْفَيْهِمَا حَتَّى قَتَلاَهُ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَاهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُّكُمَا قَتَلَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا أَنَا قَتَلْتُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ مَسَحْتُمَا سَيْفَيْكُمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالاَ لاَ ‏.‏ فَنَظَرَ فِي السَّيْفَيْنِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كِلاَكُمَا قَتَلَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَضَى بِسَلَبِهِ لِمُعَاذِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْجَمُوحِ وَالرَّجُلاَنِ مُعَاذُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْجَمُوحِ وَمُعَاذُ ابْنُ عَفْرَاءَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa yuwsufu bnu almaajishuwni, 'an saalihi bni iibraahiyma, bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, aannahu qaala baynaa aanaa waaqifun, fiy alssaffi yawma badrin nazartu 'an yamiyniy, washimaaliy, faiidhaa aanaa bayna, ghulaamayni mina alaansaari hadiythaain aasnaanuhumaa tamannaytu law kuntu bayna aadla'a minhumaa faghamazaniy aahaduhumaa ‏.‏ faqaala yaa 'ammi hal ta'rifu aabaa jahlin qaala qultu na'am wamaa haajatuka iilayhi yaa abna aakhiy qaala aukhbirtu aannahu yasubbu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laiin raaaytuhu laa yufaariqu sawaadiy sawaadahu hattaa yamuwta alaa'jalu minnaa ‏.‏ qaala fata'ajjabtu lidhalika faghamazaniy alakharu faqaala mithlahaa - qaala - falam aanshab aan nazartu iilaa aabiy jahlin yazuwlu fiy alnnaasi faqultu aalaa tarayaani hadhaa saahibukumaa alladhiy tasaalaani 'anhu qaala faabtadaraahu fadarabaahu bisayfayhimaa hattaa qatalaahu thumma ansarafaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbaraahu ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aayyukumaa qatalahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala kullu waahidin minhumaa aanaa qataltu ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ hal masahtumaa sayfaykumaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalaa laa ‏.‏ fanazara fiy alssayfayni faqaala ‏"‏ kilaakumaa qatalahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqadaa bisalabihi limu'aadhi bni 'amriw bni aljamuwhi waalrrajulaani mu'aadhu bnu 'amriw bni aljamuwhi wamu'aadhu abnu 'afraa'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Auf who said:While I was standing in the battle array on the Day of Badr, I looked towards my right and my left, and found myself between two boys from the Ansar quite young in age. I wished I were between stronger persons. One of them made a sign to me and. said: Uncle, do you recognise Abu Jahl? 1 said: Yes. What do you want to do with him, O my nephew? He said: I have been told that he abuses the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). By Allah, in Whose Hand is my life, if I see him (I will grapple with him) and will not leave him until one of us who is destined to die earlier is killed. The narrator said: I wondered at this. Then the other made a sign to me and said similar words. Soon after I saw Abu Jahl. He was moving about among men. I said to the two boys: Don't you see? He is the man you were inquiring about. (As soon as they heard this), they dashed towards him, struck him with their swords until he was killed. Then they returned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and informed him (to this effect). He asked: Which of you has killed him? Each one of them said: I have killed him. He said: Have you wiped your swords? They said: No. He examined their swords and said: Both of you have killed him. He then decided that the belongings of Abu Jahl he handed over to Mu'adh b. Amr b. al-Jamuh. And the two boys were Mu'adh b. Amr b. Jawth and Mu'adh b. Afra
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَتَلَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ حِمْيَرَ رَجُلاً مِنَ الْعَدُوِّ فَأَرَادَ سَلَبَهُ فَمَنَعَهُ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ وَكَانَ وَالِيًا عَلَيْهِمْ فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَوْفُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ فَأَخْبَرَهُ فَقَالَ لِخَالِدٍ ‏"‏ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تُعْطِيَهُ سَلَبَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ اسْتَكْثَرْتُهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ادْفَعْهُ إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَمَرَّ خَالِدٌ بِعَوْفٍ فَجَرَّ بِرِدَائِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ هَلْ أَنْجَزْتُ لَكَ مَا ذَكَرْتُ لَكَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَمِعَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتُغْضِبَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تُعْطِهِ يَا خَالِدُ لاَ تُعْطِهِ يَا خَالِدُ هَلْ أَنْتُمْ تَارِكُونَ لِي أُمَرَائِي إِنَّمَا مَثَلُكُمْ وَمَثَلُهُمْ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ اسْتُرْعِيَ إِبِلاً أَوْ غَنَمًا فَرَعَاهَا ثُمَّ تَحَيَّنَ سَقْيَهَا فَأَوْرَدَهَا حَوْضًا فَشَرَعَتْ فِيهِ فَشَرِبَتْ صَفْوَهُ وَتَرَكَتْ كَدَرَهُ فَصَفْوُهُ لَكُمْ وَكَدَرُهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amriw bni sarhin aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy mu'aawiyaau bnu saalihin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni jubayrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'awfi bni maalikin, qaala qatala rajulun min himyara rajulaan mina al'aduwwi faaaraada salabahu famana'ahu khaalidu bnu alwaliydi wakaana waaliyana 'alayhim faaataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'awfu bnu maalikin faaakhbarahu faqaala likhaalidin ‏"‏ maa mana'aka aan tu'tiyahu salabahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala astakthartuhu yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ adfa'hu iilayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ famarra khaalidun bi'awfin fajarra biridaaiihi thumma qaala hal aanjaztu laka maa dhakartu laka min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasami'ahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faastughdiba faqaala ‏"‏ laa tu'tihi yaa khaalidu laa tu'tihi yaa khaalidu hal aantum taarikuwna liy aumaraaiiy iinnamaa mathalukum wamathaluhum kamathali rajulin astur'iya iibilaan aaw ghanamana fara'aahaa thumma tahayyana saqyahaa faaawradahaa hawdana fashara'at fiyhi fasharibat safwahu watarakat kadarahu fasafwuhu lakum wakadaruhu 'alayhim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Auf b. Malik has narrated that a man from the Himyar tribe killed an enemy and wanted to take the booty. Khalid b. Walid, who was the commander over them, forbade, him. 'Auf b Malik (the narrator) came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and informed him (to this effect). The latter asked Khalid:What prevented you from giving the booty to him? Khalid said: I thought it was too much. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Hand it over to him. Now when Khalid by Auf, the latter pulled him by his cloak and said (by way of chafing him): Hasn't the same thing happened what I reported to you from the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him)? When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) heard it. he was angry (and said): Khalid, don't give him, Khalid, don't give him. Are you going to desert the commanders appointed by roe? Your similitude and theirs is like a person who took camels and sheep for grazing. He grazed them and when it was time for them to have a drink, he brought them to a pool. So they drank from it, drinking away its clear water and leaving the turbid water below So the clear water (i. e. the best reward) is for you and the turbid water (i e. blame) is for them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ الأَشْجَعِيِّ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ مَنْ خَرَجَ مَعَ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ فِي غَزْوَةِ مُؤْتَةَ وَرَافَقَنِي مَدَدِيٌّ مِنَ الْيَمَنِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ قَالَ عَوْفٌ فَقُلْتُ يَا خَالِدُ أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَضَى بِالسَّلَبِ لِلْقَاتِلِ قَالَ بَلَى وَلَكِنِّي اسْتَكْثَرْتُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa safwaanu bnu 'amrinw, 'an 'abdi, alrrahmani bni jubayri bni nufayrin 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'awfi bni maalikin alaashja'iyyi, qaala kharajtu ma'a man kharaja ma'a zaydi bni haarithaaa fiy ghazwaai muutaaa waraafaqaniy madadiyyun mina alyamani ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ binahwihi ghayra aannahu qaala fiy alhadiythi qaala 'awfun faqultu yaa khaalidu aamaa 'alimta aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qadaa bialssalabi lilqaatili qaala balaa walakinniy astakthartuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Auf b. Malik al-Ashja'i who said:I joined the expedition that marched under Zaid b. Haritha to Muta, and I received reinformcement from the Yemen. (After this introduction), the narrator narrated the tradition that had gone before except that in his version Auf was reported to have said (to Khalid): Khalid, didn't you know that the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) had decided In favour of giving the booty (sized from an enemy) to one who killed him? He (Khalid) said: Yes. but I thought it was too much
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ الْحَنَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِيَاسُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ الأَكْوَعِ، قَالَ غَزَوْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَوَازِنَ فَبَيْنَا نَحْنُ نَتَضَحَّى مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ عَلَى جَمَلٍ أَحْمَرَ فَأَنَاخَهُ ثُمَّ انْتَزَعَ طَلَقًا مِنْ حَقَبِهِ فَقَيَّدَ بِهِ الْجَمَلَ ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمَ يَتَغَدَّى مَعَ الْقَوْمِ وَجَعَلَ يَنْظُرُ وَفِينَا ضَعْفَةٌ وَرِقَّةٌ فِي الظَّهْرِ وَبَعْضُنَا مُشَاةٌ إِذْ خَرَجَ يَشْتَدُّ فَأَتَى جَمَلَهُ فَأَطْلَقَ قَيْدَهُ ثُمَّ أَنَاخَهُ وَقَعَدَ عَلَيْهِ فَأَثَارَهُ فَاشْتَدَّ بِهِ الْجَمَلُ فَاتَّبَعَهُ رَجُلٌ عَلَى نَاقَةٍ وَرْقَاءَ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَلَمَةُ وَخَرَجْتُ أَشْتَدُّ فَكُنْتُ عِنْدَ وَرِكِ النَّاقَةِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمْتُ حَتَّى كُنْتُ عِنْدَ وَرِكِ الْجَمَلِ ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمْتُ حَتَّى أَخَذْتُ بِخِطَامِ الْجَمَلِ فَأَنَخْتُهُ فَلَمَّا وَضَعَ رُكْبَتَهُ فِي الأَرْضِ اخْتَرَطْتُ سَيْفِي فَضَرَبْتُ رَأْسَ الرَّجُلِ فَنَدَرَ ثُمَّ جِئْتُ بِالْجَمَلِ أَقُودُهُ عَلَيْهِ رَحْلُهُ وَسِلاَحُهُ فَاسْتَقْبَلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسُ مَعَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ قَتَلَ الرَّجُلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا ابْنُ الأَكْوَعِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَهُ سَلَبُهُ أَجْمَعُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu yuwnusa alhanafiyyu, haddathanaa 'ikrimaau bnu 'ammaarin, haddathaniy iiyaasu bnu salamaaa, haddathaniy aabiy salamaau bnu alaakwa'i, qaala ghazawnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hawaazina fabaynaa nahnu natadahhaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh jaa'a rajulun 'alaa jamalin aahmara faaanaakhahu thumma antaza'a talaqana min haqabihi faqayyada bihi aljamala thumma taqaddama yataghaddaa ma'a alqawmi waja'ala yanzuru wafiynaa da'faaun wariqqaaun fiy alzzahri waba'dunaa mushaaaun iidh kharaja yashtaddu faaataa jamalahu faaatlaqa qaydahu thumma aanaakhahu waqa'ada 'alayhi faaathaarahu faashtadda bihi aljamalu faattaba'ahu rajulun 'alaa naaqaain warqaa'a ‏.‏ qaala salamaau wakharajtu aashtaddu fakuntu 'inda wariki alnnaaqaai ‏.‏ thumma taqaddamtu hattaa kuntu 'inda wariki aljamali thumma taqaddamtu hattaa aakhadhtu bikhitaami aljamali faaanakhtuhu falammaa wada'a rukbatahu fiy alaardi akhtarattu sayfiy fadarabtu raasa alrrajuli fanadara thumma jiitu bialjamali aaquwduhu 'alayhi rahluhu wasilaahuhu faastaqbalaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalnnaasu ma'ahu faqaala ‏"‏ man qatala alrrajula ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa abnu alaakwa'i ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ lahu salabuhu aajma'u ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been reported by Salama b. al-Akwa':We fought the Battle of Hawazin along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). (One day) when we were having our breakfast with the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him), a man came riding a red camel. He made it kneel down, extracted a strip of leather from its girth and tethered the camel with it. Then he began to take food with the people and look (curiously around). We were in a poor condition as some of us were on foot (being without any riding animals). All of a sudden, he left us hurriedy, came to his camel, untethered it, made it kneel down, mounted it and urged the beast which ran off with him. A man on a brown rhe-camel chased him (taking him for a spy). Salama (the narrator) said: I followed on foot. I ran on until I was near the thigh of the she-camel. I advanced further until I was near the haunches of the camel. I advanced still further until I caught hold of the nosestring of the camel. I made it kneel down. As soon as it placed its knee on the ground, I drew my sword and struck at the head, of the rider who fell down. I brought the camel driving it along with the man's baggage and weapons. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came forward to meet me and the people were with him. He asked: Who has killed the man? The people said: Ibn Akwa'. He said: Everything of the man is for him (Ibn Akwa)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 32 — The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِيَاسُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، غَزَوْنَا فَزَارَةَ وَعَلَيْنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَمَّرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَيْنَا فَلَمَّا كَانَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ الْمَاءِ سَاعَةٌ أَمَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَعَرَّسْنَا ثُمَّ شَنَّ الْغَارَةَ فَوَرَدَ الْمَاءَ فَقَتَلَ مَنْ قَتَلَ عَلَيْهِ وَسَبَى وَأَنْظُرُ إِلَى عُنُقٍ مِنَ النَّاسِ فِيهِمُ الذَّرَارِيُّ فَخَشِيتُ أَنْ يَسْبِقُونِي إِلَى الْجَبَلِ فَرَمَيْتُ بِسَهْمٍ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ الْجَبَلِ فَلَمَّا رَأَوُا السَّهْمَ وَقَفُوا فَجِئْتُ بِهِمْ أَسُوقُهُمْ وَفِيهِمُ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ بَنِي فَزَارَةَ عَلَيْهَا قِشْعٌ مِنْ أَدَمٍ - قَالَ الْقِشْعُ النِّطَعُ - مَعَهَا ابْنَةٌ لَهَا مِنْ أَحْسَنِ الْعَرَبِ فَسُقْتُهُمْ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُ بِهِمْ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَنَفَّلَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ ابْنَتَهَا فَقَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ وَمَا كَشَفْتُ لَهَا ثَوْبًا فَلَقِيَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي السُّوقِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا سَلَمَةُ هَبْ لِي الْمَرْأَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَعْجَبَتْنِي وَمَا كَشَفْتُ لَهَا ثَوْبًا ثُمَّ لَقِيَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْغَدِ فِي السُّوقِ فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ يَا سَلَمَةُ هَبْ لِي الْمَرْأَةَ لِلَّهِ أَبُوكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ هِيَ لَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا كَشَفْتُ لَهَا ثَوْبًا فَبَعَثَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ فَفَدَى بِهَا نَاسًا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَانُوا أُسِرُوا بِمَكَّةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa 'ikrimaau bnu 'ammaarin, haddathaniy iiyaasu bnu salamaaa, haddathaniy aabiy qaala, ghazawnaa fazaaraaa wa'alaynaa aabuw bakrin aammarahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaynaa falammaa kaana baynanaa wabayna almaa'i saa'aaun aamaranaa aabuw bakrin fa'arrasnaa thumma shanna alghaaraaa fawarada almaa'a faqatala man qatala 'alayhi wasabaa waaanzuru iilaa 'unuqin mina alnnaasi fiyhimu aldhharaariyyu fakhashiytu aan yasbiquwniy iilaa aljabali faramaytu bisahmin baynahum wabayna aljabali falammaa raaawua alssahma waqafuwa fajiitu bihim aasuwquhum wafiyhimu amraaaaun min baniy fazaaraaa 'alayhaa qish'un min aadamin - qaala alqish'u alnnita'u - ma'ahaa abnaaun lahaa min aahsani al'arabi fasuqtuhum hattaa aataytu bihim aabaa bakrin fanaffalaniy aabuw bakrin abnatahaa faqadimnaa almadiynaaa wamaa kashaftu lahaa thawbana falaqiyaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alssuwqi faqaala ‏"‏ yaa salamaau hab liy almaraaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi waalllahi laqad aa'jabatniy wamaa kashaftu lahaa thawbana thumma laqiyaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alghadi fiy alssuwqi faqaala liy ‏"‏ yaa salamaau hab liy almaraaaa lillahi aabuwka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu hiya laka yaa rasuwla alllahi fawaalllahi maa kashaftu lahaa thawbana faba'atha bihaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa aahli makkaaa fafadaa bihaa naasana mina almuslimiyna kaanuwa ausiruwa bimakkaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Salama (b. al-Akwa') who said:We fought against the Fazara, and Abu Bakr was the commander over us. He had been appointed by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). When we were only at an hour's distance from the water of the enemy, Abu Bakr ordered us to attack. We made a halt during the last part of the night to rest and then we attacked from all sides and reached their watering-place where a battle was fought. Some of the enemies were killed and some were taken prisoners. I saw a group of persons that consisted of women and children. I was afraid lest they should reach the mountain before me, so I shot an arrow between them and the mountain. When they saw the arrow, they stopped. So I brought them, driving them along. Among them was a woman from Banu Fazara. She was wearing a leather coat. With her was her daughter who was one of the prettiest girls in Arabia. I drove them along until I brought them to Abu Bakr who bestowed that girl upon me as a prize. So we arrived in Medina. I had not yet disrobed her when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) met me in the street and said: Give me that girl, O Salama. I said: Messenger of Allah, she has fascinated me. I had not yet disrobed her. When on the next day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) again met me in the street, he said: O Salama, give me that girl, may God bless your father. I said: She is for you, Messenger of Allah! By Allah.
